Please apply directly through Westminster University's Career Job Board .

About Westminster University:

Westminster University is a private, independent, and comprehensive university in Salt Lake City, Utah. For more than 150 years, Westminster has combined academic excellence with a strong sense of community and purpose. Located at the base of the Wasatch Mountains, the university offers the energy of a growing metropolitan area alongside world-class outdoor recreation just minutes from campus.

Our campus is collaborative, student-centered, and grounded in academic integrity. Faculty and staff work closely with students to foster critical thinking, career readiness, and meaningful engagement beyond the classroom. Employees are supported in their professional growth and encouraged to bring forward ideas that strengthen the university.

Westminster is committed to creating a workplace where people thrive – offering flexibility, generous time off, and a culture that values balance, inclusion, and innovation.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, the Director of Public Relations drives strategies for and implementation of a range of external communications and marketing projects. Working to build the university’s reputation and brand expression, this role leads communications and marketing strategy for the university’s programs and initiatives and supports student success through communicating the student experience to Westminster audiences and the public at large. This position leads a team of digital media and marketing professionals.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Four (4)years or more of work experience in communications, public relations, marketing, or other closely-related fields.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in communications, marketing, or a related field.
- Demonstrable experience with principles and concepts in public relations and media relations, and familiarity with marketing, social media, copywriting, photography, graphic design, audio and video production.

Preferred Qualifications:

- One (1) year or more of managing individuals who report to you.

Additional Requirements:

- May be designated as essential personnel in cases of campus closure or emergency.
- Extended hours, including evenings and weekends will be required.
- Ability to respond on-callas assigned, including evenings and weekends is required.

Responsibilities:

_Communications_

- Develop, manage, and execute a strategic communications strategy that elevates the visibility of the university and its leadership.
- Serve as the point of contact for media outlets and reporters. Field all incoming media requests and serve as the university’s spokesperson.
- Develop messaging and narrative structures for media campaigns and materials such as press releases, media advisories, and pitches.
- Responsible for news coverage monitoring, analysis, and internal visibility to continuously elevate and adjust communications strategies.
- Produce internal communications that build community and credibility, keeping the campus community engaged and informed.
- Lead the strategy and production of integrated multi-media content for Westminster’s website, social media channels, internal newsletters, enrollment platforms, and university publications.
- Develop and execute crisis and emergency communications plans for the university.
- Develop and plan for weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting on communications campaign performance and impact.

_Marketing_

- Lead the strategy and production of integrated multi-media content for Westminster’s website, social media channels, internal newsletters, enrollment platforms, and university publications.
- Develop and set social media strategy aligned to the university’s goals and strategic communications plans in coordination with the Digital Media Manager and Chief Communications Officer.
- Serve as a reviewer and proofreader of outbound marketing campaigns and materials to review brand and message alignment.
- Responsible for analyzing marketing campaign performance to determine effectiveness and make strategic optimizations for future campaigns.
- Develop and plan for weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting on marketing campaign performance and impact.

_Government & Community Outreach_

- In collaboration with the Chief Communications Officer, building relationships with relevant elected representatives at the local, state, and federal level.
- Leading legislative communications and updates to the campus community.
- Researching and developing relationships with community organizations, nonprofits, businesses, and other community partners for the university.

_Organizational & Administrative Tasks_

- Supervise the Marketing Manager and Digital Media Manager, providing regular feedback, guidance, and coaching, along with hiring and training as needed.
- Other duties as assigned.

What we offer:

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- Paid Parental Leave
- Paid Family and Medical Leave
- 403(b) Retirement Plan with a 5.5% employer contribution
- Tuition Remission (after a qualifying period of employment)
- 18 Paid Holidays Annually
- Cell Phone Plan Discounts

_Equal Employment Opportunity:_

Westminster University is committed to a diversified workforce, equal opportunity, and nondiscrimination. At Tecnica Group, every role—on the mountain, in the warehouse, or behind a desk—helps bring our vision to life: inspiring an active, outdoor lifestyle through great products and experiences. We're excited you're considering joining our team of passionate, driven people who believe in movement, adventure, and growth.

With over 60 years in business and a global family of brands— Blizzard, Lowa, Nordica, Moon Boot, Rollerblade, and Tecnica,— we're proud of our roots and excited about our future. Tecnica Group North America has about 100 team members across our U.S. and Canadian offices, all part of a worldwide team 3,400+ strong.

We’re not just a workplace—we’re a community that supports wellness, embraces curiosity, and values people from all walks of life. Our leaders are committed to helping you grow—professionally and personally—because we know that when you thrive, we all move forward.

Job Purpose:

Located in Salt Lake City, UT, the Digital Marketing Manager leads Nordica’s digital marketing and e-commerce presence in the United States, turning NorAm Go-To-Market strategy into strong domestic execution across the digital landscape. Reporting to the Nordica North American Business Unit Director, this role owns the campaign calendar, our e-commerce and CRM platforms, and the paid media, creative and PR partnerships that bring the Nordica brand to life for U.S. consumers.

This role is ideal for a hands-on marketing professional who wants real ownership across the full digital toolkit, from CRM and e-commerce to paid media, creative and PR, and the chance to shape how a heritage ski brand shows up for U.S. consumers. You’ll manage multiple workstreams, direct agency and vendor partners, and turn strategy into campaigns and digital experiences that are unmistakably Nordica.

GENERAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include, but are not limited to, the following:

BRAND & GTM STRATEGY

• Partner with the Business Unit Director, alongside the Trade & Community Manager, to shape NorAm GTM strategy and the direction of agreed NorAm Hero Product Categories.

• Develop integrated seasonal plans covering positioning, launch strategy, campaign architecture and ADV budget prioritization.

• Partner with the International Marketing team to maintain brand consistency and to secure and shape technical asset delivery that meets the US needs.

DIGITAL, E-COMMERCE & CRM

• Own the U.S. digital and D2C marketing strategy, working closely with the BUD and Sales Manager to align on consumer revenue growth plans and their relationship to the wholesale channel.

• Lead CRM onboarding for North America, owning the data model, segmentation and team adoption.

• Manage the U.S. site in partnership with the international web team, the trade and consumer email program, and digital analytics and reporting.

• Direct the Marketing Coordinator on the NuOrder B2B showroom (buildout, catalog management and digital assets), the marketing portal digital asset bank, and field CRM lead generation support.

CAMPAIGN, CREATIVE & COMMUNICATIONS

• Own the creative brief and approval chain for NorAm-originated work, including trade collateral such as catalogs and price lists, and direct Nordica’s creative agency.

• Own paid media strategy and manage the buy in partnership with our external agency and media partners.

• Serve as the U.S. lead supporting the SpA-managed social agency relationship, translating priorities into the content calendar.

• Own the master PR agency relationship (contract, budget, overall scope and escalation) and align quarterly with the Trade & Community Manager on the freeski sourcing workstream within that contract.

• Own English product copywriting, with scope direction from the International Marketing team and Product Manager.

• Own the master campaign calendar, integrating athlete, trade and community content supplied by the Trade & Community Manager.

BUDGET & PERFORMANCE

• Own the US ADV budget and resource allocation; report to the Business Unit Director, who holds P&L ownership and budget approval.

• Monitor campaign and digital performance, ROI and market insight, and adjust plans accordingly.

• Define the measurement approach for brand, digital and trade programs.

COLLABORATION

• Collaborate with colleagues across the North American organization to keep other departments informed and share best practices.

Experience/Education:

6+ years of marketing experience, including brand and campaign ownership, in the ski, outdoor or adjacent consumer industry, with demonstrated e-commerce and digital ownership and hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM platform. Hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Reddit, YouTube, Google Ads and programmatic buying, along with agency management across creative and PR. Go-to-market strategy experience and comfort contributing to GTM planning in close partnership with senior leadership. Strong personal execution capability across brand, digital and campaign work, comfortable operating with a small team and doing what’s needed to get the job done. Budget ownership and ROI reporting experience, with experience working with international brand teams and headquarters relationships. Strong understanding of the alpine skiing community.

Computer Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual should have advanced knowledge of MS Office software, with a strong command of MS Excel. Advanced use of marketing automation programs and CRM tools. Adobe Suite experience (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

Additional Skills:

• Communication skills: clear and persuasive written and verbal communicator; comfortable presenting to leadership, trade and agency audiences.

• Self-management: strong self-management and a proactive communicator across a distributed team.

• Versatility: comfortable moving between strategic brand work and hands-on digital execution.

• Interpersonal style: approachable and collaborative; active outdoor enthusiast preferred.

Physical Requirements:

Hybrid position based in Salt Lake City, in-office 3 days per week, with periodic travel to the New Hampshire headquarters. Also requires extensive travel domestically and abroad for events and tradeshows, with trips

lasting 7–10 days. General administrative tasks include sitting or standing at a desk, typing and use of computer. May require some lifting (up to 50 lbs. routinely, 75–100 lbs. occasionally) during travel, events and tradeshows.

About MarketStar

In everything we do, we believe in creating growth, for our clients, our employees, and our community. About the Account Executive Strategist - Reddit:

MarketStar is looking for an Account Executive Strategist to support our Reddit SMB advertising organization. This role serves as a dedicated optimization and performance resource that partners closely with Account Managers and SMB leadership to improve advertiser performance, uncover growth opportunities, and increase adoption of advertising products and best practices.

The Account Executive Strategist will provide strategic account support through performance analysis, optimization planning, and business intelligence. In addition to supporting individual advertisers, this role will identify trends across the SMB business and develop scalable recommendations that improve advertiser outcomes, influence business strategy, and drive revenue growth.

Location: Ogden, UT (Hybrid)

What Will You Do?

- Partner with SMB leadership and Account Managers to improve advertiser performance across high-priority accounts and strategic growth opportunities.

- Manage support requests submitted through a standardized intake process and prioritize work based on revenue impact, business needs, and available capacity.

- Conduct deep performance reviews to identify root causes of account challenges and develop data-driven recommendations that improve advertiser performance.

- Support revenue growth efforts by identifying optimization opportunities, upsell potential, and recovery strategies for underperforming accounts.

- Analyze advertiser performance across the SMB business to identify recurring trends and scalable optimization opportunities.

- Monitor adoption of optimization best practices and recommend actions that improve advertiser outcomes.

- Develop and document data-driven recommendations, case studies, best practices, and performance strategies that Account Managers can leverage during advertiser conversations.

- Curate successful optimization and advertiser re-engagement strategies that can be replicated across similar advertiser segments.

- Create and track opportunities resulting from SMB Performance Strategist engagements.

- Apply optimization best practices and recommendations shared by cross-functional teams and strategic partners.

- Share advertiser wins, performance insights, and scalable strategies across the SMB organization.

- Participate in regular reporting cadences to review accounts supported, revenue impact, ARPA growth, churn outcomes, and overall program performance.

- Partner closely with SMB leadership to ensure priorities, resources, and performance initiatives align with evolving business needs.

- Other applicable duties as assigned.

What Will You Need to Succeed?

- 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, account management, campaign optimization, performance marketing, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

- Experience reviewing advertiser performance metrics and developing optimization strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.

- Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or other reporting and analytics tools.

- Ability to analyze data, identify root causes, and recommend strategic actions that improve performance.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple teams.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Account Managers, leadership, and cross-functional partners.

- Experience identifying scalable opportunities and creating best practices that improve overall business performance.

- Passion for optimization, advertiser success, and continuous improvement.

- Other applicable criteria.

What We Offer

In our commitment to our “We Care” value, we believe in providing employees with valuable mental and physical well-being benefits including:

- Structured learning and career development programs

- Mental health program

- Generous Paid Time Off policy

- Paid medical leave

- Child/Dependent Care Reimbursement

- Education reimbursement

- 401(k) match, hardship loan program, and access to a financial wellness advisor

- Comprehensive healthcare coverage including medical, dental, and vision benefits

_MarketStar is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination. Reasonable accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you are an individual who identifies as someone with a disability and require reasonable accommodation(s) to complete any part of the job application process, please contact us at_ people.success@marketstar.com for _assistance._

All employees are expected to maintain a permanent residence within the State of Utah as a condition of employment. New employees must provide a valid Utah residential address within 30 days of their start date.

Job Summary

The Healthcare Sciences Pathways Coordinator manages day-to-day coordination of the Healthcare Sciences AS pathway program, serving as the primary connector between students interested in Health Science careers, SLCC Health Science programs and industry partners. This position coordinates program logistics and outreach, tracks and reports on program and grant performance data, supports proposal and grant reporting activity, and mentors student workers or peer navigators supporting the program. The Coordinator exercises independent judgment in setting outreach milestones and daily priorities within program goals set by the Associate Dean, and serves as the College's operational point of contact to industry and grant partners for this pathway.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities & Knowledge Skills & Abilities

Student Support & Guidance

- Serve as primary point of contact for students in the Healthcare Science AS program or Health Science pathway.
- Coordinate closely with faculty and administration to assist in management of the Healthcare Science AS program.
- Regularly communicate with students via phone, e-mail, SMS (text messages), and in person to provide clear direction and ensure access to institutional support services.
- Monitor students’ progress in completing prerequisite work, offering support and guidance to help them stay on track.

Matching Students with Institutional Resources

- Serve as a personalized resource hub, connecting students with academic advisors, tutoring services, faculty, admissions counselors and other institutional resources as needed.
- Connect students with institutional resources such as academic and career advising, tutoring, and career services to ensure they are adequately supported during their prerequisite coursework.
- Facilitate introductions to financial aid officers, admissions counselors, and other departments to help students navigate the logistical aspects of enrollment and move forward along their chosen career and college pathways.
- Work closely with admissions, advising, and academic departments to ensure seamless communication and coordination regarding student progress and readiness for program entry.

Program Collaboration

- Work closely with admissions, advising, and academic departments to ensure seamless communication and coordination regarding student progress and readiness for application to selective admissions programs or enrollment in non-clinical concentrations.
- Provide regular updates to Associate Dean, program coordinators, related dashboards, and other partners on student engagement, readiness and potential barriers to program entry.
- Work with students who were unsuccessful in their first-choice program through Selective Admissions to prepare them to re-apply or redirect to other opportunities that may be a better fit, including non-clinical health careers.

Program Coordination

- Coordinate day-to-day operations of the Healthcare Sciences AS pathway program, including scheduling, outreach planning, and logistics for student cohorts.
- Establish own outreach milestones and priorities in alignment with program goals set by the Associate Dean; exercise independent judgment to resolve routine to moderately complex program issues.

Partner & Grant Relationship Management

- Serve as the College's primary operational point of contact for industry and grant partners connected to this pathway, including sponsored-student and up-skilling initiatives.
- Support development and submission of grant proposals and reports; monitor program activity against grant deliverables and timelines.
- Prepare and present regular data updates and dashboards to the Associate Dean, program partners, and funders on student engagement, program outcomes, and barriers to entry.

Mentoring

- Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to student workers or peer navigators supporting the pathway program.

Other Duties as Assigned

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Commitment to keep the college accessible to a diverse urban population.
- Understanding of the Health industry and Health Science pathways programs at SLCC/SLTC.
- Ability to assess student needs and match them with appropriate educational resources and support services at SLCC and in the community.
- Excellent organizational and time management skills.
- Ability to work in a team setting.
- Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to address faculty, staff, partner, and student issues in a positive manner at the department or division level and in collaboration with other college departments, divisions, and administrators.
- Ability to build rapport with prospective students.
- Strong understanding of health science admission processes, pre-requisite requirements and student support services.
- Ability to communicate effectively with a broad range of people with a variety of abilities and backgrounds, to maintain good working relationships across the College.
- Ability to work with all groups from a variety of academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds, and with community college students, faculty, and staff, including those with disabilities.

Minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in education, health sciences, business administration, or a related field.
- One (1) to three (3) years full time (or part time equivalent) work in healthcare or related field.
- Knowledge of health care industry, workforce trends and upskilling pathways.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree in education, health sciences, business administration, or a related field.
- Experience developing or reporting on grant-funded programs.
- Experience with program management, digital communications and marketing, student advising, or career coaching.
- Experience in higher education, educational counseling, workforce development or related role.

SLCC Information

Salt Lake Community College is Utah’s largest open-access college in the state. We proudly educate 45,000+ students pursuing degrees in 100+ programs across 8 areas of study, and Utah’s fastest growing industries and four-year baccalaureate programs consistently welcome SLCC graduates. Every SLCC employee has a hand in transforming students’ lives to strengthen its surrounding communities. SLCC employees work at 8 locations across the valley and capital city of Salt Lake with easy access to the beautiful Wasatch Mountains, world-class outdoor recreation, sporting events, museums, history, and arts and entertainment.

Salt Lake Community College seeks and values contributions from each community member and welcomes new perspectives. A respectful work environment is its top priority; academic excellence and lasting transformation occurs when we can collaborate freely. As an emerging Hispanic Serving Institution, SLCC leads the state with the highest enrollment of students from the Latinx/a/o community. SLCC is committed to serving students and being a model for inclusive and transformative education.

Salt Lake Community College (SLCC) is fully committed to policies of equal employment and nondiscrimination. The College does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability, religion, protected veteran status, expression of political or personal beliefs outside of the workplace, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

SLCC is a participating employer with Utah Retirement Systems (“URS”). In addition to URS, SLCC offers several other retirement account options.

This position is subject to a successful completion of a criminal background check.

Avenue5 is growing, and we are in search of a regional manager to join our dynamic team of Fivers!

About Us

We are a vibrant third-party multifamily property management firm with locations across the United States. We are proud of our vibrant, inclusive, make-it-happen culture, where we:

- Listen to our associates, recognize them, and give them room to grow
- Invest in our associates to help them become the best version of themselves
- Approach every important decision with our associates in mind
- Celebrate our associates’ successes and encourage them to raise the bar even higher

About the Regional Manager Role

We’re looking for a talented regional manager who will be responsible for the overall operations of several properties, ensuring the efficient operations, overseeing vendor contracts and maintenance, lease administration, monthly reporting and ensuring a positive experience for the residents, associates and property owners in conjunction with the property leadership team.

Regional Manager Responsibilities and Objectives

- Oversees the operations of several properties including resident satisfaction and retention, full resident lifecycle activities (e.g., lease administration, rental collection and delinquency management), property P&L, and property marketing in accordance with company standards.
- Responsible for ensuring a high level of client customer satisfaction.
- Responsible for full associate life cycle including recruiting, mentoring, and performance management.
- Creates strategic marketing plans to attract and retain residents in conjunction with Avenue5 marketing team.
- Responsible for the properties annual budget, P&L statements, general ledger and creating necessary reports for the property owners and Avenue5 leadership.
- Understands the operations guidelines for each property established within the Property Management Agreement.
- Regularly inspect the property to ensure the highest level of curb appeal, office and maintenance operations, and competive market positioning.
- Responds to escalated resident complaints and issues and serve as liaison to residents and corporate office regarding the administration of common area maintenance and the enforcement of landlord rules and regulations.
- Oversees site natural disaster and emergency evacuation plans.
- Oversees the management of the property and associate safety records, property loss claims and risk management initiatives.
- Other responsibilities as assigned by management.

Education and Experience

- High School diploma or equivalent is required. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
- Five to ten years of property management experience is required.
- Three to five years of direct management experience is required.
- Prior experience in Yardi or another equivalent property management system is required.
- Real estate license as required by state or local law.
- Understanding of HUD and/or loan assistance process is preferred.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or related field preferred.

- Strong project management and organizational skills; experience with Monday.com or similar work management platforms is a plus.

Position Overview

Position: Marketing Manager

Location: West Jordan, UT

We're hiring a Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day marketing effort at Rust. You'll work with leadership to set priorities, then turn those priorities into campaigns, content, events, and tools that help our sales teams and manufacturer partners be more effective.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of variety: trade shows, manufacturer marketing, digital campaigns, content, sales materials, and our website. You won't be doing it alone. We already have marketing support, an internal development team, established manufacturer relationships, and leadership that is invested in making marketing a stronger part of the business.

Role & Responsibilities

Marketing strategy and planning

Work with leadership to set marketing priorities, including the markets we focus on, manufacturer lines we promote, how we position ourselves, and where we spend our time and budget. Then turn those priorities into action.

Trade shows and events

Manage industry shows, customer training events, and vendor events from start to finish, including booth logistics, pre-show outreach, lead capture, staffing, follow-up, and measuring results.

Manufacturer and vendor marketing

Work with our manufacturer partners on co-op marketing funds, joint campaigns, product launches, line cards, and literature. Make sure we're representing their brands well and taking advantage of the resources they provide.

Demand generation

Manage paid media, SEO, email campaigns, content, landing pages, and list building. Track performance and understand what these efforts are producing.

Sales enablement

Create and manage line cards, spec sheets, case studies, presentations, and other materials our sales teams use in the field. The goal is simple: give our salespeople tools that are useful and that they actually want to use.

Swag, literature, and fulfillment

Manage Rust and vendor swag, printed literature, and line cards. Forecast what our sales teams and branches will need, coordinate orders, work with vendors, and keep materials organized and available.

Brand and content

Maintain a consistent voice and look across everything we put out, including customer stories, LinkedIn, newsletters, website content, and PR where it makes sense.

Measuring results

Track things like pipeline contribution, cost per lead, cost per quote, campaign performance, and where our marketing dollars are going.

What makes this role different

Manufacturer partnerships are a big part of the job

We're a partner-led business, so working with our manufacturer partners is an important part of marketing here. That includes brand standards, co-op dollars, product launches, joint campaigns, and other marketing programs.

Experience on the manufacturer or distributor side is a plus, but it's not required.

Qualifications & Profile

We're flexible on how you got here. Any of these could be a good fit:

- Marketing management at an industrial distributor, manufacturer's representative, manufacturer, or another technical industry
- A strong marketing specialist or manager at a larger industrial company who's ready for more responsibility
- Agency experience serving industrial clients, if you're ready to come in-house and work more directly with the business and its results

Deep trade show and event experience is a real plus. So is experience working with manufacturer partners and joint marketing programs.

A relevant degree, equivalent experience, or a track record that speaks for itself can all work here. We care more about what you've built and how you work than exactly where you learned it.

You like people.

This job puts you in front of customers, manufacturer partners, and our own team constantly. Trade show floors, booth duty, dinners, meetings, and plenty of conversations. It isn't a desk job with a campaign calendar.

You finish things.

There are a lot of moving pieces in marketing. You need to be organized, keep things moving, close loops, and follow through.

You take responsibility.

You'll have support and a solid foundation to work from, but you'll be responsible for keeping your areas moving and making sure things get done.

You bring ideas and can execute them.

We want someone who will look at what we're doing and find ways to make it better. At the same time, you'll need to be comfortable taking an established program and executing it well without feeling like everything needs to be redesigned first.

You're comfortable with technical people.

You don't need an engineering degree. You do need to be curious about what a flow meter or control panel actually does and comfortable sitting down with an engineer and asking questions.

You're honest about the numbers.

If a campaign didn't work, tell us. We'd rather learn from it than find a way to make the numbers look better.

Benefits & Perks

- Stability: Join a family-owned company with a long-standing reputation.
- Growth Opportunities: Access to a wide range of training programs.
- Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan with company match.
- Culture: Be part of a motivated and collaborative team in a company that values its people.

Is This You?

Do you:

- Enjoy working with a motivated team that provides the best solutions for customers?
- Exemplify what "great" looks like in your work?
- Thrive on solving problems and tackling challenges?

If you said YES to these questions we want to hear from you! Join the Rust Automation & Controls family and help us make a difference for our customers and teammates.

We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email [email protected].

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.What is a day in the life of a Senior Paid Media Manager?

- Set up and launch paid campaigns primarily across TikTok DTC and TikTok Shop, with additional support on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), aligned with brand objectives and target audiences.

- Develop and brief ad creatives (video assets, UGC-style content, copy, calls-to-action) built first for TikTok's platform, trends, and native formats — with Meta adaptations as needed.

- Optimize live campaigns to maximize ROI by adjusting targeting, creatives, bids, and placements across TikTok and Meta.

- Monitor daily performance metrics such as CPM, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and engagement rates at both the platform and account level.

- Conduct A/B testing on creatives, audiences, offers, and campaign structures — with a focus on TikTok's unique testing environment.

- Produce regular performance reports with insights and recommendations spanning TikTok Shop, TikTok DTC, and Meta.

- Coordinate with creative and content teams to maintain a constant pipeline of TikTok-native assets and Meta-ready formats.

- Stay ahead of TikTok platform updates, algorithm changes, new ad solutions, and shopping features, while keeping a working knowledge of Meta developments.

- Troubleshoot tracking, set up conversion events, and maintain pixel health across TikTok Pixel and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

- Manage budgets and pacing across channels to ensure campaigns stay within spend targets and hit efficiency goals.

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- Minimum 4-6 years' experience managing TikTok Ads campaigns; Meta experience is a plus but not the primary focus.

- Strong, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Ads Manager and TikTok Shop ad formats — In-Feed, Spark Ads, TopView, GMVmax, and more.

- Working familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and core formats

- In-depth knowledge of TikTok-specific audience targeting, bidding strategies, and campaign optimization; solid foundational understanding of the same on Meta.

- Creative mindset with an intuition for what performs natively on TikTok — short-form video, trending sounds, authentic storytelling.

- Familiarity with pixel setup, server-side tracking, and attribution best practices across TikTok and Meta

- Experience with budget management, pacing, and multi-channel reporting.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What does high performance look like?

- TikTok campaigns — across both DTC and Shop — consistently achieve or exceed KPIs for ROAS, CPA, GMV, and engagement.

- Meta campaigns are managed efficiently and support broader brand performance goals.

- Proactive and timely execution of campaign launches, creative refreshes, and optimizations, particularly within TikTok's faster-moving environment.

- Data-driven recommendations surfaced regularly to internal teams and brand partners, with TikTok insights leading the narrative.

- Consistent adoption and testing of new TikTok ad formats, Shop features, and beta opportunities, with Meta learnings incorporated where relevant.

What is my potential for career growth?At Pattern, we are committed to employee development and recognize high performance. In this role, you will develop deep expertise in TikTok's commerce and paid social ecosystem — one of the fastest-growing areas in digital marketing — while building well-rounded paid media experience through Meta. Advancement may include progression to senior management, a specialized TikTok Shop or Paid Social lead role, or cross-functional opportunities within Pattern. You will have access to professional development resources, mentorship, and regular feedback to help guide your path.What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

First 30 days: Learn Pattern's systems, platforms, and workflows. Get fully oriented across active TikTok and Meta campaigns, accounts, and reporting cadences. Build relationships with your team, creative partners, and brand contacts.

First 60 days: Take ownership of day-to-day campaign management, optimization, and reporting — with a focus on TikTok DTC and TikTok Shop. Contribute to creative briefs and begin making data-driven recommendations for improvement across channels.

First 90 days: Independently manage campaigns end-to-end, with TikTok as your primary channel and Meta as a strong secondary. Consistently deliver on KPIs, bring forward new ideas for TikTok strategy or platform features, and be recognized as a reliable partner by your peers and brand contacts.

What is the team like?

- You will work alongside other TikTok Shop and Paid Social managers and be supervised by the Associate Director, Paid Social & Creative Strategy, with mentorship from the Head of Accounts for TikTok Shop. This is a data-driven, results-oriented team with a strong TikTok-first mindset. Collaboration is built into the workflow — you'll regularly partner with creative, analytics, and account teams to drive results, and your ideas and input are actively encouraged.

Sounds great! What's the company culture?

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner's expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern's talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Discuss professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Provide insights on how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern
- Share experience on any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

- Unlimited PTO
- Paid Holidays
- Onsite Fitness Center

We are searching for a Manager Lifecycle Marketing to join our Seriously Nice™ Marketing team. This role combines strategic and analytical thinking with hands on execution, someone equally comfortable analyzing performance data and crafting the messaging that reaches our Guests. You will own the full lifecycle marketing program across email, SMS, and push, from planning and segmentation through execution and reporting.

Here’s what you’ll do

Strategy & Lifecycle Management

- Own the email, SMS, and push marketing program, including planning, lifecycle design, prioritization, and execution, in support of acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue goals.

- Design and manage ongoing lifecycle journeys, including welcome, reengagement, win back, post purchase, and Loyalty.

- Develop and refine audience segmentation to personalize messaging based on behavior, engagement level, lifecycle stage, and product affinity.

- Maintain the campaign roadmap and content calendar, leading initiatives from concept through deployment, coordination with cross functional partners, managing timelines, and resolving dependencies.

- Guide the creation of email assets, including drafting copy, developing creative briefs, and partnering closely with Copy and Design to build on brand creative that drives conversions and engagement.

- Collaborate with marketing and other commercial teams to develop strategies that align with Breeze's overall brand, marketing, and business goals.

- Build and maintain scalable, production ready HTML email templates.

- Perform the operational tasks required to launch campaigns, including audience setup, journey configuration, scheduling, and final pre send validation.

- Establish rigorous project management and operational processes to ensure sends are accurately built, reviewed, tested, and deployed on time.

- Implement and optimize automation workflows, including welcome series, drip campaigns, and transactional sends.

- Support the selection and strategy for new ESPs, CDPs, and marketing platforms, coordinating with partners across teams to ensure a smooth transition.

- Establish best practices for email, SMS, and push campaigns, including cadence, message testing, and opt in and opt out management.

- Act as an organization wide resource for email, SMS, and push notification best practices, providing guidance on transactional and Guest notification strategy as needed.

Testing, Performance & Analytics

- Monitor campaign and lifecycle performance, using data and analysis to identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.

- Analyze key performance metrics and produce clear, actionable readouts and recommendations that inform campaign and program decisions.

- Lead A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, send times, content, and journey logic to improve engagement and growth.

- Help define and track key metrics for audience growth, engagement, and retention.

- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality and delivery issues related to ESP performance and reporting.

- Monitor deliverability and implement strategies to maintain a high inbox placement rate.

Guest Data & Compliance

- Use Guest data to segment Breeze's subscriber lists based on demographics, geography, behavior, and preferences.

- Manage and maintain subscriber lists across email, SMS, and push, ensuring accuracy and compliance with data protection regulations.

- Implement list hygiene practices to improve deliverability and engagement.

- Make sure every send complies with spam and email marketing regulations (CAN-SPAM), TCPA, carrier guidelines, and related best practices.

- Partner with Product, Technology, and Data teams to define requirements, resolve issues, maintain a working understanding of data feeds, and develop journeys and campaigns that support lifecycle, promotional, and automation goals.

Here's what you need to be successful

Minimum Qualifications

- Four year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in B2C email, lifecycle, or CRM marketing, with demonstrated experience building and managing multi layered, segmented journeys at scale.

- Hands on experience coding, building, and deploying HTML emails directly within an ESP such as Iterable, with sufficient proficiency to troubleshoot rendering issues.

- Deep experience with reporting and analytics, including Google Analytics and Excel, with a track record of connecting marketing activity to downstream revenue.

- Experience with marketing automation, segmentation, and personalization at scale.

- Understanding of CAN-SPAM, TCPA, deliverability, spam complaint rate, and related compliance standards across email, SMS, and push.

- Self-starter with a positive attitude and a strong desire to succeed.

- A track record of completing projects on time with minimal supervision, including a willingness to work varied hours when needed to meet deadlines.

- Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Iterable or a comparable ESP or CRM and lifecycle platform, with the ability to ramp up quickly on new systems.

- SendGrid and Figma experience a plus.

- PowerBI and Snowflake experience a plus.

- SQL experience a plus.

- Airline experience a plus.

Skills/Talents

- Strong sense of email, SMS, and push marketing fundamentals.

- Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a proven ability to adapt tone and style to brand needs.

- Strong project management and presentation skills, with the ability to think strategically while executing tactically.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.

- Collaborative and curious, with experience partnering across commercial, marketing, creative, analytics, ecommerce, IS, and data teams, while also working effectively independently.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.

- Exemplifies Breeze's safety culture, values, and mission.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.

- Ability to work with individuals and teams at every level of the organization.

Physical Demands & Working Conditions

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment

- Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds

- Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment

- Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision

Perks of the Job

- Health, Vision, and Dental for Full Time Team Members

- Health Savings Account with Breeze Team Member Match

- 401K with Breeze Team Member Match

- Generous PTO

Sr. Product Marketing Manager - Events (Remote)

❮ back to last search

RainFocus

Orem, Utah

Full time

REMOTECLOSING SOON

Apply for this job RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Sr. Product Marketing Manager - Events. About RainFocus:

RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies in the heart of Utah's Silicon Slopes, is in search of an exceptional Product Marketing Manager. RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly-growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Cisco, Oracle, Gartner, and VMware to prepare and execute events, each with tens of thousands of attendees, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing teams. We are well-funded, growing fast, taking on an established industry leader, and building a company that is changing the market—it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role:

As Senior Product Marketing Manager - Events, you will own go-to-market strategy for RainFocus's core events platform, the flagship product line our enterprise customers rely on to plan, run, and measure their largest, most complex events. This is a strategic seat, not just an execution one: you will act as a thought partner to product and executive leadership, translating raw platform capabilities into validated, persona-specific use cases and value metrics, not just a list of features. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Marketing and working closely with product, marketing, sales, and customer success leaders, you will have the opportunity to shape a disruptive platform in a hyper-growth business.

Does This Sound Like You?

You see connections between problems, business goals, and solutions that others don't see. You excel in a cross-functional environment, driving collaboration across departments and disciplines to get the best possible outcome. You execute relentlessly and are a force multiplier to others in that execution, and you genuinely enjoy coaching other product marketers rather than just carrying your own workload. You thrive on data and thirst to gather qualitative, quantitative, and anecdotal evidence through active listening.

You are an entrepreneur at heart, willing to take chances, able to lead through influence, and have strong opinions loosely held. You treat AI as more than a productivity trick: you experiment with it constantly, and you're just as interested in designing the systems that help an entire team move faster as you are in speeding up your own drafts. You'd rather build the process nobody asked for than wait for someone to hand you one, and you bring solutions to gaps before anyone assigns you to fix them. You attract attention through your wit, well-constructed arguments, and sense of humor.

You are not above the detailed logistics that need to be managed to make a product successful. You are not intimidated by working with very smart, very driven, and very technical people, and you love learning, unlearning old habits that no longer serve a growing business, and pushing yourself to do even better. You enjoy what you do, and that enjoyment spreads to those you work with.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Own go-to-market strategy for RainFocus's core events platform across the full customer lifecycle, from first evaluation through renewal and expansion, for our largest, most complex enterprise events.

- Partner directly with product and executive leadership to turn platform capabilities into validated, persona-specific use cases, rather than marketing features in isolation, working from real customer and market evidence instead of assumptions.

- Define and evolve positioning, messaging, and pricing strategy for the platform, including go or no-go and monetization recommendations for new capability combinations as they're evaluated.

- Lead planning and business readiness for major company moments tied to the events platform, including RainFocus INSIGHT and Sales Kickoff, in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.

- Support the sales enablement asset library for the core platform, keeping messaging, decks, and reference materials current across every major release.

- Conduct ongoing market, competitive, and customer research on the enterprise event management category, including proactively identifying trends like AI-powered capabilities or new pricing models, and distill it into insights that shape product strategy and roadmap decisions.

- Own the release and business readiness process end-to-end for new platform capabilities, ensuring marketing, sales, service, and support are all ready before customers see it, and own the full lifecycle of larger, multi-quarter strategic initiatives the same way.

- Collaborate with others to create compelling content across formats, release communications, presentations, webinars, video, and represent RainFocus as an engaging speaker at customer events, industry conferences, and company-run events.

- Serve as the source of truth for your product area's GTM plans and competitive research, keeping it current without being reminded, and proactively flag at-risk timelines well before they become a problem.

- Identify high-leverage opportunities to apply AI across the product marketing function, beyond your own workflow, and build the frameworks and systems that let the broader team operate at a higher velocity, whether that's competitive intelligence at scale or another team-wide bottleneck.

- Work directly with Fortune 500 event and marketing teams to understand their goals, challenges, and opportunities, and feed that insight back into the product roadmap.

Required Skills and Experience

5-10+ years of highly successful business-to-business software product marketing, or product management with a strong marketing bent.

Direct experience in the event management software market, or a comparable enterprise SaaS category with complex, multi-stakeholder buying groups and large-scale, high-stakes customer deployments.

A track record of building the business case behind a product bet, not just executing against a predefined feature list, including experience partnering with executive leadership on roadmap and monetization decisions.

Proven history of creating and delivering innovative products to market that are backed by business results.

Experience with SaaS companies working in an agile development environment with continuous delivery.

Strong understanding of sales and marketing tactics, dynamics, and processes, along with enterprise service models.

Comfortable owning large-scale, cross-departmental initiatives with minimal day-to-day direction: you surface and solve problems before being asked, rather than waiting to be assigned to them.

A genuine track record of coaching or mentoring other product marketers, with real interest in multiplying a team's output, not just your own.

Hands-on, active experimentation with AI in your own work, ideally with real examples of building a repeatable system or framework, not just using it to speed up a first draft.

Tireless, motivated, confident, and determined, with excellent communication skills, integrity, and judgment.

MBA or compelling comparable experience.

Location
This remote role can be located anywhere in the United States.

Why work at RainFocus?
At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities.

What are you waiting for? Apply today! _We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!_

Location and work arrangement: Hybrid — Essen, North Rhine - Westphalia, Germany, with roles across Germany. ### What people in these roles do day-to-day You will develop and deliver sales and/or marketing strategies aligned to revenue growth, pipeline targets, market share, and brand objectives. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike.  We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

- Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
- Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
- Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
- Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
- Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
- Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
- Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
- Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

Preferred Qualifications:

- Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
- Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
- Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
- Experience in retail revenue strategy

What does high performance look like?

- You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
- You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
- You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
- You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
- You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
- You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

- You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

- 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
- 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
- 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

What is the team like?

- You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

We want individuals who are:

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
- Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid Holidays

- Onsite Fitness Center

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Casual Dress Code

- Competitive Pay

- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.

Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Grants fund nonprofit work, but they also create some of the toughest operational challenges. Every grant brings its own deadlines, spending restrictions, reporting requirements, and commitments, so managing that complexity across fundraising, finance, and HR requires more than spreadsheets.

Instrumentl is the system of record for grants. We bring discovery, applications, award compliance, and grant operations into one platform, giving nonprofits a shared foundation to grow their revenue and impact. More than 6,000 nonprofits rely on Instrumentl, from local community groups to state and county governments, universities, and maybe even your local animal shelter.

We're a cash flow positive, YC-backed company building our next chapter, and we're hiring people who will shape and grow the impact of the nonprofit sector.

About the role:

We’re hiring a Marketing Ops Manager, reporting to the Revenue Operations Lead, to own the technical infrastructure that powers our marketing engine. This is a builder role. You’ll architect our marketing data model within our CRM, integrate new data sources, and implement AI tools across our marketing programs. You’ll partner closely with our Product Marketing Managers (campaigns, launches), our Events & Community team (conferences, virtual webinars, community programs), and our Growth Product team (a high-speed engineering team focused on product signups and onboarding). You’ll act as the connective tissue for Marketing, Sales, and CS initiatives so every launch ships with the execution and reporting these teams need to operate in lockstep.

You’ll work alongside two other RevOps Managers and together, you’ll form the core team that makes our GTM motion efficient, scalable, and increasingly intelligent. This role is ideal for someone who is an equal parts systems thinker and hands-on builder, someone comfortable writing SQL queries in the morning and presenting a quarterly business review to leadership in the afternoon.

What you'll do:

Data Architecture & CRM Ownership

- Own and maintain our marketing data model in HubSpot, ensuring clean object relationships, consistent field architecture, and scalable structure as we grow
- Build and maintain data pipelines connecting external sources (product usage, event platforms, enrichment providers, ad platforms) into our marketing systems
- Establish data governance standards and ensure data quality across all marketing systems, from campaign attribution to lifecycle stage definitions
- Partner with Growth Product to instrument signup and onboarding events, ensuring product data flows cleanly into HubSpot
- Build and refine lead scoring and segmentation models based on conversion data and PMM feedback

AI Tooling & Automation

- Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI tools that enhance marketing productivity
- Build automated workflows that reduce manual work: enrichment on inbound signups, event follow-up sequences, intelligent nurture branching, and onboarding triggers
- Partner with Marketing team on adoption of new tools
- Stay current on emerging AI/automation capabilities and bring a POV on what to test next

Reporting & Analytics

- Build and maintain dashboards providing visibility into funnel health, channel performance, campaign ROI, event ROI, and signup-to-activation conversion. Bring a point of view on what the data is telling us
- Own the lead tracking and management funnel across channels (SEO, SEM, Social, AOE, events, etc.)
- Enable downstream optimization and experimentation, including A/B testing, performance modeling, and forecasting
- Document metric definitions, scoring logic, and attribution methodologies to ensure transparency across Marketing and GTM teams
- Partner with Growth Product and Marketing to define launch KPIs and stand up dashboards that give Marketing, Sales, and CS shared visibility

Integration & Tech Stack

- Own integrations across the martech stack beyond HubSpot (event platforms, community tools, ad platforms, enrichment, product analytics, data warehouse)
- Evaluate new tools and make build-vs-buy recommendations
- Ensure our marketing tech stack is lean, well-integrated, and delivering ROI

What we're looking for:

Required

- 3-5+ years in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a GTM Systems role at a B2B SaaS company
- Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM administration in Hubspot.
- Data architecture experience: you’ve designed or significantly improved a marketing data model and connected multiple systems
- Analytical mindset: you make decisions based on data and know how to measure whether a campaign or experiment is working
- Comfortable partnering with product and engineering teams

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with product analytics tools and how product event data feeds lifecycle marketing
- Experience with data enrichment vendors and intent data providers
- Experience supporting field marketing, events, or community programs
- Experience with BI tools or data warehouses

Who you are

- Builder mentality: You'd rather create a scalable system than do the same manual task twice
- Curious about AI: You're excited (not anxious) about how AI is changing marketing and you want to be the person figuring out how to use it
- Strong communicator: You can explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into system design
- Ownership-oriented: You don't wait to be told what to do. You see a gap, propose a solution, and drive it forward
- Collaborative: You know that the best systems are built in partnership with the people who use them whether that's a PMM, an Events Manager, or a Growth Product engineer

Compensation & Benefits

For US-based candidates, the target salary range for this role is $130,000–$155,000 base + quarterly performance bonus (10–15% of base) plus equity. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skillset, scope of responsibility, interview performance, and geographic location. We’re committed to paying competitively and equitably.

Benefits

- 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (50% for dependents)
- Generous PTO, including parental leave
- 401(k)
- Company laptop and home-office stipend
- Bi-annual company retreats

Instrumentl is evolving rapidly. You’ll always have new challenges and opportunities to grow here.

_Instrumentl is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know._

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.

The Senior Digital Marketing Manager at Fullscript will lead the strategic planning, execution, and optimization of high-impact digital advertising campaigns to drive customer acquisition, retention, and engagement. This senior role will take ownership of the overall digital paid strategy across programmatic, Display Advertising, Paid Search, and Search Engine Marketing (SEM). You will oversee the full lifecycle of digital programs—from planning to performance analysis—working alongside a small team and external agency toward Fullscript’s growth objectives.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and strategic marketing leader who can balance hands-on campaign management with long-term strategic vision. You will shape Fullscript’s paid digital approach, mentor a growing team, and continuously evolve how Fullscript connects with healthcare providers online.

What You'll Do

- Paid Digital Strategy: Includes Paid Search, Social, and Programmatic. Strategically drive planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns across platforms, focusing on customer acquisition. Ensure cohesive strategy across all channels.
- Campaign Management: While hands-on execution is managed by our agency, this role will be expected to optimize, and troubleshoot digital campaigns across the marketing funnel. Leverage market-leading DSPs, Meta, Google Ads, and Microsoft Ads to achieve Fullscript’s growth goals.
- Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze large data sets to pull meaningful insights related to campaign performance, and provide actionable recommendations to optimize results. Measure campaign success against KPIs to ensure maximum efficiency and ROI.
- Team Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with internal teams including marketing, creative, and data, while also managing external partners. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, ensuring the effective execution of campaigns.
- Client & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners, and cross functional stakeholders. Collaborate on strategy and planning for campaigns as part of Fullscript’s broader marketing mix.
- Process Improvement: Actively contribute to the development and enhancement of Fullscript’s paid digital capabilities. Identify and implement process improvements to automate and streamline workflow to ensure efficient high-quality campaign delivery.
- Budget Management: Oversee paid digital budget management, including spend delivery, invoicing, investment, and margin tracking. Help drive profitability within the department while ensuring campaign efficiency and performance.

What You'll Bring
