About The role.

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager — Paid Media & Digital Execution to own the execution and optimization of paid media campaigns across Findem's business.

This is a highly execution-focused role. You will partner closely with Growth Engineers and marketing stakeholders who define campaign strategy, while you bring that strategy to life by building, launching, managing, and optimizing campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, retargeting, and other paid channels.

You will also own paid media performance visibility and reporting, execute newsletters and always-on nurture programs in HubSpot, and support Growth Engineers with campaign-level workflow setup.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on in advertising platforms, optimizing campaigns, solving execution challenges, and ensuring marketing programs run smoothly and reliably.

What You Will Do

What You Will Do

Paid Media Execution & Optimization

- Build, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, retargeting, and other relevant paid channels.
- Translate campaign strategies and briefs into high-quality, live campaigns.
- Manage campaign setup, targeting execution, budget pacing, bidding, creative testing, and ongoing optimization.
- Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve platform-level efficiency.
- Ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on time, and with appropriate quality checks.
- Manage and optimize campaigns against agreed campaign objectives and performance benchmarks.
- Support multiple business units and campaigns while effectively managing competing priorities.

Paid Media Performance & Reporting

- Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date reporting on paid media performance.
- Track and communicate key channel and campaign metrics, including spend, CPC, CTR, efficiency, quality signals, and other relevant performance indicators.
- Ensure Growth Engineers and marketing stakeholders have a clear and trustworthy view of paid media performance.
- Surface platform-level performance insights, benchmarks, and cost data to support advertising and budget discussions.
- Monitor campaign and tracking hygiene and flag potential issues impacting campaign performance or visibility.

HubSpot, Newsletter & Nurture Execution

- Build and send company newsletters using content provided by the Content and Marketing teams.
- Manage general and always-on nurture programs in HubSpot.
- Build and maintain lists, segmentation, campaign sends, and workflows.
- Support Growth Engineers with campaign-specific HubSpot workflow setup and maintenance.
- Monitor workflows and troubleshoot execution issues when required.
- Ensure reliable campaign and nurture delivery, including attention to deliverability and engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Growth Engineers to execute paid media strategies and campaign briefs.
- Work with the GTM Engineer to ensure campaigns follow established tagging and tracking standards.
- Flag tracking, campaign hygiene, and execution issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
- Partner with the Content Manager and Marketing team to execute newsletters, nurture programs, and paid campaigns.
- Manage relationships with advertising platforms and vendor representatives, including Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.

Campaign Operations & Quality

- Ensure accurate campaign setup, tracking, and tagging across paid media platforms.
- Apply established campaign tracking and attribution standards.
- Perform campaign quality checks before and after launch.
- Troubleshoot platform, workflow, delivery, and execution-related issues.
- Maintain organized documentation and processes related to recurring campaign activities.
- Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Required Skills & Experience

- 4+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid media campaigns.
- Strong experience working with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
- Experience managing paid media campaigns with real budget and optimization responsibility.
- Strong understanding of paid media metrics, including CPC, CTR, conversion metrics, budget pacing, and channel efficiency.
- Hands-on experience launching, monitoring, testing, and optimizing campaigns.
- Working experience with HubSpot, including campaign setup, workflow building, list segmentation, and email sends.
- Experience supporting retargeting and multi-channel paid media campaigns.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring, deadline-driven work.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- Comfortable working as an execution partner and translating campaign strategy into high-quality execution.

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience working in an agency environment or managing an external paid media agency.
- Experience working in B2B SaaS or high-growth technology companies.
- Experience supporting multiple business units, products, or marketing teams.
- Familiarity with campaign tracking and tagging practices.
- Experience working closely with Growth, Demand Generation, GTM, or Marketing Operations teams.
- Experience managing relationships with advertising platform representatives and vendors.
- Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM workflows beyond basic HubSpot campaign execution.

What Success Looks Like

- Paid media campaigns are launched accurately, efficiently, and on time across active channels.
- Paid media performance is clearly tracked and reported, giving stakeholders a trustworthy view of spend and channel performance.
- Platform-level efficiency and campaign execution meet or exceed established benchmarks.
- Newsletter and always-on nurture programs run reliably and consistently.
- Growth Engineers can execute campaign strategies without being slowed down by campaign setup and workflow execution.
- Campaign tracking and tagging consistently follow established standards.
- Paid media execution is effectively managed in-house with strong operational ownership.

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst (Web Acquisition). Our Analytics team is looking for someone to take ownership of how conversion signal gets delivered, measured, and trusted across our paid web traffic. You will own the full chain from server-side postbacks and click-ID capture to UTM taxonomy and affiliate reconciliation, catch measurement gaps before they hit spend, and turn conversion and funnel data into dashboards and recommendations that our marketing and User Acquisition teams act on daily. It's a hands-on role for someone who treats SQL, BI, and Python as everyday tools, is comfortable testing hypotheses alongside performance marketers, and wants their analysis to directly shape how we scale acquisition across millions of users in Tier-1 and international markets.

About the company: United Tech is a global IT product company shaping the future of real-time social connection. With millions of users across North America, Europe, LATAM, and MENA, we build next-gen mobile and web apps for live-streaming and social networking. Our platforms enable connection at scale - fast, interactive, and deeply engaging. The market is projected to exceed $206B by 2030, and we are already leading the evolution. Founded in Ukraine, scaling worldwide.

Know someone perfect for this role? Recommend a candidate and receive a $2000 bonus!

In this role, you will

- Own conversion signal delivery end to end: S2S postbacks per channel, event mapping, deduplication across event sources, and match-quality diagnostics

- Own identity and match quality: hashed first-party data used for matching, click-ID capture and persistence from landing page to CRM to payment

- Own what we optimize toward: value-based bidding, conversion value modelling, event taxonomy and attribution windows

- Work across channel specifics: Google Ads conversion diagnostics, Enhanced Conversions, offline conversion import, gclid/gbraid/wbraid and Consent Mode; Meta Conversions API, EMQ and deduplication; TikTok/Snapchat Events API and ttclid/sccid; AppLovin AXON Conversion API; Mintegral tracking URLs, UTM capture and S2S postbacks; affiliate postback integrations, click and sub-ID passing, conversion validation

- Build monitoring and alerts for signal errors, latency, coverage, match rates and platform-vs-internal discrepancies

- Investigate signal-related performance drops and assess the measurement impact of site releases and ad-platform changes before they hit spend

- Own UTM taxonomy and campaign naming conventions across all channels, with automated validation

- Own affiliate measurement: deduplication between partner postbacks and paid channels, attribution windows and overlap rules, conversion validation and payout accuracy, partner-level quality and fraud controls

- Analyze campaign and partner performance and traffic quality by channel, campaign, creative, geo and placement, including landing-page and checkout funnel conversion, lead quality, repeat purchase, LTV and payback

- Find growth points in CAC, ROAS and payback and turn them into recommendations the UA and affiliate teams can act on

- Test optimization hypotheses with UA: bidding strategy, which conversion to optimize for, conversion value definitions, audience and creative structures

- Build automated Tableau dashboards and ad-hoc reports on conversion values, bidding performance, signal delivery, partner payouts and funnel metrics

- Build and maintain custom marketing datasets in BigQuery on top of network, GA4, affiliate and CRM data

It's all about you

- 3+ years of experience in marketing or product analytics, with hands-on ownership of paid acquisition data

- Confident SQL in BigQuery

- Solid understanding of statistics: funnel conversion, sample size, telling a real difference from noise

- Python (Pandas) for analysis and automation: data validation, conversion uploads, recurring pipelines

- Hands-on Tableau, from data model to dashboards the team uses daily

- Practical experience with server-side conversion delivery on at least one platform: Meta CAPI, Google offline / Enhanced Conversions, TikTok or Snapchat Events API, or affiliate postback integrations

- Understanding of web attribution and performance marketing: click IDs and UTM, attribution windows, why platform, GA4 and internal numbers disagree and which to trust for which decision

- Understanding of consent, first-party identity and cookie limitations, and what they do to measured conversions

- Experience collaborating with User Acquisition teams and supporting data-driven decisions

- Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

- Ability to identify root causes of changes, not just describe the numbers

- Ability to build and defend clear business conclusions and recommendations

- Proactive mindset and strong communication skills

Would be a plus

- Experience with A/B testing

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude in your analytical work

- Experience with affiliate / performance-partner measurement: S2S postbacks, sub-ID structures, conversion validation

What we offer

Care and support:

- 20 paid vacation days, 15 sick leave days, and 6 additional days off for family events

- 100% medical insurance coverage

- Sports and equipment reimbursement

- Team building events, corporate gifts, and stylish merch

- Financial and legal support

- Maternity Recovery Support Allowance

- Position retention and support for those who join the Armed Forces of Ukraine

- Participation in social initiatives supporting Ukraine

Comfortable working environment:

- Work from our Kyiv hub or remotely with a flexible schedule

- Modern equipment or depreciation of your own tools

Investment in your future:

- Collaborate with a highly-skilled team of Middle & Senior professionals, sharing practical cases and expertise in the social networking niche

- 70% of our heads and leads have grown into their roles here – so can you!

- Performance-oriented reviews and Individual Development Plans (IDPs)

- Reimbursement for professional courses and English classes

- Access to premium AI tools and technologies

- Corporate library, book club, and knowledge-sharing events

Hiring process

- Intro call
- Technical Interview

- Offer

714.FireCrawl Job Description: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Sr. Product Marketing Manager - Audience Engagement. About RainFocus: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies in the heart of Utah's Silicon Slopes, is in search of an exceptional Product Marketing Manager. RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly-growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Cisco, Oracle, Gartner, and VMware to prepare and execute events, each with tens of thousands of attendees, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing teams. We are well-funded, growing fast, taking on an established industry leader, and building a company that is changing the market—it will be challenging, fun, and exciting. About the Role: As the Senior Product Marketing Manager -Audience Engagement you will drive a key RainFocus product line serving as the go-to-market bridge between our event data and the Revenue Action Orchestration (RAO) ecosystem. You will lead cross-functional teams to define business cases, align solutions, and ensure successful market delivery. Reporting to theDirector, Product Marketing you will work closely with product, marketing, and customer success leaders to lead our go-to-market strategy. \n Does This Sound Like You? You multiply the efforts of those around you by coaching peers and fostering cross-departmental collaboration. You are an entrepreneurial leader who takes calculated risks and holds strong opinions loosely. You get excited about a combining event with digital intent signals into holistic CDPs to drive account expansion You communicate with well-constructed arguments and a sense of humor. You happily manage detailed logistics to ensure product success. You identify process gaps, connect unseen business problems to solutions, and build self-driven initiatives. Sales alignment and enablement. Own the operating cadence with the sales team: shared account lists, handoff SLAs, and joint ownership of go to market strategy. Partner with sales to plan and deliver content matched to every stage of the sales cycle, from early education through late stage proof points, so reps always have the right asset to move a deal forward. Attribution and budget partnership. Maintain a defensible, auditable view of what spend produces (anchored in Salesforce and Marketo), quantify the bookings marketing sources and influences, and partner directly with the CMO on building, defending, and reallocating the department budget. Team leadership. Manage a paid media manager, a team of demand and integrated marketing managers, and a lifecycle marketing manager, all against an efficiency target rather than a flat activity budget. You'll also be asked to build out an autonomous AI layer across the function. Martech and AI partnership. Partner with Marketing Technology leadership on the tools and AI systems the team runs on, setting the standard for how the team uses AI without compromising brand judgment or data integrity. Ground strategy in qualitative signal, sales calls, win and loss themes, account feedback, not only dashboards. Have already owned a hard efficiency or ROI target in front of leadership, not just an activity or awareness target. Can point to a motion you already rebuilt in response to new tooling or buyer behavior. Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. At elk Marketing, we’re a fast-growing digital agency serving brands like HexClad, goodr, and Built Bar with sharp, high-performance SEO, Paid Search, and Paid Social strategies. We're looking for a strategic SEO leader who can influence agency direction, own enterprise client growth strategies, communicate effectively up and down the client chain of command, mentor other strategists, and help shape the future of SEO at elk Marketing. This role blends advanced SEO expertise with business consulting, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to drive measurable growth for some of our largest clients.

This is a role for an experienced SEO professional who’s excited to lead strategic work, share ideas that push the department forward, and support the growth of teammates along the way. You’ll collaborate with Account Executives, Paid Media Strategists, Content Teams, and Development Teams to execute strategy and deliver performance-driven results.

What You’ll Do

In Your First 30 Days:

- Onboard with our SEO team, tools, systems, and clients

- Get up to speed on the accounts you'll be supporting by reviewing existing strategies, campaign roadmaps, content calendars, and recent performance

- Shadow other SEO team members (Senior SEO Strategists and SEO Managers) and join client calls to understand our workflow, client needs, and cross-team dynamics

- Join internal SEO team syncs and begin 1:1s with your manager

By Day 60:

- Own ongoing SEO strategy and reporting across your assigned client load
- Begin presenting performance insights and strategic roadmap updates in a way that feels authentic to your style

- Review SEO Specialist work for quality, consistency, and alignment with strategy

- Collaborate with SEO Managers to ensure specialty areas are accounted for within your strategy (content, technical, local- if applicable)

- Join company-wide internal team meetings such as All Hands and Team Syncs

By Day 90:

- Lead SEO strategy and reporting across all assigned accounts with confidence

- Support roadmap planning, content calendar planning, and contribute to client QBRs alongside Account Executives and Strategists

- Be a resource for training others on SEO strategy, whether it’s mentoring a teammate, supporting an internal promotion, or helping onboard a new hire

- Start contributing to process improvements and documentation that strengthen the SEO department

- Serve as SEO Team Captain on one or more internal initiatives, such as tooling audits, reporting improvements, or documentation projects

Your Day-to-Day as a Senior SEO Strategist at elk Marketing:

- Lead keyword research, site audits, content strategy, and campaign planning across your assigned clients

- Develop multi-month strategic plans that demonstrate exceptional foresight & prioritization, ensuring elk & client teams are aligned and executing strategic implementation effectively & efficiently

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Executives, internal and/or external dev teams, and the technical SEO team to implement SEO recommendations and maintain site health

- Identify upsell opportunities alongside Account Executives

- Create and present performance reports leveraging first-party & third-party data sources to tell a cohesive story of performance, deliver insights to results, and schedule the appropriate actions to course-correct or accelerate growth.

- Provide input on site structure, redirects, schema, and performance-related issues, working closely with internal and client-side dev teams

- Spot trends across accounts, share learnings with the team, and recommend new tactics, tools, or testing strategies

- Lead complex technical initiatives including migrations, indexation strategy, and large-scale site architecture improvements

Additional Senior SEO Strategist Responsibilities:

- Serve as the executive SEO advisor and provide executive-level strategy during client planning and quarterly business reviews

- Lead training sessions on AI, GEO, Technical SEO, Off-page Authority Building, or Content Strategy

- Develop agency-wide SEO frameworks, processes, and best practices

- Mentor Strategists and Specialists while elevating the overall quality of SEO deliverables

- Partner with leadership on service development and innovation

You’re a Fit If You:

- Have 7+ years of experience in SEO, including agency or multi-client work, with at least 1+ year of deep SEO technical experience

- 3+ years leading strategy for enterprise or high-growth ecommerce brands

- Experience presenting to executive stakeholders

- Proven history mentoring team members

- Are excited by working directly with clients such as HexClad, Built Bar, and Taylor Made

- Naturally take initiative and enjoy mentoring others

- Think beyond execution and want to shape processes, tools, and workflows

- You bring a creative and critical approach to your SEO strategy

- You have an interest in ongoing education of our ever-changing field (GEO, AI Optimizations, LLM Optimizations)

- You’ve used Slack, Asana, Google Workspace (GSC, GA, GBP, GMC) SEMRush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and any content optimization tool (SurferSEO, Frase, MarketMuse, etc.)

- Want to grow into a leadership position within a collaborative team

Nice to Have:

- Experience leading or contributing to training programs
- Curiosity around measurement, testing frameworks, and marketing analytics

Interview Process We believe transparency sets the tone. Here’s what to expect:

- Recruiter Screen: A 30-minute call to go over compensation, benefits, elk Marketing, and the role

- Test Project: A take-home assessment where you get to show off your approach to SEO strategy.

- Panel Presentation Interview: A one-hour conversation with our Head of SEO or SEO Manager and a few elk teammates. You'll kick things off by presenting your test project to the team. Following the presentation, you can expect to engage in a deeper discussion about your experience, strategic vision, and career goals.

- One-on-One meeting with Department Head: Discuss the industry, share approaches & philosophies, gain additional clarity on the role, expectations, and values that have driven elk’s growth trajectory.

$95,000 - $118,000 a year

About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner.

With 6,200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact.

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.

Graphic Communications

This role is part of our Graphic Communications business unit, which serves the global print and packaging industry with ERP and production software designed for commercial printers, packaging manufacturers, promotional and transactional print providers, sign and display manufacturers, and in-plant operations. Our solutions accelerate performance by improving operational visibility, production efficiency, and profitability in complex, high-volume environments.

About the Role

CAI Software is seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Manager to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue growth for our industry-leading Graphic Communications Suites and workflow automation solutions. This role is critical in ensuring that our leading Print productivity and management software solutions, are effectively positioned in the market.

As part of the Marketing team, you will develop compelling product messaging, execute go-to-market strategies, and support sales enablement efforts to ensure our solutions help customers automate workflows, reduce waste, and improve profitability in the print industry.

You will collaborate closely with product management, sales, and customer success to translate technical capabilities into clear, value-driven marketing initiatives. Your expertise will help differentiate CAI Software’s Graphic Communications modular and scalable solutions from competitors and drive demand among commercial, packaging, and specialty print businesses.

What You'll Do

- Go-to-Market Strategy – Develop and execute product positioning, messaging, and launch strategies for Graphic Communication’s Print Productivity Suites and integrated workflow solutions.
- Sales Enablement – Create battle cards, presentations, and training materials to equip the sales team with compelling narratives about our solutions’ benefits.
- Market Research – Analyze customer needs, competitive trends, and industry insights to refine marketing strategies.
- Content Development – Develop thought leadership content, including whitepapers, blogs, case studies, and demo videos, that highlight how Graphic Communication’s solutions optimize print operations.
- Demand Generation – Collaborate with the marketing team to drive lead generation for core MIS platforms and productivity solutions.
- Customer Journey Optimization – Align marketing efforts with the print buyer's journey, ensuring Graphic Communications’ messaging is effective from awareness to conversion.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with product management, sales, and the channel team to align marketing initiatives with business goals.
- Channel Partner Marketing Support – Develop co-marketing initiatives, promotional materials, and enablement programs to help channel partners successfully market and sell CAI Software’s Graphic Communications solutions.
- Performance Tracking – Measure and analyze campaign effectiveness, making data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

- 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing or print industry technology
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or equivalent work experience
- Knowledge of Printing MIS, web-to-print, workflow automation, and AI-driven technology and productivity tools a bonus
- Strong storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex solutions into customer benefits
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and Google Analytics
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-starter with a results-oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
- Remote role with minimal travel as required

Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6,200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like — and we are building the team to lead that work.

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers — and how we work:

- Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
- Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays.
- Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance.
- Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
- Experience working independently on analytical tasks, building, and optimizing ‘big data’ pipelines, architectures, and data sets.
- Experience developing and delivering presentations using insights derived from analytics.
- Experience using data to solve complex business questions and demonstrate an awareness of the broader business impacts that drive business solutions.
- Account management and customer success skills, including strong written and verbal communication.
- Experience collaborating with others to implement change initiatives.

- Results Driven Understands the broader impact of a solution

- Creative Collaboration Develops a network of resources within AP and is gracious when others provide assistance
- Harnessing Innovation Works with manager and/or team to create and implement change initiatives

$80,000 - $115,000 a year

Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Grants fund nonprofit work, but they also create some of the toughest operational challenges. Every grant brings its own deadlines, spending restrictions, reporting requirements, and commitments, so managing that complexity across fundraising, finance, and HR requires more than spreadsheets.

Instrumentl is the system of record for grants. We bring discovery, applications, award compliance, and grant operations into one platform, giving nonprofits a shared foundation to grow their revenue and impact. More than 6,000 nonprofits rely on Instrumentl, from local community groups to state and county governments, universities, and maybe even your local animal shelter.

We're a cash flow positive, YC-backed company building our next chapter, and we're hiring people who will shape and grow the impact of the nonprofit sector.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Content Marketing Manager, reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, to build and run the content engine that turns nonprofit awareness into pipeline. You'll help tell our category story as Instrumentl evolves from a grant discovery tool into the operating system for grant-funded organizations, with writing that is versatile across both short and long form content, strategically designed across the full demand funnel and connects emotionally, moving people to act. This is a performance role, too: you’re passionate about measuring outcomes and using data to keep improving it.

What you'll do:

Versatile, conversion-first content

- Write compelling content across formats — long-form thought leadership, benchmark reports, one-pagers, ads, social posts & website content
- Have a POV on what types of messaging works best and adjust for each channel including social/digital/SEM/AEO
- Tell our strategic category story — why Instrumentl is becoming the operating system for grant-funded organizations, and why that matters to the people using it

Full-funnel strategy & execution

- Map content to funnel stage — awareness, consideration, decision — and build sequences that move nonprofits from first touch to customer
- Build and manage a content calendar coordinating campaigns in partnership with the broader marketing team
- Help executives and other internal thought leaders build a consistent voice and posting cadence on social — developing themes, calendar, and content that reflects each person's POV, not just amplifying the company page.

Data-driven performance marketing

- Understand our audience deeply — who they are, what they do and how we can meet their needs
- Track what's working and what isn't, and use those learnings to optimize
- SEO and AEO: Stay ahead of how generative and agentic search is changing how nonprofits find and evaluate solutions, and create content that moves the needle.

What we're looking for

Required

- 6+ years of experience in content marketing, performance marketing, or content strategy
- Recent experience with B2B
- Experience owning content across the full funnel, from top-of-funnel editorial to bottom-of-funnel conversion assets like landing pages and ad copy
- Strong command of SEM and SEO fundamentals, plus working knowledge of AEO/GEO and agentic search
- A performance mindset: comfortable with data and quick to turn results into sharper work
- Strong writer with sharp editorial judgment and an instinct for the emotional and practical reasons an audience acts
- Ability to quickly build subject matter expertise in a complex domain through research and SME interviews

Nice to Have

- Experience with nonprofit, social impact, or mission-driven organizations
- Background in grants, fundraising, or nonprofit operations
- Hands-on experience running or optimizing paid digital advertising
- Experience managing freelancers and agency relationships

Compensation & Benefits

For US-based candidates, the target salary range for this role is $ 125,000 – $150,000 USD, plus equity. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skillset, scope of responsibility, interview performance, and geographic location. We’re committed to paying competitively and equitably.

Benefits

- 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (50% for dependents)
- Generous PTO, including parental leave
- 401(k)
- Company laptop and home-office stipend
- Bi-annual company retreats

Instrumentl is evolving rapidly. You’ll always have new challenges and opportunities to grow here.

_Instrumentl is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know._

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director, Paid Media to help build P10’s media capabilities and deliver thoughtful, effective strategies for our clients. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will develop integrated media strategies, guide audience and investment decisions, and personally plan, launch, buy, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns. You should be equally comfortable presenting recommendations to senior client stakeholders and working directly in a DSP or other media platform. You'll report to the Head of Analytics.

The ideal candidate has deep paid media expertise, a strong understanding of healthcare marketing, and particular strength in programmatic media. You will also help expand P10’s capabilities across endemic, EHR, point-of-care, and emerging channels.

This role is open to fully remote candidates in the United States. Travel will be required up to 5%.

Responsibilities

Media Strategy and Planning

- Translate client objectives and audience insights into integrated media strategies, channel plans, budgets, forecasts, and learning agendas.

- Develop plans across programmatic, endemic, EHR, point-of-care, paid social, paid search, video, audio, and emerging channels.

- Build strategies that reach healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, office staff, access stakeholders, and the broader care team.

- Create clear recommendations that explain what P10 proposes, why it matters, and how the investment supports client objectives.

- Partner with Client Services, strategy, creative, technology, and analytics to integrate media into broader client planning.

Activation and Optimization

- Plan, build, launch, buy, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns across DSPs and other paid media platforms.

- Manage budgets, pacing, audience quality, frequency, inventory, creative performance, conversions, and other relevant indicators.

- Lead optimization decisions across audiences, channels, partners, bids, budgets, placements, and creative.

- Establish quality-control standards for campaign setup, tracking, launch, optimization, reporting, and billing.

- Ensure campaigns meet platform, privacy, client, and regulated healthcare advertising requirements.

- Translate results into clear recommendations that explain what happened, why it matters, and what should happen next.

- Apply campaign findings to future audience, channel, creative, and investment decisions.

Client Growth and Capability Building

- Serve as a trusted media advisor and present strategies, investment recommendations, performance findings, and future opportunities to clients.

- Identify opportunities to expand media engagements within existing client relationships.

- Lead or contribute media strategy to pitches, proposals, scopes, and capabilities presentations.

- Help evolve P10’s DSP and broader healthcare media capabilities.

- Evaluate programmatic, endemic, EHR, point-of-care, and emerging media partners.

- Design pilots and turn successful approaches into repeatable P10 offerings.

- Build scalable processes, tools, benchmarks, partner scorecards, and ways of working.

- Mentor and provide strategic and technical guidance to team members as the practice grows.

Requirements

- Healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical technology agency experience.

- Recent experience building, launching, optimizing, and troubleshooting campaigns within DSPs and other paid media platforms.

- Strong understanding of programmatic media, audience activation, inventory, bidding, optimization, brand safety, and frequency management.

- Experience developing integrated media plans, budgets, forecasts, and client recommendations.

- Working knowledge of paid social, paid search, video, audio, and other digital channels.

- Ability to move comfortably between strategic client conversations and detailed platform execution.

- Experience managing budgets, building client relationships, and contributing to business growth.

- Strong communication, presentation, organization, and problem-solving skills.

$130,000 - $150,000 a year

We provide base salary, discretionary bonus and benefits to our employees.

Interested in working with us? Apply online today.

Not an agency*

The layer-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego-driven dog-and-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.

P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different - join us.

apply for this job

HIGHER! is a new business branch of Crypto Banter on a mission to help people change their lives through dopamine-fueled, 1-7 day challenges across crypto, AI, trading & beyond.

Our challenges guide achievers through step-by-step transformations, checkpoint by checkpoint, delivering real wins and fast results. We’re building a community of achievers who level up together. We’re in the early stages and scaling rapidly. Our first challenge proved that the model works. Now, we’re expanding across multiple categories and hosts. As a new vertical, we focus on user acquisition beyond Crypto Banter’s current audience, challenges creation, and building a thriving community.

Everything we do is about helping people change their lives. Let’s go HIGHER!

Role Overview

We're looking for an analytical, numbers-driven Growth Marketing Manager to own the performance and execution of our Meta Ads strategy. You'll be responsible for scaling HIGHER! beyond our existing audience by masterminding end-to-end campaigns on Meta. You aren't just managing budgets. You're a creative strategist who knows how to warm up cold traffic through sophisticated funnels, from the initial scroll-stopping ad to the final product conversion.

What you'll do

- Own the full-funnel architecture: Design and own the entire user journey, from paid acquisition strategy through to the channels and funnels that support the challenge business. This means building end-to-end campaigns, high-converting landing pages and email sequences that carry a lead all the way to sign-up.

- Lead creative quality control: Own the hooks, angles and core performance copy. We don't run generic ads. You'll have a sharp eye for what makes creative work, partnering with designers and editors so every ad lands with the psychology of the target audience.

- Drive performance and ROI: Be fully accountable for the commercial outcome of your spend. You'll track metrics daily to make sure we're generating revenue rather than burning cash, shifting budget and tweaking funnel logic based on hard data.

- Set the audience strategy: Own the thinking behind the traffic. Identify new audience segments, run the warming strategy for our existing audience, and understand what someone is thinking when they click and how to move them through the funnel (simple quizzes, commitment hooks) to maximise conversion.

- Execute lifecycle journeys: Make the transition from Meta lead to challenge participant seamless. Own the tools and tracking that keep users engaged from first click through to the final product.

Your skills and experience

- Meta Ads specialist: deep, hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and a proven track record of scaling paid spend for info-products, webinars or digital challenges.

- Info-product mindset: you understand the story-driven nature of selling a challenge or transformation versus a standard SaaS product, and how to use urgency and value to drive sign-ups.

- Analytical and numbers-driven: you live in analytics and base every decision on data. You can spot a leak in the funnel before it hits the bottom line.

- Technical funnel builder: comfortable with Typeform, landing page builders and CRM software to build the infrastructure behind your funnels.

- Creative strategist: you can spot a generic ad from a mile away. You know how to brief and iterate on high-performance creative that stops the scroll and converts.

- Category experience: you've worked with audiences and campaigns across finance, crypto, trading, e-products or ecommerce.

- Direct communicator: you write and speak clearly in UK English, have a bias to action and thrive in a lean, high-output team where you own the results.

Nice to have

- Understanding of search/SEO and Google campaigns

- Exchange experience

- Understanding of trading

_Come for the Challenge. Stay for the Experience._

At HCVT, we believe every challenge presents an opportunity to positively impact our clients and people. Talented and ambitious individuals who seek limitless professional opportunities thrive at HCVT. Our team is known for its technical skill and ability to help clients address complex business issues all while investing in and supporting our people to provide a rewarding employee experience.

_What We Do and Who We Serve_

We offer Tax, Audit, Advisory, and Business Management services to our clients, which include private and public companies, high-net-worth individuals, and family offices. We also specialize in serving clients across the following industries: Private Equity, Real Estate & Hospitality, Media & Entertainment, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Manufacturing & Distribution, Professional Services Firms, Technology, Healthcare, Nonprofit Organizations, and Affordable Housing.

_We Live Our Core Values_

Our values guide us in our day-to-day interactions with our clients and each other—Integrity at our Core; Building Success Together; Passion for Excellence; and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion. We are focused and committed to the needs of our clients and our team.

_Discover How Far You Can Go._

Opportunities abound at HCVT. Our firm has experienced steady growth since its founding in 1991 and continues to expand its client service offerings, creating new opportunities for professionals to grow their careers. We make significant investments in training and provide interesting, diverse, and intellectually stimulating work for our teams—the kind of work that helps you develop and refine your skills to advance in the profession.

Hybrid Work

HCVT currently offers a hybrid work model that allows eligible employees to work both remotely and in the office, based on business needs and team coordination. When working remotely, employees are expected to meet the same performance standards, adhere to the same policies, and maintain the same level of communication, collaboration, and responsiveness as working in the office. Please note that this arrangement is not guaranteed and subject to change at any time. We will strive to provide reasonable notice of any changes to your work location or schedule whenever possible.

We are seeking a highly motivated and adaptable marketing professional to join our Growth team. This individual will play a critical role in supporting firm growth initiatives through proposal development, digital presence, and marketing execution, while also contributing to ongoing transformation efforts including the adoption of AI-enabled tools, automation, and innovative technologies that enhance marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency. This role plays a key role within a small, collaborative Growth team, supporting proposals, digital visibility, and marketing execution while contributing to process improvements and innovation initiatives.

This is a fast-paced, high-visibility role requiring a self-starter who can manage multiple priorities, respond to rapidly shifting demands, and collaborate closely with partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role, you will be responsible for, but not limited to the following:

Proposal Operations & Process Management

- Support proposal development with rapid turnaround times, including same-day or urgent requests.
- Manage proposal intake, prioritization, workflow coordination, and stakeholder communication.
- Partner with internal teams to develop clear, high-quality deliverables aligned with client needs.
- Contribute to improvements in proposal processes, including leveraging automation and AI tools.
- Track proposal activity and support performance reporting as needed.

Brand Visibility

- Partner closely with firm leadership, partners, and stakeholders to support growth initiatives and client-facing materials
- Assist with complex projects and initiatives tied to firm-wide branding efforts
- Support and execute website performance, optimization, design, and governance initiatives.
- Execute SEO and Answer Engine Optimization initiatives.
- Monitor keyword rankings, search visibility, and AI search performance.
- Develop recommendations to improve organic visibility and brand awareness.

Social Media & Digital Marketing

- Coordinate content planning and content calendars.
- Monitor engagement and campaign performance.

Reporting, Analytics & Business Intelligence

- Develop and maintain reporting frameworks across Growth initiatives.
- Create dashboards and reporting for proposal activities, pipeline visibility, event ROI, SEO performance, etc.
- Analyze performance data and identify actionable opportunities.
- Present insights and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

To be successful, these are the skills, qualities and experience you will need:

- 4+ years of experience in marketing operations, proposal management, digital marketing, or growth/BD operations within a public accounting or other professional services firm
- Experience supporting or executing proposal processes in a deadline-driven environment
- Experience building and maintaining reporting dashboards, analytics frameworks, and performance insights
- Strong understanding of SEO best practices, keyword strategy, metadata optimization, and search visibility
- Experience developing and managing social media strategy and content calendars
- Familiarity with HubSpot or other CRM systems
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, tight deadlines, and competing priorities
- Independent, organized, self-starter that will provide tactical and strategic support to partners and key leaders
- Ability to quickly establish rapport and credibility with partners and professional teams, including operations and administration
- Ability to work occasional overtime to support urgent projects or firm events
- Travel periodically to other HCVT offices to support the growth function as directed (10-15%)

You Matter - HCVT provides a variety of benefits and perks that help sustain a healthy and thriving work environment.

- Visit the Benefits section to learn more

This salary range is specific to the state(s) listed and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill set and education; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the range for this position is $80,000-$90,000 plus overtime.

Own the Alliance Narrative

- Build messaging that helps customers understand when and why to adopt Obsidian alongside partner platforms, and helps alliance partners position Obsidian with clarity and conviction
- Lead product marketing for joint launches, co-marketing campaigns, and major alliance field moments, coordinating across alliances, product, and marketing teams
- Support the GTM models behind each alliance, including marketplace, co-sell, and integration motions, with the positioning, content, and enablement they need to perform
- Create enablement that alliance sellers actually use: solution briefs, pitch decks, objection-handling guides, and co-branded campaign materials
- Drive co-marketing programs with strategic alliances that deliver measurable pipeline contribution and deal acceleration

- Elevate “how we do things” into “why it matters”: articulate why Obsidian’s architecture solves problems that point tools and adjacent platforms cannot
- Develop technical marketing content such as architecture narratives, technical briefs, blogs, webinars, and demos that proves differentiation rather than asserting it
- Bring competitive and market insights back into product, alliances, and executive planning to sharpen roadmap framing and GTM strategy

About You

- Technical to the core, fluent in the “why.” 8+ years in product, technical, or partner marketing in cybersecurity or enterprise software, ideally with a hands-on technical background.
- A competitive strategist. You have built compete programs and turn competitor analysis and win/loss data into positioning the field trusts. You know the difference between a feature comparison and a structural advantage.
- Experienced in technology alliance marketing. You have built better-together narratives, joint launches, and enablement with strategic technology partners, and understand marketplace, co-sell, and integration GTM motions.
- Fluent in the cybersecurity buyer. You know how security leaders evaluate and buy, and how to help alliance partners have that conversation on Obsidian’s behalf.
- Strategic, hands-on, and collaborative. You see the big picture but are comfortable writing, building, and shipping the work yourself, and you align alliances, sales, product, and engineering without owning all the decisions.

Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees’ well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy:

About this role

About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most – patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The Role

Nabla is looking for a Growth Marketing Director to join our team to lead marketing efforts that will first focus on Mid-Market segment: large physicians groups up to 400 providers, then expand into Enterprise and other verticals. Your mission: attract new customers, improve every step of their journey, and help steer our strategy with sharp, data-driven insights.

You’ll take full ownership of our core marketing channels from paid acquisition to email nurture to integrated campaigns with one goal: generate qualified leads, speed up our sales pipeline, and help more clinicians discover how Nabla is changing the way they work.

This is a strategic and hands-on role (individual contributor) setting the strategy and executing it. You’ll run experiments, launch and optimize campaigns, test new angles, analyze results, and move fast. Whether it’s rolling out a new paid campaign or launching a product GTM, you’ll adapt, iterate, and aim for impact every time.

Responsibilities

- Lead and execute digital-first programs that attract, convert, and nurture leads through the customer journey.

- Set up and scale our email marketing from scratch: build and automate lifecycle email journeys including onboarding, re-engagement, and nurture flows, using segmentation, behavioral triggers, and continuous A/B testing to boost engagement and conversion.

- Launch, manage, and continuously improve performance campaigns on social media and search platforms that are perfectly tailored to the right audiences and personas.

- Design and grow targeted ABM programs to connect meaningfully with decision-makers in our highest-value accounts.

- Brief and collaborate with design and content teams to create high-converting ad creatives, landing pages, and email assets that reflect Nabla’s brand and resonate with target personas.

- Orchestrate integrated marketing campaigns around product launches, events, and key initiatives making sure every touchpoint feels on-brand and consistent.

- Run A/B tests and experiments to optimize conversion across ads, landing pages, and emails and turn learnings into growth.

- Own growth analytics and campaign performance tracking the metrics that matter (CAC, CPL, ROAS, LTV, conversion rates, email engagement, etc.) and use this datas to constantly improve lead quality and ROI.

- Dig deep into data, market trends, and customer insights to uncover fresh growth opportunities and turn them into concrete action.

- Work closely w/ sales, customer success, and the marketing team to align on strategy and drive results together.

Qualifications

We are seeking candidates with:

- 5–8+ years of experience in growth, performance, or campaign marketing in B2B SaaS or digital health with a strong track record of launching and scaling high impact acquisition and retention programs.

- Hands-on and strategic marketer with deep experience in marketing automation platforms (Hubspot, Marketo, Pardot, Mailchimp) and CRM systems such as Salesforce with the ability to build and launch marketing campaigns from the ground up, from strategy through to execution.

- Strong understanding of lead generation strategies, conversion optimization and pipeline attribution.

- Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

- A self-starter mentality, with proven ability to thrive in fast-paced start-up environments.

- Excellent communication, project management, and collaboration skills.

- Team player who collaborates seamlessly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and external partners to align campaigns with broader business priorities.

- Bonus: Experience marketing to healthcare providers or enterprise health systems

_Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must be able to maintain authorization to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship, now or in the future. For this role, the Company is not able to sponsor, transfer, or extend employment-based visas or other work authorization._

Benefits

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

- Compensation, Equity & 401k: Competitive salary, stock options & 401k

- Comprehensive Health Plans: 100% individual coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

- Time Off: Unlimited paid time off and 11 national holidays

- Health Comes First: Unlimited sick leave

- Parental Leave: Paid leave for new parents

- Remote-friendly: $1,000 to purchase home office equipment

- Trust & accountability: Full ownership of your time and schedule

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do – caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

About Nabla

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The Role

Nabla is looking for a Growth Marketing Director to join our team to lead marketing efforts that will first focus on Mid-Market segment: large physicians groups up to 400 providers, then expand into Enterprise and other verticals. Your mission: attract new customers, improve every step of their journey, and help steer our strategy with sharp, data-driven insights.

You’ll take full ownership of our core marketing channels from paid acquisition to email nurture to integrated campaigns with one goal: generate qualified leads, speed up our sales pipeline, and help more clinicians discover how Nabla is changing the way they work.

This is a strategic and hands-on role (individual contributor) setting the strategy and executing it. You’ll run experiments, launch and optimize campaigns, test new angles, analyze results, and move fast. Responsibilities

- Lead and execute digital-first programs that attract, convert, and nurture leads through the customer journey.

- Set up and scale our email marketing from scratch: build and automate lifecycle email journeys including onboarding, re-engagement, and nurture flows, using segmentation, behavioral triggers, and continuous A/B testing to boost engagement and conversion.

- Launch, manage, and continuously improve performance campaigns on social media and search platforms that are perfectly tailored to the right audiences and personas.

- Design and grow targeted ABM programs to connect meaningfully with decision-makers in our highest-value accounts.

- Brief and collaborate with design and content teams to create high-converting ad creatives, landing pages, and email assets that reflect Nabla’s brand and resonate with target personas.

- Orchestrate integrated marketing campaigns around product launches, events, and key initiatives making sure every touchpoint feels on-brand and consistent.

- Run A/B tests and experiments to optimize conversion across ads, landing pages, and emails and turn learnings into growth.

- Own growth analytics and campaign performance tracking the metrics that matter (CAC, CPL, ROAS, LTV, conversion rates, email engagement, etc.) and use this datas to constantly improve lead quality and ROI.

- Dig deep into data, market trends, and customer insights to uncover fresh growth opportunities and turn them into concrete action.

- Work closely w/ sales, customer success, and the marketing team to align on strategy and drive results together.

Qualifications

We are seeking candidates with:

- 5–8+ years of experience in growth, performance, or campaign marketing in B2B SaaS or digital health with a strong track record of launching and scaling high impact acquisition and retention programs.

- Hands-on and strategic marketer with deep experience in marketing automation platforms (Hubspot, Marketo, Pardot, Mailchimp) and CRM systems such as Salesforce with the ability to build and launch marketing campaigns from the ground up, from strategy through to execution.

- Strong understanding of lead generation strategies, conversion optimization and pipeline attribution.

- Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

- A self-starter mentality, with proven ability to thrive in fast-paced start-up environments.

- Excellent communication, project management, and collaboration skills.

- Team player who collaborates seamlessly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and external partners to align campaigns with broader business priorities.

- Bonus: Experience marketing to healthcare providers or enterprise health systems

_Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must be able to maintain authorization to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship, now or in the future. For this role, the Company is not able to sponsor, transfer, or extend employment-based visas or other work authorization._

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

- Compensation, Equity & 401k: Competitive salary, stock options & 401k

- Comprehensive Health Plans: 100% individual coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

- Time Off: Unlimited paid time off and 11 national holidays

- Health Comes First: Unlimited sick leave

- Parental Leave: Paid leave for new parents

- Remote-friendly: $1,000 to purchase home office equipment

- Trust & accountability: Full ownership of your time and schedule

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do – caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. This person will play a key role in strategy, execution, and measurement of our paid media programs, helping SeatGeek reach new audiences and drive incremental growth.

You’ll partner with internal teams, agencies, and media partners to translate business priorities into thoughtful media plans, evaluate what’s working, and identify opportunities to optimize and scale our investments.

What you’ll do

- Media Strategy & Planning

  - Help develop SeatGeek’s strategy across video (linear TV, DRTV, CTV, streaming), audio (streaming, radio), Display, YouTube, and other emerging channels
  - Evaluate the role of different channels, partners, networks, and inventory types within the broader media mix
  - Test new channels, formats, publishers, and inventory to uncover scalable growth opportunities

  - Support day-to-day management of campaigns on Display, DRTV, CTV, Audio, and other assigned channels from planning through launch and reporting
  - Partner with agencies and media vendors to develop recommendations, manage campaign setup, and ensure campaigns launch on time and deliver in full
  - Pressure test assumptions around audiences, budgets, reach/frequency, inventory, and measurement approaches, providing thoughtful feedback
  - Monitor campaign delivery and performance and identify opportunities for in-flight optimization
  - Manage select campaigns directly within buying platforms, including campaign setup, targeting, pacing, optimizations, and reporting
  - Maintain budget trackers and support media invoicing and reconciliation

- Measurement & Testing

  - Help build and execute a testing roadmap designed to answer questions about channel effectiveness, audiences, creative, frequency, and more
  - Partner with internal analytics teams to evaluate performance using incrementality testing, attribution, and other measurement approaches
  - Apply learnings across campaigns to continuously improve SeatGeek’s media strategy and investment decisions
  - Maintain monthly and ad hoc reporting

- Cross-functional collaboration

  - Partner closely with Creative, Analytics, and other marketing teams to support planning, execution, and measurement of paid media channels
  - Build strong relationships with agency, platform, publisher, and measurement partners

What you have

- Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of experience in media planning, buying, performance marketing, integrated marketing, or a related field
- Hands-on experience with at least two of the following channels: DRTV, CTV, Audio, Display, Online Video, or other paid media formats
- Strong understanding of media planning fundamentals, including audience strategy, reach and frequency, flighting, inventory, and budget allocation
- Experience working with media agencies and/or directly with publishers
- Strong analytical skills and an interest in sophisticated measurement approaches, particularly incrementality
- A performance-oriented mindset and ability to use data to make recommendations about where and how to invest
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns, partners, timelines, and priorities simultaneously
- Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfortable working with a range of stakeholders
- A proactive and curious approach; you’re excited to dig into how media works, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities to improve performance

Perks

- Discretionary annual bonus
- Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
- A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
- Unlimited PTO
- Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
- 401(k) matching
- Student loan matching program
- Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
- Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
- $500 per year for wellness expenses
- Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
- $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
- Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

About this role

About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

_Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above._

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Marketing Planning and Operations function sets the standard for how marketing is planned and executed at Life360. The team is responsible for long-term planning and budgeting, ensuring alignment across the organization and that the right strategies and processes are in place to achieve company objectives. Operating cross-functionally within the marketing organization, this group maintains a holistic view of initiatives and priorities, enabling it to inform marketing strategy and support the execution of both short- and long-term goals.

About the Job

Life360’s marketing org has grown fast — spanning B2C and B2B, multiple international markets, and a widening set of specialist teams — and we’re ready to build the planning and budget infrastructure that matches that scale. We’re hiring a Director, Marketing Planning & Operations, reporting to the VP Integrated Marketing, to build that infrastructure: a single source of truth for the budget, a planning cadence every team can rely on, and workflows that replace ad hoc coordination. Within your first year, success means marketing leadership has one real-time view of spend and priorities and every team knows exactly how their work connects to the plan.

The US-based salary range for this position is $137,000 to $252,000. We take into consideration an individual’s background and experience in determining final salary – therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

Planning

Drives end-to-end strategy and process across the marketing organization, ensuring alignment between business priorities and how marketing supports them.

- Own and drive long-range, annual, and quarterly planning—defining strategic pillars, establishing cross-team timelines, and collaborating with global marketing leadership to scale, adapt, and align marketing execution across international markets.
- Facilitate brainstorm sessions for planning with clear structure, driving discussion, decisions, and next steps.
- Produce and manage key marketing deliverables and executive templates, including QBR presentations (in collaboration with marketing leads), weekly status updates, monthly company newsletters, and Board of Directors materials.
- Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CMO and marketing leads.

Operating Rhythms

Ensure effective, cohesive operations across every team in the marketing organization.

- Partner across all marketing functions—including Creative, Lifecycle, PMM, Paid Ads, and Integrated Marketing—to evaluate team operations, bridge cross-functional gaps, and establish unified workflows, templates, and processes that optimize execution and drive integrated performance.
- Ensure every team understands how they collaborate and connect across the broader organization, identifying and building the cross-functional workflows to support this.
- Own the communication and rollout of new workflows and operating practices across the marketing org.
- Support the marketing organization through agency selection, management, and procurement.
- Identify, recommend, and implement workflow tools that improve efficiency across individual teams and the organization as a whole.

Budgets

Partner with the CMO and marketing leads to plan and manage annual and quarterly budgets.

- Maintain a central budget system that enables accurate, real-time tracking across all teams and channels.
- Partner closely with Finance to manage budgets, project metrics, and control costs across T&E and marketing investment areas, driving financial efficiency and maximum ROI.
- Lead key stakeholder partnerships to align cross-team priorities, establishing consistent operating rhythms and communications that clarify budget expectations and streamline execution.

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of experience in Marketing Planning, Marketing Operations, or Strategy & Operations roles.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to draft clear, concise, and impactful executive communications.
- Stellar project management expertise with a strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding project deadlines.
- Deep business acumen and curiosity for problem-solving, understanding business drivers, and engaging directly with the product.
- Financial acumen, including hands-on experience managing complex budgets within matrixed or multidivisional organizations.
- Proactive and collaborative mindset, with a history of building strong cross-functional partnerships across all organizational levels.
- Subscription business model experience preferred.
- International experience working across global teams is a plus.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Our Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
- Paid parental leave
- 401(k) plan with company matching program
- Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
- Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
- Learning & Development programs
- Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
- Free Life360 Platinum Membership Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

- Be a Good Person – We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
- Be Direct With Respect – We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
- Members Before Metrics – We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
- High Intensity, High Impact – We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

_We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status._

_We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful._ _Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!_
