Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to lead our consumer retention and engagement programs across the full customer lifecycle. This role goes beyond managing emails—it’s about building a product-integrated lifecycle engine that drives real behavioral change: more usage, more upgrades, and higher retention.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to create high-impact lifecycle touchpoints, tackle churn with precision, and ensure that our messaging not only reaches the inbox—but drives action.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of marketing and product.

Job Responsibilities:

- Own lifecycle strategy and execution from onboarding through retention, expansion, and winback across channels like email, in-app, push, and SMS.
- Partner closely with Product and Engineering to define and implement user-level triggers, event tracking, and product experiments tied to lifecycle outcomes.
- Deeply understand the customer journey to identify friction points, design solutions, and communicate value throughout the member experience.
- Improve email deliverability and performance, ensuring campaigns follow best practices, maintain sender reputation, and meet compliance standards.
- Develop advanced segmentation and personalization strategies to ensure the right message reaches the right user at the right time.
- Design upsell and expansion programs for converting users to annual plans, multi-seat subscriptions, and higher-value tiers.
- Run rigorous experimentation and reporting, using A/B testing and lift analysis to optimize conversion, engagement, and retention.
- Collaborate with Customer Support and CX to proactively address pain points and reduce ticket volume through smart lifecycle interventions.
- Report on lifecycle KPIs and build dashboards to track performance over time.

Job Requirements:

- Minimum of 6+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention, or product-led growth roles—preferably in consumer SaaS or subscription businesses.
- Strong track record of working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to build personalized, product-integrated marketing.
- Deep knowledge of email deliverability best practices, authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR).
- Experience managing customer journeys in tools like Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or similar.
- Data-savvy with strong command of segmentation, cohort analysis, experimentation, and SQL (or a willingness to get scrappy).
- Exceptional communicator and project manager with a bias for action.
- Passion for online privacy, consumer protection, and making the web safer for everyone.
- This role may require occasional domestic and international travel. All standard travel expenses will be covered in accordance with the company’s travel reimbursement policy.

- Birthday Off

As you’d expect from a company obsessed with keeping families connected, the eCommerce team moves fast and takes the member experience seriously – because a clunky flow is its own kind of broken promise. Sitting inside Journey Marketing, we’re a mix of merchandisers, marketers, data folks, and designers who all care about the same thing: turning every member touchpoint — from first website or app visit — into long-term loyalty and lasting relationships. From the online store to in-app purchases to wherever commerce shows up next, this team builds the experience that turns interest into purchase. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in systems, and turning “maybe” into “yes” at scale, you’ll fit right in.

About the Job

Search has changed and is reshaping how families discover Life360 before they ever visit a website or app store. The SEO and ASO Manager owns Life360’s unified organic discovery strategy across traditional search (SEO), AI answer surfaces (AEO/GEO), and app stores (ASO) – while simultaneously owning the content strategy, editorial calendar, and site information architecture that powers all three. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing to build the technical foundation, content depth, and structured data layer that earn Life360 citations, rankings, and recommendations across every surface where families make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with real execution accountability. You’ll manage a content strategist and supporting agency, setting the quality bar for everything we publish, and personally own the technical and strategic work that requires deep expertise. You’ll be Life360’s subject matter expert on how organic discovery works in an AI-first world and the person responsible for making sure we win it.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $121,500 to $178,500 USD. We take into consideration an individual’s background and experience in determining final salary – therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

- Manage a small team currently consisting of a Content Strategist
- Own Life360’s unified organic discovery strategy across SEO, AEO/GEO, and ASO, ensuring that search rankings, AI citations, and app store presence operate as a single, coordinated system across membership and devices.
- Lead the content strategy and editorial calendar for Life360.com, setting the topical roadmap, content hierarchy, and publishing cadence across blog, product marketing pages, help content, and comparison pages – ensuring every piece serves a defined discovery and conversion purpose.
- Build and maintain the site information architecture, owning URL structure, taxonomy, internal linking, and wayfinding logic that enables both users and crawlers to navigate Life360’s content efficiently.
- Execute AEO optimization across all content surfaces (web and app), implementing and expanding structured data, shaping content for AI parsing, and building the signals that AI models weight heavily.
- Monitor and grow Life360’s AI citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, tracking citation rate and proactively identifying content gaps where competitors or third parties are defining our narrative before we do.
- Lead technical SEO health: manage crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, canonical and redirect logic, hreflang implementation, and structured data integrity; partner with Engineering to triage and resolve issues and build technical SEO requirements into relevant product and site launches.
- Optimize landing pages and FAQ content for both traditional SERP performance and AI answer eligibility, ensuring high-commercial-intent pages are built to convert and be cited.
- Drive the off-page authority strategy in partnership with PR, identifying link-building opportunities, editorial placements (Wirecutter, Forbes Advisor, parenting publishers), and creator co-citation campaigns that build Life360’s domain authority and AI recommendation weight.
- Own regional SEO localization including locale-specific keyword research, localized content briefs, hreflang governance, and coordinated ASO refreshes for each market.
- Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting across organic sessions, AI citation rate, app store rank, and organic revenue contribution – translating data into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

- 5–8 years of experience in content strategy and SEO, with a track record of measurable organic performance improvement on apps and websites.
- Proven AEO experience: you understand how LLMs parse content, what structured data signals matter for AI citation, and have implemented strategies that improved a brand’s visibility in generative search results.
- Strong technical SEO foundation: you’ve worked directly with Engineering on crawl health, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site architecture; you can write a detailed technical brief and QA the implementation.
- Content strategy ownership: you’ve built and run an editorial calendar, managed content production workflows, conducted content gap analysis, and made strategic decisions about topical authority and content hierarchy – not just written or edited content.
- AI-native operator: you use AI tools actively in your workflow (content research, brief generation, structured data implementation, performance analysis) and can guide AI systems to produce on-brand output at scale.
- Global SEO experience: including hreflang implementation, locale-specific keyword strategy, and regional content localization across multiple markets.
- Data-driven decision maker who can build performance dashboards, identify anomalies, and translate organic metrics into clear business impact narratives for leadership.
- Proficiency with SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent) and Google Search Console; experience with ASO platforms (AppTweak, Sensor Tower, or equivalent) is a strong plus.
- Strong cross-functional collaborator who can work fluidly with Engineering, Product, Marketing, and PR to align organic strategy with product launches, campaigns, and technical roadmaps.

About the Job

Search has changed and is reshaping how families discover Life360 before they ever visit a website or app store. The SEO and ASO Manager owns Life360’s unified organic discovery strategy across traditional search (SEO), AI answer surfaces (AEO/GEO), and app stores (ASO) – while simultaneously owning the content strategy, editorial calendar, and site information architecture that powers all three. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing to build the technical foundation, content depth, and structured data layer that earn Life360 citations, rankings, and recommendations across every surface where families make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with real execution accountability. You’ll manage a content strategist and supporting agency, setting the quality bar for everything we publish, and personally own the technical and strategic work that requires deep expertise. You’ll be Life360’s subject matter expert on how organic discovery works in an AI-first world and the person responsible for making sure we win it.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $121,500 to $178,500 USD. We take into consideration an individual’s background and experience in determining final salary – therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

- Manage a small team currently consisting of a Content Strategist
- Own Life360’s unified organic discovery strategy across SEO, AEO/GEO, and ASO, ensuring that search rankings, AI citations, and app store presence operate as a single, coordinated system across membership and devices.
- Lead the content strategy and editorial calendar for Life360.com, setting the topical roadmap, content hierarchy, and publishing cadence across blog, product marketing pages, help content, and comparison pages – ensuring every piece serves a defined discovery and conversion purpose.
- Build and maintain the site information architecture, owning URL structure, taxonomy, internal linking, and wayfinding logic that enables both users and crawlers to navigate Life360’s content efficiently.
- Execute AEO optimization across all content surfaces (web and app), implementing and expanding structured data, shaping content for AI parsing, and building the signals that AI models weight heavily.
- Monitor and grow Life360’s AI citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, tracking citation rate and proactively identifying content gaps where competitors or third parties are defining our narrative before we do.
- Lead technical SEO health: manage crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, canonical and redirect logic, hreflang implementation, and structured data integrity; partner with Engineering to triage and resolve issues and build technical SEO requirements into relevant product and site launches.
- Optimize landing pages and FAQ content for both traditional SERP performance and AI answer eligibility, ensuring high-commercial-intent pages are built to convert and be cited.
- Drive the off-page authority strategy in partnership with PR, identifying link-building opportunities, editorial placements (Wirecutter, Forbes Advisor, parenting publishers), and creator co-citation campaigns that build Life360’s domain authority and AI recommendation weight.
- Own regional SEO localization including locale-specific keyword research, localized content briefs, hreflang governance, and coordinated ASO refreshes for each market.
- Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting across organic sessions, AI citation rate, app store rank, and organic revenue contribution – translating data into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

- 5–8 years of experience in content strategy and SEO, with a track record of measurable organic performance improvement on apps and websites.
- Proven AEO experience: you understand how LLMs parse content, what structured data signals matter for AI citation, and have implemented strategies that improved a brand’s visibility in generative search results.
- Strong technical SEO foundation: you’ve worked directly with Engineering on crawl health, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site architecture; you can write a detailed technical brief and QA the implementation.
- Content strategy ownership: you’ve built and run an editorial calendar, managed content production workflows, conducted content gap analysis, and made strategic decisions about topical authority and content hierarchy – not just written or edited content.
- AI-native operator: you use AI tools actively in your workflow (content research, brief generation, structured data implementation, performance analysis) and can guide AI systems to produce on-brand output at scale.
- Global SEO experience: including hreflang implementation, locale-specific keyword strategy, and regional content localization across multiple markets.
- Data-driven decision maker who can build performance dashboards, identify anomalies, and translate organic metrics into clear business impact narratives for leadership.

About this role

AI is fundamentally changing how product strategy and market strategy work together. The boundary between building the right product and bringing it to market the right way is disappearing — and the companies that recognize this will build product marketing functions that operate as strategic growth engines, not service organizations.

ActiveCampaign’s Active Intelligence platform — autonomous AI agents serving 180,000+ growing businesses — is redefining how marketing works. We need a Director of Product Marketing who shapes how the market understands it through bold storytelling, drives adoption that compounds, and transforms the PMM discipline in the process.

This role reports to the SVP of Product. Product and Product Marketing operate as a single strategic arm — you’ll have the same context as the people building the product and the same accountability for what happens when it meets the market. This is a player-coach role: you lead a team, but you also personally create — strategies, narratives, content, programs. AI makes that possible at a level it never was before, and we expect our leaders to use it.

Why This Role Matters:

The way companies build, market, and grow products is being reshaped by AI. Product Marketing must evolve from a support function into a strategic operating system for customer understanding, market differentiation, and intelligent go-to-market execution. At ActiveCampaign, we’re building that now. This role is at the center of it.

On a typical day, you might:

- Market Narrative & Positioning:

- Define and evolve positioning that clearly articulates why Active Intelligence represents a fundamentally new way for businesses to run their marketing — and why that matters now.
- Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling customer value that resonates across segments.
- Bring conviction to the narrative — if the story isn’t bold enough, make it bolder. We want a PMM leader whose point of view strengthens every room they’re in.
- Adoption & Customer Outcomes:

- Lead go-to-market strategies measured by adoption and continued usage, not launch ceremony. Your success is customers who build their business on Active Intelligence.
- Own the market-side of the customer lifecycle — the narrative that moves someone from “I tried it” to “I can’t turn this off.” Partner with Product to build both sides of that engine.
- Run experimentation-driven programs: every initiative has a hypothesis, a signal, and a learning cycle. We move in weekly learning cycles, not quarterly planning windows.
- AI-First Execution:

- Automate traditional launch mechanics — release notes, enablement decks, internal comms. Your team operates above the automation line.
- Leverage AI to transform how the PMM craft works, not just what it produces. Speed, experimentation, and operational scale improve by default.
- Sales, Partner & Revenue Enablement:

- Arm Sales, CS, and our partner ecosystem with positioning, proof points, and talk tracks that improve conversations and conversion.
- Establish feedback loops between GTM teams and Product — friction points and market opportunities flow back into product decisions.
- Evangelism & Market Authority:

- Build the market presence that makes ActiveCampaign the reference point for autonomous marketing — thought leadership, proof points, and narrative formats that establish our position.
- Team Leadership:

- Lead a PMM team of outcome owners who own strategic priorities the way PMs own product areas — with backlogs, experiments, and shipped impact.
- Set the standard by doing the work yourself, not just directing it. The best PMM leaders we’ve seen create alongside their teams — AI makes that leverage real.
- Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and urgency. Create clarity in ambiguity and drive alignment through influence and results.
- Invest in your people’s growth as seriously as the work itself — create conditions where they do the best work of their careers in service to their individual and collective success.

The ideal candidate will bring:

Required:

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or Product Strategy in B2B SaaS or AI-driven technology companies.
- 3+ years of proven leadership experience leading PMM teams — experience building or transforming a function, not just running one.
- A product-strategy mindset: you think about market impact the way great PMs think about product-market fit.
- A proven track record driving adoption and retention outcomes, not just launch metrics.
- Proven ability to influence across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

Highly Valued:

- Prior experience with AI-native products, marketing automation, or platform products serving SMB/mid-market
- Experience building experimentation-driven marketing functions.
- Deep customer empathy paired with analytical rigor.
- A mindset that thinks beyond launches — you understand how product marketing drives company growth.
- A desire to erase the artificial boundary between product and marketing.
- An AI-native approach in how you think, work, and lead — not just AI-curious.
- A bias for action and execution: you’d rather build the positioning doc yourself than wait for someone to draft it. Leading a team doesn’t mean you stop creating.
- The ability to build trust through clarity, accountability, and results. You care about outcomes, not organizational theater.
- A passion for transformation rather than maintenance.

What Success Looks Like:

Within 3–6 months, you will have:

- Established Product Marketing as a strategic growth function trusted by Product, GTM, and leadership.
- Driven measurable improvement in product adoption, continued usage, and customer expansion.
- Sharpened market and product positioning to the point where customers deeply understand the step-change innovation we’re delivering and how it transforms their business.
- Built a modern PMM operating model — a team of leaders fully leveraging AI in everything they do, oriented around measurable business outcomes.

One more thing

Please review the prompt below and come prepared to discuss it during the interview:

_Tell us about a time you drove product adoption through experimentation rather than a traditional launch playbook. What was the hypothesis? What did you learn? What would you do differently?_

_We value this response highly — it tells us more about how you think than any resume line._

Compensation

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base rate only and do not include bonus, equity, sales incentives or other role specific compensation that the role may be eligible for. ActiveCampaign believes in and is committed to equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided above is a good faith estimate of the pay range determined by the location associated with the job posting. The actual salary depends on a candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

About ActiveCampaign:

ActiveCampaign is the autonomous marketing platform for people at the heart of the action. It empowers teams to automate their campaigns with AI agents that imagine, activate, and validate–freeing them from step-by-step workflows and unlocking limitless ways to orchestrate their marketing.

With AI, goal-based automation, and 1,000+ app integrations, agencies, marketers, and owners can build cross-channel campaigns in minutes–fine-tuned with billions of data points to drive real results for their unique business.

ActiveCampaign is the trusted choice to help businesses unlock a new world of boundless opportunities–where ideas become impact and potential turns into real results.

ActiveCampaign’s Active Intelligence platform — autonomous AI agents serving 180,000+ growing businesses — is redefining how marketing works. We need a Director of Product Marketing who shapes how the market understands it through bold storytelling, drives adoption that compounds, and transforms the PMM discipline in the process.

This role reports to the SVP of Product. Product and Product Marketing operate as a single strategic arm — you’ll have the same context as the people building the product and the same accountability for what happens when it meets the market. This is a player-coach role: you lead a team, but you also personally create — strategies, narratives, content, programs. AI makes that possible at a level it never was before, and we expect our leaders to use it.

Why This Role Matters:

The way companies build, market, and grow products is being reshaped by AI. Product Marketing must evolve from a support function into a strategic operating system for customer understanding, market differentiation, and intelligent go-to-market execution. At ActiveCampaign, we’re building that now. This role is at the center of it.

On a typical day, you might:

- Market Narrative & Positioning:

- Define and evolve positioning that clearly articulates why Active Intelligence represents a fundamentally new way for businesses to run their marketing — and why that matters now.
- Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling customer value that resonates across segments.
- Bring conviction to the narrative — if the story isn’t bold enough, make it bolder. We want a PMM leader whose point of view strengthens every room they’re in.
- Adoption & Customer Outcomes:

- Lead go-to-market strategies measured by adoption and continued usage, not launch ceremony. Your success is customers who build their business on Active Intelligence.
- Own the market-side of the customer lifecycle — the narrative that moves someone from “I tried it” to “I can’t turn this off.” Partner with Product to build both sides of that engine.
- Run experimentation-driven programs: every initiative has a hypothesis, a signal, and a learning cycle. We move in weekly learning cycles, not quarterly planning windows.
- AI-First Execution:

- Automate traditional launch mechanics — release notes, enablement decks, internal comms. Your team operates above the automation line.
- Leverage AI to transform how the PMM craft works, not just what it produces. Speed, experimentation, and operational scale improve by default.
- Sales, Partner & Revenue Enablement:

- Arm Sales, CS, and our partner ecosystem with positioning, proof points, and talk tracks that improve conversations and conversion.
- Establish feedback loops between GTM teams and Product — friction points and market opportunities flow back into product decisions.
- Evangelism & Market Authority:

- Build the market presence that makes ActiveCampaign the reference point for autonomous marketing — thought leadership, proof points, and narrative formats that establish our position.
- Team Leadership:

- Lead a PMM team of outcome owners who own strategic priorities the way PMs own product areas — with backlogs, experiments, and shipped impact.
- Set the standard by doing the work yourself, not just directing it. The best PMM leaders we’ve seen create alongside their teams — AI makes that leverage real.
- Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and urgency. Create clarity in ambiguity and drive alignment through influence and results.
- Invest in your people’s growth as seriously as the work itself — create conditions where they do the best work of their careers in service to their individual and collective success.

The ideal candidate will bring:

Required:

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or Product Strategy in B2B SaaS or AI-driven technology companies.
- 3+ years of proven leadership experience leading PMM teams — experience building or transforming a function, not just running one.
- A product-strategy mindset: you think about market impact the way great PMs think about product-market fit.
- A proven track record driving adoption and retention outcomes, not just launch metrics.
- Proven ability to influence across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

Highly Valued:

- Prior experience with AI-native products, marketing automation, or platform products serving SMB/mid-market
- Experience building experimentation-driven marketing functions.
- Deep customer empathy paired with analytical rigor.
- A mindset that thinks beyond launches — you understand how product marketing drives company growth.
- A desire to erase the artificial boundary between product and marketing.
- An AI-native approach in how you think, work, and lead — not just AI-curious.
- A bias for action and execution: you’d rather build the positioning doc yourself than wait for someone to draft it. Leading a team doesn’t mean you stop creating.
- The ability to build trust through clarity, accountability, and results. You care about outcomes, not organizational theater.
- A passion for transformation rather than maintenance.

What Success Looks Like:

Within 3–6 months, you will have:

- Established Product Marketing as a strategic growth function trusted by Product, GTM, and leadership.
- Driven measurable improvement in product adoption, continued usage, and customer expansion.
- Sharpened market and product positioning to the point where customers deeply understand the step-change innovation we’re delivering and how it transforms their business.
- Built a modern PMM operating model — a team of leaders fully leveraging AI in everything they do, oriented around measurable business outcomes.

One more thing

Please review the prompt below and come prepared to discuss it during the interview:

_Tell us about a time you drove product adoption through experimentation rather than a traditional launch playbook. What was the hypothesis? What did you learn? What would you do differently?_

_We value this response highly — it tells us more about how you think than any resume line._

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base rate only and do not include bonus, equity, sales incentives or other role specific compensation that the role may be eligible for. ActiveCampaign believes in and is committed to equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided above is a good faith estimate of the pay range determined by the location associated with the job posting. The actual salary depends on a candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

Additional Information

About ActiveCampaign:

ActiveCampaign is the autonomous marketing platform for people at the heart of the action. It empowers teams to automate their campaigns with AI agents that imagine, activate, and validate–freeing them from step-by-step workflows and unlocking limitless ways to orchestrate their marketing.

With AI, goal-based automation, and 1,000+ app integrations, agencies, marketers, and owners can build cross-channel campaigns in minutes–fine-tuned with billions of data points to drive real results for their unique business.

ActiveCampaign is the trusted choice to help businesses unlock a new world of boundless opportunities–where ideas become impact and potential turns into real results.

As a global multicultural company, we are proud of our inclusive culture which embraces diverse voices, backgrounds, and perspectives. We don’t just celebrate our differences, we believe our diversity is what empowers our innovation and success. You can find out more about our DEI initiatives here.

Perks and benefits:

At ActiveCampaign, we prioritize employees’ well-being and professional growth by cultivating a culture centered on collaboration and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll not only have the opportunity to make a significant impact, but also enjoy a range of benefits tailored to support your personal and career development.

Here are some of the benefits we offer:

-Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Top-tier benefits package that includes a fully-covered High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), complimentary access to telehealth services, and a free subscription to Calm.

-Growth & Development: Access to LinkedIn Learning, professional development programs, and career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organization.

-Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and take the time you need to maintain work-life balance with open PTO.

About this role

Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Director, Product Marketing

We’re looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Help Scout tells its story in a crowded, fast-growing market – shaping the positioning, narrative, and go-to-market strategy that define how customers, prospects, and the industry understand our platform.

It’s an exciting time to be here. With a new vision and an AI-driven vision, we’ll be shipping more products faster to ensure we can quickly meet the changing needs of the market. You’ll set the strategy for how we position that pace of innovation, build the frameworks that help the whole company talk about it credibly, and make sure our AI-driven product investments land as real value in the market not just feature noise. You’ll report to the VP of Marketing, leading our product marketing function, and will manage our Lead Product Marketing Manager.

_Please note: This role is only open to US-based applicants._

About the role

- Own product marketing strategy. Set and execute the quarterly and long-term strategy for how Help Scout positions its product and platform, informed by market trends, competitive analytics, and where the company is headed.

- Build and scale the product marketing function. Manage and partner with our Lead Product Marketing Manager, setting priorities, coaching on craft, and creating room for them to grow into owning larger initiatives. You’ll help build the team’s roadmap for headcount and capability over the next 12-18 months.

- Enable the whole company. Ensure sales, support, and teammates across Help Scout have what they need to understand and clearly articulate the value of what we ship. You’ll build the frameworks and enable the company to talk about our products in a way that ultimately leads to new revenue and expansion.

- Shape competitive intelligence at a strategic level. Go beyond synthesizing competitive research by turning it into a point of view on where the market is heading and how Help Scout should move to win, and make sure that point of view shapes product-led growth, direct and indirect sales, and expansion.

- Own major product launches and seasonal release events end-to-end. Set the strategy and narrative arc for product release events and other major launches, coordinating across Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to land them with impact.

- Represent Help Scout’s product story externally. Use guest posts, podcasts, social, and other channels to build the company’s external visibility and reputation as a category leader, both for the platform and for how we’re building it.

About you

- You have significant experience in product marketing for a B2B SaaS product or AI platform, with a track record of owning strategy, not just executing campaigns.

- You’re an expert in every core discipline of product marketing: positioning, messaging, buyer personas/ICP, sales enablement, and launches, and you can identify which high-value activities matter most for the business right now.

- You’ve managed people before, and know how to coach someone on craft, give them room to own real work, and help them grow into more senior responsibility.

- You have a point of view on positioning AI-powered products credibly, and ideally have direct experience marketing AI features or products.

- You use AI tools daily to improve your own output and your team’s, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, or scale of what you or your team delivered.

- You’re a storyteller at heart. You write strong narratives that make complex products feel simple, human, and memorable, and you know how to communicate and build relationships across a remote, async environment.

Company values

_Happy to Help_

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

_Craft over Convention_

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

_Progress not Perfection_

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

_Own the Outcome_

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

- Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

- Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

- 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

- A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

- A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

- A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

- If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it’s the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we’d like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

_Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an_@ helpscout.com _email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels._

About this role

AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

We’re looking for a B2B Integrated Campaign Manager who wakes up thinking about pipeline. In this role, you’ll own the strategy and hands-on execution of full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns that drive real revenue; building in HubSpot, pulling the levers, and iterating relentlessly until the numbers move. This is a fast-scaling SaaS environment where every campaign decision is made through one lens: what gets more qualified opportunities into the funnel, faster.

This isn’t your typical enterprise SaaS role. AssetWatch sells into the manufacturing plant floor – maintenance managers, reliability engineers, plant managers, and operations leaders who aren’t scrolling LinkedIn between meetings. Reaching them requires a dual playbook: account-based tactics for executive buyers, and channel-agnostic creative for the plant-level practitioners who champion the technology.

This role blends campaign strategy, cross-functional leadership, and technical campaign execution, and it demands someone who plans obsessively and operates with precision. You’ll be managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously, and the throughline that keeps it all moving is your ability to build the system, run the system, and hold it accountable to pipeline.

What You’ll Do:

Campaign Strategy & Execution

- Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns to drive demand, pipeline, and revenue
- Translate business goals into coordinated campaigns across email, paid media, web, events, and sales outreach
- Own campaign execution end-to-end, including building and launching campaigns in HubSpot

Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations

- Build, test, and deploy campaign assets in HubSpot (emails, landing pages, workflows, forms)
- Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to ensure proper segmentation, targeting, and timing
- Manage campaign workflows and triggers to support lead generation and nurture efforts
- Ensure campaigns are properly tracked, tagged, and attributed

Cross-Functional Alignment

- Collaborate with product marketing, content, design, and sales to align messaging and campaign goals
- Work closely with RevOps to ensure Salesforce and HubSpot alignment for campaign tracking and lead flow
- Support sales with campaign insights, follow-up strategies, and enablement materials

Performance & Optimization

- Define KPIs (MQLs, pipeline, conversion rates, campaign ROI)
- Monitor campaign performance and optimize in real time (A/B testing, messaging, timing, channels)
- Build and maintain campaign reporting dashboards in HubSpot

Data & Compliance

- Ensure campaigns follow best practices for data usage, segmentation, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR)
- Maintain clean campaign data and proper attribution tracking

Qualifications

- 4–7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns
- Hands-on experience executing campaigns in HubSpot (or similar MAP)
- Strong understanding of pipeline generation and SaaS funnel metrics
- Experience working with Salesforce CRM and marketing-sales alignment
- Ability to manage both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment

What Success Looks Like

- Campaigns consistently generate qualified pipeline and revenue
- Seamless execution from strategy → build → launch → optimization
- Strong alignment between marketing campaigns and sales outcomes
- Clear, reliable campaign reporting and attribution

LI-REMOTE

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. The Role

We are seeking a Head of Demand Generation to own our full revenue marketing engine and lead our demand generation and digital marketing initiatives globally. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you’ll be an integral member of the marketing leadership team. Digital Marketing Manager - Americas

Tampa, Florida, United States Remote

Apply

About Appspace:

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

Your Role as a Digital Marketing Manager:

We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale Appspace’s paid media engine. Paid media is the primary mandate of this role—you will control significant advertising budgets across search, social, and display channels, and be held accountable for pipeline contribution and ROAS. Beyond paid, you’ll help optimize our website for conversion and AI-engine discoverability, and partner cross-functionally to ensure every dollar of digital spend is tied directly to revenue outcomes.

_This is not a generalist role. The right candidate lives in campaign dashboards, obsesses over cost-per-opportunity, and knows how to scale what’s working while ruthlessly cutting what isn’t._

A Day in the Life of a Digital Marketing Manager:

1. Own and Optimize Paid Media Programs

Paid media performance is the core metric by which this role is measured. You will:

- Manage and allocate multi-channel paid media budgets across Google Ads (Search, Display, P-Max), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, 6sense, and Meta Ads—continuously rebalancing based on pipeline contribution and cost-per-opportunity.
- Build and maintain always-on advertising programs alongside point-in-time campaign bursts, ensuring consistent pipeline coverage throughout the fiscal year.
- Develop quarterly paid media plans grounded in buyer persona research, intent data, and competitive analysis; translate strategy into channel-specific execution plans with clear KPIs.
- Define and own paid media KPIs: CTR, CPC, CPL, cost-per-MQL, cost-per-opportunity, ROAS, and pipeline-influenced revenue. Report weekly to senior leadership.
- Run structured A/B tests on ad copy, creative, audience segments, bidding strategies, and landing pages; document results and scale winners systematically.
- Design and test ad creative and copy by leveraging AI generation tools alongside content and design teams—using performance data to drive the next iteration of brand assets.
- Leverage B2B intent data and account-intelligence platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora) to build targeted ABM ad campaigns aligned with Sales outbound targets.
- Stay current with platform algorithm changes (Google’s AI-driven bidding, LinkedIn audience expansion, Meta Advantage+) and adapt strategies proactively.

1. Optimize Website Performance

- Measure and monitor the Appspace website’s health, performance, and conversion rates; share regular dashboards with marketing leadership and stakeholders.
- Optimize web content, layout, structure, and UX for both human conversions (CRO) and AI-engine discoverability (SEO/AEO), ensuring Appspace surfaces across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery.
- Manage and coordinate with Appspace’s external SEO agency—set deliverables, hold the agency accountable to results, and integrate SEO insights into paid media and content strategies.
- Implement and maintain website tracking through Google Tag Manager.

1. Collaborate Across the Marketing & Revenue Team

- Feed paid media performance data, search intent trends, and AI-discovery insights back into the content engine—partnering with creative, copywriting, and content teams so messaging continually evolves based on real-time market signals.
- Work hand-in-hand with Revenue Operations to manage multi-touch attribution models, ensuring all digital spend is mapped to pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue.
- Support integrated campaigns by handling all paid advertising components: planning, audience building, ad construction, trafficking, and measurement.
- Contribute to quarterly and annual marketing planning by providing paid media performance data and forward-looking budget recommendations.

What You'll Need:

- Paid Media Expertise (Required): 5+ years managing substantial B2B SaaS paid media budgets with demonstrable results—specific experience driving pipeline from Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta is essential. Please be prepared to share performance results.
- AI-Augmented Execution: Hands-on use of AI-driven marketing workflows—ad copy generation, audience modeling, bid optimization, and creative testing at scale.
- Platform Mastery: Expert-level command of Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM and SFDC reporting.
- ABM & Intent Data: Practical experience using B2B intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent) to build targeted account-based campaigns in close partnership with Sales.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to move beyond surface-level reporting—interpret multi-touch attribution, journey-aware bidding signals, and predictive analytics to make budget decisions with confidence.
- Web & CRO Fluency: Solid understanding of CMS management, landing page builders (e.g., Unbounce, Webflow), and conversion rate optimization best practices.
- Revenue Mindset: Comfortable tying digital spend directly to pipeline and closed-won revenue; you speak the language of Sales and RevOps, not just marketing.
- Adaptability: A bias for action and experimentation in a fast-changing landscape where AI platforms and buyer behaviors shift quickly.

The Perks of Working for Appspace:

For all our US based team members, we offer a variety of benefits from competitive salaries, medical, dental and vision coverage, disability coverage, employer paid life insurance, mental health resources, 401(k) plan and a fully paid parental leave program.

Additional perks include:

- Generous PTO
- Flexible work schedules
- Remote work opportunities
- Paid company holidays
- Appspace Quiet Fridays (No non-essential internal meetings scheduled)
- A casual dress work environment

Disclaimer:

_Appspace is committed to equitable compensation practices and complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. For jurisdictions that require pay scale disclosure, a general compensation range may be provided during the initial stages of the interview process. Final compensation will be based on multiple factors including experience, skills, certifications, and overall fit for the role._

_If you are located in a jurisdiction with specific pay transparency requirements, we will be happy to discuss the relevant range during your application process._

- Develop strong written content for ads, emails, landing pages, campaigns, and other marketing materials.
- Build a library of creative concepts to communicate value to different buyer personas.
- Improve middle-of-funnel conversion rates through messaging and tactics that optimize customer engagement and retention.
- Collaborate with other departments to enhance creative quality and performance in digital marketing campaigns.

Qualifications

- You have strong startup experience and are comfortable working in a fast-moving, resourceful environment.
- You are a heavy user of AI tools and know how to apply them to grow, automate, and scale marketing efforts.
- You have experience scaling a marketing channel from zero to significant reach, ideally beyond paid acquisition.
- You love brainstorming new concepts, ad creatives, campaign ideas, and messaging.
- You have experience acquiring small businesses and prosumer customers.
- You understand how to assess campaign impact and estimate the effort needed to generate results.
- You can manage multiple projects simultaneously and identify the fastest path to value.
- You bring a full stack of marketing skills, from ideation to execution and analysis.
- You have experience managing paid digital marketing campaigns.
- You have excellent command of the English language and are a strong writer.
- You’re able to create compelling content for ads, emails, landing pages, and campaigns.
- You have a creative mindset and an eye for design, brand, and visual communication, and have used that ability to author copy, images, and videos with AI assistance.
- You have at least 3 years of marketing experience, including at least 1 year in a senior role.

Why You Should Apply

If you’re passionate and skilled but don’t meet every qualification, please apply anyway. Talent, potential, and enthusiasm are highly valued here.

B12 is a safe and inclusive workplace, welcoming applicants from diverse backgrounds. We particularly encourage applications from women, people of color, underrepresented minorities, and members of the LGBTQIA community.

Our platform also provides tools for scheduling, payments, and email marketing. We’re a fully remote company, founded in 2015, and supported by investors like Breyer Capital, General Catalyst, SV Angel, and Tola Capital. Visit www.b12.io to learn more.

Channel Marketing Manager (Partner Growth)

at Bitwarden in Marketing

Remote US

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.

We're hiring a Channel Marketing Manager to own partner marketing end-to-end — from partner onboarding and enablement to demand generation and events — across MSP, reseller, and VAR motions, prioritizing effort based on revenue potential and business urgency rather than spreading evenly across all three.

This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the U.S. (Preferred East Coast/Central for EMEA support)

RESPONSIBILITIES

_Grouped by sequencing, not just importance. This role is expected to partner with leadership to actively triage and prioritize as the programs and opportunities evolve._

- Own the MSP channel marketing motion end-to-end: partner onboarding content, lifecycle email programs, enablement webinar series, and support the annual event calendar (e.g., MSP Summit, IT Nation Connect).
- Develop the annual Channel Marketing Plan: event selection, budget, campaign strategy, and executive approval process, in partnership with the Marketing and Sales leadership.
- Serve as the marketing primary point of contact for Channel Sales (MSP, reseller, VAR) — running the biweekly Channel Marketing meeting, managing the event intake process, and building/evolving the deliverables (templates, briefs, self-serve assets) that empower Sales to execute quickly and independently.
- Own reporting on program performance: pipeline influenced, partner engagement, event ROI, and progress against the $5M combined reseller/MSP revenue target, presented to marketing and sales leadership.
- Extend proven partner playbooks — onboarding sequences, enablement content, partner toolkits, prioritizing by revenue contribution and need (starting with enabling active partners).
- Build and drive a proactive, always-on partner demand generation strategy to drive net-new target partner interest (e.g., partners in uncovered territories/regions) with a coherent plan tied to pipeline and ARR targets.
- Manage the channel marketing budget across sponsorships, campaigns, and partner enablement programs, and make prioritization trade-offs as new event and partner requests come in.
- Partner with Marketing Operations, Comms, and Product Marketing to keep partner-facing content, campaigns, and the partner portal current and aligned to brand and product roadmap. Wherever possible, focus on public facing web documents that are visible globally by individuals and AI agents.
- Assist with the administration of the Bitwarden partner portal and ensure content is up-to-date, accessible, and aligned with go-to-market priorities

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- 7+ years of B2B channel, partner, or field marketing experience — ideally including work with MSPs, resellers, or VARs in a SaaS or technology company.
- Proven ability to own a marketing program end-to-end: strategy, budget, execution, and reporting, without heavy hands-on direction.
- Experience planning and executing in-person or virtual partner events, from sponsorship negotiation through post-event lead follow-up.
- Experience building or running partner lifecycle email programs (onboarding, engagement, re-engagement) — comfort partnering with marketing ops/automation owners to execute them.
- A track record of turning a reactive, request-driven function into a proactive, planned one — you build the calendar instead of just reacting to what lands in your inbox.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — this role sits at the intersection of Growth Marketing, Channel Sales, and Marketing Operations, and will need trust from all three.
- Comfort with ambiguity and prioritization — you'll be handed more inbound requests (events, campaigns, partner asks) than one person can execute, and part of the job is deciding what not to do.
- Collaborative and adaptable mindset
- Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
- Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
- Excellent problem-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Meeting with our Recruiting Manager
- Interview with the Head of Growth Marketing and Operations
- Interview(s) with Channel Sales stakeholders (e.g., Channel Sales Manager, Channel Sales AE)
- Interview(s) with Growth Marketing team members (e.g., Demand Generation, Product Marketing)
- Interview with the Chief Customer Officer
- Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
- Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
- We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
- Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

Associate Director, Paid Search

Remote / Kansas City, MO / Chicago, IL / New York, NY / Denver, CO

Apply

MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We’re an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and management of paid search accounts to drive client performance and growth. You will provide leadership across the business and partner with other channels to provide an integrated plan to optimize plans to meet marketing goals. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment are essential.

Here's what it takes to be successful in the role:

- Curiosity and Skepticism: You are always asking, "WHY?" You have an internal drive to learn more and expand your knowledge. You consider situations from multiple perspectives.
- Strategic, Creative Problem-Solving: You are analytical and enjoy working with data to derive insights. You use insights and knowledge to develop robust strategies and visions for success. You love coming up with creative solutions to new and old problems alike.
- Initiative: You are a gritty self-starter driven to find answers, solve tough problems, and overcome challenges. You proactively bring solutions to challenges.
- Communication & Storytelling: You can easily communicate complex information or nuanced situations. You know what details are necessary and what details to leave behind. You can marry data and storytelling to articulate a compelling vision.
- Adaptability: You can comfortably adjust in evolving or ambiguous situations. You use creativity to tackle new and existing challenges. You're ready and excited for changes in the media landscape.
- Self-Development: You're reflective and self-aware. You seek opportunities to learn and develop yourself and others.

Responsibilities

- Leads and/or oversees campaign development, optimization, and reporting across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and supporting SEM platforms (e.g., SA360), including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max.
- Designs and implements optimal SEM account structures, forecasting methodologies, bidding strategies, goal frameworks, and segmentation approaches to maximize efficiency and scale.
- Partners with platform reps (Google, Microsoft) to evaluate betas, automation features, audience expansion tools, and opportunities to strengthen competitive advantage.
- Identifies new opportunities to supplement goals and formulate strategies to capitalize on new opportunities.
- Builds strong relationships with Google and Microsoft platform teams to stay ahead of auction dynamics, product updates, and performance opportunities.
- Serves as the integral activation lead in key client communication.
- Manages, reviews, and performs daily account responsibilities for client portfolio.
- Updates Director on status of current accounts and team on an ongoing basis and elevates issues in a timely manner.
- Ensures accurate SEM tracking, conversion tagging, feed integrity, and audience framework implementation prior to launch, partnering closely with Ad Operations and Analytics.
- Demonstrates thought leadership and professional communication skills by developing and delivering client-facing materials.
- Provides oversight and works closely with other team members to meet client goals.
- Supports creation of SEM reporting dashboards and delivers clear insights on performance, auction behavior, query trends, feed health, and algorithmic learning.
- Leads in collaboration with finance team members to resolve media billing issues.
- Ensures strict adherence to client budgets while meeting client objectives.
- Manages junior staff with training, project prioritization, and client deliverables.
- Stays current on all media trends and opportunities in the industry.
- Other duties/responsibilities may be assigned from time to time.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of Paid Search experience required, including hands-on management of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
- Experience with SEM management platforms (e.g., DeepSearch, SA360) or direct platform execution in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
- Experience working in and leading a team in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
- Knowledge and utilization of 1st- and/or 3rd-party data.
- Strong organizational and mathematical skills.
- Ability to multi-task and deliver work on-time for set deadlines.
- Ability to work effectively with a variety of internal teams and business groups, including Creative, Account Management, Finance, and Project Management.
- Ability to communicate effectively within a team environment, with outside media reps as well as with current clients.
- Must be prepared for a fast-paced environment and be comfortable making decisions.

_The annual gross base salary range is $85,000 - $120,000 USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K._

Manager, Growth & Customer Marketing

United States, Remote

Apply

About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

- Be Clear & Credible
  - We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
- Be Human
  - We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
- Be Better Together
  - We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
- Be Honourable/Honorable
  - We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
- Be Connected
  - We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.

What Makes You a Great Fit

- You take ownership and follow through
- You communicate clearly and effectively
- You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
- You learn quickly and adapt as things change
- You care about the team, not just your own work
- You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Manager, Growth & Customer Marketing to lead a team of two and own ClearGov’s full-funnel growth motion — from a prospect’s first touch through expansion revenue with existing customers. You’ll manage and develop a team of two: one teammate focused on inbound (SEO/AEO) and net-new ABM/ABX campaigns, the other on customer marketing for cross-sell and upsell. You inherit both with real runway to grow in scope and title as the team’s results build.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the strategy, coach your team, and own the numbers — while staying hands-on with the highest-leverage campaigns and content yourself.

We need someone who is AI-forward by default: you use AI tools to move faster on content, targeting, SEO/AEO research, and reporting as a matter of course, and you build that habit into how your team works, not just how you work. You’re proactive — you spot the SEO gap, the underperforming segment, or the expansion signal in the data before anyone points it out, and you act on it.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership

- Hire (as needed), coach, and manage a team of 2 marketers — one owning acquisition (inbound/SEO/AEO, ABM/ABX), one owning customer marketing (cross-sell/upsell) — with regular 1:1s, clear goals, and a development plan that gives each a real path to grow.
- Set quarterly growth marketing strategy and OKRs spanning net-new pipeline and expansion revenue; report results to marketing leadership.
- Operate as a player-coach: personally lead ClearGov’s highest-priority campaigns and strategic accounts while delegating day-to-day execution to your team.
- Proactively surface and act on growth opportunities across the funnel — SEO/AEO gaps, underperforming ABM segments, expansion or churn-risk signals in customer health data — rather than waiting for them to be flagged.

Acquisition & Demand Generation

- Own ClearGov’s inbound strategy — SEO and AEO (optimizing for AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, in addition to traditional search) — to grow organic visibility and traffic.
- Build and run ABM/ABX programs for net-new prospects, coordinating email, webinars, social, and content into unified account-based campaigns.
- Partner with Sales to align target account lists, campaign timing, and lead hand-off criteria for ABM-sourced pipeline.

Customer Marketing

- Own the full post-sale marketing motion — customer touchpoints (newsletter, product launch announcements, webinars), in-app announcements, and expansion/cross-sell campaigns from audience segmentation through performance measurement.
- Build and manage ClearGov’s customer reference and advocacy program; lead the creation of case studies, video testimonials, and social proof.
- Track and report on expansion campaign performance — influenced pipeline, conversion rates, and contribution to upsell/cross-sell revenue.

AI & Ways of Working

- Use AI tools daily to speed up content production, campaign personalization, SEO/AEO research, and reporting — and build this into how your team operates, not just how you work individually.
- Bring a testing mindset: run experiments across channels and let data decide what gets more investment.

Critical Skills/Experience:

- 5–7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, including 1–2+ years directly managing people — this is a people-management role from day one, not a step toward one.
- Full-funnel growth marketing experience with a track record you can show numbers for — growing net-new pipeline (SEO/AEO, ABM/ABX, demand gen) and growing expansion revenue (NRR, cross-sell/upsell).
- Hands-on SEO experience and working knowledge of AEO/answer-engine optimization — how content gets discovered by both traditional search and AI answer engines.
- Experience building and running ABM/ABX programs across email, webinars, and social; familiarity with intent/ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar) a plus.
- Demonstrated, regular use of AI tools in a marketing workflow — content generation, personalization, research, or reporting — not just occasional experimentation.
- Hands-on proficiency with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar) and comfort using CRM data (Salesforce preferred) to segment audiences and measure performance.
- Strong content and storytelling skills across formats — case studies, campaign copy, webinar scripts, video.
- Experience in a SaaS environment; GovTech or public sector experience is a plus, but not required.

Compensation:

- In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $155,000 - $185,000 USD or $130,000 - $155,000 CAD, and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

- Remote and flexible work environment
- Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
- Collaborative, high-performing team
- Competitive compensation and benefits
- Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

- Medical, dental & vision insurance
- FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
- Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
- Life + disability insurance (Canada)
- 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
- 10 company holidays
- 3 wellness days
- Paid vacation time off
- Sick and safe time off
- Paid parental leave
- Paid bereavement leave
- Paid jury duty + civic service leave
- Employee assistance program
- 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
- Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply

Ready to join us? Apply online today!

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

Cobalt is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to join our marketing team. This isn't a traditional demand gen role. We are building a sophisticated Growth Marketing framework that is focused on automation and orchestration to identify accounts with the highest propensity to buy, and nurture them into turning purchase ready.

In this role, you will develop and execute integrated marketing playbooks and measure the efficacy of the programs on regular cadences. With the goal of generating and accelerating pipeline across North America and EMEA regions, you will leverage your experience to build systems that are scaleable, repeatable and sustainable.

With tight alignment with Sales and Revenue Operations teams, you will utilize Salesforce, UserGems, HubSpot to identify intent and track buyer movement, in support of both new business and expansion pipeline. You are accountable, fearless in taking ownership, and ready to move beyond "lead gen" to innovate programs across the entire customer journey.

What You’ll Do

- Full-Lifecycle Account Progression: Develop and execute integrated marketing plans aligned to company growth objectives, focusing on both new logo acquisition and expansion within existing customer accounts.
- Multi-Touch Program Engagement: Drive multi-channel initiatives (such as email, webinars, social, direct mail and digital advertising) to guide target prospects through every phase of the buyer journey.
- Automation & AI Agents: Design and oversee automated agents to streamline routine workflows, accelerate program delivery, and ensure swift, confident execution.
- Intent & Movement Orchestration: Use UserGems intent signals and tracking to trigger automated playbooks that reach and engage buying committees and follow previous champions to new target accounts.
- Customer Marketing & Advocacy: Develop programs to nurture existing customers, leveraging their success stories to drive whitespace expansion and cross-sell.
- Content Strategy & Execution: Co-own the content calendar alongside the content team, designing multi-format programs to engage key contacts and activate target accounts.
- Sales & Success Enablement: Act as the primary marketing contact for sales and BDR teams, leading weekly syncs to align, equip, and empower sellers on activation plans and performance expectations.
- Analytics & Optimization: Track active program metrics continuously, taking direct ownership of course corrections to ensure key performance targets are met.

You Must Have

- Experience: 6+ years of marketing experience with a focus on growth, demand generation, or regional marketing, ideally within a B2B technology or cybersecurity environment.
- ABM Execution: Demonstrable expertise in account-based marketing strategies, tactics, and modern growth technologies.
- Marketing Automation & CRM: Demonstrated expertise with Salesforce, HubSpot, and intent tools (such as UserGems or 6Sense), along with hands-on experience developing MCP agents
- Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret data to derive actionable insights that drive campaign optimization and improve outcomes.
- Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for creating engaging, conversion-focused content.
- Accountability: A strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Why You Should Join Us

- Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
- Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
- Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
- Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
- Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
- Leverage stipends for:
- Wellness
- Work-from-home equipment & wifi
- Learning & development
- Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave
