Director, Lifecycle Marketing Operations

San Francisco, CA, USA

Apply

About the role

Chime is hiring a Director of Lifecycle Marketing Operations to build and run the operational engine behind everything we send to members: campaign execution, channel health and deliverability, the automation and platform layer, and the governance that keeps it all safe and high quality at scale. Most of that work is manual today. Your mandate is to make it faster, higher quality, and increasingly automated, with an agent-supported operation as the destination.

You'll lead a growing execution team through an execution lead and a set of channel and platform specialists, and partner closely with MarTech, Growth Engineering, and the lifecycle strategy leads to turn strategy into live, high-quality messaging. This is a leadership role with real technical depth: you set the operational strategy and prioritize the work, and you go deep into the detail when it counts.

In this role, you can expect to

- Own the Messaging Operations engine and set its operational strategy across campaign execution, channel health, deliverability, automation, and the platform layer — and own the metrics that say whether it's working: throughput, quality, speed to launch, deliverability, and channel health.
- Own the operational process end to end, from intake to launch: build, QA, deployment, and the standards that keep quality and speed high as volume grows.
- Drive the automation and AI-agent roadmap, taking the team from manual execution to supervising and governing automated workflows, and fold what you learn from experimentation into the wider Lifecycle roadmap.
- Own governance for everything that ships: channel standards, deliverability and compliance, and the QA model for automated and agent-driven sending, in a regulated environment where safe sending is non-negotiable.
- Own channel excellence across email, push, in-app, and SMS — health, analytics, opt-in/opt-out, and deliverability. Set the benchmarks the operation runs on, connect them to the business metrics leaders care about, and scout and pilot new channels before we need them.
- Build and lead a growing, increasingly technical team through an execution lead plus channel and platform specialists: set the structure, proactively source talent for your team and across Chime, set clear expectations, and give the team the context and room to own outcomes.
- Act as Lifecycle's primary stakeholder to MarTech on how we use the platform and what gets built on top of it, partner with Growth Engineering on the build, and work with the lifecycle strategy leads to turn their plans into live messaging.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 8+ years in marketing or CRM operations, lifecycle execution, or martech, including 3+ years leading teams — with experience developing leads or managers, not only individual contributors.
- Deep expertise with engagement and CRM platforms (Braze or similar): campaign operations, journey architecture, automation, and the technical layer underneath.
- A strong track record in governance: setting and enforcing channel, deliverability, and compliance standards, and building the QA that keeps a high-volume operation safe.
- A real track record of building toward automation. You've scaled manual processes and have a clear point of view on where AI and agents fit in marketing operations.
- Deep channel health and deliverability expertise at scale: sender reputation, inbox placement, fatigue management, and opt-in/opt-out hygiene.
- Strong operational and analytical judgment. You run on metrics, can tell at a glance whether the engine is healthy, and balance speed against safe, compliant sending in a regulated environment.
- The influence to align peer Directors and VPs across Marketing, Engineering, and Product on shared standards, and the range to lead at altitude on strategy and transformation while translating the technical detail into a story each audience can act on.

Bonus points if you have

- Experience standing up or scaling an automation or agent layer in a marketing or CRM context.
- Fintech or regulated-industry experience and the compliance instincts that come with it.
- Experience in a business where owned-channel volume is measured in millions of sends per week.

A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What we offer for our full-time, regular employees

- 🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
- 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
- ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
- 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
- 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
- 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
- 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
- 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
- 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.

About the Role

We're hiring a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and drive measurable growth outcomes across Chime Enterprise's B2B2C funnel — the path that turns eligible employees at our employer partners into enrolled, funded, and engaged Chime members.

Chime Enterprise is Chime's B2B business, with a vision to be the premier HR benefits platform dedicated to holistic financial wellness. Our flagship product, Chime Workplace, gives employers an all-in-one financial wellness suite at no cost — spanning capital management (including MyPay at Work), capital growth, credit building, and rewards and loyalty (Salt). Sales and Customer Success win and onboard employer partners; once a partner is live, we gain access to their workforce — their _eligible employees_. Converting those eligible employees into Chime members is the challenge this role owns, and mastering it unlocks one of the most powerful and defensible distribution channels at Chime.

This role is embedded directly within the cross-functional Chime Enterprise growth effort and operates as the growth owner, not just a marketing advisor. You'll sit at the intersection of growth strategy, experimentation, performance analysis, and product marketing craft: identifying opportunities, prioritizing and running experiments, and driving metric movement against clear goals. While the role retains core product marketing strengths — research, positioning, and messaging — it goes further by owning results and tradeoffs.

In this role, you can expect to

Growth Ownership & Strategy

- Own end-to-end growth strategy and outcomes for Chime Enterprise's employee-side funnel, from opportunity sizing through roadmap delivery against quarterly and annual goals.
- Serve as the embedded growth lead for Enterprise, co-owning planning with Enterprise Product, Engineering, and Analytics and with Growth Marketing's channel teams.
- Build a repeatable model for converting eligible employees into members that scales across partners rather than being rebuilt deal by deal.

Funnel & Experimentation

- Drive performance across the B2B2C funnel — worksite awareness, enrollment, funding, direct deposit, and early retention — with deep ownership of employer landing pages, eligibility flows, and in-product onboarding.
- Own the Enterprise experimentation roadmap, designing reads that hold up at partner-sized cohorts and deciding what to scale, iterate, or sunset.
- Lead creative and messaging execution for experiments and launches across paid, lifecycle, and owned surfaces.

Offers & Qualified Acquisition

- Own incentives, promotions, and offers that drive qualified acquisition of primary banking relationships — balancing cost per enrollment, activation quality, and long-term value, within partner agreement and compliance guardrails.
- Partner with Lifecycle to connect enrollment, onboarding, and retention into one journey.

GTM & Measurement

- Lead GTM for employer launches, building the playbooks, campaign kits, and reporting that Sales, Customer Success, and GTM/Ops reuse at every go-live.
- Track pacing against goals and translate results into clear briefs and recommendations for Enterprise and Growth Marketing leadership.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, performance marketing, or a related role (level dependent).
- Proven experience driving measurable growth through experimentation and optimization, including owning a funnel metric end to end.
- Experience marketing to end users through a partner, employer, or channel relationship — B2B2C, workplace or benefits marketing, marketplace, or embedded distribution — and comfort operating when you don't fully control the audience or the channel.
- Strong analytical skills; ability to define success metrics, track performance, extract insights, and reason clearly about statistical confidence when sample sizes are constrained.
- Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams, plus commercial partners like Sales and Customer Success.
- Strong storytelling and communication skills — able to translate insights into action, and to speak credibly to both internal stakeholders and external HR partners.
- Strong executive communications and the ability to influence and instill confidence.

About Code3

Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms.

Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.

With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Strategist, Paid Search B2B, you’ll be responsible for leading paid search strategy, activation and thought leadership across a portfolio of B2B clients. You’ll bring a strong understanding of how search can drive demand throughout the B2B buyer journey, from initial consideration and lead generation through qualified opportunities, pipeline and revenue.

You have a deep passion for staying on top of trends and understand how paid search fits into the broader B2B media and demand generation ecosystem. You’ll work closely with cross-disciplinary teams across both challenger and enterprise accounts, managing performance, driving growth and helping clients shift their thinking beyond basic campaign metrics to connect paid search investment with broader marketing, sales and business outcomes.

What you’ll do:

- Provide paid search strategy & conduct routine audits on your portfolio of B2B  accounts across platforms  (Google and Microsoft) and tactics (Brand, Non-Brand, PMAX, Demand Gen, Competitor, and other emerging search opportunities)
- Develop paid search strategies designed to generate qualified leads, opportunities, and sales pipeline, aligning campaign strategy with each client’s business objectives
- Deliver activation excellence on campaign builds, pacing management and optimization deployment
- Conduct keyword research, writing ad copy, optimizations and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs
- Perform QA for all campaign builds, edits, landing pages, URL tags, campaign settings and measurement studies
- Leverage CRM, marketing automation and analytics data to evaluate paid search performance beyond the initial website conversion and identify the campaigns, keywords and audiences driving the greatest business value
- Partner with client and internal teams to develop measurement approaches and feedback loops that connect paid search activity to lead quality, sales outcomes, pipeline, and revenue
- Be a storyteller: turning complex search strategies into compelling campaign recommendations

- Maintain high standards across media planning, forecasting, budgeting, campaign setup, learning agenda development, and performance analysis
- Cultivate strong relationships with clients by providing POVs, industry trends, platform updates and acting as a trusted advisor on search and digital marketing
- Support new business initiatives and pitches by conducting platform audits and recommendations

Who will love this role:

- A paid search marketer who is passionate about the ever-changing media landscape and the evolving role search plays within B2B marketing
- A data-driven decision-maker who enjoys connecting media performance to lead quality, pipeline and business growth
- Someone who is curious about the full customer journey and wants to understand what happens after a prospect converts
- A people person who enjoys building close relationships with teams, partners, and clients
- Someone who is passionate about sharing thought leadership and new ideas through presentations, blogs, and other content channels
- A problem solver with the ability to develop creative solutions

You should have:

- 4-6 years of hands-on paid search experience, including substantial experience developing and optimizing SEM programs for B2B organizations with lead-generation, pipeline and revenue objectives
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing paid search strategies designed to generate qualified leads, opportunities and sales pipeline
- Ability to anticipate client requests, team and agency needs and provide proactive solutions
- Experience working with CRM and marketing automation data to evaluate paid search performance beyond the initial website conversion; experience with platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo or similar strongly preferred
- Certifications in digital marketing and/or paid search media strategy are a plus ( Google Analytics Certification, Microsoft Advertising Search Certification, Google Ads Search Certification, etc.)

The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents here. Salary Range

$82,000 - $106,000USD

Working at Code3

At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human.

Here’s what you can expect as a Coder:

- Remote-first workplace designed to support flexibility and connection
- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus a generous retirement program
- Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program
- Flexible Time Off, sabbatical opportunities, paid holidays, quarterly Company “Recharge” Days, and a holiday closure in December
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities to help you grow your skills and career
- A commitment to transparent DEIB practices and building a workplace where everyone can thrive

A Few Things to Know

All candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check.

Want to get to know us a little better? Check out Life at Code3 to learn more about our people, culture, and what it’s like to be a Coder.

Our Interview Process

During this first call, we’ll get to know you, learn more about your experience, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next opportunity. We’ll also explore alignment with our company and values, and depending on the role, we may ask a few technical or role-specific questions. From there, the process can look a little different depending on the role. You can expect to meet several members of the team and, for some positions, complete a skills assessment such as a Take-Home Assignment or Live Exercise. We’ll make sure you know what to expect every step of the way. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk you through the full process during your initial conversation.

Inclusive Workforce

At Code3, we’re committed to creating a culture where people from all backgrounds feel welcome, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We want every Coder to feel included and have the opportunity to contribute fully to our vision and goals. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic in the location where the candidate is applying.

If you have an accessibility need or would benefit from an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know at recruiting@code3.com. We’re happy to work with you to make the process as comfortable and accessible as possible.

For more information about the data we collect and how we use it, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

We use AI technology to help streamline parts of our hiring workflow. People are at the heart of our hiring process, and all candidate decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition Team.

_Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruitment firms._

Marketing Campaign Manager

Leeds, England, United Kingdom; United States - Remote

Apply

Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Campaign Manager to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple business units within our Education Division. This role will act as the key liaison between each business unit and our external marketing agency to drive pipeline growth across the division’s portfolio of products and services.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in the Eastern U.S. time zone as a fully remote opportunity, with a preference for candidates based in or near Leeds, UK, where the role can be offered in a hybrid/remote capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Planning

- Develop and lead comprehensive, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned to business unit goals.

- Collaborate with business unit stakeholders to understand target audiences, value propositions, and key business priorities to inform marketing campaign strategy and messaging.

Execution & Project Management

- Manage end-to-end campaign execution, partnering with business unit functional teams and our external marketing agency.

- Own campaign timelines, deliverables, and budgets, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.

Performance & Optimization

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance using marketing analytics tools and dashboards.

- Continuously test, optimize, and iterate based on data-driven insights to improve conversion rates and pipeline contribution.

Collaboration & Communication

- Partner closely with sales to ensure campaign alignment, support enablement, and accelerate opportunities.

- Communicate campaign plans, performance, and insights to key stakeholders across marketing and business leadership.

Competencies

- Strategic Execution: Able to translate business objectives into measurable marketing campaigns. Balances creative concepts with analytical rigor to ensure campaigns ladder up to pipeline, revenue, and brand goals. Demonstrates a strong understanding of audience segmentation and funnel dynamics.

- Analytical Decision-Making: Comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify patterns, draw insights, and recommend next steps. Skilled at using experimentation frameworks (A/B, multivariate, incrementality) to validate hypotheses and continuously improve performance.

- Operational Excellence: Drives campaigns from ideation through post-mortem with exceptional organization and attention to detail. Anticipates dependencies across channels, timelines, and stakeholders; maintains clear documentation and repeatable processes for scale.

- Communication and Collaboration: Communicates campaign goals, insights, and results clearly across marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams. Skilled in vendor and stakeholder management, ensuring alignment on deliverables, expectations, and optimization decisions.

- Agility and Growth Mindset: Thrives in dynamic environments. Rapidly adapts to performance trends, feedback, or market changes while maintaining focus on long-term objectives. Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning in new platforms, tools, and testing methods.

- Creative and Brand Stewardship: Shows strong creative judgment and an eye for brand consistency across channels. Partners effectively with content and design teams to ensure messaging and visuals drive engagement while staying true to the company’s identity.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2+ years in campaign management.

- Experience managing campaigns across multiple business units or products within a division.

- Proven success driving integrated campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes (pipeline, revenue)

- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Proficiency in marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot (or Marketo/Eloqua), Google Analytics, and project management tools.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

- Familiarity with segmentation, personalization, and campaign automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

- Vertical B2B SaaS experience in education or edtech

_Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies._

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

- Health and Wellness:
  - Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
- Retirement Savings:
  - 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  - RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
- Paid Time Off:
  - Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
- Parental Leave:
  - 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
- Remote Work Support:
  - Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
- Holidays:
  - Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

Manager, Marketing Science & Analytics

Remote, USA

Apply

WHO WE ARE

Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.

We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

We have offices in the US, London and Germany.  Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, Planet Fitness, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.

OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Supervisor, Marketing Science & Analytics to join Redbox, Crossmedia’s marketing science and data science team. You will serve as a day-to-day analytical lead across client engagements, new business opportunities, and internal initiatives, partnering closely with Analysts, Engineers, Directors, and cross-functional agency teams.

This role combines hands-on statistical and data science expertise with client leadership, team management, and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear, actionable insights.

YOUR ROLE

- Lead marketing science and analytics workstreams across current clients, new business, and internal initiatives, managing projects from data and measurement through analysis, insights, and recommendations.
- Partner directly with clients and account teams to define measurement objectives, translate business questions into testable hypotheses, and develop rigorous analytical approaches.
- Apply statistical and data science methods including media mix modeling (MMM), regression, causal inference, experimentation, geo-lift/DMA holdout testing, Bayesian methods, segmentation, forecasting, and optimization.
- Build, interpret, and communicate statistical models and translate complex analyses into compelling, actionable stories for clients and internal stakeholders.
- Use Python and SQL to analyze data and build reproducible, well-documented analytical workflows; experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery is preferred.
- Develop dashboards, visualizations, and other data products using tools such as Tableau, Python visualization libraries, or Datorama.
- Manage analytical delivery and execution with external measurement and data partners.
- Serve as a trusted statistical and marketing science expert in client meetings, confidently explaining methodology, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
- Ensure analytical work is statistically rigorous, reproducible, and meets XM’s standards for quality.
- Lead and mentor Analysts and Data Scientists, providing guidance on prioritization, analytical approaches, coding practices, and professional development.
- Keep Directors and account teams informed of project progress, risks, and key decisions, escalating issues and seeking senior support when appropriate.
- Contribute to the development of Redbox’s marketing science and data science capabilities through training, thought leadership, technical content, and new methodologies.
- Participate in broader team and agency initiatives, including talent development, recruiting, vendor management, and department planning.
- Stay current on emerging statistical, data science, and marketing measurement approaches and adapt as Redbox’s tools and capabilities evolve.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 3+ years of experience in marketing science, statistics, econometrics, data science, or another quantitative discipline; media or advertising experience is a plus.
- Strong foundation in statistics and hands-on experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
- Proficiency in Python, with experience using tools such as pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, PyMC, Meridian, or similar.
- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets; cloud data warehouse experience preferred.
- Experience with marketing measurement, including MMM, incrementality, experimentation, causal inference, or related methodologies.
- Ability to independently manage analytical workstreams and client relationships while knowing when to bring in senior leadership.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience managing, mentoring, or developing junior team members.
- Curiosity, sound analytical judgment, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning.
- Ability to thrive in a collaborative, evolving environment and move comfortably between client work, new business, and internal initiatives.

CROSSMEDIA BENEFITS

Our principles of Trust, Reason, and the Pursuit of Happiness are brought to life through benefits that recognize and support the diversity and physical, emotional, and professional well-being of our people, including:

- Flexibility to work in hybrid manner with in-office and work from home options (depending on role).
- Open/Flexible PTO/Annual leave with US & UK specific policies
- Sponsored healthcare options and agency-wide physical & mental health support
- 401k with company match (USA), and generous Pension (UK)
- Paid sabbatical at significant milestone anniversaries
- Generous paid parental leave policy
- Life milestone recognition & support
- The Pursuit of Happiness Fund devoted to helping Crossmedians find their happy (be it travel, enrichment class, fitness membership or professional development)
- Cell phone/tech reimbursement
- Student Loan payment plan (US)
- Tuition reimbursement
- Learning & Development and training programs
- And burgers – lots and lots of burgers

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Diversity is in our DNA. As a minority-owned company, our commitment to an inclusive environment has long been embedded into agency practices and at every level. Almost one third of senior leadership identifies as a person of color and over half of our executive leadership are women. We have active mentoring & internship programs that create opportunities for underrepresented groups. Internal agency programming is anchored by XMEquity365, a permanent, year-round initiative fostering acknowledgement and support of marginalized communities within five pillars – Excellence, Voices, Education, Giving & Representation.

_Crossmedia is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and creating a diverse and inclusive company culture and that does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law._

_All job requirements are subject to possible revision to reflect changes in the position requirements, business necessities and/or to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Essential and other job functions are subject to modification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to which will be required in this position. Employees will be required to follow other job-related duties as requested by their supervisor/manager (within guidelines and compliance with laws in the US and UK )._

_Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.” Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions in compliance with the American with Disabilities Act of 1990 (US based)_

_Physical Demands:_

_The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:_

- _Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time._
- _Ability to stand, bend, and reach_
- _Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer._
- _The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations._
- _The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer)._

_In compliance with the current Americans with Disabilities Act and state and local laws, if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation to apply for a position with Crossmedia, please email_ _people.team@xmedia.com_ _.  (US based candidates)._

We’re looking for an Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central to join Cresta’s Revenue Marketing team. This role owns strategy, execution, and performance across a high-volume portfolio of field marketing programs — from industry events and executive dinners to regional programs, roadshows, customer experiences, and partner activations.

This isn’t an events-for-events-sake role. Field Marketing is a meaningful pipeline channel at Cresta, and you’ll partner closely with Sales to determine where we invest, which accounts and audiences we target, and how programs contribute to pipeline creation and acceleration.

- Create Standout Experiences: Bring new ideas and formats to the table that differentiate Cresta and create meaningful experiences for customers and prospects.
- Build Repeatable Playbooks: Develop processes and workflows that allow the field marketing motion to scale as Cresta grows.
- Support Executive Programs: Partner with Cresta executives and Sales leaders on messaging, speaker preparation, executive experiences, and customer engagement.

Qualifications

- 3–5+ years of B2B field marketing, regional marketing, event marketing, or integrated campaign experience
- Experience owning field programs end-to-end, from strategy through execution and measurement
- Comfortable managing 8–10+ concurrent programs per quarter in a fast-moving environment
- Strong understanding of pipeline, revenue attribution, conversion, and event ROI
- Proven experience partnering directly with Sales on account targeting, program strategy, and follow-up
- Experience managing program budgets, vendors, contracts, and competing priorities
- Strong communicator who can work effectively across Sales, Marketing, executives, agencies, and external partners
- Currently based in the Eastern or Central U.S., with a strong preference for East Coast
- Willing and able to travel approximately 20–30%

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or startup environment
- Experience with AI, Contact Center, Customer Experience, or adjacent enterprise technology
- Experience supporting enterprise or strategic Sales teams
- Experience with ABM/account-based field marketing programs
- Previous Sales/SDR experience or strong understanding of enterprise Sales processes
- Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and field marketing/event tools such as Mobly

- Flexible vacation time to support a healthy work-life blend
- Paid parental leave

Role Overview

Cresta is looking for a Growth Marketing Manager who thrives on creativity, innovation, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking, not someone looking to run an existing playbook. This role happens to live in paid and digital (LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads), but the job is to build and own a growth thesis, not to babysit ad accounts. We care more about your ability to reason from first principles and move fast than about whether you've spent years in a specific channel. If you come from a demanding, analytical field such as investment banking, consulting, or a technical or quantitative discipline, and you're hungry to build a career in growth marketing, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

- Own the pipeline and acquisition number for your channels and decide what to double down on and what to pull back.
- Build a growth thesis for our paid and digital mix from first principles, and bring new bets to the table rather than waiting to be told where to focus.
- Lead paid social across LinkedIn and Meta Ads and a focused paid search program alongside it.
- Partner with our brand designer on ad creative, pushing the quality bar and staying current on what's working.
- Monitor campaign pacing against budget and pipeline goals, flagging issues proactively and knowing when to kill something versus double down.
- Leverage AI tools and audience enrichment platforms (including Clay) to build precise targeting, automate workflows, and drive output at a lean-team scale.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with demand generation, content, creative, sales, etc.

Qualifications

- A track record of excellence in a demanding, analytical field such as investment banking, consulting, biz ops, a co-founder or early startup builder background, or a technical or quantitative discipline (econ, stats, math, or similar), with genuine interest in growth marketing. We evaluate on outcomes, not pedigree. (Strong traditional digital marketing backgrounds will also be considered.)
- Quantitative fluency; a math-first brain that reasons about performance from the data.
- Demonstrated creativity and original thinking: evidence you generate ideas rather than default to convention.
- Strategic mindset: able to connect day-to-day execution to broader business goals, and a sense of ownership over the number, not just the tasks.

Senior Demand Generation Manager

Remote - United States

Apply

The Opportunity:

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger.

It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline.

You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working.

What You'll Do

- Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself.
- Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution.
- Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results.
- Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume.
- Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync.
- Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution.
- Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread.

What You'll Bring

- A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync.
- Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency.
- Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks.
- B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle.
- Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners.
- Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role.
- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively  manage internal stakeholders and external vendors and partners.

Bonus Points

- Experience in privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or another regulated, technical software category.
- Marketo or Pardot experience alongside HubSpot.
- Familiarity with account-based marketing or intent-data tools.
- Comfort using AI to speed up operational work, such as campaign QA, data hygiene, or reporting synthesis.
- Experience being the first or founding owner of a demand gen or marketing ops function, from the ground up with hands-on responsibility for building and scaling it.

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 Days You'll:

- Learn DataGrail's product, buyer personas, and ICP quickly enough to start contributing, not just observing, and meet the marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success teams to understand what's running and where the friction is.
- Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel.
- Drive the event calendar and process, and produce a keep, fix, or cut recommendation for each program.
- Audit HubSpot and existing reporting, and deliver a written list of what's fragile, missing, or misleading in current attribution and lifecycle reporting.
- Ship at least one visible fix to a live, underperforming channel or process

Within 180 Days You'll:

- Show measurable improvement, with before and after comparisons, on two to three of the biggest inefficiencies identified in the 90-day audit, whether that's rebalanced paid spend, improved event-to-pipeline conversion, or cleaner attribution.
- Run paid media and events with full autonomy, proposing and executing budget and calendar changes without waiting on sign-off.
- Ship at least three new or rebuilt nurture and re-engagement tracks, with early performance data on each.
- Rebuild or upgrade the dashboards used for weekly pipeline calls.
- Build a working rhythm with Sales, RevOps, and Product Marketing so hand-offs, routing, and lead flow don't require chasing people down.

Within 365 Days You'll:

- Own a program for paid media, events, and HubSpot that runs noticeably better than the one you inherited, with clear before and after numbers on channel efficiency and cost per qualified opportunity.
- Be the person others trust when they want to know how well our campaigns and events are actually performing.
- Have made real budget and channel calls, moving spend into what works and cutting what doesn't, with pipeline impact you can point to.
- Have built a foundation that doesn't need rebuilding when volume doubles.
- Have identified where the team needs more support, whether that's tooling, headcount, or an agency change, and made the case for it.

Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state.

All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change.

Compensation Range

$140,000 - $165,000USD

About Us:

DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales.

Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC.

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social, you'll be central to how we grow our member base. You'll run, test, and tune campaigns across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Snap, and more) and programmatic, and partner day to day with Analytics, Creative, and Product to design rigorous tests that move growth faster. You'll also own our paid social AI workflows and insight reporting, and shape where they go next. We're looking for someone fluent in mobile attribution and incrementality testing who has built real experimentation roadmaps, not just run one-off tests.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $162,849-$199,037, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Optimize through data: Use performance data and insights to refine campaigns, test new channels, and improve creative, so every dollar drives incremental growth.
- Lead experimentation and measurement: Build, prioritize, and run new user acquisition initiatives, with structured measurement frameworks behind each one.
- Launch new products: Own campaign execution, forecasts, and growth experiments for new product launches, working with cross-functional partners to hit efficiency and conversion targets.
- Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Analytics, Creative, and Product so paid social stays tied to business goals.
- Drive creative testing: Partner with Creative to develop and test ad concepts, keep a structured creative learning agenda, and scale winning formats across channels.
- Accelerate agentic workflows: Build and iterate on AI workflows that surface performance insights faster. Experience creating agents or sub-agents is a strong plus.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years of experience in growth marketing, with 7+ years of hands-on experience in B2C growth marketing for a mobile-first company.
- Proven track record running and optimizing campaigns across paid social and programmatic channels.
- Strong analytical skills (incrementality testing, MMM, marginal CAC) and the judgment to turn data into better performance.
- Deep experience with mobile attribution and MMPs.
- Comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution.
- A collaborative mindset and a track record of working across teams toward shared goals.
- Clear, confident presenting of performance insights and strategy to cross-functional partners and senior leadership.
- A proactive, self-driven approach to testing ideas and building new processes.
- A genuine interest in helping build a financial system that works for everyone.

LI-Hybrid

Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing

- Remote - Australia: Select locations

Role Description

As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox’s regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets—Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan—while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox’s global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance.

You will be Dropbox Marketing’s senior voice in the region—bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution.

Responsibilities

- Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox’s global marketing strategy.
- Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth.
- Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics.
- Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data.
- Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution.
- Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox’s market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand.
- Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams.
- Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI.
- Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression.
- Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution.
- Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries.
- Travel within the region and internationally as needed to support team leadership, sales planning, partner engagement, and key programs—approximately 20%

Requirements

- 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional, field, demand generation, and/or channel marketing within enterprise software, SaaS, or another technology environment.
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-country APJ marketing strategies that produced measurable pipeline and sales impact.
- People-management experience, including coaching and developing marketers working across different countries, cultures, or time zones.
- Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, translate sales priorities into marketing plans, and build alignment through planning and business reviews.
- Experience leading an integrated mix of field and channel programs, including events, account-based programs, partner co-marketing, campaigns, and pipeline-acceleration initiatives.
- Strong commercial and analytical skills, including experience managing regional budgets, setting program KPIs, evaluating pipeline contribution, and using performance data to optimize investment.
- Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed, and highly collaborative organization.

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep familiarity with the APJ technology market, with experience developing differentiated strategies across mature and emerging markets; direct experience in several of Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets is strongly preferred.
- Experience in a channel-led or partner-influenced go-to-market model, including co-marketing with resellers, distributors, alliances, or technology partners.
- Experience building or evolving a regional marketing function, operating model, or playbook in a growing or changing business.
- Strong understanding of enterprise and commercial buying journeys, account-based marketing, opportunity acceleration, and regional event strategy.
- Experience working in a Virtual First or similarly distributed global organization.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to _amplify_ human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

- Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
- Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
- Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
- Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Read more about our benefits here.

Company Description

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

Team Description

The Dropbox Marketing Team shows the world how Dropbox makes work better. We're storytellers and strategists, exploring new ways to connect our products with the people who need them. From product launches to campaign strategy, message positioning to digital marketing, we blend creativity with data-driven insights to build our brand and grow our impact. Working across disciplines, you will tap into your own inventiveness while collaborating with teams throughout the organization, including Product, Sales and Engineering. If you're excited about translating complex technologies into engaging narratives and shaping how the world understands and experiences Dropbox, join our Marketing team.

Virtual First

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI Fluency

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We look for four key behaviors in candidates:

- Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
- Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.

Role Description

As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox’s regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets—Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan—while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox’s global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance.

You will be Dropbox Marketing’s senior voice in the region—bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution.

Responsibilities

- Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox’s global marketing strategy.
- Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth.
- Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics.
- Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data.
- Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution.
- Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox’s market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand.
- Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams.
- Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI.
- Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression.
- Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution.
- Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries.
- Travel within the region and internationally as needed to support team leadership, sales planning, partner engagement, and key programs—approximately 20%

Requirements

- 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional, field, demand generation, and/or channel marketing within enterprise software, SaaS, or another technology environment.
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-country APJ marketing strategies that produced measurable pipeline and sales impact.
- People-management experience, including coaching and developing marketers working across different countries, cultures, or time zones.
- Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, translate sales priorities into marketing plans, and build alignment through planning and business reviews.
- Experience leading an integrated mix of field and channel programs, including events, account-based programs, partner co-marketing, campaigns, and pipeline-acceleration initiatives.
- Strong commercial and analytical skills, including experience managing regional budgets, setting program KPIs, evaluating pipeline contribution, and using performance data to optimize investment.
- Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed, and highly collaborative organization.

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep familiarity with the APJ technology market, with experience developing differentiated strategies across mature and emerging markets; direct experience in several of Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets is strongly preferred.
- Experience in a channel-led or partner-influenced go-to-market model, including co-marketing with resellers, distributors, alliances, or technology partners.
- Experience building or evolving a regional marketing function, operating model, or playbook in a growing or changing business.
- Strong understanding of enterprise and commercial buying journeys, account-based marketing, opportunity acceleration, and regional event strategy.
- Experience working in a Virtual First or similarly distributed global organization.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to _amplify_ human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

- Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
- Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
- Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
- Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Read more about our benefits here.

Company Description

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

Team Description

The Dropbox Marketing Team shows the world how Dropbox makes work better. We're storytellers and strategists, exploring new ways to connect our products with the people who need them. From product launches to campaign strategy, message positioning to digital marketing, we blend creativity with data-driven insights to build our brand and grow our impact. Working across disciplines, you will tap into your own inventiveness while collaborating with teams throughout the organization, including Product, Sales and Engineering. If you're excited about translating complex technologies into engaging narratives and shaping how the world understands and experiences Dropbox, join our Marketing team.

Virtual First

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI Fluency

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We look for four key behaviors in candidates:

- Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
- Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
- Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
- Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

Growth Marketing Specialist

Brooklyn, New York

Apply

As a Growth Marketing Specialist, you will scale our Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) by contributing to enrollment growth. You will support the marketing strategy and enrollment goals for key device categories. By combining your skills in multi-channel marketing and project management, you will execute initiatives that champion our VPP programs. You will also collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to support existing relationships and identify opportunities for optimization.

To thrive in this role, you should be a versatile marketer who embraces new challenges as opportunities to learn and grow. A natural curiosity and an appetite for testing, analyzing, and adapting will be the keys to your success.

What you will do:

- Deeply understand the customer journey, identify friction points, and stay informed about industry realities.
- Execute multi-channel marketing campaigns, including paid social, to deliver measurable growth.
- Use marketing analytics to build reporting and surface data-driven insights for ongoing initiatives.
- Help manage paid media, regularly analyzing marketing efforts to identify bottlenecks, optimize channels, and confidently make strategic assumptions with existing data.
- Coordinate co-marketing efforts with OEMs, complementary brands, and communities.
- Explore creative messaging strategies and work with external copywriters and designers to deliver high-quality, on-brand content and design assets.

What we expect from you:

- 3-4 years of non-internship marketing experience, ideally in a startup or agency environment where you gained hands-on experience across multiple channels rather than being specialized in just one area.
- High comfort level with ambiguity. You are willing to test out new concepts, learn fast, and pivot your approach when data tells you a campaign is not working.
- Foundational knowledge of marketing analytics with a growing ability to review datasets and translate insights into actionable strategies.
- Hands-on experience with marketing tracking, platforms, and tools like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta, and CMS platforms.
- Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools such as Sigma, Tableau, or adjacent technologies is a plus.
- Strong project management and communication skills to support multiple campaigns and collaborate effectively across teams.
- Curiosity to develop category knowledge and a willingness to learn creative and customer experience best practices.

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

- Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
- Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
- Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.
- Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate.

About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

To learn more, visit energyhub.com.

EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.

About the Role

Travel is Engine's core product and our biggest growth opportunity. We're looking for a Travel Performance Manager to own the full paid performance portfolio for our B2B Travel product line. Driving net-new business sign-ups and converting them into first-time bookers, across every paid channel that reaches the business travel buyer, from search and social to programmatic, CTV, audio, and the emerging channels we haven't tested yet.

This role sits on the Performance Marketing team and is accountable to product-line efficiency, while driving effective channel performance. You'll own the strategy, execution, and measurement of every paid dollar we spend to acquire B2B Travel customers. This is an established program with real spend behind it, and it's scaling fast.
