- Drive net-new business sign-ups and improve the rate at which sign-ups convert into first-time bookers, owning both halves of the acquisition motion.
- Drive acquisition efficiency, measured against product-line ROAS and LTV:CAC, not channel-level proxies.
- Partner across Performance, Analytics, and Product to ensure measurement, attribution, and signal quality reach a high bar across the sign-up and first-booking funnel.
- Own the creative testing loop for Travel (hypothesis, variant, scaled winner) in partnership with brand and creative resources.
- Lead channel expansion into net-new paid channels (CTV, Spotify and audio, direct mail, emerging platforms) with a structured test-and-graduate framework.
- Build and maintain the weekly performance narrative for Travel: what's working, what's not, and what's next.
- Coordinate with lifecycle and CRM so paid acquisition hands off cleanly into the customer journey, without owning the email and journey flows yourself.
- Use AI tools and workflows to increase throughput: audience building, creative briefing, performance reporting, and in-platform optimization.

Who you are

- 7–10 years of performance marketing experience with a track record of driving efficient acquisition against ROAS, LTV:CAC, or payback-period targets.
- You've owned a full paid portfolio, not just one or two channels, and know when to scale, hold, or kill spend.
- You've managed paid programs at meaningful scale, and you know how to grow spend without letting efficiency slip.
- Deep hands-on experience across search, social, and programmatic. Bonus points if you've tested and scaled net-new channels like CTV, audio, podcast, or direct mail.
- Strong creative instincts. You can brief, evaluate, and iterate on creative with a clear point of view, not just rely on an agency or designer to drive the loop.
- AI-fluent and systems-adaptive. You've actively used AI tools to change how you work, and you can onboard new platforms and workflows without hand-holding.
- You understand measurement end-to-end: attribution, incrementality, MMM, and why each matters at different altitudes.
- Comfortable with SQL or BI tools at a functional level. You can pull and interpret your own data without waiting on analytics.
- B2B SaaS experience preferred. Travel, T&E, or high-velocity B2B backgrounds are a plus.
- You lead with data and outcomes, not activity or impressions.
- Comfortable balancing optimization of an established program with expansion into new channels.
- Direct communicator who can speak to executives and ICs with equal clarity.

- Proactively surface data quality or process issues and collaborate on solutions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally, showing initiative and accountability in all communications and project work.

About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how  law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.

Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.

Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.

AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.

Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About This Role:

You will own Eve's messaging house - the single source of truth for what Eve is, why it wins, and who it's for - and you will own the places that messaging actually gets tested: the first call deck, the keynote stage, and our customer stories.This is a role that makes sure every rep, every exec, and every event says the same differentiated thing, and that the thing itself is sharp enough to win.

What You Will Accomplish:

- Own the messaging house. Build and maintain the master messaging framework - core narrative, value pillars, proof points, persona messaging, and competitive counter-positioning.
- Own the first call deck. The highest-leverage asset in the company. You own its narrative, its structure, and its evolution, iterating against real deal outcomes
- Own our event session content. Own the narrative arc, script, and build of Eve's keynote and event sessions, partnering with the presenter (often an exec) from outline to stage, and in some cases presenting yourself.
- Partner with the executive team. Work directly with the CEO, CPO, and product leadership as the person who sharpens how they tell the Eve story — in board decks, on stage, on podcasts, and in the field. You'll push back on language that's vague, internal, or undifferentiated.
- Make sure we sound different. Build a defensible, well-sourced point of view on how Eve wins against the legal AI landscape, and make sure that difference is legible in every asset. If our messaging could be lifted onto a competitor's site without anyone noticing, that's your problem to fix.
- Ground it in the market. Talk to customers, prospects, and reps constantly. Bring what you hear back into the messaging and into Product.
- Make the messaging travel. Partner with Enablement, Demand Gen, Content, and the broader PMM team so the framework shows up accurately in collateral, campaigns, training, and launches.

What We Are Looking For:

7+ years in B2B SaaS or legal tech product marketing, with a track record of owning messaging and positioning for a core product or platform — not just contributing to it.An exceptional writer. You can take technical AI depth and turn it into something a busy plaintiff attorney understands in one pass. You care about the difference between a good sentence and a nearly-good one.Comfortable on stage and in front of executives. You can hold your own in a room with the CEO, and you can build a keynote that lands with a live audience.You think in frameworks — competitive messaging, category design, buyer psychology — and can explain not just what a product does, but why it wins.Genuinely curious about the market. You are willing to sit on ten sales calls and read analyst reports.A strong cross-functional partner who can hold one consistent story across Product, Sales, Events, and Marketing without becoming a bottleneck.

Nice to Have: Legal AI experience

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Operations Manager to oversee the delivery and analysis of Ethos’ CRM lifecycle campaigns, with an emphasis on email and SMS campaign execution. - Script dynamic communications to build a personalized user experience
- Write SQL to manage/build data tables, and build custom audience segmentation

- Establishing high quality processes and infrastructure for our email and SMS tooling
- Codifying documentation of internal best practices, tooling, and process improvements

- Extremely high attention to detail, all while managing a large volume of campaigns simultaneously

- Strong collaboration skills in team environments, ability to effectively work with key stakeholders to clarify campaign requirements, but able to act quickly as the decision-maker
- High technical aptitude with the ability to quickly ramp up on internal nuances related to people, processes, and technology.
- A minimum of 4 years of experience building cross-channel campaigns using ESP platforms and/or marketing automation platforms
- Experience in launching audience-specific dynamic content lifecycle and event-triggered CRM programs
- Working familiarity with HTML/CSS
- Comfort with data pipelines and architecture, targeting, multi-step workflows, QA, and reporting
- Strong knowledge of best practices for email creative, segmentation, dynamic content, testing methodologies, deliverability, CAN-SPAM regulations, email deployment platforms, and ESPs
- Knowledge of the interconnectivity between technology and customer experience
- Ability to compile a well-articulated dashboard and share performance metrics
- Excellent project management skills, ability to multitask effectively, and work cross-functionally

Director, Marketing Operations, Technology, and Analytics (Remote)

Boston, MA

Apply

ezCater is the #1 food tech platform for workplaces in the US. The company makes it easy for any organization to manage its food needs and order from over 125,000 restaurants nationwide. For workplaces, ezCater provides flexible and scalable solutions for everything from employee meal programs to one-off meetings, all backed by 24/7 service and business-grade reliability. For restaurant partners, ezCater helps grow their business by bringing them new high-value customers and large orders.

As Director of Marketing Operations, Technology & Analytics, you will lead the people, processes, systems, and measurement that enable Marketing to execute reliably, scale efficiently, and make data-informed decisions. Reporting to the VP, Brand & Digital Marketing, you will lead a multidisciplinary team that supports ezCater’s blended B2B and B2C growth model across demand generation, lifecycle, marketplace customer acquisition, and restaurant-partner GTM motions.

You will lead and develop a high-performing team and ensure Marketing can move quickly with trusted data, strong governance, and rigorous measurement. You will own the marketing measurement strategy that helps the business understand what is working, why it is working, what is incremental, and where to invest next. You will also partner closely with business stakeholders and analytics leaders across Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering & Data Tech, and Finance.

What You'll Do:

- Lead a team across marketing operations, marketing technology, and marketing analytics
- Balance near-term execution with longer-term capability building and communicating trade-offs clearly when priorities change
- Define and evolve the operating model, governance, and cross-functional processes that enable scalable campaign and lifecycle execution across Marketing
- Own the martech strategy and roadmap, from architecture through day-to-day governance, including marketing automation, CRM and audience data, customer data platforms, web content systems, advertising operations, analytics, and workflow tools
- Ensure marketing systems and data flows work together across platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Iterable, WordPress, ActionIQ, Google Marketing Platform, Google Analytics, BI tools, and related technologies.
- Drive collaboration among Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to build an evolved martech stack that helps realize our strategic vision and deliver AI-driven processes and technology that improve marketing workflows
- Evolve the architecture of our marketing-owned web experience, ensuring end-user friendliness and enhanced testing and analytics
- Lead marketing analytics and measurement strategy, including attribution, incrementality testing, forecasting, executive reporting, and advanced analysis, to improve marketing efficiency and guide investment decisions
- Partner with leaders in Marketing, Finance, Product, and other Analytics teams to translate marketing performance into channel- and segment-level investment decisions, forecasts, and scenarios
- Set standards for analytical quality and storytelling, focusing the team on proactive decision support and analysis

What You Have:

- 10+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Technology and Analytics
- Proven experience leading through managers and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary teams of operators, technologists, analysts, and data professionals.
- Strong judgment in balancing strategic leadership with enough functional depth to challenge assumptions, coach the team, and drive quality across marketing operations, technology and analytics
- Demonstrated ability to create clarity, prioritization, and structure in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and frequently changing environment.
- Strong understanding of marketing data and technology architecture, including CRM, marketing automation, CDP or audience data, data warehouses, APIs, integrations, web analytics, advertising platforms, and business intelligence tools.
- Deep experience translating marketing data into insights across the full funnel, including acquisition, paid media, SEO/GEO, attribution, and retention; familiarity with both B2C and B2B models preferred.
- Experience implementing, owning, and improving marketing processes and technology across multiple engagement channels, including web, email, SMS, push, mobile, paid media, direct mail, and sales or account-based motions.
- Experience evolving the infrastructure for successful marketing web content management and landing pages, including personalization, testing and optimization (enterprise Google Analytics implementation experience preferred)
- Experience building or implementing AI enablement programs, including prioritizing use cases, setting practical guardrails, evaluating tools and risks, and helping teams adopt AI responsibly.
- Excellent communication, executive presence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, technical, and analytical topics into clear decisions and actions.
- A customer- and partner-first mindset, strong bias toward outcomes over activity, and a practical approach to testing, learning, iterating, and scaling what works.
- Ability to travel up to 5 days per quarter for Together Weeks, team gatherings and other events, when applicable.

_The national total targetcash compensation range for this position, including base salary and bonus target, is $195,864-$268,420 annually.*_

_*Please note: Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise and region & may vary from the amount above. This range does not represent additional compensation benefits (such as equity, 401K or medical, dental or vision insurance)._

ezCater does not sponsor applicants for work visas or legal permanent residence.

What You’ll Get from Us:

You’ll get a terrifically compelling experience in an innovative, high performing environment. You’ll get to work with engaged and passionate colleagues on challenging and impactful projects. You will have opportunities to grow in your career, and work in a place that values work/life harmony.

Oh, and you’ll get all this: Market competitive salary, stock options that you’ll help make worth a lot, 12 paid holidays, flexible PTO, 401K with ezCater match, health/dental/FSA, long-term disability insurance, mental health and family planning resources, remote-hybrid work from our awesome Boston office OR your home OR a mixture of both home and office, a tremendous amount of responsibility and autonomy, wicked awesome co-workers, employee meal program (and many more goodies) when you’re in our office, and knowing that you helped transform the food for work space.

ezCater is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace humans of every background, appearance, race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, and disability status. At the same time, we do not employ jerks, even brilliant ones. Following a conditional offer of employment, ezCater may require a background check.

For information on how ezCater collects and uses job applicants' personal information, please visit our Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Who you are

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller, operator, and builder.

You love turning complex products into simple customer stories that help sales teams win. You think beyond launches—you think about commercialization, adoption, pipeline, and revenue. You understand that great product marketing isn't about creating more assets. It's about building systems.

You've partnered closely with Product, Sales, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership to define positioning, create value messaging, develop repeatable sales motions, and improve how products reach the market.

You're comfortable creating the strategy yourself while also building the playbooks, messaging, presentations, and processes needed to make it real.

Most importantly, you're excited about building a function that doesn't exist today.

Your impact

Senior Director, Brand Marketing

Remote - USA

Apply now

A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

- Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
- Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is writing a new chapter. We are moving from a well-loved product in a category we helped define to a brand that fleet operators, technicians, and executives recognize at first sight and trust on instinct. We put our name on a NASCAR race. We have a car on track with 23XI Racing. We are rebuilding the company narrative around where fleet operations are actually going — not where it has been.

What we need now is the person who makes it all feel like one thing.

As Senior Director of Brand, you own how Fleetio looks, sounds, and shows up — everywhere. Our visual identity. Our editorial voice. Our social presence and video work. Our earned media. The creative expression of the company story across every surface a customer, a candidate, or an analyst will ever touch. You will lead a talented in-house team and a set of agency partners, and report directly to the CMO on a marketing leadership team being rebuilt for the next stage of growth.

This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. The narrative foundation is being set now. You get to define the expression of it.

Fleetio has a product customers love and a story the market has not yet fully heard. Closing that gap is the single highest-leverage thing marketing can do for this company right now. This seat is where that work lives.

What You’ll Own

- Brand system and creative. Visual identity, creative direction, and design standards across web, campaign, product surfaces, events, and sponsorship — the system that makes Fleetio recognizable in a category where most brands look interchangeable.
- Content and thought leadership. Editorial strategy and the content engine — thought leadership, long-form, owned research, and the always-on content that builds authority with fleet leaders and feeds organic and AI-driven search.
- Social and multimedia. Organic social and video as a real channel, not an afterthought — the presence that keeps Fleetio in the conversation between sales cycles.
- Communications and PR. Earned media strategy in partnership with our PR agency, executive visibility programs, awards, and the messaging discipline that holds across every external moment.
- Brand activation. Turning our 23XI Racing partnership and our field presence into a year-round content and storytelling engine — not a logo on a car.
- Team and partners. Hiring, developing, and leading the brand and content team; owning agency relationships, creative operations, and the intake and prioritization system that lets a small team punch far above its weight.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year:

- The new Fleetio narrative is live and consistent everywhere — from the homepage to the trade show booth to the sales deck — and it looks and sounds unmistakably like us.
- Awareness and share of voice move measurably in our favor in the fleet management category.
- The content engine runs at a cadence demand generation, and sales can actually build on, anchored by at least one owned research franchise, the industry cites.
- The NASCAR partnership produces story, not just impressions — with a content calendar behind every race weekend.
- The brand and content team is stronger, clearer on standards, and doing the best work of their careers.

Who You Are

- 10+ years in brand leadership, including 4+ years leading and developing teams.
- You have taken a B2B brand — ideally SaaS, ideally at meaningful scale — through a narrative or identity evolution, and shipped it into market. Not just designed it. Shipped it.
- You have real taste, editorial and visual, and the judgment to know when good enough ships and when it does not.
- You are comfortable being measured. Awareness, share of voice, engagement, content-influenced pipeline — you can hold a number and defend it in front of a CEO.
- You are a genuine partner to product marketing, demand generation, events, and customer marketing. Brand does not work in a room by itself.
- You have managed agencies well — gotten more out of them than the retainer suggested.
- You like real-world industries. Our buyers are fleet managers, technicians, and operations leaders. They are not marketers, and they can smell marketing from a mile away.

Nice to Have

- Sponsorship, partnership, or experiential activation experience — sports, motorsport, or large-scale events.
- Experience building or running an in-house creative studio.
- Challenger-brand or category-creation experience against a larger, better-funded incumbent.
- Fluency in how content strategy is changing under AI-driven search and answer engines.

Benefits

- Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
- Vision insurance
- Incentive stock options
- 401(k) match of 4%
- PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
- 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays

- You bring focus and clarity to territory marketing, aligning efforts to the accounts and regions that matter most
- You use Salesforce and data to connect the dots between marketing activities and revenue impact
- You help us show up in the market in a way that feels authentic, helpful, and distinctly Fleetio
- You test, learn, and improve, building a field marketing motion that gets better every quarter
- You find creative ways to break through the noise without overcomplicating things
- You help us build stronger relationships with customers and prospects, not just leads, but real people

- 5–7 years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with a strong field or demand gen focus
- A track record of working closely with sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue
- Experience planning and executing events, campaigns, and account-based programs
- Comfort working in Salesforce and using data to guide decisions
- Ability to own programs end-to-end—from idea to execution to measuring impact
- A mindset that balances creativity with practicality (you know what’s worth doing—and what’s not)
- Willingness to travel ~30–40% to spend time in the field with customers and sales

Benefits

- Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)

- Incentive stock options

Senior Data Scientist, Mobile Marketing Analytics

United States - Remote

Apply

About Us:

Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.

With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

Data Science at Gametime

Our Marketing Analytics team is a cross-functional group supporting all aspects of Gametime, partnering closely with User Acquisition to optimize mobile campaign performance across channels like Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and other paid platforms. We drive creative and spend efficiency through rigorous experimentation, advanced measurement, and granular channel analysis, and we work to strengthen the connection between platform-reported performance, attribution-based data, and internal customer economics. The team studies mobile cohorts to identify high-value opportunities across leagues, teams, performers, and user segments, with an eye toward maximizing lifetime value and durable growth.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help build and scale the analytical frameworks that power mobile marketing at Gametime, from executive-level performance narratives down to campaign, creative, cohort, and audience-level diagnostics.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with mobile marketing, paid social platforms, mobile attribution, experimentation, causal measurement, audience management, and financial profitability modeling in a marketplace or consumer mobile setting, and is comfortable moving fluidly between strategic and highly granular work.

We hire based on impact and capability, not just years of experience. We encourage you to apply and your level will be fully determined and agreed in the interview process.

What You'll Do

- Own the analytical frameworks for tracking mobile marketing effectiveness in a privacy-aware environment, bridging platform-reported data, attribution data, MMP data, and internal truth to support confident decisions despite measurement noise.
- Own the end-to-end design and maintenance of marketing analytics dashboards in Sigma/Tableau, serving as a trusted source of truth for performance, user quality, payback, and profitability reporting.
- Conduct granular analysis on campaign, ad set, ad, and creative performance (IPM, CPM, CPI, CAC, ROAS), providing data-driven recommendations and partnering with marketing to spot creative fatigue and winning assets.
- Analyze mobile user cohorts to understand retention, monetization, payback, and LTV behaviors, identifying efficiency trends across leagues, teams, and acquisition sources to guide budget allocation.
- Partner with marketing and finance to understand channel incrementality, profitability, and spend efficiency, building financial scenario models to inform where to scale, reduce, or reallocate spend.
- Design, analyze, and interpret experiments to measure true channel incrementality and marketing lift, including geo-lift, PSA tests, and audience holdouts, translating results into practical recommendations.
- Own analytical support for retargeting and audience strategy, building and maintaining user lists and improving segmentation to ensure programs drive incremental value rather than capturing organic demand.
- Analyze how marketplace conditions, event demand, league mix, pricing, and seasonality influence acquisition efficiency, helping distinguish marketing execution shifts from broader marketplace dynamics.
- Partner with leadership to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations on spend allocation, channel strategy, and growth investment, communicating tradeoffs and risks to support fast decisions.
- Stay current on the evolving mobile privacy and attribution landscape (Apple ATT, MMP capabilities) to keep data science a competitive advantage in how Gametime measures and scales mobile growth.

What You'll Bring

- 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth data science, mobile analytics, or a related field; Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
- Prior experience at a mobile-first company, with deep understanding of mobile attribution, Apple ATT, MMPs, and privacy-aware measurement solutions.
- Hands-on experience with Meta, TikTok, Reddit, or similar paid social platforms, analyzing performance at the campaign, creative, and cohort level.
- Experience evaluating acquisition and retargeting performance through LTV, CAC, ROAS, payback windows, and profitability models.
- Experience designing and interpreting marketing experiments or causal measurement studies, such as geo-lift tests and audience holdouts.
- Experience building, managing, or analyzing user lists for paid marketing activation, with a strong grasp of segmentation, suppression logic, and saturation.
- Strong foundation in statistics, with experience in experimentation, incrementality measurement, cohort analysis, and causal inference.
- Experience analyzing creative performance and identifying fatigue to improve testing frameworks.
- Proficiency in Python or R and SQL, along with hands-on experience with BI tools (Tableau, Sigma) and Mobile Measurement Partners (Adjust, AppsFlyer, etc.).
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical insights and attribution nuances in a way that supports executive decision-making.
- Preferred: experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) or incrementality testing, and experience in ticketing, live events, marketplaces, or consumer mobile apps.
- Preferred: experience working with highly seasonal businesses, event-driven demand, or shifting supply and pricing dynamics.

What We Offer:

- Flexible PTO
- Competitive salary & equity package
- Monthly Gametime credits for any event ($1,200/yr)
- Medical, dental, & vision insurance
- Life insurance and disability benefits
- Diverse Family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
- 401k, HSA, pre-tax savings programs
- Company off-sites and meet-ups
- Wellness programs
- Tenure recognition

- Collaborate with Data and Analytics teams on attribution, incrementality, and measurement initiatives.

- Build reporting frameworks and performance insights that support decision-making across Growth leadership.

- Deep expertise in Google Ads, Performance Max, SA360, and Microsoft Ads.
- Strong understanding of bidding systems, attribution, incrementality, and performance measurement.
- Experience operating large-scale search programs in complex environments.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently evaluate performance and identify growth opportunities.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, reporting automation, and search optimization tools.

Leadership & Collaboration

- Strong ownership mindset and accountability for business outcomes.
- Ability to influence Product, Data, and Creative teams through data and clear communication.
- Comfortable operating independently within a lean, high-performing team.
- Strong experimentation mindset and bias toward testing and learning.

Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years of in-house paid search experience.

- Demonstrated ownership of ROAS, CPA, or similar business outcomes.

Nice to Have

- AI fluency within search workflows and analysis.

About Faire

About this role

You'll own retailer product marketing at Faire. Your job is to make Faire simple for retailers, grow their share of wallet, and set the strategy for how we position and communicate Faire's value to them. You'll be the senior thought partner to the Retailer Product org, Revenue, Marketing, and Ops, bringing the retailer point of view into the room and connecting every launch to the bigger picture. You'll lead a team of product marketers and report to our CMO.

What you’ll do

- Own a sharp, consistent retailer narrative: set the strategy for how Faire communicates each core value prop, how those props reinforce each other to grow share of wallet, and when to message which products across the retailer lifecycle
- Lead the 'Opening Soon' initiative, our motion to acquire retailers opening new stores, and grow both the volume we acquire and how well we convert them
- Own go-to-market for complex retailer products end to end: positioning, messaging, and multi-channel execution
- Lead and develop a team of PMM ICs, setting direction, allocating work, and coaching them to own launches end to end
- Partner with Product, Revenue, Growth Marketing, and Ops leaders, getting involved upstream to shape roadmaps through customer insight
- Design and run research, quantitative and qualitative, to validate positioning, sharpen messaging, and measure GTM impact
- Model AI adoption for the team and help them find real ways to use AI to sharpen and speed up their work

Qualifications

Must haves:

- Experience managing and developing product marketing ICs across career stages, knowing when to get close to the work and when to step back
- Deep GTM ownership for complex products, with direct responsibility for positioning, messaging, and multi-channel execution
- A builder who creates structure where none exists. You build the framework or playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for someone to define the work
- Obsessed with the retailer. You spend real time with them, cut jargon and messaging that doesn't matter, and hold a coherent narrative across launches instead of a pile of product stories
- Strong cross-functional instincts. You build trust fast, disagree directly, commit cleanly, and are the person partners pull into rooms early
- Bias to ship. You'd rather launch something directionally right this month than perfect next quarter, and you make calls with incomplete information
- Fluent in the metrics that move the business. You connect positioning, messaging, and GTM to GMV, retention, and whichever KPIs matter, and use data to validate positioning and measure impact
- AI fluency. You actively experiment with and adopt AI tools to sharpen your own work, and model that for the team

Nice to haves:

- Retail or SMB experience, with a feel for how independent retailers and small business owners make decisions and what earns their trust
- Two-sided marketplace background, where brand and buyer motions are distinct but interdependent
- High-growth or scaling environments where PMM infrastructure was still being built
- Background in STEM, management consulting, finance, or another quantitative field

Salary Range

San Francisco: The pay range for this role is $208,000- $286,000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors, including transferable skills, work experience, market demand, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday)._ Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting._

Why you’ll love working at Faire

- Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
- Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
- Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
- Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
- Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

- Develop deep customer understanding for your product area and translate those insights into clear, compelling positioning.
- Make Faire feel simple to customers. Cut jargon, kill messaging that doesn't matter, and push back on product complexity that won't land.

- Hold the thread across multiple launches in your area, surfacing a coherent narrative rather than a stack of individual product stories.

- Build and own end-to-end GTM strategy for your product area, from positioning through launch and adoption.
- Ship directionally right launches fast. Comfortable making calls with 70% of the information and adjusting after, rather than waiting for perfect.
- Execute across multiple channels, sequencing customer education to drive behavior change at the right moments in the journey.
- Coordinate cross-functional enablement across Revenue, CX, Lifecycle, and other partners to bring GTM plans to life.
- Act as a customer-centric thought partner to Product, Design, Legal, and other stakeholders as your products evolve. Get involved upstream and shape roadmaps through customer insight.

_Team and craft_

- Spend real time with customers and bring their POV into strategic conversations. Ground decisions in research and feedback rather than internal assumptions.
- Use AI tools to sharpen and accelerate your work, and contribute to a culture of peer learning on the PMM team around how we experiment with and adopt AI.

- 6+ years of product marketing experience, or an adjacent role with direct ownership of positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and GTM strategy for complex products.
- Track record of building positioning from scratch and reworking the positioning of existing products, then driving consistency across multiple channels.
- Builder who makes order from chaos. Comfortable when the path isn't obvious, and energized by the chance to create structure where there is none.
- Experience building thematic campaigns across product areas, not just siloed launches.
- Uses data to size opportunities, measure impact, and pressure-test strategy. Fluent in the metrics that move the business.
- Experience conducting or directing customer research and translating findings into positioning.
- Actively experiments with and adopts AI tools to sharpen and accelerate their work, and helps the team find real ways to use AI in PMM craft.

_Nice to have_

- Familiarity with how independent retailers or small business owners make decisions and what earns their trust.
- Two-sided marketplace background, where brand and buyer motions are distinct but interdependent
- Background in STEM, management consulting, finance, or other quantitative fields.

- Build and own end-to-end GTM strategy for your product area, from positioning through launch and adoption.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists.

Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches.

We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting.

This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project.

You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones.
- Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it.
- Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter.
- Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content.
- Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing.
- Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it.

What Makes You a Great Fit

- 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus).
- Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions.
- Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers.
- Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for.
- Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.
- Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.
- Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator.

Bonus Points For

- Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries.
- Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost.
- Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem.
- Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).
- Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is CAD 101,000- CAD 122,000.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

_*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process._

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
- In-Person onboarding- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. _*We will comply with local legislation where applicable._

Equal Opportunity Employer: _Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow._

Principal Product Marketing Manager

Austin | Chicago | New York City | Salt Lake City | San Francisco

Apply

Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

We are looking for a Principal PMM to own the narrative, strategy, and GTM for the fastest-moving surface in our platform – the agentic execution layer that turns everything Gong knows about a revenue organization into action. This is where the vision for the Gong Revenue AI OS becomes real for the market.

This is not a role for someone who wants to market features. This is a category-defining role for a technical buyer audience. You will shape how enterprise IT and revenue operations leaders think about agentic AI for revenue: what governed execution actually looks like, how organizations move from agent sprawl to a coordinated operating model, and why the data foundation underneath agents is what determines whether they deliver compounding value or plateau. You will partner closely with Product, GTM, and executive leadership to turn a genuinely new architectural concept into a narrative that earns trust with buyers who evaluate infrastructure, not just software.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the technical buyer narrative — define positioning and messaging that earns credibility with CIOs and RevOps leaders evaluating enterprise AI infrastructure for revenue. Go beyond outcomes: make governance models, orchestration architecture, data permissioning, and agent lifecycle management feel purpose-built and immediately trustworthy.
- Build the infrastructure conversation— develop the content, frameworks, and tools that help CIOs and RevOps architects understand how Gong fits into their AI stack. This means data flows, governance controls, agent coordination, MCP integrations, audit trails, and the role of the Gong Revenue Graph as the grounding layer that makes autonomous execution reliable at enterprise scale.
- Unify AI and execution into a single story — intelligence and execution are one product. Your job is to make the integrated picture feel inevitable to a technical buyer who has spent the past 18 months evaluating fragmented point solutions and wondering why none of them hold up in production.
- Take a portfolio view — make and defend recommendations about how AI execution capabilities are packaged and monetized across the platform.
- Shape product and GTM strategy — bring structured buyer, competitive, and analyst insights into product planning; develop a deep POV on how enterprise IT and revenue operations teams evaluate, adopt, and govern agentic AI; be the team’s expert on how this market is evolving and how enterprises are making platform decisions.
- Drive high-impact launches — partner with the broader PMM team, PM, Enablement, sales, post-sales, comms, and ops to drive launches from brief to execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of B2B product marketing experience, with at least four years owning the full PMM lifecycle for an AI platform, agentic infrastructure, or complex workflow product at an enterprise SaaS company with demonstrated success marketing to technical buyers.
- Working knowledge of agentic workflow concepts: triggers, actions, plays, next-best-action, human-in-the-loop governance, MCP integrations, and how enterprises think about AI governance and data residency.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You write with precision, distill architectural concepts into narratives that earn trust, and can adapt your message to a variety of audiences across business and technical audiences.
- A bias toward evidence and action — you test positioning with customers, validate it in win/loss data, and iterate based on what actually moves technical buyers.
- Comfort operating in ambiguity and at pace. Gong ships fast. You will make good decisions with incomplete information and adapt as the product and market evolve.
- Experience marketing to RevOps, Sales Operations, or Revenue Leadership (CRO, VP Sales) personas.
- A track record of making complex, multi-layered systems feel coherent and inevitable to skeptical enterprise buyers. You have had to explain governance models, data permissioning, orchestration logic, or agent lifecycle management and made it land.
- Prior experience working on a product that was actively defining or expanding a market category, not just competing in an established one.
- Experience with analyst relations (Gartner, Forrester) — you have presented at briefings, shaped Magic Quadrant narratives, or contributed to Wave evaluations.
- Comfort with quantitative analysis: win/loss data, pipeline influence metrics, adoption curves, and consumption/credit pricing models.

PERKS & BENEFITS

- We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.
- Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.
- Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.
- 401(k) program to help you invest in your future.
- Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development.
- Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.
- Paid parental leave to support you and your family.
- Company-wide recharge days each quarter.
- Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.

The annual salary hiring range for this position is $174,000 - $250,000 USD.

Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.

We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect.

You’ll have the platform, people, and purpose to make an impact — on our market, our customers, and our brand.

Deep Product & Customer Understanding

- Develop deep product and technical fluency. Build a hands-on, first-principles understanding of Gong’s products, AI, ecosystem, and underlying technology so you can tease out the true, defensible differentiation that generic “AI wrappers” can’t replicate. Partner with Product leadership to align roadmaps with customer needs and market trends, and ensure GTM plans are grounded in real product depth.
- Champion the customer POV and value. Immerse yourself in the customer’s world, including pain points, buying journey, and decision criteria, and translate Gong’s product value proposition into quantifiable customer value and business outcomes. Use the customer’s own language, drawn from win-loss analysis, customer interviews, and sales conversations in Gong, as the raw material for positioning and messaging.

Positioning & Differentiation

- Own Gong’s strategic narrative and positioning. Craft clear, differentiated messaging and positioning across the platform, products, and competitive landscape, and codify it in a messaging architecture and assets that the GTM and Marketing teams can carry across every marketing channel.
- Establish true differentiation in a crowded AI market. In a category still being defined, where “AI-powered” is now table stakes, define what makes Gong distinct and hard to copy. Lead with customer outcomes over technology, ground claims in measurable proof and accuracy, and sharpen positioning against both horizontal foundation-model providers and point solutions, anticipating how the competitive set will keep shifting.

GTM Execution Support

- Lead product launches that drive growth. Own launch narrative, enablement, and execution across every customer touchpoint so new products and capabilities land with the GTM team and drive customer engagement, adoption, and growth.
- Leverage AI to scale knowledge sharing. Use AI tools to scale context and content to GTM teams so reps can generate tailored, on-brand content in real time — by persona, segment, industry, and deal stage. Deliver the messaging, playbooks, demos, and more that improve close rates, win rates, and deal velocity, and close the “last-mile” gap between what marketing produces and what reps actually use.

Solution Marketing

- Tailor the value proposition by industry and persona. Develop differentiated value propositions, messaging, use cases, and proof points for Gong's priority industries and buyer personas, translating each segment's specific business challenges into measurable, role-relevant outcomes.
- Carry the solution story across the full customer journey. Ensure the tailored value proposition shows up consistently at every stage — fueling demand generation and campaigns to build awareness and pipeline, guiding buyers through evaluation, and equipping the field with the plays, business cases, and proof points needed to advance and close deals.

Brand, Communications & Thought Leadership

- Shape Gong’s external narrative. Partner with Corporate Marketing to influence Gong’s media coverage, analyst reports, and industry rankings.
- Serve as a senior external ambassador for Gong. Regularly engage with industry analysts, press, influencers, partners, and customers to build trusted relationships, shape market perception, and represent Gong’s strategy, products, and point of view with credibility and consistency.
- Develop thought leadership and demand-gen content. Work with the Content team to deliver high-impact materials that engage buyers from awareness through decision, plus speaking opportunities that reinforce Gong’s position as the leader in Revenue AI.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnerships

- Build deep cross-functional partnerships. Operate as connective tissue across the company, forging especially deep and durable partnerships with the GTM organization and with Product, aligning strategy, roadmap, and field execution around a shared story and shared outcomes.
- Empower channel and partner success. Partner with the Partnerships team to spotlight new integrations, MCP support, and marketplace and co-sell partnerships, turning a fast-growing ecosystem into a proof point for Gong's platform leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of Product Marketing experience in B2B enterprise software (SaaS preferred), with a proven record of creating differentiated positioning and driving measurable business impact.
- Experience positioning AI or other technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving, still-forming category, where differentiation must be earned through outcomes, proof, and depth rather than claimed.
- Deep technical curiosity and fluency: able to get hands-on with the product and technology, understand how the AI actually works, and translate that into defensible differentiation and clear customer value.
- High fluency with AI tools across the PMM workflow (research, insight synthesis, messaging, competitive intelligence, enablement, and content), and a strong point of view on using them to scale context and tailored, real-time content to GTM teams without sacrificing quality or strategic judgment.
- Experience leading large, high-performing PMM teams in scaling organizations, ideally at $500M+ ARR.
- Strong strategic thinking paired with executional excellence: you can shape a vision and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
- Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, and Marketing leaders, building deep and durable relationships that align strategies and outcomes.
- A customer-first mindset and passion for creating market-defining stories that inspire and sell.
- Bring urgency, extreme ownership, and a bias for action, staying hands-on to do whatever it takes to drive impact.
- Creative, resourceful, and energized by a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Global Sourcing Manager, Marketing

Boston, Massachusetts, United States

Apply

We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

We are seeking a Global Sourcing Manager, Marketing, to join Hasbro in Boston, MA. At Hasbro, we build play and entertainment experiences that connect generations and encourage fans around the world.

As the Global Sourcing Manager, Marketing, you will develop and complete sourcing and category strategies across marketing and production spend. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, build strong supplier partnerships, and provide value through innovation, cost optimization, and operational excellence.

You will report directly to the Director of Global Strategic Sourcing, aligning procurement approaches with business priorities. You will also build stronger supplier relationships and advance sourcing initiatives supporting brand growth and business performance.

Effective from the date that Hasbro opens its new Boston location, this position will be onsite Tuesday – Thursday at Hasbro’s new HQ location in Boston, MA. In the interim, this position will be onsite Tuesday –Thursday at Hasbro’s HQ in Pawtucket, RI or at Hasbro’s temporary location in Boston, MA.

A Day in the Life of a Global Sourcing Manager, Marketing:

- Lead comprehensive sourcing projects across marketing and production categories, from opportunity evaluation through contract negotiation and supplier optimization.
- Analyze financial data to deliver timely, actionable insights that support sourcing decisions.
- Align sourcing and supplier approaches with business priorities, integration plans, and long-term roadmaps.
- Develop and complete category strategies across production vendors, creative agencies, branding partners, post-production suppliers, and marketing technology providers.
- Partner with Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Production teams to align priorities, build consensus, and get results.
- Deliver measurable value through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, demand management, and total cost optimization.
- Direct agency and supplier performance to promote innovation, ownership, and alignment with company standards.
- Transform complex data into insights and recommendations that influence business decisions.

In this role, you'll build how our brands show up in the world, from global product launches and retail moments to video content, digital, and social. You'll elevate our creative standards, unlock breakthrough ideas, and connect beloved brands with the kids, fans, and grown-ups who love them. And of course, have a lot of fun doing it!

In the role of Creative Director for Hasbro Toys and Games Marketing, you will guide the creative vision, storytelling, and visual elements across a portfolio that includes preschool, action, collector, adult, and family play. You will be supported by internal teams of copywriters, designers, art directors, and partner with product marketing teams and toy studios to develop groundbreaking campaign platforms and launch new products and characters.

This creative leadership role requires hands-on involvement, combining a strong understanding of how to inspire kids and kidults with visual and storytelling craftsmanship. It values a true appreciation of how toys are played with and a solid grasp of business aspects. The ideal candidate has directed creative campaigns for consumer, entertainment, or brand-based products. They shift easily from big-picture ideas to detailed actions, addressing retail needs, out of home, packaging placement, and global market variations.You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing Creative to ensure our brands keep innovating while staying true to what makes them endure.

Effective from the date that Hasbro opens its new Boston location, this position will be onsite Tuesday – Thursday at Hasbro’s new HQ location in Boston, MA. In the interim, this position will be onsite Tuesday –Thursday at Hasbro’s HQ in Pawtucket, RI or at Hasbro’s temporary location in Boston, MA.

A Day in the Life of a Marketing Creative Director:

What You'll Do

- Take charge of the creative development and delivery toy and game marketing, encompassing campaign platforms, launch assets, video, retail, and digital creative.

- Collaborate with brand and product marketing leads to translate strategy into emotionally resonant, data-driven creative.

- Mentor and guide teams of internal creatives, helping them grow, complete work at a high level, and stay encouraged.

- Set and uphold the creative bar across all work, whether it's a global brand film or a single post between beats.

- Work with product development, development services, and licensing teams to uncover storytelling opportunities in each launch and maintain consistent brand expression from ad to package to shelf.

- Guide and encourage external agency partners and vendors, ensuring alignment to each brand's tone, visual identity, and audience.

- Balance the demands of a multi-brand portfolio, prioritizing effort, sequencing work, and knowing where a distinct brand voice matters versus where scale and system win.

- Represent creative in key meetings, working closely with senior leadership across the business.

What You Bring:

- 10+ years of creative experience in brand or campaign work for consumer products, toys, entertainment, or organizations centered around intellectual property.

- 5+ years leading internal and external creative teams with a track record of strong mentorship and collaborative leadership.

- A deep love of visual storytelling, audience-first thinking, and brands people grow up with.

- Outstanding concepting, campaign development, and narrative instincts.

- Comfortable working across multiple brands and audience segments at once, from preschool to adult collector.

- Ability to clearly communicate and present ideas to senior customers and collaborators.

- A portfolio that showcases variety, creativity, and a strong grasp of how to engage audiences through creatively inspiring work.

This helps ensure our products and programs reach a broad audience optimally. This role is ideal for someone with a passion for gaming and experience in B2B channel marketing.

What You'll Do:

• Create and implement trade (retail) marketing strategies and tactics for products with our B2B retail channels - local hobby game stores

• Support the Organized Play team by creating materials for in-store play programs.

• Develop branding materials for B2B events, and creative displays that drive foot-traffic and increase consumer awareness.

• Partner with internal cross-functional marketing, sales, design, and global teams on global campaign execution alignment, point-of-sale materials, learn-to-play materials, and digital assets for both in-store and online retail environments.

• Identify and evaluate new opportunities within the core hobby retail channel to expand product transparency, branding, and store traffic.

• Set and report on clear meaningful metrics for all campaign marketing initiatives, measuring impact and providing post-mortem analysis to guide future campaigns.

What You'll Bring:

• BA/BS or equivalent experience with a concentration in Marketing or Business.

• 5+ years of experience in retail marketing to specialty, retail brick and mortar, or related field, with a strong preference for experience within the gaming, entertainment, or consumer products industry.

• Experience working with retail marketing agencies and design teams to create physical and digital marketing assets.

• Ability to drive projects forward independently by providing clear and concise direction/feedback and influencing partners.

• Strong project management abilities; capable of prioritizing and balancing multiple projects simultaneously, under tight time constraints and within budget parameters.

• Well developed, verbal, written and presentation skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

• An analytical perspective with experience in performance analysis and reporting on marketing initiatives.

• Familiarity with Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons is a strong plus.

• This role is onsite at our headquarters in Renton, WA.

Apply

About the Role

We are seeking a VP/SVP, Product & Audience Marketing to join iCapital’s International Marketing & Communications team. Based in Lisbon, this role will be responsible for driving product positioning, go-to-market initiatives, audience engagement, and sales enablement across LATAM and Canada.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product, Platform Solutions, Client Solutions, regional business leaders, International Marketing & Communications team members, and the U.S. Product Marketing Team to ensure iCapital’s products, solutions, and capabilities are effectively brought to market outside the U.S. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and requires a strong understanding of financial services, wealth management, and private markets.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Go-to-Market Strategy

- Develop and execute go-to-market plans for products, solutions, and platform capabilities.
- Partner with Client Solutions, Product, and regional leadership to translate business priorities into actionable marketing strategies.
- Support the international launch and adoption of new offerings, ensuring clear and differentiated positioning.

Audience Marketing & Campaigns

- Develop audience-led marketing programs targeting wealth managers, banks, and advisors.
- Drive regional campaigns, thought leadership initiatives, webinars, content programs, and event-related marketing activities.
- Partner with U.S.-based Demand Generation and Digital teams to optimize engagement and audience growth.

Localization & Sales Enablement

- Adapt U.S. marketing materials for regional use where possible, ensuring relevance, compliance, and commercial effectiveness.
- Develop new sales enablement content, presentations, messaging frameworks, and client-facing materials.
- Collaborate with Compliance and Legal teams to support regional regulatory requirements.

Stakeholder Management & Performance

- Act as a strategic marketing partner to regional business leaders and Client Solutions teams.
- Measure campaign effectiveness and provide insight-driven recommendations.
- Support the continued development of the International Product & Audience Marketing function and operating model.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, audience marketing, asset management, wealth management, fintech, or financial services.
- Strong understanding of private markets, alternatives, investment products, or wealth management.
- Experience developing go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Proven ability to translate complex concepts into compelling, client-focused marketing materials.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Experience working across international markets and multiple time zones.
- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Why This Role Matters

As iCapital continues to expand internationally, this role will help ensure our products, platform capabilities, and strategic initiatives are effectively positioned and adopted across diverse markets. The position plays an important role in connecting product strategy, commercial priorities, and client engagement, helping drive the continued growth of iCapital's International business.

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office 4 days a week with the flexibility to work remotely 1 day ( Friday).

Benefits

iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance.

For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us  Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc

Marketing Operations Manager - Associate

Lisbon, Portugal

Apply

About the Role

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Associate to join iCapital's International Marketing & Communications team in Lisbon. The role reports jointly to the CMO International and to the VP, Marketing Operations & Asset Manager Partnerships, who provides day-to-day direction, guidance and prioritization.

This is a supporting role designed to build the operational backbone of the team. The successful candidate will assist with budget tracking, vendor administration, reporting and project coordination, and will provide execution support on strategic initiatives, management presentations and select deliverables across the wider International Marketing & Communications team.

Operating mode : The role sits at the intersection of operations, finance coordination and marketing execution, working under the direction of the Marketing Operations &Asset Management Partnerships lead and alongside regional marketing, communications and events colleagues. Based in Lisbon, the role collaborates daily with Zurich, London, Hong Kong and the wider international network, with occasional travel.

Key Responsibilities

Budget Tracking & Vendor Administration

- Assist in maintaining and tracking the International Marketing & Communications budget, monitoring spend by region, program and event against forecast.
- Support forecasting, accruals and reconciliation in partnership with Finance, flagging variances for review.
- Handle vendor and agency administration: onboarding paperwork, purchase orders, invoicing and payment tracking.
- Act as a day-to-day administrative contact for suppliers and agencies to keeping deliverables and costs on track.

Reporting & Management Presentations

- Support the annual planning process, KPI tracking and performance reporting, gathering and consolidating inputs from regional and functional teams.
- Help prepare updates and presentation materials for senior management, monthly alignment calls with client-facing teams and business reviews.
- Maintain dashboards and trackers that give visibility on priorities, milestones and deadlines.

Project Coordination & Process Support

- Support the coordination of cross-regional workstreams, maintaining timelines, action logs and follow-ups.
- Help ensure consistency of process and documentation across markets.
- Contribute ideas and support the implementation of improvements to templates, tools and ways of working.
- Maintain central repositories, naming conventions and workflow documentation for the international team.

Execution Support

- Provide hands-on support to strategic initiatives led by the CMO International and the Marketing Operations & Asset Manager Partnerships lead.
- Assist the wider International Marketing & Communications team on select deliverables across events, content initiatives and campaigns.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support coordination between International Marketing & Communications, Events, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and regional stakeholders.
- Help ensure global processes are applied consistently across regions.

Qualifications & Experience

- 2–5 years of experience in marketing operations, business operations, events or a comparable coordination or administrative role; financial services or professional services exposure an advantage.
- Comfort working with numbers, budgets and invoices, with strong attention to detail.
- Excellent organizational skills; able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with guidance.
- Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills; able to produce clear, well-structured materials and trackers.
- CRM and or project management tool experience preferred ( such as monday.com )
- Strong written and verbal communication in English; additional languages an advantage.
- Collaborative, proactive and dependable, with a willingness to learn and the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones.

Why This Role Matters

As the International team continues to expand its event portfolio, content initiatives and business support responsibilities, dedicated operational support is essential to create a scalable infrastructure. This role improves efficiency, drives consistency across regions, and enables existing team members to focus on higher-value strategic activities.

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

This is a senior IC role. You drive impact through the quality of your thinking and your ability to move sales, enablement, and campaigns to execute with confidence.

This role is competitive-first. Your first mission is to establish our compete function from the ground up - the intelligence, the messaging, and the system that keeps the field ahead of a fast-moving market. It's roughly 70% competitive today, expanding over time to support sales plays and enablement as the function matures. In a moment where AI makes it easy to copy features and stand up new competitors overnight, this is one of the highest-leverage roles in PMM.

The Role

You'll build and own how Fin positions itself against the competition - differentiation against our tier 1 competitors, a sustainable competitive intelligence program, and the plays and content that let the field act on it in real deals. You'll decide what "great compete" looks like at Fin and stand it up.

You'll work directly with sales leadership, research, SEs, GTM strategy, and sales enablement. You'll be hands-on with the product, the market, and every competitor's moves.

- Establish Fin's competitive function from the ground up - the intelligence, the messaging, and the operating system that keeps the field current without creating noise

- Stand up a sustainable, AI-driven competitive intelligence program with Research, Solutions Engineering and GTM - tracking moves, updating positioning, and keeping the field ahead
- Operationalise competitive strategy so the field can act on it: battle cards, competitive plays, and objection handling that reps actually use
- Synthesise win/loss data, customer interviews, and market signals into strategic recommendations that feed back into product, marketing and ICP decisions
- Co-build the proactive compete motion - the sales plays and campaigns that drive win rates, not just defend against losses
- Over time, extend into sales plays and field enablement as the compete function matures - raising how the field sells against every alternative
- Create high-quality core PMM assets yourself, and maintain the competitive 'brain' of context that feeds our AI-first approach
