Specialist, Search Engine Marketing (SEM)

London, United Kingdom

Apply

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

OpenTable's Growth Marketing team is looking for a Specialist, Search Engine Marketing to own and grow our restaurant-facing B2B paid search programme; in this role, you will own paid search end-to-end across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in more than ten markets. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role; you will be the person who makes the daily optimization calls around campaign strategy, helps design the tests, and finds the opportunities rather than waiting for one. Search is changing quickly - AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and AI answer engines are reshaping how intent is captured - and we want someone who is genuinely excited to figure out what works before the playbook exists. You will sit within our growth marketing function, working closely with Analytics, MarTech, Web, Brand, and Sales to connect what happens in the auction to what happens in the pipeline.

Responsibilities

- Own B2B paid search strategy and execution across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in all active markets, managing the full campaign lifecycle from build through optimisation, budget pacing, and performance reporting.
- Own keyword, search term, and negative keyword strategy — running regular search term mining and audits
- Manage bidding and budgets with a performance-first mindset, choosing and tuning bid strategies (Manual CPC through to Smart Bidding and target-based strategies) and maintaining pacing and efficiency against lead volume and cost-per-lead targets.
- Own the post-click experience alongside Web and CRO partners — designing and running landing page A/B tests, using experimentation and heat-mapping tools to diagnose where the journey breaks, and turning findings into page-level recommendations.
- Lead a rigorous, always-on testing roadmap: form hypotheses, design clean experiments, read results with an eye on statistical significance, test and scale emerging Google and Microsoft products — AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, AI-based ad copy
- Build and maintain reporting that leadership trusts — pacing dashboards and performance reporting across market, campaign, and keyword level — and translate the numbers into a clear performance narrative with a recommended next action.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands-on paid search experience with deep, demonstrable ownership of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising accounts — building campaigns from scratch, diagnosing performance problems, restructuring accounts for efficiency, and decision-making based on performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CVR, CPA/CPL, ROAS or ROI).
- Expert-level command of the core mechanics: keyword research and match types, campaign and ad group architecture, negative keyword and search term management, Quality Score diagnostics, ad copy testing, and bid strategy selection and tuning.
- Experience independently managing meaningful paid search budgets, with a rigorous approach to pacing, efficiency, and forecasting.
- Strong working knowledge of conversion tracking and attribution: tag management, conversion goal configuration, attribution and lookback windows, and what breaks when tracking is wrong.
- Confident in analytics and reporting tooling: GA4, a BI or dashboarding tool such as Looker Studio or a comparable platform, and advanced spreadsheet analysis.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience running paid search in a lead generation environment — B2B marketing experience preferred but not required.
- Experience optimising to marketing qualified leads, sales qualified leads, and downstream revenue rather than to clicks or immediate conversions, and understanding a longer, multi-touch consideration cycle.
- Preferred: Google Ads certifications (Search as a baseline; Performance Max, Display) and the GA4 Individual Qualification and Microsoft Advertising certification.
- Hands-on experience with newer AI-led ad products — AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, or AI-generated ad copy and search theme controls
- Ability to write your own SQL against a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery & familiarity with CRM &marketing automation data — Salesforce in particular — and how the marketing-to-sales handoff actually works.

Benefits and Perks

- 5 weeks paid vacation
- Private health & dental insurance
- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
- Focus on mental health and well-being:

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

OpenTable's Growth Marketing team is looking for a Specialist, Search Engine Marketing to own and grow our restaurant-facing B2B paid search programme; in this role, you will own paid search end-to-end across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in more than ten markets. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role; you will be the person who makes the daily optimization calls around campaign strategy, helps design the tests, and finds the opportunities rather than waiting for one. Search is changing quickly - AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and AI answer engines are reshaping how intent is captured - and we want someone who is genuinely excited to figure out what works before the playbook exists. You will sit within our growth marketing function, working closely with Analytics, MarTech, Web, Brand, and Sales to connect what happens in the auction to what happens in the pipeline.

Responsibilities

- Own B2B paid search strategy and execution across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in all active markets, managing the full campaign lifecycle from build through optimisation, budget pacing, and performance reporting.
- Own keyword, search term, and negative keyword strategy — running regular search term mining and audits
- Manage bidding and budgets with a performance-first mindset, choosing and tuning bid strategies (Manual CPC through to Smart Bidding and target-based strategies) and maintaining pacing and efficiency against lead volume and cost-per-lead targets.
- Own the post-click experience alongside Web and CRO partners — designing and running landing page A/B tests, using experimentation and heat-mapping tools to diagnose where the journey breaks, and turning findings into page-level recommendations.
- Lead a rigorous, always-on testing roadmap: form hypotheses, design clean experiments, read results with an eye on statistical significance, test and scale emerging Google and Microsoft products — AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, AI-based ad copy
- Build and maintain reporting that leadership trusts — pacing dashboards and performance reporting across market, campaign, and keyword level — and translate the numbers into a clear performance narrative with a recommended next action.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands-on paid search experience with deep, demonstrable ownership of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising accounts — building campaigns from scratch, diagnosing performance problems, restructuring accounts for efficiency, and decision-making based on performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CVR, CPA/CPL, ROAS or ROI).
- Expert-level command of the core mechanics: keyword research and match types, campaign and ad group architecture, negative keyword and search term management, Quality Score diagnostics, ad copy testing, and bid strategy selection and tuning.
- Experience independently managing meaningful paid search budgets, with a rigorous approach to pacing, efficiency, and forecasting.
- Strong working knowledge of conversion tracking and attribution: tag management, conversion goal configuration, attribution and lookback windows, and what breaks when tracking is wrong.
- Confident in analytics and reporting tooling: GA4, a BI or dashboarding tool such as Looker Studio or a comparable platform, and advanced spreadsheet analysis.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience running paid search in a lead generation environment — B2B marketing experience preferred but not required.
- Experience optimising to marketing qualified leads, sales qualified leads, and downstream revenue rather than to clicks or immediate conversions, and understanding a longer, multi-touch consideration cycle.
- Preferred: Google Ads certifications (Search as a baseline; Performance Max, Display) and the GA4 Individual Qualification and Microsoft Advertising certification.
- Hands-on experience with newer AI-led ad products — AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, or AI-generated ad copy and search theme controls
- Ability to write your own SQL against a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery & familiarity with CRM &marketing automation data — Salesforce in particular — and how the marketing-to-sales handoff actually works.

- 5 weeks paid vacation
- Private health & dental insurance
- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
- Focus on mental health and well-being:

  - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
  - Company-paid subscription to Headspace

Senior Field Marketing Manager

UK - Remote

Apply

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Ping Identity is looking for a proactive Senior Field Marketing Manager to join the UKI region. This team has gone through a restructure in 2025 and while has the largest customer base in EMEA ,the objective is to drive geo growth in 2H 2026 and beyond.  There is considerable effort needed to boost brand awareness and create net new logo demand to achieve the regions’ ambitious growth targets.

This individual will be responsible for the UKI region, alongside a UKI Field Marketing Specialist. This innovative and forward-thinking marketing professional will partner closely with the UKI Sales leaders and Sales organisation and work with pan-EMEA Go To Market (GTM) teams to develop and implement a strategic integrated GTM plan, focusing on multi-touch campaigns that drive qualified pipeline.

Duty and Responsibilities:

- Jointly work as part of the UKI leadership team and the Senior Manager Field Marketing for Northern Europe to develop the strategic approach required for success in region to drive exceptional growth
- Work with internal parties and third-party vendors to develop and achieve our Go To Market vision in region
- Execute the UKI plan with clear focus on delivering the metrics of success
- Manage the day to day activity of the Field Marketing Specialist, ensuring growth and development
- Review, refine and develop the GTM tactics on a regular basis to ensure continued engagement and penetration into the named strategic accounts
- Work with the Pan-EMEA Programmes lead to create and execute vertical or use case led GTM plans for Account Executives to an enterprise audience (ABM 1:Few, 1:1, Deal acceleration programmes,)
- Provide articulate feedback on the campaigns, analysis of success and next steps
- Participate to the quarterly QBRs reporting on successes and outlining future strategies and tactics
- Responsible for budget and procurement processes, auditing and accountability for budget spend and management

_Desired Skills & Experience_

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or in a related field.
- A minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in Senior Field Marketing role
- Previous experience in the IT industry, ideally in a technology B2B SAAS environment
- Knowledge of current digital marketing technologies and techniques.
- Working knowledge of SFDC and Marketo.
- Great relationship building and negotiation skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Positive attitude and work collaboratively.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong initiative and ability to work independently and collaboratively.

_Qualifications:_

- A marketing or related business degree or equivalent

_Working Conditions:_

- Travel – approximately 30% travel, mostly within the UKI region but some within Europe or US
- Remote working contract with occasional travel to our London and Bristol based offices to work alongside the regional Sales Development Reps

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

- A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
- Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
- Regular company and team bonding events.
- Competitive benefits and perks.
- Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

- Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
- Parental Leave
- Progressive Healthcare Options
- Retirement Programs
- Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
- Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

_We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law._

- 10+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including full‑stack applications and/or backend services on a modern cloud platform (such as AWS or similar). Experience in enterprise or business systems environments is a plus.

- Strong proficiency in Python and experience with at least one of: Java, Node.js, and/or Javascript, with a track record of delivering reliable, maintainable code in collaborative engineering teams.

- Practical experience building or integrating GenAI/ML‑powered features or services in production—such as LLM‑based workflows, ML‑driven recommendations, or intelligent automation—including an understanding of evaluation, observability, and common failure modes.

- Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and agents to write, review, and validate detailed technical design documents (TDDs), specifications, and test plans as part of a spec‑driven, agentic development workflow, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, quality, and correctness.

- Experience using GenAI coding tools (for example, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and/or agents in your development workflow, with a demonstrated ability to validate AI‑assisted output and maintain high standards for quality, security, and maintainability.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional, diverse teams and to explain complex technical concepts—including GenAI/ML tradeoffs—to non‑technical partners.

- Outcome‑oriented mindset: you focus on delivering business outcomes rather than just technical outputs, using technology and AI thoughtfully to positively impact key performance metrics for Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

- Salesforce engineering experience (for example, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Salesforce integrations) is a plus, especially where it supports Sales and Marketing workflows.

This role serves as the bridge between annual launch campaigns and year-round player engagement, ensuring that marketing efforts continue to drive participation, retention, excitement, and community engagement throughout the baseball season. The Manager will drive integrated lifecycle strategies across owned, earned, and paid channels, connecting in-game content, real-world baseball moments, and marketing activations cohesively.

- Develop player engagement strategies across the customer lifecycle.
- Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, retention, reactivation, and long-term engagement.

- Ensure launch campaigns create momentum that carries into ongoing live-service engagement.

Performance, Experimentation, & Insights

- Develop recommendations based on engagement data and campaign results.
- Lead campaign post-mortems and learning reviews.

- Demonstrated knowledge of MLB The Show and its game modes, content structure, and player community.

- Experience supporting live-service video games, ongoing content programs, and customer engagement initiatives.
- Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with data.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience with player retention, CRM, or lifecycle marketing programs.
- Experience working with sports, entertainment, or gaming communities.
- Experience partnering with analytics and community teams to inform marketing decisions.

Mobile Campaign Execution

- Drive the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns for MLB The Show Mobile.
- Coordinate timelines, assets, approvals, and deliverables across internal and external teams.

- Maintain campaign trackers, status reports, and project documentation.
- Helping create and evolve strategy for marketing of product

App Store & Platform Marketing Support

- Coordinate assets, copy, and featuring nominations for event marketing on App Store and Google Play.
- Partner with external vendor on App Store Optimization (ASO), including keyword research, metadata updates and localization.
- Partner with external vendor on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), including test strategy, asset development and execution.
- Track platform merchandising, featuring opportunities, and partner programs.

Live Service & Customer Engagement Support

- Assist with the execution of live-content marketing campaigns and player engagement initiatives.
- Support CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention, and reengagement programs.
- Collaborate with product team on in-game messaging, content announcements, and promotional calendars.
- Monitor player feedback, community conversations, and emerging opportunities.

Creative & Performance Marketing Support

- Assist in the development and trafficking of creative assets across marketing channels.
- Support A/B testing efforts for creative assets and app store content.
- Collaborate with paid media team to monitor campaign performance data, review takeaways and align on optimizations.
- Contribute ideas for improving player acquisition, engagement, and retention.

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Partner with cross-functional teams, including paid media, product, analytics, creative, community, CRM, store publishing and external marketing agencies.
- Work with insights teams to determine player insights to inform marketing strategy and execution
- Track project milestones and communicate status updates to stakeholders.
- Ensure marketing materials and deliverables are completed on time and meet quality standards.
- Manage asset reviews with studio, legal and licensors, consolidating and applying feedback to gain approval.

Reporting & Market Insights

- Monitor holistic marketing performance and deliver ongoing reporting.
- Track competitor activity, mobile gaming trends, and sports marketing best practices.
- Help identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and player engagement.

Qualifications

Required

- 2–4 years of experience in mobile app/game marketing
- Strong organizational and project management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Passion for gaming, sports, and mobile experiences.

Preferred

- Experience supporting mobile marketing campaigns.
- Familiarity with App Store and Google Play ecosystems.
- Experience with ASO/CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or live-service products.
- Experience with programmatic media, analytics and campaign reporting.
- Knowledge of baseball and MLB The Show.
- Experience coordinating creative production workflows.

Success Metrics

- Quality and timeliness of campaign execution
- Accuracy and completeness of marketing deliverables
- Support of live-content and engagement initiatives
- Effectiveness of App Store marketing support
- Stakeholder satisfaction
- Contribution to player acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts

Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 B2B accounts. That means running Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) to identify what's actually constraining each client's growth, building the strategy around that diagnosis, and holding the team accountable for executing it.

The B2B version of this job involves the client's sales team as much as their marketing team. Lead quality, ICP definition, pipeline conversion, win rates — these come up in every QBR. You need to be comfortable having those conversations with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of marketing's contribution.

Responsibilities:

- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
- Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews for each account — diagnose growth constraints across all six pillars (Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, Measurement) and build the roadmap from the findings
- Work directly with client sales leadership on ICP refinement, lead scoring criteria, MQL→SQL handoff quality, and pipeline health
- Own the senior client relationship; QBRs should address revenue, not recap campaigns
- Coordinate paid, SEO, content, ABM, and creative work around a single account strategy
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Coach and give direct feedback to analysts and specialists on your accounts

Role Requirements:

- 6+ years in B2B marketing, with client-facing or consultative experience
- Has worked with sales teams directly — understands why the MQL→SQL handoff breaks and how to fix it
- Fluent in B2B-specific dynamics: buying committees, long sales cycles, high-ACV pipeline, CAC in enterprise contexts
- Knows B2B measurement well enough to have an opinion — pipeline attribution, MMM limitations in long-cycle sales, when last-touch is misleading
- Has presented to VP and C-suite stakeholders and pushed back on them when the data supported it
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts
- ABM strategy experience, not just execution

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Team Coaching and Development
- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

- Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
- Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
- Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
- Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
- Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

- Help clients build measurement infrastructure from scratch when it doesn't exist, establish baselines before optimizing against them

- Identify expansion opportunities that fit the client's stage, don't oversell services a brand isn't ready for
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
- Coach analysts and specialists; many will be working with startups for the first time

- Has worked with founder-led businesses and understands the dynamic — decisions move fast, emotions run high, strategy and execution blur together
- Comfortable building from scratch: no brand guidelines, no historical data, no benchmark — and still making good decisions
- Understands crowdfunding-to-DTC transitions and what changes when a brand moves from Kickstarter momentum to sustainable acquisition
- Strong prioritization instincts — knows which problems to solve first and which to defer
- Comfortable with scrappy media mixes and knows how to get signal out of small budgets
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts, including accounts that went through rough patches

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy

- Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
- Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
- Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
- Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
- Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
- On time for all deliverables & launches
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

- Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
- Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
- Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers

- Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
- Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

- Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution

  - Manage and perform migrations to new Marketing Automation Platforms/CRMs (primarily Hubspot)
  - Clean up existing Marketing Automation Platforms/CRMs and continue to ensure they operate cleanly and efficiently

    - Typical clean-up tasks include deduplication (via Insycle), field standardization, asset organization, contact purges, sync error resolutions, sync setting updates, compliance program setup, and custom field consolidation

  - Set up any custom objects or custom behavioral events
  - Ensure any platform integration syncs are accurate and clean and set up new integrations that have a native integration with the MAP
  - Strategize sales and marketing alignment automation within the Marketing Automation Platform/CRM

  - Lead qualification automation optimizations
  - Campaign creation & SOPs
  - System troubleshooting & additional customizations
  - Additional custom reports & dashboards

  - KPI field setup & tracking (ex. Lead status date stamps, speed to lead tracking, etc.)
  - Sales performance & activity reports
  - Operational and day-to-day SOP creation for CRM utilization and clean data entry

- Support internal growth of the Marketing Ops Department
  - Audit systems of prospective/existing clients
  - Actively identify opportunities to improve products/services beyond their accounts
  - Mentors team members and holds strategy sessions on accounts they support with
  - Reviews and provides feedback to junior team members on reports & deliverables
  - Assist with developing our product offering, identify opportunities to improve the department, and actively share insights with the team
  - Document all processes and conduct trainings for client and/or sales team members

- 4+ years experience in marketing operations or related role
- Expert in Hubspot and proficient in Pardot (any other MAP and CRM platforms are a plus!)
- High proficiency in Salesforce with the ability to perform intermediate functions including but not limited to:

  - Report and dashboard-builds
  - Campaign setup and reporting
  - Field setup and mapping
  - Record customization
  - Intermediate to advanced automation builds

- Experience with various sales and marketing systems and tools (ie. ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, Insycle, 6Sense, etc.) and an understanding of how they interact and integrate with a Marketing Automation Platform and/or CRM
- Ability to quickly troubleshoot issues within the marketing technology stack (including the CRM)
- Experience building out complex processes and automations
- Ability to be client-facing and discuss complex strategies and recommendations with the client
- Comfortable with ambiguity. You know how to structure complex issues and take a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.
- Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators):

- Leads 6 - 8 clients (more of our complex clients)
- RPE goal of $25k/month
- 90% client retention rate

- Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles

Director, Field Marketing Americas

Boston, MA

Apply

With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a strategic and operationally rigorous Director, Field Marketing, Americas to lead and scale a metrics-driven field marketing organization across North America, Latin America, and Public Sector. This leader will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Demand Generation to create regional, territory-based, and account-focused marketing programs that accelerate pipeline creation, improve opportunity progression, and drive measurable revenue impact.

_* This role requires working from the Recorded Future office in Boston, MA at least 3 days per week._

What You’ll Do:

Field Marketing Strategy, Execution, & Performance

- Develop and execute a scalable Americas field marketing strategy aligned to corporate revenue goals and the priorities of North America, LATAM, and Public Sector sales teams.
- Build integrated regional and territory marketing plans that support account penetration, opportunity acceleration, customer expansion, and pipeline generation.
- Partner directly with Americas sales leaders and Account Directors to align marketing programs with territory plans, target accounts, and whitespace opportunities.
- Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by working closely with Sales and the Partner and Alliances organization on shared goals.
- Own the Americas partner marketing calendar and budget, tracking investment against pipeline and revenue impact.
- Set the operating rhythm for field events, executive engagement programs, webinars, partner initiatives, ABM campaigns, and industry activations across commercial and Public Sector markets.
- Establish a data-centric operating model with clear KPIs, dashboards, attribution models, and performance benchmarks.
- Define and operationalize metrics related to pipeline generation, revenue influence, account engagement, territory growth, conversion, pipeline velocity, and campaign ROI.
- Create a culture of accountability where investment decisions and program prioritization are driven by measurable business outcomes.
- Deliver regular business reviews, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership and Americas sales stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Serve as a strategic partner to North America, LATAM, and Public Sector sales leadership to drive territory development, pipeline generation, and revenue growth.
- Collaborate with Revenue Operations to identify whitespace accounts, underperforming territories, and growth opportunities across the Americas.
- Build repeatable frameworks that enable field marketers to proactively support pipeline creation and opportunity progression within their assigned markets.
- Improve marketing and sales alignment through shared planning, forecasting, and pipeline accountability.
- Partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Partner Marketing to deliver coordinated go-to-market programs.
- Ensure consistency in messaging, segmentation, campaign execution, attribution, reporting, and funnel visibility while adapting programs to regional and Public Sector market needs.

Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

- Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing field marketing team supporting North America, LATAM, and Public Sector.
- Design and scale the Americas field marketing organization, including clear regional ownership, responsibilities, and success measures.
- Hire strategically across field and partner marketing functions as the organization grows.
- Drive team performance and development in alignment with company OKRs and defined success metrics.
- Implement best practices for campaign planning, execution, measurement, and post-program analysis.
- Drive operational discipline in budgeting, forecasting, vendor management, and program optimization.
- Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring:

- 10+ years of B2B marketing experience in the security space, including significant experience leading field marketing teams.
- Proven success supporting enterprise sales organizations and delivering measurable pipeline and revenue impact.
- Experience developing regional marketing strategies across multiple markets, ideally including North America, LATAM, and Public Sector.
- Strong experience building metrics-based marketing frameworks and reporting methodologies.
- Deep understanding of enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or related technology markets.
- Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment.
- Experience with ABM, territory planning, partner marketing, and integrated campaign execution.
- Strong analytical and operational mindset with expertise in marketing performance measurement.
- Experience managing distributed teams and balancing the needs of distinct regional and market segments.
- Proficiency with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, or similar technologies.

_The base salary range for this full-time position is $167,000-$234,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The salary displayed reflects the range for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Marketing Analytics Manager

Boston, MA

Apply

With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Marketing Analytics Manager. As a Marketing Analytics Manager, you will be a strategic partner across marketing decision-making, reporting to the Senior Manager of Marketing Analytics to execute on the reporting, measurement, and data foundation that helps the business make faster, smarter, outcome-driven decisions. You will articulate compelling buyer journey stories through data for  demand generation, field marketing, marketing operations, and the broader go-to-market organization. Beyond day-to-day analytics and ad hoc analysis, you'll help drive our growing investment in AI, automation, and modern data tooling, bringing curiosity and a builder's mindset to how we scale the analytics function. This role is ideal for a data-driven, business-minded analyst who wants to sit at the intersection of marketing strategy, measurement, and emerging data and AI capability in a B2B SaaS environment.

_Note:_ This role is required to work from the Recorded Future office in Boston, MA at least 3 days per week.

What You'll Do:

Marketing Analytics & Strategic Insights:

- Serve as a strategic analytics partner across the marketing organization, translating data into insights that shape planning, investment, and campaign decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.
- Develop, maintain, and refresh marketing dashboards and reports across HockeyStack, Salesforce, Domo, and Adobe CJA to track KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and ROI.
- Report on top of funnel marketing performance, lead acquisition, conversion rates and velocity, and opportunity progression, to give a clear view of marketing's impact.
- Support reporting needs across all levels of the business, from executive leadership to individual executors, tailoring insight to each audience.
- Deliver ad hoc analysis, segment breakdowns, and channel/campaign deep dives that answer strategic questions on short turnaround.

Marketing Data Quality & Governance:

- Validate reporting and ensure the numbers reconcile across systems, so stakeholders can trust the metrics they act on.
- Troubleshoot and resolve integration and data discrepancies.
- Help build out the marketing data warehouse, partnering with the centralized data infrastructure team to establish a scalable, reliable data foundation.
- Help maintain the clean, consistent, well-governed data foundation that enables faster reporting, trusted metrics, and confident decision-making across marketing.

Attribution & Pipeline Measurement:

- Support the maintenance and evolution of multi-touch attribution models, keeping reporting objects current as campaigns and channels change.
- Partner with field marketing, revenue operations, and the Sales/BDR organizations on lead-to-opportunity reporting and analysis, ensuring accurate tracking of marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline.
- Translate attribution and pipeline data into actionable insights that help stakeholders make informed ROI decisions when planning activities.

Automation, Tooling & AI Innovation:

- Help drive our growing investment in AI and automation for marketing analytics, we're actively expanding into this space and want someone with the curiosity and passion to help shape it.
- Build and extend automation and data-access workflows, including API and MCP connections, that broaden analytics and AI tooling access for the Marketing Analytics & Operations team.
- Explore and apply emerging AI and data capabilities to increase analytics throughput, reduce manual work, and unlock new kinds of insight.
- Develop reusable reporting templates, lightweight data products, and cross-system data workflows that scale the team's impact.

What You'll Bring:

- 3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing/revenue operations, or a related analytical field, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
- Strong proficiency building dashboards and reports in tools such as HockeyStack, Domo, Tableau, or Sigma, or similar BI/visualization platforms.
- Hands-on experience with CRM data (particularly Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms (Marketo or HubSpot).
- Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to analytics or operations workflows.
- Experience building automations or integrations via APIs, with familiarity with emerging standards like MCP a plus.
- Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data analysis and cross-system data work.
- Self-driven and intellectually curious, with the initiative to dig into problems without waiting to be told how, you can pick up the business and domain along the way.
- Solid understanding of the marketing funnel, lead lifecycle, and attribution concepts (multi-touch, first-touch, last-touch).
- Curiosity and passion for AI, automation, and modern data tooling, with eagerness to help build in an emerging space.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights and business recommendations.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake) and data-quality, ETL, or data-pipeline processes.
- Exposure to customer journey analytics (e.g., Adobe CJA).
- Certification in Marketo or Salesforce.
- Previous experience in a high-growth, enterprise SaaS company.

_The base salary range for this full-time position is $92,000-$137,500. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Apply

ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

The Rocket Money Data Analytics team is comprised of data analysts who are passionate about using data to drive business decisions and improve user experiences. Analysts work within a semi-embedded organizational structure to independently build data analytics tooling, drive strategy with data, and assess experiments within cross-functional product vertical aligned teams. Analysts also work closely with other members of the analytics engineering and data science teams to further our product delivery, operations, finance, and marketing goals.

We’re seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing team and play a critical role in shaping our analytics strategy. In this role, you’ll work closely with our Growth Marketing team to drive data-informed decision-making across the organization. You’ll leverage a full suite of analytical tools to measure performance across online channels, enhance our modern martech infrastructure, and develop scalable frameworks and tooling. Your work will be instrumental in evaluating and optimizing marketing investments against core business metrics, including ROAS, LTV, and conversion rates.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL 🤹

Be a trusted advisor on our marketing data. You will understand the intricacies of our ad platforms, MMP (we use Singular), and various third parties to produce a cohesive and actionable view. Including:

- Build and improve analytics reporting and processes (we use Looker)
  - Work with stakeholders to scope analytical questions and determine appropriate KPIs/metrics
  - Determine optimal data visualization methods for decision making
  - Reduce technical debt, implement new parameters, and update LookML to align with best practices
  - Collaborate with Data Engineering/Analytics Engineering on data mart and model requirements
  - Identify automation and process improvement opportunities in BI
- Analyze marketing experiments
  - Includes ad hoc analysis of ad platform testing
  - Work with our CRM team to analyze campaigns and global program holdouts
- Partner with the Growth team to translate business needs into data problems and prioritize work.
  - Proactively identify new insights and recommendations and partner with growth stakeholders to implement solutions
  - Complete ad hoc analysis including:
    - Performance of keyword cohorts to identify targeting opportunities
    - Building/analyzing composite success measures for marketing campaigns
    - Applying growth marketing knowledge to analyze ad fatigue in our customer base
  - Monitor marketing trends to proactively identify worthwhile trends for media buyers

ABOUT YOU 🦄

- 4+ years of experience in data analytics or related roles.
  - 2+ years experience in marketing or growth analytics or similar experience with modern marketing tech (e.g. MMPs, Social / Digital platforms, SKAN) and digital marketing optimization.
- 2+ years of experience with BI Tools (Looker preferred, Tableau, PowerBI, Sigma, Omni, Databricks)
- You have a strong SQL background. You are comfortable spinning up a quick analysis or proof of concept data model.
- You have experience with product, CRM, or marketing experimentation design and measurement.
- You’re comfortable with applying standard marketing measures such as: LTV/NPV, CAC, Cost per Action, Retention metrics, ROAS, CTR, CPM, etc.
- Strong cross-functional communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders and business decisions

Bonus points if:

- You understand what is possible, and what the limitations are, of marketing measurement and attribution. You enjoy the challenge of balancing rigor with the realities of the business.
- You have experience with our stack (BigQuery, Singular, Looker, dbt, Amplitude, DeepNote, git)
- You’re familiar with Agile process/Sprint cycles
- You have experience in mobile app analytics
- You have a genuine interest marketing attribution and technology including keeping up-to-date with emerging trends in the marketplace

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the criteria listed, especially the preferred qualifications. We want to hear from candidates who bring diverse perspectives and experiences, even if your background doesn't align perfectly with every requirement listed.

WE OFFER 💫

- Health, Dental & Vision Plans
- Competitive Pay
- 401k Matching
- Unlimited PTO
- Lunch daily _(in-office only)_
- Snacks & Coffee _(in-office only)_
- Commuter benefits _(in-office only)_

Additional information: Salary range of $120,000 - $160,000 + bonus + benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

- Drive TV Channel Performance: Own day-to-day media buying, optimizations, pacing, and post-buy analysis across Linear and Streaming TV, ensuring we consistently hit CPA, CAC, and ROAS targets.

- Treat Creative As A Performance Lever: Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on TV creative, and turn testing insights into a stronger, higher-performing creative library.
- Manage Agency and Vendor Partners: Work closely with our TV buying and measurement partners to plan, execute, and optimize campaigns, holding them to a high bar.
- Strengthen Measurement: Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, and CRM to improve attribution, unlock growth levers, and ensure data quality across campaigns.
- Communicate Performance and Insights: Contribute to regular reporting on TV channel performance, sharing key wins, learnings, and recommendations with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Improve Systems and Processes: Contribute to Rocket Money's culture of curiosity by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance tracking, and build scalable processes as the TV program continues to grow.
- Stay Ahead of the Space: Track industry trends, identify first-to-market opportunities, and share learnings across the team.

ABOUT YOU 🦄

- 4+ years of experience in TV media buying at a high growth consumer company, startup, or agency, with hands-on experience across Linear and/or Streaming/CTV.
- Strong analytical foundation with fluency in core growth and efficiency metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV to CAC, and blended performance.
- Ability to turn data and experiment results into clear recommendations and action.
- Experience coordinating across internal teams and external partners or agencies.
- A holistic view of the marketing funnel and an understanding of the role each channel plays.
- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and making fast decisions with imperfect information.
- Familiarity with TV measurement approaches like incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and attribution, and how to apply findings to channel strategy. Bonus points if you've worked with Haus.
- Naturally curious with a strong inclination to question assumptions and validate ideas through data and experimentation.
- Advanced proficiency in Excel. Experience with Looker or similar analytics tools is a plus.

WE OFFER 💫

- Health, Dental & Vision Plans
- Life Insurance
- Long/Short Term Disability
- Competitive Pay
- 401k Matching
- Team Member Stock Purchasing Program (TMSPP)
- Learning & Development Opportunities

- Unlimited PTO

- Commuter benefits _(in-office only)_

* * *

What You'll Be Doing

The Senior Marketing Designer joins our design team and works across everything design touches: the website, brand, GTM and sales assets, and internal and employer branding. As ScaleOps moves from category creator to category leader in autonomous cloud and AI infrastructure management, this role helps mature the brand and build a design language that projects confidence, trust, partnership, and real expertise. Our product is deeply technical and our buyers are technical — platform engineers, DevOps, and SREs who are allergic to fluff — so the work here isn't decoration, it's translating hard technical substance into design this audience trusts.

- Design and evolve the website, from core pages to campaigns and product launches.
- Create GTM and sales assets: decks, one-pagers, solution briefs, event graphics, and social.
- Own internal and employer-branding design that supports culture and hiring.
- Research the product, category, and audience deeply enough to design with real understanding.
- Translate complex concepts across Kubernetes, cloud cost, and autonomous infrastructure into clear visual language.
- Design for credibility with an expert buyer, choosing substance and clarity over decoration.
- Partner with product marketing and engineering to get the technical story and details right.
- Help evolve the brand from early-stage toward category-leader maturity, building and extending a consistent design language — system, templates, and reusable components.

What You'll Bring

- A senior designer with real range across web, brand, and GTM work.
- AI-oriented — you use AI tools to accelerate and elevate your craft.
- Fluent in Figma, our core design system.
- Highly organized, able to run many work streams cleanly and reliably.
- A deep researcher who can absorb a technical product and audience, then translate them into design an expert buyer respects.
- Proactive by nature — you run the research on your own initiative and are always pushing to grow and advance the brand, not waiting to be told.

Samsara's Mission

Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, team player who loves a fast-paced environment and thrives on results. In this role, you will meticulously plan, execute & measure new events and programs for Samsara. These events can include industry trade shows, hosted events, customer and executive experiences, regional summits, educational programs and workshops, strategic sponsorships, partner activations, and other high-impact field marketing programs.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close partnership across Sales, Account Development, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations & Product Management. You should be results-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about driving business impact. This is a fast-growing area of the business that plays a strategic role in our future success.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Mexico City and will require travel up to 50% in Mexico.

You should apply if:

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
- You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

- Own trade shows and hosted events strategy, planning, execution, and success for a strategic company industry vertical, territory or segment
- Execute end-to-end event program management and logistics from initial planning to post-event program follow up, including vendor management, budget management, event promotions, sales enablement, data cleansing/tracking, KPI measurement, and maintenance of all event assets
- Manage event budget forecast and reporting, evaluate and communicate results against goals, and generate learnings for improvement
- Facilitate timely event lead processing within Salesforce, measure event impact, and develop post-event reports and communicate insights
- Own project management tools, documentation, event calendar, and processes used for managing event marketing programs & tradeshows
- Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event program
- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

- 3+ years of professional experience in field marketing, event marketing, or integrated marketing, with demonstrated ownership of customer-facing programs from strategy and planning through execution and post-event measurement.
- Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Marketing, agencies, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders.
- Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
- Proficient using a CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and/or Marketing Automation platforms.
- Must be fluent in Spanish and English.
- Based in/near Mexico City and comfortable going into the office when needed.
- Ability to travel up to 50% for events.

An ideal candidate also has:

- A positive attitude, a team player mentality, and an unmatched love and enthusiasm for all things events.
- A demand generation mindset for event assessment, planning, and execution.
- Experience communicating with and presenting to senior executives, VIPs, customers, and partners.
- Experience managing strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and third-party event relationships to maximize brand presence and business impact.
- Outstanding skills in problem-solving, project management, creative thinking, written/verbal communication, and presenting.
- A self-starter mentality with impeccable organization and a strong attention to detail.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Marketing Platform Operations Manager

-REMOTE, USA-

Apply

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

As the Marketing Platform Operations Manager, you will own data quality and data flow across Smartsheet's marketing technology stack with a particular focus on how lead and account data moves between systems, where it breaks down, and how it can move better in an AI-first environment. You'll dig into the mechanics of our lead flow: where data originates, how it's enriched and scored, how it syncs across platforms, and where gaps or failures cost the business pipeline. This is a hands-on, systems-fluent role. You'll partner closely with Marketing Platform Operations, Campaign Operations, Analytics Engineering, and Sales teams to diagnose data issues, improve data architecture, and support the evaluation and rollout of new tools that improve enrichment, orchestration, and data integrity across the funnel. You'll also contribute to broader Marketing Operations initiatives as they arise.

This role reports to the Director, Marketing Platform Operations and can be based in our Bellevue, WA office or remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

- Own data quality standards across CRM and Marketing Automation Platform (MAP), including field completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
- Lead deduplication efforts and ongoing hygiene initiatives across contact, lead, and account records.
- Diagnose root causes of recurring data quality issues and design scalable fixes rather than one-off cleanups.
- Establish and monitor data quality metrics and reporting to track health over time.
- Map and document how lead and account data flows across systems — from initial capture through enrichment, scoring, routing, and attribution.
- Investigate sync failures, latency, and data loss points between systems, and drive resolution with the appropriate technical owners.
- Analyze lead flow data to identify bottlenecks, leakage, and quality gaps that impact pipeline.
- Partner with Analytics Engineering and BI on data structure, definitions, and reporting logic to ensure consistency across teams.
- Support the evaluation, implementation, and rollout of new marketing technology platforms focused on data enrichment, orchestration, and lead flow automation.
- Translate business requirements into technical specifications for system configuration and integration work.
- Partner with vendors and internal technical teams during implementation, testing, and hypercare periods for new systems.
- Maintain documentation of system architecture, data mappings, and integration logic across the MarTech stack.
- Partner with Marketing Operations on the data inputs and logic underlying lead scoring models.
- Monitor scoring and routing performance post-launch, flagging data anomalies or model drift.
- Support ongoing refinement of scoring criteria based on data quality findings.
- Serve as a data-fluent partner to Sales Development, Campaign Operations, and Analytics Engineering on shared data initiatives.

You Have:

- 8+ years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations, data management, or a closely related field.
- Bachelors degree or equivalent
- Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce and a Marketing Automation Platform (e.g., Marketo), including data structure, field architecture, and integrations.
- Demonstrated experience diagnosing and resolving data flow or sync issues across systems.
- Comfort working with SQL, data mapping, or similar tools to analyze and validate data at scale.
- Experience supporting or leading MarTech implementations, integrations, or platform migrations.
- Familiarity with data enrichment, orchestration, or lead scoring/routing tools and concepts.
- Ability to translate ambiguous or technical problems into clear, actionable plans for cross-functional stakeholders.
- Collaborative and communicative mindset - able to build strong working relationships with Sales, Marketing, and Operations stakeholders across time zones.
- Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

- Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
- 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
- Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
- Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
- US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
- US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
- Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
- Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
- Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
- Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
- Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

_Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity._

US Base Salary Pay Range

$122,500 - $160,000USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Channel Marketing Manager - Fixed Term Contract staring in November 2026.

Singapore, Singapore

Apply

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

The APJ Channel Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing partner marketing strategies that accelerate partner-sourced pipeline, customer acquisition, partner activation, and revenue growth across Asia Pacific & Japan. This role acts as the bridge between Global Partner Marketing, APJ Channel Leadership, Country Marketing teams, and Partners to ensure regional priorities are effectively translated into scalable, measurable go-to-market programs.

The successful candidate will drive engagement across Veeam's channel ecosystem, including distributors, resellers, VCSPs, service providers, and strategic channel partners, while enabling local teams with programs, campaigns, content, tools, and best practices that support growth objectives.

What You’ll Do

Partner Ecosystem Strategy & Planning

- Develop and execute the APJ channel marketing strategy aligned to regional revenue and partner growth objectives.
- Build annual and quarterly marketing plans supporting key channel motions, including partner recruitment, activation, retention, SaaS adoption, and customer expansion.
- Partner closely with APJ Channel Leadership to translate business priorities into scalable marketing initiatives.
- Align regional plans with Global Partner Marketing programs while tailoring execution to local market requirements.

Partner Demand Generation

- Design and execute integrated partner-led and partner-enabled demand generation campaigns.
- Support strategic channel partners with joint marketing plans, co-branded campaigns, events, webinars, executive engagement programs, and digital initiatives.
- Drive pipeline creation through MDF/PMDF investments and partner marketing funds.
- Measure campaign effectiveness and optimise investment based on business outcomes.

Partner Engagement & Enablement

- Develop programs that improve partner engagement, awareness, and adoption of key initiatives.
- Enable partners with messaging, campaign kits, event-in-a-box programs, content, sales plays, and marketing tools.
- Collaborate with channel teams to increase partner participation in programs, product launches, and strategic initiatives.
- Support partner segmentation strategies and differentiated engagement models.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Channel Sales, Alliances, Enterprise Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Operations, and SDR teams to ensure alignment of campaigns and follow-up motions.
- Coordinate regional execution across APJ countries, balancing global consistency with local market relevance.
- Act as the primary marketing contact for channel business priorities across APJ.

Budget & Investment Management

- Manage channel marketing budgets, MDF/PMDF programs, and partner investment plans.
- Maintain governance, compliance, and reporting standards for partner-funded activities.
- Ensure investments are aligned to strategic priorities and deliver measurable ROI.

Measurement & Insights

- Establish KPIs and performance reporting for channel marketing programs.
- Track partner engagement, pipeline contribution, influenced revenue, marketing-sourced opportunities, and partner activation metrics.
- Deliver quarterly business reviews and recommendations to leadership.
- Provide insights and feedback to Global teams regarding APJ market needs and partner trends.

Success Measures

- Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline
- Marketing-influenced revenue
- MDF/PMDF utilisation and ROI
- Partner activation and engagement levels
- Joint campaign execution metrics
- VCSP/SaaS growth contribution
- Strategic partner business plan attainment
- Event and digital program performance
- Channel partner satisfaction and participation

What You’ll Bring

- 5-8+ years in channel marketing, partner marketing, field marketing, or alliance marketing.
- Experience managing complex partner ecosystems across multiple APJ markets.
- Strong understanding of indirect sales models, distributors, resellers, MSPs, CSPs, and cloud/service provider channels.
- Proven experience managing partner marketing investments and MDF programs.
- Expertise in demand generation, digital marketing, events, and partner enablement.
- Strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones in a matrix organisation.

What You’ll Get

- 15 to 21 annual vacation days (based on role level), plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
- Private medical plan for employees and eligible dependents, including major medical, hospital, surgical, and outpatient coverage
- Dental insurance with comprehensive coverage for employees and dependents
- Annual wellbeing allowance for health and wellness support
- Life and accident insurance for added financial protection
- Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

As Marketing Strategy Director at Airalo, you will collaborate closely with the Growth organization to define and optimize acquisition, conversion, and retention targets across regions and channels. You will operate as a central, region agnostic capital allocator within Growth — ensuring time, budget, and effort are deployed toward the highest incremental impact opportunities. Acting as a key partner to Growth leadership, you will turn complex data into clear trade off decisions, pressure test assumptions, and help determine where the next dollar and the next hour should be invested.

In this role, you will own Growth’s forecasting and planning processes, ensuring regional and central teams are aligned on targets, assumptions, and trade offs. You will run the operating cadence for Growth, steward the business inputs, scenario frameworks, and planning logic layered on top of Data’s forecasting model, and translate performance insights into cross regional and cross channel allocation decisions that improve incremental growth and capital efficiency — operating within the financial guardrails set by our Finance team.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Forecasting, Planning & Operating Rhythm

- Own Growth’s forecasting process end to end: gather assumptions, challenge inputs, coordinate with Data, and prepare forecast narratives for leadership

- Maintain and continuously refine the business logic, pacing, scenario planning, and target setting frameworks built on top of Airalo’s forecasting model

- Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews — prepare materials, synthesize insights, and ensure follow-ups drive real action

- Run weekly operating cadence for Growth: performance reviews, KPI tracking, variance analysis, and strategic escalations

Budget Allocation & Strategic Decision Support

- Build data-driven recommendations on spend allocation across regions and channels, using CAC, pLTV, incrementality and ROI insights to optimize for incremental profit/growth

- Conduct granular regional deep dives (country/segment/channel) and identify levers to improve growth or efficiency.

- Identify cross-regional capital reallocation opportunities and quantify trade-offs between markets (e.g., where incremental $1 delivers highest marginal return).

- Partner with Growth, Product, Brand, and Finance to align on targets, trade-offs, and the drivers behind plan variances.

Analytics Partnership & Insight Activation

- Serve as Growth’s primary business partner to the Data team: consolidate analytical needs, provide business context, and ensure high-quality inputs into Data’s roadmap.

- Translate analytical outputs (forecasts, dashboards, experiment results) into decisions, actions, and processes that stick.

- Ensure Growth teams adopt and operationalize dashboards and models — build documentation, training, and clear workflows.

Cross-Functional Strategy & Special Projects

- Lead cross-functional projects such as regional/channel diagnostics, efficiency audits, or market deep-dives - including 30 day “drop-in” sprints to fix specific business problems

- Build frameworks that guide decision-making: ROI models, sizing models, scenario tools, prioritization structures.

- Identify and implement process improvements across the Growth org to increase speed, clarity, and execution quality.

Must Haves:

- 9+ years in Marketing Strategy, BizOps, FP&A, Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, or similar analytical roles.

- Demonstrated experience owning planning cycles and influencing capital allocation decisions at a multi-market or global level.

- Demonstrated ability to maintain forecasting models (Excel/Sheets) and run scenario planning, CAC/LTV experience, pacing, and ROI logic.

- Strong analytical proficiency: Excel (advanced), and comfort working with SQL and modern BI tools (Looker, Lightdash, Tableau). Experience with MMM models a plus.

- Clear experience turning data into recommendations — not just reporting results, but synthesizing insights into “what we do next.”

- Ability to challenge assumptions, pressure-test inputs, and navigate ambiguous or incomplete data.

- Experience working cross-functionally with channel leads, PMs, and Data teams; strong communication skills with senior stakeholders.

- Comfort managing complex, deadline-driven projects, prioritizing across markets, and driving alignment among multiple teams.

- A proactive, structured problem-solver who can pick up unclear problems, untangle them, and deliver clarity with minimal guidance.

Nice To Haves:

- Experience in consumer tech, marketplace, travel, or subscription businesses

- Familiarity with marketing analytics: attribution, CAC/LTV modeling, incrementality testing, funnel analysis

- Comfort coordinating experimentation roadmaps and interpreting lift tests or causal results

- Prior experience as the business partner to a Data/Analytics org

£80,800 - £119,500 a year

Senior Marketing Manager

Nashville, TN / Austin, TX

Marketing – Global Marketing /

Full Time /
