apply for this job

About Ampd Energy

Ampd Energy is transforming how cities build - cleaner, smarter, and more sustainably. We are trailblazers in making the construction industry emission-free. Our products are advanced, compact, and connected battery energy storage system (BESS) designed to replace the dirty, noisy, and hazardous diesel generators that power construction sites around the world. By combining connected hardware with advanced software and AI, we reduce emissions, noise, and operational complexity.

We envision an emission-free future across all industries. Our mission is to develop robust, versatile, and easy-to-use products that deliver clean energy - empowering businesses and people to achieve more. We're seeking individuals who bring entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and enthusiasm, and who thrive in an environment of continuous learning and evolution.

Summary of the Position

Ampd Energy is growing fast, and  we are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to help scale our global marketing capability to the next level.

Based remotely in the United States, this role reports to the Chief Commercial Officer. This is a hands-on global role focused on building the Ampd brand, engaging strategic accounts, generating demand and supporting commercial growth across our markets.

We are looking for a modern B2B marketer who combines strong marketing fundamentals with expertise in Account-Based Marketing, digital marketing, demand generation, content, marketing technology and AI. You will work closely with cross functional teams - Sales/Commercial, PreSales/Application Engineering and Product teams to translate our strategy and technical capabilities into compelling campaigns, customer engagement and measurable commercial opportunities.

A key part of this role will be helping Ampd use AI and automation to scale how we market and sell. This includes building and deploying AI agents and automated workflows for areas such as market and account intelligence, competitive research, content development, lead generation and qualification, campaign execution and sales enablement.

This role is not about simply using AI to create content faster. We are looking for someone who understands how AI, agents and automation can fundamentally improve the way a modern marketing and commercial organization operates.

Ampd Energy is a values-driven company, and we are looking for candidates aligned with our core values: Never Satisfied, Selfless, Resourceful and Bold.

What you'll do

- Develop and execute global marketing programs aligned with Ampd's commercial strategy and growth priorities.

- Build and execute Account-Based Marketing programs targeting Ampd's highest-priority customers, prospects and strategic accounts.

- Partner closely with regional Sales teams to develop demand-generation programs that create qualified opportunities and measurable pipeline.

- Develop campaigns supporting new products, applications, geographic markets and strategic commercial initiatives.

- Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that improve marketing and commercial effectiveness, speed and scalability.

- Apply AI to market research, account intelligence, competitive monitoring, content development, personalization, lead qualification, campaign optimization and sales enablement.

- Identify manual and repetitive Marketing and Commercial activities that can be improved or automated through AI.

- Connect HubSpot, marketing platforms, data sources and AI tools to create scalable marketing workflows.

- Own and continuously improve Ampd's digital presence, including website performance, SEO/SEM, AI-search visibility, digital campaigns and social channels.

- Build a scalable content engine supporting customer education, thought leadership, demand generation and sales conversion.

- Develop high-quality sales enablement materials including presentations, playbooks, case studies, application content and competitive positioning.

- Translate Ampd's technical capabilities and customer applications into clear, compelling commercial value propositions.

- Develop a structured approach to market and competitive intelligence and use AI-enabled tools to identify market trends, customer opportunities and competitive activity.

- Work closely with Sales Operations to improve HubSpot utilization, lead management, marketing attribution and visibility across the customer journey.

- Measure marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline, strategic account engagement, conversion, campaign performance and ROI.

- Use data and customer insights to continuously improve marketing strategy, investment and execution.

- Maintain a consistent global Ampd brand while enabling effective regional execution.

- Work collaboratively across Commercial, Application Engineering, Product and other functions to support Ampd's continued global growth.

Who you are:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- 7+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, preferably within energy, clean technology, industrial technology, construction equipment, manufacturing or another complex technical industry.

- Demonstrated success developing and executing Account-Based Marketing and demand-generation programs.

- Strong understanding of complex, high-value B2B sales cycles and how Marketing contributes to pipeline and revenue growth.

- Strong digital marketing experience, including website optimization, SEO/SEM, digital campaigns, social media and analytics.

- Experience developing sales enablement, thought leadership and customer-facing content for technical products or solutions.

- Strong experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms; HubSpot experience is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on professional experience applying generative AI within marketing or commercial environments.

- Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI agents, automated workflows or multi-step AI-enabled processes.

- Ability to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve marketing productivity, customer engagement and commercial effectiveness.

- Strong analytical skills with experience measuring marketing performance, pipeline contribution, conversion and ROI.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and compelling commercial messaging.

- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

- Experience working across multiple geographic markets or supporting global growth is preferred.

- Self-motivated and able to operate with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

Ampd Energy offers competitive benefits, strong opportunities for professional growth, and a collaborative, multinational work environment.

All information provided will be treated in strict confidence and used solely for recruitment purposes.

Ampd Energy is an equal-opportunity employer. All candidates will be assessed on merit without regard to age, race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, marital status, political affiliation, or any other factor protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

- Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
- Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.

CaptivateIQ is the leading Sales Performance Management solution, recognized by Forrester and G2, and trusted by customers including Affirm, Gong, and Figma. With solutions for Sales Planning and Incentives, we help revenue teams automate processes, hit revenue targets, and adapt with business change, ultimately driving efficient growth. It's time to rethink ROI - your return on incentives - with CaptivateIQ.

With backing from Sequoia, Accel, ICONIQ, Sapphire Ventures, and other leading investors, CaptivateIQ is on a mission to enable every company to improve their return on incentives and sales planning.

Come and see why Glassdoor and Comparably have recognized CaptivateIQ as a best place to work!

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly strategic Senior Content Marketing Manager to own the complete lifecycle of our content: strategy, execution, and distribution. Success in this role will be rooted in critical thinking and a structured approach to problem-solving, which will directly shape our market narrative. In this role, you will be the architect of our market point of view, developing a high-velocity distribution engine across social and owned channels, and orchestrating a high-impact editorial and social calendar that directly fuels awareness, engagement, and pipeline for the business. You’ll collaborate closely with customers, SMEs, and cross-functional partners to craft differentiated narratives for RevOps, Sales, and Finance audiences.

This is a highly growth-oriented role. Your success will require not just a clear, documented content strategy and standout content but also the ability to translate content into growth through increased traffic, owned audience, and brand awareness.

Responsibilities

- Build and continuously evolve a company‑wide content strategy aligned to growth priorities, target segments, and the buyer journey, translating strategy into clear editorial roadmaps and channel plans.
- Own and manage integrated content and social calendars, ensuring the right mix of campaigns, thought leadership, product narratives, customer stories, and lifecycle content is planned, produced, and shipped on time.
- Own the organic brand awareness motion via social: define content pillars and social voice, executive social and employee advocacy programs, channel‑specific formats, and trend/reactive content guidelines.
- Partner with customers and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop unique points of view on the market, shaping signature assets such as category narratives, executive bylines, long‑form guides, research reports, and event keynotes.
- Lead the development of cornerstone content and atomize it across blog, social, newsletter, sales enablement, webinars, video, podcasts, and field events to maximize reach and ROI.
- Establish an editorial governance model including voice and tone, messaging guardrails, briefing templates, and QA standards to ensure clarity, consistency, and brand integrity.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Growth, Comms, Field, and Sales to align content with launches, demand programs, events, and enablement needs, setting clear briefs and success metrics.
- Measure, analyze, and report on content performance (traffic, engagement, pipeline, SEO, social share of voice), translating metrics into an experimentation roadmap to drive continuous growth and audience building.
- Coordinate external partners (agencies and freelancers) with clear briefs, SLAs, and editorial standards to scale production as needed.
- Drive operational excellence across intake, prioritization, production workflows, and reviews, improving speed‑to‑publish and content quality.

Requirements

- 7–10 years of B2B content experience with a track record of building programs that drive measurable impact across awareness and demand.
- Deep experience collaborating with executives, customers, and SMEs to produce differentiated market-shaping thought leadership and category narratives.
- Proven ownership of organic social strategies: channel planning, voice development, executive social, employee advocacy, and social listening/engagement.
- Strong editorial judgment and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into simple, compelling narratives.
- Proficiency with SEO, content analytics, and experimentation to prioritize topics, optimize distribution, and demonstrate ROI.
- Hands‑on writing and editing skills across long‑form, short‑form, and multimedia formats; comfortable giving and receiving editorial feedback.
- Experience coordinating external partners and vendors, including budgeting and capacity planning for outsourced work.
- Familiarity with tools such as CMS platforms, SEO suites, analytics, social scheduling and listening, project management, and marketing automation.
- Bonus: Experience in B2B SaaS for revenue operations, sales performance, finance, or compensation; executive ghostwriting; original research programs.

Core Competencies

- Proven customer focus; builds trusted relationships and uses voice‑of‑customer to shape content strategy and execution.
- Consistent results orientation; meets goals, drives impact, and iterates based on outcomes.
- Strong planning and organization; prioritizes, sequences, and manages multiple workstreams and stakeholders effectively
- Discipline in managing and measuring work; sets clear objectives, defines success metrics, and builds feedback loops.
- High creativity; generates original, differentiated ideas and connects dots across channels and formats.
- Broad perspective; ties day‑to‑day content to business goals, market dynamics, and future implications.
- Vision and purpose; articulates compelling narratives

Benefits

- (US-ONLY) 100% of medical, dental, and vision covered including 75% for dependents
- Flexible vacation days and quarterly mental health days so you can recharge
- Enjoy a one-time expense on your 1-year work anniversary (to use for travel, home furnishings, fancy meal)
- One time work from home stipend & annual stipends for professional development and caretaking
- Virtual team lunches to keep you connected
- (US-ONLY) 401k plan to participate in and save towards the future
- Newest Apple products to help you do your best work
- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support and celebrate the shared identities and life experiences of communities within CaptivateIQ. ERGs directly support our company-wide DEI goals as a space for developing and retaining diverse talent

Notice for Prospective Candidates

- Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.

We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:

- Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
- Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
- Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
- Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
- Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
- Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.

$110,000 - $150,000 a year

The compensation offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. The salary range for this role is $110,000- $ 150,000. Compensation for candidates hired in Canada will be provided in Canadian dollars and may differ from the ranges listed above due to currency conversion. Our OTE is just one component of CaptivateIQ's competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity, comprehensive health benefits, and other perks and benefits.

- Experience with more technical products and comfort sitting with technical teams and customers alike. You can understand an architecture, ask the right questions, and find the customer problem in it
- Track record of influencing product decisions. You can show work where customer feedback you gathered changed what shipped
- Experiencing using AI tools and have points of view on positioning AI products
- Exceptional storytelling and communication skills. You can distill complex concepts into clear, compelling messaging
- A structured, evidence-driven approach to research and measurement. You can design win/loss or buyer research, read the data honestly, and iterate on what you learn
- Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in an environment where GTM infrastructure is still being built, not inherited
- Deep understanding of competitive intelligence and how to use it to differentiate and win deals

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with SPM, ICM, or related revenue and compensation technology platforms
- B2B enterprise fluency, particularly within the Office of the CFO, Finance, or RevOps; you understand these buyers, their specific pains, and their software evaluation criteria
- Hands-on experience developing custom AI tools or autonomous agents

- Direct experience in the marketing of AI and agentic product solutions

About the role

We're looking for someone to own product marketing at Drivetrain end to end.

That means being the bridge between what we build and how the market understands it: sharpening how we position against legacy EPM incumbents and spreadsheet inertia, running launches that land, arming our sales team with narratives that win competitive deals, and driving in-app adoption so customers go deeper into the product rather than plateauing after onboarding.

This is a builder's role, not a maintenance one. You'll be defining the function — the messaging architecture, the launch process, the competitive intelligence program — and as the team grows, hiring and developing the people who run it.

What you'll be doing

Positioning and messaging

- Own the company narrative and product-level messaging: why Drivetrain, why now, why not the alternative. Make it specific enough that a finance buyer feels understood.
- Build and maintain the messaging architecture across personas (CFO, VP Finance, FP&A manager) and segments, and hold the organization to it.
- Develop pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product and Sales, grounded in willingness-to-pay research rather than instinct.

Go-to-market and launches

- Run product launches end to end — tiering, positioning, enablement, content, timing, and post-launch measurement. Define what a successful launch looks like before it ships.
- Partner closely with Product on roadmap inputs, bringing market and competitive evidence into prioritization conversations.

Adoption and expansion

- Drive in-app product adoption in partnership with Product and Customer Success: onboarding narratives, feature discovery, lifecycle messaging. Increase usage and stickiness, and turn that into retention and expansion.
- Instrument it. Know which cohorts are adopting what, and why the others aren't.

Content and demand

- Set the editorial bar for everything we publish — research reports, whitepapers, case studies, website copy — and defend the difference between genuinely good content and filler.
- Partner with Demand Gen to make sure campaigns are built on messaging that converts, not just channels that spend.

Team

- Manage and develop product marketers as the team scales; in the near term, expect to be hands-on in the work yourself.

What you'll bring

- 5–12 years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 4 in product marketing and meaningful experience marketing to technical or financial buyers.
- A track record of owning positioning for a product or product line — not just executing launches someone else scoped.

You’ll work closely with the broader elk team to support both ongoing client email programs and one-off projects that require specialized email expertise or a faster turnaround than external partners can provide.

- Identify opportunities for additional automations and lifecycle marketing initiatives.

- Monitor flow performance and make data-driven recommendations for ongoing optimization.

- Build recurring and ad hoc email marketing reports.

- Evaluate key performance indicators such as open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, revenue, engagement, and unsubscribe rates.

- Identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement across email programs.

- Communicate results and recommendations to internal teams and clients as needed.

- Strong understanding of email marketing best practices, including segmentation, personalization, testing, deliverability, and optimization.

- Comfortable interpreting email performance data and turning insights into recommendations.

- Experience working with multiple clients, brands, or projects in an agency environment is strongly preferred.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.

- Ability to work collaboratively while also taking ownership of projects from start to finish.

London – Manager, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness

Ekimetrics is a global leader in Marketing Effectiveness and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping businesses optimise marketing and operations by combining AI with business and tech expertise across 4 domains: Marketing Effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we deliver tailor-made solutions that turn data into real positive impact, leveraging our unique combination of technology and services.

We excel at delivering AI impact at scale. Our mission is to harness this power to tackle the world’s most urgent issues. We commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematic AI impact at scale, and loyalty to our values and DNA.

Your responsibilities

As a manager specialising in MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will lead high-impact MMM programmes for international clients across industries such as Auto, Beauty, Retail, and Financial Services. You will manage multiple teams and accounts, oversee end-to-end project delivery, and ensure actionable insights are delivered to clients while driving business growth and talent development.

Lead Projects

·Oversee end-to-end MMM and marketing effectiveness programmes, from scoping and data strategy through to modelling, insights, and activation.

·Ensure robust project governance, including data quality, model validity, and actionable recommendations that drive client impact and business growth.

·Translate complex analytical outputs into strategic narratives and clear actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and C-suite clients.

·Define, steer, and monitor project roadmaps using Ekimetrics’ methodologies and standards, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, profitability targets, and timelines.

·Provide strategic oversight to clients, helping optimise marketing spend, enhance campaign performance, and improve customer segmentation and ROI.

·Support partners and senior managers in client engagement, delivering strategic insights, shaping proposals, and contributing to RFPs/pitches

·Continuously identify and implement innovative approaches to solve client business challenges.

People & Project Leadership

·Line manage multiple team members, overseeing performance, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and talent assessments, while ensuring high-quality delivery, profitability, and client satisfaction.

·Lead talent development initiatives, including annual talent reviews and career development planning,

·Mentor project teams, guiding analytical workstreams, ensuring quality, and promoting knowledge sharing to develop team capabilities.

·Contribute to project staffing strategy, balancing business priorities, expertise requirements, and team development opportunities

·Recruit, align, and develop resources to build high-performing teams, retaining top talent.

·Encourage collaboration, communication, and knowledge sharing within squads, inspiring team engagement and continuous improvement.

Account & Business Growth

·Serve as the operational and strategic point of contact for key accounts, maintaining strong long-term client relationships.

·Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities and support global account growth strategies.

·Contribute to the scoping and design of new projects, ensuring business cases align with Ekimetrics capabilities.

·Provide strategic guidance to clients using data-driven insights, helping them understand target audiences, optimise marketing spend, and measure campaign impact.

Practice & Thought Leadership

·Enhance MMM methodologies, automation, tooling, and internal assets to scale delivery excellence.

·Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge management, and innovation initiatives.

·Act as an ambassador of Eki culture, role-modelling Ekimetrics’ core values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission, Pleasure.

Your profile

Experience & Technical Skills

·Experience in econometrics, MMM, or marketing effectiveness.

·Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics, or related field.

·Proficient in Python, R, SQL, Excel, and visualisation tools; experience with Databricks, Azure, or other cloud/data platforms is a plus.

·Strong understanding of econometrics, regression, Bayesian statistics, and advanced modelling techniques.

·Skilled in handling large datasets, optimising pipelines, and delivering high-quality outputs

·Track record of translating complex model results into actionable business recommendations.

Client & People Management

·Proven ability to lead multiple project teams and manage priorities autonomously.

·Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills for senior stakeholders.

·Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on continuous improvement.

·Experienced in mentoring, talent development, and encouraging team growth.

·Skilled in client account management, maintaining relationships, and identifying growth opportunities.

Soft Skills

·Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven.

·Positive, resilient, and adaptable in fast-paced consultancy environments.

·Curious, creative, and committed to delivering high-quality work.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, encouraging you to push boundaries while thriving in a collaborative environment. We believe in enjoying what we do and fostering a safe, inclusive space where you can bring your authentic self.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR.

Our purpose: Accelerate organisations’ transformation towards sustainability through data science and AI.

We are proud to have been certified Great Place to Work© in France, the UK, and the US, with our Hong Kong office recognised as Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©. Ekimetrics is also part of the French Tech 120, selected among the top French scale-ups with potential for international leadership.

You will have access to:

·Salary From £80,000 + Bonus 20% + Corporate bonus

·The Eki.Academy training catalogue: learning paths, solution- and role-specific programs, and Climate School environmental awareness courses

·Regular events and seminars to connect with colleagues

·Modern office space in a central London location

·Flexible hybrid working policy (2 days a week in office + 20 days remotely)

·25 days annual leave + bank holidays, plus 3 additional days for tenure

·Private healthcare, life insurance, and wellbeing support

·Group pension scheme

·Opportunities for international mobility and career development

_As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams._

Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve pioneered the use of AI and data science applied to unified marketing measurement and holistic business optimization aligned with sustainability performance.

Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for sustainable business performance.

At Ekimetrics, we have the ambition to help our clients rethink their business models by reconciling economic, environmental and social performance through data science.

·400 data science experts globally (50+ in the UK)

·4 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London and New York

Why are we hiring?

As we continue to grow, bringing on new global clients, we are looking for a manager to join our London office. We want to strengthen our market optimization offering which focuses on “Marketing Effectiveness” and “Marketing Measurement”. We support clients with detailed recommendations that can be acted upon immediately, as well as on longer-term brand strategies, reconnecting immediate and future business impact.

Your role in the team

As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to work in various teams to service global clients, on key accounts, across multiple continents to deliver marketing and customer analytics projects that will lead to significant, value-led transformations. You will support Managers by acting as project lead for our clients. You will gain a deep understanding of their needs and offer the most effective solutions, providing impactful and useful insights to help steer their revenue or data strategies, and building long-term relationships.

Embedded in the core of this position lies your expertise in Marketing Mix Modelling. You will be responsible for steering the client, and delivery of BMC's and MMM models. Whilst you may not generate these models directly you will need prior knowledge of MMM and modelling platforms. Your role will require you to navigate these insights into compelling stories that resonate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Overview

·Use your knowledge and experience In Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) to make business-led decisions

·Create real valuable actionable insights for clients defining their marketing and strategic direction.

·Lead projects with globally recognised brands

·Manage and lead end-to-end analytics projects, including planning, design, and implementation.

·Lead a team of 3-8 consultants.

About You

We are looking for someone who can show both advanced analytics skills and a strong interest in marketing & business strategy. Ideally, you’ll have:

·Strong Knowledge and experience in Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM)

·Experience working across large data sets

·Understanding of media variables/econometrics and prior modelling experience.

·Experience working with clients and account management

·Knowledge and/or understanding of Coding languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki

·Proficiency in Microsoft Office software such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

·Degree in Economics/Econometrics, Maths/Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science or a related field

·Interest in working in a fast-paced and driven consultancy environment.

·Clear and concise communication

Working for Eki

Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! We have clients across multiple industries and are constantly looking to innovate and explore new ways of doing things. Our London team consists of ~50 people and are predominantly Data Science Consultants. We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success.

We encourage continuous self-development and thought leadership throughout Ekimetrics and foster a culture of transmission and pleasure – we love what we do, and we want to share it!

As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:

·Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office)

·25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays and additional days for tenure)

·Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services (all on entry)

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Manager, Demand Generation owns EnableComp’s demand generation engine — planning and executing the multi-channel campaigns that build pipeline, and, as our first dedicated content hire, creating the blog posts, ebooks, landing pages, and nurture content those campaigns run on. This role builds on the technical infrastructure the GTM Engineer maintains and the positioning the Director, Product Marketing sets, translating both into campaigns that generate and nurture qualified leads.

Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the Manager will partner closely with Product Marketing, the Commercial Enablement Director, the Manager of Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships, and the SDR function to ensure a consistent, well-coordinated path from first touch to qualified pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at this time.

The Job Responsibilities Include

- Plan, build, and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, paid social, SEM, retargeting, and organic channels.
- Own marketing-sourced pipeline targets and report on campaign performance against revenue goals.
- Manage the demand generation budget, tracking spend against ROI and reallocating based on channel performance.
- Own funnel content end-to-end: blog posts, ebooks/guides, landing pages, and nurture email copy that fuel campaigns — this is our first dedicated content hire, so the expectation is building the engine, not just staffing it.
- Ensure all campaign content reflects current positioning and messaging maintained by the Director, Product Marketing.
- Establish a scalable, repeatable content calendar and production workflow.
- Build and manage lead nurture email programs and campaign workflows inside HubSpot, working within the lead scoring and account routing logic the GTM Engineer designs and maintains.
- Partner with the GTM Engineer on campaign-specific automation needs and data requirements, without owning the underlying tech stack, integrations, or scoring/routing architecture.
- Monitor and troubleshoot campaign-level workflow issues, escalating systemic or infrastructure issues to the GTM Engineer.
- Partner with the Manager, Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships on webinar and event promotion strategy, registration goals, and post-event lead nurture (Events owns strategy, logistics, and execution; Growth Marketing owns the pipeline goals and follow-up).
- Partner with the Director, Product Marketing to ensure campaigns and content reflect current narrative, positioning, and competitive messaging.
- Partner with the SDR function on lead handoff, MQL quality feedback, and conversion tracking.
- Analyze campaign and content performance data to identify what’s working, kill what isn’t, and continuously optimize for MQL volume, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition.
- Stay current on emerging channels and AI-powered marketing/content tools, piloting new tactics to keep programs ahead of the curve.
- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
- 3–5 years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, or a related B2B marketing role.
- Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), or another complex B2B industry is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
- Strong writing skills — comfortable independently drafting blog posts, email copy, and landing page copy, since this role owns content without a dedicated content team behind it.
- Strong analytical skills, with experience pulling and interpreting campaign data to make decisions.
- Comfort partnering with a technical GTM/RevOps function (e.g., a GTM Engineer) on automation and data needs without owning the underlying systems.
- Regular and predictable attendance.
- Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use office applications, including MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook), Zoom, and other learning technology.
- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations & Prerequisites

- Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.
- Individual contributor role; no direct reports at this time.
- A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders.
- Strong project management and prioritization skills; comfortable running multiple campaigns simultaneously.
- A bias toward experimentation and iteration, including piloting AI-enabled content and marketing tools.
- Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites.
- Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment.

_EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment._

apply for this job

About the Role

TurFresh is looking for a hands-on Growth & Marketing Operations Manager to improve marketing performance across multiple markets.

This role combines strategy, analytics, execution oversight and team coordination. You will connect paid media, SEO, local search, CRM, marketing automation, websites, lead handling, agencies and internal specialists into one accountable system.

You will work closely with John and the President/General Manager, who will provide strategic guidance and feedback. You will be expected to turn that direction into clear plans, disciplined execution and measurable results.

You should be analytical, commercially minded, organized, technically capable and comfortable moving between strategy and execution.

You should naturally ask:

What happened? Why did it happen? Was the work executed correctly? What should we do next?

What You Will Own

- Marketing performance by market and channel

- Weekly KPI reporting and executive communication

- Lead volume, qualified leads, CPL, CAC, conversion and ROI

- Paid-media agency performance

- SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profile performance

- Lead attribution, CRM and marketing automation

- Website and landing-page conversion

- Marketing priorities, projects and vendor deliverables

- Coordination between Marketing, Sales and Operations

- Marketing processes, SOPs and quality control

What You Will Do

Performance & Analytics

Track performance across paid search, organic search, local search, email/SMS, referrals and other channels.

Connect marketing activity to:

Lead → Contact → Quote → Sale → Revenue

Investigate changes in lead volume, lead quality, cost, conversion, revenue and market performance. Determine whether problems come from strategy, execution, tracking, lead routing, follow-up, agencies or market conditions.

Translate data into clear recommendations, owners, action steps and success criteria.

Growth Management

Identify opportunities to increase profitable customer acquisition.

Evaluate:

- Market and channel performance

- Budget allocation

- Search and keyword opportunities

- Landing pages

- Local search

- Lead reactivation

- CRM and follow-up

- New tests and growth initiatives

Work with John and the President/General Manager to prioritize opportunities and execute them effectively.

Hands-On Marketing Direction

Provide practical direction to agencies, vendors and internal specialists.

You should be able to review and improve:

- Paid-search structure, targeting, bids, budgets and ad copy

- Keywords and negative keywords

- Landing pages and conversion paths

- SEO and local-search execution

- Google Business Profiles

- CRM workflows and lead routing

- Tracking and attribution

- Website forms and calls

- Marketing SOPs and quality-control processes

You do not need to perform every task daily, but you must understand the work well enough to direct it, evaluate it, teach it and step in when necessary.

Agency & Vendor Management

Set clear expectations for each agency or specialist, including:

- Objective

- Strategy

- Required work

- KPI and target

- Deliverable

- Deadline

- Result

- Corrective action

Challenge vague explanations and distinguish between poor strategy, weak execution, tracking issues, lead-quality problems and sales follow-up problems.

Marketing Operations

Create structure around the marketing department.

Maintain:

- Priorities and project ownership

- Due dates and reporting

- KPI dashboards

- Campaign calendars

- Testing backlogs

- Vendor deliverables

- SOPs and training materials

- Quality-control checklists

- Open issues and follow-up items

Eliminate, automate, delegate or simplify low-value work.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

Work with Sales to understand what happens after a lead is generated.

Use downstream results to evaluate targeting, messaging, qualification, routing, response time, follow-up and sales execution.

Marketing success is not simply generating inquiries. The goal is generating qualified opportunities that become profitable customers.

Team Coordination

Work with specialists in:

- Paid media

- SEO and local SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Content

- Email and SMS

- Creative

- Website

- Marketing automation

- Analytics and reporting

You are not expected to own every specialty, but you must be able to evaluate the work, set direction, identify problems, coach others and hold people accountable.

Executive Partnership

Our owner and the President/General Manager are both marketers and will remain actively involved.

They will provide strategic guidance, feedback and context on priorities, positioning, messaging and customer experience.

You will be expected to present recommendations, accept feedback, revise plans when appropriate and own the day-to-day marketing operating system.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will have:

- Established a reliable weekly marketing scorecard

- Created clear ownership across marketing functions

- Improved visibility into performance by market and channel

- Evaluated agency, vendor and execution quality

- Improved lead attribution and CAC reporting

- Connected marketing results to sales outcomes

- Identified priority growth opportunities

- Documented key SOPs and standards

- Created a testing and optimization roadmap

- Established an effective working rhythm with leadership

Over time, success means:

- More qualified leads

- Lower acquisition costs

- Better marketing efficiency

- Stronger attribution

- Better agency accountability

- More consistent execution

- Faster problem resolution

- Stronger internal capability

- More predictable revenue growth

Ideal Background

We are looking for someone with approximately 5–8+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, marketing operations, demand generation or digital marketing.

Strong candidates will have hands-on experience with several of the following:

- Google Ads / PPC

- SEO and local SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- GA4 and Google Search Console

- CRM and marketing automation

- Lead routing and call tracking

- Attribution and reporting

- Conversion-rate optimization

- Landing pages and websites

- Agency management

- Multi-market or local service businesses

- Executive KPI reporting

- SOP development

- Team training or coaching

Experience personally diagnosing and correcting marketing problems is especially valuable.

The Person We Are Looking For

You are:

- Analytical and commercially minded

- Highly organized

- Technically credible

- Comfortable with accountability

- Curious about why performance changes

- Able to move between strategy and execution

- Comfortable reviewing detailed work

- Strong at prioritization

- Clear with executives, vendors and teammates

- Comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Resourceful, dependable and coachable

- Focused on outcomes rather than activity

- Committed to high-quality work and continuous improvement

You should enjoy building systems, improving performance and developing people while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is being done correctly.

This Role Is Probably Not Right for You If

You primarily want to:

- Focus on brand strategy without owning performance

- Create content as your main responsibility

- Manage social media

- Review dashboards without investigating the work

- Delegate without understanding execution

- Rely entirely on agencies

- Avoid platform or implementation details

- Resist feedback

- Report metrics without owning results

- Prioritize activity over business outcomes

Reporting Relationship

Reports directly to the President/General Manager and works closely with John, Sales, Operations, internal marketing specialists and external agencies.

Core Scorecard

Your performance will be evaluated on:

Qualified Lead Growth

Cost per Qualified Lead

Customer Acquisition Cost

Marketing-Sourced Revenue

Conversion Performance

Marketing ROI

Execution Quality

Attribution Accuracy

Team and Vendor Capability

Process Improvement

and the organization’s ability to understand where growth is coming from, whether the work is being executed correctly and where the next marketing dollar should be invested.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Working directly at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, and Marketing, you are responsible for keeping pace with an AI-forward environment where speed wins. - Messaging and Positioning: You will own messaging and positioning of the individual products within the portfolio for business partners and stakeholders.

Launch Execution & GTM Orchestration

- Cross-Functional Delivery: Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure everyone contributes effectively to GTM strategies and hits their respective milestones.

- Win/loss discipline: Own a consistent win/loss practice and turn the findings into positioning changes.

- Generative AI & LLMs: Comfort with technical concepts, APIs, modern software architectures, and specific familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or legal workflows.

- Cross-Functional Tech Alignment: Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management and Engineering teams to translate product roadmaps into GTM strategies.

Qualifications:

- Professional Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated product marketing experience within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally experiencing the high-growth transition from Series C to IPO. Previous experience as a legal professional is a strong plus.
- AI-Forward Execution & Velocity: Proven experience working in a fast-paced technology or AI environment. You understand that speed wins, and you have a track record of flawlessly executing GTM tasks under tight timelines.
- Proactive Writer & Practitioner: A stellar portfolio demonstrating your ability to write clear, compelling product content and high-stakes customer-facing presentations.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated success partnering across product, sales, and marketing teams to execute unified strategies.
- Analytical & Technical Curiosity: Comfort with technical concepts, APIs, and modern software architectures. Specific familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or legal workflows is highly advantageous.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Technical Writing, or a related field. A JD is also accepted and encouraged.

About Galvanick

Galvanick protects the industrial world against cyber attacks. About The Role

We are looking for our first Head of Marketing. You will build the marketing function from the ground up and own everything from brand strategy and market awareness to lead generation and sales enablement.

Galvanick has a strong brand foundation, a differentiated product, and early traction with Fortune 100 customers and the U.S. Government. The OT security buyer community is small enough to reach and underserved enough to win. Your job is to make Galvanick the company that surfaces first when a COO asks their CISO, "who should we look at for OT security?" You will do this with a small team and an aggressive orientation toward AI-powered automation.

You will work directly with our CEO and Sales Team, and partner closely with our CTO and engineering leadership to translate deep technical expertise into narratives that resonate with enterprise security and operations leaders. Our technical team built Galvanick because existing solutions failed them firsthand. Your job is to turn that conviction and credibility into market awareness and sales leads.

What You Will Do

- Build brand awareness and market presence. Make Galvanick impossible to ignore within the OT security buyer community through thought leadership, event strategy, media, and analyst relationships.
- Build our lead generation engine. Design automated, multi-channel processes that identify and engage target accounts. Implement lead scoring that ensures our sales team focuses only on high-intent opportunities.
- Create intelligent nurture systems. Develop campaigns for Operations Leaders, Security Executives, and Technical Evaluators that adapt based on engagement patterns, with distinct messaging for each persona.
- Generate technical content at scale. Extract knowledge from our CTO and engineering team, then build systems to repurpose it across solution briefs, web content, blogs, social, video, and research.
- Partner with Sales. Create sales enablement materials and account intelligence that help close enterprise deals in the private sector and across the U.S. Government.
- Build a peer and customer advocacy engine. Buyers trust practitioners over marketing. Build systematic programs for customer references, peer review sites, and practitioner case studies that turn early wins into a credibility flywheel.
- Own AI-era discoverability. Structure our content and digital presence so Galvanick surfaces accurately when buyers use AI tools to research and compare OT security vendors.
- Deploy AI as infrastructure, not just tools. Architect intelligent systems that compound our capabilities, where one input produces many outputs.

Who You Are

- 8+ years of experience in B2B marketing with at least 3 years in a leadership role. You have a proven track record building marketing from scratch at Series A/B companies.
- Experience marketing complex technical products to enterprise buyers. You have generated pipeline for products with $100K+ ACVs and you understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
- A brand builder, not just a demand gen operator. You have built market awareness for a company that started with low name recognition and turned it into a category presence. You understand that brand and pipeline reinforce each other.
- Demonstrated success operating as a small team with limited resources. You know how to build systems that scale without agencies or large teams, delivering outsized results through AI, automation, and smart prioritization.
- Technically fluent enough to understand and communicate our value proposition. You do not need to be an OT security engineer. You do need to sit with our CTO, absorb a whiteboard session on detection philosophy, and turn it into a compelling solution brief.
- Data-driven with strong systems thinking. You make decisions based on metrics, build repeatable processes, and constantly optimize for efficiency and impact.
- AI-native in your marketing practice. You use AI tools across the full marketing workflow: content production, competitive intelligence, campaign personalization, and reporting. You think of AI as infrastructure that lets one person operate like a team.
- Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration. You thrive in environments where strategies evolve quickly and you build systems while simultaneously running them.

Bonus Points

- Experience marketing to both government and commercial sectors, understanding the different buying processes and messaging requirements.
- Background in cybersecurity, deep tech, or industrial/infrastructure technology markets.
- You have worked at a startup that scaled from Series A to Series C or a successful exit.
- Experience with account-based marketing to Fortune 500 enterprises.
- Familiarity with compliance frameworks like CMMC and the ability to speak to regulatory requirements.

Benefits

We provide top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, along with additional benefits designed to optimize every team member's health and wellness. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across various geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $140,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $200,000/year in our highest geographic market. Pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Galvanick is an early-stage startup and base salary is only one component of our compensation package. Depending on the position offered, equity may form a significant part of the compensation package, in addition to medical, financial, and other benefits.

Location

This role will be based in the United States and travel to various marketing and company events will be required. Remote US based candidates will be considered.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to US Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a US citizen, lawful permanent resident of the US, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the US Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

apply for this job

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

Flex is building its product marketing function from the ground up. We're looking for someone who can own how the market understands Flex — positioning, competitive narrative, and the “why us” story across our full product suite: reward card, credit card, banking, AP automation, expense management, AR/invoicing, working capital, and global payments.

This is a builder's role: you'll be the first dedicated owner of product marketing at Flex. Today, that work happens through ad-hoc conversations between Product and Sales leadership — there's no formal owner, no documentation (no formal case studies, external collateral, or internal knowledge repository), no consistent process, and no one dedicated to making sure something that ships well also lands well in-market. You're fixing this from zero, not inheriting a system someone else already built.

You'll partner closely with Revenue Leadership (Sales, Partnerships, CS, Support), Sales Enablement, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the story you build actually lands in the market. That story must resonate with our target audience no matter where it surfaces: in marketing campaigns, live deals, automated customer journeys, in-app experiences, and everywhere Flex shows up to a prospect or customer. You'll partner directly with Product early and often — bringing market, competitive, and customer signal into how we plan, sequence, and position what we ship — rather than writing about it after the fact.

What You'll Do

- Own go-to-market for everything Flex ships. Partner with Product leadership every quarter to bring market and customer signal into roadmap planning, and work together in defining what “ready to launch” means across all stakeholders; orchestrate between Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Support, and Ops as product updates and new releases are being built; create internal content (messaging, what it is, how it works, competitive positioning, etc.), then partner with Enablement to deploy revenue enablement programming that equips the teams prior to any launch. It's critical that you're comfortable holding the line with Product when something isn't positioned well enough to ship externally yet, or when there's misalignment with Revenue leaders and customer needs.

- Own Flex's competitive positioning end-to-end. Define the ICP across each of our product lines using real data, conduct market research, and leverage Apollo call-recording data to identify why we win — then translate that internally and externally so it holds together across our full product suite, in a market where Ramp, Brex, and Bill.com are all fighting for the same mental real estate. Run win/loss analysis and turn what you learn into real changes to messaging, internal battlecards, external collateral, and objection handling. When gaps are identified, proactively surface them with Revenue, Ops, and Product leadership so they can be evaluated and prioritized against the Product Roadmap.

- Give Lifecycle Marketing and Sales Enablement ready-to-go information, content, and messaging for their needs. Own all aspects of the written content and messaging used internally and externally: company narrative, value props, pains addressed, proof points (case studies, best-in-class client examples, relevant success-story statistics), where we lose, and objection handling that both teams pull from. Lifecycle turns this into campaign copy for email/SMS sequences; Sales Enablement incorporates it into the CMS, pitch materials, and training. You're the source of truth for what to say and why it's true.

- Take a data-first approach to determine how we prioritize launches and messaging, based on customer, market, industry, and product research you proactively conduct. Use data to inform your decisions — listen to real conversations with prospects and clients to understand how things are landing in the market, review win/loss data to understand why we win and identify GTM or product gaps, proactively research competitors to stay on top of what's new, and review tool-adoption data and identifycustomer examples so teams have data points to use on calls. This informs how you decide what pain-centered messaging, positioning work, competitive intel, and launches matter most given Flex's current stage — rather than waiting to be told.

- Be the internal expert and resource on how Flex is positioned in the market, our full product suite, and the owner of our launches. Become the SME on our value prop, who we serve, how we address market pains, why we win and lose, how we're differentiated, and everything about our product offerings (what they are, how they work, the value they provide, how customers use them). Beyond owning external messaging, you'll equip internal Revenue teams with what they need to succeed (in partnership with Sales Enablement), and brief Leadership and Product on what's changing in the competitive landscape, why it matters, and how gaps can be addressed via the Product Roadmap.

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

Flex is building its product marketing function from the ground up. We're looking for someone who can own how the market understands Flex — positioning, competitive narrative, and the “why us” story across our full product suite: reward card, credit card, banking, AP automation, expense management, AR/invoicing, working capital, and global payments.

This is a builder's role: you'll be the first dedicated owner of product marketing at Flex. Today, that work happens through ad-hoc conversations between Product and Sales leadership — there's no formal owner, no documentation (no formal case studies, external collateral, or internal knowledge repository), no consistent process, and no one dedicated to making sure something that ships well also lands well in-market. You're fixing this from zero, not inheriting a system someone else already built.

You'll partner closely with Revenue Leadership (Sales, Partnerships, CS, Support), Sales Enablement, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the story you build actually lands in the market. That story must resonate with our target audience no matter where it surfaces: in marketing campaigns, live deals, automated customer journeys, in-app experiences, and everywhere Flex shows up to a prospect or customer. You'll partner directly with Product early and often — bringing market, competitive, and customer signal into how we plan, sequence, and position what we ship — rather than writing about it after the fact.

What You'll Do

- Own go-to-market for everything Flex ships. Partner with Product leadership every quarter to bring market and customer signal into roadmap planning, and work together in defining what “ready to launch” means across all stakeholders; orchestrate between Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Support, and Ops as product updates and new releases are being built; create internal content (messaging, what it is, how it works, competitive positioning, etc.), then partner with Enablement to deploy revenue enablement programming that equips the teams prior to any launch. It's critical that you're comfortable holding the line with Product when something isn't positioned well enough to ship externally yet, or when there's misalignment with Revenue leaders and customer needs.

- Own Flex's competitive positioning end-to-end. Define the ICP across each of our product lines using real data, conduct market research, and leverage Apollo call-recording data to identify why we win — then translate that internally and externally so it holds together across our full product suite, in a market where Ramp, Brex, and Bill.com are all fighting for the same mental real estate. Run win/loss analysis and turn what you learn into real changes to messaging, internal battlecards, external collateral, and objection handling. When gaps are identified, proactively surface them with Revenue, Ops, and Product leadership so they can be evaluated and prioritized against the Product Roadmap.

- Give Lifecycle Marketing and Sales Enablement ready-to-go information, content, and messaging for their needs. Own all aspects of the written content and messaging used internally and externally: company narrative, value props, pains addressed, proof points (case studies, best-in-class client examples, relevant success-story statistics), where we lose, and objection handling that both teams pull from. Lifecycle turns this into campaign copy for email/SMS sequences; Sales Enablement incorporates it into the CMS, pitch materials, and training. You're the source of truth for what to say and why it's true.

- Take a data-first approach to determine how we prioritize launches and messaging, based on customer, market, industry, and product research you proactively conduct. Use data to inform your decisions — listen to real conversations with prospects and clients to understand how things are landing in the market, review win/loss data to understand why we win and identify GTM or product gaps, proactively research competitors to stay on top of what's new, and review tool-adoption data and identifycustomer examples so teams have data points to use on calls. This informs how you decide what pain-centered messaging, positioning work, competitive intel, and launches matter most given Flex's current stage — rather than waiting to be told.

- Be the internal expert and resource on how Flex is positioned in the market, our full product suite, and the owner of our launches. Become the SME on our value prop, who we serve, how we address market pains, why we win and lose, how we're differentiated, and everything about our product offerings (what they are, how they work, the value they provide, how customers use them). Beyond owning external messaging, you'll equip internal Revenue teams with what they need to succeed (in partnership with Sales Enablement), and brief Leadership and Product on what's changing in the competitive landscape, why it matters, and how gaps can be addressed via the Product Roadmap.

- Demonstrated GTM ownership: you've built positioning and messaging, launched products, and driven adoption — including at least one zero-to-one, “no existing function to inherit” experience, where you defined a Product ↔ PMM ↔ Stakeholder handshake from scratch

- Strong competitive intelligence instincts — you know how to build a battlecard that gets used on a live sales call, not filed away

- Strong instincts for what resonates in the market and in GTM — you can clearly separate the most important elements of an internal or external message from what's “fluff,” and you intuitively know the questions a new prospect, client, or CSM will ask about how something works, why it's built that way, and what objections will come up

- Proven experience partnering directly with Product on positioning, without a dotted-line PM relationship to lean on

- Excellent written communication — much of this role lives in documents (positioning frameworks, battlecards, briefs) that other teams execute directly against

- Comfort with ambiguity and zero-to-one building; you don't need an existing playbook or team to make progress

- Bonus: experience at a company without a dedicated marketing leader, where you had to establish process rather than inherit it

- Bonus: direct experience as a SaaS individual contributor (Sales, AM, CS) — ideally as a CSM — who intuitively understands what customers want and what internal employees need to know about a product to inform launch strategy

Why This Role Is Different

Most product marketing roles at this level either inherit an established function or slot into a larger marketing org with brand, demand gen, and content already in place. This one has neither yet — which means the person who takes it defines what “good” looks like for product marketing at Flex, with outsized influence on how we're positioned in market for years to come.

Search is being rewritten. Come lead the team doing it.

The way people find brands is changing faster than it ever has, and most agencies are scrambling to keep up. GR0 isn't.

We're one of the fastest-growing digital marketing agencies in the country, and we're hiring a Director of SEO & AI Search to own the evolution of our core service line. This is the role for someone who sees what's coming in search, has the chops to build for it, and wants to lead a team doing work that actually matters.

You'll have a real seat at the table. You'll own outcomes, not just tasks. And you'll have the resources, the team, and the client portfolio to prove what's possible when deep SEO expertise meets genuine AI fluency.

What this role actually is:

You're the head of SEO at a high-growth agency working with some of the most ambitious D2C brands in e-commerce. Your job is to make the department perform, scale, and stay ahead.

That means leading a talented team of SEO managers, driving retention and results across a diverse client portfolio, and being the person in the room who knows both the technical fundamentals and where the industry is going next.

You'll also be a builder. New processes, new capabilities, new revenue streams. If something isn't working, you fix it. If there's an opportunity no one has spotted yet, you find it.

What you'll own:

The team. Hire great people. Coach them well. Build a culture where high standards and psychological safety coexist. Weekly 1:1s are coaching sessions, not check-ins.

The clients. Senior voice on strategy calls, QBRs, and escalations. You know which accounts are at risk before they churn, and you have a plan ready before anyone asks.

The work. Full-funnel SEO strategies built on data: technical audits, content roadmaps, backlinking, digital PR, and cross-platform approaches spanning Google, Bing, Amazon, and beyond.

The business. Department P&L, capacity planning, tooling decisions, sales pitches. You're not just running a service line. You're running a business unit.

The future. AI search is not a side project. You'll lead GR0's point of view on generative engine optimization and make sure the team is ahead of every platform shift, not reacting to it.

Who we're looking for:

You have 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including 2+ years managing people, with agency experience that's non-negotiable. You've managed managers. You've owned a P&L. You've recovered at-risk campaigns and helped close new business.

But beyond the resume, you're the kind of leader who gets energy from building. You're curious about AI search, not intimidated by it. You know how to win over a C-suite client and how to give a junior employee feedback they'll actually use. You hold a high bar and people still want to work for you.

Required:

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, 2+ years in people management
- Agency experience (required, not preferred)
- Proven track record managing managers and leading high-performing teams, including offshore
- Deep expertise across technical SEO, content, and off-site disciplines
- Financial acumen with P&L ownership experience
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI's role in search and the future of discovery
- Strong executive presence: comfortable on pitch calls, client calls, and the conference stage

Preferred:

- Experience with D2C brands and performance marketing environments
- Prior success managing offshore talent across time zones
- Entrepreneurial background or history of launching new initiatives inside an agency or startup

What winning looks like here?

- Team members promoted from within. 1:1s never skipped. SOPs that the team actually uses.
- A department that's recognized, inside the agency and outside it, as the standard for what SEO looks like in the age of AI.

Hiring Process:

- Stage 1 — Recruiter Screen After submitting your application, our People & Culture team will review and reach out to selected candidates. During this 30-minute call, we'll get to know your career journey, professional motivators, and what excites you about GR0 — while giving you a full picture of who we are and what we're building.
- Stage 2 — Panel Interview You'll meet with members of our leadership team for a deeper dive into your background and experience. Expect to walk through your technical skills, people management approach, and how you think about strategy — and of course, share why you're excited about this opportunity at GR0.
- Stage 3 — Co-Founders Connect The final conversation is always our favorite. You'll get to connect directly with our CEO & Co-Founder, Kevin Miller, and our Chief Growth Officer & Co-Founder, Jon Zacharias. This is your chance to ask big questions, share your vision, and see if the feeling is mutual.
- Stage 4 — Offer If a #GR0mance has brewed  — we'll extend a competitive offer and hope you'll join the team!

What's in it for you?

- Shared Financial Success - GR0 believes strongly in equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one vehicle to achieve that. Annual compensation for this role is market competitive.
- Health and Family Benefits - GR0 offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options for GR0ers and their families.
- Wi-Fi Reimbursement - All employees receive a monthly reimbursement to help cover internet expenses while working.
- Unlimited PTO -We know that rest is vital to your well-being and career success, so we give you the flexibility and trust to take it when you need it.
- Paid Holidays - Take time to celebrate and rejuvenate with 13 fully paid holidays throughout the year.
- Community Impact -GR0 is committed to supporting the communities where we work and live by partnering with local charitable organizations to give back in various ways.

Please note: GR0 is currently able to hire in the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Iowa, Nevada, North Dakota, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wisconsin. Candidates must be based in one of these states to be considered for this role.

About Us

Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, GR0 is an award-winning digital marketing agency focused exclusively on igniting organic growth for direct-to-consumer and business-to-business startups and established brands. GR0 empowers these brands to build powerful online brands using a highly technical, best-in-class approach that delivers value and experience to consumers and engagement and sales for brands.

GR0’s notable awards and achievements include:

- Glassdoor’s “Top CEOs” (2021)
- Clutch’s “Top 100 Fastest Growing Companies” (2022)
- Comparably’s “Best Places to Work in Los Angeles” (2021, 2022)
- Comparably’s “Best Company for Career Growth” (2021)

- Okendo Partner Award for Top Marketing Agency, North America (2026)
