_At Gurobi Optimization, we're on a mission!_

A mission that focuses on mathematical optimization. We empower our customers to expand their use of mathematical optimization technology in order to make smarter decisions and solve some of the world's toughest and most impactful business problems. We're looking for passionate, dedicated, innovative game-changers to join our team and drive the future of Gurobi.

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Marketing Operations Manager to support and scale our global demand generation engine. Alongside the Marketing Operations Director, this role will serve as an operational backbone for the marketing organization, partnering closely with operations teams to optimize lead management, campaign execution, funnel performance, and marketing attribution.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in marketing automation, CRM processes, lead lifecycle management, and marketing analytics, with a strong understanding of how these capabilities work together to support an effective marketing organization.

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys building scalable systems, improving processes, and using data to drive operational excellence and more predictable pipeline growth within a high-growth B2B software environment.

What will you be doing?

Demand Generation Operations

- Partner with Demand Generation team to execute, optimize, and scale integrated marketing campaigns across digital, webinar, event, content syndication, and ABM channels.
- Build and manage campaign workflows, audience segmentation, nurture programs, and automation processes.
- Maintain campaign governance, quality assurance standards, and operational best practices.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide actionable insights to improve pipeline generation and conversion rates.
- Partner closely with operations to support organizational changes, territory realignments, and go-to-market initiatives through scalable routing and assignment strategies/processes using LeanData.

Marketing Automation & Martech Management

- Support the administration and optimization of Marketo, Marketo Measure, and related marketing technologies.
- Support governance, standardization, integrations, and data synchronization.
- Develop scalable program templates, tokens, operational workflows, and reporting frameworks.
- Partner with the Marketing Operation Director to evaluate and implement new marketing technologies and AI-powered workflows that streamline campaign execution, reporting, and operational processes.

Operations Alignment

- Work closely with operations to align marketing and sales processes, reporting, and funnel definitions.
- Optimize lead scoring, qualification, routing, lifecycle stages, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
- Ensure seamless handoff of leads between Marketing, SDRs, and Sales.
- Understand Marketo Measure attribution and how marketing contribution to pipeline, bookings, and revenue.
- Analyze funnel performance, channel performance, campaign ROI, conversion rates, velocity metrics, and attribution data.

Data Management & Governance

- Maintain high standards for data quality, compliance, segmentation, and database health.
- Partner with Operations and Data & Analytics to establish data governance policies and operational standards.
- Support deduplication, enrichment, normalization, and data hygiene initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and other applicable privacy regulations.

Process Optimization & Scale

- Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
- Document workflows, system architecture, and operational procedures.
- Cross-functional projects focused on improving marketing effectiveness and revenue generation.
- Collaborate on initiatives that leverage AI to improve forecasting, pipeline visibility, and revenue performance.

Qualifications:

- 4+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Operations, or a related role within a B2B software organization.
- Advanced expertise with Marketo, including administration, campaign operations, lead lifecycle management, and reporting.
- Strong Salesforce CRM experience, including lead, contact, account, opportunity, and campaign management.
- Deep understanding of demand generation programs and marketing funnel metrics.
- Hands-on experience with LeanData, including lead routing, account matching, territory assignment, and workflow optimization.
- Experience supporting complex sales organizations with multiple territories, segments, and routing requirements.
- Strong understanding of B2B software lead management best practices and opportunity lifecycle processes.
- Data quality, database health metrics, and data integrations experience.
- Familiarity with attribution platforms such as Marketo Measure and revenue intelligence tools.
- Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools, automation platforms, or advanced analytics solutions to improve marketing performance, operational efficiency, or decision-making.
- Experience partnering directly with Marketing and Sales leadership.

Your Alignment with our Gurobi Core Values:

- Customer Focus:Verbal & written communication skills that bring clarity and build trust.
- Power of the Team: Motivated with a team-oriented mindset that aims to both inspire and be inspired by others.
- Innovation:The courage to bring ideas forward and see yourself as an integral part of our global team.
- Dedication:Organized and agile, focusing on meeting professional objectives while promoting a healthy work/life balance.
- Integrity:Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility.

_Gurobi Optimization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law._

_Gurobi Optimization is an E-Verify employer. As part of our hiring process, we utilize the federal E-Verify program to verify the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For additional information regarding E-Verify, please visit www.e-verify.gov._

About Hive

Hive is the leading provider of cloud-based AI solutions to understand, search, and generate content, and is trusted by hundreds of the world's largest and most innovative organizations. The company empowers developers with a portfolio of best-in-class, pre-trained AI models, serving billions of customer API requests every month. Hive also offers turnkey software applications powered by proprietary AI models and datasets, enabling breakthrough use cases across industries. Together, Hive’s solutions are transforming content moderation, brand protection, sponsorship measurement, context-based ad targeting, and more.

Hive has raised over $120M in capital from leading investors, including General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. We have over 250 employees globally in our San Francisco, Seattle, and Delhi offices. Please reach out if you are interested in joining the future of AI!

Growth Marketing Lead Role

Hive is looking for an experienced manager to own and scale the Growth Marketing function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing and working closely with the broader executive team. As the lead of this critical but nascent practice, you will both be setting the top level acquisition strategy and be in accounts building and optimizing campaigns to accelerate Hive’s growth. This will be an individual contributor role to start, but we expect this person to hire and lead a team of 1-2 growth marketing specialists by the end of their first year.

Responsibilities

- Own the strategy, development, and optimization of growth marketing campaigns across paid and organic channels to generate awareness and high quality leads for Hive’s best-in-class AI solutions
- Collaborate across a network of internal (product, sales, design) and external (Ad reps) partners to align strategy, tactics, and goals
- Build and manage a continuous experiment pipeline to iterate on audience, creative (both ad + landing page), and channel strategies to unlock new opportunities and incremental improvements on existing campaigns
- Raise the creative bar, working with design as an expert in your channels to incorporate channel best practices, using experience and competitive research to inform approaches
- Measure and report on the performance of growth campaigns against internal targets (which you will set yourself) and competitor benchmarks (where available).
- Extract quantitative and qualitative insights to inform campaign strategy and share insights with other internal teams
- Set OKRs and hold quarterly / annual business reviews with executive stakeholders
- Report on program budget and ROI, and build business cases for increased investments where you can identify and validate new growth opportunities
- Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role
- Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets
- Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority

Qualifications

- 4+ years experience generating demand for technology products or services, ideally in the B2B/enterprise space
- Expert using various channels (Google Ads, LinkedIn, GDN, SEO / content marketing, email, in-product) and tools (SEMrush, Moz, GSC, etc) to move prospects through the buying journey and generate revenue
- Deep understanding of tracking and attribution (Google Analytics, GTM) with excellent analytical skills; able to craft actionable insights from complex data
- Mastery of hypothesis-guided optimization and A/B testing best practices; can build and prioritize a pipeline of ideas against finite resources
- Good design sense and experience partnering with internal and external creative partners on asset development
- Can thrive autonomously with sound judgment in a self-serve, ambiguous environment to build stakeholder relationships and ensure success of the program
- Biased towards speed - understands the opportunity costs of over documenting and over engineering campaigns in a fast paced, high growth startup environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to influence at all levels and match the audience / context

Nice to have:

- Technical background building ML models, experience marketing AI products, or a passion for AI technology
- Experience with website CMS, landing page, and personalization platforms
- Advanced reporting capabilities (Tableau, Google Data Studio or others)
- Design and media editing skills (Figma, Adobe Suite, Canva)

Don’t meet every qualification?  We encourage strong applicants to apply - we are looking for the right people, not just checking a box.

Who We Are

We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Hive, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.

Thank you for your interest in Hive and we hope to meet you soon!

The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $80,000 - $120,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here.

About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are

You are an experienced digital marketer with a strong foundation in campaign execution, digital marketing operations, and performance optimization. You enjoy translating marketing strategies into well-executed campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

You are highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously. You work collaboratively across Marketing, Product, Creative, Revenue, and Operations teams to execute marketing programs, continuously improve campaign performance, and deliver measurable business results.

You bring strong expertise across digital campaigns, marketing workflows, analytics, SEO, lifecycle marketing, and performance optimization. You are equally comfortable working at the strategic level and getting into the details when needed to ensure high-quality execution.

Digital Marketing Strategy & Campaign Ownership

- Own the execution plan and optimization of integrated multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned with business and marketing objectives.

- Support campaign planning by contributing ideas, customer insights, and performance recommendations.
- Assist in defining campaign objectives, audience targeting, messaging, and execution timelines.

Performance Marketing & Analytics

- Own campaign performance across key marketing KPIs, including ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, conversion rates, and engagement.
- Analyze campaign results and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Partner with Data and Analytics teams to develop reporting and performance dashboards.
- Present campaign insights and recommendations to marketing leadership.

Marketing Workflow & Operational Excellence

- Support the development and continuous improvement of marketing workflows.
- Identify process improvements that increase campaign efficiency and execution quality.
- Partner with Marketing Operations to improve campaign execution and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Creative, Revenue, Customer Success, Marketing Operations, and Analytics teams to execute integrated marketing initiatives.
- Lead coordination of  cross-functional activities to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
- Establish a system and cadence to communicate campaign status, dependencies, and results to key stakeholders.

SEO & Organic Growth

- Execute SEO initiatives, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO improvements, and performance monitoring.
- Partner with Content and Web teams to improve organic search visibility.

Customer & Lifecycle Marketing

- Support lifecycle marketing initiatives that improve customer engagement, onboarding, adoption, and retention.
- Use customer insights and behavioral data to optimize marketing campaigns and customer communications.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Stay current on emerging marketing trends, technologies, and AI capabilities.
- Recommend new ideas and optimization opportunities that improve campaign performance and customer experience.
- Share learnings and best practices within the Marketing team.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

- 8+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience leading and executing complex, multi-channel marketing initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
- Proven track record of improving campaign performance, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention through data-driven optimization.
- Strong experience with performance marketing, campaign analytics, marketing automation, CRM platforms, and customer journey optimization.
- Experience developing and executing SEO initiatives, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and organic performance reporting.
- Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional marketing initiatives by partnering effectively with Marketing, Product, Revenue, Creative, Operations, and Analytics teams.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
- Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced SaaS or technology environment is preferred.
- Proficiency with digital analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics/GA4), marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and project management platforms.
- Solid understanding of attribution models, funnel performance, conversion optimization, customer segmentation, and campaign measurement.
- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and well-supported recommendations.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

About the Team

The Marketing OS – LeadGen Team owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

The team is responsible for:

- Forms and form-building experiences

- Surveys and customer data-collection workflows

- Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences

- QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition

- Chat Widget and conversational lead capture

- External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties

- Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics

These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel's CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.

Why Join HighLevel?

- Ownership: It is never somebody else's job.

- Customer focus: We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.

- Speed: We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.

- Experimentation: Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.

- Growth: You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.

- People: We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.

Role Overview

As Senior Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen, you will help shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.

You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to evolve these products into a cohesive LeadGen experience that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition journeys, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel's CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data on your portfolio, partner with adjacent product teams on shared foundations, and help shape how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

Your Responsibilities

- Own the LeadGen roadmap: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.

- Build cohesive experiences: Drive consistency across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.

- Improve lead capture: Ship capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.

- Connect the customer journey: Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.

- Drive External Tracking: Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.

- Strengthen analytics foundations: Contribute to consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.

- Drive AI-assisted creation: Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.

- Improve cross-device experiences: Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.

- Partner on technical decisions: Work with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.

- Drive cross-functional execution: Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.

- Support go-to-market: Contribute to product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.

- Operate hands-on: Write PRDs and strategy documents, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.

- Own measurable outcomes: Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

Experience

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.

- Experience owning a customer-facing product or product area end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.

- Experience defining and executing a roadmap across multiple related product areas.

- Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.

- Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.

- Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.

- Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.

- Exposure to embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.

- Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.

- Experience partnering with Engineering on frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

- Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.

- Ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment without direct authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI- or LLM-powered creation, conversational, or optimization products.

- Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.

- Experience with first-party tracking, customer identity, attribution, consent management, or data governance.

- Exposure to high-volume event ingestion, real-time analytics, experimentation, or personalization systems.

- Experience building products for marketing agencies, SMBs, creators, or multi-location businesses.

- Prior experience working in a remote, globally distributed product organization.

Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 4 weeks and selling directly to consumers through its Galatea app. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Recently raising a Series C and backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into CandyJar is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for a top-tier Senior CRM Lifecycle Marketing Manager who is both a strategist and a hands-on executor, to drive exceptional revenue growth for our flagship apps, Galatea and CandyJar. This role is tailor-made for a CRM expert who thrives on data, analytics, and automation. You’ve mastered the advanced features of platforms like Iterable—going beyond high-level analytics to build sophisticated customer segmentation and automated, personalized lifecycle flows that drive revenue. You will lead the charge in analyzing current CRM data, testing customer segmentation, and planning and executing cutting-edge lifecycle campaigns that deliver personalized experiences and turn installs into loyal, paying subscribers.

Core Responsibilities:

- Audit & Strategy: Analyse current CRM data across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging for Galatea and CandyJar. Identify opportunities to enhance customer segmentation and personalization, and suggest optimizations and innovations that will drive revenue.

- Behavioral Segmentation & Content Targeting : Analyze user behavior and content performance data to define sophisticated audience segments. Leverage these insights to determine the optimal messaging and content strategy for each cohort, ensuring highly relevant and personalized touchpoints.

- Campaign Planning & Execution: Develop and execute campaigns with cutting-edge personalization automation that optimize conversion to paid customers, and drive renewals and winbacks.

- Roadmap Development: Work closely with the CRM Director to develop strategic roadmaps that leverage advanced segmentation and behavioral triggers to optimize existing campaigns and launch new initiatives.

- Technical Collaboration: Work closely with the tech team to implement personalization logic, dynamic content, and automated workflows that adapt to user behavior.

- A/B Testing & Optimization: Deploy a rigorous test-and-learn approach—designing, executing, and iterating A/B tests to maximize impact.

- Performance Analysis: Dive deep into CRM performance data to extract meaningful insights, refine targeting and messaging, and continuously optimize campaign effectiveness.

- Innovation & Market Leadership: Stay ahead of CRM trends, emerging tools, and best practices, ensuring our lifecycle marketing strategy remains cutting-edge and highly effective.

What You’ll Bring:

- Strong track record of scaling CRM programs within digital B2C businesses, directly driving revenue growth.
- Deep experience leveraging CRM platforms (e.g., Iterable) to build highly targeted audience segments and behavioral cohorts that drive conversion. You know how to go beyond standard demographics, using data to create hyper-relevant, personalized experiences at scale.
- You don’t just strategize—you own execution from start to finish, ensuring every campaign delivers measurable impact.
- Deep understanding of A/B testing methodologies and analytics tools with the ability to dig deep into data to understand next steps.
- Knowledge of SQL and ability to make your own queries.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with marketing, tech, and analytics teams.
- You continuously push for improvement, challenging assumptions, iterating fast, and delivering ever-stronger results.
- You move fast and are willing to roll up your sleeves and do it yourself to get the job done.

Who We Are Looking For:

- Autonomous
- Bring solutions instead of problems
- Highly data driven
- Quick to action
- A high functioning workaholic
- Looking for exponential career growth
- Have lots of fun building a generational AI x Entertainment company

What We'll Offer:

- 401k plan, designed to help you save for the future
- Health benefits tailored to your needs, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
- Professional coaching for everyone
- Team-building events, including our annual Tulum trip
- Unlimited access to our Galatea app and Galatea TV app
- Unlimited budget for self-development books
- Charity donation of your choice at your one year anniversary
- Free lunch in office everyday
- Class Pass membership for US based employee and gym access for Berlin employees
- Dog friendly offices in Berlin and San Francisco

$147,000 - $190,000 a year

Salary offers are determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and alignment with the requirements of the role, as well as internal equity and market benchmarks.

_At Inkitt, we strive to build a company culture and provide employment opportunities based on diversity and inclusion. We believe every author should have an equal opportunity to succeed, as should our team members. As a growing team from 20+ countries, we welcome everyone to apply._

We look forward to hearing from you!

Follow us on Instagram & LinkedIn! 💻

Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.

How We Work — please read this part carefully

Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas, and you will keep a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for your area — a new idea only enters by beating one already on it.

You pitch on a single slide with an impact calculation attached. Anything over a week of engineering needs a methodical business case demonstrating ROI. Ali rejects ideas that will not move the number enough to justify the build, and he does so often. The loop is pitch, get rejected, sharpen, re-pitch — continuously, alongside delivery.

Once approved, you own execution outright, including release and A/B ramping. Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it. Your performance is measured on two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

This is not a role where a roadmap is handed to you and you are judged on delivering it. If that is the job you are looking for, this will frustrate you, and we would rather you knew now.

What You'll Do:

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Inkitt’s marketing-technology and measurement ecosystem — the tooling, data, and signal infrastructure that powers paid user acquisition across Galatea, CandyJar, and Ironblood. This role is primarily about the technology behind paid acquisition. Lifecycle and CRM sit adjacent to it, not at the centre
- Own mobile attribution and measurement end-to-end (MMP, SKAdNetwork/AEM, Conversions API): ensure clean, trustworthy signal flows to Meta, TikTok, and other channels, and continuously improve signal quality to drive more efficient spend
- Build the measurement and experimentation backbone — incrementality/true-lift testing, event pipelines, audience and segmentation infrastructure, and the dashboards and observability the Growth team runs on
- Own the martech stack and integrations (attribution, CDP/event pipeline, campaign & lifecycle platforms, ad-platform APIs): build-vs-buy decisions, vendor selection, and the governance, QA, and release process that keeps it reliable
- Sit embedded with User Acquisition and Growth first, and with Lifecycle/CRM, Analytics and Engineering alongside them — translate their needs into a martech roadmap and ship the tooling that compounds performance over time
- Drive features and tooling through the entire product lifecycle: ideation, specification, development, release, analysis, and iteration
- Establish data quality, privacy-by-design, and observability so the business can trust its numbers and move fast
- Communicate your experiment roadmap, hypotheses, and results to team members and leadership; educate and influence cross-functional stakeholders to secure buy-in
- Perform quantitative and qualitative research to explore and validate opportunities

What You'll Bring:

- 6+ years of professional experience (we measure years on the job, not years holding a “product manager” title) in a fast-growing B2C consumer tech company, with mobile app experience
- Deep expertise in marketing technology and measurement: mobile attribution (AppsFlyer / Adjust / Branch), SKAdNetwork/AEM and Conversions API/CAPI, event pipelines/CDP, and performance measurement and incrementality
- Proven track record building measurement, experimentation, and martech tooling that made paid acquisition materially more efficient
- Exceptional analytical skills where you can quantify both qualitative and quantitative data to make product and strategic decisions — i.e. Advanced SQL skills
- Strong technical fluency — able to partner deeply with engineering on data pipelines, integrations, and tooling (hands-on data-engineering background a plus)
- Deep experience partnering with paid-UA teams; familiarity with paid-social, paid-search, and DSP/programmatic measurement. Lifecycle/CRM exposure is useful but secondary
- Self starter that can deliver results with limited supervision and thrives in a fast-paced, experimentation-driven environment
- Willing to roll up your sleeves to go above and beyond to make things successful, with a builder mentality and ownership mindset

Who We Are Looking For:

- Autonomous
- Bring solutions instead of problems
- Data driven
- Quick to action
- A high functioning workaholic
- Looking for exponential career growth
- Have lots of fun building a generational AI x Entertainment company

What We'll Offer:

- 401k plan, designed to help you save for the future
- Health benefits tailored to your needs, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
- Professional coaching for everyone
- Team-building events, including our annual Tulum trip
- Unlimited access to our Galatea app and CandyJar app
- Unlimited budget for self-development books
- Charity donation of your choice at your one year anniversary
- Free lunch in office everyday
- Class Pass membership for US based employees and gym access for Berlin employees
- Dog-friendly offices in Berlin and San Francisco

$190,000 - $225,000 a year

Salary offers are determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and alignment with the requirements of the role, as well as internal equity and market benchmarks. We are open to hiring this role at either Staff or Principal level. The posted range spans both. We calibrate level during the interview process based on the scope you have owned, and we will tell you where we have landed before we make an offer.

_At Inkitt, we strive to build a company culture and provide employment opportunities based on diversity and inclusion. We believe every author should have an equal opportunity to succeed, as should our team members. As a growing team from 20+ countries, we welcome everyone to apply._

We look forward to hearing from you!

Digital and Content Marketing Manager

Anywhere - US

Sales & Marketing – Sales and Marketing /

apply for this job

Istari Digital is a high-growth technology company enabling the next generation of AI-native engineering across aerospace, defense, and industrial enterprises. Our infrastructure platform orchestrates data across tools, organizations, and classification levels, removing barriers that limit digital engineering, and empowers customers to modernize mission-critical workflows and unlock meaningful ROI from digital transformation at scale.

As demand accelerates across commercial aerospace & defense, we are expanding our marketing organization to support execution of integrated, multi-channel demand generation programs, including the content that fuels them.

Position Overview

The Digital Marketing & Content Specialist leads content creation and digital campaign execution across Istari's marketing channels. This role partners closely with the Marketing Lead to translate messaging and campaign strategy into the content and campaigns that drive demand: emails, landing pages, digital ads, webinars, social media video clips.

You will write and produce campaign content, execute email, paid, social, and web campaigns end to end, and report on performance to inform what gets built next. You'll also turn raw material like event footage, employee and customer interviews, or podcast recordings into publish-ready content. Your work should ultimately be measurable against top-of-funnel pipeline impact.

The Marketing Lead owns marketing strategy, budget, and messaging across the business. The Field Marketing Manager owns field and in-person execution. The Digital Marketing & Content Specialist owns content creation and digital campaign execution, ensuring every email, ad, and landing page reflects Istari's brand and drives measurable results.

Together, these roles translate company strategy into consistent, coordinated go-to-market execution across every channel prospects encounter.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

_Content Creation_

- Write email copy, landing page copy, ad creative, and social captions consistent with brand voice across campaigns, including both ABM-targeted content for priority accounts and broader campaign content; source and design accompanying visuals

- Repurpose long-form content into social posts, email snippets, and sales one-pagers, helping a single piece of content reach further across channels

_Webinars_

- Plan and execute virtual webinars and livestreams, including identifying topics and audiences in coordination with the Marketing Lead, building registration pages, and managing promotion; send post-webinar marketing follow-up (recording, nurture emails) and pass attendee data to sales for outreach

_Social Media_

- Schedule and maintain the social content calendar so posting stays consistent, monitor engagement by responding to comments and DMs, and track performance metrics such as follower growth, engagement rate, and top-performing posts to understand what's resonating

- Edit short-form video clips from event footage, employee and customer interviews, and podcast episodes into social-ready posts, including trimming, captions, and formatting for platform specs

_Blog & SEO_

- Format and upload blog posts in Webflow, including sourcing and formatting supporting visuals, so content is publish-ready even when written elsewhere

- Manage on-page SEO fundamentals, including meta titles and descriptions, alt text, header structure, and internal linking, and monitor overall site health for issues like broken links, slow page speed, or indexing problems

_Email & Campaign Execution_

- Maintain email list hygiene, including segmentation, suppression lists, bounce and unsubscribe management, and list growth tracking; build and launch email campaigns and nurture sequences in the marketing automation platform, including sequences built specifically for ABM target accounts

- Build and publish personalized landing pages for campaigns and target accounts so the digital experience feels tailored rather than generic

- Support execution of paid social and paid search campaigns, including account-based targeting such as LinkedIn ABM ads aimed at specific target accounts

- Run A/B tests on subject lines, send times, and creative to continually improve campaign performance

- Set up and maintain UTM parameters and CRM tagging so campaign and ABM performance can be traced and reported on accurately

- QA every campaign before launch, checking links, formatting, personalization tokens, and mobile rendering to catch mistakes before real prospects see them

_Website_

- Make ongoing Webflow website updates, such as banner swaps and landing page edits, keeping the site current without needing a developer for every small change

_Reporting & Collaboration_

- Pull a monthly digital marketing summary covering social, blog, SEO, email, and campaign performance for the Marketing Lead's review

- Coordinate with sales on campaign-driven follow-up so leads generated by digital campaigns get timely attention, and support the Field Marketing Manager with content needs for field programs, such as event invite copy, signage, or one-pagers for a conference booth

Required Qualifications

_Experience_

- 1-3 years in content marketing, campaign execution, or demand generation

- Strong writing portfolio in email, web copy, or similar formats

- Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform

- Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot

_Skills & Capabilities_

- Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats

- Close attention to detail and strong organizational skills

- Comfortable working with data and basic reporting and analytics

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously

_Bonus Experience_

- Experience with HTML/CSS for email templates

- Familiarity with paid media platforms such as Google Ads or LinkedIn Ads

- Experience in aerospace, defense, or industrial technology

Why this role?

- Own content and campaign execution end to end at a high-growth technology company

- Get hands-on experience across writing, marketing operations, and paid media

- Work directly with the Marketing Lead on strategy and career growth

- Join a high-trust, mission-driven team building transformative technology

$96,600 - $160,000 a year

The anticipated compensation range for this position may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and business needs. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

About Istari Digital

Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Our platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels — whether they're designing prototypes, performing virtual testing, or training AI and autonomy for complex systems.

Focus is rewarded.  Finish is remembered.

Facts are friendly.  Even when they are not fun.

Fellowship is fundamental.  Make others successful.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Great email marketers don't just hit send. They test, learn, optimise and make the next campaign better.

That's exactly what we're looking for. Legend is hiring a CRM & Email Marketing Specialist to join our Gaming team in Bratislava.

You'll build and launch campaigns, experiment with new ideas and use real performance data to understand what works and what to try next. You'll get hands-on with Optimove while building your skills across automation, segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle CRM. And because we're still growing our CRM capability, you won't be stepping into a world where everything has already been figured out. You'll have space to test, improve how we work and see your ideas go live quickly.

You'll be joining a global Gaming business with ambitious growth plans and plenty of customer behaviour to get curious about.

Working in a small CRM team, you'll have the chance to make a visible impact on user experience and business performance across multiple brands, international audiences and significant user volumes.

Already worked in gaming? Great.

Haven't? That's not a dealbreaker.

If you know how to build great email campaigns in a B2C environment and want to take your CRM career further, we'd like to meet you. In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact:

- Build, QA and launch high-quality email and CRM campaigns, delivering consistently and at pace.
- Run A/B tests across messaging, creative, audiences and other campaign elements, using the results to continuously improve performance.
- Use campaign data and customer insights to understand what's working, identify opportunities and apply learnings to future campaigns.
- Support the development of automated customer journeys across onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation.
- Work with customer segments to deliver increasingly relevant and personalised CRM experiences.
- Brief high-quality creative assets, partnering with Design and other teams to bring campaigns to life.
- Track and report on campaign performance, translating results into clear recommendations and next steps.

What You'll Bring:

- Hands-on experience in CRM, email marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation or a similar role within a B2C environment.
- Fluent/professional working level in Slovakian and English
- Experience building and launching email or CRM campaigns yourself, with strong attention to detail and a clear understanding of campaign QA.
- Experience using a CRM or marketing automation platform such as Optimove, Bloomreach/Exponea, Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Xtremepush, Smartico or similar.
- A testing mindset. You're comfortable developing hypotheses, running A/B tests and using the results to improve future campaigns.
- Confidence working with campaign data, analytics platforms and spreadsheets, with the ability to interpret performance and turn insights into action.
- An understanding of the key ingredients of effective email creative and the ability to brief copy and creative requirements clearly.

Salary starts from €2000 per month

Why Legend?

- Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
- Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
- Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
- Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
- Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
- Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!

Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of global benefits, alongside local perks.

The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (45 minutes via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our General Manager (Marketing) and CRM Lead (60 minutes via Zoom)

3rd: Take-home case study and presentation with our General Manager (Marketing) and CRM Lead (90 minutes via Zoom).

4th: Final coffee chat in our Bratislava office with our Head of People

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com, and we'll do all we can to support you.

Every message, every renewal, every product recommendation, and every touchpoint is an opportunity to build trust, increase lifetime value, and create an exceptional customer experience.

As our Manager, Retention & Lifecycle Marketing, you’ll own the strategy and execution behind the customer journey from first purchase through long-term loyalty. You’ll combine customer insights, compelling creative, experimentation, personalization, and automation to deliver the right message to the right customer at the right time.

This is a high cross-functional role that sits within the Creative Strategy team. You’ll partner closely with Growth Marketinbg, Creative, Product, Customer Experience, Analytics, and Engineering to build best-in-class lifecycle programs that strengthen customer relationships while driving measurable business growth.

What You’ll Own

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategy across email, SMS, and other owned channels.

- Build and optimize automated customer journeys that improve engagement, retention, renewal rates, and customer lifetime value.

- Develop customer segmentation strategies that deliver personalized experiences at scale.

- Create testing roadmaps across messaging, creative, timing, offers, channel mix, and audience segmentation.

- Partner with designers, copywriters, and creative strategists to develop compelling lifecycle campaigns that strengthen customer relationships and increase revenue.

- Analyze customer behavior to identify opportunities to reduce churn, increase repeat purchases, and improve subscription retention.

- Lead lifecycle campaigns supporting onboarding, renewals, product launches, cross-sells, upsells, referrals, win-back initiatives, and loyalty programs.

- Monitor and report on key lifecycle metrics including retention, renewal rate, churn, repeat purchase rate, engagement, unsubscribe rates, and customer lifetime value.

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve customer communications, automation, personalization, and the overall customer experience.

- Continuously identify new opportunities to improve customer engagement through experimentation, data, and creative thinking.

What Great Looks Like

- You think beyond campaigns.

- You think in customer journeys.

- You understand that every message should have a purpose, and every interaction should strengthen the relationship between the customer and the brand.

- You're equally comfortable building strategy, reviewing creative, analyzing performance, and identifying opportunities hidden within customer data.

- You believe the best lifecycle marketing doesn't feel like marketing. It feels helpful, timely, relevant, and personal.

- You love testing ideas, measuring outcomes, and continuously improving the customer experience.

Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, CRM, email marketing, orcustomer marketing.

- Experience managing lifecycle programs for a subscription, DTC, e-commerce, consumer technology, or digital healthcare company.

- Strong understanding of customer segmentation, personalization, lifecycle strategy, and marketing automation.

- Experience building and optimizing automated customer journeys.

- Must have experience with Braze.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable marketing strategies.

- Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Exceptional written communication skills and an understanding of conversion-focused messaging.

- Comfortable managing multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Points

- Experience in telemedicine, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated industry.

- Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms such as Braze (certified), Iterable, Klaviyo, Customer.io, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

- Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel customer engagement.

- Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and customer research methodologies.

- Experience with analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Looker, Amplitude, or similar tools.

- Experience using AI tools to accelerate content creation, personalization, campaign optimization, and workflow efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

- Within your first year, you'll have built and optimized lifecycle programs that meaningfully improve customer engagement, subscription retention, and lifetime value.

- You'll create customer experiences that feel thoughtful, personalized, and seamless across every touchpoint.

- You'll become a trusted strategic partner across Creative, Growth Marketing, Product, and Customer

- Experience while helping build one of the most sophisticated retention programs in direct-to-consumer healthcare.

Why Join Us

- We're building a culture that values ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and measurable impact.

- If you're excited about building world-class lifecycle marketing, creating meaningful customer experiences, and driving long-term business growth through creativity and strategy, we'd love to meet you.

- Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance

- Complimentary daily lunch provided on-site

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Director of Demand Generation to own our inbound revenue number and the plan to grow it several times over in the next three years. You’ll drive leads across three channels: paid advertising (Google, LinkedIn), organic search and SEO, and AI-powered search and LLM visibility (GEO). You’ll report to the COO, and partner closely with our Sales and Marketing teams.

This is a builder role. You’ll own the strategy, run the channels, and build the agentic workflows that make the whole machine run more efficiently over time. Your success is measured in revenue, not pipeline or activity.

What You’ll Own

- Pipeline end to end: qualified leads across inbound and outbound channels, from first touch to sales handoff

- Paid advertising: Google Ads and LinkedIn, with full budget accountability and a bias toward what actually converts

- Organic search and SEO: making Meeting Tomorrow’s content and website attractive to Google and ranking for the terms that matter to our buyers

- LLM and GEO: growing Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search and recommendation environments

- Agentic workflows: building and managing the automations that drive campaign efficiency and compress time-to-pipeline

- Demand gen KPIs: CPL, MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, and CAC, with regular visibility to leadership

- Budget decisions: full accountability for how demand gen dollars are allocated, with the COO in the loop

Key Responsibilities

- Build and execute the demand generation roadmap, aligned to revenue targets and Sales priorities

- Own SEO strategy and execution: keyword targeting, on-page optimization, content signals, and technical SEO in partnership with the web team

- Manage paid media across Google and LinkedIn: campaign structure, targeting, creative testing, and budget allocation

- Develop Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) through GEO strategies

- Build and iterate on agentic workflows that automate repeatable marketing functions, from lead scoring to outreach sequencing

- Run A/B tests and side-by-side comparisons across channels to continuously improve performance

- Partner with Sales on lead handoff, pipeline review cadences, and feedback loops

- Ensure all outbound programs comply with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA

Who You Are

- You’re a builder. You see a gap, you close it. You don’t wait for someone to tell you how.

- You’re entrepreneurial about channels: when something works, you double down. When it doesn’t, you move on and find what does.

- You think in systems and automation. The goal is a demand gen function that compounds over time, not one that depends on you doing everything manually.

- You treat Sales like a partner, not an internal customer. Pipeline is a team sport.

- You can walk into ambiguity, build structure, and make progress without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook.

What You’ve Done

- Proven SEO expertise: you know how to make a website and its content rank. You’ve done it, you can show the results, and you understand the technical and content sides of the discipline.

- Hands-on experience building AI agents or agentic workflows: not theoretically familiar, not interested in learning. You have built at least one agent that automated something real and you can speak to what it did.

- A clear track record of digital lead growth tied to revenue: you can point to a channel you found or optimized and tell us what it made the business.

- Strong data fluency: you own your numbers, run your own analysis, and can walk leadership through your pipeline story without a deck full of caveats.

- Experience with paid media platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn) and marketing automation or CRM systems (HubSpot, Marketo, ActiveCampaign, or equivalent).

- Has carried a revenue number, not just a channel number — built a multi-year revenue model and defended the acquisition budget behind it to a CEO, board, or investor.

The Impact

Within 1 month, you’ll:

- Deeply understand the brand, business, and related goals.

- Run a full audit of existing programs, stack, and agent infrastructure to understand the foundation we are working from.

Within 3 months, you’ll:

- Create first agentic workflow live and tracked against pipeline KPIs

- Create a demand gen roadmap presented to leadership with agent strategy integrated

Within 6 months you’ll:

- Have measurable pipeline impact from agent-run programs with compounding momentum

Benefits

- Medical, dental, and vision plan options

- Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access

- 401k with employer matching up to 4%

- 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays

- Annual profit-sharing bonus

- 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)

- $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement

- Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell

- Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)

- Regular social events and learning opportunities

$140,000 - $186,001 a year

The above range is the starting salary range for this role. The final starting salary is based on individual experience and how closely it translates to the role. Once in the role, we offer annual merit increases based on performance.

The Digital Marketing Manager serves as a critical link between brand strategy, digital execution, and external agency partnerships. This role is responsible for running day-to-day digital marketing operations, leading relationships with digital agencies and third-party vendors, supporting brand and campaign strategy, and ensuring successful execution of marketing initiatives across channels.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of B2B marketing experience, agency expertise, strong project management skills, and a strategic mindset. This individual will help scale marketing efficiency by driving operational excellence, identifying the right partners and solutions, and ensuring alignment between brand objectives and digital execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Agency Management & External Partnerships

- Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for digital marketing agencies and external partners.
- Manage agency scope, deliverables, budgets, timelines, and performance expectations.
- Lead regular planning sessions, status meetings, and business reviews with agency partners.
- Evaluate agency performance and identify opportunities for optimization and increased efficiency.
- Ensure agency and vendor activities align with business goals, campaign priorities, and brand standards.

Vendor Strategy & Scoping

- Research, evaluate, and recommend third-party marketing vendors, technologies, and service providers.
- Develop requirements, scopes of work, and success criteria for vendor engagements.
- Manage RFP processes, vendor selection, onboarding, and contract support activities.
- Partner with procurement, finance, and legal teams as needed to support vendor relationships.
- Track vendor performance and ROI to advise future investment decisions.

Brand Strategy & Campaign Support

- Partner with brand, campaign, content, and product marketing teams to support coordinated marketing strategies.
- Ensure all digital marketing initiatives align with brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, and business objectives.
- Contribute strategic recommendations regarding audience targeting, content promotion, digital experiences, and campaign execution.
- Support the development of marketing plans that drive awareness, engagement, and demand generation.

Digital Marketing Operations

- Manage day-to-day digital marketing workflows, calendars, and operational processes.
- Coordinate campaign launches, asset delivery, approvals, and cross-functional execution activities.
- Ensure marketing programs are delivered on time, within budget, and according to established quality standards.
- Identify process improvements that increase team efficiency and operational effectiveness.
- Maintain documentation for vendors, agencies, workflows, budgets, and campaign activities.

Performance & Optimization

- Supervise key marketing, digital, and vendor performance metrics.
- Partner with agencies and internal stakeholders to analyze campaign results and identify optimization opportunities.
- Develop reporting and insights that help guide future marketing investments and strategic decisions.
- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging digital marketing best practices.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, or related field.
- Proven experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, agency account management, marketing operations, or integrated marketing.
- Experience working directly with marketing agencies, consultants, and third-party vendors.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including paid media, social media, email marketing, web, and content marketing.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience working in both agency and in-house marketing environments.
- Experience supporting brand strategy and integrated campaign planning.
- Experience with marketing automation, CRM platforms, analytics, and reporting tools.
- Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or B2B technology marketing.
- Experience managing agency contracts, scopes of work, and performance reviews.

Success Metrics:

- Agency performance against established KPIs and service-level expectations.
- Successful delivery of digital marketing initiatives on time and within budget.
- Stakeholder satisfaction across brand, campaign, and digital marketing teams.
- Effectiveness and ROI of third-party vendor relationships.
- Operational efficiency improvements and process optimization outcomes.
- Brand consistency across digital channels and campaigns.

Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Head of Marketing Operations

Role Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Head of Marketing Operations to lead the systems,

data, reporting and operational infrastructure that enables a high-performing global marketing

organization for its Intelligence Center X portfolio. This leader will oversee marketing technology,

reporting, analytics, tooling, procurement, system migrations and program management, ensuring the

marketing organization can operate effectively in a fast-paced, data and AI-driven, and highly matrixed

enterprise environment.

This role is both strategic and operational: helping to define how marketing runs, how performance is

measured, and how systems and processes scale across teams, regions and product units. This leader

will serve as the operational backbone of the marketing organization, partnering across Marketing,

Revenue Operations, Product, Finance, Procurement and IT to drive efficiency, visibility and execution

rigor.

Key Responsibilities:

• Marketing Systems & Tooling

o Own the marketing systems ecosystem, including core platforms, integrations,

governance and ongoing optimization

o Oversee marketing technology strategy and administration across systems, such as

Salesforce, Marketo, Qualified, Asana, and related reporting, automation and workflow

tools

o Ensure platform health, data flow, system reliability and scalable processes that support

campaign execution, lead management, brand management, lifecycle management, and

measurement

o Evaluate new tools and technologies, balancing business needs, scalability, integration

fit and operational complexity

• Reporting, Analytics & Measurement

o Own marketing operations reporting, dashboards and performance measurement across

pipeline, campaign effectiveness, lifecycle performance and operational efficiency

o Build a strong analytical foundation for the organization, including executive dashboards,

KPI frameworks and recurring business reviews

o Partner across Marketing, RevOps and Product/R&D to ensure consistent definitions,

data quality, attribution logic and reporting alignment

o Use data to drive recommendations on performance, investment allocation, process

improvements and strategic decision-making

• Processes & Program Management

o Oversee program management for major cross-functional initiatives, including marketing

operating rhythms, planning cycles, and enterprise-wide dependencies

o Bring structure and discipline to a complex, matrixed organization by clarifying

ownership, decision paths and execution models

• System Migration & Transformation

o Lead system migrations and major operational transformation initiatives, including

requirements, stakeholder alignment, implementation oversight, change management

and adoption, with minimal operational disruption

o Partner with IT, Procurement, Security and business stakeholders to ensure successful

delivery of system changes and integrations

• Leadership

o Serve as key operational partner to marketing leadership, RevOps, Finance, IT and

Procurement

o Help marketing translate strategic priorities into measurable plans, operating models and

systems requirements

o Ensure strong alignment across business segments, regions and shared services in a

highly matrixed environment

o Build, lead and develop a high-performing Marketing Operations team

o Establish clear priorities, service models and success metrics for the functions

Qualifications

Required

• 12–15+ years of experience in marketing operations or revenue operations in B2B SaaS or

enterprise technology

• Extensive leadership experience overseeing marketing systems, reporting, analytics and

operational process design

• Deep experience operating in a highly matrixed, enterprise environment with multiple

stakeholders and competing requirements

• Strong data and analytical background

• Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort working directly with data to validate reporting,

analyze performance and support decision-making

• Deep familiarity with Salesforce and Marketo, including integrations, lead lifecycle design and

reporting

• Strong venture management, procurement and budgeting experience

• Excellent communications skills and ability to influence across functions

$147,000 - $255,000 a year

Intelligence Center X is Siemens Digital Industries Software's agentic enterprise system, empowering companies to embed agents alongside people with the context, intelligence, orchestration and governance they need to deliver AI-driven business impact. Siemens Digital Industries Software helps organizations of all sizes digitally transform using software, hardware and services from the Siemens Xcelerator business platform. Siemens' software and the comprehensive digital twin enable companies to optimize their design, engineering and manufacturing processes to turn today's ideas into the sustainable products of the future. From chips to entire systems, from product to process, across all industries.

Senior Content Marketing Manager– Industrial B2B

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors – and lives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. We’re looking for someone who has built content programs that speak to these industries’ buyers. You will lead and manage the production of content that earns the trust of an executive level audience, that translates complex concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption.

You'll be building category-defining content: SME-driven insight pieces, research-backed reports, practitioner guides, webinars, and executive thought leadership ~~.~~ To be successful in this role, you should be curious, resourceful, process and outcome oriented, and eager to stay ahead of the market to make sure what we publish resonates and leads.

What You'll Do

Content

- Manage content across blogs/articles, long-form, video scripts, webinars, and social snippets tied to product capabilities, use cases, pipeline goals, and audience segments, including how-to guides, reports, solution briefs and white papers
- Manage relationships with freelance writers and agencies, ensuring quality and consistency across contributors
- Develop thought leadership programs for company executives, including ghostwriting, podcast prep, and byline articles for industry publications
- Partner with cross-functional marketing teams to translate positioning into always-on content programs that span the full buyer journey
- Collaborate with subject matter experts (customers, product managers, data scientists, developers, etc.) to produce accurate, credible, practitioner-grade content
- Identify content gaps by analyzing search intent, competitive coverage, analyst reports, and field feedback from sales
- Lead a scalable content framework that can support multiple technical personas
- Own the content repurposing motion: adapting high-performing assets across formats and channels to maximize the reach and shelf-life of every content piece produced

SEO & Distribution

- Support the development of organic content strategy: keyword research, topic clustering, and on-page optimization, with a focus on high-intent, bottom-of-funnel terms
- Partner with demand gen to integrate content into nurture tracks, paid amplification, and ABM programs
- Lead content distribution across owned channels (blog, newsletter, developer hub) and earned channels (syndication, guest posts, community forums)
- Ensure content is discoverable and well-positioned across both traditional search and AI-driven search/answer engines, adapting strategy as the discovery landscape evolves

Measurement & Optimization

- Track content KPIs: organic traffic, engagement, MQL contribution, pipeline influence, and content-assisted revenue
- Contribute to regular content audits; prune, update, and consolidate underperforming assets to protect domain authority
- A/B test headlines, CTAs, and formats; use data to iterate quickly and scale what works

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Serve as the content partner for product launches: owning the blog post, the launch email, the release notes narrative, and the sales one-pager
- Enable the sales team with content that maps to objection-handling moments, competitive comparisons, and proof points
- Coordinate with developer relations and community teams to amplify practitioner-generated content and surface customer stories

What We're Looking For

Required

- 7+ years of B2B content marketing experience, with at least 2 years
- Exceptional writing and editing skills. You can go deep on a technical topic and still make it readable for a VP
- Demonstrated ability to translate complex, highly technical concepts (data pipelines, cloud architecture, observability, security posture) into clear, compelling narratives
- Strong grasp of SEO fundamentals and experience driving measurable organic growth
- Proven track record collaborating with product marketing, PMMs, and engineers to ship accurate content on time
- Familiarity with the modern data stack or cloud security landscape (e.g. you know what a data lakehouse is)

Preferred

Experience marketing to developer, practitioner, or highly technical audiences at scale

- Hands-on experience with tools like Salesforce, Marketo, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and CMS platforms (WordPress)
- Portfolio of published technical content (e.g. long-form guides, whitepapers, or bylines in industry publications)
- Strongly process-oriented; comfortable both following established workflows and building new ones; fluent with AI writing and research tools, and experience using AI to automate workflows

$102,500 - $184,500 a year
