Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

- SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

- SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

- SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

- Committed to our customers and community.

- Obsessed with quality.

- Deliberate in our decisions.

- Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar.

This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts.

What you will do

- Own ABM strategy and account selection: Define and run Sonar’s account-based marketing strategy across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many tiers — partnering with sales to select, segment, and prioritize target and expansion accounts based on fit, intent, and opportunity.

- Build and execute multi-channel account plays: Plan, build, and continuously optimize personalized campaigns across paid (e.g., LinkedIn, display, and ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase), email, web personalization, direct mail, and content — tailored to each account’s buying stage and stakeholders.

- Align marketing and sales: Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the account teams — co-developing account plans with AEs and SDRs, equipping them with the right messaging and assets, and coordinating outbound and marketing touches into a single, orchestrated motion.

- Define and optimize the ICP: Partner with product marketing and sales to define, refine, and continuously optimize Sonar’s ideal customer profile — using performance data, intent signals, and win/loss insight to sharpen account selection and targeting.

- Leverage intent and engagement data: Use intent signals, engagement scoring, and account analytics to identify in-market accounts, prioritize outreach, and trigger the right plays at the right moment.

- Drive pipeline and expansion: Generate and accelerate qualified pipeline within target accounts and expansion within existing customers — tracking engagement, opportunity creation, and influenced pipeline against clear goals.

- Measure and report on impact: Define and own ABM metrics — account engagement, pipeline contribution, velocity, and ROI — and deliver regular reporting with clear, data-driven recommendations to refine targeting and spend.

- Partner cross-functionally on content and messaging: Work with product marketing and content teams to develop account- and persona-specific messaging, assets, and experiences that resonate with technical and executive buyers.

- Collaborate on field and event programs: Partner with field and demand gen teammates to integrate ABM into events, executive roundtables, and webinars that engage priority accounts and convert into pipeline.

- Manage budget and vendors: Allocate and steward the ABM budget for maximum return, and manage ABM platform, data, and agency vendors to ensure quality execution.

Experience and qualifications

- Have 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on account-based marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns — preferably within enterprise SaaS or technology.

- Bring a proven track record of planning and executing ABM programs (one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many) that engage target accounts and drive measurable pipeline and expansion.

- Have hands-on experience with ABM and intent platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and an understanding of how to operationalize account data and intent signals.

- Have strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, optimize spend, track account engagement and pipeline, and report on ROI across channels.

- Be experienced partnering closely with sales and SDR teams to align on account strategy, plays, and follow-up.

- Be proficient with marketing automation tools and CRM systems (e.g., Marketing Cloud, Salesforce).

- Be familiar with paid media and digital channels relevant to ABM, including LinkedIn and programmatic display.

- Be highly organized and able to manage and prioritize multiple programs, accounts, and stakeholders simultaneously and independently.

- Have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments and functions.

- Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA a plus).

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com.

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

- Manage tool integrations: Ensure data flows correctly between marketing platforms, CRM, and analytics systems — working with technical stakeholders to maintain clean, reliable data across the stack.

- Partner on AI and automation: Work closely with the Marketing AI Engineer to identify automation opportunities, provide business context for workflow design, and champion adoption of AI-powered capabilities across the marketing team.

- Manage budgets and vendors: Own the marketing technology budget, manage vendor contracts and renewals, and negotiate to maximize value for the business.

Experience and qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

- Have 4+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, or revenue operations — preferably within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

- Have a strong understanding of how marketing tools integrate with CRM systems (Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms.

- Be skilled at translating business requirements into technical configurations and working with engineering or IT teams to implement them.

- Have experience designing workflows and creating training materials that drive adoption across non-technical teams.

- Be data-driven — comfortable building dashboards, analyzing tool utilization data, and presenting ROI findings to marketing leadership.

- Be highly organized and capable of managing multiple tools, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously.

- Have strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally across marketing, IT, RevOps, and finance.

This isn't about crafting a 3-second Gen-Z hook for TikTok,it's about earning emotional trust with a mature audience on Tier-1 markets with an exceptionally long customer lifetime, a fundamentally different creative challenge than most of the market faces. Our web2web, credit-based monetization model runs on different funnels, different logic, and different insights than the mobile-subscription products most competitors build, and your work will plug directly into a UA team already managing $300K+ per month with a clear path to $1M+, so every hypothesis gets tested against real volume, fast. You'll make decisions without red tape, own the creative direction end-to-end, and build a team of 6 creative marketers and designers over the next 3–6 months in a place where 70% of our heads and leads have grown from within

About our product: We have created an international web platform that's genuinely changing how people connect in Tier-1 markets: 1 million users across the USA, Canada, and UK trust us for meaningful relationships that go beyond surface-level matching! Since 2020, we have been the platform for people seeking real connections. Our users enjoy 24/7 communication, seamless content sharing, and a completely ad-free experience. We have found our sweet spot in performance and intuitive design that keeps people engaged and actually connecting with each other. So, you will be part of an ambitious journey toward our clear goal: becoming one of the Top-5 international social networking platforms globally. We are already succeeding in our current markets, and now we are ready to bring that same thoughtful approach to worldwide scale.

In this role, you will

- Own the end-to-end creative strategy across paid channels, starting with Meta and expanding into Snapchat, TikTok, and Google, in close partnership with the UA team

- Run the full creative cycle: research, insight, hypothesis, brief, production, launch, analysis, and iteration

- Generate original creative concepts, narratives, angles, and messaging tailored to different audience segments, not just hooks

- Build and evolve a creative testing methodology, from hypothesis design to clean test execution and pattern recognition

- Hire, lead, and grow a team of 6 creative marketers and designers, setting quality standards and giving hands-on feedback

- Track competitors and trends through Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, and Google Ads Transparency Center, turning observations into prioritized creative bets

- Embed AI tools into the creative production pipeline to increase testing speed and volume

It's all about you

- 3+ years in creative marketing, performance creative, or creative strategy, including 1+ year leading or mentoring a creative team
- Strong performance background and a direct-response mindset – you know why a creative works, not just that it does
- Hands-on experience scaling creatives for Meta as a primary channel, plus practical experience with Snapchat or TikTok Ads
- Fluency in creative metrics (hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop rate, creative win rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) as everyday decision-making tools, and a clear view of how creative connects to registration, first purchase, revenue, and LTV
- A track record of concepts you personally scaled, backed by real numbers
- Daily, practical use of AI tools for creative generation and research (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Pika, HeyGen, Krea, or similar), with your own workflows or prompts you can walk us through
- Upper-Intermediate English (B2+)

Would be a plus

- Experience in social discovery or social networking niches, and familiarity with credit-based or transactional monetization models
- Background in User Acquisition or video production (shooting, editing, directing)
- Experience hiring creative marketers or designers and building AI-driven production pipelines or automations (n8n, Make)

What we offer

Care and support:

- 20 paid vacation days, 15 sick leave days, and 6 additional days off for family events

- 100% medical insurance coverage

- Sports and equipment reimbursement

- Team building events, corporate gifts, and stylish merch

- Financial and legal support

- Maternity Recovery Support Allowance

- Position retention and support for those who join the Armed Forces of Ukraine

- Participation in social initiatives supporting Ukraine

Comfortable working environment:

- Work from our Kyiv hub or remotely with a flexible schedule

- Modern equipment or depreciation of your own tools

Investment in your future:

- Collaborate with a highly-skilled team of Middle & Senior professionals, sharing practical cases and expertise in the social networking niche

- Performance-oriented reviews and Individual Development Plans (IDPs)

- Reimbursement for professional courses and English classes

- Corporate library, book club, and knowledge-sharing events

- AI is an integral part of our work culture. We invest in modern AI tools, equip our teams with the skills to use them effectively, and foster an environment where technology helps people achieve better results faster

- Test Task/Workshop

Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. Take full ownership of vivenu’s organic growth strategy — combining deep SEO expertise with emerging GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) capabilities. You’ll define and execute how vivenu becomes visible, relevant, and influential across global markets, traditional search, and new generative discovery platforms.

As Senior SEO, GEO & Content Strategy Manager (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:

- Owning and evolving vivenu’s global SEO and GEO strategy to drive measurable organic growth and high-intent enterprise pipeline.

- Partnering cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Design, and Engineering to embed SEO/GEO criteria into every campaign and feature launch.
- Experimenting with AI-assisted tools and next-gen search workflows to continuously scale our organic reach.
- Analyzing performance data and technical health metrics, translating insights into actionable improvements that boost rankings and conversion rates.

What you will need to succeed in this role:

- 5+ years of experience in technicalSEO or organic growth, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.
- Proven success in scaling organic visibility and improving keyword performance in competitive markets.
- Strong analytical mindset and proficiency with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, etc.).

Live Entertainment Tech

Sustainable Growth

Fast Growing, in All Aspects

Next-Gen Leaders & Insights

At Wave, we help small businesses to thrive so the heart of our communities beats stronger.  We work in an environment buzzing with creative energy and inspiration. The mark of true success at Wave is the ability to be bold, learn quickly and share your knowledge generously.

The Senior Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for owning the execution, optimization, and operational excellence of Wave’s customer marketing automation programs across email, in-product, and push channels.

Working closely with Lifecycle and Product Marketing, Growth, Product, Data and other cross-functional partners, this role translates customer and business strategies into sophisticated, scalable automated journeys that drive activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and expansion.

This role serves as the subject matter expert in marketing automation, campaign orchestration, testing, and measurement —  ensuring our customer communications are highly targeted, personalized, measurable, and continuously optimized.

Here's How You Make an Impact:

- Own the execution and optimization of automated customer journeysacross email, in-product and push channels — from audience creation and build through QA, launch, monitoring and continuous improvement.

- Leverage Braze, Segment and Amplitude to turn customer data into action, using behavioral insights, product usage and lifecycle signals to build targeted audiences, trigger personalized journeys and identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, conversion and retention.

- Translate lifecycle strategies into scalable automation programs, partnering with Lifecycle, Product Marketing and Growth to determine the right audience, message, channel, timing and journey logic.

- Drive experimentation and optimization through A/B and multivariate testing across messaging, creative, targeting, timing, cadence and journey design, turning results into actionable recommendations.

- Own campaign performance and measurement, monitoring lifecycle and channel KPIs and partnering with Data & Analytics to understand customer behavior, measure impact and uncover opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure the health and scalability of our marketing automation ecosystem, maintaining strong standards for QA, deliverability, data integrity, consent, documentation and campaign governance.

- Serve as the marketing automation subject matter expert, partnering with Product, Data and Engineering to define the customer events, attributes and integrations needed to enable increasingly sophisticated segmentation, personalization and automation.

You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:

- 5+ years of experience in marketing automation, lifecycle marketing operations, CRM, or a related discipline, ideally within a SaaS, fintech, subscription, or product-led growth environment.

- Advanced hands-on experience with Braze, including building multi-step journeys, audience segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, and experimentation.

- Experience working with Segment and Amplitude, with the ability to use customer and product behavioural data to inform segmentation, journey design, and lifecycle optimization.

- Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing across onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, expansion, and re-engagement.

- Strong analytical and experimentation skills, with experience designing tests, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into actionable recommendations and optimizations.

- Strong knowledge of email, push and in-product messaging best practices, including deliverability, consent management, frequency management, and customer experience.

- Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and Liquid templating; with the ability to troubleshoot personalized, dynamic communications.

- Strong operational discipline and attention to detail, particularly across campaign QA, data accuracy, documentation and governance.

- A collaborative, self-directed approach, with the ability to independently own execution while partnering effectively with Growth, Product and Lifecycle Marketing teams, Data, Product and Engineering.

$85,000 - $105,000 a year

Final compensation is determined based on experience, expertise, and role alignment. Most candidates are hired within the middle of the range, with the upper end reserved for those bringing exceptional depth, impact, and immediate autonomy.

We also offer:

- Bonus Structure
- Employer-paid Benefits Plan
- Health & Wellness Flex Account
- Wellness Days
- Paid Holiday Shutdown
- Wave Days (extra vacation days in the summer)

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Veeva Crossix Sales team is looking for a skilled Account Partner (Marketing Analytics) to drive sales within our media measurement and optimization business to Life Sciences companies.  As an Account Partner, you will be responsible for aligning customer objectives with the Veeva Crossix marketing analytics solutions, including the Crossix Measurement Suite.

To be successful in this role, you must be strong at communicating across various business functions, organizational levels (including C-level), and brand marketing departments. Creativity, initiative, and the ability to work effectively within a growing team are critical.  You are also someone who is humble, hungry, and smart  –  you put the success of the team ahead of your own; you have a relentless drive to do what it takes to succeed, and you find a way to overcome obstacles and solve business problems.

What You'll Do

- Develop a thorough understanding of Crossix offerings, competitive advantages, and processes. Learn to articulate them persuasively to prospects and customers
- Develop strong and mutually valuable relationships with new and existing customers
- Manage pipeline with CRM tools for maximum efficiency and visibility, with carefully executed follow-up to closure
- Work in close partnership with Client Services to manage successful client deployments and to ensure ongoing high client satisfaction, renewal, and deep penetration of customer organizations for incremental business
- Keep current with industry trends; engage your customers, address their business challenges, and propose solutions

Requirements

- Passionate about healthcare with a strong interest in pharmaceutical marketing. You feel a strong connection to our mission and will work hard to ensure customer success
- As an educator and business consultant; you love teaching clients about how they could maximize their potential working with us.
- Demonstrated development of meaningful partnerships with a diverse client base and proven track record as a trusted advisor to brands
- Highly organized with a firm grasp of your business - you accurately log all sales activity and prospecting in SFDC with speed and accuracy
- Understanding of the digital media/marketing landscape with the ability to credibly articulate strategic insights for clients that are based on data and research
- A fast learner, you love to stay at the forefront of an ever-evolving industry
- A creative problem solver - you stay cool under pressure and thrive in an atmosphere of change
- At least 3 years experience in selling technology, marketing, pharma data/insights, or media solutions in the life sciences industry or closely related field
- Proven track record of exceeding sales goals while contributing to the success of the team
- Strong understanding of digital media and ad tech ecosystem
- At least 5 years of overall business experience in sales, business development, or account management preferably in digital advertising, technology businesses, and healthcare data/consulting
- Eagerness to work in a startup team environment that will be rapidly changing
- BS or BA degree is required

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
1. A conversation with the hiring manager
2. A practical case exercise
3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
- Retirement programs
- 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

- Base pay: $80,000 - $300,000
- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate - New Channels | Acorns

Acorns is looking for a curious, driven Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to join our team and help expand our paid acquisition channel mix. You will work closely with the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager to research, launch, and scale emerging platforms—from programmatic DSPs to community-based channels like Reddit—driving user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early.

This role carries real ownership. You’ll operate with meaningful day-to-day autonomy, exercise judgment within established frameworks, and produce analysis and recommendations that shape how we invest in new channels. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Analytics, Creative, and channel partners to bring experiments to life and move quickly from proof of concept to scaled channel.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do

Channel Testing & Execution

- Help develop and execute a structured testing roadmap for new and emerging paid media channels, including programmatic display, Reddit, Snapchat, and other alternative platforms.

- Own day-to-day campaign management across existing channels like Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, and YouTube

- Run tests on new channels, including setup, trafficking, pacing, and ongoing optimization.

- Use performance data and judgment to make in-channel optimizations, escalating broader strategic decisions to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager as needed.

- Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ad assets tailored to each platform and audience.

Measurement & Reporting

- Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, collaborate with the Analytics team to design the test structure, and own the launch and ongoing performance monitoring of each experiment.

- Track and report on key performance indicators for new and existing channel initiatives, translating data into clear summaries for internal stakeholders.

- Maintain organized records of test results, learnings, and optimization actions to build a shared knowledge base for the team.

Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support acquisition growth across our brand portfolio—Acorns and Acorns Early.

- Work collaboratively with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to execute experiments efficiently and surface actionable insights.

- Actively monitor the AdTech landscape—including gaming platforms (e.g., Roblox, Discord), community platforms, and emerging programmatic DSPs—and bring forward channel opportunities for the team to evaluate.

What You Will Bring

- 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, or growth marketing with a BS/BA; or equivalent work experience.

- Hands-on experience with at least one paid media platform (e.g., Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, The Trade Desk, or similar).

- Familiarity with mobile measurement platforms (e.g., Adjust, AppsFlyer) and an understanding of how attribution frameworks inform paid media decisions. Exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is a plus.

- A data-driven mindset—you’re comfortable working with performance data and translating numbers into clear, actionable takeaways.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you follow processes carefully, flag questions early, and aren’t afraid to modify your approach when the situation calls for it.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills—you can summarize experiment results and share channel recommendations in a way that’s easy for stakeholders to act on.

- Genuine curiosity about where digital advertising is heading and a hunger to explore channels competitors aren’t using yet.

- A belief that your work is connected to something bigger—helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do at Acorns, and we want teammates who are energized by that mission.

_You are not expected to have experience with every platform listed. If you’re passionate about Acorns’ mission and eager to grow in performance marketing, we encourage you to apply._

What we offer:

- Competitive salary and stock options

- A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family

- Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off

- 401(k) matching

- Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family

- Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth

- Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)

- Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders

- Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events

- Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.

- The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.

About Acorns:

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people, and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.

Compensation Information:

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between 75,000-111,500/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity grants, and discretionary cash bonus awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Work Authorization:

Acorns participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information about E-Verify, please visitwww.e-verify.gov.

You'll also play a critical coordination role across the broader paid marketing team, keeping campaigns on track from planning through launch.

CTV & Podcast Channel Ownership

- Partner closely with Analytics to design and launch incrementality and lift studies, translating results into clear optimization actions and investment recommendations.

- Balance brand-building and performance objectives within each channel, maintaining a clear view of how both contribute to CAC goals and overall growth targets.

- Act as the integrated planning coordinator across the paid marketing team, ensuring all paid initiatives are accounted for and aligned when launching new creatives, brand campaigns, or promotional moments.

- Own and maintain workback schedules for paid campaign launches, proactively flagging risks, keeping stakeholders informed, and ensuring deadlines are met.

- Coordinate creative requests across channels, ensuring assets are briefed, approved, and delivered on time for campaign launches.

- Partner with Analytics and channel managers to confirm tracking is scoped, implemented, and QA'd ahead of every launch.

- Serve as a central point of communication across paid marketing, creative, analytics, and other cross-functional partners to keep campaigns moving efficiently.

- 3–5 years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, with direct, hands-on experience running CTV and/or Podcast campaigns against performance KPIs.

- Deep familiarity with the CTV ecosystem—including streaming platform dynamics, publisher relationships, and measurement approaches—with the ability to evaluate inventory quality and targeting strategies.

- Experience managing Podcast media across host-read, produced, and programmatic ad formats, including dynamic ad insertion, publisher partnerships, and podcast-specific attribution methodologies.

- Demonstrated ability to manage agency relationships, set clear expectations, and drive performance accountability.

- Strong analytical foundation—comfortable designing and interpreting incrementality studies, MMM inputs, and channel-level performance reporting, and translating data into clear recommendations.

- Proven project management and coordination skills; you build workback schedules, keep stakeholders aligned, and proactively resolve blockers before they become problems.

- Experience working cross-functionally with creative, analytics, and external agency partners to bring campaigns from brief to launch.

At Acorns, our mission is to look after the financial best interests of the up-and-coming, beginning with the empowering, proud step of micro-investing. How do we accomplish our mission? Our values.

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate – Emerging Media & Planning | Acorns

Acorns is looking for a strategic, hands-on Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to own our CTV and Podcast channels and serve as the connective tissue for integrated media planning across paid initiatives. You'll operate as a single-threaded owner for two of our most important emerging channels—managing agency relationships, leading performance-driven tests, and ensuring best-in-class creative execution. You'll also play a critical coordination role across the broader paid marketing team, keeping campaigns on track from planning through launch.

This role is equal parts strategist and executor. You'll bring deep channel expertise in CTV and Podcasts, a sharp analytical mindset, and the organizational discipline to keep cross-functional campaigns moving. You thrive in environments where you own outcomes, not just tasks.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do

CTV & Podcast Channel Ownership

- Serve as the single-threaded owner for CTV and Podcast paid media, owning strategy, execution, and performance end-to-end.

- Manage and cultivate relationships with CTV and Podcast agencies, acting as the primary day-to-day point of contact and holding partners accountable to performance and delivery standards.

- Develop and execute structured testing roadmaps across both channels—spanning audience targeting, creative formats, publisher mix, and buying strategies.

- Partner closely with Analytics to design and launch incrementality and lift studies, translating results into clear optimization actions and investment recommendations.

- Ensure creative excellence across CTV and Podcast placements—briefing channel-specific assets, providing feedback rooted in both brand standards and performance KPIs, and iterating quickly based on test learnings.

- Balance brand-building and performance objectives within each channel, maintaining a clear view of how both contribute to CAC goals and overall growth targets.

Integrated Media Planning & Campaign Coordination

- Act as the integrated planning coordinator across the paid marketing team, ensuring all paid initiatives are accounted for and aligned when launching new creatives, brand campaigns, or promotional moments.

- Own and maintain workback schedules for paid campaign launches, proactively flagging risks, keeping stakeholders informed, and ensuring deadlines are met.

- Coordinate creative requests across channels, ensuring assets are briefed, approved, and delivered on time for campaign launches.

- Partner with Analytics and channel managers to confirm tracking is scoped, implemented, and QA'd ahead of every launch.

- Serve as a central point of communication across paid marketing, creative, analytics, and other cross-functional partners to keep campaigns moving efficiently.

What You Will Bring

- 3–5 years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, with direct, hands-on experience running CTV and/or Podcast campaigns against performance KPIs.

- Deep familiarity with the CTV ecosystem—including streaming platform dynamics, publisher relationships, and measurement approaches—with the ability to evaluate inventory quality and targeting strategies.

- Experience managing Podcast media across host-read, produced, and programmatic ad formats, including dynamic ad insertion, publisher partnerships, and podcast-specific attribution methodologies.

- Demonstrated ability to manage agency relationships, set clear expectations, and drive performance accountability.

- Strong analytical foundation—comfortable designing and interpreting incrementality studies, MMM inputs, and channel-level performance reporting, and translating data into clear recommendations.

- Proven project management and coordination skills; you build workback schedules, keep stakeholders aligned, and proactively resolve blockers before they become problems.

- Experience working cross-functionally with creative, analytics, and external agency partners to bring campaigns from brief to launch.

- A belief that your work is connected to something bigger—helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do at Acorns, and we want teammates who are energized by that mission.

About Acorns:

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people, and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.

Compensation Information:

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $94,000-$108,000; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, equity grants, and discretionary cash bonus awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

About Atlas

At Atlas, we believe the financial system should work for everyone. We’re building a modern rewards credit card and banking platform designed to grow with our members - helping them build credit on autopilot with 0% APR, no late fees, and premium rewards. By replacing harsh penalties with empathy and smart technology, we are making stress-free financial progress accessible to millions.

We are a product- and technology-obsessed team with roots at Facebook, Amazon, Robinhood, and Uber. If you’re ready to build a high-impact product that democratizes opportunity and accelerates financial empowerment, join us.

About the role

We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to design and optimize the programs that engage, retain, and grow our members across their entire journey with Atlas, from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention, with a clear focus on driving engagement, retention, and user lifetime value (LTV).

We want a marketer with experience building targeted campaigns across all channels we own (email, SMS, in-app messages, push) and connecting those touchpoints to the broader, lifecycle goals that shape how members experience Atlas. You’ll turn performance data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business, and you’ll use AI tools to drive efficiency and output.

_This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco. Team members are expected to come into the office two days a week._

What you’ll do

- Own post-activation lifecycle strategy: from onboarding to long-term retention, building targeted campaigns that drive engagement, retention, and member LTV.

- Turn segments into personalized campaigns: define the segments that matter and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across multiple channels.

- Continuous experimentation: data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications

- Steward our communications ecosystem: develop and own channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of every message we send members.

- Leverage AI to compress the work: use AI tools to automate analyses, accelerate research, and remove busywork so the team ships faster.

- Partner cross-functionally: build strong relationships across Engineering and Operations to deliver on shared strategies for large, cross-functional initiatives.

What we’re looking for

- 4-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing

- A proven track record of running successful campaigns against targeted segments across multiple channels (email, SMS, in app messages, push)

- Strong analytical skills; comfort with pulling data, performing analyses, and reporting on performance to drive key business decisions and outcomes across the user lifecycle

- The ability to work cross-functionally and exercise significant independent judgment.

- Crisp written communication; high agency; low ego; bias to action, customer obsession.

What sets you apart

- Fintech experience - bonus points if you’ve worked on credit, lending, or other consumer financial products.

- Hands-on experience with key marketing platforms (Braze or similar).

- Comfortable leveraging AI tools as a daily multiplier - for analysis, automation, research, and writing.

- A strong self-starter mindset – adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

- Strategic thinking; you naturally ask “why” and “what if,” not just “what happened.”

What we offer

- Competitive salary and benefits with market leading equity. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

- 401(k) match

- Medical, dental & vision insurance

- Unlimited PTO & work from home flexibility

- Lunch & dinner at the office

🔁 Testing & Scaling

- Run systematic tests across audiences, bids, placements, and campaign structures

- You hit or beat CAC/ROAS targets consistently, not by accident

- You scale winning campaigns confidently without overspending into diminishing returns

- You think in frameworks and playbooks, not isolated campaign tweaks

- You catch underperformance early and act on it fast

- Proven track record hitting CAC or ROAS targets at meaningful spend levels

- Strong grasp of funnel economics (CAC, LTV, MER, payback period)

- Ability to analyze campaign data and make decisions without hand-holding

- Experience managing full-funnel paid budgets across multiple platforms

Bonus Points

- Experience in consumer fintech, DTC, or subscription/rewards businesses

- Experience managing 6–7 figure monthly ad budgets

- Familiarity with landing page CVR optimization

- Experience briefing creative/UGC teams on what to test next

KPIs

- CAC / ROAS performance

- Spend scaled efficiently

- Campaign win rate

- Speed of iteration and optimization

Who This Is NOT For

- Pure brand marketers

- People who need a fixed playbook rather than building one

- Creative only thinkers who don't want to own the numbers

- Marketers who won't dig into platform level data themselves

Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia, and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby. I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I've worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum, with whom I'd spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 to lead Product Marketing, thrilled to build something meaningful with people I admire, and to help shape the future of hiring in a way that's thoughtful, effective, and human.

We're a small team with high standards and mutual respect for our teammates and community. The way we do Product Marketing at Ashby reflects that, all with a good dose of fun 🎉. We value clarity over cleverness, lean into autonomy, and treat writing well and first-principles thinking as core parts of the job. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and focus on helping customers and prospects genuinely understand what our product does and how it can help them.

What we’re looking for

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own our Enterprise narrative, content and enable our go-to-market teams with clarity and confidence.

This includes the messaging, content, and sales support that helps us win and grow our largest, most complex customers. This role is about deeply understanding what it takes to sell and support Ashby at the Enterprise level: longer sales cycles, more sophisticated buying committees, and a much wider set of stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and more).

You'll partner closely with our Director of Product Marketing to make sure Enterprise messaging ladders up to Ashby's overarching company narrative, while you go deep on what makes that narrative land specifically with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers. You will synthesize inputs from customer research, product direction, market dynamics, and company vision into clear, compelling narratives that scale across the segment.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with Solutions Engineers and Sales Leaders to drive success within the segment, as well as collaborate with other marketing teams such as our Content & Community, Demand Gen, Events and Partnerships, to influence campaigns for the Enterprise segment.

This role is a great fit for someone who loves to problem-solve through complexity, enjoys working with sophisticated buyers, and wants to own a full segment end-to-end.

Your Background

There's no perfect path into this role. We're open to a variety of backgrounds, including:

- Product Marketing

- Sales Enablement

- Competitive Intelligence

- Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering

What You’ll Do

Own Enterprise segment narrative development

- Conduct deep research and develop messaging for the full Enterprise buying committee: Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and other stakeholders that don't show up the same way in smaller segments.

- Translate Ashby's company-level narrative into a story that resonates with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers.

- Maintain the Enterprise messaging framework that empowers Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to communicate, sell and service Ashby’s differentiation with confidence.

Be a strategic partner to Enterprise sales

- Partner deeply with Sales Leadership and Solutions Engineering to identify opportunities within the segment

- Develop Enterprise-specific enablement and build campaigns and materials that support the Enterprise sales process.

- Act as the source of truth and connective tissue between Marketing, CS, and Sales on how to speak to the Enterprise buyer, overall messaging and collateral

- Deliver well-crafted trainings to sales in collaboration with other sales-supporting teams to move forward audience positioning and other key initiatives.

Develop Enterprise-specific content

- Own the content and collateral that's unique to Enterprise: case studies, decks, one-pagers, and campaigns, including 1-1 and 1-to-few ABM built for this buyer set.

- Support TCO reports and ROI content that help Enterprise buyers and champions justify Ashby internally.

- Make sure CS, Sales, and Marketing are aligned and working from the same Enterprise messaging.

Examples of Projects You'll Work On

- Support Enterprise ABM initiatives: Support enterprise messaging for the marketing ABM program with the content, and compelling creative campaigns that support 1-1 and 1-to-few messaging.

- Analyst Relations Briefs: Partnering with Analyst Relations to prepare and brief analysts and press on Ashby’s offerings.

- Sales Leadership Strategic Initiatives: Work with Sales Leadership to translate big ideas and top company priorities into actionable assets, initiatives and roll outs that the Sales Team can use to drive deals forward.

- Enterprise buying committee messaging: Build out messaging tailored to secondary Enterprise stakeholders (Legal, Analysts, RecOps) who influence but don't lead the buying process.

- Enterprise sales deck refresh: Partner with Sales leadership to refresh the core Enterprise pitch as our narrative evolves.

- Cross-functional alignment: Make sure CS, Sales, and Marketing are aligned and using the same Enterprise messaging as new campaigns roll out.

You Might Be a Fit If You ...

- Love the complexity of Enterprise buying: multiple stakeholders, longer cycles, higher stakes.

- Are a confident writer who can flex a company narrative to resonate with a more sophisticated, skeptical buyer.

- Are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design to produce polished, Enterprise-grade assets.

- Like partnering closely with Sales and being in the room for their biggest deals.

You Might Not Be a Fit If ...

- You are drained by ambiguity or unsolved problems.

- You don't love the enablement aspects of product marketing.

- You'd rather work on message development in the abstract than get into the weeds of a specific deal or buyer.

- You are not a confident writer and storyteller.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

- 30 min: Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

- 45 min: Interview with Hiring Manager (Rosalia)

- 30 min: Interview with Marketing

- Assignment

- Final Round with key stakeholders

Benefits

- You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

- Competitive compensation is offered.

- 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

- Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

- Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

- Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

- $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. We hope that excites you enough to apply

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities._

Senior Growth Marketing Manager

United States

- $150K – $160K

About BiOptimizers

BiOptimizers exist to help people go from baseline health to peak biological performance. We develop science-backed supplements and wellness tools that deliver measurable results. As a remote-first company, our globally distributed team focuses on clarity, autonomy, and operational excellence. Every role is designed to support the health and performance of both our customers and our organization.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to scale our direct-to-consumer (DTC) business by acquiring new customers — and specifically new subscribers — profitably, at or below our target customer acquisition cost (CAC). This is the core of the role: bring in high-quality subscribers at a CAC that works against their lifetime value, and then scale that engine without breaking the economics.

This is a hands-on, in-the-platform operator role — not a strategy-only seat. You will build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns daily across Meta and Google, extend into video and TV as we scale, and own the full path from ad impression to subscribed customer — including the offers, the creative, and the landing pages that convert a first-time visitor into a recurring subscriber.

You understand that new-customer CAC — not blended ROAS — is the number that matters, and that acquiring a subscriber is worth more than a one-time buyer because subscriber retention and LTV set how much you can profitably spend to acquire. You keep ad message, audience signal, offer, and landing page tightly aligned to drive subscription take-rate. This role reports into marketing leadership and contributes directly to BiOptimizers’ mission of biologically optimizing the health of humanity.

Key Responsibilities

- New-subscriber acquisition at or below target CAC — you own the number, the spend, and the outcome.

- Daily, hands-on management of paid acquisition across Meta and Google, scaling profitable spend as fast as the CAC target allows.

- The acquisition offer and funnel — how first-order offers, subscribe-and-save mechanics, and checkout drive subscription take-rate, first-order margin, and payback.

- The creative and landing-page system that converts cold traffic into subscribers, in partnership with creative and front-end development.

- A repeatable creator-content testing pipeline that graduates winning organic concepts into paid ads.

- Expansion into upper-funnel video and TV (linear / CTV) as the account scales, measured for true incrementality.

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on, in-platform paid acquisition experience for a DTC or consumer brand — you have personally managed budgets and owned CAC and performance, not just briefed an agency.

- A proven track record of acquiring new customers profitably at a target CAC and scaling spend without blowing up the economics. Subscription / recurring-revenue acquisition experience is strongly preferred — you understand how subscriber retention and LTV set your allowable CAC and payback window, and how offers and checkout drive subscription take-rate.

- Deep, hands-on Meta Ads management: campaign structure, Advantage+ Shopping and broad targeting, creative testing, and budget scaling. You understand Meta’s Andromeda retrieval engine and how creative volume, signal quality (CAPI / server-side), and audience consolidation feed it to improve delivery and lower CAC.

- Hands-on Google Ads management across Search, Performance Max, and YouTube — including asset group construction, search-term mining, brand vs. non-brand separation, and negative keyword discipline.

- Working knowledge of how to buy linear TV and/or connected TV (CTV), including how upper-funnel video is planned, trafficked, and measured for incrementality alongside lower-funnel paid social and search.

- Strong command of how landing pages interact with ads — message match between ad and page, page speed and structure, and how landing page experience drives (or kills) conversion rate and downstream ad performance. You can spec, test, and iterate on pages, not just hand them off.

- A working understanding of full-funnel creative and how it maps to intent: top-of-funnel content that stops the scroll and earns attention, middle-of-funnel that builds belief and educates, and bottom-of-funnel that converts. You know how hooks, offers, and calls-to-action change by funnel stage and can direct or brief creative accordingly.

- Working knowledge of TikTok as a growth channel, and — critically — how to build a repeatable system for testing content with creators: sourcing and briefing creators, running organic content as a testing ground, reading what resonates, and graduating winning concepts into paid ads across TikTok and Meta.

- Fluency in data-driven decision-making and A/B testing — you design clean tests, read results correctly, and act on them. Comfortable with Google Analytics and attribution platforms.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience scaling subscriber acquisition for a consumer wellness or supplement brand in a hypergrowth environment.

- Hands-on experience with subscription platforms (e.g., Recharge) and optimizing subscribe-and-save offers and churn.

- Experience designing and reading geo holdout or incrementality tests, especially for video / TV spend.

- Familiarity with omnichannel dynamics — how DTC, Amazon, and retail interact, including the effect of branded-search and pricing across channels.

Work Location

This is a fully remote position. BiOptimizers has a globally distributed team and supports flexible work arrangements across time zones.

Company Hours & Collaboration

With team members across many countries and time zone differences of up to 16 hours, we’ve established a standard collaboration window from 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

This is not a required work schedule, but a shared time frame for meetings and team syncs. At BiOptimizers, we support flexibility — team members are encouraged to work the hours that best suit them, as long as they:

- Attend required meetings

- Communicate effectively across time zones

- Deliver work by agreed-upon deadlines

Equal Opportunity Statement

BiOptimizers is committed to diversity and inclusion and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Compensation Range: $150K - $160K

Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. Team Leadership & Coaching

- Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team.

- Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market.

Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role)

- Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas.

- Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio.

- Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level.

- Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops.

- Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams.

What you’ll bring

- 8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.

- A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.

- Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy.

- Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members.

- An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing.

- Outstanding presentation and business writing skills.

Bonus Points

- Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits.

Discover your purpose at work

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

As a seasoned product marketer and leader, you possess a knack for being able to identify business and market needs, conduct research and build strategic plans, craft compelling messaging and positioning, work directly with clients, and collaborate with teams across the business to bring game-changing products to the market. You see the big picture while managing seamless execution for your portfolio.

What you’ll do:

Team Leadership & Coaching

- Mentor and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketers, providing regular coaching on core competencies such as messaging, GTM execution, and cross-functional influence.

- Establish a culture of professional growth by creating tailored development plans that align individual career goals with company objectives.

- Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, offering actionable feedback to help team members navigate complex projects and evolve their strategic thinking.

- Define and prioritize the team’s roadmap, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across product launches, sales enablement, and demand generation efforts.

- Standardize PMM workflows by implementing scalable processes for launch tiering, messaging frameworks, and competitive intelligence to ensure consistent quality across the team.

- Act as a strategic influencer, navigating internal stakeholder dynamics and clearing hurdles to ensure the team can execute on-time and with high impact.

- Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team.

- Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market.

Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role)

- Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas.

- Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio.

- Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level.

- Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops.

- Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams.

What you’ll bring

- 8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.

- A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.

- Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy.

- Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members.

- An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing.

- Outstanding presentation and business writing skills.

Bonus Points

- Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits.

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Are you an experienced product marketer who thrives at the intersection of positioning, storytelling, and go-to-market strategy? Flashpoint is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team, remote in the United States. In this role, you will own the go-to-market strategy for our core cyber threat intelligence offerings, shaping our value proposition, positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation, and evolving pricing and packaging as we scale. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, working closely with your manager to translate technical capability into a narrative that resonates with CISOs and security practitioners around the world. This is a high-visibility seat: your work directly shapes our market position, win rates, deal value, and company growth.

We have a role for you if, you:

- Build and run product marketing programs for SaaS B2B threat intelligence or cybersecurity software.

- Own product launches end to end, from positioning through sales enablement to measurable adoption.

- Translate complex technical capability into messaging and assets that sales teams actively use in the field.

- Drive cross-functional GTM initiatives across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to measurable results.

- Have briefed executives, boards, or industry analysts on competitive and market dynamics.

- Shape pricing and packaging strategy for SaaS products.

- Are genuinely curious about applying AI to product marketing work, and have put it to work within your roles.

- Create differentiated positioning and messaging grounded in a clear understanding of the buyer, the market, and Flashpoint's core capabilities.

- Drive awareness, pipeline, and growth for Flashpoint's threat intelligence offerings.

- Own the product marketing strategy and roadmap for key offerings.

- Partner cross-functionally to design and execute GTM initiatives and commercialization efforts that drive measurable results.

- Build sales and marketing content, including collateral, thought leadership, solution presentations, and website content, that moves buyers through the funnel.

- Equip sales and partner teams with the messaging, training, and support structures they need to run a strong sales motion.

- Become the resident expert on target buyers, market trends, and the competitive landscape, and use that expertise to shape planning.

- Represent Flashpoint as a thought leader through publishing, social, and webinars.

What you will achieve:

Within 30 days

- You will learn Flashpoint's vision, mission, strategy, and culture, and meet with your manager and key stakeholders across leadership, marketing, product, intelligence, sales, and customer success.

- You will get up to speed on Flashpoint's product and service offerings and the competitive landscape.

- You will analyze customer engagements and feedback to understand the business outcomes Flashpoint drives for them, and review prospect data to identify the biggest levers and blockers in the sales cycle.

Within 60 days

- You will contribute to a GTM initiative aimed at new business or existing-customer upsell.

- You will complete a content audit and map content to the buyer's journey to drive conversion.

- You will have built working competitive intelligence resources for your product area, and articulated how Flashpoint differentiates itself.

By 90 days

- You will have a prioritized action plan for your area of the PMM team, aligned to Flashpoint's corporate and marketing goals.

- You will have built a product demo and delivered a training session to Sales so they can confidently communicate the value of our solutions to prospects and customers.

- You will translate the product roadmap for your area into a unified launch strategy that supports the broader business.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

- Product marketing experience in cybersecurity or threat intelligence software.

- Strong written and presentation skills you can point to, such as decks, launches, or competitive briefs.

- Experience shaping pricing and packaging strategy for a SaaS product.

- The ability to run multiple concurrent initiatives without losing momentum.

Base Pay Range: $150,000-165,000/yr plus target bonus

Why Flashpoint is a Great Place to Work:

- Diversity.  Flashpoint is committed to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging, and equity. We recognize that diversity is key to achieving our vision. The Role Directive is building a dedicated Lifecycle Marketing practice designed to help clients turn more of the demand they already generate into pipeline, revenue, repeat purchases, expansion, and long-term customer value. We are looking for an Associate Director of Lifecycle Marketing to help build that offering from the ground up. This is a player-coach role from day one . You will be hands-on with strategy, platform architecture, client delivery, and execution while also helping define how Directive approaches Lifecycle Marketing as a practice. As the offering grows, you will help hire, mentor, and develop the team around you while continuing to stay close to our most strategic and complex client work. You will have significant autonomy to shape the practice, including our methodology, service offerings, delivery model, technology recommendations, measurement frameworks, and how we bring Lifecycle Marketing to market. You will work closely with the Director and Managing Director, who will provide strategic direction, support, and partnership while giving you room to build. This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a finished playbook. We have a strong starting point, but we are looking for someone with the experience and point of view to challenge it, improve it, and help us create something meaningfully differentiated. Channel & Partner Enablement Lifecycle: Manufacturers selling through distributors, dealers, resellers, or other channel partners. In these environments, the lifecycle audience may be the channel partner rather than the end buyer. Service & SaaS Lead Nurture & Pipeline Acceleration: Our Service and SaaS clients generate handraisers across paid media, organic, events, content, and other acquisition channels. Customer Expansion & Subscription Growth: Once a prospect becomes a customer, Lifecycle Marketing can help deepen that relationship. Develop segmentation strategies using demographic, firmographic, behavioral, purchase, engagement, lifecycle-stage, and account data. Identify gaps in existing lifecycle programs and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities. Build testing roadmaps across messaging, timing, audience, journey structure, offers, and conversion points. Establish measurement frameworks that connect lifecycle activity to meaningful business outcomes. Hands-On Client Delivery You will be expected to build alongside the team and act not only as a strategy-only leader. Platforms & Technology You will work across client technology stacks rather than operating within a single platform. Client Leadership As a senior member of the practice, you will own relationships, not simply deliver assigned tasks. Build the Lifecycle Marketing Practice A meaningful part of this role is building the offering itself.
