We expect you to finish what is incomplete, improve what can be better, and introduce new approaches when your experience tells you there is a stronger way to solve the problem. Sales, Scoping & Growth As a foundational leader of the offering, you will also help Directive determine where Lifecycle Marketing can create value before an engagement begins. Over time, you will become one of the people Directive's Sales and Client teams turn to when they need to understand what a strong Lifecycle Marketing engagement should look like. What We're Looking For Player-Coach Leadership. Initially, time will be spent building and directly delivering client work. As revenue and headcount grow, responsibilities will increasingly include developing the people around you. 6+ years of experience across Lifecycle Marketing, CRM, marketing automation, retention, or related disciplines. Meaningful experience supporting B2B, SaaS, Service, or complex eCommerce business models . A purely traditional DTC background is unlikely to be enough for this role. Hands-on experience architecting lifecycle programs from scratch rather than only optimizing established programs. Strong understanding of segmentation, automation, customer journeys, trigger logic, experimentation, and lifecycle measurement. Working expertise in at least two major lifecycle or marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot, Klaviyo, Marketo, or Attentive. At G2, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. That's why our compensation program is rooted in market data, transparency, fairness, and individual performance.

Compensation in an offer is determined by factors such as the candidate’s experience, relevant skills, and job-related knowledge.

We’ve built a company-wide framework to provide employees clarity on how compensation and success is measured at each level. This career framework supports our employees' professional growth and guides them to their PEAK.

We also support our employees by offering generous benefits, such as flexible work, ample parental leave, and unlimited PTO. Click here to learn more about our benefits.

About G2 - The Company

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

About G2 - Our People

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— ( _P_ erformance + _E_ ntrepreneurship + _A_ uthenticity + _K_ indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

About The Role

Drive lifecycle marketing end to end across G2's marketplaces (Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp) — owning audience, segmentation, and messaging strategy and running AI-assisted, cross-channel campaigns (email, SMS, paid social) that grow engagement and retention. Lead and develop the lifecycle team, set the operating cadence, and drive outcomes through experimentation and influence with senior stakeholders.

In This Role, You Will:

- Lifecycle Strategy & Execution (35%)

  - Own and drive end-to-end lifecycle programs for both software buyers and reviewers — driving engagement, retention, and advocacy across every stage of the journey.

  - Design and optimize onboarding, nurture, and reactivation campaigns across email and SMS, using segmentation and personalization to deliver relevant experiences at scale.

  - Own the full workflow: ideation, build, QA, launch, and ongoing optimization for marketing automation across channels.

  - Apply AI tools across the lifecycle workflow, from content generation to segmentation and journey automation, to increase program speed and scale.
- Data-Driven Insights & Experimentation (25%)

  - Own the lifecycle metrics that matter: engagement, retention, LTV and stay accountable for moving them, not just measuring them.

  - Read user behavior, campaign performance, and cohort trends to decide where the biggest opportunities are and what to do next.

  - Drive the experimentation roadmap: sizing bets by impact and effort, prioritizing ruthlessly, and deciding what to kill, scale, or double down on based on results.

  - Partner with Analytics, Product, and Advisor/Advocate teams to pressure-test the strategy and keep it aligned to business goals.
- Strategy & Team Management (30%)

  - Lead and develop the lifecycle team, setting the operating cadence and process for how work is prioritized, built, launched, and measured.

  - Identify opportunities for efficiency across the lifecycle workflow — streamlining production, QA, and reporting so the team ships more, faster.

  - Own the lifecycle segmentation framework across buyers and reviewers — cohorts, lifecycle-stage triggers, and the messaging, copy, and email template strategy that AI and the team execute against; partner with Content on editorial themes.

  - Set how lifecycle work gets prioritized, built, launched, and measured, and drive alignment with senior stakeholders through influence and results.

  - Drive innovation in lifecycle, coaching the team to test new approaches, channels, and AI-assisted solutions that raise the bar on impact.

  - Stay ahead of lifecycle, email, SMS, and AI trends, and own email/SMS best practices, deliverability, data integrity, and compliance.
- Cross-Channel Execution (10%)

  - Aim to own SMS end to end and coordinate with paid social — aligning messaging and timing across email, SMS, and paid social into one coherent experience, not siloed touches.

  - Partner with Product, Content, CRO, and Engineering to keep experiences and supporting landing pages seamless.

Minimum Qualifications:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

-  7–10 years in lifecycle, retention, or CRM marketing — ideally in SaaS, a digital marketplace, or B2B — with a track record as a recognized subject-matter expert in the discipline.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

About G2 - Our People

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— ( _P_ erformance + _E_ ntrepreneurship + _A_ uthenticity + _K_ indness. About The Role

G2 is looking for a Senior SEO Specialist. As part of our world-class SEO team, your goal is to grow measurable traffic, citations, and conversions on our marketplace and other sites. This is a senior, in-house role where you’ll work across a broad range of SEO and AEO disciplines, from technical optimization and schema to keyword strategy, citations, and experimentation.

This role requires a good technical understanding of the way search engines crawl, index, render, and rank websites. You should also bring good project management and communication skills to be successful.

You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, learn how to navigate a fast-growing startup environment, and be part of a mighty team. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Content, and Analytics to turn SEO opportunities into shipped, measurable impact.

This position is based in Bengaluru and requires in-office attendance for 2 days in a week.

In This Role, You Will:

- Support the SEO team in developing and executing high-impact, resource-intensive initiatives for our marketplace

- Support G2 localization and drive increased global website traffic

- Own the keyword strategy and content optimization on learn.g2.com and www.g2.com.

- Increase organic and LLM-driven traffic through continuous optimization and experimentation

- Perform comprehensive keyword research and develop detailed keyword/prompt mapping strategies

- Lead competitive SEO and AEO analysis to benchmark performance and identify opportunities for growth

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams, serving as the primary SEO point of contact, and implement technical SEO and AEO recommendations at scale

- Optimize internal linking structures, on-page content, and site speed for improved rankings and UX

- Develop deep expertise in Technical SEO and AEO and serve as a trusted SME for the team

- Mentor and coach Jr. and SEO Specialists through guidance, reviews, and shared learning

How We Work

At G2, SEO work is owned from end to end. We believe that the best outcomes come from teams that think holistically, collaborate deeply, and remain curious about their impact. In this role, you’ll be involved across the full lifecycle of SEO and AEO initiatives, including:

- Research and analysis to identify opportunities and inform decisions

- Building clear SEO/AEO cases grounded in data, context, and logic

- Translating ideas into well-defined implementation requirements

- Collaborating closely with partners through sprint planning, execution, and reviews

- Measuring performance, sharing outcomes, and iterating based on results

We value thoughtful problem-solving, strong attention to detail, and proactive communication. Feedback is a core part of how we learn and grow together, and senior team members are expected to apply it consistently to raise the bar for themselves and the team.

How You’ll Spend Time

In this role, your time will be split across systems ownership, experimentation, and cross-functional execution. While priorities may shift based on business needs, your focus will broadly include:

- Search infrastructure and crawl systems (20%): You’ll own and lead initiatives that strengthen the technical foundation of G2’s discoverability. This includes technical audits, crawl and index health, and structural improvements that enhance how search engines interpret and rank G2.

- AEO, entity & answer systems (20%): You’ll help shape G2’s visibility across AI-driven and answer-based search experiences. You’ll partner cross-functionally to diagnose performance shifts and improve our presence across emerging search and LLM ecosystems.

- On-page SEO systems & templates (20%): You’ll lead scalable improvements across key page types to improve rankings, topical authority, and search performance. You’ll also collaborate with Content, Product, and Engineering to ensure templates and modules deliver measurable impact.

- Strategy and experimentation (20%): You’ll model search opportunity, run SEO/AEO experiments, analyze performance shifts, and translate insights into actionable roadmap recommendations.

- Global SEO (10%): You’ll support localization efforts and identify opportunities to grow traffic across international markets.

- Mentorship and technical SME (10%): As a senior member of the team, you’ll mentor junior team members, review work, establish standards, and serve as a trusted technical voice across teams. You’ll help raise the quality bar for execution and thinking across the SEO function.

Minimum Qualifications:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

- Bring 3+ years of proven SEO experience with a strong track record of delivering measurable results

- Demonstrated ability to conduct in-depth SEO data analysis using Excel and related tools to uncover insights and drive strategy

- Possess a strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from an SEO perspective

- Deep proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Profound, and STAT to monitor performance and guide decision-making

- Strong technical SEO expertise, including experience auditing enterprise-scale websites and translating findings into actionable recommendations for site improvements.

- Working expertise in structured data implementation (schema markup) and its impact on search engine visibility

- Ability to manage multiple SEO/AEO projects at once while keeping priorities aligned to business impact.

- Experience working cross-functionally to advocate for SEO and AEO best practices across the organization

- Strong communicator who can break down complex SEO/AEO insights into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Possess a strong personal brand and active presence in the SEO community, staying updated on trends and best practices

Nice to Have

- Experience with large-scale marketplaces or SaaS platforms

- Experience with hreflang and international SEO fundamentals

- Exposure to AEO, LLM-driven search, or citations optimization

- Familiarity with log file analysis and crawl budget optimization in large-scale sites

- Experience running or partnering on A/B testing initiatives for SEO, content, or on-page optimization

- Experience managing large-scale taxonomy, faceted navigation, or programmatic SEO architectures

- Engagement with the SEO community (experimentation, writing, speaking)

Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity

At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. About The Role

G2 is seeking a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to support marketing analytics and lead routing/scoring systems. This role is split between analytics and systems work with the majority of the work is building and maintaining reporting on funnel performance, lifecycle metrics, and campaign effectiveness. The remainder focused on owning lead routing and lead scoring logic.

This role reports directly to the Director of Marketing Operations and operates independently on both the analytics and systems side of the work. The Marketing Operations Specialist continues to own higher complexity, strategic systems work, such as Clay administration, enrichment platform strategy, data architecture, and sales handoff/engagement workflows (Groove, Qualified).

The ideal candidate has hands-on marketing analytics experience already, is comfortable working across Salesforce and Marketo data, and wants to build deeper systems fluency in lead routing and scoring over time.

In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For:

_Marketing Analytics & Reporting_

- Build and maintain operational reporting on funnel performance, lifecycle stage conversion, routing efficiency, and campaign engagement metrics

- Partner with BI and Data teams on dashboard development and operational analytics

- Validate reporting outputs and troubleshoot data discrepancies across Salesforce, Marketo, and connected GTM systems

- Identify trends, gaps, and optimization opportunities through data analysis, and bring findings directly to the Director of Marketing Operations

_Lead Scoring, Routing, and Handoff_

- Manage lead and contact scoring models aligned to buying intent, engagement signals, and funnel stage

- Own RingLead routing logic and lead/account matching across sales teams

- Continuously improve speed-to-lead and inbound lead qualification frameworks

- Perform daily QA on Marketo smartlists, Salesforce routing reports, and RingLead workflows to catch and resolve mis-routed or unsynced records

- Troubleshoot and resolve lead routing and scoring issues as they arise, and escalate systemic issues to the Director of Marketing Operations

- Manage the handoff process between Marketing and Sales; including sales alerts and follow-up flows

_AI-Enabled QA & Reporting_

- Use AI tools to cross-reference and reconcile records across Salesforce, Marketo, and 6sense during QA, for example checking a batch of Marketo smartlist records against Salesforce to verify MQL date, source program, and contact status before pushing corrected records back

- Apply AI tools to speed up recurring reporting and QA tasks, and suggest additional workflows worth automating

Minimum Qualifications:

-  3+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing analytics, or a related data/systems role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or technology company

- Prior hands-on experience with marketing analytics or reporting tools

- You have deep understand of core marketing KPIs and what drives them

- Working knowledge of Salesforce and Marketo, or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms

- Experience with, or strong aptitude for, lead routing and scoring logic

- Comfortable working with data at the record level: profiling, cleaning, and reconciling data across systems

- Strong attention to detail and a QA mindset

- Demonstrated interest in or exposure to using AI tools to support analysis or QA work

- Strong communication and organizational skills and experience presenting to senior leadership teams

What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:

About The Role

At G2, our Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Solutions owns go-to-market strategy and hands-on growth execution for G2 AI Solutions — G2’s full AI product portfolio, spanning G2.ai (our AI playground and beta testing ground for Blueprints, Agent Evals, and what’s next) all the way through their migration into G2.com. You’ll define who these products are for, build the story that makes buyers care, and personally drive the growth tactics that take an early AI product from zero traction to revenue — owning that GTM motion end-to-end, from first beta signal in G2.ai to full integration on G2.com. You will report to the Senior Director, Product Marketing, with a dotted line into the product organization, and be a key member of the PMM team.

This role owns G2 AI Solutions — G2’s newest, most ambiguous, and fastest-moving product bets — end to end, covering both sides of the merger from G2.ai (our AI playground) into G2.com, not just work happening in the AI playground. As capabilities like Agent Evals get built directly into G2.com, this person owns how the audience, story, and growth motion travel with them.

You’ll be a dedicated PMM partner for G2 AI Solutions, embedded in product roadmap and planning from the earliest stages, while also working directly with the builders behind individual solutions underneath it.

This is a blend of strategist and operator: you form a sharp point of view on audience and positioning, and you’re also comfortable rolling up your sleeves to run the campaigns, community plays, and early pipeline motions that get a new product to its first dollar of revenue.

In This Role, You Will:

_GTM Vision & Market Definition (25%)_

- Define who each AI product is for and why, and build positioning and messaging that’s differentiated and defensible — testing assumptions fast through lightweight experiments, customer conversations, and early pilots.

- Own GTM strategy for G2 AI Solutions end-to-end — from G2.ai (Blueprints, Agent Evals, and what’s next) through their migration into G2.com — with a buyer-first lens; seller-facing use cases are secondary and in service of seeding buyer adoption.

- Own the plan for how each product’s audience, messaging, and channel strategy evolves as it migrates from G2.ai into G2.com — including products like Agent Evals that are launching directly into G2.com.

_Growth Execution & Zero-to-Revenue (20%)_

- Personally own and run the growth tactics that take AI Solutions products from early access to revenue-generating — campaigns, community seeding, lifecycle nurture, and early pipeline generation — not just briefing others on what to build.

- Own pipeline and revenue visibility for the AI Solutions portfolio in its early stages, and run lightweight acquisition and activation experiments (organic, community-led, referral) to find what moves users from aware to paying.

- Partner with Sales and RevOps to define what “revenue-ready” looks like for an early-stage AI product, and drive the handoff from PMM-led growth to a scaled GTM motion.

_Early User Research & Market Validation (15%)_

- Proactively identify and engage prospective buyers before a product is ready, running lightweight discovery — user interviews, concept tests, early-access pilots.

- Stay close to the competitive landscape and category trends; feed market perspective back to Product as the informed voice of the buyer.

- Build and maintain a network of early users and prospective customers who can give honest, ongoing input as AI Solutions products evolve; synthesize findings into clear takeaways on who’s likely to buy and what’s resonating.

_Sales Enablement & Go-to-Market Readiness (15%)_

- Partner with Sales Enablement to understand what’s landing in the field and close gaps quickly with the right narrative, proof points, and collateral.

- Use G2’s existing seller and customer base to seed early adoption of AI Solutions products, rather than building net-new external communities from scratch.

- Brief the PMM team on what enablement materials need to exist across Buyer, Seller, and Reviewer audiences, and serve as a strategic driver behind early pilot and launch motions.

_Cross-Functional Partnership & Orchestration (15%)_

- Serve as Products' dedicated PMM partner for AI Solutions — embedded in product org’s roadmap and planning from the earliest stages — while also partnering directly with the builders of individual solutions underneath it.

- Translate early and often-unformed product direction into a GTM plan the PMM team can execute against; build frameworks and messaging together with PMM peers, then partner with Demand Gen, Content, and Comms to execute.

- Communicate GTM direction, experiment results, and recommendations clearly to the Senior Director, PMM leadership, and Product; flag when something upstream is broken and bring a proposed solution.

_Alignment & Market Intelligence (10%)_

- Give the team clarity on what you’re working toward and why; operate as a reliable, easy-to-trust partner across Marketing and Product.

- Maintain a current view of the competitive landscape and category trends specific to AI-powered GTM and software discovery, and use it to keep AI Solutions positioning sharp and relevant.

- Build and maintain a high hiring bar for the PMM function — attracting marketers with intellectual rigor, genuine product fluency, and GTM depth.

Minimum Qualifications:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

-  7+ years of product marketing, growth marketing, or GTM strategy experience in B2B SaaS, including at least one experience getting a product off the ground with little to no playbook.

- Proven ability to take a product from zero to revenue — hands-on experience running growth or demand campaigns, building pipeline, and driving early revenue, not just strategy and orchestration.

- Experience in an early-stage or new-product environment (startup, internal venture, or skunkworks team) where you had to define the market as much as the message.

- Comfortable with data and experimentation: you understand testing frameworks, know how to build and validate a hypothesis, and use data to build a compelling story.

- A natural relationship builder who gets things done through people — across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Leadership. History of relationships strong enough that people at past companies would say you made their work better.

- Clear, confident communicator — you write sharp positioning, give a crisp verbal brief, and make meetings productive.

- Comfortable in ambiguity — you don’t need a fully-formed brief to get started, you help create it.

- Deep familiarity with or genuine curiosity about AI and how it’s reshaping software buying behavior.

- Experience with PLG or self-serve motions where understanding the buyer deeply was essential to acquisition.

- Comfortable owning a broad, evolving portfolio (multiple AI products at different maturity stages) rather than a single, narrowly-defined product.

Travel: Willingness to travel for company events, product offsites, and customer-facing meetings as needed.

Senior Product Marketing Manager, Handshake AI

San Francisco, CA

Employment Type

Full time

Location Type

On-site

Department

Marketing

Compensation

- $152K – $190K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

_For cash compensation, we set standard ranges for all U.S.-based roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above._

About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We've grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. Now, we are bringing the same capabilities to grow the Enterprise business.

Why join Handshake now:

- Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

- Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions

- Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

- Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

We're now bringing that same rigor to the enterprise. Handshake AI moves enterprise agents from pilot to production, in a repeatable way, through quality infrastructure such as evals and rubrics, simulations, safety and security testing, and model optimization that encodes an organization's own expertise into durable, sovereign IP the customer owns, at the optimal cost. We work with Fortune 500 leaders to close the gap between AI pilots and production-grade deployment.

About The Role

You'll be the end-to-end product marketing owner for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, the connective tissue between research, product, sales, and the market. You'll translate deep technical work into positioning that lands with researchers and lab leadership, then arm sales with everything they need to close and grow those relationships. This is a build-from-scratch seat: you'll set the GTM playbook for a business growing faster than almost anything in AI.

- Positioning & Strategy: Build end-to-end positioning, messaging, and competitive strategy for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, keeping it unified with Handshake's broader career-network story rather than siloed as a separate business.

- Research Translation: Partner with the HAI research team to turn technical research outputs into market-ready content, building Handshake AI's credibility with researchers and the broader AI community.

- Content & Website: Build the lab-facing content engine, including one-pagers, conference materials, and a Handshake AI website that is ready to be built out from scratch.

- Data Catalog: Create and maintain a data gallery, a clear menu of the data types Handshake AI offers, so researchers can see at a glance what is possible.

- White-Space Discovery: Spot where Handshake's expert human data can add the most value to lab research, and turn those insights into positioning and content.

- Sales Ownership: Serve as the primary PMM point of contact and decision-maker for how Handshake AI shows up in lab-facing conversations — value props, proof points, pricing/packaging narratives, and objection handling.

- Sales Enablement Materials: Build and maintain the playbooks, talk tracks, competitive one-pagers, and pitch assets the field runs on, iterating based on direct feedback from Sales.

- GTM Strategy: Partner with HAI Product and Sales leadership to shape long-term product and GTM strategy — synthesizing customer, competitive, and market insight into clear executive recommendations — and codify the frameworks, launch templates, and messaging systems the broader team reuses.

- Event & Field Marketing: Partner with the field marketing team to translate HAI positioning into compelling in-person and virtual experiences, owning messaging for executive dinners, field events, and conference activations.

You'll also help stand up Handshake AI's newer Enterprise AI business, co-owning product marketing with a fellow AI product marketer:

- Content & Thought Leadership: Create content and thought leadership pieces for external awareness, and figure out how to promote them across the website, social, and other channels.

- Sales Enablement: Build the assets sales needs to sell Enterprise AI into Fortune 500 accounts such as competitive battlecards (backed by ongoing competitive analysis), pitch decks, use case examples, and other collateral.

- Use Case Prioritization: Prioritize which enterprise use cases and industries to go after, in partnership with a teammate who also works on industry use cases, based on market and customer insight.

- Event Marketing: Collaborate with the field marketing team (which has dedicated enterprise reps) on which enterprise-specific events to attend and how Handshake AI shows up there.

You Have

- 6+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, or a related B2B marketing discipline

- Strong foundation in positioning, messaging, and content creation, including website and social

- A track record of 0-to-1 program building — comfortable with ambiguity, working independently without a perfect brief, wearing multiple hats, prioritizing, and scaling based on data

- Ability to influence at all levels, including executives

- Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder launches

- Experience building sales enablement materials, including competitive positioning and technical demo content

Bonus points:

- Experience in the human data or AI training data field

- AI/ML background or technical fluency, including experience partnering directly with researchers, scientists, or other technical stakeholders

- Experience marketing to enterprise B2B buyers — ideally in AI/ML infrastructure, data, or a related technical category, with exposure to Fortune 500 sales cycles

- Experience in demand generation, growth, partner marketing, or full-funnel marketing at a startup

We Offer

_Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full-time US employees._

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above._

About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We've grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. Now, we are bringing the same capabilities to grow the Enterprise business.

Why join Handshake now:

- Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

- Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions

- Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

- Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

We're now bringing that same rigor to the enterprise. Handshake AI moves enterprise agents from pilot to production, in a repeatable way, through quality infrastructure such as evals and rubrics, simulations, safety and security testing, and model optimization that encodes an organization's own expertise into durable, sovereign IP the customer owns, at the optimal cost. We work with Fortune 500 leaders to close the gap between AI pilots and production-grade deployment.

About The Role

You'll be the end-to-end product marketing owner for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, the connective tissue between research, product, sales, and the market. You'll translate deep technical work into positioning that lands with researchers and lab leadership, then arm sales with everything they need to close and grow those relationships. This is a build-from-scratch seat: you'll set the GTM playbook for a business growing faster than almost anything in AI.

- Positioning & Strategy: Build end-to-end positioning, messaging, and competitive strategy for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, keeping it unified with Handshake's broader career-network story rather than siloed as a separate business.

- Research Translation: Partner with the HAI research team to turn technical research outputs into market-ready content, building Handshake AI's credibility with researchers and the broader AI community.

- Content & Website: Build the lab-facing content engine, including one-pagers, conference materials, and a Handshake AI website that is ready to be built out from scratch.

- Data Catalog: Create and maintain a data gallery, a clear menu of the data types Handshake AI offers, so researchers can see at a glance what is possible.

- White-Space Discovery: Spot where Handshake's expert human data can add the most value to lab research, and turn those insights into positioning and content.

- Sales Ownership: Serve as the primary PMM point of contact and decision-maker for how Handshake AI shows up in lab-facing conversations — value props, proof points, pricing/packaging narratives, and objection handling.

- Sales Enablement Materials: Build and maintain the playbooks, talk tracks, competitive one-pagers, and pitch assets the field runs on, iterating based on direct feedback from Sales.

- GTM Strategy: Partner with HAI Product and Sales leadership to shape long-term product and GTM strategy — synthesizing customer, competitive, and market insight into clear executive recommendations — and codify the frameworks, launch templates, and messaging systems the broader team reuses.

- Event & Field Marketing: Partner with the field marketing team to translate HAI positioning into compelling in-person and virtual experiences, owning messaging for executive dinners, field events, and conference activations.

You'll also help stand up Handshake AI's newer Enterprise AI business, co-owning product marketing with a fellow AI product marketer:

- Content & Thought Leadership: Create content and thought leadership pieces for external awareness, and figure out how to promote them across the website, social, and other channels.

- Sales Enablement: Build the assets sales needs to sell Enterprise AI into Fortune 500 accounts such as competitive battlecards (backed by ongoing competitive analysis), pitch decks, use case examples, and other collateral.

- Use Case Prioritization: Prioritize which enterprise use cases and industries to go after, in partnership with a teammate who also works on industry use cases, based on market and customer insight.

- Event Marketing: Collaborate with the field marketing team (which has dedicated enterprise reps) on which enterprise-specific events to attend and how Handshake AI shows up there.

You Have

- 6+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, or a related B2B marketing discipline

- Strong foundation in positioning, messaging, and content creation, including website and social

- A track record of 0-to-1 program building — comfortable with ambiguity, working independently without a perfect brief, wearing multiple hats, prioritizing, and scaling based on data

- Ability to influence at all levels, including executives

- Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder launches

- Experience building sales enablement materials, including competitive positioning and technical demo content

Bonus points:

- Experience in the human data or AI training data field

- AI/ML background or technical fluency, including experience partnering directly with researchers, scientists, or other technical stakeholders

- Experience marketing to enterprise B2B buyers — ideally in AI/ML infrastructure, data, or a related technical category, with exposure to Fortune 500 sales cycles

- Experience in demand generation, growth, partner marketing, or full-funnel marketing at a startup

We Offer

_Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full-time US employees._

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.

About Hatch

Hatch is an AI agent lead management platform that helps services businesses turn every customer interaction into revenue growth. Our AI agents handle conversations over SMS, email, and voice—24/7—enabling businesses to scale 1:1 communication without scaling headcount.

Recently acquired by Yelp, Hatch operates as a standalone product and is expanding our reach to help thousands more businesses unlock the revenue sitting in their lead pipeline. We've driven $5.1B in revenue for our customers—and we're just getting started.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager to run our partner program — one of Hatch's highest-leverage growth channels. Rather than a channel support role, this is a co-marketing, co-sell, and relationship-driven one — and you'll own it end to end.

You'll be the main point of contact and connective tissue between Hatch and our partners the person they come to for events, campaigns, and co-created content — and you'll pull in the right people across marketing (product marketing, enablement, content, field marketing) to make it happen.

This is high-impact work. Strong partnerships drive pipeline, expand our reach, and build Hatch's credibility across the industry — and you'll be in charge of scaling that program.

What you'll do:

- Help land new partners: partner with product marketing and enablement to produce the collateral BD uses to pitch and land new partners.

- New strategic partner and integration launches: Onboard and announce new partners and product integrations across email, blog, website, and social — working with product marketing on the integration's value prop.

- Co-marketing campaigns: Plan and execute co-branded campaigns — launches, webinars, ebooks, seasonal offers — tapping partners as a distribution channel to get Hatch's content in front of their audiences. You'll own the partner relationship and the plan, and partner with content and product marketing on assets, talk tracks, and speakers.

- Partner program management: For partners with year-round programs (newsletter placements, blog posts, committed content), own the fulfillment — producing some content yourself and pulling in content, PMM, and enablement for the rest. You'll also help keep Hatch's listings and profiles on partner sites accurate and up to date.

- Partner enablement: Scope the collateral partners need to speak fluently about Hatch to their audiences, and partner with product marketing and enablement to produce it. As Hatch evolves, keep partners in the loop and their materials current — so their knowledge of Hatch stays fresh.

- Partner events: Work with field marketing on partner events and VIP experiences, contributing partner context, messaging, and coordination.

- Repeatable playbooks & scaling: Turn one-off partner activations into repeatable playbooks, so the program scales efficiently as we add partners and move into new verticals.

- Partner relationships: Maintain ongoing relationships with partner contacts — regular syncs, staying current on their updates, and keeping communication flowing — and proactively bring partners ideas for campaigns and content.

- Tracking & optimization: Measure and optimize partner ROI, track referral handoffs, and improve lead quality from partner activity.

What it takes to succeed:

- Relevant background: 4–7 years in partner marketing, co-marketing, or related B2B SaaS marketing (product or content)

- Natural relationship-builder: comfortable being the face of Hatch to partners, building trust, and managing external stakeholders

- Strong project management: you can juggle multiple partners and orchestrate deliverables across internal teams you don't manage — knowing when to set direction and when to step back — and keep a dozen moving parts on track and shipping on time

- Solid content and campaign instincts: you can develop narratives, campaign angles, and webinar topics, and produce or shape content across formats

- Multi-partner-type experience: you've worked across associations, tech platforms, and agencies — not just one vertical

- Fluent in pipeline language: SQOs, referral attribution, and co-marketing ROI

- Thrives in a build-stage environment: comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace, and energized by shaping a program rather than inheriting a finished one

What you'll get:

- Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental

- 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday

- Up to 14 weeks of parental leave

- Monthly wellness subsidy

- Work from home reimbursement

- Flexible spending account

- 401(k) retirement savings plan

- Employee stock purchase plan

- Compensation range for this position is $106,000 - $198,000 annually. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

_We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability._

_Where required by law, a criminal background check will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment is made, and any evaluation of a candidate's criminal background check will be subject to an individualized assessment that takes into account the candidate's specific criminal records and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role._

About Us

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Your Mission

Hawk is looking for an exceptional Head of Demand Generation to run a numbers-driven demand program that delivers pipeline and revenue goals.

You'll own the full-funnel demand strategy — from creating global and localized campaigns for top-of-funnel awareness through to optimizing the inbound customer journey — across ABM, digital, events, partner marketing, and beyond.

You'll head up a talented team of specialist marketers, providing leadership, direction and orchestration to ensure perfect alignment of work for exceptional outcomes. You’ll work hand-in-glove with the other Marketing functions, aligning closely with Product Marketing, Content, Business Development and Operations to ensure synchronicity. You’ll partner with Sales, Partnerships, Customer Success, and RevOps to develop winning strategies for prospect and customer engagement.

You’ll be the person the CMO and CRO turn to for a clear-eyed view of what's generating pipeline, what isn't, and why.

This is a leadership role for someone who has both built demand generation strategies and can still get into the weeds — whether it’s being the onsite Marketing lead at a conference, helping to optimize ABM ads, or sense-checking a paid media budget.

Your Responsibilities

- Own the demand generation strategy and pipeline number: set targets for MQLs/SQLs/pipeline by channel and be accountable for delivering on those goals

- Build and lead an integrated, multi-channel demand plan spanning ABM, paid and organic digital, events/webinars, partner marketing, BDRs, and more — ensuring all channels align and reinforce each other

- Identify the campaigns you need to be successful, working with the Content and Product Marketing teams on quarterly strategy plans and then collaborating on a weekly basis to execute campaign activity

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of marketing specialists — setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, and building a high-performing, accountable department

- Be hands-on — you’ll own some elements of the demand gen program as you prove their value and grow your team, plus you’ll step in and be on-site for events taking place in your location

- Partner with Sales on lead handoff, scoring, SLAs, and follow-up — demand gen doesn't stop at the MQL, and you'll own the quality of that handoff

- Own the demand gen budget: allocate spend across channels based on performance, defend the ROI of that spend to the exec team, and reallocate quickly when something isn't working

- Drive attribution and reporting: build a clear, trusted view of what's working across the funnel (multi-touch attribution, pipeline velocity, CAC by channel/segment) and report on it to the CMO, CRO, and board

- Build a testing culture: run structured experiments across channels and segments, and use the results to continuously improve efficiency and conversion rates

- Work with Marketing Ops to ensure we have the right martech stack relevant to demand gen (e.g. ABM platform, marketing automation, ad platforms, intent data), ensuring it's used effectively and integrated cleanly with CRM

- Bring an outside-in view: track what's working in B2B demand gen more broadly and bring new channels, formats, or approaches to the team.

What You'll Bring

- 7+ years in B2B demand generation, with proven experience of delivering on pipeline and revenue targets

- 3+ years managing people, with a track record of developing specialists into strong independent operators

- Experience in marketing to the financial services industry, preferably in financial crime and compliance or cybersecurity

- Hands-on fluency across channels, especially ABM, paid and organic digital, field/virtual events and webinars, and partner marketing

- A passion for identifying and executing on campaign ideas, both local and global, that successfully take a prospect through the buying funnel

- Experience in actively fostering productive relationships with your Marketing colleagues to achieve stellar outcomes

- The ability to work closely with Sales, with a genuine orientation toward pipeline quality and revenue outcomes over other metrics (lead volume, website traffic, etc.)

- A track record of building scalable systems and processes, not just running individual campaigns — this role is as much about building the machine as operating it

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort presenting results and plans to executive leadership and the board

- Sharp budget management and prioritization instincts; comfortable making the case for (and against) spend with data

Compensation Range: $135K - $175K

About Morning Consult

Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act.

This role is available in any of our office locations (Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL) or can be based remotely. Join us in the office for catered lunch on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays!

About the Role

We're seeking a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to own and evolve the systems, strategy, and data infrastructure that power Morning Consult's marketing and revenue engine. You'll set the standard for how we run HubSpot, govern our marketing data, and connect campaign activity to measurable pipeline outcomes — with Salesforce as your key integration partner.

This is a high-impact IC role for someone who doesn't just keep the lights on, but actively raises the bar: proactively identifying gaps in our tech stack, driving improvements before they're asked for, and shaping how Marketing and RevOps operate together.

The Business Operations Team

Business Operations is the connective tissue of Morning Consult's revenue organization. We own the systems, processes, and reporting that power the commercial engine — and we bring structure to ambiguity across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and beyond.

What You'll Be Working On:

HubSpot Platform Ownership

- Primary HubSpot admin across Marketing, Sales, and Operations Hubs: configuration, data architecture, user management, and platform health

- Build and maintain automation workflows, lifecycle stage logic, lead scoring, nurture sequences, list segmentation, and own the roadmap for platform improvements, not just maintenance

- Own data governance: field standards, deduplication, database hygiene, and compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM

- Evaluate and recommend new HubSpot capabilities and adjacent tools; make the case for investment or consolidation based on ROI and operational need

CRM Integration & Salesforce Alignment

- Own the HubSpot–Salesforce integration: bidirectional sync, lead routing, MQL/SQL definitions, and attribution

- Monitor integration health; resolve sync failures before they affect reporting or sales workflows

- Serve as the marketing systems authority in RevOps conversations; define requirements, not just execute them

Reporting & Dashboards

- Design and maintain dashboards in HubSpot and Salesforce covering funnel health, campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and MQL conversion

- Own reporting cadences (weekly snapshots, monthly reviews, and QBR-ready summaries), delivering insight-driven narratives rather than just raw numbers and surfacing proactive recommendations rather than just status updates.

- Define and document the marketing data model and metric hierarchy; ensure consistency of definitions across Marketing, RevOps, and Finance

Campaign & Process Operations

- Own the operational layer of campaign execution: list pulls, workflow QA, email setup, UTM governance, suppression logic, and post-campaign reporting

- Support ABM operations for enterprise accounts using enrichment and routing tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, LeanData)

- Own the process improvement roadmap — identify, prioritize, build, and document automation initiatives with measurable time/cost impact

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Operate as the marketing systems authority for cross-functional stakeholders — shaping how Marketing and RevOps design processes together, not just implementing requests

- Help stakeholders scope requests, assess tradeoffs, and self-serve through training and documentation, and build scalable enablement resources so the team grows with you.

About You and What You've Done:

- 5–7 years in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related role at a B2B SaaS, data, or technology company

- Deep HubSpot expertise and a track record of platform ownership — you've built and scaled the system, not inherited it; you can articulate architectural decisions and their tradeoffs; certifications expected

- Solid grasp of the HubSpot–Salesforce integration; comfortable in Salesforce for reports, record inspection, and joint process work

- Strong dashboard and reporting skills, advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for data manipulation and ad hoc analysis, and experience defining metric frameworks rather than just pulling numbers.

- Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and UTM governance — you understand how campaigns get measured end to end

- Experience with ABM and enrichment/routing tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, LeanData), and you've operationalized ABM motions, not just supported them

- Working knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM as applied to marketing databases

- AI-native working style — you use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar to accelerate operational work and know where human judgment still matters

- Systems thinker who proactively identifies what's broken before being asked — and builds the case for fixing it

- Independent, clear communicator who can translate technical logic for non-technical partners, and you've influenced stakeholders at the Director level and above

_Note: We view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds — if you're open to building new skills, we'd love to hear from you._

Compensation

The expected salary range for this position is $81,700 – $130,000, with a midpoint of $105,800. In most cases, we target the midpoint for new hire compensation. This role is eligible for an equity grant. Please see an overview of Morning Consult's benefits on our Career Page.

We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. About Morning Consult

Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act.

This role is available in any of our office locations or can be based remotely. Our award-winning and modern offices are located in Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; and New York, NY. All three offices are accessible by public transportation and in close proximity to great restaurants and shopping.

Join us in the office for catered lunch on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, or grab a beverage from the fridge for an impromptu after-work happy hour!

The Role

Morning Consult is hiring a Director, Marketing Strategy and Operations to own the marketing organization's highest-priority cross-functional initiatives end to end — from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and the outcome each one was meant to produce. This is the kind of work that doesn't sit neatly inside a single function, requires structuring real ambiguity, and needs someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

How ownership works:This role owns projects and supports every function across the Marketing team. On every initiative you take on, you are the accountable owner: you define the problem, build the plan, convene the cross-functional group, drive the decisions, and are measured on whether it shipped and moved the number it was supposed to move. Marketing leadership may be in the room for the first meeting — after that it's yours. Every initiative on the list below is one the business cannot execute without a dedicated owner, which is why the role exists.

This is not a conventional product marketing, growth, or operations role. You'll flex across the function to support what the business needs most in a given quarter. In one stretch that might mean rebuilding how inbound leads flow from marketing to sales; in another, it might mean helping take new AI and agentic product capabilities to market, translating strategic priorities into concrete plans and scorecards, or working through how the team's content function should evolve.

What You'll Be Working On

- Own the marketing organization's highest-priority cross-functional initiatives — scoped with the Chief Growth Officer, then run by you — the projects too multidisciplinary or consequential to sit inside a single function.

- Own communication and reporting of overall growth function performance to executive, cross-functional, and team function leaders.

- Own large-scale transformation projects end-to-end, from problem definition through implementation and adoption.

- Structure undefined, messy problems into clear plans, workstreams, timelines, and owners — and drive them to completion.

- Translate Marketing leadership's strategic priorities into concrete operating plans, targets, and scorecards, and own tracking progress against them over time.

- Build and run the operating rhythm for the marketing organization — planning cycles, leadership reviews, and the decision forums that go with them — so the team operates against real targets and a real calendar.

- Lead Marketing's role in company-level strategic efforts — the go-to-market for new AI and agentic product capabilities, our analytics investment, and Marketing's contribution to our largest enterprise and AI-partner pitches. You'll carry these with the authority to decide, not just to report back.

- Partner with functional leads to evaluate and strengthen the team's capabilities and areas for improvement.

- Build the materials and narratives for executive- and leadership-level conversations, translating complex initiatives into clear, decision-ready updates.

- Serve as a trusted thought partner to marketing leadership on prioritization, resourcing, and organizational design decisions.

- Build trust and alignment across stakeholders in Sales, Product, RevOps, and Finance, ensuring Marketing's priorities are understood and properly resourced beyond the marketing org itself.

- Move fluidly between strategy and hands-on execution — this role is built to flex toward wherever the business need is greatest.

About You and What You've Done

- 8+ years of experience spanning product marketing, growth, or business/marketing operations and strategy, ideally including time at a high-growth SaaS, data, or technology company.

- A track record of owning large-scale, cross-functional transformation projects from ambiguity through execution.

- Comfortable operating without a fixed functional lane — genuinely energized by moving between strategy, analytics, and hands-on execution as priorities shift.

- A systems thinker who can diagnose broken or informal processes and redesign them to scale.

- Strong judgment operating with significant autonomy; exercises wide latitude in determining the right approach to critical, undefined assignments.

- Experience operating as a close, trusted partner to a senior leader on strategic initiatives.

- Experience building or running planning cycles, operating cadences, or scorecards for a leadership team, and comfort acting as a proxy for senior leadership in certain settings.

- Strong analytical fluency and comfort getting into the data to inform recommendations.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between detailed execution and clear, executive-level narrative.

- Genuine curiosity about applying AI to marketing and operations, with an interest in evaluating and rolling out new tools and agentic capabilities.

- Depth in B2B product marketing, data or licensing go-to-market, or enterprise growth is a strong plus — several of the first projects sit squarely in that territory.

_Note: We view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. Research shows that underrepresented/marginalized groups are less likely to apply for a job if they feel that they don’t meet 100% of the qualifications. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t satisfy every single bullet on this list! It’s expected that you’ll learn and grow throughout your time at Morning Consult, so if you’re open to building new skills, we’d love to hear from you._

Director, Product Marketing

US/Canada - Remote

Employment Type

Full time

Location Type

Remote

Department

Marketing

Director, Product Marketing

Location: USA (100% Remote)

Canada (100% Remote)

Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend.

We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend.

Product marketing sits at the center of how we're understood in that market, and we're hiring a Director to lead it.

About the role

Procurify is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to define how we compete and win. You'll own the company narrative, the messaging architecture our go-to-market organization builds on, how we segment and prioritize the market, and the analyst relationships that influence how Procurify is understood.

This is a chance to help define Procurify's next stage of growth as the agentic procurement platform. You'll be at the center of translating that strategy into positioning, messaging, assets, and programs that drive demonstrable impact across our go-to-market organization.

This is a senior seat on the marketing leadership team, with full visibility across the company and regular engagement with executives. You'll lead two Product Marketing Managers. You'll raise their craft, sharpen their judgment, and expand what they're capable of owning, building both the team's impact and their careers as leaders in their own right.

This is a true player-coach role. Your PMMs own their product portfolios, and you'll guide their strategy and raise the quality of their work while directly owning company-level and cross-portfolio initiatives yourself. It's hands-on by design: you get the scope and influence of a senior leader while staying close to the craft.

AI fluency is table stakes for this role. We expect AI to be foundational to how you analyze information, build workflows, create and evaluate work, and scale the team's impact without compromising quality.

Key responsibilities

Positioning and market strategy

- Own Procurify's positioning strategy and define how we differentiate in the procurement market.

- Build and maintain the company-level narrative and messaging architecture as the single source of truth across all surfaces, and translate it into positioning teams can execute against.

- Own the AI and agentic narrative: make the platform's intelligence concrete, credible, and differentiated for finance and operations buyers.

- Own market segmentation and use it to direct where we invest and who we talk to.

- Own the voice of the customer with deep customer research and win/loss analysis.

- Use product, customer, funnel, and market data to identify patterns, test assumptions, and turn evidence into clear strategic recommendations.

- Shape Procurify's analyst relations strategy and narrative, building credible relationships with top-tier analyst firms and influencing how the company and category are represented.

- Act as a credible external voice on procurement and the agentic shift through analyst briefings, press, and webinars.

Go-to-market

- Set the execution standard and quality bar for the function, along with the operating rhythms that keep it consistent.

- Own launch strategy across the portfolio and decide which messages and formats get tested in the market, in partnership with demand generation.

- Own the strategy for direct-to-customer communications: launch and product-news emails, in-app posts, in-app tours, and lifecycle journeys.

- Report and analyze product marketing's contribution to pipeline, adoption, and retention.

AI-first practice

- Build an AI-enabled Product Marketing practice that improves the quality, consistency, and scale of the function.

- Establish shared tools, context, and repeatable workflows across core PMM work, and partner with Marketing’s AI specialists to make Product Marketing a model for effective AI-assisted work.

Internal alignment and enablement

- Influence the roadmap, pricing, packaging, and launch sequencing with market, customer, and competitive insight.

- Own the enablement deliverable set for each product portfolio with your PMMs, including positioning one-pagers, battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, and objection handling, maintained as living resources in our library rather than launch-day artifacts.

- Train Sales and Customer Success on messaging, use cases, and differentiation.

- Set the standard for how competitive intelligence gets gathered and used by go-to-market teams.

Team leadership and coaching

- Coach two Product Marketing Managers: raise their craft, give direct feedback, hold a high bar on the work, and map a clear path to their next level.

- Own the team's structure, culture, and operations: the processes, templates, and shared standards that keep output consistent across portfolios, whoever is doing the work.

- Own the team's plan: what it takes on each quarter, what it defers, and how portfolio coverage is split across the two PMMs.

Experience

- 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant Product Marketing leadership experience and direct people management.

- You’ve owned company-level positioning and messaging for a multi-product or complex SaaS platform, including a meaningful repositioning, category shift, or evolution in market narrative.

- You’ve led go-to-market strategy across a product portfolio, from segmentation and launch strategy through sales enablement, customer communications, and market adoption.

- You know how to turn customer, competitive, win/loss, and market insight into decisions on positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and where the business invests.

- You’ve built credibility with senior executives, Sales, Product, Customer Success, customers, and industry analysts, and can influence decisions without relying on organizational authority.

- You’ve built and coached a high-performing Product Marketing team, raised the quality bar for the function, and helped marketers meaningfully grow their craft and careers.

- You’re commercially minded and comfortable measuring Product Marketing against business outcomes, including pipeline, adoption, retention, and competitive performance.

- You’re AI-fluent in practice, not theory. You’ve changed how a team works using AI, built repeatable workflows around it, and can point to meaningful improvements in the quality or scale of the work.

- You are an exceptional writer and storyteller who still does the work yourself. You can turn a complex platform into differentiated, credible language that a CFO can understand and repeat.

- You maintain an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensure it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect your role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

Why Procurify?

We’re building a product that matters.

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

Be empowered to do your best work

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

- Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

- Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

- Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

- Continuous learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

- Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

- Typical Base Salary Range:

  - Canada: $168,000–$210,000 CAD

About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

About the Role

OpenRouter grows because developers find it, try it, and route more of their work through it. More than 10 million users and 250k+ apps process 200T+ tokens on the platform every month, nearly all of it starting in self-serve. You’ll own turning that reach into revenue: more of the right developers discovering OpenRouter, signing up, buying their first credits, and growing their usage.

You’ll run the self-serve growth engine: paid media and sponsorships, AEO/SEO, conversion optimization on key pages and flows, and the measurement and forecasting that keeps it all optimized. That’s roughly 75% of the role. The other 25% is partnering with our enterprise team as an execution and thought partner on demand gen.

This is a Director-level, player/coach role with a paid budget of $5M+ for 2027. In year one you’re hands-on: buying media, shipping tests, building the measurement stack, managing agencies. As the engine proves out, you build the team around it.

What You’ll Do

- Own self-serve revenue growth: build and run the marketing engine that reaches developers at scale, moves them from first touch to signup, first credit purchase, and expanding usage.

- Plan and buy paid media across channels developers respect: search, social, newsletter and podcast/creator sponsorships, audio, OOH, and event sponsorships, spanning awareness and direct response. You own the budget and the agency/vendor bench.

- Own the AEO/SEO roadmap for openrouter.ai: classic organic search plus answer-engine visibility,executing with content, engineering, and outside specialists.

- Run conversion optimization on key pages and flows (homepage, model pages, pricing, signup, credit purchase) in partnership with product and engineering, on a standing experimentation cadence.

- Own measurement for all paid activity: attribution design, incrementality and holdout testing, channel reporting, and the quarterly forecasting and planning cycle for the paid budget.

- Support enterprise demand gen as an execution and thought partner: MQL/MQA generation programs and the measurement connecting marketing touches to pipeline.

What We’re Looking For

- 8+ years in growth or performance marketing, including meaningful time at a developer tools, API-first, or technical B2B SaaS company.

- You’ve been directly accountable for self-serve or usage-based revenue (signup, activation, and spend) as your primary metric.

- You’ve owned an annual multi-channel paid budget of $5M+, or scaled a program from seven figures into that range, and can walk through your CAC, payback math, and the channels you killed.

- Hands-on with the measurement stack: product analytics (PostHog, GA4, Hex, or similar), attribution design, and at least one incrementality or holdout test you designed yourself.

- You’ve owned or directed SEO for a technical product, and you have a working point of view on AEO: what changes when the search result is a ChatGPT answer.

- You’ve built and run CRO/experimentation programs with real statistical discipline: hypothesis, test design, readout, decision.

- Player/coach: comfortable executing solo today and building the function (agencies, contractors, eventual hires) as it scales.

Nice to Have

- You’ve marketed to AI engineers specifically, or you’ve built something against an LLM API yourself (bonus if it was through OpenRouter).

- Brand campaign experience: OOH, audio, or major sponsorships, measured with brand-lift studies or geo holdouts.

- Demand gen or ABM experience feeding an enterprise sales motion.

- Time inside a consumption-pricing business (Twilio, Datadog, Vercel-style) where marketing was judged on usage rather than lead volume.

_If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team._

Compensation Range: $190K - $230K

You check yesterday's numbers and notice that applications from one of our newest states are up 18%. Great. Then you notice conversion on one of the highest-traffic pages dropped 7%. Less great. You start digging. 9:15 AM: You're in a launch meeting for a new state. Paid media wants creative. Content has questions about state-specific messaging. Partnerships thinks there might be a compliance wrinkle. Someone asks, "Are we still on track for launch?" You smile. Yes. You are. You know what's working. You know what's not. And you already have a recommendation for what to do next. 4:00 PM: Surprise! Something changed. A campaign isn't performing. A launch timeline moved. A landing page needs to ship. A partner has a new opportunity. Someone needs a decision. You reprioritize. You make the hard call. You keep moving. Because "we should probably..." isn't really your favorite phrase. "I did." is. 5:00 PM: You look at your launch calendar. Another state is coming. You tweak the playbook based on what you learned today. Because the goal isn't to launch one market successfully. It's to build a repeatable growth engine that makes every launch faster, smarter, and more efficient than the last. And then you shut your laptop. Tomorrow, you'll do it again. Probably with more coffee.
