What You'll Do
You will report into the VP, Commercial Product and Go To Market
Go-To-Market & Vendor Governance
Own the Measurement Narrative: Serve as the definitive technical voice for client and agency management, translating complex attribution frameworks into clear, high-impact business value.
Measurement as a Product: Treat measurement capabilities as a core commercial asset; partner with Sales to transform data insights into packaged media solutions that scale.
Sales Enablement & Decision Tree Design: Co-develop structured decision trees, FAQs, and frameworks to guide Sales and Sales Enablement teams on mapping the right measurement solutions to specific client goals.
Vendor & Commercial Governance: Manage the technical onboarding, benchmarking and financial efficiency of third-party measurement vendors to ensure contract costs directly fuel revenue growth.
Technical Methodologies & Data Science
Causal Experimentation: Guide the data science design, execution, and evaluation of advanced incrementality testing, establishing scientific rigor via Geo-lifts, split-market holdouts, and randomized controlled trials.
MMM Data Architecture: Systematically map and pipeline complex media exposure data to cleanly ingest into global agency holding companies and corporate Marketing Mix Models.
Identity & Privacy Engineering: Own the technical identity roadmap—navigating MAIDs, clean rooms, cookieless identifiers, and privacy compliance (CCPA/GDPR)—to ensure high-fidelity signal capture across the ad stack.
Product Innovation & 3-Year Vision
Close the Product Loop: Funnel behavioral, network, and creative insights directly back to Product Management to inform future core builds (acting as a key stakeholder for initiatives like the Product Manager Atelier).
Scale Multi-Product Frameworks: Design and execute sophisticated measurement for performance tools (e.g., Future Optic, Helix) while expanding capabilities across social, audio/podcasts, and lower-funnel iterations.
Architect the Proprietary Ecosystem: Oversee the 3-year migration from third-party dependencies to an in-house, full-stack ecosystem powered by first-party pixels, predictive models, and custom testing frameworks.
Experience That Will Put You Ahead Of The Curve
Experience
: 4+ years in Marketing Science, Ad Analytics, or Attribution within a digital publisher, advanced measurement vendor, or quantitative media agency.
Agency Ecosystem Fluency
: Deep understanding of major agency holding companies, their workflows, operational RACI matrix configurations, and media-planning vocabulary.
Measurement Mastery
: Strong practical knowledge of MTA, Geo-testing, and MMM, alongside platform attribution algorithms (Meta, Google, DV360) and modern Data Clean Rooms.
Client-Facing Impact
: 2+ years presenting complex data methodologies directly to brands and agencies, with a proven ability to turn technical frameworks into clear, commercial stories.
Technical Stack
: Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools. Hands-on experience with Python or R for custom statistical analysis is highly preferred.
Education
: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.). A Master’s or PhD in Econometrics or Applied Statistics is a strong plus.
Compensation and Benefits
The expected range for this role is $162,000 - $180,000
Uncapped leave, because we trust you to manage your workload and time
When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
Refer a friend and get rewarded when they join Future
Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programs
Opportunity to purchase shares in Future with our Share Incentive Plan
Internal job family level Commercial 3
This is a hybrid role from our New York office, working three days from the office and two from home.

Diversity is central to who we are. We believe different perspectives spark new ideas, fuel creativity, and drive innovation. That's why we're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed.

Description

Pareto Publishing is a fast-growing email-marketing company with an engaged subscriber base of 8 million+, helping financial and investment brands acquire investors through performance-driven email campaigns. We're looking for a highly organized, client-focused Campaign Delivery Manager to own client relationships after the sale and make sure every campaign launches smoothly and delivers outstanding results! :)

This role sits right at the intersection of client service, campaign operations, and account management — you'll take the handoff from Sales and carry the client through onboarding, delivery, and renewal.

Key Responsibilities 🔑

- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients post-signature, owning onboarding and building strong, long-term relationships.
- Coordinate campaign launches across CPA, CPC, dedicated sends, and newsletter sponsorships — making sure assets, targeting, and specs are approved and on track.
- Monitor pacing and delivery throughout the campaign lifecycle, proactively resolving performance concerns and operational bottlenecks.
- Track delivery against KPIs, analyze results, and prepare client-facing performance summaries with optimization recommendations.
- Manage reconciliations, settlement, and invoicing — and grow accounts through renewals and upsell opportunities.

Requirements 📋

- 3+ years in account management, campaign management, client services, or customer success.
- Experience in email marketing, digital advertising, lead generation, or media operations.
- Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns at once.
- Analytical mindset and sharp attention to detail, comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.
- Hands-on experience with performance-based models like CPA and CPC strongly preferred.
- Experience in financial marketing, investor acquisition, or capital-markets campaigns highly desirable.
- Familiarity with email deliverability, audience targeting, and CRM/reporting platforms is a plus.

What to Expect 🚀

- Competitive salary plus performance-based bonus opportunities.
- A high level of ownership and direct client responsibility from day one.
- Exposure to financial services, investor marketing, and digital media.
- A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your work is visible.
- A clear path to grow into senior client-services or operations-leadership roles.

Vouched builds identity verification infrastructure that helps organizations know who they're dealing with - whether that's a patient, a financial customer, an online shopper, or an AI agent acting on someone's behalf. As identity verification needs expand beyond people to include autonomous agents, Vouched is at the center of defining what trust looks like next.
About the Role
We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who thrives on execution — someone who can take a campaign from idea to measured results across email, social, and events without needing much direction along the way. You'll be the person who keeps our always-on marketing motion running smoothly and reports back on what's actually working.
What You'll Do
Execute marketing campaigns across email, social media, and events, from planning through to launch
Own optimization, testing and measurement and reporting for each channel, and use the results to sharpen future campaigns
Build and manage email and lifecycle campaigns, including nurture sequences and product announcements
Support event marketing logistics and promotion, from webinars to in-person or virtual conferences
Maintain the marketing calendar and keep campaigns on track across multiple channels at once
Use HubSpot (or a similar platform) to build campaigns, automate workflows, and track performance
Bring a self-starter, can-do attitude — spot what needs to get done and get it done with minimal oversight
Collaborate with content, design, and performance marketing to keep messaging and campaigns aligned
Requirements
3+ years of experience executing marketing campaigns across email, social, and events
Genuinely self-sufficient — a self-starter who takes ownership without needing close supervision
Comfortable measuring and reporting on campaign performance, and adjusting based on the data
Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and channels at once
A can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude toward getting campaigns live and improving them
Excellent written communication skills; comfortable writing or editing customer-facing copy
Nice to Have
Experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform
Experience marketing to buyers in healthcare, fintech, or eCommerce
Familiarity with agentic AI, identity verification, fraud, trust & safety, or compliance-driven markets
Experience at an early- or growth-stage B2B SaaS company
Benefits
Equity compensation
Remote-first environment
Flexible PTO and 11+ annual company holidays
401k
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Wellness benefits (EAP, LifeHealth Online, One Medical, Perkpot)
Paid parental leave
Pay scale: $90k-$100k OTE
Vouched is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team.
This is a remote role - however, you must be based in the US (US work authorization required)

Who We Are
Sans is on a mission to build the next great consumer hardware brand, with a laser focus on products that help people live healthier lives at home. We started with a category-leading air purifier before expanding to a best-in-class countertop water purifier that actually works to eliminate harmful contaminants – and our product roadmap is just getting started.
We’re a small, ambitious team that believes deeply in our ability to create a meaningful consumer brand. We move fast, learn quickly, and consistently outperform much larger competitors.
Your Role
The Growth team plays a critical role in driving customer acquisition, revenue, and scalable growth across channels. This team is accountable for developing and optimizing performance marketing strategies, creative, and experiments to efficiently reach new customers and expand our impact as we grow.
The Paid Media Manager will own the day-to-day management of millions in monthly ad spend across Meta, Pinterest, and AppLovin — with the opportunity to expand into additional platforms as we scale. They will be responsible for the planning, execution, and optimization of our paid social campaigns, ensuring every dollar is deployed efficiently against our growth and efficiency targets.
This role will report to the Sr. Director of Growth, and will partner with them on forecasting, budget allocation, and high-leverage optimization decisions. This person will also be in close communication with the Creative Strategy team to translate performance signals into actionable creative insights and ideation.The ideal candidate is highly analytical, deeply fluent in paid social platforms, and excited to operate at the intersection of media buying, creative testing, and growth strategy. They bring a scrappy, proactive mindset and thrive in a fast-moving, high-spend environment where small decisions compound into meaningful business outcomes.
Requirements
Responsibilities and Duties
Own day-to-day management of millions in monthly paid social spend across Meta, Pinterest, and AppLovin, with potential expansion to additional platforms (TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, etc.)
Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns to hit aggressive efficiency and volume targets across prospecting and retargeting
Develop and execute structured testing roadmaps across audiences, placements, bidding strategies, and account structures
Partner closely with the Creative Strategy team to translate performance data into creative insights, hooks, angles, and net-new concepts for testing
Collaborate with the Sr. Director of Growth on forecasting, budget pacing, scenario planning, and channel-level optimization decisions
Build and maintain reporting dashboards to monitor performance, surface trends, and communicate results to cross-functional stakeholders
Conduct deep-dive analyses on creative, audience, and funnel performance to identify what's working, what's not, and where to invest next
Manage daily pacing, bid adjustments, and budget reallocations to hit blended CAC, ROAS, and contribution margin goals
Highlight new creative needs based on platform-specific performance gaps and opportunities
Stay ahead of platform updates, beta features, and industry best practices, and translate them into actionable testing opportunities
Own measurement integrity across platforms — including pixel/CAPI health, attribution settings, and incrementality testing
Support broader growth initiatives including landing page testing, offer strategy, and full-funnel optimization in partnership with the Sr. Director of Growth
Qualifications and Skills
Experience:
Bachelor's Degree and/or equivalent work experience in marketing, business, economics, or a related field
5+ years of hands-on paid social buying experience, ideally at a high-growth DTC brand or performance-focused agency
Proven track record managing $1M+ in monthly paid social spend with direct accountability for CAC, ROAS, and revenue targets
Deep expertise in Meta Ads Manager is required; hands-on experience with Pinterest and AppLovin is strongly preferred
Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured creative and audience testing frameworks
Experience with attribution platforms (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox). MMM/incrementality experience is a plus
Startup, DTC, or consumer hardware experience or strong interest is a plus
Interpersonal:
Highly analytical and data-driven – able to move fluidly between campaign-level details and business-level implications
Strong creative instincts – able to interpret performance data and translate it into clear, actionable creative direction
Scrappy and proactive – takes ownership of outcomes, identifies problems early, and drives solutions independently
Strong communication and collaboration skills – able to work effectively with creative, growth, and external partners
Organized and detail-oriented – able to manage high spend, multiple platforms, and competing priorities without dropping the ball
Operates with urgency and judgment – knows when to move fast and when to slow down on high-stakes decisions
Curiosity and eagerness to learn – excited to push the boundaries of paid social performance in a fast-paced environment
Benefits
Hours and Compensation
The anticipated base compensation range for this role will be $100,000 - $120,000 annually, plus discretionary bonus and equity. Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and local market rates.
Job Type: Full-time
Position will be based out of Culver City, Los Angeles (Tu. - Th. in office/Mo. & Fr. remote)
Benefits & Perks
Option for fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
Opportunity to contribute to 401k
Unlimited PTO plus 11+ paid holidays
Monthly wellness stipend

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

Are you a data-driven lifecycle marketer with a passion for customer engagement and the technical chops to strengthen and scale customer lifecycle marketing capabilities? We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our powerhouse team and lead lifecycle strategy and execution across Oportun's product ecosystem and key member moments. You will define and execute programs across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels to drive activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

You are responsible for both strategy and execution. This includes prioritizing lifecycle initiatives across products, ensuring campaigns run reliably, and continuously improving performance through testing, segmentation, personalization, and marketing technology enhancements. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Marketing Technology to deliver timely, compliant, and effective communications. You will also manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and translate business needs into clear data, platform, and execution requirements.

This role will also help advance Oportun's CLM technology capabilities. You will identify and implement opportunities such as new channel expansion, custom event integrations, improved customer data flows, AI-assisted campaign workflows, and automation that makes the CLM program more scalable, personalized, and efficient.

Success in this role means improving key lifecycle metrics across products, building scalable systems, strengthening CLM platform capabilities, and ensuring lifecycle marketing is a reliable, tech-enabled growth lever for the business.

If you're a hands-on marketer with a passion for strategic thinking, lifecycle marketing execution, data-driven decision-making, marketing technology, and customer engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

- You’ll own and optimize the lifecycle roadmap across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and cross-product growth.
- You’ll build, launch, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels.
- You’ll use customer data, behavioral signals, product events, segmentation, and personalization to deliver timely and relevant member experiences.
- You’ll design and improve automated lifecycle journeys that support onboarding, activation, feature adoption, servicing, engagement, and retention.
- You’ll lead structured experimentation, including A/B and holdout testing, to measure incremental impact and improve performance.
- You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data, Design, Content, Legal, Compliance, and Marketing Technology to align priorities and deliver new capabilities.
- You’ll translate lifecycle needs into clear technical requirements, event definitions, data requirements, use cases, and implementation priorities.
- You’ll help advance Oportun’s CLM technology capabilities through new channels, custom events, improved data flows, platform enhancements, and automation.

You’ll own digital marketing campaigns that drive QCon registrations, certification enrollments, and InfoQ Live registrations. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where you’ll write copy, manage email campaigns and audience segments, run paid advertising, analyze performance, and continuously improve our marketing processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who enjoys building repeatable campaigns, reaching new audiences, and writing compelling content for a technical audience of senior software engineers and architects. Experience with marketing conferences, certifications, courses, or professional development is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

- Own end-to-end demand generation campaigns for QCon, certifications, and InfoQ Live.
- Create email sequences, landing page copy, social posts, and paid ad copy.
- Manage audience segmentation, exclusions, automations, and email campaigns.
- Plan and execute organic and paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, and social channels.
- Track and report weekly on registrations, enrollments, cost per registration, and revenue.
- Maintain marketing dashboards, trackers, and campaign calendars.
- Test new channels and strategies to reach audiences beyond our existing database.
- Build repeatable campaign processes and continuously improve performance.
- Coordinate campaigns across products while managing shared audiences and contact limits.
- Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, content creation, testing, analysis, and automation.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in digital marketing and demand generation, with a strong focus on email and lifecycle marketing.
- Proven experience driving measurable registrations, enrollments, leads, or sales.
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.
- Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting skills for technical audiences.
- Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, and organic social media.
- Strong analytical and reporting skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
- A proactive approach to staying current with marketing platforms, tools, trends, and best practices.
- Comfortable using AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity.

Remote Work Requirements

- Must reside in Europe
- Able to work in a full-time remote position
- Able to work in overlap with our core global office hours (9 AM - 1 PM EST)
- Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-office setup
- Willing and able to travel to the USA or Europe 1–3 times per year for conferences and company meetings

Why work at C4Media

- Work from home - always: We are a remote-first and remote-always team that has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that.
- Travel the world: C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences & team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip.

- Learn something new: C4Media’s culture is one of learning & mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it.
- Make friends across the world: Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life.
- Support wellbeing: In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness.
- Generous paid time off: In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education.

_Qualified candidates are to submit their applications on our C4Media website. Only candidates who submit their applications in English will be considered for this role (including resume)._

Hi there, I'm Mehak, interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team.

About the role

As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager, you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

- Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

- Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets.

- Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots.

- Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor.

- Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions.

- Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language.

- Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins.

What you’ll bring

We're looking for someone who:

- Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

- Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment.

- Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS.

  - _We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far._
- Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager.

- Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite.

- Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly.

- Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use.

- Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply.

Bonus skills

While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have:

- Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution.

- Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM.

- Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget.

- Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels.

- Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool

What’s in it for you?

Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process.

- Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world

- Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs)

- Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.

* _Check out the countries we currently hire from_ _here_

- Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

- Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities

- Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches

- Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone!

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

- Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
- Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
- Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
- Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

- An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive.

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

- Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against
- Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current
- Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey
- Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution

- Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership
- Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments
- Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale
- Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution

Sales Enablement & Sales Plays

- Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases.
- Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling).
- Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions
- Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments

Analyst & Review Site Strategy

- Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).
- Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.
- Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization
- Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings

Website & CRO Performance

- Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide
- Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance
- Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows
- Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data

Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.

- Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership
- Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration
- Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.
- Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.
- Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.
- Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment.
- Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.
- Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy.
- Exceptional communication skills and executive presence.
- Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence.
- Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus.
- Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure._

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

You can find more information about our privacy policyhere._

- A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.

- Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.

- Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.

- The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.

- A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

- Translate strategic direction into positioning, messaging, launch roadmaps, and measurable GTM outcomes for each product and initiative.

- Act as the connective tissue between strategy and execution, ensuring high-quality delivery across every workstream.

- Provide thought leadership on narrative development, competitive positioning, and content strategy as the portfolio and brand initiative scale.

- Contribute to future marketing team design as the division builds out brand and agency sales.

_Brand & Agency Sales Growth_

- Build the new narrative, messaging, and marketing plan required to support Xsolla Ads’ expansion into brand and agency sales.

- Partner with the Currency team on the company’s strategic brand initiative, helping define and roll out Xsolla’s new positioning.

- Build the messaging foundation and sales enablement that the emerging brand sales team will carry to market.

- Translate the new brand positioning into a consistent story across products, sales, and external communications.

_Messaging & Cross-Product Narrative_

- Own the cross-product narrative that ties the portfolio into one coherent story across Choice, ID+ and Backpack, Rewards, and Ads.

- Build core messaging frameworks, value propositions, and proof points for each audience, keeping them consistent across web, sales, PR, and events.

- Make complex and emerging concepts, including Web3, on-chain attribution, and zero-party data, legible and compelling to non-technical buyers.

- Develop audience- and persona-specific demand stories for both gaming and non-gaming ICPs, with alignment and feedback from BD.

_Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership_

- Own the marketing operating model across the portfolio, including campaign intake, prioritization, GTM documentation, and approvals.

- Maintain GTM calendars and a coordinated launch and event drumbeat across the year, and surface trends, risks, and optimization opportunities to the VP of Marketing.

- Coordinate with the central Xsolla marketing team to ensure division campaigns stay consistent with brand standards and broader GTM strategy.

- 7–8 years of experience in marketing or GTM, with a proven track record of owning product launches and positioning end to end.

- Mastery of positioning, messaging, and narrative — able to turn complex, multi-product technology into a clear story for multiple audiences.

- Experience launching products across both B2B and B2C, and to multiple ICPs (developers, marketers, brand advertisers).

- Strong cross-functional leadership in a matrixed organization; comfortable being the bridge between product, sales, and marketing.

- Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to adapt voice across executive narratives, sales enablement, and customer-facing copy.

- Comfort with emerging and technical categories — Web3 and on-chain, identity and zero-party data, ad tech, and loyalty — and the ability to make them legible to non-technical buyers.

- Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage multiple concurrent launches without things falling through the cracks.

- Collaborative team player comfortable interfacing with product, creative, growth, BD, and sales stakeholders.

_Preferred_

- Experience in gaming or games-adjacent industries.

- Background in ad tech, programmatic, or loyalty and rewards.

- Web3, crypto, or identity and privacy marketing experience.

- Experience standing up sales enablement for a new or newly formed sales team.

- Background in B2B SaaS GTM strategy.

$160,000 - $185,000 a year

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Director of Marketing who is a sharp strategic storyteller and a hands-on operator to join our Advertising & Rewards division. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own positioning and go-to-market at the intersection of several high-growth opportunities: a B2B advertising business, a B2C rewards app, a zero-party data and rewards platform, an on-chain identity and attribution layer, and a major strategic brand initiative.

Strong narrative development, messaging, and launch GTM skills are essential, along with experience turning complex, multi-product technology into clear, compelling stories for very different audiences — game developers, app marketers, and brand advertisers. The ability to build go-to-market from the ground up, owning positioning and enablement end to end, will be key to your success in this role.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

_Strategic Leadership & Portfolio GTM_

- Co-develop and operationalize an integrated go-to-market strategy across the Advertising & Rewards portfolio, supporting Xsolla Ads, Rewards, Xsolla Choice, and Xsolla ID+ and Backpack.

- Translate strategic direction into positioning, messaging, launch roadmaps, and measurable GTM outcomes for each product and initiative.

- Act as the connective tissue between strategy and execution, ensuring high-quality delivery across every workstream.

- Provide thought leadership on narrative development, competitive positioning, and content strategy as the portfolio and brand initiative scale.

- Contribute to future marketing team design as the division builds out brand and agency sales.

_Brand & Agency Sales Growth_

- Build the new narrative, messaging, and marketing plan required to support Xsolla Ads’ expansion into brand and agency sales.

- Partner with the Currency team on the company’s strategic brand initiative, helping define and roll out Xsolla’s new positioning.

- Build the messaging foundation and sales enablement that the emerging brand sales team will carry to market.

- Translate the new brand positioning into a consistent story across products, sales, and external communications.

_Messaging & Cross-Product Narrative_

- Own the cross-product narrative that ties the portfolio into one coherent story across Choice, ID+ and Backpack, Rewards, and Ads.

- Build core messaging frameworks, value propositions, and proof points for each audience, keeping them consistent across web, sales, PR, and events.

- Make complex and emerging concepts, including Web3, on-chain attribution, and zero-party data, legible and compelling to non-technical buyers.

_Sales Enablement & Content_

- Translate positioning into the assets the field needs: decks, one-pagers, case studies, demand stories, web and landing-page copy, and event narratives.

- Equip BD and sales teams, including the advertiser outreach team and the new brand sales team, with the assets, talk tracks, and competitive positioning they need to win.

- Develop audience- and persona-specific demand stories for both gaming and non-gaming ICPs, with alignment and feedback from BD.

_Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership_

- Own the marketing operating model across the portfolio, including campaign intake, prioritization, GTM documentation, and approvals.

- Maintain GTM calendars and a coordinated launch and event drumbeat across the year, and surface trends, risks, and optimization opportunities to the VP of Marketing.

- Partner across product, growth, design, BD, legal, finance, and central marketing to keep launches on-brand and on time.

- Coordinate with the central Xsolla marketing team to ensure division campaigns stay consistent with brand standards and broader GTM strategy.

_Required_

- 7–8 years of experience in marketing or GTM, with a proven track record of owning product launches and positioning end to end.

- Mastery of positioning, messaging, and narrative — able to turn complex, multi-product technology into a clear story for multiple audiences.

- Experience launching products across both B2B and B2C, and to multiple ICPs (developers, marketers, brand advertisers).

- Strong cross-functional leadership in a matrixed organization; comfortable being the bridge between product, sales, and marketing.

- Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to adapt voice across executive narratives, sales enablement, and customer-facing copy.

- Comfort with emerging and technical categories — Web3 and on-chain, identity and zero-party data, ad tech, and loyalty — and the ability to make them legible to non-technical buyers.

- Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage multiple concurrent launches without things falling through the cracks.

- Collaborative team player comfortable interfacing with product, creative, growth, BD, and sales stakeholders.

_Preferred_

- Experience in gaming or games-adjacent industries.

- Background in ad tech, programmatic, or loyalty and rewards.

- Web3, crypto, or identity and privacy marketing experience.

- Experience standing up sales enablement for a new or newly formed sales team.

- Background in B2B SaaS GTM strategy.

Follow up and re-engage stalled or unresponsive leads and process opt-outs across channels. Maintain accurate CRM records, lead stages, ownership, activities, and data hygiene. Build and maintain CRM workflows, automations, and outbound tool integrations. Build, launch, and manage multi-step email and LinkedIn campaigns, including nurture and re-engagement flows. Configure sequences, schedules, sending limits, and sender assignments while monitoring campaign health. QA outbound communications for personalization, links, messaging, sender details, and compliance. Manage sending domains, mailboxes, DNS authentication, warm-up, deliverability, and sender account health. Build, clean, deduplicate, and enrich targeted prospect lists using data and scraping tools. Prepare calling lists and manage data credits across tools. Deliver weekly performance reporting and maintain CRM dashboards and live campaign trackers. Administer GTM tools, accounts, subscriptions, and credits. Document recurring processes and support sales with data, lead context, and CRM fixes. Strong CRM administration skills. Experience managing lead replies and sales handoffs. Working knowledge of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, and bounce management. Experience with list building and data enrichment. Advanced spreadsheet skills. Strong attention to detail and clear written English. Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Instantly, and a LinkedIn automation tool such as Aimfox or similar. US healthcare or staffing outbound experience is a plus. Knowledge of CAN-SPAM and TCPA basics for US outreach is a plus. Experience with Apollo, SignalHire, FullEnrich, Apify, Floqer, remote.co, Make.com or Zapier, and JustCall is preferred.

About AutoFi

AutoFi is the leading provider of digital commerce technology that powers the sales and finance experiences for the most innovative brands and dealers in automotive. The AutoFi platform enables a more transactional buying experience with $4B in funded loans processed through AutoFi annually. AutoFi’s dynamic selling platform empowers dealers to sell vehicles more efficiently and profitably, both online and in the showroom. We are funded for years of future growth and backed by investors including Crosslink Capital, Santander Holdings USA, SVB Financial Group, Ford, BMW iVentures and JP Morgan Chase.

Our team is diverse - spread out across the U.S. and Canada, we have backgrounds from finance and technology as well as deep experience in all areas of the auto space. We’re empathetic, gritty, curious, and humble owners of this business and are supported by some of the biggest names in the auto and financial industries as commercial partners. We’ve never been more excited about the opportunity in front of us to help transition the auto industry from offline to online. If changing a trillion-dollar industry sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you.

For more information, visit www.autofi.com.

About the Role

AutoFi is looking for a versatile Digital Marketing & Creative Manager who can bring ideas to life across digital channels.

This isn't a traditional graphic design role. We're looking for a well-rounded marketer who combines strong creative instincts with hands-on digital marketing skills and is comfortable working across design, video, web, social media and campaign execution.

You'll work closely with our Content Marketing Manager and Head of Marketing to develop and execute campaigns across AutoFi's website, social channels, email programs, events and sales initiatives.

The right person is comfortable moving between disciplines. One day you may be creating campaign graphics or editing a customer video; the next you may be building a WordPress landing page, publishing social content or helping launch a new product campaign.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is creative but practical, who enjoys making things but also understands why they're being made.

You should be equally comfortable starting with a blank canvas and jumping into an existing project that needs to get across the finish line.

You'll have room to be creative, but you'll also be part of a small marketing team where everyone contributes beyond a single specialty.

Above all, we're looking for someone who likes to learn, experiment and get things done.

Responsibilities

- Develop creative assets for marketing campaigns across digital, social, email, web, sales enablement and events
- Create and edit graphics, presentations, infographics, customer stories and other marketing materials
- Edit short-form and long-form video content for LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other channels
- Help manage and publish content across AutoFi's social media channels in partnership with the Content Marketing Manager
- Create social-first content by turning interviews, customer stories, product demonstrations and long-form content into engaging short-form assets
- Build, update and maintain pages on AutoFi.com using WordPress and WordPress content plug-ins
- Create and update landing pages supporting campaigns, product launches, events and partner programs
- Collaborate with the Content Marketing Manager to bring campaign concepts and stories to life visually
- Support email campaigns with creative development, formatting and execution
- Maintain brand consistency across marketing materials while continually finding new ways to evolve AutoFi's visual storytelling
- Support event marketing, including booth graphics, signage, presentations, digital promotion and supporting collateral
- Partner with sales and customer teams to develop presentations, one-sheets and other sales enablement materials
- Use AI-powered creative and marketing tools to accelerate content development and production
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously and move quickly from concept to execution
- Track performance across digital and social content and use results to improve future creative

Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, creative marketing or a similar role
- Strong visual design skills with experience creating professional digital marketing assets
- Experience with tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Figma or similar creative platforms
- Experience editing video for digital and social media
- Experience working with WordPress or another content management system
- Experience managing or publishing content across social platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube
- Strong understanding of how creative needs to adapt across different digital channels and formats
- Ability to take a project from idea through execution with limited direction
- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
- Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across areas of marketing rather than operating within a narrow specialty

Desired Qualifications

- Experience working in B2B SaaS
- Automotive industry experience
- Experience building digital landing pages
- Basic understanding of SEO and website optimization
- Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, HubSpot or similar marketing automation tools
- Experience creating motion graphics or animated digital content
- Familiarity with performance marketing and paid social creative
- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and AI-powered creative tools to accelerate marketing production

$100,000 - $120,000 a year

What's in it for you:

- We offer full training and a competitive total rewards package along with great benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision coverage - 100% premium coverage for employee / 50+% for dependents

- Flexible work hours

- Remote environment

- Competitive pay

- Visionary leadership team

- Growth opportunities within a dynamic culture

- Wellness & cultural initiatives (fitness challenges, wellness webinars, virtual games, regional activities, etc.)

- Up to $1K per year for employee professional development

- Stock options - we are all owners!

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience and qualifications and local market conditions. Please note, the foregoing salary range does not reflect an employee’s total compensation package, which may include bonus, company equity, and health benefits.

Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.
Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.
The Role
We're looking for an experienced Search Lead to join our growing marketing team. You'll own the strategy and day-to-day execution of our paid search program, translating high-level growth goals into world-class campaigns that drive qualified leads and new members. As Search Lead, you'll partner closely with the marketing, planning, and analytics teams to build and optimize the paid search campaigns that fuel Facet's growth.
In this role, you'll manage campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads — including Search and Performance Max — while owning conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting so every dollar of spend is working as hard as possible. You'll lead keyword and search-term audits, build exclusion strategies to protect budget from low-quality traffic, and design tests that continually improve performance. You'll also be a hands-on mentor, training and coaching teammates so the whole team executes flawlessly.
If you're a paid search expert who thrives on turning data into decisions and enjoys being the go-to voice on search strategy, we'd love to meet you!
What You'll Do
Partner with senior marketing leadership to translate growth strategy into paid search campaign plans, and own execution across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max) and Microsoft Ads, plus emerging paid media channels.
Lead keyword, search-term, and negative keyword audits across the account, building and maintaining exclusion strategies to protect budget as spend scales.
Optimize tCPA and tROAS bidding strategies with a strong understanding of bidding mechanics and signal quality.
Use Google Ads Editor, Microsoft Ads Editor, scripts, or APIs to make and audit bulk account changes.
Build and own a testing roadmap for landing page design and cohesion, alongside ad creative and bidding strategy tests, to continually increase conversion rates across search campaigns.
Own campaign, budget, and performance reporting; deliver clear, timely analysis and recommendations to stakeholders.
Serve as a liaison between search and other marketing channels to support a cohesive, multi-channel strategy.
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on paid search experience, ideally within an agency environment managing multiple accounts.
Deep expertise in Google Ads, including Search, Performance Max, and Smart Bidding.
Experience with Google Ads Editor, scripts, or APIs for bulk campaign management.
Strong experience troubleshooting conversion tracking, GA4, GTM, and attribution issues.
Experience identifying and excluding fraudulent or low-quality traffic sources.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and complex formulas.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
Basic management skills — setting expectations, training others, delegating tasks, and providing feedback.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with strong attention to detail; dependable, organized, and able to work independently.
Preferred Qualifications
7+ years of Google Ads experience; Microsoft Ads and Meta experience a plus.
Experience conducting in-depth campaign and pipeline analysis to inform strategy.
Strong executive presence, with the ability to pitch and present recommendations confidently to senior stakeholders.
Background in financial services or another regulated industry.
Ability to multitask and handle other duties as assigned.
Benefits
Competitive Compensation: $130,000 - $160,000 + bonus
Ownership: Equity in a rapidly growing company on the path to becoming the "Next Great Financial Services Company".
Flexibility: Remote-first culture—work from anywhere in the U.S..
Time Off: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO).
Comprehensive Benefits and Perks: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, disability, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursement, and education reimbursement programs.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any.
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere.
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like
Own a set of DTC accounts
as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship.
There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything.
Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses.
Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing.
The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash.
Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed.
Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking.
GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.
Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs.
Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
You are a fit if
You have done this with real money.
Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack
, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build.
This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.
You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers.
You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.
Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
You are not a fit if
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
Benefits
Why this role is exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Manager, Growth & Customer Marketing

Location:Salt Lake City, UTCompany:ClearGov

Description:

Job Description

Job Description

About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow. Our Core Values

- Be Clear & Credible
  - We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
- Be Human
  - We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
- Be Better Together
  - We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
- Be Honourable/Honorable
  - We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
- Be Connected
  - We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.

What Makes You a Great Fit

- You take ownership and follow through
- You communicate clearly and effectively
- You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
- You learn quickly and adapt as things change
- You care about the team, not just your own work
- You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Manager, Growth & Customer Marketing to lead a team of two and own ClearGov's full-funnel growth motion — from a prospect's first touch through expansion revenue with existing customers. You'll manage and develop a team of two: one teammate focused on inbound (SEO/AEO) and net-new ABM/ABX campaigns, the other on customer marketing for cross-sell and upsell. You inherit both with real runway to grow in scope and title as the team's results build.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy, coach your team, and own the numbers — while staying hands-on with the highest-leverage campaigns and content yourself.

We need someone who is AI-forward by default: you use AI tools to move faster on content, targeting, SEO/AEO research, and reporting as a matter of course, and you build that habit into how your team works, not just how you work. You're proactive — you spot the SEO gap, the underperforming segment, or the expansion signal in the data before anyone points it out, and you act on it.

Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership

- Hire (as needed), coach, and manage a team of 2 marketers — one owning acquisition (inbound/SEO/AEO, ABM/ABX), one owning customer marketing (cross-sell/upsell) — with regular 1:1s, clear goals, and a development plan that gives each a real path to grow.
- Set quarterly growth marketing strategy and OKRs spanning net-new pipeline and expansion revenue; report results to marketing leadership.
- Operate as a player-coach: personally lead ClearGov's highest-priority campaigns and strategic accounts while delegating day-to-day execution to your team.
- Proactively surface and act on growth opportunities across the funnel — SEO/AEO gaps, underperforming ABM segments, expansion or churn-risk signals in customer health data — rather than waiting for them to be flagged.

Acquisition & Demand Generation

- Own ClearGov's inbound strategy — SEO and AEO (optimizing for AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, in addition to traditional search) — to grow organic visibility and traffic.
- Build and run ABM/ABX programs for net-new prospects, coordinating email, webinars, social, and content into unified account-based campaigns.
- Partner with Sales to align target account lists, campaign timing, and lead hand-off criteria for ABM-sourced pipeline.

Customer Marketing

- Own the full post-sale marketing motion — customer touchpoints (newsletter, product launch announcements, webinars), in-app announcements, and expansion/cross-sell campaigns from audience segmentation through performance measurement.
- Build and manage ClearGov's customer reference and advocacy program; lead the creation of case studies, video testimonials, and social proof.
- Track and report on expansion campaign performance — influenced pipeline, conversion rates, and contribution to upsell/cross-sell revenue.

AI & Ways of Working

- Use AI tools daily to speed up content production, campaign personalization, SEO/AEO research, and reporting — and build this into how your team operates, not just how you work individually.
- Bring a testing mindset: run experiments across channels and let data decide what gets more investment.

Critical Skills/Experience:

- 5–7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, including 1–2+ years directly managing people — this is a people-management role from day one, not a step toward one.
- Full-funnel growth marketing experience with a track record you can show numbers for — growing net-new pipeline (SEO/AEO, ABM/ABX, demand gen) and growing expansion revenue (NRR, cross-sell/upsell).
- Hands-on SEO experience and working knowledge of AEO/answer-engine optimization — how content gets discovered by both traditional search and AI answer engines.
- Experience building and running ABM/ABX programs across email, webinars, and social; familiarity with intent/ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar) a plus.
- Demonstrated, regular use of AI tools in a marketing workflow — content generation, personalization, research, or reporting — not just occasional experimentation.
- Hands-on proficiency with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar) and comfort using CRM data (Salesforce preferred) to segment audiences and measure performance.
- Strong content and storytelling skills across formats — case studies, campaign copy, webinar scripts, video.
- Experience in a SaaS environment; GovTech or public sector experience is a plus, but not required.

Compensation:

- In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $155,000 - $185,000 USD or $130,000 - $155,000 CAD, and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

- Remote and flexible work environment
- Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
- Collaborative, high-performing team
- Competitive compensation and benefits
- Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

- Medical, dental & vision insurance
- FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
- Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
- Life + disability insurance (Canada)
- 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
- 10 company holidays
- 3 wellness days
- Paid vacation time off
- Sick and safe time off
- Paid parental leave
- Paid bereavement leave
- Paid jury duty + civic service leave
- Employee assistance program
- 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
- Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply

Ready to join us? Apply online today!

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
