Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full-time, long-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Demand Generation Manager to build and execute integrated programs that create pipeline, engage buying groups, and help accelerate opportunities through the funnel. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a strategic, analytical marketer who can translate growth priorities into coordinated programs across paid media, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll own demand program strategy and execution, direct our paid media agency, and continuously use performance data to determine what we should test, optimize, and scale. You’ll work closely with Content Strategy, Product Marketing, Events, Marketing Operations, Sales, and agency partners to connect audiences, content, and channels into cohesive buyer experiences that drive measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Drive Pipeline Across the Funnel

- Build and execute integrated demand campaigns that generate new pipeline, engage buying groups, and accelerate existing opportunities.

- Develop distinct strategies for pipeline creation and acceleration, tailoring audiences, content, channels, and calls to action based on where buyers are in their journey.

- Partner with Sales to understand account and pipeline priorities and identify opportunities for targeted engagement.

Own Digital Channel Strategy & Performance

- Own the strategy and performance of paid media, email, nurture, web, and emerging demand channels, connecting them into cohesive cross-channel programs.

- Direct agency execution across paid media and email, setting audience, channel, investment, testing, and performance expectations while holding partners accountable to pipeline outcomes.

- Own paid media, email, and nurture strategy and performance, continuously optimizing audience segmentation, engagement, conversion, and progression through the funnel.

- Identify and test new channels, tactics, and approaches to expand reach and improve demand performance.

Build Integrated Campaigns

- Partner with Content Strategy to jointly develop campaigns, with you bringing audience, channel, funnel, and performance insights and Content Strategy bringing content strategy, narrative, and format expertise.

- Partner with Product Marketing to connect buyer, market and competitive insights to audience and demand strategies, while sharing campaign performance insights that inform future messaging and go-to-market decisions.

- Extend Events and other Marketing programs through pre- and post-event digital engagement that maximizes their pipeline impact.

- Partner with Marketing Operations to leverage standardized campaign processes, tracking, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that improve execution and scale.

Measure, Experiment & Optimize

- Own campaign and channel performance against pipeline and revenue goals, using funnel and channel-level metrics to continuously optimize investment and execution.

- Analyze performance to identify audience, content, channel, and conversion opportunities and turn insights into actionable recommendations.

- Develop hypotheses, run experiments and determine where to optimize investment.

- Use AI to accelerate campaign planning, personalization, experimentation, analysis, and optimization, and partner with Marketing Operations to turn successful approaches into scalable workflows.

Requirements

- 5–8 years of B2B demand generation, growth marketing, digital marketing, or related experience, preferably in healthcare/health tech or another complex B2B environment.

- Demonstrated experience building integrated demand programs that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

- Strong knowledge of paid media and email strategy and performance, with experience effectively managing agencies or external partners.

- Strong analytical skills and experience using funnel and campaign data to diagnose performance, develop hypotheses, and make investment recommendations.

- Hands-on experience using AI to improve campaign development, personalization, analysis, experimentation, or marketing workflows.

- Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, with the ability to turn strategy into action and independently drive programs forward.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll build a repeatable demand engine that creates pipeline while increasing engagement across the full buyer journey. You’ll bring together audience, content, channels, data, and experimentation to continuously improve performance—and help us scale demand generation as Artera expands into new audiences and go-to-market motions.

$130,000 - $170,000 a year

This compensation range is for candidates who will be based out of our Santa Barbara, CA or Seattle, WA offices. This role also comes with a 10% annual bonus, equity, and various benefits.

OUR APPROACH TO WORK LOCATION

At Artera, we believe the best work happens when people are truly connected. Our AI services model has shown what’s possible when small, focused teams move fast together — the speed of collaboration, pace of career growth, and quality of what we build can become stronger when teams share space. As we grow, we want every new teammate to feel part of an in-person community from day one.

That’s why we are focusing our U.S. hiring in three cities, where we are investing in offices and building strong local teams:

- Santa Barbara, CA (Our HQ)
- Seattle, WA
- Kansas City, KS/MO

Unless a role’s posting states otherwise, new U.S. roles are based in one of these three cities, and candidates should reside in (or be willing to relocate to) one of these areas. Each location follows an in-person schedule that reflects how our local teams work best; we’ll walk you through what to expect for your specific role and city during the interview process.

Focusing on offices and hiring in a few locations, rather than spreading thin across many cities, lets us invest deeply in each one so every team has real community, mentorship, and momentum in person.

WORKING AT ARTERA

Company benefits - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term & long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k) and more!

Career development - Manager development resources, employee development funds

Generous time off - Company holidays, Winter & Summer break, and flexible time off

Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) - We believe that everyone should belong at their workplace. Our ERGs are available for identifying employees or allies to join.

DATA PRIVACY

Tenable is seeking a talented and dynamic product marketing leader to help extend the company’s leadership across the cloud security (CNAPP) and operational technology (OT) security markets.

Tenable is the Exposure Management company. More than 40,000 organizations around the world rely on us to help them understand and reduce cybersecurity risk. Our goal is to arm every organization, no matter how large or small, with the visibility and insight to answer four critical questions at all times: Where are we exposed? Where should we prioritize based on risk? Are we reducing our exposure over time? How do we compare to our peers?

In this role, you will lead product marketing for Tenable’s Cloud Exposure (CNAPP) and Operational Technology (OT) solutions, with Product Marketing Managers aligned to each area reporting to you. - Ensure cloud and OT positioning reinforces Tenable’s overall exposure management platform narrative
- Create clear and compelling content for sales collateral, solution briefs, blog posts, website, webcasts, trade shows, and related activities to drive market demand and awareness for both businesses
- Identify key technology partnership / co-marketing opportunities and new routes to market
- Lead new product and solution launches across cloud security and OT
- Take ownership of results by measuring the effectiveness of campaigns and launch activities with data-driven insights and performance tracking
- Actively participate in analyst relations and public relations initiatives
- Participate in webcasts, events and other demand generation activities
- Guide and contribute to sales and partner enablement across both product areas
- Serve as a voice of the sales team to the product development organization
- Manage and develop Product Marketing Managers aligned to cloud security and OT, including setting priorities and ensuring alignment across both go-to-market strategies
- Recruit, onboard and train new hires
- Provide mentorship, guidance and career development to members of the team
- Create an inclusive, supportive environment where all team members can do their best work
- Evaluate performance of the team, including quarterly performance feedback for each team member; complete annual reviews and recommend rewards (merit/promotion/equity) based on performance for the review period
- Partner with manager on budget requests and spending for strategy and team development needs
- Provide input on yearly budget for planned strategy as well as for the team (T&E, etc.)
- Must have ability to travel in the US up to 20% of time

What You’ll Need:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
- 12+ years of high-tech product marketing or similar experience; 7+ years’ experience as a direct people manager
- Hybrid: Ability to commute to our Columbia, MD headquarters OR Boston, MA office – 3 days per week.
- Demonstrable knowledge of cloud security and vulnerability management trends, along with working knowledge of the operational technology (OT) field and broader trends in OT-heavy industries such as manufacturing and utilities
- Your written and oral communication skills are superb, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to a variety of audiences
- You are able to collaborate in a highly matrixed environment with many different stakeholders, including all levels of management
- You have the ability to blend strategic thinking with creative execution
- You possess excellent organizational skills and strong follow-through
- You thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where change is the norm and the bar for quality is set high
- You have the capacity to balance multiple projects with aggressive deadlines at the same time

And Ideally:

- Master’s degree
- Working knowledge of both the CNAPP/cloud security market and the OT security landscape, including relevant compliance frameworks

Title: Director, Global Field & Channel Marketing

Location: United States; Remote, CST/EST or Canada

Experience: Director

Job Function: Marketing

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer & Network Security

About the position

The Director, Global Field & Channel Marketing is responsible for developing and executing global field marketing strategies that drive pipeline growth and accelerate revenue, while collaborating with the Director of Channel Marketing to support channel priorities and partner engagement. This leader owns field-sourced and field-influenced pipeline performance across regions and partners closely with Sales, RevOps, Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Channel teams to align marketing investments with business outcomes. The role leads a team of Field & Channel Marketing Managers and establishes scalable planning frameworks and playbooks that enable global consistency while supporting local market needs.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Revenue Marketing

- Global Field Marketing Strategy: Define and execute global field marketing strategies aligned to corporate growth objectives, pipeline targets, and revenue goals, while supporting channel priorities in partnership with the Director of Channel Marketing.
- Pipeline Ownership & Revenue Accountability: Own field-sourced and field-influenced pipeline contribution, with programs designed to create, progress, and accelerate opportunities across target segments and geographies; support partner-sourced pipeline through aligned channel programs.
- ABM & Territory Marketing: Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Revenue Marketing to develop account-based marketing programs, territory plans, whitespace strategies, and regional growth initiatives for named, strategic, and customer accounts.
- Global Center of Excellence: Build scalable planning frameworks, playbooks, campaign models, reporting standards, and best practices that drive consistent global execution while enabling regional adaptation.
- Market Insight: Use customer, competitive, and market insights to guide regional strategy, program design, and investment decisions.

Campaigns, Events & Executive Engagement

- Integrated Campaign Leadership: Lead integrated regional programs across events, digital, content, partner, and outbound channels to drive engagement and pipeline growth.
- Field Event Strategy: Set strategy for major conferences, regional events, roadshows, webinars, and customer experiences, partnering closely with the Event Marketing Manager on logistics and execution.
- Executive Engagement: Develop and scale high-value programs including advisory boards, executive roundtables, customer councils, leadership dinners, and strategic experiences that engage buying committees and accelerate enterprise opportunities.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of field and channel marketing professionals, setting clear objectives and fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Sales & GTM Alignment: Serve as the senior marketing partner to regional sales leaders and establish recurring planning, forecasting, and performance reviews aligned to territory priorities, target accounts, pipeline goals, and business outcomes.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Success, RevOps, Channel, and Sales leadership to ensure coordinated go-to-market execution and a strong feedback loop from the field.

Partner Ecosystem Growth

- Channel Marketing Collaboration: Collaborate with the Director of Channel Marketing to support channel strategy and execute aligned regional co-marketing programs that expand reach, strengthen partner engagement, and contribute to through-partner pipeline.

Budget, Performance & Innovation

- Budget Management & ROI Optimization: Own and forecast global field marketing budgets, allocating resources against the highest-impact regional and business priorities.
- Performance Measurement & Analytics: Partner with RevOps to track performance against established targets and measurement frameworks, analyze pipeline contribution, opportunity progression, deal acceleration, attribution, and ROI, and translate insights into recommendations for leadership.
- AI & Marketing Innovation: Champion AI-enabled marketing, intent data, predictive analytics, and modern MarTech to improve targeting, personalization, operational efficiency, and program performance.

Skills and Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including global or multi-region field marketing leadership within enterprise SaaS; cybersecurity experience strongly preferred.
- Proven experience owning or materially influencing pipeline and revenue targets, with accountability for field-sourced and field-influenced results and experience supporting partner-sourced outcomes.
- Demonstrated success developing account-based marketing programs and territory strategies for enterprise and strategic accounts.
- Experience directly leading and developing field marketing managers, including responsibility for team structure, priorities, performance, and growth.
- Hands-on experience building and executing field strategies across multiple regions and countries, with the ability to balance global consistency and local market requirements.
- Strong partnership with Sales leadership, RevOps, Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Channel teams to drive measurable go-to-market outcomes.
- Experience developing executive engagement programs and managing major conferences, regional events, partner activations, and customer experiences.
- Demonstrated ability to manage substantial budgets, forecast investments, assess ROI, and communicate performance and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Fluency with CRM, marketing automation, intent and predictive-data platforms, event technology, analytics, and AI-enabled marketing tools.
- Outstanding strategic, operational, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead through influence in a fast-paced global environment.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:

- Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
- Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
- Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
- Competitive time off globally.
- Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
- DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
- The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
- Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
- Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
- Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
- Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:

Trust is paramount.

_We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business._

Customers are core.

_We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own._

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.

_The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve._

We deliver with agility .

_We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals._

United by respect .

_Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities._

Teams make “it” happen.

_Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one._

Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems

Company: Valsoft Corporation

About KidKare
The people who care for and feed children every day have enough on their plates. Their software shouldn't add to it.
For more than 30 years, KidKare has built technology for the people behind childcare and child nutrition, helping them spend less time on paperwork, compliance, and administrative work and more time focused on the children and communities they serve.
Our roots run deep in the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP), a federal nutrition program that helps provide healthy meals and snacks to children and adults across the country. Today, we're building on that expertise with a growing ecosystem of software supporting childcare organizations across food program compliance, business management, professional development, and licensing.
We're growing into new products, new markets, and have a much bigger vision for what KidKare can do for the childcare community. To support these goals, we're looking for a Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems to build and run the engine that turns our product value into pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
Position Summary
This is an
execution-first growth
role.
You'll partner with Product and Revenue Operations leadership to define the positioning and value proposition for each product, then put them to work: translating individual product propositions and features into audience-specific messaging and deploying that messaging through various tactics. You’ll be involved in managing the CRM, data enrichment, prospect scoring, routing, & lifecycle marketing. You'll report to our VP of Revenue Operations and work across Product, Sales, and Customer Growth to turn every launch and feature release into measurable pipeline, adoption, and expansion.
In a given week you might ship a new CRM workflow, tune a fit-and-intent scoring model, launch a demand-gen test to a newly enriched segment, build an app telemtry guide for a feature release, fix a routing rule that's sending leads to the wrong queue, or walk leadership through what moved in the funnel and why.
You'll build the machine, and you'll run it.
You'll partner closely with our Digital Marketing Manager, who owns brand, creative, content, and channel execution. You'll own the systems, segmentation, lifecycle logic, experiment design, and measurement that make that work reach the right audience at the right moment. Together, you'll turn product and market insight into demand.
Primary Responsibilities
Positioning, Feature Messaging & Launch Execution
•    Partner with product leadership to define and refine positioning and value propositions for each product and major release, grounded in customer, competitive, and market insight.
•    Translate individual product features and releases into audience-specific messaging (the value, the proof, and the call to action) for each persona and segment we serve, carrying positioning down to the feature level.
•    Execute launches through the systems you manage: target segments, lifecycle and nurture workflows, in-app guides, sales sequences and snippets, with launch tiers matched to the size of the release.
•    Package features into the battlecards, talk tracks, and objection handling our Sales and Customer Growth teams need, delivered inside CRM where reps actually work.
CRM Management & GTM Systems
•    Manage the CRM as the system of record for marketing and lifecycle: data model, custom properties, lifecycle stages, lead status, lists and segments, forms, and workflow automation.
•    Maintain CRM data quality and governance, including deduplication, field standards, consistent deal stages across pipelines, and clear documentation, so Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership trust the data.
•    Orchestrate the GTM stack (CRM, app telemtry, data enrichment, and automation tools) so product, marketing, and sales data flow cleanly between systems.
Enrichment, AI Scoring & Routing
•    Build and maintain enrichment workflows that close firmographic, contact, and segment data gaps, including vertical-specific sources relating to childcare, education, and food program participation data.
•    Design, deploy, and continuously tune fit, intent, and product-usage scoring models, using AI and predictive approaches where they outperform rules-based logic.
•    Own lead and account routing rules, handoff SLAs, and alerts to Sales and Customer Growth, and monitor speed-to-lead and conversion by route.
Demand Generation Experiments
•    Run a structured demand-gen experimentation program: define the hypothesis, audience, channel, offer, success metric, and decision rule before launch, then scale or move to the next experiment based on results.
•    Build and execute campaigns, nurture tracks, and outbound sequences against enriched, scored segments, partnering with the Digital Marketing Manager on creative and channel execution.
•    Use customer, competitive, and market insight to surface new segments and opportunities worth testing, and maintain a prioritized backlog and a visible results log so learnings compound.
Lifecycle & In-App Engagement
•    Own lifecycle programs across the customer journey: onboarding, activation, feature adoption, cross-sell and expansion, renewal, and win-back.
•    Build behavior-triggered journeys that combine CRM email and telemetry in-app guides, driven by product usage signals rather than calendar cadence alone.
•    Partner with Product and Customer Growth to identify adoption gaps and cross-sell opportunities across our product portfolio, and run the programs that close them.
Funnel Reporting & Measurement
•    Support maintenance of funnel stage definitions and conversion logic from first touch through closed-won, activation, and expansion.
•    Build and own dashboards and recurring funnel reporting for RevOps and leadership, covering pipeline, conversion rates, velocity, channel and campaign performance, and product adoption.
•    Set attribution and experiment measurement standards, and translate the numbers into clear recommendations on where to invest next. We care about great marketing, but ultimately we care about whether it drives growth.
What Success Looks Like
•
First 90 days:
You've aligned with product leadership on positioning for priority products; audited HubSpot data, lifecycle stages, and routing; published agreed funnel definitions; shipped a baseline funnel dashboard; and launched your first experiments.
•
First 6 months:
Enrichment and scoring are live and routing leads to Sales and Customer Growth against defined SLAs; core onboarding and adoption journeys are running across email and in-app; and experiments ship on a steady cadence with documented results.
•
First 12 months:
Every feature release runs through a repeatable launch playbook executed in the stack; conversion, speed-to-lead, and product adoption show measurable lift; and leadership uses your funnel reporting to make investment decisions.
You'll Probably Love This Role If…
•    You're a builder who loves making the machine work, not just drawing the diagram. You'd rather ship the test than debate it.
•    You're curious about customers, competitors, and markets and naturally find yourself asking, “Where's the opportunity here?”
•    You read a feature release and immediately think about the segment, the trigger, the channel, and the metric.
•    Messy CRM data bothers you, and you'd rather fix it at the source than patch it in a spreadsheet.
•    You think in funnels and can explain, in plain language, why a conversion rate moved.
•    You use AI as a force multiplier in real workflows, from enrichment and scoring to research and content variants, and you know where it helps and where it doesn't.
•    You’re a natural collaborative and aren’t afraid to step outside of the RevOps team to work with Product, Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership.
•    You're comfortable owning your work end to end without needing a huge team around you.
•    You're excited to build the GTM engine rather than inherit a finished one.
Required Qualifications
•    4+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, revenue operations, or GTM engineering or a related B2B SaaS role.
•    Hands-on CRM management/ownership as an admin or power user, including properties, lifecycle stages, workflows, lists, scoring, and reporting.
•    Experience partnering with product leadership to define positioning and value propositions, and a proven ability to translate individual features into audience-specific messaging deployed across campaigns, lifecycle programs, in-app experiences, and sales enablement.
•    Experience building data enrichment, lead scoring, and routing, including AI or predictive scoring approaches.
•    A track record of designing and running demand-gen experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented outcomes.
•    Experience building behavior-triggered lifecycle programs across email and in-app channels.
•    Strong funnel reporting and analytics skills: defining stages and conversion metrics, building dashboards, and working comfortably with data in spreadsheets or BI tools.
•    Clear, concise writing, from lifecycle copy to experiment readouts to leadership summaries.
•    Strong project management and systems thinking, with a habit of documenting what you build.
•    A builder mentality and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with CACFP, childcare, child nutrition, education, government programs, or other regulated industries is a huge plus, but not a requirement.
CACFP has its own language, regulations, acronyms, and complexities. If you already know it, amazing. If you don't, you'll be surrounded by an exceptional team of people who do, and we'll help you get up to speed.
A few other things we'd love to see:
•    Experience with vertical SaaS, multi-product portfolios, or marketing to both SMB and enterprise or public-sector buyers.
•    CRM certifications (Marketing, Sales, or Operations related) or hands-on experience with CRM AI and data enrichment features.
•    Hands-on experience with in-app engagement or product adoption platforms
•    Experience with enrichment and GTM automation tools
•    Technical comfort beyond the UI: SQL, APIs and webhooks, or light scripting (JavaScript or Python) to connect systems and automate workflows.
•    Comfort building AI-powered workflows for research, enrichment, scoring, and content variation. You know how to make AI your copilot, not your copywriter.
Why KidKare?
We're at an exciting inflection point, taking decades of experience in childcare and child nutrition and using it to build a broader ecosystem of products for the organizations and people who help care for our communities.
You won't be starting from scratch. We've invested deeply in understanding our customers, markets, competitors, and products. But we're not handing you a finished machine and asking you to keep it running.
We want you to build the engine that powers what comes next.
If you want to own the systems, run the experiments, build the lifecycle, measure the funnel, and see exactly how your work moves pipeline and adoption, you'll have plenty to dig into here.
All qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or marital status.
KidKare

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations
- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

About this role

GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026. We’re now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO’s essay on what that will take.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it’s really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location: _This role is fully remote but must overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours._ _We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time._

About this role

Individual Giving has set an objective to double new donor acquisition in 2027 and expand our awareness through brand ads for key segments. Paid media is the biggest lever we have to get there, and as Growth Manager, Paid Media, you’ll own delivery of this important priority. To help get us there, GiveDirectly is planning to expand its spend on paid media.

We are looking for someone who will be a strong cultural fit—curious, keen not to follow industry standards but to look for disproportionately high-leverage opportunities, keen to constantly learn and adjust, and comfortable launching a paid program without agency support. This role would suit someone comfortable in a fast-paced environment, able to pivot and change tactics based on data and changing circumstances.

Reporting to our Director of Individual Giving, you’ll manage all paid acquisition for Individual Giving across Meta, Google, YouTube, and TikTok, and also work closely with the VP of Marketing to manage all upper-funnel media buys (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, etc.) for both the Individual Giving and Marketing teams. This role is responsible for executing our paid media program end to end, including negotiating and managing contracts, creating ads, capturing screenshots for documentation, publishing campaigns, and monitoring performance. You will also build our tracking and attribution systems and use that data to grow both one-time and monthly giving. To do so, we are looking for a strong individual contributor who is comfortable executing within the platforms without a big team or agency.

The Individual Giving team is responsible for generating revenue across donors with an annual gift below $50k. To do so, the Individual Giving team executes compelling public fundraising campaigns, drives creative donor-facing content, and tests new marketing initiatives aimed at expanding our donor base and raising awareness of direct cash transfers. You’ll join a small but high-performing team that runs several campaigns at once and works with a lot of independence. You’ll partner with Brand and Marketing colleagues each campaign cycle to ensure integrated marketing across all public-facing materials.

Level: Manager (we are willing to hire at Senior Manager for more experienced candidates)

Reports To: Director of Individual Giving

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1–2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits

What you’ll bring:

- 3–5+ years in growth or performance marketing with a proven track record running paid media to a conversion or revenue target, in-house or agency, across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Non-profit experience is a plus, but not required.
- Experience managing a paid media budget of at least US$5M a year with a track record of strong performance measurement, with the discipline to trust your own data over platform recommendations and the judgment to know when to scale a channel, cut it, or admit it isn’t working—pause and reset.
- A genuine test-and-learn habit: you design multivariable testing across creative, audience, messaging, and landing pages, using these insights to scale the program.
- Strong written communication, the ability to own creative direction of ads (from conception and drafting through launch), and experience with or a strong eye for graphic design (Figma, Canva). You’ll work with content creation teams for bigger projects, but initial ideation and direction should come from you.
- Strong, succinct communication, and the ability to work productively with a Brand and Marketing team focused on brand awareness.
- Alignment with GiveDirectly’s values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.
- Experience with tracking and attribution to ensure detailed reports are shared with senior management.

Bonus skills:

- Experience with our tech stack (WordPress, Salesforce, PostHog, Google Analytics, Tableau, Zendesk, Ahrefs) or similar tools.
- Experience with paid ads with a non-profit of a similar size or an agency supporting non-profits.

What you’ll do

Own paid media strategy and performance to execute growth and brand goals

- Develop and execute the paid digital fundraising strategy that acquires new donors, grows revenue, and strengthens long-term supporter value across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, programmatic, and emerging platforms (approx. 50% of time).
- Run top-of-funnel brand ads, from placement and contracting to creative direction and development, including podcasts, OOH, and connected TV (approx. 30% of time).
- Manage and optimize paid investment daily, monitoring spend, pacing, cost per acquisition, and conversion, and reallocating budget as performance dictates.
- Run a continuous test-and-learn program across audiences, creative messaging, channels, landing pages, and donation experiences, and turn results into decisions rather than reports.
- Make key and strategic recommendations to the Director of Individual Giving and VP of Marketing on where budget spend should be allocated based on performance data.

Grow one-time and monthly giving through paid

- Run acquisition and conversion campaigns for both one-time and monthly giving, testing paid tactics to grow the recurring program—the fastest-growing part of our portfolio.
- Optimize the digital supporter journey so paid campaigns connect cleanly to landing pages, donation forms, email, and CRM, maximizing conversion and retention.
- Analyze acquisition, conversion, revenue, and retention trends by segment to inform where the next dollar goes.

Measurement & Reporting

- Stand up standardized paid-channel attribution and UTM tracking so acquisition spend is evaluable outside the ad platforms.
- Build and maintain performance dashboards that connect campaign, website, and CRM data into a single view of what each channel returns.
- Develop a forecasting model that projects cost per acquisition and revenue by channel, so budget increases are decisions rather than bets.
- Report to senior management on budget and paid campaign performance on a bi-weekly basis.

This role might not be for you if

- You are used to relying on an agency for recommendations or ad builds in the platforms themselves.
- You do not have experience/familiarity with both upper-funnel and direct conversion paid advertising.
- You are not comfortable managing projects from A–Z, including ideation, planning, launching, testing, iterating, and evaluating.

What success looks like in 12–18 months

- A clear, measurable contribution to the 2027 goal of doubling new donor acquisition, with a 50–70% share of new monthly donors acquired through paid.
- The Google Ad Grant is fully deployed against upper-funnel objectives, in compliance, and contributing measurable qualified traffic.
- A documented acquisition model forecasts cost per acquisition and revenue by channel accurately enough to justify a materially larger paid budget.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here. Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, the US, or the UK, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

United States

- Base Salary: $99,940
- Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
- Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

- Base Salary: £66,150
- Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
- Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

- Base Salary: $65,000
- Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
- Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

We’re looking for a VP of Revenue Marketing to lead the strategy and execution of Veriff’s global revenue marketing engine, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, acceleration and marketing ROI.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who knows how to build an integrated B2B marketing engine, brings deep expertise in ABM, and can balance strategy with true hands-on execution. - Diagnose the current revenue marketing engine across funnel performance, channel mix, budget, attribution and team structure, and share clear findings with Sales and RevOps.

- Have integrated ABM and demand-generation programmes running across priority accounts, with measurable engagement and progression.

- Senior B2B marketing leadership experience, ideally with 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or technology and experience leading across multiple marketing disciplines.

- Proven ability to operate as a true go-to-market partner to Sales and Revenue Operations, agreeing shared targets and priorities and working through disagreements constructively.
- A builder mentality: able to set strategy and prioritise ruthlessly while staying close enough to the work to personally drive execution when needed.

Nice to have

- Experience in identity, security, fintech or a related industry.
- Hands-on experience with web strategy, SEO and emerging AEO / AI-driven discovery.
- Experience building field and event programmes around target accounts, including executive dinners and roundtables.
- Experience with customer marketing, lifecycle and advocacy programmes that have contributed to customer expansion.
- Experience working in a global, multi-region go-to-market organisation.

- Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation

Digital Marketing Manager

REPORTS TO: Senior Digital Marketing Manager

LOCATION: Salt Lake City – Hybrid Schedule

POSITION TYPE: Full Time, Exempt

OUR COMPANY

Deseret Book is a mission-driven company, committed to being a trusted gathering place for thoughtful expressions of faith. Established in1866, today we create and curate stories worth telling, questions worth exploring, and beauty worth sharing to improve the lives of individuals and families in every step of their faith journey.

In our work culture, we put people first. Our team members are dedicated to meeting the needs of our communities as we work together, creating an environment where collaboration is critical and personal accountability is expected. If you are passionate about helping people find inspiration and help for their lives, and working with colleagues who want to do the same, then Deseret Book Company is the place for you.

The Opportunity

Deseret Book Company is a leading retailer and publisher of faith-centered books, media, and products, operating retail stores, a robust ecommerce platform (DeseretBook.com), and Bookshelf+, our growing digital subscription service. We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growth and lifecycle marketing efforts.

Position Summary

We're seeking a detail-driven, analytically sharp Digital Marketing Manager to own execution of growth campaigns, lifecycle marketing, paid and organic media coordination, and cross-functional project management. This is not a strategy-only role, you'll be hands-on building launch plans, coordinating across internal teams and external vendors, managing timelines, running A/B tests, and reporting on performance with clear, actionable insights.

This role works at the intersection of ecommerce, retail, product, development, creative, and media. If marketing campaigns are the engine, this role keeps every piston firing on time, on spec, and on budget — while continuously finding ways to make the engine run faster.

Core Responsibilities

Growth Campaigns & Conversion

- Translate growth strategies into integrated launch plans across paid media, email, social, retail, and owned channels.

- Lead execution of gifting, referral, and conversion-funnel initiatives end-to-end.

- Partner with Ecommerce, Retail, Product, and Development to optimize landing pages, checkout, and post-purchase experiences.

- Own pre-launch QA — links, pixels, promo codes, UTMs confirmed before every launch.

Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

- Partner with Email Marketing Strategist on automated journeys (onboarding, post-purchase, retention, win-back) for DeseretBook.com and Bookshelf+.

- Define audience segments; develop and run A/B tests; apply findings to improve lifecycle performance.

- Track engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue across all lifecycle programs.

Paid, Organic & Traditional Media Coordination

- Coordinate paid, organic, and traditional media campaigns — deliver assets, confirm specs/timelines, ensure tracking is live.

- Evaluate channel performance (impressions, engagement, ROAS, cross-channel lift); surface insights for media mix decisions.

Marketing Promotions

- Manage print/offline placements (package inserts, magalogs, QR codes, trackable URLs) with same tracking rigor as digital.

Project, Vendor & Cross-Functional Management

- Own timelines, requirements, testing, approvals, and launch readiness across concurrent campaigns.

- Serve as day-to-day contact for developers, production partners, and media vendors.

- Maintain campaign documentation in Asana; proactively surface risks and resolve gaps.

Performance Reporting & Optimization

- Maintain weekly performance reporting across all assigned campaigns and Deliver weekly performance reports with clear insights and action plans — not just data.

- Monitor conversion rate, CPA, engagement, referral activity, scan rates, retention, and attributed revenue.

Qualifications

- 5–7 years in digital/growth/performance marketing (retail, ecommerce, or subscription preferred).

- Hands-on experience executing integrated campaigns across paid media, email, social, and owned channels.

- Strong lifecycle/retention marketing skills, automated journeys, segmentation, A/B testing.

- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-team projects with concurrent timelines.

- Proficient with GA4, UTM/conversion tracking, attribution models, and email platforms (MailChimp, Klaviyo, or equivalent).

- Comfortable with Asana (strongly preferred) and external vendor coordination.

- Detail-oriented, specs, timelines, and tracking must be right.

- Strong written communication, clear briefs, concise reports, actionable recommendations.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in faith-based, book/publishing, or family-oriented consumer brands.

- Familiarity with subscription business models and subscriber lifecycle management (acquisition, onboarding, retention, win-back).

- Experience with referral and gifting program mechanics.

- Familiarity with retail marketing (in-store materials, package inserts, magalogs).

- Experience with Tapfiliate or other affiliate tracking platforms.

- Exposure to app-based marketing (push notifications, in-app messaging, app store optimization).

Equal Opportunity

Deseret Book is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where every individual is valued, respected, and empowered to do meaningful work. We strongly encourage all qualified candidates to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

- Strong communication and relationship skills across creators, internal teams, and legal.

- Familiarity with major social platforms and current content trends.

- Self-starter — building a function, not inheriting one.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

- Experience in faith-based, book/publishing, or family-oriented consumer brands.

- Familiarity with subscription-based business models and subscriber acquisition strategies.

- Experience creating training/enablement content for external partners.

- Knowledge of click fraud detection tools and affiliate compliance monitoring.

- Coordinate with Online Marketing on email and in-product activation and partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing teams.

- Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred but not required when the candidate's work demonstrates the needed judgment and execution.

2232.FireCrawl Job Description: About the Role This is a high-impact, high-ownership role at the center of how NetBox Labs drives pipeline. As our Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll be responsible for the strategy and execution behind how we create and accelerate demand — from integrated campaign development and account-based marketing to email nurture, social, and our website. You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our programs generate real pipeline, not just activity. This is the right role for someone who thinks in full funnels, can manage multiple programs at once without losing quality, and brings both strategic instincts and execution chops. If you're energized by proactivity and making a real impact — and want to do it at a company with a product that practitioners genuinely love and executives choose for their critical infrastructure — this is your seat. What you will do: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns across the full funnel, from awareness to pipeline — and own the performance reporting that follows. Build and scale an account-based marketing (ABM) program targeting enterprise accounts in partnership with Sales, including tiered account plays and cross-functional alignment. Own our end-to-end email nurture strategy across audience segments — free users, trial accounts, and enterprise prospects — and continuously improve conversion through testing and segmentation. Partner with marketing colleagues to develop organic social media strategy, with a focus on LinkedIn and other channels relevant to our technical and buyer audience. Work with our agency partners to manage the website, owning updates, campaign landing pages, and conversion optimization projects — and coordinating across design, product marketing, and marketing teammates to ship on time. Partner with Product Marketing on campaign messaging and asset development to ensure programs are compelling and consistent. Track, report, and iterate. You'll be accountable for pipeline contribution, not just campaign outputs. What you will bring: 6+ years of B2B demand generation experience, ideally at a SaaS or engineer-focused company. Proven track record building integrated campaigns that drive measurable pipeline. Hands-on ABM experience — you've built the plays, not just the strategy decks. Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment. Strong command of marketing automation (HubSpot, Claude Code, or equivalent) and CRM (HubSpot). Comfortable pulling and interpreting data and making decisions from it. Experience managing website projects cross-functionally with design, product, and marketing teams. Strong written communication skills — you have experience writing sharp web copy and communicating clearly internally. Able to manage multiple programs in flight simultaneously without dropping quality. Bonus points: Experience marketing to technical audiences — network engineers, IT ops, infrastructure teams. Familiarity with open-source communities or product-led growth motions. Experience leveraging Claude or other AI tools to accelerate campaign development or, automate systems and processes About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. From intimate dinners to large-scale activations like our annual ChiliPalooza, we bring top GTM leaders together to connect, exchange ideas, and build lasting relationships. It's how we turn a room full of people into real pipeline, and how we've built a community that actually wants to hear from us. We're hiring an Events Manager to scale these experiences and deepen our relationships with the GTM community: executive dinners, industry conferences, sponsorships, speaking moments, webinars, and ChiliPalooza. This is the person who turns our presence in a room, physical or virtual, into brand awareness, pipeline, and lasting relationships. This role is part of our marketing team and works cross-functionally with Sales and Partnerships to run Chili Piper's global event strategy. You'll have real ownership of the calendar and where we show up, not just the execution. You'll shape the annual plan, then make it happen: logistics, promotion, on-site, and follow-up, all the way through to measurable impact. This is a hands-on role. You're the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. It's a strong fit for someone who is organized and proactive, thinks creatively about how we show up, and brings original ideas and a sense of humor to every event. It's fully remote, with travel to events as needed. What you'll do Own the annual event calendar. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else's Manage execution end to end. Logistics, budgets, venues, vendors, shipments, swag, and on-site coordination, done by you and tracked by you Run event promotion from start to finish. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time What we're looking for Builder mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead Strong communicator. You coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and execs smoothly Customer-first. We'll review your background and experience to make sure there's a good fit for the role. Culture add interview. A first chat to get to know you: what drives you, how you like to work, and what unique perspective you'd bring to Chili Piper. Assessment. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It's not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process. Executive interview. The final step. We're hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. Additional Information Why you'll love being a part of our team: Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future. Work with an immensely talented global team Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun How we work: Freedom and flexibility. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom. Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software. Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results. Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential. The perks: Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!) Generous health, dental, and vision insurance Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD Equity - all Pipers receive stock options Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.

Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels. Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact. Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter. Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation. Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Parental Leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’ Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. Director of Demand Marketing

Lehi, Utah

Apply

At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.

Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.

Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.

About the Role

We are transforming the way small businesses operate with an AI workforce, and we're hiring a Director who will run marketing demand generation end-to-end. Think of this as the CMO of a sub-vertical: you own the monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency numbers the business is counting on. You own the strategy and channel execution to get there.

This is a builder and operator role: you'll roll up your sleeves, drive critical projects, lean in deeply with a team of direct and indirect reports, and IC where needed to get the job done. You're deeply performance and demand focused.

The right person is highly biased towards action, hungry to drive impact, exercises extreme ownership, thrives at a startup pace, and can set a vision that inspires the team. You're a heavy AI user, passionate about building a marketing engine at the bleeding edge of what's possible.

This role is required to be in office 5 days per week at our Lehi HQ.

What You'll Own

- Set an integrated marketing strategy that delivers on demand targets and rallies the team. Set the vision, set the pace, and hold the org to it.
- Hold full accountability for marketing's monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency targets, plus the levers underneath them: channel mix, budget allocation, execution, comms calendar, and demand content. You own the number and how it gets hit.
- Track pacing and pipeline against targets, and proactively lead the team in building and executing on gap plans the moment funnel targets slip.
- Lead, coach, and raise the ceiling for a lean team of direct reports owning trade show/events, partner marketing, webinars, third-party media, lifecycle and content marketing channels.
- Proactively collaborate with a team of indirect reports (centralized marketing subject matter experts) across digital channels, AEO/SEO, and web, to execute on the highest impact strategies in your vertical.
- Rigorously measure the efficacy of tactics/channels/funnel and continuously optimize via experimentation. Align marketing portfolio bets to maximize impact.
- Manage the vertical budget, spending within profitability constraints, surfacing opportunities. Drive AOP planning prep and recommendations.
- Regularly report on marketing performance and strategy to leadership / exec team.
- Set the standard for AI-first marketing in tooling, planning, and agent building, deploying AI workflows that transform impact.
- Work closely with marketing leadership across other verticals (auto, aesthetics) and partnering functions (design, product marketing) to prep for launches, align on resourcing and positioning. Align with Sales, CS, Product, Finance, and Revenue Operations leaders on goals and priorities.

Candidate Profile

_Must Haves_

- Successful track record of leading an integrated, demand generation strategy/function or channel group with accountability to a revenue number, a budget, and ROI.
- Hands-on depth across relevant marketing channels like trade shows, field or partner marketing, lifecycle, webinars, content marketing, digital, and ABM. You've personally run a collection of channels at similar scale.
- Extreme ownership and bias to action. You move fast without waiting for consensus, and you're comfortable building a strategy out of ambiguity and high change.
- Critical thinker and analytically rigorous. You make data informed decisions using full funnel metrics and know what inputs are most important to drive to a decision.
- Highly performance focused and ROI minded. Understands the right balance of investment into higher funnel initiatives and the limitations of various attribution methods.
- Excellent communicator. Clear, decisive, and collaborative.
- Sets a high bar for the team and provides the coaching, vision and accountability to get there.
- Excellent project management skills. Can drive action and alignment.
- Customer first. Draws on a deep understanding of the customer, industry and Podium value.
- Uses AI heavily, building workflows and agents. Can show what you've built.
- A strong cross-functional partner. Builds trust and alignment across the org.

_Nice-to-Haves_

- Experience marketing to SMBs / local businesses or marketing an AI product.
- Familiarity with the home services trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest, landscaping, etc.) and their buying behavior.
- Familiarity with the medspa aesthetics industry and their buying behavior.

_Not a Fit If_

- You need a big team, a big agency, or a big budget to operate.
- You want to run strategy and hand execution to someone else. You own both.

Benefits

- Work in Lehi, UT, 5 days a week
- Open and transparent culture
- Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
- Paid maternity and paternity leave
- Fertility Benefits
- Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends
- Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits
- 401k Plan
- Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel
- A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered
- Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees

_Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status._

2241.Gecko Job Description: Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency. Powered by LOIS , the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country. Role Summary: The Vice President, Performance Marketing owns the end-to-end strategy, execution, and scaling of performance-driven lead generation across SEO/AEO/GEO, SEM, email, affiliate, and emerging channels. This executive leader will architect a high-velocity demand funnel that fuels MQL → SQL → SAL → revenue targets across all product lines and industries. Reporting directly to the CGO, the VP will build and lead a world-class performance marketing organization, establish predictive forecasting models, and implement real-time optimization frameworks powered by data, automation, and cross-functional alignment. \n Responsibilities Strategic Ownership: Design and execute a unified performance marketing strategy that drives predictable, scalable demand across B2B and B2C segments. Funnel Architecture : Build and optimize a multi-touch attribution funnel with stage-specific KPIs (MQL, SQL, SAL, pipeline velocity, revenue attribution). Target Setting & Accountability : Define, forecast, and hit aggressive growth targets for lead volume, cost-per-lead, conversion rates, and downstream revenue impact. Data & Analytics Leadership : Establish enterprise-grade reporting, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, incrementality, LTV:CAC modeling). Team Building & Leadership : Scale and mentor a high-performing team; recruit senior talent in paid social, SEO, and lifecycle marketing. Cross-Functional Alignment : Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align marketing investment with revenue outcomes and unit economics. Innovation & Channel Expansion: Identify and pilot high-ROI channels (e.g., TikTok, Reddit, partner co-marketing, review platforms) while optimizing core engines (Google, LinkedIn, Meta). Qualifications: 10+ years of progressive experience in performance marketing, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) at a high-growth SaaS, tech, or AI-native company. Proven P&L Impact : Track record of building and scaling $10M+ performance marketing budgets with measurable ROI and revenue attribution. Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs), Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, CDP integration, and HTML/CSS for landing page optimization. Analytical Rigor : Advanced proficiency in performance forecasting, cohort analysis, attribution modeling, and statistical significance testing. Leadership & Team Scaling : Experience hiring, developing, and leading distributed or multi-disciplinary marketing teams (8+ members). Creative Problem-Solving : Known for testing bold hypotheses, failing fast, and iterating toward breakthrough efficiency. Collaborative Operator: Thrives in high-autonomy environments; partners seamlessly with Sales, Product, and Executive leadership. Nice-to-Have Led demand gen at a company with $50M+ ARR** or 1M+ monthly active users. Built in-house capabilities in SEO content engines, email lifecycle automation and affiliate/partnership programs. Experience with Capterra, G2, Software Advice, or industry-specific review platforms. Familiarity with privacy-first marketing. \n Work Location Expectation: Filevine maintains offices in Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Chicago, and New York. Candidates based in or near these metropolitan areas will work on a hybrid or in-office schedule, while candidates located outside these regions are eligible for remote work Cool Company Benefits: - A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees) - Competitive & Fair Pay - Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees) - Short & long-term disability - Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team - Top-of-the-line company swag Privacy Policy Notice Filevine will handle your personal information according to what’s outlined in our Privacy Policy . Communication about this opportunity, or any open role at Filevine, will only come from representatives with email addresses using " filevine.com ". Other addresses reaching out are not affiliated with Filevine and should not be responded to. Filevine is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualifications for employment, promotion and other terms and conditions of employment are based upon the ability to perform the job. Equal-employment opportunities are provided to all applicants and employees without regard to race, creed, religion, color, age, national origin, sex, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected class. Filevine is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or accommodation due to disability, or if you have concerns related to Filevine’s equal employment opportunities, you may contact us at legal@filevine.com

2243.Gecko Job Description: Your role in our mission Prosper is seeking an analytically-driven, values-led VP of Marketing to accelerate our mission of advancing financial well-being. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will oversee the end-to-end marketing ecosystem - from performance-based acquisition to the launch of new borrowing and investing products. We need a leader who can mentor a talented team of 20+ while maintaining a sharp focus on ROI and market-leading brand positioning. Whether you work from our San Francisco headquarters or remotely in the US, you will be the lead storyteller and strategist connecting our products to the millions who need them. Drive scalable growth : You will own top-of-funnel metrics and multi-year marketing plans for our retail investor, personal loan, and credit card portfolios. You’ll determine requirements, assess support needs, build internal alignment, and deliver results that hit our aggressive volume targets. You will accelerate the development of enhanced machine learning targeting models and aggressive customer research. Define the competitive edge: You will lead us to beat the competition at our game - not theirs. This means overseeing deep market research and competitor analysis to drive recommendations that lean into Prosper’s unique marketplace advantages. You will lead a proactive PR strategy to ensure our strengths are clearly communicated and widely recognized by the market, media, and our customers. Influence the product roadmap: You will act as a key partner on new product design, bringing deep market intelligence and customer insights to the table to ensure our future offerings are positioned to win from day one. Level-up the team: You’ll mentor and empower our 20+-person team to be a data-first execution engine that thrives on mission-driven, high-performance culture. Reporting to the CEO, you will work in close alignment with the President & CFO, CTO, and General Counsel to position marketing as a primary driver of Prosper’s financial and technical roadmap. You will collaborate daily with the Heads of Product, Credit, and Operations to deliver a seamless borrower and investor experience. You will lead the entire marketing organization, providing strategic oversight to your direct reports: the Sr. Director of Performance Marketing & Analytics, the Director of Web & Conversion, and the Sr. Partnerships Manager. Fintech Leadership: 15+ years of marketing experience with a deep mastery of the personal loan and financial services landscape, including content, digital and product marketing. The ROI mindset: A proven track record of driving ROI-positive acquisition across multiple channels, including digital, direct mail, and lead aggregators. Data as a second language: Strong analytical rigor with the ability to use performance data to pivot strategies and uncover untapped market segments. Executive presence: High-level communication skills with a history of presenting performance and vision to employees and the Board of Directors. Regulatory fluency: A firm grasp of compliance and regulatory standards for advertising and acquisition in financial markets. Academic foundation: A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred. A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported. Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security. Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage. Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace. #LI-DG1 #LI-Remote About Us Prosper introduced U.S. consumers to an innovative approach to personal finance as the first peer-to-peer lending platform in the country. Since 2005, Prosper has helped over 2 million customers achieve financial well-being through a comprehensive suite of digital personal finance products. Prosper’s flagship personal loan* marketplace continues to offer unique value for both borrowers and investors, while the Prosper® Card¹ provides essential access to credit and flexibility for those managing their financial journey. Guided by its mission to advance financial well-being, Prosper is dedicated to helping people thrive by meeting people where they are with simple, trusted, and affordable financial solutions. Learn more at www.prosper.com. Rockstar is recruiting for a client in the lighting industry. The client designs and manufactures lighting products and solutions, serving customers through independent representatives and channel partners.
