Work Environment:
Hybrid, office and remote based, with frequent travel to customer sites, trade shows, and industry events
Travel:
Up to 35% within assigned region
Job Summary
The Director of Sales and Marketing is responsible for the strategic leadership, management, and execution of all sales, customer service and marketing activities across the company’s market segments. This includes oversight of the independent representative network, development of new business opportunities, management of major accounts, pricing strategies and worksheets, and direction of sales operations to achieve company growth and profitability goals.
This role includes full oversight of marketing, including branding, product marketing, digital presence, messaging, campaign development, trade show strategy, and market analytics. The Director will lead Marketing staff and work collaboratively with cross-functional departments to drive integrated commercial strategies.
Responsibilities include managing staffing, training, and performance of respective sales representatives; identifying new market opportunities; analyzing market and competitive trends; preparing pricing proposals; delivering product demonstrations; guiding marketing initiatives to support revenue growth and brand strength; and ensuring customers receive the best customer service possible.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Administers, leads, manages, and directs the RSMs, customer service and marketing
Achieves sales and profit goals
Maintains and manages major accounts; identifies and develops new customers, territories, and markets
Reviews customer applications and generates proposals
Maintains and builds strong relationships with key accounts (customers and suppliers)
Analyzes and reviews sales trends by region; identifies opportunities, risks, and actions needed
Provides automotive project management as required
Creates and delivers product training to channel partners
Performs product demonstrations at customer sites, trade shows, and events
Develops and executes mutual action plans with key channel partners
Coordinates contract review with regional sales managers as needed
Oversees all customer service functions, including customer order entry, warranty claims and other post-sale customer service activities
Oversees all Marketing functions, including strategy, planning, messaging, and execution
Leads the Marketing Specialist in developing campaigns, promotions, digital content, and trade show materials
Directs product marketing activities, including competitive positioning, value propositions, and launch planning
Guides branding, website content, literature development, and communication materials
Analyzes market trends, competitive activity, pricing, and customer insights to influence strategy
Collaborates with Engineering and Product Development to align marketing with the new product roadmap
Works extensively with Regional Sales Managers, Purchasing/Supply Chain, Operations and Engineering to develop customer solutions
Provides inputs and direction into the New Product Development roadmap
Analyzes and prepares pricing for products with cross-functional input
Attends production or status meetings as needed
Performs other duties assigned to support customer commitments and company goals
Direct Reports
Regional Sales Managers
Customer Service Representative
Marketing Specialist
Skills and Abilities
Excellent relationship-building skills
Self-directed, detail-oriented, and highly organized
Strong verbal and written communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously and maintain accuracy
Strong prioritization skills, with ability to meet deadlines and resolve conflicts
Ability to develop and present strategy effectively to senior leadership
Proven ability to lead, influence, and manage sales teams and independent agencies
Strong negotiation skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM platforms
Education and Experience Required
Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field required
Minimum 5–10 years of experience in sales or business development
Experience in the lighting industry strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to own and drive sales and business development initiatives
Mental Demands
Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities under time constraints
Strong analytical thinking for proposals, pricing, and market analysis
Maintains focus and professionalism in high-pressure situations

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach.

What You'll Do

- Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out.
- Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all.
- Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures.
- Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back.
- Partner with Marketing Operations to get attribution and UTM tracking right before scaling spend, so every dollar is measurable.
- Define target audiences and channel mix aligned to Netlify's ICP; partner with Product Marketing on messaging inputs for paid creative.
- Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel.
- Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off.
- As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team.

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment
- Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports
- A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there
- Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them
- Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales
- Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel

This Role Is a Great Fit If

- You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature.
- You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency.
- You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters.
- You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought.
- You want to build in close partnership with Lifecycle, Campaigns, and Marketing Ops rather than run paid as a separate lane that hands off a spreadsheet at the end of the quarter

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include:

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $150,000 - $200,000  for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Lead Product Marketing Manager - Novus

Posted 3 days ago

Apply now

The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

- Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.
- End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.
- Top-of-funnel and conversion: Partner with revenue marketing to define the acquisition channel mix, run campaigns, and drive early-access signups. Connect demand activity to free-to-paid conversion and early commercial signals.
- Community building: Build Novus' presence where builders already spend time, including developer forums, social channels, influencer relationships, and event-driven activation. Earn trust with audiences that are skeptical of traditional marketing.
- PLG motion: Partner with product and growth to design self-serve onboarding, activation flows, and freemium-to-paid conversion paths. Use data and feedback to improve how users discover, try, activate, and expand with Novus.
- Novus and Pendo positioning: Define how Novus and Pendo exist together in the market. Shape the path for customers moving from fast-moving AI-native teams into more complex product organizations.
- Sales and partner enablement: Build the materials, messaging, and proof points that help sales and partner teams have credible conversations with product engineers. Translate the product for a buyer that is meaningfully different from Pendo's traditional PM audience.
- Metrics and commercial impact: Work with revenue marketing to define and track the metrics that connect Novus activity to pipeline and early revenue outcomes. Focus on activation, free-to-paid conversion, marketing-sourced ARR, and other signals that show whether the motion is working.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Product Marketing Directors don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

- 7+ years of marketing experience with real ownership of positioning and narrative for a product or category at the individual contributor level.
- Proven ability to drive a launch, repositioning, or category story end to end, including the writing and strategic thinking behind the work.
- Strong content instincts, with the ability to create crisp narratives, sharp positioning documents, and launch materials that audiences actually engage with.
- Active, practical fluency with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar, with evidence that AI has meaningfully changed how you work and what you ship.
- High bias to action, with a track record of shipping, gathering feedback, iterating, and filling gaps without waiting for perfect information.
- Ability to translate technical depth into clear, compelling messaging without oversimplifying a novel product.
- Strong cross-functional influence with product, sales, marketing, and leadership stakeholders, especially in environments where you need to drive alignment without direct authority.
- Experience with PLG motions, including self-serve acquisition, freemium conversion, activation, or community-led distribution.
- Credibility with developer or builder audiences, including an understanding of how technical users discover, evaluate, and build trust in new tools.

Nice-to-haves

- Hands-on experience building community among developers or other technical builder audiences.
- Technical fluency from building software or working closely enough with engineers to understand codebases, pull requests, and deploy cycles.
- Experience in product analytics, instrumentation, observability, developer tools, open source, or AI coding tools.
- Growth-hacking experience in an early-stage or 0-to-1 product environment.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Compensation: The expected salary range for this role to be performed in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA is $196,300 - $249,000.

Benefits: Pendo offers highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage in the United States, including $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

Brief Overview

This role owns Amwell's marketing web estate and how discoverable it is, across four properties: SilverCloud, business.amwell.com, patients.amwell.com, and LiveHealthOnline. Accountability covers performance and conversion on those properties, the compliance posture of what runs on them, and discoverability as search behavior shifts toward AI-generated answers.

The role directs work rather than performing all of it. Engineering owns development capacity and Design owns visual execution; this role defines, sequences, and holds the quality of the work both produce for the web estate. Page content and messaging remain with the pillar that owns each page, so this role owns the platform and its performance rather than what the pages say.

Core Responsibilities

_What the role owns:_

• The four web properties — performance, conversion, and delivery

• Web compliance and governance, including cookie consent and tracking governance

• GEO and AI-answer discoverability across the properties, alongside conventional search performance

• Definition and sequencing of website build and development work delivered by Engineering

• Coordination with the separate Design team on visual work for the estate

• The web roadmap and the case for what it returns

_How success is measured:_

• Conversion performance across the four properties, and measured improvement in GEO and AI-answer discoverability (primary measurable output)

• Web property performance, including speed and core experience measures

• Tracking-compliance coverage across the estate

• Delivery of the web roadmap against plan

• Contribution of web to demand and engagement funnels

_What the role does not own:_

Scope boundaries are explicit, so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Page content and messaging — each pillar owns what its own pages say

• Product application surfaces — Product

• Engineering development capacity itself — Engineering owns the resource; this role directs the work

• Visual design execution — the separate Design team

• Off-site authority and earned citations — Brand and Corporate Marketing with the external agency

• Paid media and demand strategy — Demand Generation Manager

Qualifications

• 7+ years in web, digital marketing, or growth, with direct ownership of a web estate

• A track record of moving a conversion measure on owned properties, not only of shipping site work

• Technical SEO depth, and demonstrated engagement with GEO and AI-answer discoverability

• Experience directing engineering delivery without owning the engineering resource

• Web compliance and tracking governance experience, including consent management

• Analytics fluency sufficient to defend what the web numbers claim

• The ability to hold a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands from multiple pillars

_Preferred_

• Healthcare or other regulated-industry web experience, including accessibility obligations

• Multi-property or multi-brand estate management

• CMS migration or replatforming experience

• Experience establishing GEO measurement where no baseline existed

The John Gore Organization (JGO) is a leading presenter, distributor, and marketer of Broadway theater worldwide. Led by owner John Gore, a record 27-time Tony Award winner and Emmy Award recipient, its family of companies includes Broadway Across America, Broadway.com, The Broadway Channel, BroadwayBox.com, Group Sales Box Office, and Broadway Brands. JGO presents live theater in more than 45 cities across North America, as well as on Broadway, Off-Broadway, London’s West End, Japan, and China. Its productions have earned Tony Awards in every producing category, along with numerous Drama League, Drama Desk, and Olivier Awards. The organization is committed to expanding access to the arts and supporting theater education initiatives that inspire and develop the next generation of artists, audiences, and industry leaders. John Gore also oversees John Gore Studios, a British film and television studio dedicated to preserving iconic heritage IP and championing new storytelling.

We are committed to developing an inclusive and supportive culture, where employees have equal opportunity for growth.

FLSA Status: Exempt

Summary

The Regional Director of Marketing is a demonstrated leader, creating and executing fully integrated advertising and promotional campaigns for all Broadway presentations of BAA in Salt Lake City, Boise and Albuquerque. This is a data-driven role, and the Regional Director of Marketing is expected to be innovative, tech-savvy, and digital forward. Hybrid work schedule is available for this position.

Duties and Responsibilities

- Oversee marketing efforts and initiatives for Salt Lake City, Boise and Albuquerque in the Broadway Across America network which includes the following:
  - Manage subscription campaign including establishing overall strategy, timeline, budget, and marketing materials, while monitoring sales results and adjusting all as needed
  - Create advertising plans for season advertising and single show ad budgets with local partners input and facilitating approvals from shows where necessary
  - Set goals, priorities, timelines, sales, marketing, and pricing strategies in coordination with the Vice-President, members of the ticketing team, and local partners for both season ticket campaigns and individual show campaigns
  - Manage and track show budgets based on markets approved spend and approved advertising plans per show – track ROAS and adjust advertising as needed based on return and forecasted sales
  - Facilitate the placement of media buys in specific markets
  - Manage subscription campaign including budgets, marketing materials, sales results
  - Strategize with Digital Marketing Manager for all digital placements including OTT, retargeting, paid social, etc.
  - Formulate agendas and lead weekly and/or bi-weekly calls with local teams
  - Create and implement timely, targeted, and engaging email and social media campaigns for shows, subscription efforts, and institutional marketing.
  - Supervise timely, targeted, and engaging email campaigns for shows, subscription efforts, and institutional marketing.
  - Maintains the local Broadway Across America market webpages for the mountain markets including facilitating updates and brand standards with oversight from BAA National Marketing
  - Create season amortization schedule and ensure timely updates are made with AP and REC
  - Advise or direct local public relations and group sales efforts
  - Oversee media and non-media based promotions and grass roots promotional efforts
  - Establish priority offers with local market, BAA lists, Ticketmaster and etc.
  - Submit and approve job requests for print collateral, online assets, email blasts, etc.
  - Work with Regional VPs and ticketing including advising marketing efforts, pricing strategies, advertising settlements, priority offers, etc.
  - Approve or oversee advertising settlements
  - Assist with single ticket revenue forecasting and budgeting
  - Utilize Domo and BI tools to guide decisions on advertising spends, single ticket revenue pacing and market to market/show to show analysis to facilitate best practice for regional markets
  - Act as liaison between local market and NY design team, National BAA staff, show press agents, Ticketmaster and etc.
  - Ensure all assets are being used efficiently including, SMS, apps, website, email, social, signage, and all communication avenues
  - Work with BAA National marketing and creative teams to develop new ideas and initiatives
  - Provides strategic direction and support for organic social media content.
  - Work in rotation with the BAA Mountain team to remotely settle shows on select weekends.
- Other duties as assigned

Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social

❮ back to last search

Brex

Salt Lake, Utah

116000-145000 per year

Full time

CLOSING SOON

Apply for this job

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story — turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you’ll do

Brex is seeking a deeply analytical, growth-rooted Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our Paid Social engine, with Meta as the core growth driver and a clear mandate to test and scale emerging channels.

In this role, you will be accountable for down-funnel pipeline, efficient CAC, and customer acquisition. You won't just optimize campaigns; you will engineer signal architecture, build scalable audience models, and establish a high-velocity creative testing engine. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation. You’ll help accelerate Brex’s growth by scaling what works, continuously improving how we operate, and unlocking new opportunities for impact.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Team members are expected to work in-office three days per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.

Responsibilities

- Growth & Pipeline Ownership: Own Meta + emerging channel budgets, CAC efficiency, conversion, and downstream pipeline/revenue across self-serve and sales-led motions.
- Signal & Measurement Strategy: Partner with Data and Marketing Ops to improve conversion signals, CAPI, and offline conversion tracking, enabling platforms to optimize toward higher-quality customers.
- Structured Experimentation: Build and execute a continuous, hypothesis-driven testing framework across audiences, bidding strategies, optimization events, landing pages, and creative concepts; document learnings to turn paid social into a predictable acquisition channel.
- Full-Funnel Growth: Build paid social strategies that create demand at the top of the funnel and efficiently convert it through retargeting and lower-funnel programs.
- Creative Strategy: Translate performance data into creative hypotheses and partner with Brand and Design to test, iterate, and scale winning concepts.
- Audience Strategy: Use first-party data, intent signals, modeled audiences, lookalikes, and platform automation to identify and scale high-value audiences.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Analytics, Marketing Ops, Field / Events team, PMM, and Sales to connect paid social performance & programs to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Requirements

- 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on expertise managing and scaling Meta as a primary acquisition channel.
- Demonstrated experience owning a paid social channel end to end, including strategy, budgets, forecasting, campaign architecture, optimization, and performance reporting.
- Relentlessly analytical: Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), attribution modeling, and how to connect platform metrics directly to down-funnel business impact.
- Experience running full-funnel paid social programs, from awareness/video and demand generation through conversion and pipeline.
- Strong expertise in audience strategy and platform automation, including first-party audiences, lookalikes, broad targeting, retargeting, and automated campaign products.
- Strong understanding of conversion signals and measurement, including Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution, conversion-event strategy, and CRM/offline conversion data.
- Demonstrated experience building structured experimentation roadmaps across creative, audiences, bidding, optimization events, and new platform capabilities.
- Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs and translating performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
- Excellent communicator who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional partners across Brand, PMM, Design, Analytics, Engineering, Marketing Ops, and Sales.

Bonus Points

- Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
- Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $116,000 - $145,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

• Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, constantly evolving with the latest digital advertising trends.

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike. We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

- Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
- Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
- Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
- Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
- Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
- Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
- Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
- Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

Preferred Qualifications:

- Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
- Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
- Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
- Experience in retail revenue strategy

What does high performance look like?

- You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
- You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
- You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
- You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
- You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
- You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

- You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

- 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
- 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
- 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

What is the team like?

- You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

We want individuals who are:

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
- Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

- Unlimited PTO
- Paid Holidays
- Onsite Fitness Center
- Company Paid Life Insurance
- Casual Dress Code

About this role

What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking an experienced and commercially-minded Sr. Product Marketing Manager to own the commercial strategy for Content Cloud, including our headless CMS, Assets (our DAM), and Launch. This is the largest revenue base in our portfolio and the product line where many of our customers begin their Contentstack journey.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. You’ll own the product line end to end, including positioning, packaging, launches, buyer narratives, pricing, competitive strategy, and field readiness. You’ll also help raise the bar for the broader product marketing team without directly managing them and serve as a strategic resource when the function lead is unavailable.

The role has a strong commercial focus. You’ll help protect and grow our largest installed base, drive expansion from CMS into Assets and Launch, and shape how we compete in highly competitive enterprise markets. You’ll also help evolve our story as Contentstack moves toward agentic experiences, using customer insights, market intelligence, and adoption data to continuously improve our strategy.

Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we bring practical experience using AI tools and technologies to improve how we work, learn, solve problems, and drive impact. If you’re excited by the opportunity to own a significant product line, shape how we compete in the market, and make a measurable commercial impact, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

- Own the commercial strategy for Content Cloud, including positioning, packaging, launches, buyer narratives, and field readiness.
- Own the renewal and expansion narrative for our largest installed base, including opportunities to grow adoption of Assets and Launch.
- Lead competitive strategy, including battlecards, win/loss insights, enterprise RFP/RFI support, and translating competitive deal intelligence into product strategy.
- Own pricing, packaging, ICP, and core value propositions, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing.
- Define and measure adoption goals for launches, using data and customer feedback to improve go-to-market strategies.
- Bring the voice of the customer and market into our strategy through regular customer conversations, analyst briefings, and competitive research.
- Represent Contentstack externally through live demos, webinars, customer roundtables, ContentCon, and other market-facing opportunities.
- Raise the bar for the product marketing team through mentorship, collaboration, and strategic leadership without direct management responsibility.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

- 8-12 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, including at least 4 years marketing a headless CMS, DXP, DAM, or content infrastructure product. Deep category experience is critical.
- Hands-on enterprise DAM or content management experience, including familiarity with RFPs and complex enterprise buying processes.
- Proven experience owning pricing and packaging for a product line and confidently defending your commercial decisions.
- You can demo a product live and unscripted without relying on a sales engineer. This will be tested during the interview process.
- Experience positioning against enterprise incumbents and challengers, with a track record of applying lessons from both wins and losses.
- A demonstrated track record of driving adoption after launch, using data to understand what worked and what needs to change.
- Strong communication, executive presence, and influence skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, and the executive team.
- Additional experience with DAM, retail/commerce, developer audiences, partner ecosystems, product-led growth, or answer engine/search optimization is a plus.
- You like occasional travel
- You value a collaborative, fun culture!

_Salary for this role ranges between $155,000-175,000 based on skill set and experience_

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no ahole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together – with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Reporting to our Vice President of Product and Solutions Marketing, the Senior Director of Product Marketing - Competitive and Sales Enablement will lead the development of competitive intelligence programs and enablement tools. To empower our sales teams to win more against the competition, you will own the creation of competitive insights including beat the competition presentations, battlecards, responses to major analyst research and major vendor product introductions. You will also develop a sales playbook strategy comprised of multiple plays aligned with Ping’s product strategy and highlighting our differentiation in the market.

As a member of the product marketing leadership team, this position will partner with multiple stakeholders such as systems engineering, domain architecture, and product management to gather and correlate insights. You’ll then contextualize the intelligence to inform sales play formation, lifecycle management for product teams, messaging for product marketing, and competitive de-positioning for sales.

What You’ll Do

- Lead ongoing analysis of competitors’ products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.
- Develop and maintain competitive selling presentations, battlecards, win/loss insights, and content for executive briefings.
- Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales including Ops, AR to synthesize market trends and threats.
- Build and maintain modular playbooks tailored to buyer personas, verticals, and use cases to drive sales productivity (reps and pre-sales). These are aligned to product direction, launches, campaign themes, and GTM priorities.
- Collaborate with Sales Enablement to deliver training and reinforcement programs.
- Work closely with Product and Solutions Marketing, Field Enablement, and Sales Leadership to ensure competitive insights are actionable.
- Partner with Demand Gen and Sales/Revenue Operations to measure playbook adoption and impact on pipeline and win rates.
- Manage CI platforms and work with enablement solutions (e.g. Crayon, Seismic, Highspot, etc.).

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of top notch competitive and market intelligence talent.

We’re Looking for Someone With:

- Education:

  - BA/BS or equivalent industry experience required.

- Experience:
  - 15+ years product marketing, competitive intelligence, and/or sales enablement experience in a cybersecurity, IT operations, or networking company.
  - Previous experience in a lead role with responsibilities for sales playbook development and training.
  - Familiarity with identity access management.
  - Knowledge of adjacent technologies including SASE/SSE, endpoint security, SIEM, and EDR is a plus.
  - Understanding of agentic AI is a plus.
  - Strong collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to partner with diverse stakeholders.
  - Strong ability to influence and work cross-functionally.
  - Results-oriented leader with proven ability to build creative, collaborative teams; develop people; and link performance to overall business objectives.

Base Salary Range:

$137,000 to $197,000 CAD

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

- A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
- Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
- Regular company and team bonding events.
- Competitive benefits and perks.
- Global volunteering and community initiatives

- Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
- Parental Leave
- Progressive Healthcare Options
- Retirement Programs

- Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

- Advanced Commercial Modeling: Partner with broader central data science teams on company wide marketing frameworks (like Marketing Mix Modeling), while independently owning custom scenario analysis (e.g., ASP impact of bundling, Customer Lifetime Value/LFTV cohorting, and field event ROI modeling).
- Maintain & Modernize GTM Data Infrastructure: Curate and optimize our Looker, Tableau, and SFDC reporting assets, managing SQL logic via GitHub version control, dashboard glossaries, and automated data QA processes.

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, GTM Strategy, Revenue Operations, or Business Intelligence within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology organization.

- Commercial Acumen & Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated experience partnering directly with Director/VP-level leaders to turn data insights into operational decisions.

- Experience working with customer data platforms and intent tools (e.g., Segment, 6sense, Marketo).

  - Ship, learn, repeat

- Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

Supervisor, Paid Search

Denver, CO; Kansas City, MO; Chicago, IL; New York, NY; Remote

Apply

MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We’re an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact.

This is a full-time position for a Supervisor, Paid Search at BarkleyOKRP.  In this role, you will develop strategies and manage the performance of various paid search accounts, to drive client performance and growth. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment are essential.

Qualities

Here’s what it takes to be successful in the role:

- Curiosity and Skepticism:  You are always asking, “ _WHY?_” You have an internal drive to learn more and expand your knowledge. You consider situations from multiple perspectives.

- Strategic, Creative Problem-Solving: You are analytical and enjoy working with data to derive insights. You use insights and knowledge to develop robust strategies and visions for success. You love coming up with creative solutions to new and old problems alike.

- Initiative: You are a gritty self-starter driven to find answers, solve tough problems, and overcome challenges. You proactively bring solutions to challenges.

- Communication & Storytelling: You can easily communicate complex information or nuanced situations. You know what details are necessary and what details to leave behind. You can marry data and storytelling to articulate a compelling vision.

- Adaptability: You can comfortably adjust in evolving or ambiguous situations. You use creativity to tackle new and existing challenges. You’re ready and excited for changes in the media landscape.

- Self-Development: You’re reflective and self-aware. You seek opportunities to learn and develop yourself and others.

Responsibilities:

- Paid Search Management in Google & Bing Platforms as well as through our proprietary tool: Deep Search.

- Performance Management: The Account Supervisor independently owns managing to budgets and campaign targets to achieve or exceed client goals across all of their accounts. Exhibit full mastery of performance management, with ability to execute across different verticals and different goal types. Proactively creates target management solutions and tracking solutions to improve performance across all clients.

- Campaign Structure: Stewardship over campaign structure, proactively auditing, implementing, and evangelizing best practices. Across all accounts, ensures campaigns are set up properly to appropriately spend and perform, including targeting, ads, and scheduling. Proactively recommends how to enhance campaign performance/account structure. Is a resource across the team for best practices and performance insights.

- Reporting & Analysis: Independently owns and proactively builds upon regular and ad hoc client-facing reporting in Deep Search, Google Ads, Microsoft. Expertly recognize and communicate performance trends and to connect the dots between performance trends and campaign management. Leads diagnosing account issues and steps needed to improve performance, as well as serves as a resource others can turn to. Able to dig into niche performance questions, pulling together data from multiple sources and telling a coherent performance story for the client.

- Strategy & Innovation: Leads strategic planning for entire account(s) and has full command of account’s marketing program and how the Paid Search strategy fits into it. Proactively coordinates with team on testing roadmaps and plans. Owns the why behind account and campaign setup. Proactively explores and investigates additional strategies that will help enhance the client's performance. Leads testing planning, execution, and reporting.

- Communication & Storytelling: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, serving as the primary point of contact for all paid search-related inquiries and updates. Invested in industry trends and creates recommendations around those trends for the client. Leads client calls and owns the day-to-day relationship with professionalism and enthusiasm. Ensure consistent and thorough follow-ups from client requests and post-client meetings. Ensures client emails are answered in a timely manner.

Qualifications:

- 3+ years in a fast-paced agency, media, or marketing environment, hands-on experience building and managing paid search campaigns.

- Google Ads & Bing Ads proficiency

- Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, Microsoft Word/Google Docs

- Excellent organizational and communication skills

- Proficient with SEM reporting and third-party analytics tools (E.g. GA4, Adobe, etc.)

- Google AdWords proficiency

- Experience managing data feeds and shopping campaigns.

Position Status: Exempt

Years of Experience: 3+ Years

Reports To: Director

Compensation

_The annual gross base salary range is $70,000- $115,000 USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K._

- At BarkleyOKRP, DEI+B drives work that matters. We believe people and creativity are made of the same substance, and when every perspective is valued, the impact is stronger. We build belonging as a business strategy, power inclusive creativity that delivers measurable results, and hold ourselves accountable as a B Corp committed to progress over performative intent. Samsara's Mission

Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.

This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.

You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
- You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

- Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
- Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
- Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
- Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
- Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
- Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.

Minimum requirements for the role:

- 3+ years of experience in event management/production
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
- This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time.
- Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

- Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization
- Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
- Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
- Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Strategic Events Marketing Manager

Samsara's Mission

Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.

This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.

You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
- You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

- Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
- Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
- Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
- Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
- Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
- Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.

Minimum requirements for the role:

- 3+ years of experience in event management/production
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
- This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time.
- Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

- Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization
- Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
- Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
- Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$79,135—$119,700 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. Events Marketing, Senior Specialist (REMOTE CST or EST)

Remote, United States

Apply

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

Our Global Events team understands the critical business impact we can make through events and experiences. As Senior Events Marketing Specialist, you'll play a key role in bringing Veeam's flagship internal events to life, including Veeam Launchpad (VL), our annual global sales kickoff; Veeam eXcellence (VX), our incentive event for top performers; and Veeam Quotient (VQ), our leadership summit.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter, problem solver, and strong communicator who is detail-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills. In this role, you'll support the team that plans, manages, and executes memorable and engaging experiences. You thrive in ambiguity, proactively seek solutions, and embrace change with agility, and you're comfortable making independent decisions and taking ownership of tasks while balancing multiple priorities. You'll report to the Senior Manager on the Global Events team and support project leads across several internal programs.

What You’ll Do

- Lead individual workstreams across various internal events, owning timelines, milestones, and deliverables that align with event strategy and business goals
- Manage day-to-day operations with external agency partners and vendors, including briefings, timelines, and deliverables
- Support the building and updating of registration sites and attendee portals, manage communications, and pull reports to evaluate performance
- Support attendee gifting and giveaways, from proposing ideas to working with vendors and placing orders through fulfillment
- Submit and track purchase requisitions and invoices; reconcile against event budgets and maintain accurate budget tracking
- Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, innovate event formats, and increase efficiency, including through AI tools

What You’ll Bring

- 4+ years of experience in event management, event production, or experiential marketing, ideally including internal or large-scale events
- Demonstrated experience leading a workstream or owning an event workstream from ideation through execution, including timelines, resources, and deliverables
- Hands-on experience with Cvent for registration and attendee management
- An independent self-starter who is proactive, adaptable, and thrives in fast-paced environments with minimal guidance, resilient, flexible, and agile
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of an organization, including senior stakeholder
- A team player who enjoys healthy debate around ideas, drives toward team goals, and leads with trust and empathy
- Tech literate and comfortable learning new platforms and tools; proficient in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel
- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 20% of the time

Bonus Skills

- Experience supporting internal events such as sales kickoffs, leadership summits, or company-wide programs
- Experience with additional event platforms such as RainFocus, Swoogo, Zoom, or Teams
- Experience with Coupa for purchasing and invoicing
- Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT
- Passion for creating innovative, high-impact experiences that leave a lasting impression on attendees

If you are an innovative, self-motivated team player who thrives in dynamic environments and loves creating exceptional experiences, we'd love to have you join our team!

LI-TS1 #remote

What you'll get

- Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
- Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
- Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
- 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
- Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
- AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
- Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
- Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
- Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.
