How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

- Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
- Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
- Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
- Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
- Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
- Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
- Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at evolve.com.

Senior Manager, Performance Marketing

Remote - US

Apply

At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

As Senior Manager of Performance Marketing, you'll own Evolve's paid acquisition program end-to-end — the channel mix, the budget, the campaigns, the creative strategy, and the agency relationships — against a monthly qualified-lead target and a cost per qualified lead. You'll decide where an eight-figure annual media budget goes, and you'll be in the platforms making those decisions yourself. The timing matters; We're winding down a search agency contract and bringing that work in-house, which means you'll be rebuilding the program rather than inheriting a finished one. We're also opening channels Evolve has never run — so a meaningful part of the first year is zero-to-one work.

This is a senior individual-contributor role on a small, flat, high-ownership team. You'll lead through evidence and influence rather than headcount.

The team

Growth owns Evolve's owner-acquisition funnel from first impression to a signed agreement, across five programs: Attract, Convert, Launch, Nurture, and Foundations. This role owns Attract. It's a small team by design, which means less process, more surface area, and a direct line from your decisions to the company's number.

What you’ll do

- Channel Strategy & Budget

  - Own paid channel mix and in-month allocation across paid search, paid social, programmatic, direct mail, AI search surfaces, and new test channels — strategy, campaign structure, bidding, budgets, pacing, and performance
  - Monitor qualified-lead delivery against plan and forecast, diagnose what's driving it, and decide where the next dollar is most likely to generate efficient volume
  - Own the monthly spend and volume inputs to the marketing forecast, and re-plan in-month when delivery moves

- Hands-On Campaign Management

  - Be hands-on in the platforms. Google Ads and Meta are yours to build and optimize directly, not to review in a weekly deck
  - Build audience strategy across prospecting, retargeting, customer lists, lookalikes, and Evolve's own first-party data on properties, permits, and owners
  - Design and analyze structured tests across audience, creative, bidding, placement, geography, and landing destination

- New Channels & Creative

  - Launch new channels from zero to one — Performance Max, connected TV, podcast, and an expanded direct mail program — with a plan for how each will be measured before it spends
  - Develop paid creative strategy with our creative partners: messaging, format, testing frameworks, and the analysis that decides what scales and what gets cut

Product Marketing Manager

Remote - US

Apply

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Product Marketing Manager to support the development of our product marketing function as Machinify evolves from services-based offerings to a unified, scalable tech platform model.

This is a builder role for someone excited to learn by doing. You will work closely with Product Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners to build foundational assets, support product launches, and help translate complex capabilities into clear, compelling messaging. You’ll play a key role in improving how our products are understood by customers and enabling sales and go-to-market success.

Key Responsibilities & Skillsets

Messaging & Positioning (Support & Execution)

- Assist in developing and refining product messaging, positioning, and value propositions across the platform –so buyers and the people who influence them understand “why Machinify” and “why now.”
- Translate complex AI-powered capabilities into clear, defensible value propositions for payer audiences (executive, clinical, operations, and payment integrity).
- Partner with product, sales, and operations teams to incorporate feedback into messaging and content.

Persona Development & Customer Insight

- Support the development of personas by gathering and synthesizing customer, sales, and market insights.
- Help map customer pain points and workflows across the payment integrity lifecycle.
- Partner with product, sales, and operations teams to incorporate feedback into messaging and content.

Video-Forward Storytelling & Core Asset Library

- Support video content development, including scripting, coordinating with subject matter experts, and working with creative teams. Potential output includes product explainers, “what it is/why it matters” modules, release highlights, and buyer-specific narratives that reduce time-to-understanding.
- Contribute to the creation of core marketing assets such as product collateral, sales enablement materials, and short-form content.
- Ensure content aligns with overall product messaging and clearly communicates customer value.

Product Launches

- Assist in coordinating product launches in partnership with Product Operations and Marketing.
- Help develop launch materials, internal communications, and enablement resources.
- Support execution of repeatable launch processes and post-launch learnings.

Sales Enablement

- Help create and maintain sales tools such as pitch decks, one-pagers, and competitive insights.
- Work with sales teams to understand common objections and areas where messaging can improve.
- Contribute to training and enablement efforts to support field teams.

What You Bring (role requirements)

Experience

- Experience in product marketing (or adjacent GTM roles with heavy messaging/content ownership), ideally in B2B SaaS and/or healthcare technology companies.
- Demonstrated experience supporting messaging, content creation, or product launches in a cross-functional environment.
- Experience partnering closely with product, operational, and sales counterparts.

Personal Attributes

- Builder Mentality: Energized by creating the first version of what “great” looks like, and then iterating quickly as you learn.
- High Ownership, Low Ego: Jumps in wherever needed, seeks truth over credit, and prioritizes outcomes over optics.
- Technical Fluency: Able to engage product and data science teams to understand what’s real, what’s differentiated, and what needs nuance, and then translate it for market impact.
- Clarity Obsessed: Unusually strong instinct for simplifying complexity into language that moves decisions and reduces friction.
- Credible, Customer-Focused Storytelling: Balances ambition with accuracy; aims for defensible, trustworthy narratives in a high-stakes healthcare context.
- Comfort with Ambiguity: Thrives in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as Machinify scales its unified platform approach.

Additional Requirements

- Experience building and scaling product marketing “from the ground up” is strongly preferred.
- Passion for healthcare technology and commitment to improving outcomes through smarter, more accurate systems.

This comprehensive set of requirements is designed to attract candidates who can effectively lead the product marketing function as Machinify brings our legacy companies together and transitions to a tech-first product model.

This is an exempt position. The salary range is for Base Salary. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law. In accordance with applicable state laws, we do not inquire about salary history during the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiters know. - You take ownership and follow through
- You communicate clearly and effectively
- You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
- You learn quickly and adapt as things change
- You care about the team, not just your own work
- You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

ClearGov has built a strong product marketing foundation, with an established team supporting product launches, messaging, and sales enablement across a growing portfolio. As the company enters its next phase of growth, ClearGov is hiring a Director of Product & Solution Marketingto elevate the function from strong product-level execution to platform-and- solution-level strategy.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, this leader will define how ClearGov positions, packages, and brings to market a suite of 13 products across cities, counties, school districts, and special districts, each with distinct needs and buying dynamics. The Director of Product & Solution Marketing will help the company make sharper decisions about where to invest, how the products fit together, and how ClearGov expands within its customer base.

This is a highly visible leadership role with meaningful autonomy and direct access to the executive team and board. The Director of Product & Solution Marketing will serve as a strategic partner to the VP of Marketing, CPO and CRO, translating customer and market insight into portfolio choices and measurable commercial impact.

This leader will manage an established team of four, creating a five-person product & solution marketing organization, with the opportunity to grow the team as the function expands.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead pricing and packaging strategy: Set the strategic direction for bundling, discounting, and launch pricing in partnership with Product, Finance, Revenue, and external research partners.
- Set portfolio and commercialization strategy: Define how ClearGov’s products fit together, where bundling and cross-sell opportunities exist, and how positioning and go-to-market motions should vary across customer segments.
- Shape executive decision-making: Represent product marketing with the executive team and board, connecting market, customer, and competitive insight to growth priorities and business performance.
- Lead and develop the product marketing organization: Build on the team’s subject matter expertise and strengths in messaging, launches, and enablement while expanding its capabilities in portfolio strategy, market intelligence, pricing, and commercial planning.
- Build a scalable launch and integration model: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales on new product / bundle launches and create repeatable approaches for positioning, packaging, and commercializing acquired products.
- Strengthen expansion motions: Partner with Revenue and Marketing leaders to improve cross-sell, upsell, and account-based growth programs across ClearGov’s customer base.
- Establish a market and customer intelligence discipline: Build competitive intelligence, win-loss analysis, and industry engagement that inform product, sales, and portfolio decisions.
- Own the market narrative and field adoption: Craft bold, outcome-based messaging that clearly differentiates ClearGov from spreadsheets and competing vendors, including sharp depositioning that sales can use in live deals. Ensure sales actually uses what the team builds by measuring content adoption, retiring assets that go unused, and tying messaging to win rates.
- Create clear measures of impact: Define how product marketing performance is evaluated and connect the team’s work to adoption, expansion, win rates, and revenue outcomes.

Critical Skills/Experience:

- Significant product marketing leadership experience in B2B SaaS, including recent experience at the Director or Senior Director level, or operating at a comparable scope.
- Experience owning go-to-market or commercialization strategy across a multi-product / platform portfolio, multiple customer segments, or distinct buyer personas.
- Pricing and packaging experience, including bundling, discounting, or launch pricing.
- A track record of translating customer, market, and competitive insight into positioning, portfolio, investment, or growth decisions.
- People leadership experience, including building, developing, and elevating a product marketing team.
- Strong partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing leaders in a mid-market or enterprise sales environment.
- Executive presence and sound judgment, with the ability to operate autonomously, align senior stakeholders, and communicate strategy clearly to executives and board members.
- Comfort operating in a growing, evolving business where portfolio priorities and organizational needs continue to change.
- Experience with mid-market or lower-enterprise B2B SaaS products in the $30K–$60K ARR range and sales cycles of approximately three to four months.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

- Experience with programmatic growth motions such as account-based marketing, cross-sell, or upsell at scale.
- Experience with enterprise SaaS products of $75k-$250M+
- Background in GovTech, FinTech, finance, accounting, compliance, or another technical or regulated vertical.
- Experience supporting growth through M&A, portfolio expansion, or product-line integration.
- Experience building win-loss, competitive intelligence, or industry analyst programs.

Compensation:

- In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $165,000 - $200,000 USD or $155,000 - 190,000 CAD, and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

- Remote and flexible work environment
- Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
- Collaborative, high-performing team
- Competitive compensation and benefits
- Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

- Medical, dental & vision insurance
- FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
- Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
- Life + disability insurance (Canada)
- 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
- 10 company holidays
- 3 wellness days
- Paid vacation time off
- Sick and safe time off
- Paid parental leave
- Paid bereavement leave
- Paid jury duty + civic service leave
- Employee assistance program
- 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
- Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply

Ready to join us? Apply online today!

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Keep Growing with Nutrafol

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

About You:

The Director, Brand Marketing, Nutrafol will build and launch the brand story for new product innovations!

Nutrafol is the #1 dermatologist-recommended hair growth supplement brand and the pioneer of the hair wellness category. We’re in the process of developing new product innovation that extends our focus from the inside-out to the outside-in. Your job is to make the range unmistakably Nutrafol  - why it exists, who it's for, how it fits the routine she's already in, and why she should believe it works.

You'll set strategy within the Nutrafol masterbrand platform, reporting to the SVP, Brand. Brand and Consumer

- Run the primary and secondary research that answers those questions; turn competitive and category analysis into a point of view, not a deck
- Identify the insights and tensions that shape both the launch and the next wave of innovation
- Own naming for the range and individual SKUs, working with Creative, with Legal and Product Development holding sign-off on trademark availability and claims risk

Product Partnership

- Deliver a ranked consumer-priority claims input ahead of study protocol design, so Product Development and R&D can prioritize what gets tested and substantiated
- Own how approved claims show up in market — which ones lead, how they're expressed, how they ladder to the story
- Shape the launch range and wave sequencing as a required consumer input into Product Development's range recommendation
- Protect the brand across every consumer-facing touchpoint, holding the line on the dermatologist-recommended credibility and the subscription model that built us

Launch and Go-To-Market

- Build the launch plan across DTC, Amazon, and Pro in partnership with Growth, Marketplaces, CX, and Pro Marketing
- Accountable for launch readiness and in-market performance against the agreed product availability date, which Product Development owns
- Own new product innovation pricing above an agreed margin floor set annually with Finance
- Lead the annual and quarterly brand plan for new product innovation, with clear priorities and a roadmap the cross-functional team can work from
- Brief and collaborate with Creative; lead ideation on campaign, content, and social narrative
- Set the brand direction for partnerships, collaborations, and any external voices attached to the range
- Manage the new product innovation brand marketing budget

Leadership without authority

- Keep a cross-company group moving to one plan - and know which decisions are yours, which are Product's, and which need both
- Own the consumer, positioning, and go-to-market sections of Unilever leadership updates, delivered from one shared plan alongside Product Development
- Give clear, executive-ready updates to Nutrafol leadership
- Surface risks and dependencies early rather than reporting them after the fact
- Track performance post-launch and use what you learn to sharpen the range and inform what comes next
- Build trust fast across teams who've never worked on a launch like this

Requirements:

- 8–12 years of brand management, brand marketing, or innovation marketing at a high-growth brand; hair care, beauty, or science-led consumer health preferred. DTC experience is required
- Track record taking a product from concept to market alongside R&D, regulatory, and supply chain - you don't need to have run formulation, but you need to know how to be a good partner to the people who do
- Proven ability to build integrated brand strategies and launch campaigns across digital, social, CRM, retail media, and direct response
- Strong commercial and go-to-market instincts across DTC, e-commerce, and omnichannel, including pricing
- Comfortable at the seam between an entrepreneurial brand and a large matrixed organization, and able to align partners across both without formal authority
- Fluent in segmentation and in both quantitative and qualitative consumer insight
- Sharp judgment on claims, positioning, and premium experience
- Entrepreneurial and self-directed - you'll be hands-on doing the work, not just directing it
- Exceptional written and verbal communication
- Low ego, high ownership, and the kind of energy that makes a dispersed team want to be in the room

The Senior Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for owning the execution, optimization, and operational excellence of Wave’s customer marketing automation programs across email, in-product, and push channels.

Working closely with Lifecycle and Product Marketing, Growth, Product, Data and other cross-functional partners, this role translates customer and business strategies into sophisticated, scalable automated journeys that drive activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and expansion.

This role serves as the subject matter expert in marketing automation, campaign orchestration, testing, and measurement —  ensuring our customer communications are highly targeted, personalized, measurable, and continuously optimized.

Here's How You Make an Impact:

- Own the execution and optimization of automated customer journeysacross email, in-product and push channels — from audience creation and build through QA, launch, monitoring and continuous improvement.

- Leverage Braze, Segment and Amplitude to turn customer data into action, using behavioral insights, product usage and lifecycle signals to build targeted audiences, trigger personalized journeys and identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, conversion and retention.

- Translate lifecycle strategies into scalable automation programs, partnering with Lifecycle, Product Marketing and Growth to determine the right audience, message, channel, timing and journey logic.

- Drive experimentation and optimization through A/B and multivariate testing across messaging, creative, targeting, timing, cadence and journey design, turning results into actionable recommendations.

- Own campaign performance and measurement, monitoring lifecycle and channel KPIs and partnering with Data & Analytics to understand customer behavior, measure impact and uncover opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure the health and scalability of our marketing automation ecosystem, maintaining strong standards for QA, deliverability, data integrity, consent, documentation and campaign governance.

- Serve as the marketing automation subject matter expert, partnering with Product, Data and Engineering to define the customer events, attributes and integrations needed to enable increasingly sophisticated segmentation, personalization and automation.

You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:

- 5+ years of experience in marketing automation, lifecycle marketing operations, CRM, or a related discipline, ideally within a SaaS, fintech, subscription, or product-led growth environment.

- Advanced hands-on experience with Braze, including building multi-step journeys, audience segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, and experimentation.

- Experience working with Segment and Amplitude, with the ability to use customer and product behavioural data to inform segmentation, journey design, and lifecycle optimization.

- Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing across onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, expansion, and re-engagement.

- Strong analytical and experimentation skills, with experience designing tests, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into actionable recommendations and optimizations.

- Strong knowledge of email, push and in-product messaging best practices, including deliverability, consent management, frequency management, and customer experience.

- Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and Liquid templating; with the ability to troubleshoot personalized, dynamic communications.

- Strong operational discipline and attention to detail, particularly across campaign QA, data accuracy, documentation and governance.

- A collaborative, self-directed approach, with the ability to independently own execution while partnering effectively with Growth, Product and Lifecycle Marketing teams, Data, Product and Engineering.

$85,000 - $105,000 a year

- Performance Measurement & Analytics - Own AMER reporting on pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, event performance, and funnel health. - 5–10 years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or other GTM strategy role in SaaS or specialized consultancy
- Familiarity with AMER markets GTM dynamics, including LATAM and Canada nuances

- Proven ability to build pipeline models, set defensible targets, design attribution frameworks, and translate data into executive recommendations. Strong understanding of CLV/LTV, CAC, ROI, and funnel metrics
- Experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and Marketo (including Marketo Measure / AEP for attribution)
- Hands-on experience with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau is appreciated

Bonus Skills

- Familiarity with any of the following is a plus: LeanData, 6sense, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Content syndication integrations, Monday.com (or equivalent PPM), Confluence, and emerging GTM engineering tools (e.g., Clay)

Customer Advocacy Marketing Manager

Remote - United States

Apply

About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

The Customer Advocacy Marketing Manager owns both the strategy and scaled production of customer proof-point content: case studies, customer quotes and testimonials, logo usage and compliance, and the customer reviews program (G2, Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius). This role also owns the Customer Awards program, on-site customer content capture (video/filming) at flagship events, and the review-platform vendor relationships and budget. The ideal candidate can set a proof-point content roadmap and prioritize it against business impact, not just execute a queue — while also running a high-volume content operation end-to-end, from sourcing through legal and customer approval. This role partners closely with our Senior Manager who owns high-touch programs like our CAB, Executive Sponsorship, RKO, and customer community.

Who You Are:

- 5+ years of experience in customer marketing, content marketing, or marketing operations, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and execution.
- Proven track record of setting a content roadmap and prioritizing initiatives against business impact, not just delivering against an intake queue.
- Proven track record of owning content projects end-to-end, including legal/compliance coordination.
- Experience owning vendor relationships and budget, ideally for review-generation or reference platforms.
- Strong written communication skills and an eye for turning customer insight into compelling assets.
- Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and content intelligence tools (e.g., Peerbound, Gong) preferred.
- Comfortable managing on-site logistics for large customer-facing events.

What You’ll Do:

Strategy & Prioritization

- Define the annual case study and proof-point content roadmap in partnership with Product Marketing, aligned to revenue and pipeline priorities.
- Determine which customer stories, quotes, and proof points to pursue based on expected pipeline, bookings, and adoption impact, rather than a first-in-first-out intake queue.

Content Production

- Own the scaled creation and end-to-end delivery of customer content — quotes, testimonials, and case studies — from sourcing through legal and customer approval.
- Use tools like Peerbound to transform customer insights from Gong calls into approved, actionable content at scale.
- Own the creation and promotion of customer spotlights.
- Manage updates to existing case studies and customer stories as messaging and strategy evolve.

Customer Reviews & Platform Ownership

- Own the customer reference database and the review-generation program across platforms including G2, Gartner Peer Insights, and TrustRadius.
- Own vendor relationships and budget for review platforms, including contract renewals and spend decisions.

Logo Management

- Own the end-to-end process for customer logo usage, ensuring adherence to contract terms and legal/brand compliance.

Customer Awards Program

- Own the customer awards program on a recurring annual cadence: nominee sourcing, winner selection coordination, winner notification, awards production, and integration into the event schedule.

Event Content Capture

- Own on-site video filming and customer engagement logistics at flagship events, including building the customer filming schedule and securing signed participation agreements ahead of the event.

Workflow & Operations

- Own and continuously refine the end-to-end content workflow, from intake to publication.
- Project manage creation, review, and approval processes for all customer proof-point assets.

Reporting & Analysis

- Track and report on the performance and business impact of proof-point content (pipeline, bookings, adoption influence).
- Deliver regular reporting to stakeholders and feed the consolidated advocacy narrative owned by the Advocacy Programs Senior Manager.

Stakeholder Communication

- Maintain proactive communication with Sales, CS, Product Marketing, and Legal.
- Serve as the point of contact and escalation path for each owned initiative; surface project risks before they affect a deadline.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$90,000 - $124,000USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
- All official communications will come from an @ alpha-sense.com email address.
- If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Principal Product Marketing Manager

Remote, US

Apply

MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

The Principal Product Marketing Manager, AIStor will own how MinIO's flagship product is positioned, messaged, and brought to market. AIStor is the data foundation for enterprise AI, providing durable object and table storage that serves AI and analytics workloads at scale. This role pairs deep technical fluency in AI infrastructure and data platforms with hands-on product marketing ownership of the product at the center of MinIO's portfolio.

You will translate AIStor's capabilities into differentiated narratives, build the content and launch programs that move pipeline, and equip the field to win competitive deals. You will work across Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Alliances, and Communications to define what AIStor is, who it is for, and why it wins, then carry that story consistently into every customer-facing asset.

What You Will Do:

- AIStor Product Narrative and Positioning: Own the messaging and positioning that defines AIStor as the data foundation for enterprise AI. Establish AIStor's role as primary storage for objects and tables across the full AI lifecycle, and keep that narrative consistent across web, sales, analyst, and partner surfaces. AIStor is positioned as primary AI storage, never as cold storage, archive, or a backup target.
- Messaging and Differentiation: Develop clear, technically grounded messaging that separates AIStor from alternatives on performance, scale, simplicity, and standards-based, no-lock-in architecture. Translate engineering work and benchmark results into claims that hold up with technical buyers, qualified by configuration and workload.
- Product Launch Execution: Drive go to market strategy and execution for AIStor launches and major feature releases. Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Field, Sales, and Communications to land launches that move pipeline, and align AIStor's story with the broader portfolio of objects, tables, and context memory.
- Solutions Marketing for AIStor Use Cases: Build solutions content that shows how AIStor solves specific customer problems, including AI training data lakes, large-scale analytics and table workloads, multimodal data pipelines, and serving as the high-throughput data foundation under modern inference stacks.
- Competitive Enablement: Own the competitive program for AIStor. Build and maintain battlecards, talk tracks, and teardown content that give the field a defensible, accurate view of how AIStor compares, with claims that stand up under scrutiny and do not boomerang onto MinIO's own positioning.
- Field Enablement: Build and deliver the enablement content (battlecards, talk tracks, customer presentations, technical briefs) that lets sales engineers and account teams confidently sell AIStor to AI infrastructure buyers, platform engineers, and data platform owners.
- Content Ownership: Produce and govern the core AIStor content library, including reference architectures, solution briefs, datasheets, and customer-facing narratives, maintaining a consistent technical voice and house style across all of it.

Your Skills and Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in product marketing, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML infrastructure, data platforms, storage, or other technical infrastructure products.
- Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for technical buyers and business decision makers.
- Strong technical acumen across modern AI infrastructure, data platforms, and the storage and analytics stack. Fluent enough to engage credibly with engineering teams and with technical buyers at customer accounts.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience creating sales enablement content, competitive materials, and customer-facing assets.
- Track record of executing high-stakes product launches with cross-functional coordination across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Communications.
- Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
- Hands-on familiarity with S3-compatible storage, object storage, or high-performance data infrastructure for AI and analytics workloads.
- Direct experience marketing a technical product against a defined competitive set, including building battlecards and competitive positioning.
- Familiarity with modern AI data pipelines, training and inference workflows, and table or lakehouse formats.
- Background that includes time in technical roles (engineering, solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or developer relations).

What We Offer:

- Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
- 401K with 3% Contribution
- Pre-IPO Stock Options
- At least 12 Public Holidays
- Flexible Time Off

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role Ethos is hiring a Director, Marketing Process & Technology to join our Compliance department as a senior leader. This person will own marketing compliance review at Ethos end to end: the process, the technology, and the majority of the reviews themselves. You will be both a hands-on senior reviewer and the owner of the system that performs the review, and you will be charged with a clear mandate: move marketing review toward automation through AI as far as it can defensibly go, without loosening the standard.

You will serve as business owner of the AI tool Ethos uses for marketing review, and you will be measured, in part, on how much of the review volume that tool can absorb and how reliably it performs. At the same time, you will personally handle the judgment calls, escalations, and novel questions that automation should not decide. Beyond the tool, you own the marketing review process itself: intake, prioritization, review standards, approved language, recordkeeping, and the working relationship with Marketing/Brand/business teams. This is a player-coach role. You will carry a real review load from day one and will eventually hire and oversee a compliance analyst to support you, which means building the standards, playbooks, and training that make the work delegable. You will be expected to drive thought leadership on marketing compliance matters across Ethos. Importantly, the candidate must be risk-minded, be a team player, confident in determining acceptable risk, think creatively to always find solutions, and be technology forward.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Own the AI marketing review tool and drive the shift toward automated, AI review, including:

- Act as business owner and administrator of the tool, including configuration, rule and prompt tuning, testing, and release management
- Define the automation tiers : what AI approves outright, what AI reviews subject to human confirmation, and what always requires human review
- Continuously improve automated review quality by measuring the tool’s output against human review, tuning to reduce missed issues, and expanding the categories of content it can handle
- Establish human-in-the-loop thresholds, sampling, and ongoing QA to validate that the tool remains reliable as content, products, and regulations change
- Own the auditability of AI-assisted decisions so that any approval can be reconstructed and defended to an examiner, auditor, or carrier
- Partner with vendors and with internal engineering and data teams on integration, evaluation, and roadmap
- Grow the share of reviews completed through automation as a primary, measured objective

Own the marketing compliance review process, including:

- Design and run intake for all marketing review requests, with clear SLAs, routing, and prioritization
- Maintain the review standards of record , including: review criteria, required disclosures, and the library of pre-approved claims and language
- Personally perform the majority of reviews and serve as decision-maker on close calls, documenting rationale so decisions accumulate into usable precedent
- Maintain the recordkeeping and audit trail of submissions, versions, approvals, and conditions of approval
- Measure and improve throughput, cycle time, and review quality

Cover the full range of marketing content subject to review, including:

- Consumer-facing marketing across paid media, lifecycle and email, web, brand, and social
- Agent and producer-facing materials, including recruiting, training, and sales support content
- Partner, carrier, and co-branded campaign materials
- Product and disclosure content embedded in online flows, including rate and quote presentation and required disclosures

Keep standards evergreen, including:

- Translate insurance advertising and marketing regulatory change into concrete review criteria, tool rules, and updated approved language
- Refresh disclosure and claim libraries as products, state approvals, and carrier requirements change

Partner across the business, including:

- Embed compliance early in the marketing lifecycle, at brief and concept stage rather than at launch
- Act as trusted advisor and thought leader to Marketing, Brand, Growth, Product, and Legal
- Partner with the Compliance Risk Management team so that marketing review controls are documented and independently tested
- Support advertising filings where required, along with market conduct exams, regulatory requests, carrier requests, and data calls

- Build and lead the function. You will operate as a hands-on player-coach, then hire, onboard, develop, and manage a compliance analyst as volume and automation maturity allow
- Own marketing compliance reporting and governance, including review volume, cycle time, automation rate, quality and error rates, and KRIs
- Assist in drafting and updating marketing compliance policies and procedures
- Provide general compliance support, as needed, across the team and company, including research and provisioning of compliance guidance across Ethos

Qualifications and Skills:

- 12+ years of relevant Compliance work experience in the insurance industry, including significant hands-on marketing and advertising review experience
- Deep expertise in insurance regulatory marketing compliance, including advertising requirements, required disclosures, and advertising filing obligations across states
- Demonstrated ownership of a high-volume marketing or advertising review function, including the standards and the workflow behind it
- Hands-on experience putting AI or automation to work inside a compliance review workflow - configuring it, measuring it, and improving it, rather than simply using it
- Ability to define and defend where automation is appropriate and where human judgment is required, and to evidence that distinction to auditors, examiners, and carriers
- Strong process design instincts, including: intake, SLAs, prioritization, throughput, and cycle time
- Comfort working with data to measure review quality and automation performance, and to report both to senior leadership
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
- Persuasive communicator and thought leader who can hold a firm line with Marketing without becoming a bottleneck
- Be highly responsive and service-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to maintain strong working relationships with demanding internal clients
- Experience hiring, developing, and managing an analyst, or clear readiness to do so
- Possess sound and practical business judgment, and confidence in determining acceptable risk
- Ability to multi-task and work independently or with cross-functional teams, while adapting quickly to ambiguous and rapidly changing environments
- Attention to detail

About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role Ethos is hiring a Director, Marketing Process & Technology to join our Compliance department as a senior leader. This person will own marketing compliance review at Ethos end to end: the process, the technology, and the majority of the reviews themselves. You will be both a hands-on senior reviewer and the owner of the system that performs the review, and you will be charged with a clear mandate: move marketing review toward automation through AI as far as it can defensibly go, without loosening the standard.

You will serve as business owner of the AI tool Ethos uses for marketing review, and you will be measured, in part, on how much of the review volume that tool can absorb and how reliably it performs. At the same time, you will personally handle the judgment calls, escalations, and novel questions that automation should not decide. Beyond the tool, you own the marketing review process itself: intake, prioritization, review standards, approved language, recordkeeping, and the working relationship with Marketing/Brand/business teams. This is a player-coach role. You will carry a real review load from day one and will eventually hire and oversee a compliance analyst to support you, which means building the standards, playbooks, and training that make the work delegable. You will be expected to drive thought leadership on marketing compliance matters across Ethos. Importantly, the candidate must be risk-minded, be a team player, confident in determining acceptable risk, think creatively to always find solutions, and be technology forward.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Own the AI marketing review tool and drive the shift toward automated, AI review, including:

- Act as business owner and administrator of the tool, including configuration, rule and prompt tuning, testing, and release management
- Define the automation tiers : what AI approves outright, what AI reviews subject to human confirmation, and what always requires human review
- Continuously improve automated review quality by measuring the tool’s output against human review, tuning to reduce missed issues, and expanding the categories of content it can handle
- Establish human-in-the-loop thresholds, sampling, and ongoing QA to validate that the tool remains reliable as content, products, and regulations change
- Own the auditability of AI-assisted decisions so that any approval can be reconstructed and defended to an examiner, auditor, or carrier
- Partner with vendors and with internal engineering and data teams on integration, evaluation, and roadmap
- Grow the share of reviews completed through automation as a primary, measured objective

Own the marketing compliance review process, including:

- Design and run intake for all marketing review requests, with clear SLAs, routing, and prioritization
- Maintain the review standards of record , including: review criteria, required disclosures, and the library of pre-approved claims and language
- Personally perform the majority of reviews and serve as decision-maker on close calls, documenting rationale so decisions accumulate into usable precedent
- Maintain the recordkeeping and audit trail of submissions, versions, approvals, and conditions of approval
- Measure and improve throughput, cycle time, and review quality

Cover the full range of marketing content subject to review, including:

- Consumer-facing marketing across paid media, lifecycle and email, web, brand, and social
- Agent and producer-facing materials, including recruiting, training, and sales support content
- Partner, carrier, and co-branded campaign materials
- Product and disclosure content embedded in online flows, including rate and quote presentation and required disclosures

Keep standards evergreen, including:

- Translate insurance advertising and marketing regulatory change into concrete review criteria, tool rules, and updated approved language
- Refresh disclosure and claim libraries as products, state approvals, and carrier requirements change

Partner across the business, including:

- Embed compliance early in the marketing lifecycle, at brief and concept stage rather than at launch
- Act as trusted advisor and thought leader to Marketing, Brand, Growth, Product, and Legal
- Partner with the Compliance Risk Management team so that marketing review controls are documented and independently tested
- Support advertising filings where required, along with market conduct exams, regulatory requests, carrier requests, and data calls

- Build and lead the function. You will operate as a hands-on player-coach, then hire, onboard, develop, and manage a compliance analyst as volume and automation maturity allow
- Own marketing compliance reporting and governance, including review volume, cycle time, automation rate, quality and error rates, and KRIs
- Assist in drafting and updating marketing compliance policies and procedures
- Provide general compliance support, as needed, across the team and company, including research and provisioning of compliance guidance across Ethos

Qualifications and Skills:

- 12+ years of relevant Compliance work experience in the insurance industry, including significant hands-on marketing and advertising review experience
- Deep expertise in insurance regulatory marketing compliance, including advertising requirements, required disclosures, and advertising filing obligations across states
- Demonstrated ownership of a high-volume marketing or advertising review function, including the standards and the workflow behind it
- Hands-on experience putting AI or automation to work inside a compliance review workflow - configuring it, measuring it, and improving it, rather than simply using it
- Ability to define and defend where automation is appropriate and where human judgment is required, and to evidence that distinction to auditors, examiners, and carriers
- Strong process design instincts, including: intake, SLAs, prioritization, throughput, and cycle time
- Comfort working with data to measure review quality and automation performance, and to report both to senior leadership
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
- Persuasive communicator and thought leader who can hold a firm line with Marketing without becoming a bottleneck
- Be highly responsive and service-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to maintain strong working relationships with demanding internal clients
- Experience hiring, developing, and managing an analyst, or clear readiness to do so
- Possess sound and practical business judgment, and confidence in determining acceptable risk
- Ability to multi-task and work independently or with cross-functional teams, while adapting quickly to ambiguous and rapidly changing environments
- Attention to detail
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deadlines

Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Remote, USA

Apply

Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Today, Twin Health does almost no proactive marketing to our active members. Once someone enrolls, nearly every communication they receive is either a product-triggered push notification or a message from their care team. That has taken us a long way — but it leaves an entire layer of engagement unbuilt.

We are hiring our first Active Member Marketing Manager to build that layer. You will own the strategy and the execution of every proactive, non-clinically led communication a Twin member receives: email, SMS, in-app and push campaigns, direct mail testing, member webinars, and additional channel exploration we have not yet tried. You will design how those communications layer into the care team relationship and the product notification ecosystem already in place.

This is a build role requiring both strategic vision as well as executional know how. Twin members, data, clinical outcomes, and Braze infrastructure is already in place. What does not exist is a deliberate lifecycle program. You will write the strategy, then ship it yourself. We are looking for someone who can point to campaigns they personally built and outcomes they personally moved.

Responsibilities

Active Member Strategy and Program Ownership

- Map the member journey to build sustained engagement, as well as winback for lapsed members, and define the communication strategy for each stage, including who we deliberately choose not to message.
- Own the annual and quarterly engagement roadmap, with a defined direction on stage involvement
- Build a segmentation model grounded in real member behavior, sensors, app engagement, care team interaction, clinical trajectory, enrollment channels, etc.
- Govern the member communication calendar across marketing, care team, product, and clinical, so members experience one coherent voice instead of four uncoordinated ones.

Integration with the Care Team and Product Ecosystem

- Inventory the existing touchpoint landscape and maintain that map as the source of truth.
- Partner with Care Delivery and Clinical leadership to define the boundary between a marketing communication and a clinical one. Member marketing should make the care team more effective, not compete with it for attention.
- Design suppression, frequency capping, and quiet-hours logic across all channels so total message volume stays deliberate as the program scales.
- Work with Product on campaign-based push and in-app messaging
- Ensure deployment accuracy by accounting for the operational realities of the point solution ecosystem: eligibility files, employer and health plan communication rules, benefits calendars, co-branding constraints, and the fact that our members are often being messaged by three other vendors the same week.

Execution, Platform, and Analysis

- Build and ship campaigns end to end in Braze: audience logic, Canvas and journey build, content, QA, launch, and iteration.
- Write copy and creative briefs, and manage design, clinical and legal review as needed to deliver timely campaigns on schedule.
- Develop the Braze instance as it matures: event taxonomy, catalog and Connected Content usage, template library, preference center, deliverability and sender reputation, and the data contract with our Snowflake warehouse.
- Stand up a formal testing program: subject lines and creative to start, then channel mix, cadence, timing, incentive structure, and a direct mail pilot
- Measure performance and build dashboard in partnership with Marketing operations to showcase campaign efficacy
- Report results to Growth Marketing and the broader leadership team on a regular cadence, including wins, losses and adjustments as a result.
- Maintain compliance discipline throughout — HIPAA, PHI handling, TCPA and consent management for SMS, CAN-SPAM, and internal clinical review.
- Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Required

- 4–7 years in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or engagement marketing, with meaningful time spent owning programs end to end rather than executing someone else’s brief.
- Hands-on Braze expertise. You can build a multi-branch Canvas with behavioral triggers, Liquid personalization, and proper suppression logic without waiting on engineering.
- Real multi-channel experience including email plus at least one of SMS, push, or in-app
- Demonstrated experimentation rigor: you design tests with holdouts, understand what a result can and cannot support, and are comfortable reporting a null.
- Comfort building and defining processes. This program does not exist yet; you will be building the first version.

Strongly Preferred

- Healthcare or digital health experience, with working fluency in HIPAA and PHI handling in marketing systems.
- Direct experience in the point solution ecosystem: a digital health, condition management, or benefits vendor distributed through employers, health plans, or health systems. You understand eligibility-driven populations, client communication approvals, and the practical difference between enrollment marketing and active member marketing.
- Experience marketing alongside a human care team or clinical staff
- Exposure to offline or physical channels (direct mail, print, or member webinars) and how to measure them.

How We Will Measure Success

- Channel metrics matter, but they are not the scoreboard. In the first year, this role will be evaluated on:
- Member activation:  speed and rate of getting new members fully onboarded and using the program as designed.
- Sustained engagement: sensor wear, app usage, and care team interaction over time, particularly past the point where members typically plateau.
- Retention — reduced member attrition
- Clinical outcomes — increased milestone achievements directly impact the bottom line for Twin. Program maturity — a functioning lifecycle engine: documented strategy, healthy deliverability, a running test backlog, and reporting the business trusts.

This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

- A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
- A remote and accomplished global team
- Opportunity for equity participation
- Unlimited vacation with manager approval
- 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
- 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
- 401k retirement savings plan

This is a build role requiring both strategic vision as well as executional know how. Twin members, data, clinical outcomes, and Braze infrastructure is already in place. What does not exist is a deliberate lifecycle program. You will write the strategy, then ship it yourself. We are looking for someone who can point to campaigns they personally built and outcomes they personally moved.

Responsibilities

Active Member Strategy and Program Ownership

- Map the member journey to build sustained engagement, as well as winback for lapsed members, and define the communication strategy for each stage, including who we deliberately choose not to message.
- Own the annual and quarterly engagement roadmap, with a defined direction on stage involvement
- Build a segmentation model grounded in real member behavior, sensors, app engagement, care team interaction, clinical trajectory, enrollment channels, etc.
- Govern the member communication calendar across marketing, care team, product, and clinical, so members experience one coherent voice instead of four uncoordinated ones.

Integration with the Care Team and Product Ecosystem

- Inventory the existing touchpoint landscape and maintain that map as the source of truth.
- Partner with Care Delivery and Clinical leadership to define the boundary between a marketing communication and a clinical one. Member marketing should make the care team more effective, not compete with it for attention.
- Design suppression, frequency capping, and quiet-hours logic across all channels so total message volume stays deliberate as the program scales.
- Work with Product on campaign-based push and in-app messaging
- Ensure deployment accuracy by accounting for the operational realities of the point solution ecosystem: eligibility files, employer and health plan communication rules, benefits calendars, co-branding constraints, and the fact that our members are often being messaged by three other vendors the same week.

- Write copy and creative briefs, and manage design, clinical and legal review as needed to deliver timely campaigns on schedule.

- Measure performance and build dashboard in partnership with Marketing operations to showcase campaign efficacy

- Comfort building and defining processes. This program does not exist yet; you will be building the first version.

- Healthcare or digital health experience, with working fluency in HIPAA and PHI handling in marketing systems.

Later is seeking an Account Supervisor to drive strategic client partnerships and deliver best-in-class influencer marketing programs. In this role, you’ll own the success of key accounts, shaping integrated strategies, leading cross-functional execution, and ensuring every campaign delivers measurable business impact.

You will serve as a senior client partner and internal leader — overseeing Account Managers and Coordinators, guiding strategic direction, and acting as a trusted advisor to brands. This is a high-impact role that combines client strategy, operational excellence, and team leadership to strengthen Later’s position as a top partner in the creator economy.

Strategy

- Lead the development of influencer marketing strategies that align with client objectives and deliver measurable ROI.

- Build and nurture senior client relationships, positioning Later as a trusted strategic advisor.

- Facilitate strategic business reviews and campaign reporting that translate performance into actionable next steps.

- Identify expansion and upsell opportunities within accounts, partnering with Sales and Strategy to grow revenue.

- Contribute to RFPs and new business pitches by bringing client insights and proven campaign expertise.

Technical / Execution

- Oversee execution of multiple influencer campaigns from kickoff to wrap, ensuring quality, compliance, and measurable impact.

- Guide Account Managers in managing day-to-day client communications and executional tasks.

- Own campaign budgets, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are on track and aligned with client commitments.

- Ensure campaigns meet FTC guidelines and platform standards while maintaining creative excellence.

- Monitor campaign KPIs, surface insights, and recommend optimizations to improve performance.

Team / Collaboration

- Partner with Social, Strategy, Creator Success, Paid Media, Product, and Sales to deliver seamless integrated campaigns.

- Act as the voice of the client and influencer, ensuring feedback informs platform improvements and future strategies.

- Collaborate cross-functionally to embed innovation and elevate Later’s reputation with clients and across the industry.

Leadership

- Manage and mentor direct reports, building a high-performing, client-focused team.

- Provide coaching, performance feedback, and growth opportunities to Account Managers and Coordinators.

- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Anticipate risks early and implement proactive solutions that remove blockers for the team.

Research / Best Practices

- Stay ahead of industry trends, platforms, and cultural shifts — embedding innovation into client strategies.

- Contribute thought leadership to position Later as a market leader in influencer and creator marketing.

- Build and maintain internal processes that guarantee compliance and operational excellence across accounts.

- Key client accounts achieve renewal and expansion targets, with measurable ROI from campaigns.

- Later is seen as a trusted strategic partner, not just an executional vendor.

- Campaigns are consistently delivered on time, on budget, and above quality standards.

- Account Managers and Coordinators under your leadership grow in performance and confidence.

- Later’s Services team is recognized for innovation, compliance rigor, and best-in-class execution.

What You Bring

- 5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, or digital campaign management, with direct client-facing experience.

- Proven ability to lead client strategy and deliver results against brand objectives.

- 2+ years of strong management experience, including coaching, performance reviews, and day-to-day team leadership.

- Deep knowledge of social platforms, influencer best practices, and compliance requirements.

- Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate performance into actionable insights.

- Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

- Track record of driving account growth and strengthening client partnerships.

- Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
- Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
- Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
- Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
- Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
- Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Senior Marketing Ops Strategist

Remote - Argentina

Apply

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

*Please note: This is a contract, project-based position.

A day in the life:

As the Senior Marketing Operations Strategist, you provide comprehensive marketing operations support for our larger and more complex B2B and B2C Lead-Generation clients. You are responsible for managing the tools and processes that enable lead capture, nurture, and flow through the revenue funnel. This includes building the foundation for marketing operations success as well as optimizing and maintaining marketing operations excellence on an ongoing basis. You will also perform high-level sales operations tasks, including but not necessarily limited to building intermediate automations and dashboards for revenue teams, and building and advising on standard CRM-use processes for the sales team. You fully understand all standard system processes needed to produce factual and reliable reports.

You will also provide senior support to other Marketing Operations Strategists on accounts, and be someone that team members can turn to with ad hoc strategy or troubleshooting assistance.

You know how to act fast to solve problems and think of long-term processes and solutions. You know how to capitalize on our standard deliverables, or on the flip side, know how to pivot if a specific solution doesn't make sense for a client at that point in time. You have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future processes and strategies.

Responsibilities:

- Setting the foundation for Marketing Operations excellence

  - Manage and perform Marketing Automation Platform/CRM setups (primarily Hubspot)
  - Manage and perform migrations to new Marketing Automation Platforms/CRMs (primarily Hubspot)
  - Clean up existing Marketing Automation Platforms/CRMs and continue to ensure they operate cleanly and efficiently

    - Typical clean-up tasks include deduplication (via Insycle), field standardization, asset organization, contact purges, sync error resolutions, sync setting updates, compliance program setup, and custom field consolidation

  - Set up any custom objects or custom behavioral events
  - Ensure any platform integration syncs are accurate and clean and set up new integrations that have a native integration with the MAP
  - Strategize sales and marketing alignment automation within the Marketing Automation Platform/CRM
  - Lead program strategy and implementation including target audience builds (ie. ICP criteria and decision-maker makeup), list segmentation, lifecycle funnel automation, workflow development, and scoring model creation

- Optimizing and expanding existing Marketing Ops setups

  - Build dashboards within the CRM for revenue teams that contain important metrics and KPIs for each leader
  - Lead qualification automation optimizations
  - Campaign creation & SOPs
  - System troubleshooting & additional customizations
  - Additional custom reports & dashboards

- High-level sales operations processes and functions within the CRM

  - KPI field setup & tracking (ex. Lead status date stamps, speed to lead tracking, etc.)
  - Sales performance & activity reports
  - Operational and day-to-day SOP creation for CRM utilization and clean data entry

- Support internal growth of the Marketing Ops Department
  - Audit systems of prospective/existing clients
  - Actively identify opportunities to improve products/services beyond their accounts
  - Mentors team members and holds strategy sessions on accounts they support with
  - Reviews and provides feedback to junior team members on reports & deliverables
  - Assist with developing our product offering, identify opportunities to improve the department, and actively share insights with the team
  - Document all processes and conduct trainings for client and/or sales team members

Requirements:

- 4+ years experience in marketing operations or related role
- Expert in Hubspot and proficient in Pardot (any other MAP and CRM platforms are a plus!)
- High proficiency in Salesforce with the ability to perform intermediate functions including but not limited to:

  - Report and dashboard-builds
  - Campaign setup and reporting
  - Field setup and mapping
  - Record customization
  - Intermediate to advanced automation builds

- Experience with various sales and marketing systems and tools (ie. ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, Insycle, 6Sense, etc.) and an understanding of how they interact and integrate with a Marketing Automation Platform and/or CRM
- Ability to quickly troubleshoot issues within the marketing technology stack (including the CRM)
- Experience building out complex processes and automations
- Ability to be client-facing and discuss complex strategies and recommendations with the client
- Comfortable with ambiguity. You know how to structure complex issues and take a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.
- Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators):

- Leads 6 - 8 clients (more of our complex clients)
- RPE goal of $25k/month
- 90% client retention rate

MITs (Most Important Things):

- Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback
- Lead trainings and plays an active role in team member development and support within the department
- Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
