A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. - Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
- Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
- Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
- Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
- Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
- Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
- Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
- Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
- Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
- Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
- Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
- Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
- Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
- On time for all deliverables & launches
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
- A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
- Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
- Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
- Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
- Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
- Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
- Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers
- Proactive, solution-oriented problem solver with a team-player mentality and a bias toward original thinking over templated execution
- Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
- Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Client Book Revenue per Employee: $30k
- Client Retention: 90%
- Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%
- Range of the number of accounts (8-12)

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback → primarily working on Enterprise and/or Growth accounts
- Deep literacy of the full B2B marketing funnel and buyer journey, and command of the role Integrated Content plays in moving multi-stakeholder deals through it
- Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution
- Working with the team to delegate Integrated Content tasks and receive them back with enough time to review so that you are always hitting deadlines in regards to client workflow with minimal errors (no typos, grammatical issues). Strong attention to detail with minimal review from Account Managers and Account Directors.

- Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

Returned title: Job Application for Senior Integrated Content Marketing Strategist at Power Digital

Posting details:
[](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/)

Senior Integrated Content Marketing Strategist

Remote - Brazil

Apply

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. This role operates across the full integrated content ecosystem: thought leadership, sales enablement, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks — all engineered to move a considered, multi-stakeholder buyer through a long B2B sales cycle. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. This is a strategist who thinks in systems: mapping content audits to the buyer journey, running audience research and stakeholder interviews to surface what actually moves a B2B deal forward, and adapting the roadmap as account performance and market signals shift. They bring product-level thinking to the content offering itself; proposing new formats and approaches before clients ask. They will also mentor and uplevel the strategists and writers who support their accounts. They are equally fluent identifying the single biggest content opportunity in a client's funnel and articulating why it matters in a room full of VPs and CMOs.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
- Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
- Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
- Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
- Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
- Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
- Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
- Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
- Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
- Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
- Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
- Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
- Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
- On time for all deliverables & launches
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
- A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
- Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
- Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
- Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
- Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
- Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
- Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers
- Proactive, solution-oriented problem solver with a team-player mentality and a bias toward original thinking over templated execution
- Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
- Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Client Book Revenue per Employee: $30k
- Client Retention: 90%
- Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%
- Range of the number of accounts (8-12)

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback → primarily working on Enterprise and/or Growth accounts
- Deep literacy of the full B2B marketing funnel and buyer journey, and command of the role Integrated Content plays in moving multi-stakeholder deals through it
- Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution
- Working with the team to delegate Integrated Content tasks and receive them back with enough time to review so that you are always hitting deadlines in regards to client workflow with minimal errors (no typos, grammatical issues). Strong attention to detail with minimal review from Account Managers and Account Directors.

Benefits & Perks:

- Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
- Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
- Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
- Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
- Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

_Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/_ _. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at_ _recruiting@powerdigital.com_ _before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence._

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion.  They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment.  Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives.  As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality.  They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

- Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
- Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
- Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
- Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
- Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
- Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
- Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
- Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

- Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
- Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
- CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
- Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
- Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
- Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
- Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
- Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
- An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
- Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
- Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
- Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
- Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
- Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Project Manager, Digital Marketing

Remote - Nicaragua

Apply

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client.  This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion.  They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment.  Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives.  As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality.  They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

- Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
- Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
- Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
- Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
- Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
- Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
- Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
- Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

- Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
- Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
- CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
- Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
- Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
- Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
- Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
- Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
- An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
- Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
- Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
- Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
- Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
- Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. - Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues

- Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
- CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
- Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
- Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
- Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
- Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
- Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
- An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
- Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
- Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
- Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
- Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
- Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

These clients need a different kind of AD. The Power Circuit work is the same, but what you find is usually more fundamental: weak product-market fit signals, an undefined audience, no measurement baseline, and a media mix built on gut instinct. Prioritization matters more here because you can't fix everything at once, and trying to will burn both the client and the team.

- Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement; build a prioritized roadmap that accounts for what the client can actually execute with their current resources
- Own the senior client relationship, which often means the founder directly; QBRs should feel like a board-ready business update, not a marketing recap
- Help clients build measurement infrastructure from scratch when it doesn't exist, establish baselines before optimizing against them
- Coordinate paid, SEO, content, email, and creative work around a focused account strategy; scope management is part of the job
- Identify expansion opportunities that fit the client's stage, don't oversell services a brand isn't ready for
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
- Coach analysts and specialists; many will be working with startups for the first time

Role Requirements:

- 6+ years in marketing, with meaningful experience working with early-stage or scaling consumer brands
- Has worked with founder-led businesses and understands the dynamic — decisions move fast, emotions run high, strategy and execution blur together
- Comfortable building from scratch: no brand guidelines, no historical data, no benchmark — and still making good decisions
- Understands crowdfunding-to-DTC transitions and what changes when a brand moves from Kickstarter momentum to sustainable acquisition
- Strong prioritization instincts — knows which problems to solve first and which to defer
- Comfortable with scrappy media mixes and knows how to get signal out of small budgets
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts, including accounts that went through rough patches

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
- Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

- Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
- Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
- Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement; build a prioritized roadmap that accounts for what the client can actually execute with their current resources
- Own the senior client relationship, which often means the founder directly; QBRs should feel like a board-ready business update, not a marketing recap
- Help clients build measurement infrastructure from scratch when it doesn't exist, establish baselines before optimizing against them
- Coordinate paid, SEO, content, email, and creative work around a focused account strategy; scope management is part of the job
- Identify expansion opportunities that fit the client's stage, don't oversell services a brand isn't ready for
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
- Coach analysts and specialists; many will be working with startups for the first time

Role Requirements:

- 6+ years in marketing, with meaningful experience working with early-stage or scaling consumer brands
- Has worked with founder-led businesses and understands the dynamic — decisions move fast, emotions run high, strategy and execution blur together
- Comfortable building from scratch: no brand guidelines, no historical data, no benchmark — and still making good decisions
- Understands crowdfunding-to-DTC transitions and what changes when a brand moves from Kickstarter momentum to sustainable acquisition
- Strong prioritization instincts — knows which problems to solve first and which to defer
- Comfortable with scrappy media mixes and knows how to get signal out of small budgets
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts, including accounts that went through rough patches

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Team Coaching and Development
- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid

- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

- Own the senior client relationship, which often means the founder directly; QBRs should feel like a board-ready business update, not a marketing recap
- Help clients build measurement infrastructure from scratch when it doesn't exist, establish baselines before optimizing against them
- Coordinate paid, SEO, content, email, and creative work around a focused account strategy; scope management is part of the job
- Identify expansion opportunities that fit the client's stage, don't oversell services a brand isn't ready for
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk

- Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
- Coach analysts and specialists; many will be working with startups for the first time

- Comfortable building from scratch: no brand guidelines, no historical data, no benchmark — and still making good decisions
- Understands crowdfunding-to-DTC transitions and what changes when a brand moves from Kickstarter momentum to sustainable acquisition
- Strong prioritization instincts — knows which problems to solve first and which to defer
- Comfortable with scrappy media mixes and knows how to get signal out of small budgets
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts, including accounts that went through rough patches

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Team Coaching and Development
- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Prepaid Medicine Plan

- Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors

- 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
- Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
- Paid Social Security

- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk

- Comfortable with DTC-first brands and understands the economics: CAC, LTV, repeat rate, margin by channel
- Experience with Meta-heavy media mixes and the measurement challenges that come with them — incrementality testing, creative fatigue, audience saturation
- Has worked with brands that move seasonally and knows how to build a strategy that accounts for it
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts

- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Own the senior client relationship; QBRs should connect creative and campaign decisions back to business outcomes
- Coordinate paid search, paid social, influencer, SEO, email, and creative teams — in fashion these functions depend on each other more than in most other verticals
- Consult on customer retention strategy: repeat purchase rate, LTV by acquisition cohort, and loyalty mechanics
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Coach and give direct feedback to analysts and specialists

- 6+ years in fashion or apparel marketing, agency or brand side
- Understands how creative strategy and media strategy interact — has an opinion on which comes first and why
- Fluent in the influencer and UGC ecosystem: knows how to brief, evaluate, and scale it without losing brand control
- Comfortable with DTC-first brands and understands the economics: CAC, LTV, repeat rate, margin by channel
- Experience with Meta-heavy media mixes and the measurement challenges that come with them — incrementality testing, creative fatigue, audience saturation
- Has worked with brands that move seasonally and knows how to build a strategy that accounts for it
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Serve as Power Digital's primary ABM subject matter expert and Account Director for the Strategy and ABM teams
- Build and refine ABM audits, playbooks, and GTM plans for clients in partnership with the B2B Client Strategy team
- Architect and manage 6Sense and Demandbase implementations, including intent data integration, account scoring models, and predictive analytics workflows
- Translate intent and engagement data into actionable account tiers and campaign triggers for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams
- Lead cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to ensure ABM campaigns are unified rather than siloed
- Identify efficiency opportunities in the delivery of ABM products and collaborate toward implementation
- Support Revenue and Appraisal teams on complex GTM and ABM strategies for new and expanded business opportunities
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM measurement and reporting
- Present ABM strategy and performance directly to clients; lead discovery discussions on account-based approaches
- Mentor and upskill Strategy and ABM team members on platform proficiency and account-based methodology
- Own the ABM measurement framework — pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and velocity through funnel stages

Role Requirements:

- Mandatory: hands-on proficiency with 6Sense, Demandbase, or equivalent ABM/intent data platforms — this is a non-negotiable requirement for the role, not a nice-to-have
- 7+ years in B2B marketing strategy or ABM, in-house or in-agency, with demonstrated ownership of account-based programs end to end
- Strategic knowledge of core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, and HubSpot, and how they integrate with ABM platforms
- Deep understanding of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering — and how to operationalize them across channels
- Comfort and ease presenting strategy to clients and leading discovery discussions
- Strong project management skills; able to run multiple client ABM programs concurrently
- Strategic understanding of clients' business metrics and pipeline mechanics, and how ABM contributes to them
- Team-oriented and collaborative; comfortable leading cross-functional teams without direct authority
- Agency experience valued but not required

- Net MRR across B2B ABM / Strategy portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Lead cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to ensure ABM campaigns are unified rather than siloed
- Identify efficiency opportunities in the delivery of ABM products and collaborate toward implementation
- Support Revenue and Appraisal teams on complex GTM and ABM strategies for new and expanded business opportunities
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM measurement and reporting
- Present ABM strategy and performance directly to clients; lead discovery discussions on account-based approaches
- Mentor and upskill Strategy and ABM team members on platform proficiency and account-based methodology
- Own the ABM measurement framework — pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and velocity through funnel stages

- Strategic knowledge of core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, and HubSpot, and how they integrate with ABM platforms
- Deep understanding of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering — and how to operationalize them across channels
- Comfort and ease presenting strategy to clients and leading discovery discussions
- Strong project management skills; able to run multiple client ABM programs concurrently
- Strategic understanding of clients' business metrics and pipeline mechanics, and how ABM contributes to them
- Team-oriented and collaborative; comfortable leading cross-functional teams without direct authority
- Agency experience valued but not required

- Net MRR across B2B ABM / Strategy portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Clear, direct, and radically candid communication with internal and external stakeholders
- Client value — has your work provided new insight, confirmed a course of action, or outlined a clear path forward

- Architect and manage 6Sense and Demandbase implementations, including intent data integration, account scoring models, and predictive analytics workflows

- Identify efficiency opportunities in the delivery of ABM products and collaborate toward implementation

- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM measurement and reporting
- Present ABM strategy and performance directly to clients; lead discovery discussions on account-based approaches
- Mentor and upskill Strategy and ABM team members on platform proficiency and account-based methodology
- Own the ABM measurement framework — pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and velocity through funnel stages

- Comfort and ease presenting strategy to clients and leading discovery discussions

- Consult on geographic expansion and local market prioritization — many consumer services clients want to scale markets and need a framework for it

- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk

- Understands lead funnel economics: CPL, lead-to-opportunity rate, cost per acquisition, LTV by lead source

- Comfortable with paid search-heavy media mixes and local campaign structures
- Familiar with local SEO, GMB, and review strategy — these matter in home services and similar categories
- Understands the difference between lead volume and lead quality, and has experience shifting a client's focus from one to the other
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

- Team Coaching and Development
- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

- Unlimited Time Off available on day one

Digital Marketing Manager

Remote - USA or Canada

Apply

Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

As a Digital Marketing Manager at Array, you will be our in-house performance marketing engine — you do what a full-service agency would do, except you sit inside the GTM team, know our verticals, and are accountable to pipeline. This role reports to the Head of Marketing.

The role

You’re the person in the ad platforms, in the CMS, in the analytics. Every program you run has a goal attached: net new customers, retention, or land-and-expand. If it can’t be tied to one of those, it doesn’t run.

You will:

- Paid media — strategy and execution. Own Google Ads and LinkedIn end to end: account structure, budgets, bids, audiences, creative testing, and performance. Targeting aligned to our Tier 1/Tier 2 must-get accounts and five verticals. You build it, you run it, you hold the number.
- SEO and AI search — Build our organic program from a standing start: technical foundation, on-page work, keyword strategy mapped by vertical, and optimizing for how buyers actually search now (traditional rankings and AI/answer-engine visibility). You write the briefs; content production supports you.
- Top-of-funnel demand — Own the programs that fill the top of the funnel: search and social capture, content syndication, retargeting, and the paid layer under our ABM motion into must-get accounts.
- Landing pages and conversion — Own the conversion layer of the site: landing pages, A/B testing, form and funnel optimization, and our Qualified chatbot (routing through Salesforce). You own what converts.
- Measurement — Own tracking and reporting for everything above: UTM discipline, Salesforce campaign hygiene, and a pipeline-by-channel view.
- Work in the platforms daily. No vendor sits between you and the data.
- Report digital’s contribution to pipeline by vertical, in the same terms sales uses.
- Cut spend on programs that aren’t working, including the ones you built.
- Act on what you find the same week when able — a new audience, a rebuilt page, a tracking fix.
- Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster — it’s your default, not an afterthought.

Who you’ll work with

- Demand Gen, Sales and our Vertical Marketing Managers — your programs feed their pods, and account lists shape your targeting.
- Marketing Ops and RevOps — your partners on routing, attribution, and Salesforce campaign hygiene.

What great looks like

- 90 days in: you own paid spend end to end — accounts audited, broken campaigns rebuilt, underperforming spend cut. Baseline SEO is in place (technical audit, keyword map by vertical, first briefs out) and testing is running on the top conversion paths.
- 6 months in: leadership uses your pipeline dashboard in planning. Organic traffic is growing. Sales can point to deals that started with a program you ran.

You have:

- 5+ years running performance marketing hands-on for B2B, with real budget ownership — you’ve planned spend, defended it, and moved it when the data said to. Agency background is strongly welcome; you’ve run multiple client accounts and want to go deep on one.
- Platform fluency you can prove: Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and a CRM/MAP stack (we run Salesforce and HubSpot; we also use, ZoomInfo, and Gong).
- Real SEO chops: you can run a technical audit, brief content, and explain search visibility — including AI search — to an executive without jargon.
- CRO experience with testing frameworks, not just hunches.
- A pipeline-first mindset: you talk in opportunities and revenue influenced, not just impressions.
- Strong project management and communication — you can run multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once with clear briefs, tight timelines, and no dropped threads.
- Comfort as a team of one with agency-sized scope — this is a build role in a fast-moving GTM org, and you’d rather own the whole engine than a slice of it.
- A belief that AI is reshaping work — you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do: analysis, reporting, briefs, creative iteration. Our team builds this way; you should too.

Nice to have:

- Fintech experience or selling into financial institutions.
- ABM platform experience and tiered account strategy.
- Experience marketing embedded/API products or private label offerings.
- Background in growth, social, or partner marketing alongside paid — you’ve pulled more than one lever.
- Experience with behavioral and intent data for targeting (we use ZoomInfo intent).
- Enough design/creative sense to brief ad creative well.

Pay transparency: $160,000 + for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.

Expected interview process: Recruiter Conversation - Hiring Manager Interview - Loop round:

Expected onboarding process: Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.

Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:

- Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full-time employees and 70% for dependents
- Unlimited PTO and sick leave + 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work-life blend
- 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting
- Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents
- $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office
- $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses
- Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August
- Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces

_Not sure if you meet the Qualifications? We know that folks tend to only apply if they check every box. If you think you have the appropriate qualifications, but don’t meet every single one, we encourage you to still apply. We’d love to hear from you._

Array will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants—if you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please email talent@array.com to make your request._

- Marketing Ops and RevOps — your partners on routing, attribution, and Salesforce campaign hygiene.

- 6 months in: leadership uses your pipeline dashboard in planning. Organic traffic is growing. Sales can point to deals that started with a program you ran.

- Strong project management and communication — you can run multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once with clear briefs, tight timelines, and no dropped threads.
- Comfort as a team of one with agency-sized scope — this is a build role in a fast-moving GTM org, and you’d rather own the whole engine than a slice of it.
- A belief that AI is reshaping work — you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do: analysis, reporting, briefs, creative iteration. Our team builds this way; you should too.

- Fintech experience or selling into financial institutions.
- ABM platform experience and tiered account strategy.
- Experience marketing embedded/API products or private label offerings.
- Background in growth, social, or partner marketing alongside paid — you’ve pulled more than one lever.
- Experience with behavioral and intent data for targeting (we use ZoomInfo intent).

Vertical Marketing Manager (VMM)

Remote - USA or Canada

Apply

Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

As a Vertical Marketing Manager at Array, you will be the strategic owner of personalized account messaging, industry positioning, pipeline acceleration, and revenue impact within your assigned vertical. This role reports to the Senior Partner, Marketing.

Why this role matters

Generic messages don’t win must-get accounts. The Vertical Marketing Manager exists to make sure every message a target account sees — a sequence, a campaign, an AE deck — feels like it was written specifically for them: their industry, their pain points, their numbers.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on role for a senior marketer who thrives at the intersection of product, sales, and ecosystem partnerships. You’ll operate with autonomy, partner closely with GTM leadership, and directly influence how Array wins in your assigned market.

You will:

- Define and execute a vertical marketing strategy for your assigned GTM Pod.
- Develop clear ICPs, value propositions, use cases, and competitive positioning aligned to the pod’s sales motion.
- Build personalized messaging frameworks by account tier, persona, and pain point — so outreach, campaigns, and AE conversations all speak the account’s language.
- Partner with Product, Data, and Marketing to embed differentiated data and insights into personalized account narratives.
- Translate complex, data-rich capabilities into compelling, industry-specific messaging that resonates with economic buyers and technical stakeholders.
- Deliver field-ready enablement (decks, playbooks, battlecards, ROI tools, customer stories) — personalized to the account level for must-gets — that improves win rates and accelerates deal velocity.
- Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster — it’s your default, not an afterthought.

Campaign strategy

- Partner closely with GTM leaders to build and execute campaigns built on personalized messages — 1:1 for must-gets, 1: few for the tier behind them — that generate qualified pipeline from priority accounts.
- Drive increased awareness within your vertical to position Array as the standard for embedded financial wellness, identity, and privacy products.
- Coordinate integrated campaign strategies across touchpoints — email, webinars, paid and organic channels, outreach, in-person experiences, and more — with the personalized message carried through every touch.
- Partner with RevOps to define success metrics, analyze performance, and iterate based on results — scaling what works and refining what doesn’t.

Cross-functional partnership

- Act as the vertical marketing owner for your pod during planning cycles and QBRs.
- Influence stakeholders across Product, Sales, Data, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure strong commercialization of new capabilities.
- Establish and track KPIs tied to pipeline, revenue contribution, win rates, and strategic account growth.
- Bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and industry trends into GTM strategy discussions.

You have:

- 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, including product marketing, vertical/industry marketing, or partner/channel marketing experience in high-growth SaaS, fintech, financial services, or adjacent environments.
- Demonstrated success driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through vertical or segment-focused marketing initiatives.
- Hands-on experience building personalized, account-level messaging and running 1:1 / 1:few ABM programs.
- Strong ability to translate complex, data-centric technology into clear, compelling industry narratives.
- Experience partnering closely with sales teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Analytical rigor and experience tying marketing programs to business outcomes.
- Strong project management skills and the ability to drive multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
- A belief that AI is reshaping work — you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.

Pay transparency: $160,000 + for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.

Expected interview process: Recruiter Conversation - Hiring Manager Interview - Loop round:

Expected onboarding process: Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.

Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:

- Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full-time employees and 70% for dependents
- Unlimited PTO and sick leave + 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work-life blend
- 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting
- Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents
- $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office
- $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses
- Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August
- Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces

Marketing Operations Specialist

Remote

Apply here

Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

What we’re looking for

Demand Generation Marketing Manager: We're looking for someone who brings a marketer's curiosity and a builder's mindset to the Mid-Market segment. You understand the market we serve, the buyers you're reaching, and what moves them to act all while maintaining enthusiasm to solve challenges physical operations organizations face. You're always sharpening the axe: questioning assumptions, testing new approaches, growing your AI skill set and looking for ways to make the next campaign better than the last. You enjoy comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and are not discouraged by blockers, but motivated to find solutions. If this sounds like you, read on!

Role Responsibilities

- Plan, execute, and optimize Programmatic ABM campaigns and full-funnel demand generation campaigns across dmid-market, and working with other segment leads to ensure large scale campaigns accurately capture ICP for all segments/personas.
- Partner closely with the Content Marketing, Customer Marketing and PMM team to map existing content to the buyer's journey, identify content gaps, and request new content and sales collateral to support campaign objectives.
- Maintain target account lists and apply a working understanding of buyer funnel stages, definitions, and conversion benchmarks to inform targeting and messaging decisions.
- Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure accurate targeting, list hygiene, and campaign setup, flagging issues and driving resolution proactively.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing to apply established messaging frameworks to campaigns and adapt messaging for segment-specific needs.
- Develop campaign and creative briefs independently, including copy direction, messaging hierarchy, and design inputs that align to buyer journey stages.

Campaign and ABM Execution

- Partner with channel owners to launch and monitor campaigns across: 6sense Display, LinkedIn, Additional Display channels, Content Syndication, Email, Web, Events/Field, Associations. You will not be responsible for hands on keyboard but work with partners to understand how each channel works individually and collectively to drive new pipeline across buying committees.
- Own execution for select channels, including: Webinars, Calendared Sales Plays, and partnering on Direct Mail: managing end-to-end setup, targeting, launch, and performance tracking.
- Ensure channel execution aligns to defined campaign messaging and buyer journey stages, making adjustments based on performance data and segment feedback.
- Evaluate channel activations and performance and make strategic decisions based on segment and buyer needs, reallocating spend or effort when warranted.
- Build testing and iteration cycles into each campaign to gain a larger understanding of demand generation learnings.
- Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate campaign personalization, sales play development, and insight generation — applying a working knowledge of AI to streamline day-to-day execution without sacrificing quality.

Sales Partnership and Enablement

- Partner with SDRs, AEs, and sales leadership to align marketing campaigns with outbound and inbound motions, ensuring marketing programs support sales priorities and pipeline goals.
- Enable sales teams to act on campaign engagement by providing targeting direction, messaging, sales plays, and enablement materials.
- Maintain regular communication with sales partners to share campaign performance, upcoming programs, and recommended actions, and to incorporate sales feedback into campaign planning.

- Contribute to weekly sales communications that summarize active marketing initiatives, upcoming programs, and sales actions.
- Prepare materials for sales meetings and planning sessions, tailoring content to the audience.
- Attend select sales meetings to stay aligned on priorities and feedback, advocating for marketing programs and incorporating sales input into campaign planning.

Reporting and Optimization

- Monitor campaign performance and pipeline contribution against goals, identifying trends, risks, and optimization opportunities independently.
- Partner with Marketing Analytics to maintain dashboards and reporting cadences; partner with Marketing Operations and Sales Operations to maintain Outreach dashboards and sales command centers in Salesforce.
- Analyze performance data to understand what is working and why, making recommendations for reallocation or adjustment.
- Contribute to weekly Mid-Market metrics updates with clear, actionable insights.
- Support ad-hoc reporting needs for WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs as requested, translating data into recommendations for leadership.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, campaign management, or growth marketing (not including internships).
- Proven track record of executing multi-channel demand generation campaigns that drive measurable pipeline contribution beyond just events.
- Hands-on experience with ABM strategies, including 1:Few and 1:Many campaign motions.
- Experience partnering with sales teams (SDRs, AEs) to align marketing campaigns with outbound and inbound motions.
- Working knowledge of marketing automation platforms and CRM systems (Salesforce, Marketo)
- Comfortable analyzing campaign performance data in Excel/Google Sheets and Tableau, with the ability to derive insights and make data-informed decisions.
- Strong project management skills with experience in Asana or equivalent tools.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling campaign briefs and sales enablement materials.
- Experience required: Salesforce (required), Asana, Sendoso (or equivalent), Outreach. Glean, Clay (preferred)
- Location Preference: Austin, TX, Nashville TN or San Francisco (2x a week in the office); however for the right candidate we will consider remote USA

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.
