Demand Generation Program Manager | United States | Remote

United States (Remote)

Apply

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists.

Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches.

We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting.

This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project.

You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones.
- Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it.
- Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter.
- Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content.
- Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing.
- Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it.

What Makes You a Great Fit

- 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus).
- Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions.
- Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers.
- Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for.
- Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.
- Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.
- Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator.

Bonus Points For

- Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries.
- Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost.
- Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem.
- Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).
- Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.

In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $100,000- $120,000.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

_*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process._

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
- In-Person onboarding- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. _*We will comply with local legislation where applicable._

Equal Opportunity Employer: _Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow._

_Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings._

About The Princeton Review

The Princeton Review is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company’s Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 22 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

About the Position

We're looking for a strategic analytics leader to own revenue metrics across the customer lifecycle—from acquisition through retention. This role is perfect for someone who loves understanding the complete customer journey, optimizing unit economics, and empowering teams with data-driven insights that directly impact company growth.

You'll report to our VP of Consumer Revenue and partner with marketing, sales, and customer success teams. You’ll have insights to lead cross-functional analytics that drive customer acquisition, conversion, and retention. This leader will own marketing analytics alongside sales funnel insights and customer lifetime value metrics. You'll translate complex data into actionable insights that directly impact our revenue and unit economics. You'll blend marketing analytics rigor with sales funnel insights and customer lifetime value optimization.

What You'll Do

- Analyze the Complete Revenue Picture
- Track customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) by channel
- Understand which marketing channels drive the highest-quality leads and best ROI
- Analyze sales funnel metrics and identify conversion bottlenecks
- Identify retention drivers and churn patterns to improve LTV
- Build Revenue Analytics Infrastructure
- Own marketing analytics, sales funnel reporting, and customer retention dashboards
- Manage the marketing tech stack and integrations (Braze, Salesforce, tracking)
- Establish consistent revenue metrics across all functions
- Create executive reporting that enables fast, confident decisions
- Drive Revenue Insights & Optimization
- Identify 5+ analytics-driven initiatives to improve unit economics
- Calculate payback periods and ROI by channel
- Recommend pricing, positioning, and retention strategies informed by data
- Partner with marketing, sales, and customer success on data-driven initiatives
- Lead a High-Performing Analytics Team
- Hire and develop 3–5 analytics professionals
- Create career development paths and establish best practices
- Align analytics across revenue functions

Who You Are

You have 7–10+ years of analytics experience, with proven expertise in both marketing analytics and revenue metrics (CAC, LTV, retention). You're comfortable diving deep into data while keeping business impact front and center. You thrive in cross-functional environments and love translating data into decisions.

Key Skills & Experience:

- Strong SQL and data visualization (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI)
- Deep knowledge of marketing funnel, attribution, and channel analytics
- Expertise in SaaS metrics (CAC, LTV, cohort retention, churn, payback period)
- Hands-on experience with marketing technology (Braze, Salesforce, Google Tag Manager)
- Familiarity with sales funnel and CRM analytics
- Ability to analyze complex customer journeys across channels and touchpoints
- Proven ability to partner with non-technical stakeholders and drive adoption
- Leadership experience managing analytics teams

Nice to Have:

- SaaS or subscription business background
- Experience with customer segmentation and cohort analysis
- Predictive analytics or forecasting experience
- Growth marketing or experimentation knowledge
- Data warehouse experience (Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you'll establish trusted revenue dashboards that marketing, sales, and customer success teams rely on daily. You'll identify and help implement 5+ initiatives that improve unit economics—whether through better channel targeting, faster sales cycles, or improved retention. You'll reduce manual reporting time by 50%, freeing up your team to focus on analysis and insight. Most importantly, you'll be known as the leader who made data central to every revenue decision.

Why You'll Love This Role

- Revenue Impact: Your work directly influences company growth and profitability
- Hybrid Scope: Analyze the complete customer lifecycle, not just one function
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with marketing, sales, product, and finance leaders
- Business Criticality: Analytics inform every major decision across revenue functions
- Team Building: Hire and develop a diverse analytics team
- Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US with a fully distributed team

_The Princeton Review and Tutor.com offer a competitive salary which commensurates with experience and skills._

$150,000 - $175,000USD

- Collaborate with senior leadership to align digital marketing strategy with broader organizational strategies

- Working strategic knowledge of PPL, Programmatic, video, and paid social sufficient to set strategy and QA outcomes
- 2+ years managing individual contributors with demonstrated ability to set channel strategy while delegating execution
- Proven track record translating channel performance into strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders
- Experience with marketing platforms like Google Analytics, SA360, Salesforce, Tableau, Marketo, etc.

- Support Customer Expansion: Collaborate on campaigns designed to educate the install base and drive adoption/upsell for key product expansion motions.
- Measure, Optimize, & Enable: Standardize program reporting and post-campaign assessments. Equip regional Field Marketing and Sales/BDR teams with actionable insights, lead enablement assets, and clear SLAs to maximize pipeline conversion within the 90-day window.

Digital Marketing Manager - Americas

Toronto, Ontario, Canada Remote

Apply

About Appspace:

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

Your Role as a Digital Marketing Manager:

We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale Appspace’s paid media engine. Paid media is the primary mandate of this role—you will control significant advertising budgets across search, social, and display channels, and be held accountable for pipeline contribution and ROAS. Beyond paid, you’ll help optimize our website for conversion and AI-engine discoverability, and partner cross-functionally to ensure every dollar of digital spend is tied directly to revenue outcomes.

_This is not a generalist role. The right candidate lives in campaign dashboards, obsesses over cost-per-opportunity, and knows how to scale what’s working while ruthlessly cutting what isn’t._

A Day in the Life of a Digital Marketing Manager:

1. Own and Optimize Paid Media Programs

Paid media performance is the core metric by which this role is measured. You will:

- Manage and allocate multi-channel paid media budgets across Google Ads (Search, Display, P-Max), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, 6sense, and Meta Ads—continuously rebalancing based on pipeline contribution and cost-per-opportunity.
- Build and maintain always-on advertising programs alongside point-in-time campaign bursts, ensuring consistent pipeline coverage throughout the fiscal year.
- Develop quarterly paid media plans grounded in buyer persona research, intent data, and competitive analysis; translate strategy into channel-specific execution plans with clear KPIs.
- Define and own paid media KPIs: CTR, CPC, CPL, cost-per-MQL, cost-per-opportunity, ROAS, and pipeline-influenced revenue. Report weekly to senior leadership.
- Run structured A/B tests on ad copy, creative, audience segments, bidding strategies, and landing pages; document results and scale winners systematically.
- Design and test ad creative and copy by leveraging AI generation tools alongside content and design teams—using performance data to drive the next iteration of brand assets.
- Leverage B2B intent data and account-intelligence platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora) to build targeted ABM ad campaigns aligned with Sales outbound targets.
- Stay current with platform algorithm changes (Google’s AI-driven bidding, LinkedIn audience expansion, Meta Advantage+) and adapt strategies proactively.

1. Optimize Website Performance

- Measure and monitor the Appspace website’s health, performance, and conversion rates; share regular dashboards with marketing leadership and stakeholders.
- Optimize web content, layout, structure, and UX for both human conversions (CRO) and AI-engine discoverability (SEO/AEO), ensuring Appspace surfaces across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery.
- Manage and coordinate with Appspace’s external SEO agency—set deliverables, hold the agency accountable to results, and integrate SEO insights into paid media and content strategies.
- Implement and maintain website tracking through Google Tag Manager.

1. Collaborate Across the Marketing & Revenue Team

- Feed paid media performance data, search intent trends, and AI-discovery insights back into the content engine—partnering with creative, copywriting, and content teams so messaging continually evolves based on real-time market signals.
- Work hand-in-hand with Revenue Operations to manage multi-touch attribution models, ensuring all digital spend is mapped to pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue.
- Support integrated campaigns by handling all paid advertising components: planning, audience building, ad construction, trafficking, and measurement.
- Contribute to quarterly and annual marketing planning by providing paid media performance data and forward-looking budget recommendations.

What You'll Need:

- Paid Media Expertise (Required): 5+ years managing substantial B2B SaaS paid media budgets with demonstrable results—specific experience driving pipeline from Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta is essential. Please be prepared to share performance results.

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

Your Role as a Digital Marketing Manager:

We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale Appspace’s paid media engine. Paid media is the primary mandate of this role—you will control significant advertising budgets across search, social, and display channels, and be held accountable for pipeline contribution and ROAS. Beyond paid, you’ll help optimize our website for conversion and AI-engine discoverability, and partner cross-functionally to ensure every dollar of digital spend is tied directly to revenue outcomes.

_This is not a generalist role. The right candidate lives in campaign dashboards, obsesses over cost-per-opportunity, and knows how to scale what’s working while ruthlessly cutting what isn’t._

A Day in the Life of a Digital Marketing Manager:

1. Own and Optimize Paid Media Programs

Paid media performance is the core metric by which this role is measured. You will:

- Manage and allocate multi-channel paid media budgets across Google Ads (Search, Display, P-Max), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, 6sense, and Meta Ads—continuously rebalancing based on pipeline contribution and cost-per-opportunity.
- Build and maintain always-on advertising programs alongside point-in-time campaign bursts, ensuring consistent pipeline coverage throughout the fiscal year.
- Develop quarterly paid media plans grounded in buyer persona research, intent data, and competitive analysis; translate strategy into channel-specific execution plans with clear KPIs.
- Define and own paid media KPIs: CTR, CPC, CPL, cost-per-MQL, cost-per-opportunity, ROAS, and pipeline-influenced revenue. Report weekly to senior leadership.
- Run structured A/B tests on ad copy, creative, audience segments, bidding strategies, and landing pages; document results and scale winners systematically.
- Design and test ad creative and copy by leveraging AI generation tools alongside content and design teams—using performance data to drive the next iteration of brand assets.
- Leverage B2B intent data and account-intelligence platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora) to build targeted ABM ad campaigns aligned with Sales outbound targets.
- Stay current with platform algorithm changes (Google’s AI-driven bidding, LinkedIn audience expansion, Meta Advantage+) and adapt strategies proactively.

- Measure and monitor the Appspace website’s health, performance, and conversion rates; share regular dashboards with marketing leadership and stakeholders.
- Optimize web content, layout, structure, and UX for both human conversions (CRO) and AI-engine discoverability (SEO/AEO), ensuring Appspace surfaces across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery.
- Manage and coordinate with Appspace’s external SEO agency—set deliverables, hold the agency accountable to results, and integrate SEO insights into paid media and content strategies.
- Implement and maintain website tracking through Google Tag Manager.

1. Collaborate Across the Marketing & Revenue Team

- Feed paid media performance data, search intent trends, and AI-discovery insights back into the content engine—partnering with creative, copywriting, and content teams so messaging continually evolves based on real-time market signals.
- Work hand-in-hand with Revenue Operations to manage multi-touch attribution models, ensuring all digital spend is mapped to pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue.
- Support integrated campaigns by handling all paid advertising components: planning, audience building, ad construction, trafficking, and measurement.
- Contribute to quarterly and annual marketing planning by providing paid media performance data and forward-looking budget recommendations.

- Paid Media Expertise (Required): 5+ years managing substantial B2B SaaS paid media budgets with demonstrable results—specific experience driving pipeline from Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta is essential. Please be prepared to share performance results.

- Platform Mastery: Expert-level command of Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM and SFDC reporting.
- ABM & Intent Data: Practical experience using B2B intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent) to build targeted account-based campaigns in close partnership with Sales.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to move beyond surface-level reporting—interpret multi-touch attribution, journey-aware bidding signals, and predictive analytics to make budget decisions with confidence.
- Web & CRO Fluency: Solid understanding of CMS management, landing page builders (e.g., Unbounce, Webflow), and conversion rate optimization best practices.
- Revenue Mindset: Comfortable tying digital spend directly to pipeline and closed-won revenue; you speak the language of Sales and RevOps, not just marketing.
- Adaptability: A bias for action and experimentation in a fast-changing landscape where AI platforms and buyer behaviors shift quickly.

apply for this job

Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Job Description

Role Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Senior Solutions Marketing Manager to join the specialized Growth team focused on Intelligence Center X, Siemens' agentic enterprise system and Mendix.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Solutions Marketing, this role is responsible for developing compelling solution narratives that connect Intelligence Center X and its portfolio of products to the business challenges, priorities, and opportunities facing enterprise customers.

Working across Product Marketing, Sales, Industry teams, Campaigns, and Field Marketing, you will translate the core platform story into customer-centric messaging, industry solution plays, and sales-ready content that accelerates pipeline and supports strategic growth initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative role for a strategic marketer who enjoys simplifying complex technologies into compelling business stories that resonate with executive buyers and technical decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Messaging and Positioning

- Develop differentiated solution messaging and positioning for Intelligence Center X and Mendix across priority industries and use cases.

- Translate platform capabilities into customer-focused narratives that clearly articulate business outcomes and value.

- Create messaging frameworks tailored to key buying personas, including CIOs, business leaders, data and AI teams, and application developers.

- Ensure solution messaging aligns with the overarching Intelligence Center X and Mendix narrative while addressing industry-specific priorities.

Industry and Use Case Development

- Build solution stories around strategic business challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and digital transformation initiatives.

- Develop industry-specific messaging for aerospace and defence, automotive, heavy equipment and industrial machinery and other priority industries.

- Partner with industry experts to ensure messaging reflects market trends, customer needs, and competitive differentiation.

- Identify new solution opportunities and emerging market themes to strengthen Siemens' market position.

Go-to-Market Enablement

- Create solution briefs, messaging guides, presentations, playbooks, sales tools, and customer-facing assets.

- Support product launches, campaigns, webinars, events, analyst engagements, and executive presentations.

- Enable sales and field teams with messaging that helps position Intelligence Center X and Mendix against customer priorities and competitive alternatives.

- Support strategic customer opportunities by tailoring solution narratives for priority accounts.

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Marketing to ensure solution messaging accurately reflects platform capabilities and roadmap priorities.

- Work with Campaigns and Field Marketing to develop integrated go-to-market programs and industry campaigns.

- Collaborate with Brand and Communications to reinforce strategic messaging themes and thought leadership.

- Gather customer, sales, and market feedback to continuously refine messaging and identify new opportunities.

Market Intelligence

- Monitor competitive positioning, market trends, and customer challenges across target industries.

- Bring market insights into messaging development and go-to-market planning.

- Identify whitespace opportunities where Intelligence Center X can create differentiated customer value.

Qualifications

Required

- 6–10 years of experience in Solutions Marketing, Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, or Go-to-Market roles within enterprise software or B2B SaaS.

- Experience developing solution messaging for AI, analytics, cloud platforms, application development, or enterprise technology.

- Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys and complex solution selling.

- Experience creating sales enablement content and customer-facing messaging.

- Excellent written, presentation, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex technologies.

- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across product, sales, marketing, and leadership teams.

- Ability to work effectively within a global, matrixed organization.

Preferred

- Experience marketing AI, machine learning, low-code platforms, data platforms, or digital transformation technologies.

- Knowledge of industrial manufacturing, financial services, public sector, life sciences, energy, or other enterprise industries.

- Experience supporting analyst relations, executive thought leadership, or strategic customer engagements.

Success Measures

In this role, you will:

- Deliver compelling solution narratives that increase customer engagement and strengthen Intelligence Center X's market positioning.

- Enable sales teams with messaging and content that supports pipeline generation and deal acceleration.

- Produce high-impact industry messaging that aligns with customer priorities and strategic growth markets.

- Improve consistency of solution storytelling across campaigns, product launches, and field execution.

- Build trusted relationships across Product, Sales, Industry Marketing, and Campaign teams as the go-to expert for solution messaging.

Closing

Compensation and Benefits

The pay range for this position is $102,500 - $184,500 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher within this range depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

In addition to the base salary,  Siemens offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Silverback’s next SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search.

You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll also flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses.

Here’s what we expect from our SEO Manager:

—What You'll Do—

- Strategic Chops: Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies.

- AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines.

- Analytical Skills: Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

- Client-Facing: Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner.

- Client Management: Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships.

- Tactical Execution: Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale.

- Innovation: Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices.

- Data Analysis: Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life.

—What We’re Looking For—

- Agency Background: You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results

- Years of Experience: We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 2 years of agency experience; 3 years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required, 5+ years preferred.

- Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients.

- AI Search Testing & Optimization: You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out.

- Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar.

- Content Experience: You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production.

- Tools/Platforms: You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog.

- “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king.

- Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.

- Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you.

—Why Silverback?—

- Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

- Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

- Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

- Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

- Unlimited PTO

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

- Monthly Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

- Company-paid ClassPass membership

- 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Summer Fridays

- 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

- We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

- We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

- Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!

Legend is hiring a Senior SEO Specialist, reporting directly to our Head of SEO.

You’ll identify opportunities to use AI and automation, challenge existing processes and develop scalable solutions that can deliver meaningful impact across the wider SEO team.

You don’t need to be an AI expert. - Own and drive SEO performance across key markets or complex initiatives, shaping longer-term roadmaps, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring priorities align with wider business objectives.

- Design, test and implement scalable automation workflows that improve how the wider SEO team operates, including opportunities to transform areas such as SEO QA.
- Lead analysis of wider changes across our portfolio, translating findings into clear strategic recommendations and influencing cross-functional teams to deliver measurable improvements.
- Help shape the future of SEO at Legend, challenging existing processes, driving continuous improvement and sharing your expertise to help others adopt smarter, more scalable ways of working.

What You'll Bring:

- Deep SEO expertise, particularly across on-page optimisation, with strong technical SEO knowledge and experience developing strategies that deliver measurable improvements across large, complex websites.
- Advanced analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets, identifying trends and translating insights into strategic recommendations that influence longer-term priorities.
- A proactive approach to AI and automation, with experience identifying opportunities, experimenting with solutions and improving workflows to deliver greater efficiency and scalability.
- A proven ability to independently own complex SEO initiatives, prioritise opportunities based on impact and effort, and deliver measurable outcomes while navigating cross-functional dependencies.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex analysis, challenge assumptions and influence decisions across teams through evidence-backed recommendations.
- The strategic thinking, autonomy and adaptability to solve ambiguous problems, anticipate challenges and drive improvements beyond your immediate area of responsibility.

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (45 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Head of SEO and Senior SEO Manager (1 hour video via Zoom)

- Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
- Engaging development opportunities at all levels.

Join the growing Product Marketing team as we expand the Outreach product portfolio to dominate global markets in the Revenue Orchestration space, spanning customers from scrappy startups to some of the largest global enterprise companies in the world. We are a team that sits at the intersection of PDESS (Product, Design, Engineering, Support & Success) and the GTM engine: Marketing, RevOps, Sales, and Enablement. We are obsessed with collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders. We wake up each day ready to do our best work and remain ever curious about how to improve, evolve, innovate, and grow. Above all, we have each other's backs.

The Role

Outreach is seeking an experienced Sr. Product Marketing Manager to bring complex, high-impact governance, security, interoperability, and integration capabilities to market.

You will lead the go-to-market strategy and execution for monthly releases and quarterly product launches, building competitive advantage, revenue growth, and product adoption. You will translate innovative offerings into marketable, sellable solutions that deliver unmatched customer experiences and can scale across the globe.

You will work in partnership with the broader Product Marketing team to deliver Enterprise-focused customer value, adoption, retention, and growth.

At Outreach, AI is part of how we build our product and how we work. In this role, you will bring that mindset to product marketing, using AI to synthesize customer and market insights and draft and refine launch messaging and enablement content, while applying your own judgment to keep everything accurate, differentiated, and on brand. You will also help us explain the AI capabilities of the Outreach platform clearly to customers, partners, and our go-to-market teams.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include

- Launch Leadership: Independently lead monthly releases and quarterly go-to-market launches for Platform Services offerings, including complex, high-stakes releases, from strategy through execution. Build a strategic GTM plan for each release in close collaboration with Product Management, Partners, Marketing, Enablement, Pricing & Packaging, Sales, and Post-Sales teams.

- Product & Customer Expertise: Build deep expertise in the Outreach AI Revenue Platform and its best practices to become a trusted product and customer subject matter expert.

- Partnerships: Collaborate with the Partner team to identify strategic partner integration and co-marketing opportunities.

- Competitive Positioning & Messaging: Analyze the competitive landscape and develop value propositions, positioning, and messaging that clearly articulate Outreach's differentiators and gaps across Platform features and integrations.

- Content & Enablement: Deliver a launch content package for each release that equips Marketing, Sales, Partners, and Customer teams to take the offering to market. Collaborate with Marketing on event content, product videos, demos, training materials, case studies, campaigns, and public and analyst relations to increase product awareness.

- Customer & Market Insight: Share customer feedback with Product and leadership to inform roadmap priorities and recommendations.

Our Vision of You

- 6+ years of enterprise platform software experience focused on a highly technical product area that includes governance, interoperability, security, and integration.

- Expertise in defining and executing go-to-market strategies and in the core craft of product marketing, including messaging and positioning, market enablement for GTM teams, customer and event presentations, product launches, and event content.

- Curiosity about AI and a record of learning and adapting quickly, including experimenting with AI tools to improve how you research, create, and launch, and sharing what works with your team.

- Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders, including without direct authority, and to bring a data-informed perspective to decision-making.

- Ability to tell clear, compelling, value-based stories that communicate complex information persuasively and with empathy to diverse audiences.

- Ability to see the big picture and dig into the details, bringing clarity to complexity and turning plans into action.

- Comfort moving quickly and adapting to change, with the curiosity to ask questions and challenge the status quo, and a focus on outcomes for the business, the team, and the customer.

$135,000 - $150,000 a year

- Oversee day-to-day campaign strategy & management, acting as a champion for big data and making recommendations at scale. - Prepare and lead presentations for your clients that demonstrate your impact and value on their bottom line. You're the tried-and-true business partner that client's dream of; positioning yourself as an extension of their team, and treating their wins/losses as your own
- You understand that AI has a critical role to play in how we service clients, so you’ll leverage new tools to drive efficiencies in not only your own workflows, but test and share learnings for the benefit of the greater team

The skills you'll bring to the table...

- You've managed Paid Campaigns across a wide range of engines & management platforms. You have experience with ecommerce and lead gen and you’re ready to jump in on both with experience and insight.
- You know the world of Search changes fast and it excites you! You're all over the latest emerging trends, tools, technologies, and data sets. You see the future of Machine Learning and AI in Search. You bring fresh ideas to the table and fearlessly run alongside industry changes. Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we’re ready to add another Senior Paid Media Manager to our team. Our new Senior Paid Media Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will act as a true paid channel expert, developing and managing a portfolio of Paid Media accounts and marketing campaigns, building great relationships, managing projects and deliverables, and growing accounts.

You’ll work on a team of other Paid Media Specialists and Managers, but as the Sr. Manager, will be expected to go “above and beyond” to exemplify excellence in your work & contribute to internal initiatives like developing media best practices, disseminating industry updates, and enhancing Silverback’s overall media product. You’ll serve as a role model and mentor to your peers, and in some cases, will even directly manage 1-2 junior teammates.

The Senior Paid Media Manager is expected to work cross-functionally, finding opportunities to enhance our clients' overall digital programs through Paid initiatives and complementary strategies with other services. You'll collaborate internally with teammates in Creative, Measurement, SEO, and Client Services functions. You’ll be the true face of Paid Media for your assigned clients, and will spearhead the kickoff, development, tactical execution, and ongoing testing, optimization, and overall success of your clients’ media strategies & performance.

Here’s what we expect from our Senior Paid Media Manager.

—What You'll Do—

- Responsible for driving the strategy, innovation, and performance of multiple client Paid Media strategies

- Fully “own” the success of a portfolio of a few (3-5) client accounts

- Plan, implement, and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs and marketing goals

- Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

- Pioneer testing and deployment of “outside the box” media channels & tools

- Collaborate closely with internal teammates in our Creative and Measurement teams to drive successful creative strategy/performance & analytics measurement, tag management, etc

- Collaborate cross-functionally whenever appropriate (i.e. on multiservice clients) with counterparts in SEO to drive successful cross-channel marketing strategy for clients

- Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

- Leverage various tools to carry out analysis and to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of Paid Media accounts

- Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

- Successfully retain & even grow your assigned client portfolio through best-in-class communication, storytelling, presentation, and relationship building

- Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

- Understand the client’s industry, audience and goals and stay on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

- Play a close role in sales enablement, including but not limited to identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and contributing to sales pitches, client onboardings/kickoffs, etc

- Effectively delegate support tasks as appropriate to junior teammates; manage quality assurance for teammates’ work & ensure clients are receiving high-quality deliverables 100% of the time

- In some cases, directly manage (i.e. act as the dedicated people manager) for 1-2 Paid Media teammates (Managers, Specialists, or Associates)

- Contribute to the overall success of the Media department through proactive involvement in product development, process improvement, and direct collaboration with the Associate Directors and Senior Director of Paid Media

—What We’re Looking For—

- 5+ years of experience (minimum) managing Paid Search AND Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok)

- Previous agency experience is a must-have!

- Experience serving as the main point of contact on client engagements (at least 3+ years of client-facing experience); strong comfortability being client-facing

- Strong experience driving/leading paid media account strategy

- Strong testing & innovation mentality

- Experience collaborating with Creative resources and contributing to creative briefs + driving paid social performance creative

- Advanced proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Sheets/Excel

- Experience with Google Tag Manager and Supermetrics is a plus!

- Strong analytical skills, technical knowledge and attention to detail

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Eagerness to deliver under tight deadlines

- Genuine curiosity that will guide the research to inform your technical work

- Outstanding time management and organization skills

- The ability to accept constructive criticism in a professional manner and to learn from edits

- Comfort with constant personal and professional growth

—Why Silverback?—

- Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

- Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

- Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

- Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

- Unlimited PTO

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

- Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

- Company-paid ClassPass membership

- 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Summer Fridays

- 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

- We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

- We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

- Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!

- Work closely with Team Leads to foster collaboration between all members of the account team, while serving as a mentor and motivator to the Associates on your accounts. You’ll help your team provide the highest level of service and advanced problem solving to our clients on a day-to-day basis

- Prepare and lead presentations for your clients that demonstrate your impact and value on their bottom line. You're the tried-and-true business partner that client's dream of; positioning yourself as an extension of their team, and treating their wins/losses as your own
- You understand that AI has a critical role to play in how we service clients, so you’ll leverage new tools to drive efficiencies in not only your own workflows, but test and share learnings for the benefit of the greater team

The skills you'll bring to the table...

- You've managed Paid Campaigns across a wide range of engines & management platforms. You have experience with ecommerce and lead gen and you’re ready to jump in on both with experience and insight.
- You know the world of paid media changes fast and it excites you! You're all over the latest emerging trends, tools, technologies, and data sets. You see the future of Machine Learning and AI in Search. You bring fresh ideas to the table and fearlessly run alongside industry changes. You're quick to kick up a new opportunity and run with it, making data-driven, actionable recommendations to drive value for your clients
- You drive integrated strategies, leveraging AI where appropriate to drive efficiencies, measuring the effectiveness (traffic, conversions, revenue) and always backing up your decisions with data
- Your skills stretch beyond Paid Media -- you're savvy with Excel, Google Suite, Data Visualization tools and you have an A+ in “Data Literacy”. Most importantly, you know when there's an opportunity at your fingertips and are quick to loop-in the resident Data Analyst & Engineer to make it a reality
- You thrive on a challenge-- rolling up your sleeves to take risks with innovation and testing; you’ve got hands-on experience running campaigns and it’s made you the SME you are today
- You have experience across Paid Media & Social (we aren't mad at programmatic experience wither!)
- Paid Media may be your thing, but you know it takes a data-driven, holistic approach to drive success for your clients. You're all about channel integration and leveraging data from SEO, Social, and Analytics to build smarter Paid strategies. You may not have all the answers, but you know where to go and who to ask
- Your passion for Search stretches beyond reading industry blogs, articles, and case studies. You use your knowledge to elevate your clients, colleagues and industry peers-- through 1:1s, Lunch 'n Learns, webinars, blogs, case studies, and speaking engagements

Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.

How you'll make an impact:

We're looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Field & Event Marketing to own and grow Cin7's global field marketing program.

This isn't simply an event marketing role. We're looking for an experienced B2B marketer who understands how to build integrated marketing programs around events that create pipeline, accelerate deals, deepen customer relationships, and strengthen our brand.

You'll own the strategy and execution behind our portfolio of trade shows, industry conferences, roadshows, customer events, webinars, partner activations, and Cin7-hosted experiences. Working closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and the wider Marketing team, you'll ensure every event is supported by thoughtful pre-event planning, integrated campaigns, meaningful customer engagement, and post-event follow-up that maximizes ROI.

Success in this role requires someone equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute. You'll build scalable programs, optimize processes, analyze results, and continuously improve how field and event marketing contributes to business growth.

What you'll do:

- Own and scale Cin7's global field and event marketing program across North America, EMEA, and APAC, helping evolve a growing function that drives pipeline, customer engagement, and brand awareness.

- Lead the strategy and execution of a diverse portfolio of programs including trade shows, industry conferences, roadshows, customer events, partner activations, webinars, and Cin7-hosted experiences.

- Develop integrated marketing campaigns that maximize the impact of every event, partnering with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Creative to deliver effective pre-event, onsite, and post-event programs.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and senior leadership to align field marketing initiatives with company priorities and go-to-market objectives.

- Measure and optimize performance, using data and insights to demonstrate ROI, improve future programs, and communicate field marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue.

- Manage budgets, agencies, vendors, and event operations to ensure programs are delivered efficiently and to a high standard.

- Explore and adopt AI-powered tools and emerging marketing technologies to streamline workflows, improve campaign effectiveness, and scale the impact of the field marketing program.

What you'll bring:

- 5-7 years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in field marketing, event marketing, or integrated campaign management.

- Experience building or scaling field marketing programs within a SaaS or high-growth technology company.

- Demonstrated success planning and executing regional events, conferences, customer events, and executive experiences that drive measurable business results.

- Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to deliver programs aligned with business objectives.

- Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable developing long-term plans and rolling up their sleeves to execute.

- Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.

- Data-driven mindset with experience measuring campaign performance, event ROI, and using insights to optimize future programs.

- Curious and adaptable, with a willingness to embrace AI and emerging marketing technologies to improve productivity, campaign performance, and customer experiences.

Why join us?

- Lead a high-impact field and event marketing function at a growing global SaaS company.

- Build on a strong foundation while shaping the future of field and event marketing at Cin7.

- Work closely with a collaborative marketing team and cross-functional partners.

- Opportunity to make a measurable impact on pipeline, revenue, and brand presence.

In return, we offer:

- Competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, and a 401k company match program.
- A flexible PTO policy allowing you the time you need to recharge.
- A diverse team, where everyone helps each other and inclusion is a core value.
- Remote work flexibility allows you to maintain a work-life balance in a way that suits your needs.
- Frequent company-sponsored events so you can get to know your coworkers.

$115,000 - $135,000 a year

115-135k base salary + 15% annual variable, paid quarterly

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

We are seeking an experienced Competency Leader with deep technical expertise in Adobe platforms to join our growing Modern Business Platforms practice. Positioned to ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales through delivery, this role serves as a trusted advisor to clients and Adobe partners, with a primary focus on optimizing customer experiences and marketing strategies through the Adobe Experience Platform (particularly Real-Time CDP)and the newer Adobe CX Enterprise solution. A strong understanding of broader data, marketing, and AI technologies to design scalable architectures and strategies for successful platform implementations and launches is critical to success.

The Competency Leader partners with client service and business development teams to identify and expand account opportunities, creating solutions that maximize customer value through Adobe platforms. This role is also central to shaping how clients think about and adopt AI-powered capabilities - from Adobe's native AI tooling to broader agentic and generative AI patterns that integrate with and extend the platform's value. This high-visibility role supports partnerships with Adobe and other platforms to foster innovation, drive product adoption, achieve company certifications, and influence product roadmaps.

Information Security Responsibilities

- Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
- Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
- Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)

- Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies across multiple products within a technology portfolio.

- Proven track record of developing portfolio-level positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.

- Strong understanding of:

  - Agentic workflows and AI systems
  - AI application development

  - Data and knowledge graphs
  - Enterprise software platforms

Web data infrastructure for fast-growing tech teams. It's a mid-market, self-service platform built for speed to value, so teams move from idea to implementation without procurement slowing them down.

The culture matches the product: decisions move at the speed of the idea, and people are trusted to test, iterate, and fix what's closest to them.

We’re not looking for a "supporter" - we’re looking for an owner. If you’ve mastered growth in the SaaS space and know exactly what it takes to win in China, we want your playbook.

Acquisition ownership & growth strategy

- Translate market knowledge into a clear channel roadmap: what to run, where, why, and with what target metrics.

Paid acquisition

- Own Paid Search in China: structure, keywords, landing pages, budgets, bidding strategy, and reporting.
- Launch and optimize campaigns on relevant China ad ecosystems (based on product fit): Baidu, 360, Shenma, Toutiao/Bytedance, Tencent, etc.
- Collaborate with design/content to produce high-converting ads and landing pages.

SEO growth (strategy + collaboration)

- Define SEO strategy for China: topic clusters, landing page plan, competitor gap analysis, keyword priorities.
- Partner closely with China Content Manager: turn strategy into execution while you own outcome metrics (traffic quality, signup/purchase conversion).
- Identify technical/UX localization improvements that raise China CR% and reduce funnel drop-offs.

Native China channels & partnerships

- Identify and scale acquisition through native channels (depending on market reality): Zhihu, WeChat ecosystem, Bilibili, forums/communities, KOL/KOC collaborations, developer communities, etc.

Market intelligence & competitor advantage

- Maintain a clear view of competitor positioning, pricing tactics, channel mix, and messaging in China.

Cross-functional leadership

- Work with Product/Dev to ensure China users have a smooth journey (payment, onboarding, docs endpoints, tooling expectations).
- Align with Sales/CS on ICP targeting and feedback loops for lead quality and user objections.

Your skills & experiences:

- Deep understanding of the China digital marketing ecosystem and how to acquire users via native channels.
- Proven track record scaling performance marketing in China (Paid Search and/or other paid channels).
- At least 3 years of experience marketing proxy / VPN / scraping / cybersecurity / developer tools / SaaS (or closely related tech).
- Ability to build growth plans based on data, run experiments, and optimize funnel conversion end-to-end.
- Strong analytical skills: can define KPIs, build reporting, and make decisions based on results.
- Fluent Mandarin and strong working proficiency in English (written and verbal).
- Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced international environment.

Nice to have:

- Experience with B2B SaaS and/or developer-targeted products.
- Experience with partnerships/affiliates in China.
- Understanding of China internet policies and constraints affecting marketing and distribution

What we offer:

- Vacation days as per the Labour Code. Plus, additional vacation days after working for a certain period of time.
- Learning & development: online courses and trainings.
- Mental health apps.
- Workation.
- Full remote environment.
- Company-sponsored tech.

- Hands-on-keys Execution: Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

- Client-Facing / Account Management: Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

- Testing & Innovation: Support channel innovation efforts, ensuring clients' Paid Media strategies are following evolving best practices and using performance data to identify opportunities for new campaigns, optimizations, and testing

- Reporting: Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

- Project Management: Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

- Creative Strategy: Collaborate with Silverback's Creative Director and Design team on ad creation and testing plans; assist with creative strategy and briefs as needed

- Know Your Client's Business: Understand your clients’ industries, audience, and goals while staying on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

- Teamwork & Collaboration: Join in creative brainstorming sessions with other members of the Paid Media team to promote a culture of collaboration and innovation

- Professional Growth: Accept feedback and coaching from the Associate Director of Media to ensure our clients are receiving a best-in-class experience & top-notch performance.

—What We’re Looking For—

- Years of Experience: _A_ _minimum_ _of 3+ years of paid media agency experience - ideal candidate has 3-5 YOE._ Previous performance agency experience is a MUST-HAVE!

- Paid Search _and_ Social Expertise: Must-have experience managing both Paid Search _and_ Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google & Meta; secondary platforms are LinkedIn and TikTok)

- Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the Paid Media engagement with your assigned clients.

- Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute winning Paid Media strategies across multiple industries is crucial — but your ability to tie Media wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, revenue, etc is what will make you a superstar.

- Ownership of Work: In this role, you'll fully own the success of your 3-5 clients from strategy development, to tactical execution, to reporting & client-facing communication. You MUST have prior experience taking "full ownership" of client(s) in a similar vein in order to succeed at Silverback.

- Curiosity & “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. You’re relentlessly curious, eager to learn, and willing to make mistakes in the name of progress & growth.

- Data Analysis: You're a whiz in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Complex sets of data don't throw you, and you're comfortable analyzing & breaking down data using GA4 and other tools to produce clear, insightful, and meaningful reports for clients.

- Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don't throw you.

- Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

- Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

BAMKO is investing in marketing as a core growth engine, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll own the systems, data, and insight that tie every marketing dollar to revenue. When leadership asks what's working, where to invest next, or how marketing moves the business, your work gives them the answer.

- Connect the data: Partner with IT so marketing and business systems work together cleanly. Own data quality, field mapping, and sync logic, so leadership can trust the numbers it sees.
- Connect marketing to sales: Design and support the routing, qualification, and handoff processes that turn marketing demand into sales pipeline, then measure and tighten them over time.
- Measure what matters: Lead campaign tracking, GA4, tag management, and conversion tracking across channels. Build attribution models that show marketing's full contribution to pipeline and revenue.
- Tell the story in numbers: Build the dashboards executive leadership relies on for pipeline, revenue contribution, and funnel efficiency.
- Shape the stack: Evaluate and implement the marketing technology that gives us an edge, including data enrichment, intent, and advertising platforms.
- Raise the bar on execution: Own segmentation, list strategy, and QA standards so every program goes out right.

Who YOU are:

- 5+ years in marketing operations or revenue operations, including 3+ years as a hands-on HubSpot administrator
- A track record of building integrations between a CRM and other business systems
- Working knowledge of GA4, tag management platforms, and ad platform conversion tracking
- Strong analytical skills, with SQL or advanced spreadsheet modeling and experience in a BI tool (Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
- Experience in B2B environments with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
- The confidence to present data to senior leadership and defend the methodology behind it
- A builder's mindset: you see a gap, design the fix, document it, and make it stick
- Comfort with ambiguity and pace; you'd rather build something than wait for it to be handed to you

Nice to have

- HubSpot certifications
- Experience with data warehouses or GA4 BigQuery export
- Experience with data enrichment tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, or Apollo
- Background in distribution, manufacturing, or companies that sell through multiple channels

Why BAMKO?

At BAMKO, we want you to be well and thrive. The rate of pay offered will be dependent upon the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. In addition, there is a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, various paid time off programs, and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

This is a chance to own influencer marketing for a brand-new product from day one and to grow it into the Influencer function for the whole of United Tech. You will turn creators and communities into a steady flow of targeted traffic and sign-ups across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and Quora, with clear goals, your own area of responsibility and an agreed budget to work with. Every idea you test, from a new author to a new format or distribution channel, shows up directly in user growth and cost per registration. And as the channel proves itself, you will build a team of 2–3 people to scale what works

About our product: This is a web-first platform for real-time text and video communication, built around instant connections between real people. Users can start a text chat without registration or join a video session after logging in, directly in the browser, fast and frictionless. The product leverages an AI-powered matching system and combines AI-driven and human moderation to ensure safe interactions, high-quality content, and scalable platform growth.

In this role you will

- Build and lead a team of 2–3 people: SMM Manager, Influencer / Outreach Manager and Community Manager

- Find influencers, creators and communities through manual search, referrals, analytics tools and local agencies, and keep a database of contacts and placements

- Assess audience fit by GEO and language, real reach, engagement, comment quality and signs of fake activity

- Negotiate with creators directly or through managers and agencies on pricing, test and package placements, and timelines

- Prepare briefs, scripts and key messages with a clear call to action to visit the website

- Run direct ad integrations and content seeding across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and Quora, adapting each piece to the platform

- Manage the product’s social media channels

- Handle agreements, content usage rights, payments, the publication calendar and delivery control

- Set up tracking of clicks and leads via UTM tags, links and events together with the analytics team

- Analyze traffic quality, conversion and cost per result, test hypotheses, repeat winning placements and reallocate the budget

- Prepare regular reports on budget and results with conclusions and a plan for the next cycle

It’s all about you

- 1+ year of experience across the full influencer marketing cycle: search, vetting, negotiations, briefing, agreements, payment, publication and analysis

- Cases of driving traffic, sign-ups or other target actions where you can explain your personal contribution, budget and results

- Hands-on experience with ad integrations and short-form video on Instagram and/or TikTok, Reddit, Quora and similar platforms, plus the ability to adapt your approach to other channels

- Skilled in manual search and in influencer discovery and analytics tools, including audience and fake-activity checks

- Confident in negotiating prices, test and repeat placements, working with creators both directly and through intermediaries

- Able to independently manage the budget, multiple placements and deadlines, tracking everything in Excel / Google Sheets or a CRM

- Solid understanding of UTM tags, web analytics, conversion and cost per lead, and able to explain the limits of attribution

- Own the result: you run the full cycle yourself and take every placement through to analysis

- Persistent in negotiations: you find a way to reach the partner, argue your terms and keep the relationship going

- Think analytically and creatively: you form hypotheses and change decisions based on test results

- English at B2 level or higher

Would be a plus

- Other languages you can use to negotiate with local creators, managers and agencies

- Experience in the dating niche

What we offer

Care and support:

- 20 paid vacation days, 15 sick days, and 6 additional days off for family events

- Up to 10 additional days off for public holidays

This is a chance to own influencer marketing for a brand-new product from day one and to grow it into the Influencer function for the whole of United Tech. You will turn creators and communities into a steady flow of targeted traffic and sign-ups across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and Quora, with clear goals, your own area of responsibility and an agreed budget to work with. About our product: This is a web-first platform for real-time text and video communication, built around instant connections between real people.
