The product leverages an AI-powered matching system and combines AI-driven and human moderation to ensure safe interactions, high-quality content, and scalable platform growth.

In this role you will

- Build and lead a team of 2–3 people: SMM Manager, Influencer / Outreach Manager and Community Manager

- Find influencers, creators and communities through manual search, referrals, analytics tools and local agencies, and keep a database of contacts and placements

- Assess audience fit by GEO and language, real reach, engagement, comment quality and signs of fake activity

- Negotiate with creators directly or through managers and agencies on pricing, test and package placements, and timelines

- Prepare briefs, scripts and key messages with a clear call to action to visit the website

- Run direct ad integrations and content seeding across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and Quora, adapting each piece to the platform

- Manage the product’s social media channels

- Handle agreements, content usage rights, payments, the publication calendar and delivery control

- Set up tracking of clicks and leads via UTM tags, links and events together with the analytics team

- Analyze traffic quality, conversion and cost per result, test hypotheses, repeat winning placements and reallocate the budget

- Prepare regular reports on budget and results with conclusions and a plan for the next cycle

It’s all about you

- 1+ year of experience across the full influencer marketing cycle: search, vetting, negotiations, briefing, agreements, payment, publication and analysis

- Cases of driving traffic, sign-ups or other target actions where you can explain your personal contribution, budget and results

- Hands-on experience with ad integrations and short-form video on Instagram and/or TikTok, Reddit, Quora and similar platforms, plus the ability to adapt your approach to other channels

- Skilled in manual search and in influencer discovery and analytics tools, including audience and fake-activity checks

- Confident in negotiating prices, test and repeat placements, working with creators both directly and through intermediaries

- Able to independently manage the budget, multiple placements and deadlines, tracking everything in Excel / Google Sheets or a CRM

- Solid understanding of UTM tags, web analytics, conversion and cost per lead, and able to explain the limits of attribution

- Own the result: you run the full cycle yourself and take every placement through to analysis

- Persistent in negotiations: you find a way to reach the partner, argue your terms and keep the relationship going

- Think analytically and creatively: you form hypotheses and change decisions based on test results

- English at B2 level or higher

- Other languages you can use to negotiate with local creators, managers and agencies

- Experience in the dating niche

Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a Director of Marketing Technology to serve as a senior, consultative Multi-Solution Architect within our Digital Experience Platforms practice. This role is designed for a seasoned marketing technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with strong client advisory skills, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, architecting solutions, and contributing directly in a billable capacity across client engagements.

While Adobe Experience Cloud represents a dominant ecosystem within the Bounteous practice, this role is intentionally multi-platform. The Director is expected to bring strong Adobe expertise alongside working knowledge of complementary marketing technology platforms and patterns, including CRM, CDP, marketing automation, analytics, and personalization technologies. The role spans both B2B and B2C use cases, with an emphasis on data-driven orchestration, lifecycle marketing, and measurable business outcomes rather than CMS- or DAM-centric implementations.

This position serves as a bridge between sales and delivery, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and platform partners while also setting delivery teams up for success. The Director balances strategic leadership with hands-on, billable client work, helping clients modernize their marketing technology ecosystems and extract long-term value from their platform investments.

Information Security Responsibilities

- Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
- Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
- Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
- Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role and Responsibilities:

Multi-Solution Architecture and Strategy

- Serve as a senior, consultative marketing technology architect across multiple platforms and solutions
- Lead the design of scalable, data-driven marketing technology architectures that support both B2B and B2C customer journeys.
- Architect solutions spanning CDP, marketing automation, journey orchestration, analytics, personalization, and CRM integrations.
- Provide architectural guidance across dominant Adobe platforms as well as complementary technologies where appropriate.
- Translate business objectives into platform architectures, data models, integration patterns, and activation strategies.
- Maintain awareness of evolving MarTech capabilities, ecosystem trends, and emerging technologies.

Client Advisory and Billable Delivery

- Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to client stakeholders, guiding platform selection, roadmap planning, and architectural tradeoffs.
- Maintain an active billable role across client engagements, contributing directly to discovery, solutioning, and delivery oversight.
- Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, demos, and executive presentations.
- Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural intent and best practices.
- Support escalation, troubleshooting, and course correction on complex marketing technology programs.

Pre-Sales, Growth, and Partnerships

- Partner with client service and business development teams to support pursuits, pitches, and account expansion.
- Support pre-sales solutioning through consultative discovery, estimates, and solution narratives.
- Identify opportunities to create packaged offerings, accelerators, and repeatable solution patterns
- Collaborate with platform partners, including Adobe and other MarTech vendors, on roadmap awareness, co-innovation, and solution alignment.

Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

- Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
- Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.
- Provide thought leadership in the marketing technology space, helping position Bounteous as a trusted partner for enterprise MarTech transformation.
- Mentor architects and senior practitioners, contributing to internal enablement, frameworks, and best-practice playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

- 10 or more years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering marketing technology solutions.
- 3 or more years of experience in a digital-first, global delivery agency or consultancy.
- Deep experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, including platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Customer Journey Analytics, and related tools.
- Working knowledge of non-Adobe MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or similar, with the ability to architect across ecosystems.
- Strong understanding of CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, and data integration patterns.
- Proven ability to operate in a consultative, client-facing role while maintaining billable delivery responsibilities.
- Demonstrated success translating complex technical ecosystems into measurable business outcomes.
- Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

apply for this job

Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a Director of Marketing Technology to serve as a senior, consultative Multi-Solution Architect within our Digital Experience Platforms practice. This role is designed for a seasoned marketing technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with strong client advisory skills, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, architecting solutions, and contributing directly in a billable capacity across client engagements.

While Adobe Experience Cloud represents a dominant ecosystem within the Bounteous practice, this role is intentionally multi-platform. The Director is expected to bring strong Adobe expertise alongside working knowledge of complementary marketing technology platforms and patterns, including CRM, CDP, marketing automation, analytics, and personalization technologies. The role spans both B2B and B2C use cases, with an emphasis on data-driven orchestration, lifecycle marketing, and measurable business outcomes rather than CMS- or DAM-centric implementations.

This position serves as a bridge between sales and delivery, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and platform partners while also setting delivery teams up for success. The Director balances strategic leadership with hands-on, billable client work, helping clients modernize their marketing technology ecosystems and extract long-term value from their platform investments.

Information Security Responsibilities

- Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
- Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
- Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
- Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role and Responsibilities:

Multi-Solution Architecture and Strategy

- Serve as a senior, consultative marketing technology architect across multiple platforms and solutions
- Lead the design of scalable, data-driven marketing technology architectures that support both B2B and B2C customer journeys.
- Architect solutions spanning CDP, marketing automation, journey orchestration, analytics, personalization, and CRM integrations.
- Provide architectural guidance across dominant Adobe platforms as well as complementary technologies where appropriate.
- Translate business objectives into platform architectures, data models, integration patterns, and activation strategies.
- Maintain awareness of evolving MarTech capabilities, ecosystem trends, and emerging technologies.

Client Advisory and Billable Delivery

- Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to client stakeholders, guiding platform selection, roadmap planning, and architectural tradeoffs.
- Maintain an active billable role across client engagements, contributing directly to discovery, solutioning, and delivery oversight.
- Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, demos, and executive presentations.
- Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural intent and best practices.
- Support escalation, troubleshooting, and course correction on complex marketing technology programs.

Pre-Sales, Growth, and Partnerships

- Partner with client service and business development teams to support pursuits, pitches, and account expansion.
- Support pre-sales solutioning through consultative discovery, estimates, and solution narratives.
- Identify opportunities to create packaged offerings, accelerators, and repeatable solution patterns
- Collaborate with platform partners, including Adobe and other MarTech vendors, on roadmap awareness, co-innovation, and solution alignment.

Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

- Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
- Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.
- Provide thought leadership in the marketing technology space, helping position Bounteous as a trusted partner for enterprise MarTech transformation.
- Mentor architects and senior practitioners, contributing to internal enablement, frameworks, and best-practice playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

- 10 or more years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering marketing technology solutions.
- 3 or more years of experience in a digital-first, global delivery agency or consultancy.
- Deep experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, including platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Customer Journey Analytics, and related tools.
- Working knowledge of non-Adobe MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or similar, with the ability to architect across ecosystems.
- Strong understanding of CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, and data integration patterns.
- Proven ability to operate in a consultative, client-facing role while maintaining billable delivery responsibilities.
- Demonstrated success translating complex technical ecosystems into measurable business outcomes.
- Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

$157,000 - $227,000 a year

Individual pay is determined by many factors, including experience, relevant education or training, and organizational needs. The mid-range to maximum of the salary range is generally reserved for individuals who are highly experienced in the role.

Content Marketing Manager, Professional Learning & Growth

1 Remote

Teacher Education – Marketing /

Full Time /

apply for this job

At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity,  guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Moreland University, part of our Teacher Education Ecosystem, supports educators around the world through innovative pathways into the teaching profession and continued professional growth.

Come Build What’s Next

We’re looking for a Content Marketing Manager – Professional Learning to help build and scale Moreland University’s professional learning offering for educators.

This is an individual contributor role with meaningful ownership over a new area of growth for Moreland. We’ve spent the last several years testing professional learning experiences with educators and have seen strong interest and demand. Now, we’re ready to turn that momentum into a scalable portfolio of on-demand courses, learning journeys, live experiences, and ultimately new subscription-based offerings.

You’ll own the professional learning go-to-market calendar and help move new offerings from idea through launch — partnering closely with faculty and subject matter experts who develop the curriculum while you provide project leadership, audience insight, editorial guidance, and marketing expertise.

We’re looking for a content marketer first: someone who can write, position, launch, and promote educational offerings while keeping multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines moving forward. Experience working with educators, teachers, EdTech, professional learning, or another teacher-facing audience will be especially valuable.

You should be equally comfortable writing a landing page, building a launch calendar, guiding a subject matter expert through a project, reviewing learning materials for quality and audience fit, and looking at engagement data to determine what we should build next.

What You’ll Do

- Own the professional learning portfolio and launch calendar, helping prioritize, plan, and bring new on-demand courses, learning journeys, certificates, microcredentials, webinars, and other educator experiences to market

- Lead projects from concept through launch, coordinating faculty, subject matter experts, creative partners, and cross-functional teams while keeping timelines, deliverables, and launch readiness on track

- Create compelling short and long form marketing content including landing pages, course titles and descriptions, email campaigns, blog content, promotional messaging, participant communications, and sales enablement materials

- Build and execute go-to-market strategies that drive awareness, registrations, subscriptions, repeat engagement, and long-term growth across Moreland’s professional learning portfolio

- Use learner feedback, participation data, market insights, and performance metrics to improve existing offerings, identify new opportunities, and help scale professional learning into a meaningful new growth channel for Moreland

What You’ll Bring

- 4+ years of experience in content marketing or a closely related role, ideally within education, EdTech, professional learning, online learning, or another educator-facing environment

- Direct experience creating marketing content and bringing programs, educational offerings, digital content, courses, events, or similar products to market not simply supporting content after launch

- Strong writing and editorial skills across short- and long-form content, with the ability to translate educational concepts into clear, engaging messaging for teachers and other educator audiences

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from idea through execution, including coordinating subject matter experts or other partners who own specialized content

- A combination of creative thinking, organization, audience empathy, and commercial awareness, with the ability to use performance insights to improve engagement and inform what gets built next

A bachelor’s degree is required. A degree in marketing, communications, education, instructional design, English, journalism, or a related field is preferred.

Experience as an educator, former teacher, or in another teacher-facing role is a meaningful plus. Experience with subscription-based products, learning platforms, digital content libraries, or professional learning portfolios is also valuable.

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool or platform below is not required. We care most about your ability to create excellent content, manage work effectively, collaborate with experts, and use technology thoughtfully to improve how you work.

- Content management and email marketing platforms

- Project management and collaboration tools

- Learning management or digital learning platforms

- Analytics and performance-reporting tools

- AI-assisted content and productivity tools, including Claude or similar platforms

We believe AI can be a powerful partner in the creative and operational process. You’ll be encouraged to use it thoughtfully to improve efficiency, support content development, and strengthen the learner experience while maintaining high standards for originality, quality, and brand integrity.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Build something new: You’ll help take a successful professional learning concept and turn it into a scalable offering for educators

- Own meaningful work: This is not a small piece of someone else’s strategy, you’ll have significant ownership over the professional learning portfolio and how it goes to market

- Work with people who know education: You’ll partner with an experienced faculty community and a strong, established content marketing team

- Combine creativity with strategy: You’ll get to write and create while also shaping launches, managing projects, and influencing what we build next

- See the impact: Your work will directly influence how educators discover, engage with, and continue learning through Moreland University

- Join a mission driven organization where your creativity, judgment, and understanding of educators can have a visible impact

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that’s okay!

We’d especially love to hear from candidates coming from content marketing, education marketing, EdTech, professional learning, continuing education, teacher-facing organizations, or digital learning businesses. Former educators who have since built strong professional experience in marketing and content are also encouraged to apply.

However, this role does require strong hands-on content marketing experience, demonstrated project ownership, and the ability to develop marketing content that brings an offering to market.

If your recent experience has primarily focused on social media content creation, influencer content, organic social, or curriculum/instructional design without meaningful marketing ownership, this role may not be the right match.

If you love writing, understand educators, enjoy bringing ideas to life, and get excited by the opportunity to build a new professional learning offering from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next.

And yes, a real person reviews your application!! We do not use AI to screen, evaluate, or make decisions on applications. Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe and feel your experience deserves a thoughtful, human consideration. Application deadline: 10/16/26

1. Recruiter Conversation

An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your experience, career goals, and interest in Colibri. We’ll also share more about the role, team, compensation, and what to expect throughout the process.

2. Hiring Manager Conversation

A structured conversation with the Sr. Director of Marketing focused on examples from your experience, your approach to content and project ownership, and the priorities and challenges this person will own.

3. Team & Cross-Functional Conversations

You’ll meet with key marketing and cross-functional partners to explore the skills and experiences most relevant to the position while learning more about how the Teacher Education Ecosystem works together.

Our goal is to keep the process streamlined, thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you informed about next steps and timing throughout the process.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Veeva Crossix Sales team is looking for a skilled Account Partner to drive sales within our media measurement and optimization business to Life Sciences companies. As an Account Partner, you will be responsible for aligning customer objectives with the Veeva Crossix marketing analytics solutions, including the Crossix Measurement Suite.

To be successful in this role, you are strong at communicating across various business functions, organizational levels (including C-level), and brand marketing departments. Creativity, initiative, and the ability to work effectively within a growing team are critical. You are also someone who is humble, hungry, and smart  –  you put the success of the team ahead of your own; you have a relentless drive to do what it takes to succeed, and you find a way to overcome obstacles and solve business problems.

What You’ll Do

- Develop a thorough understanding of Crossix's offerings, hardworking advantages, and processes. Learn to articulate them persuasively to prospects and customers
- Develop strong and mutually valuable relationships with new and existing customers
- Manage pipeline with CRM tools for maximum efficiency and visibility, with carefully executed follow-up to closure
- Work in close partnership with Client Services to manage successful client deployments and to ensure ongoing high client satisfaction, renewal, and deep penetration of customer organizations for incremental business
- Keep current with industry trends; engage your customers, address their business challenges, and propose solutions

Requirements

- Passionate about healthcare with a strong interest in pharmaceutical marketing. You feel a strong connection to our mission and will work hard to ensure customer success
- As an educator and business consultant, you love teaching clients how to maximize their potential working with us
- Demonstrated development of meaningful partnerships with a diverse client base and proven track record as a trusted advisor to brands
- Highly organized and with a firm grasp of your business, you log all sales activity and prospecting in SFDC quickly and accurately
- Understanding of the digital media/marketing landscape, with the ability to credibly articulate strategic insights based on data and research for clients
- A fast learner, you love to stay at the forefront of an ever-evolving industry
- A creative problem solver - you stay cool under pressure and thrive in an atmosphere of change
- 3+ years of experience in selling technology, marketing, pharma data/insights, or media solutions in the life sciences industry or a closely related field
- Proven track record of exceeding sales goals while contributing to the success of the team
- Strong understanding of digital media and ad tech ecosystem
- 5+ years of overall business experience in sales, business development, or account management, preferably in digital advertising, technology businesses, and healthcare data/consulting
- Eagerness to work in a startup team environment that will be rapidly changing
- BS or BA degree is required

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
1. A conversation with the hiring manager
2. A practical case exercise
3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
- Retirement programs
- 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

- Base pay: $80,000 - $300,000
- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

- Strong understanding of digital media and ad tech ecosystem

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Veeva Crossix Sales team is looking for a skilled Account Partner (Marketing Analytics) to drive sales within our media measurement and optimization business to Life Sciences companies.  As an Account Partner, you will be responsible for aligning customer objectives with the Veeva Crossix marketing analytics solutions, including the Crossix Measurement Suite.

To be successful in this role, you must be strong at communicating across various business functions, organizational levels (including C-level), and brand marketing departments. Creativity, initiative, and the ability to work effectively within a growing team are critical.  You are also someone who is humble, hungry, and smart  –  you put the success of the team ahead of your own; you have a relentless drive to do what it takes to succeed, and you find a way to overcome obstacles and solve business problems.

What You'll Do

- Develop a thorough understanding of Crossix offerings, competitive advantages, and processes. Learn to articulate them persuasively to prospects and customers
- Develop strong and mutually valuable relationships with new and existing customers
- Manage pipeline with CRM tools for maximum efficiency and visibility, with carefully executed follow-up to closure
- Work in close partnership with Client Services to manage successful client deployments and to ensure ongoing high client satisfaction, renewal, and deep penetration of customer organizations for incremental business
- Keep current with industry trends; engage your customers, address their business challenges, and propose solutions

Requirements

- Passionate about healthcare with a strong interest in pharmaceutical marketing. You feel a strong connection to our mission and will work hard to ensure customer success
- As an educator and business consultant; you love teaching clients about how they could maximize their potential working with us.
- Demonstrated development of meaningful partnerships with a diverse client base and proven track record as a trusted advisor to brands
- Highly organized with a firm grasp of your business - you accurately log all sales activity and prospecting in SFDC with speed and accuracy
- Understanding of the digital media/marketing landscape with the ability to credibly articulate strategic insights for clients that are based on data and research
- A fast learner, you love to stay at the forefront of an ever-evolving industry
- A creative problem solver - you stay cool under pressure and thrive in an atmosphere of change
- At least 3 years experience in selling technology, marketing, pharma data/insights, or media solutions in the life sciences industry or closely related field
- Proven track record of exceeding sales goals while contributing to the success of the team
- Strong understanding of digital media and ad tech ecosystem
- At least 5 years of overall business experience in sales, business development, or account management preferably in digital advertising, technology businesses, and healthcare data/consulting
- Eagerness to work in a startup team environment that will be rapidly changing
- BS or BA degree is required

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
1. A conversation with the hiring manager
2. A practical case exercise
3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
- Retirement programs
- 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

- Base pay: $80,000 - $300,000
- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Senior Amazon Account Manager

hands-on senior role
for someone who can immediately take ownership of
Amazon PPC strategy, account health/violations, and client communication without requiring training or supervision.

Independently develop, manage, and scale Amazon PPC across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
Own budgets, bids, keywords, search terms, placements, testing, and ACOS/TACOS optimization.

Analyze performance and turn data into clear growth and optimization strategies.
Manage catalog health, listing optimization, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and Amazon creative requirements.
Independently lead recurring client calls, present results and strategy, establish priorities, and manage expectations.
Manage multiple brands simultaneously and take full ownership when performance or marketplace issues arise.

Strong experience independently managing multiple Amazon brands/accounts.
Advanced Amazon PPC expertise—you must be able to develop and execute strategy without training.
Proven experience managing meaningful Amazon ad budgets and delivering measurable results.
Hands-on experience resolving Amazon violations, account health issues, and Seller Central cases.
Proven experience independently leading client calls and communicating strategy to founders or senior stakeholders.
Previous
agency or multi-brand portfolio experience.

DTC/e-commerce paid media.
Strong knowledge of catalog management, listing optimization, Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Stores.
Proficiency with Amazon bulk files and tools such as Data Dive, Jungle Scout, or similar platforms.
Excellent English communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight.

ValPay builds embedded payments for software companies. Our PayFac-as-a-Service model lets ISVs offer payments to their merchants under their own brand, while we handle underwriting, compliance, and risk. Our partners serve healthcare, legal, hospitality, professional services, and other vertical markets.
Launching a payments product is the easy part. The value is created when ISV partners go live, their merchants enroll, and transactions flow. We’re hiring a product marketing Lead whose success is measured by adoption: how quickly and how deeply partners and merchants use our products.
You’ll own positioning, launches, and lifecycle marketing across our vertical markets and across North America, Europe, and APAC. You’ll report to the CEO and work closely with product, sales, partnerships, the ISV channel team, and operations.
AI should be part of how you work. Use it to research, draft, analyze, and automate. You’re responsible for the quality of the result.
What we value
Sound judgment and attention to detail.
Measuring success by what customers do, not by what we shipped.
Taking responsibility and finishing work without being chased.
Understanding how the business makes money and caring about results.
The honesty to say when something isn’t working, including your own work.
What you’ll do
Drive partner and merchant adoption:
You’ll own the adoption journey end to end: signature, integration, go-live, first transaction, merchant enrollment, and expansion. The hardest gap is between “integrated” and “actively transacting,” and you’ll be the person who finds out where partners and merchants stall and designs programs to close it. That means lifecycle campaigns, onboarding content, and activation playbooks for two audiences at once: the ISV partner and the merchants who use their software. With the ISV channel team, you’ll run co-marketing and merchant-enrollment campaigns that lift penetration within each partner’s customer base.
Measure adoption and act on it:
You’ll build and maintain the adoption dashboard: activation rate, time to first transaction, attach and penetration rate, volume per merchant, feature adoption, and cohort retention. You’ll use that data to segment partners and merchants, flag at-risk accounts, and surface expansion opportunities, then take what you find to the teams who can act on it.
Own positioning and messaging:
You’ll develop the positioning, value propositions, and messaging for each product and vertical, and for new verticals and markets as we enter them. A central part of this is explaining clearly how our embedded payments offering differs from horizontal PayFacs, processors, and ISOs. You’ll translate technical capabilities into the outcomes ISVs and merchants care about: revenue share, retention, cleaner reconciliation, and faster onboarding.
Run launches built around activation:
You’ll lead launch plans for new products, features, verticals, and regions. Every launch gets adoption targets and a 30/60/90-day activation plan, not only awareness goals. You’ll also make sure what we’re building is communicated publicly, online and through partners. You’ll adapt messaging to regional regulatory and market conditions, and work with product, finance, risk, and support so that each launch is commercially and operationally ready before it goes out.
Equip sales, partnerships, and support:
You’ll create the sales playbooks, pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, ROI calculators, and objection-handling guides that sales and partnership teams use, and equip support to explain the products as well. You’ll train teams to sell for activation, not just signature. You’ll run win/loss and churn analysis and feed what you learn back into positioning and the product.
Represent the market inside the company:
You’ll track competitors, pricing, interchange, and regulatory developments, and be the voice of the market and of adoption data in product planning. When acquisitions or product consolidations happen, you’ll support portfolio and integration messaging.
What you’ll bring
At least 3 years of experience in product marketing at a B2B software, fintech, or payments company.
A track record of running launches and measuring them on adoption or usage, not only on awareness.
Experience marketing to two audiences at once, such as partners and their customers, or platforms and their users.
Working knowledge of how card payments work, or the ability to learn it quickly and explain it accurately.
Comfort with data. You can define a metric, build or spec a dashboard, and draw a conclusion from it.
Strong writing. You can turn a technical capability into a clear business case for a software company or a small-business owner.
Experience building sales enablement that teams actually used.
You can take a loosely defined goal, set your own plan, and finish it.
You use AI tools every day for research, drafting, and analysis, and you check what they produce.
Useful experience
Embedded payments, PayFac, or ISV channel experience.
Lifecycle or onboarding marketing in a partner-led business.
Marketing in healthcare, legal, hospitality, or professional services software.
Launching products in Europe or APAC.
Running win/loss or churn analysis programs.
Hands-on experience with SQL, a BI tool, or marketing automation.
Portfolio or integration messaging after an acquisition.
Who will enjoy this role
You notice when a partner has been live for two months and only a handful of their merchants have enrolled, and you want to know why. Is it the pitch, the onboarding, the partner’s own sales team, or the product?
In the same week you might rebuild a merchant onboarding email sequence, pull cohort data for the CEO, train a partnership team on a new vertical, and rewrite a battlecard after a lost deal to a horizontal processor.
The scope is wide for one person, and adoption is a harder target than launch coverage. You’ll be judged on numbers you influence but don’t fully control, which means working through partners, product, and sales to move them. Priorities will shift with the roadmap and with acquisitions.
Why this role matters
ValPay is building products and features for software partners across several verticals and regions. That work has limited impact unless partners and merchants know about it, understand it, and use it.
You’ll work directly with the CEO to decide how our products are positioned and how each launch turns into transactions. Your work affects how quickly partners go live, how many of their merchants enroll, and how much volume flows through the platform. You’ll have the authority to set the story and change it when the adoption data says so.

ValPay conçoit des solutions de paiement intégrées pour les entreprises de logiciels. Notre modèle PayFac-as-a-Service permet aux éditeurs de logiciels (ISV) d’offrir des paiements à leurs commerçants sous leur propre marque, pendant que nous prenons en charge la souscription, la conformité et la gestion des risques. Nos partenaires servent les secteurs de la santé, du droit, de l’hôtellerie et de la restauration, des services professionnels et d’autres marchés verticaux.
Lancer un produit de paiement, c’est la partie facile. La valeur se crée lorsque les ISV partenaires sont mis en service, que leurs commerçants adhèrent et que les transactions circulent. Nous recherchons une personne responsable du marketing produit dont le succès se mesure à l’adoption : la rapidité et la profondeur avec lesquelles les partenaires et les commerçants utilisent nos produits.
Vous serez responsable du positionnement, des lancements et du marketing du cycle de vie dans l’ensemble de nos marchés verticaux, en Amérique du Nord, en Europe et en Asie-Pacifique. Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit, ventes, partenariats, canal ISV et opérations.
L’IA devrait faire partie de votre façon de travailler. Utilisez-la pour faire de la recherche, rédiger, analyser et automatiser. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du résultat.
Ce qui compte pour nous
Un bon jugement et le souci du détail.
Mesurer le succès à ce que font les clients, et non à ce que nous avons livré.
Prendre ses responsabilités et mener le travail à terme sans qu’on ait à faire de relances.
Comprendre comment l’entreprise génère des revenus et se soucier des résultats.
L’honnêteté de dire quand quelque chose ne fonctionne pas, y compris dans son propre travail.
Ce que vous ferez
Stimuler l’adoption par les partenaires et les commerçants :
Vous serez responsable de tout le parcours d’adoption : signature, intégration technique, mise en service, première transaction, adhésion des commerçants et expansion. L’écart le plus difficile à combler se situe entre « intégré » et « en transaction active », et c’est vous qui déterminerez où les partenaires et les commerçants stagnent et qui concevrez des programmes pour combler cet écart. Cela comprend des campagnes de cycle de vie, du contenu d’accueil et d’intégration (onboarding) et des guides d’activation pour deux publics à la fois : l’ISV partenaire et les commerçants qui utilisent son logiciel. Avec l’équipe du canal ISV, vous mènerez des campagnes de comarketing et d’adhésion des commerçants qui augmentent le taux de pénétration au sein de la clientèle de chaque partenaire.
Mesurer l’adoption et agir en conséquence :
Vous créerez et tiendrez à jour le tableau de bord de l’adoption : taux d’activation, délai avant la première transaction, taux de rattachement et de pénétration, volume par commerçant, adoption des fonctionnalités et rétention par cohorte. Vous utiliserez ces données pour segmenter les partenaires et les commerçants, repérer les comptes à risque et faire ressortir les occasions d’expansion, puis vous transmettrez vos constats aux équipes qui peuvent agir.
Définir le positionnement et les messages :
Vous élaborerez le positionnement, les propositions de valeur et les messages pour chaque produit et chaque marché vertical, ainsi que pour les nouveaux marchés à mesure que nous y entrons. Un volet central de ce travail consiste à expliquer clairement en quoi notre offre de paiements intégrés se distingue des PayFac horizontaux, des processeurs de paiement et des ISO. Vous traduirez les capacités techniques en résultats qui comptent pour les ISV et les commerçants : partage des revenus, fidélisation, rapprochement simplifié et intégration plus rapide.
Mener des lancements axés sur l’activation :
Vous dirigerez les plans de lancement des nouveaux produits, fonctionnalités, marchés verticaux et régions. Chaque lancement comporte des cibles d’adoption et un plan d’activation sur 30, 60 et 90 jours, et pas seulement des objectifs de notoriété. Vous veillerez aussi à ce que ce que nous construisons soit communiqué publiquement, en ligne et par l’intermédiaire des partenaires. Vous adapterez les messages aux conditions réglementaires et commerciales de chaque région, et travaillerez avec les équipes produit, finances, risques et soutien pour que chaque lancement soit prêt sur les plans commercial et opérationnel avant sa sortie.
Outiller les équipes des ventes, des partenariats et du soutien :
Vous créerez les guides de vente, présentations, fiches concurrentielles, études de cas, calculateurs de RCI et guides de réponse aux objections qu’utilisent les équipes des ventes et des partenariats, et vous outillerez également l’équipe du soutien pour qu’elle puisse expliquer les produits. Vous formerez les équipes à vendre en visant l’activation, et pas seulement la signature. Vous mènerez des analyses des gains et des pertes ainsi que de l’attrition, et réinjecterez vos apprentissages dans le positionnement et le produit.
Représenter le marché au sein de l’entreprise :
Vous suivrez les concurrents, les prix, les frais d’interchange et l’évolution de la réglementation, et serez la voix du marché et des données d’adoption dans la planification des produits. Lors d’acquisitions ou de regroupements de produits, vous soutiendrez les messages liés au portefeuille et à l’intégration.
Ce que vous apporterez
Au moins trois ans d’expérience en marketing produit dans une entreprise de logiciels B2B, de technologie financière ou de paiements.
Une expérience concrète de lancements dont le succès a été mesuré par l’adoption ou l’utilisation, et pas seulement par la notoriété.
De l’expérience à faire du marketing auprès de deux publics à la fois, par exemple des partenaires et leurs clients, ou des plateformes et leurs utilisateurs.
Une connaissance pratique du fonctionnement des paiements par carte, ou la capacité de l’acquérir rapidement et de l’expliquer avec justesse.
De l’aisance avec les données. Vous savez définir un indicateur, concevoir ou spécifier un tableau de bord et en tirer une conclusion.
D’excellentes aptitudes en rédaction. Vous savez transformer une capacité technique en argumentaire d’affaires clair pour une entreprise de logiciels ou le propriétaire d’une petite entreprise.
De l’expérience dans la création d’outils d’habilitation des ventes que les équipes ont réellement utilisés.
Vous savez prendre un objectif vaguement défini, établir votre propre plan et le mener à terme.
Vous utilisez des outils d’IA tous les jours pour la recherche, la rédaction et l’analyse, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
Atouts
Expérience en paiements intégrés, avec des PayFac ou dans un canal ISV.
Marketing du cycle de vie ou de l’accueil et de l’intégration des clients dans une entreprise axée sur les partenaires.
Marketing de logiciels dans les secteurs de la santé, du droit, de l’hôtellerie et de la restauration ou des services professionnels.
Lancement de produits en Europe ou en Asie-Pacifique.
Mise en place de programmes d’analyse des gains et des pertes ou de l’attrition.
Expérience pratique de SQL, d’un outil de veille d’affaires (BI) ou d’automatisation du marketing.
Messages liés au portefeuille ou à l’intégration à la suite d’une acquisition.
Ce poste vous plaira si…
Vous remarquez qu’un partenaire est en service depuis deux mois et que seule une poignée de ses commerçants ont adhéré, et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi. Est-ce l’argumentaire, l’accueil et l’intégration, l’équipe de vente du partenaire ou le produit?
Au cours d’une même semaine, vous pourriez refaire une séquence de courriels d’accueil pour les commerçants, extraire des données de cohortes pour le chef de la direction, former une équipe de partenariats sur un nouveau marché vertical et réécrire une fiche concurrentielle après avoir perdu un contrat au profit d’un processeur horizontal.
La portée du poste est vaste pour une seule personne, et l’adoption est une cible plus difficile à atteindre que la visibilité d’un lancement. Vous serez évalué(e) sur des résultats que vous influencez sans les contrôler entièrement, ce qui veut dire que vous devrez passer par les partenaires, l’équipe produit et les ventes pour les faire bouger. Les priorités évolueront au gré de la feuille de route et des acquisitions.
Pourquoi ce poste est important
ValPay développe des produits et des fonctionnalités pour des partenaires logiciels dans plusieurs marchés verticaux et régions. Ce travail a peu d’impact si les partenaires et les commerçants ne le connaissent pas, ne le comprennent pas et ne l’utilisent pas.
Vous travaillerez directement avec le chef de la direction pour décider du positionnement de nos produits et de la façon dont chaque lancement se traduit en transactions. Votre travail influence la rapidité avec laquelle les partenaires sont mis en service, le nombre de leurs commerçants qui adhèrent et le volume qui circule sur la plateforme. Vous aurez l’autorité nécessaire pour définir le discours et le modifier lorsque les données d’adoption l’indiquent.

Vous utiliserez ces données pour segmenter les partenaires et les commerçants, repérer les comptes à risque et faire ressortir les occasions d’expansion, puis vous transmettrez vos constats aux équipes qui peuvent agir. Définir le positionnement et les messages : Vous élaborerez le positionnement, les propositions de valeur et les messages pour chaque produit et chaque marché vertical, ainsi que pour les nouveaux marchés à mesure que nous y entrons. Un volet central de ce travail consiste à expliquer clairement en quoi notre offre de paiements intégrés se distingue des PayFac horizontaux, des processeurs de paiement et des ISO. Vous traduirez les capacités techniques en résultats qui comptent pour les ISV et les commerçants : partage des revenus, fidélisation, rapprochement simplifié et intégration plus rapide. Mener des lancements axés sur l’activation : Vous dirigerez les plans de lancement des nouveaux produits, fonctionnalités, marchés verticaux et régions. Chaque lancement comporte des cibles d’adoption et un plan d’activation sur 30, 60 et 90 jours, et pas seulement des objectifs de notoriété. Vous veillerez aussi à ce que ce que nous construisons soit communiqué publiquement, en ligne et par l’intermédiaire des partenaires. Vous adapterez les messages aux conditions réglementaires et commerciales de chaque région, et travaillerez avec les équipes produit, finances, risques et soutien pour que chaque lancement soit prêt sur les plans commercial et opérationnel avant sa sortie. Outiller les équipes des ventes, des partenariats et du soutien : Vous créerez les guides de vente, présentations, fiches concurrentielles, études de cas, calculateurs de RCI et guides de réponse aux objections qu’utilisent les équipes des ventes et des partenariats, et vous outillerez également l’équipe du soutien pour qu’elle puisse expliquer les produits. Vous formerez les équipes à vendre en visant l’activation, et pas seulement la signature. Vous mènerez des analyses des gains et des pertes ainsi que de l’attrition, et réinjecterez vos apprentissages dans le positionnement et le produit. Représenter le marché au sein de l’entreprise : Vous suivrez les concurrents, les prix, les frais d’interchange et l’évolution de la réglementation, et serez la voix du marché et des données d’adoption dans la planification des produits. Une expérience concrète de lancements dont le succès a été mesuré par l’adoption ou l’utilisation, et pas seulement par la notoriété. De l’expérience à faire du marketing auprès de deux publics à la fois, par exemple des partenaires et leurs clients, ou des plateformes et leurs utilisateurs. Une connaissance pratique du fonctionnement des paiements par carte, ou la capacité de l’acquérir rapidement et de l’expliquer avec justesse. De l’aisance avec les données. Vous savez définir un indicateur, concevoir ou spécifier un tableau de bord et en tirer une conclusion. D’excellentes aptitudes en rédaction. Vous savez transformer une capacité technique en argumentaire d’affaires clair pour une entreprise de logiciels ou le propriétaire d’une petite entreprise. De l’expérience dans la création d’outils d’habilitation des ventes que les équipes ont réellement utilisés. Vous savez prendre un objectif vaguement défini, établir votre propre plan et le mener à terme. Vous utilisez des outils d’IA tous les jours pour la recherche, la rédaction et l’analyse, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent. Atouts Expérience en paiements intégrés, avec des PayFac ou dans un canal ISV. Marketing du cycle de vie ou de l’accueil et de l’intégration des clients dans une entreprise axée sur les partenaires. Marketing de logiciels dans les secteurs de la santé, du droit, de l’hôtellerie et de la restauration ou des services professionnels. Lancement de produits en Europe ou en Asie-Pacifique. Mise en place de programmes d’analyse des gains et des pertes ou de l’attrition. Expérience pratique de SQL, d’un outil de veille d’affaires (BI) ou d’automatisation du marketing. Messages liés au portefeuille ou à l’intégration à la suite d’une acquisition. Ce poste vous plaira si… Vous remarquez qu’un partenaire est en service depuis deux mois et que seule une poignée de ses commerçants ont adhéré, et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi. Est-ce l’argumentaire, l’accueil et l’intégration, l’équipe de vente du partenaire ou le produit? Au cours d’une même semaine, vous pourriez refaire une séquence de courriels d’accueil pour les commerçants, extraire des données de cohortes pour le chef de la direction, former une équipe de partenariats sur un nouveau marché vertical et réécrire une fiche concurrentielle après avoir perdu un contrat au profit d’un processeur horizontal. La portée du poste est vaste pour une seule personne, et l’adoption est une cible plus difficile à atteindre que la visibilité d’un lancement. Pourquoi ce poste est important ValPay développe des produits et des fonctionnalités pour des partenaires logiciels dans plusieurs marchés verticaux et régions. Ce travail a peu d’impact si les partenaires et les commerçants ne le connaissent pas, ne le comprennent pas et ne l’utilisent pas. This is a practical inspection position working closely with Supplier Quality Management, Supplier Quality Engineering, and manufacturing teams.

Responsibilities
Perform in-process, final, and pre-shipment inspections of fabricated products and assemblies.
Verify product identification, quantities, purchase order requirements, drawing revisions, and applicable specifications before inspection.
Inspect dimensions, workmanship, weld appearance, surface finishes, and assembly quality against approved requirements.
Perform basic functional checks when specified in the inspection plan.
Use calibrated measuring equipment, including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, pin gauges, indicators, tape measures, and squares.
Confirm that engineering changes and approved revisions have been correctly implemented.
Review material certificates, supplier inspection records, test results, and traceability documentation.
Identify and document nonconforming products through clear descriptions, measurements, photographs, and references to requirements.
Initiate or support Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and promptly escalate issues affecting quality, fit, function, or shipment timing.
Support containment, sorting, reinspection, and verification of supplier corrections.
Withhold product release when requirements are not met or supporting evidence is incomplete, following established procedures and delegated authority.
Prepare complete inspection reports and submit supporting documentation within 24 hours of inspection completion.
Maintain accurate, traceable records in the designated quality or ERP system.
Follow ISO 9001-based quality procedures, document-control requirements, and site safety rules.

, including its application to drawings using ASME Y14.5.

, document control, traceability, and control of nonconforming products.

This role runs the full outbound operation for a go-to-market team, from building prospect lists to handing qualified leads to sales. The person in this seat owns campaign setup and execution across email and LinkedIn, CRM data integrity, email infrastructure and account health, lead reply management, and weekly reporting.
This is a hands-on, builder-style role suited for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where processes are still being built. Monitor and manage replies across all outbound channels daily; classify by intent and route next steps
Respond to warm leads using approved templates and book demos; hand qualified leads to sales with full context

Keep CRM accurate and current: import/update contacts, companies, activities, notes, stages, deals, ownership
Build and maintain CRM workflows, automations, and integrations with outbound tools; run data hygiene
Build, launch, and manage multi-step email and LinkedIn campaigns end to end, including sequences, schedules, sending limits, and sender assignment
Set up and run nurture and re-engagement flows; apply deliverability best practices; coordinate lists/senders to avoid overlap
Pause, fix, and relaunch campaigns based on performance and health checks
QA all sequences, templates, and replies against approved copy before launch (personalization, links, subject lines, signatures, compliance footers)
Maintain consistent sender identities across mailboxes and LinkedIn profiles; spot-check live sends
Manage sending domains, mailboxes, DNS authentication, and warm-up; monitor bounces, spam complaints, blocklists, inbox placement, and domain reputation
Scale sending volume based on account health; keep LinkedIn sender accounts healthy and within platform limits; work with vendors to resolve issues
Build targeted prospect lists using scraping, hiring-signal, and data tools; deduplicate, clean, and apply suppression
Enrich contacts with verified emails/phone numbers across multiple sources; prepare calling lists for sales; manage data credits
Deliver weekly performance reporting by channel and funnel stage; build/maintain CRM dashboards; distinguish genuine engagement from automated responses
Maintain a live tracker of all running campaigns
Administer accounts, seats, subscriptions, and credits across the GTM tool stack
Document recurring processes as SOPs; keep naming conventions consistent; support sales with clean data, lead context, and CRM fixes
Qualifications
5+ years in marketing operations supporting a B2B outbound or demand generation team
Proven experience running multi-channel outbound across email and LinkedIn
Strong CRM administration skills
Experience managing lead replies and handoffs to sales
Working knowledge of email deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, bounce management
Experience with list building and data enrichment
Advanced spreadsheet skills
Sharp attention to detail and clear written English
Background in US healthcare or staffing outbound (preferred)

Our Retention Marketing team in Bath manages subscriber loyalty and customer lifecycle strategies across Future's global portfolio. Based in our Bath office on a hybrid basis, we deliver data-led onboarding, engagement, and win-back campaigns for digital and print subscribers. This 12-month maternity cover role offers an exciting opportunity to guide subscriber retention across leading specialist media brands.

Reporting to the Head of Retention in Bath, you'll manage subscriber retention roadmaps across our digital and print subscriber portfolio. You'll oversee multi-channel customer journeys, automated renewal sequences, and targeted win-back campaigns to reduce churn and boost customer lifetime value. You'll analyze monthly retention metrics, translate campaign data into strategic insights, and test win-back promotional pricing models. Additionally, you'll coordinate campaign roll-outs within an agile sprint workflow and manage retention budget allocation.
Manage multi-channel onboarding, renewal, and win-back campaigns to increase subscriber engagement and reduce churn.
Optimize automated customer lifecycle journeys and email communication workflows across print and digital brands.
Deliver monthly performance reporting, translating retention analytics into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Collaborate with CRM, Design, Editorial, and Acquisition teams to create engaging, on-brand subscriber campaigns.
Recommend strategic win-back pricing and promotional offers aligned with commercial revenue goals.
Manage retention budget allocation to ensure strong return on marketing investment and long-term customer value.
What you’ll bring
Demonstrable experience in retention, CRM marketing, or customer lifecycle management within subscription or recurring revenue models.
Proficiency using CRM or CDP platforms, email marketing automation tools, and customer analytics software.
Strong data analysis skills with an ability to translate performance metrics into clear campaign recommendations.
Excellent written communication skills with experience writing copy for email and multi-channel customer journeys.
Collaborative mindset with experience working alongside cross-functional teams in agile workflows.
Proactive approach to testing new lifecycle initiatives, pricing strategies, and customer retention campaigns.
Minimum Requirements
Experience in retention or CRM marketing within subscription, digital publishing, or membership sectors.
Practical experience using CRM software, email automation platforms, and marketing data dashboards.
Ability to work from our Bath office on a hybrid basis.

Uncapped leave
Enhanced parental leave
Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care

Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes

Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

education: Unspecified

Media buying is now the easy part.
In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.
So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.
Here's what "end to end" actually means here.
You are the account manager.
We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You are the creative strategist.
You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.
You build the things the account needs.
If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You carry up to six accounts.
That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.
You can live anywhere.
We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like
Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts
as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.
Own the client relationship.
There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.
Run the research before the ads.
Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in
this
account.
Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work.
Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.
Ship creative on a cadence.
Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.
Build and test landing pages.
Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.
Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Report on new customer economics.
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.
You're a fit if
You've done this with real money.
Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.
You're AI-native, and you build.
This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.
You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level.
Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.
You can communicate your ideas.
This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.
You have taste and you know when to hand off.
You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.
You can work US Eastern business hours
for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus:
you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.
You're not a fit if
"That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary.
It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
Benefits
Why This Role Is Exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.
You will work on real brands with real budgets.
We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You will grow into senior strategy.
We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.
