Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any.
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere.
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like
Own a set of DTC accounts
as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship.
There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything.
Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses.
Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing.
The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash.
Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed.
Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking.
GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.
Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs.
Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
You are a fit if
You have done this with real money.
Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack
, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build.
This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.
You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers.
You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.
Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
You are not a fit if
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
Benefits
Why this role is exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service. Founded in 2013 and trusted by leading brands and service providers, we power seamless, reliable service experiences through a modern platform built for scale. Our platform gives businesses the visibility, communication, and control they need to manage every step of the service journey, from job acceptance through completion. With the acquisition of Youreka in 2023, Dispatch expanded its capabilities to include a leading Salesforce-native Smart Forms application that equips mobile workers with guided workflows, improves field execution and customer service, and scales to support complex enterprise operations.
As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We're investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth.
We're now investing in a dedicated marketing function to match the strength of our product and customer base, and we're hiring our first Director of Demand Generation to build it.
THE ROLE:
Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Demand Generation will own demand generation for Dispatch and Youreka, reshaping what marketing means for the company and our products. This role also owns our Business Development Representative team's strategy and targets, working primarily through our existing BDR team lead. This is a hands-on, builder role: you'll set strategy and run campaigns yourself in the early days, then pursue growth within the marketing team as the function proves out.
AS THE DIRECTOR OF DEMAND GENERATION, YOU WILL:
Demand generation & growth - assess Dispatch's situation from first principles to determine where marketing should focus (paid acquisition, lifecycle/email, organic, and other channels); own the marketing automation and CRM stack; generate and manage a healthy, measurable pipeline in close partnership with sales. Building this out is the top priority for this role.
Product-market fit & positioning - identify, through testing and analysis, which segments, use cases, and messages actually convert; use that to sharpen demand-gen targeting and messaging, and share findings with our Product Marketing team to inform their formal positioning work.
Content - build a content engine (website copy, case studies, thought leadership) that supports demand generation and conversion.
Team leadership - own strategy and targets for our BDR team, working closely with the existing Lead BDR and aligning team output with the broader demand generation strategy. You will also manage an existing marketing team resource and help define future role additions over time.
Diagnose marketing channel mix for Dispatch's products - prioritizing investment accordingly.
Establish the processes, reporting, and KPIs the function will run on.
WITHIN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:
Build a functioning marketing engine - team, tools, and process, revamped from a lean starting point and working closely with our Senior Marketing Manager.
Define a clear, data-backed point of view on where Dispatch should focus its marketing investment, measurable pipeline/revenue contribution from marketing, and BDR-driven programs.
Develop sharper product positioning and messaging along with marketing support delivered for major product launches and market expansions.
Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch's growth functions.
LOCATION:
Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use.
SALARY:
The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.
Requirements
5–10 years of marketing experience including specific focus on demand generation and program definition.
A startup-tested operator - comfortable being hands-on and building programs with limited resources, not just directing an existing team.
A proven track record of owning a marketing function or team from an early stage.
Proven, hands-on experience managing a demand-generation/marketing function is required. Experience managing a team on a sales-style comp plan - such as a BDR, SDR, or inside-sales function - is a plus.
An analytical, first-principles thinker who can diagnose which channels and tactics actually drive results for a given business, rather than defaulting to a standard playbook - we're counting on you to help define our ideal marketing mix, not just execute one.
A strong written communicator who can turn technical or operational product value into compelling brand and content narratives.
B2B SaaS experience preferred; experience in field service, home services, or enterprise software is a plus.
Benefits
WE HAVE:
An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day
Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program
A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths
A generous medical, dental, and vision package
Paid parental leave
401(k) with company match
Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability
Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits
Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule
STILL WITH US?
We're ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers.
Not a fit? Keep an eye on our
Careers Page
for other positions!
Dispatch is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other classification as required by applicable law.
Dispatch

Lead strategy, research, and creation for demand gen content, email, and social messaging, collaborating closely with team members to lead execution

Use AI tools and marketing automation platforms to optimize campaign performance, personalization, and lead scoring—leveraging technology to scale impact and work smarter.
Analyze pipeline and revenue data to guide campaign decisions, identify what's working, and continuously refine strategy and channel mix.

Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills: ability to use pipeline and revenue data to guide decisions, measure campaign performance, and optimize channel mix.
Demonstrated experience with ABM strategy and close partnership with sales teams on key account targeting and messaging.
Strong hands-on execution skills: comfort owning campaign creation, messaging, social content, and digital advertising—not just strategy or planning.

We are looking for an experienced hands-on Marketing Technology Manager to join a U.S.-based consumer health and wellness company, and own the systems behind their direct-to-consumer (DTC) business.

Role overview
As a Marketing Technology Manager, you will be the primary technical owner responsible for managing, optimizing, and consolidating the company's martech stack. You will oversee day-to-day platform administration, build cross-platform automated workflows, make direct Shopify theme updates, and ensure clean data synchronization across email, SMS, subscription, and analytics platforms.
In this role, you will step into an established stack and immediately drive high-impact initiatives, including migrating SMS into Klaviyo, consolidating review and loyalty apps, rebuilding Rebuy templates on a new site theme, and expanding BigQuery data connections. You will work closely with the Director of Marketing, balancing daily operational tasks with process automation and tech stack optimization. Candidates must be able to work full-time aligned with US Eastern Time hours to support real-time stack troubleshooting.
Selection process
The process usually consists of 4 stages and takes on average 4–6 weeks to be completed, depending on eventual additional technical rounds or take-home tests:
Initial interview with Workana's recruiting team
Technical interview with the client
Take-home/assessment assignment
Final interview with C-level
As Workana has multiple clients, if you pass the first round with Workana's recruiting team, you may also be considered for other relevant opportunities if the initial opportunity does not move forward.
Responsibilities
Administer, document, and manage core DTC platforms, including Klaviyo, Attentive, Shopify, Recharge, Rebuy, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Build, test, QA, and maintain email and SMS automated flows, campaign setups, sign-up forms, and audience segments.
Build and maintain multi-step automated workflows in Make.com (or similar integration tools) connecting platforms, webhooks, and APIs.
Perform hands-on updates directly in Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and the native theme editor.
Lead tech stack consolidation efforts, including SMS migration into Klaviyo, loyalty tool consolidation, and app rebuilds on a new theme.
Maintain data integrity and reporting connections across Shopify, Klaviyo, Triple Whale, and BigQuery.
Leverage AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to automate manual processes like brand protection monitoring and list hygiene.
Ensure strict email and SMS legal compliance across platforms (CAN-SPAM, TCPA) and document all system architectures in Asana.
Requirements
15+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, or DTC ecommerce operations.
Strong expertise with Shopify and Klaviyo ecosystems, including app integrations and automated flow architecture.
Hands-on experience building multi-step automated scenarios using Make.com, Zapier, or similar platforms via APIs and webhooks.
Proven proficiency editing Shopify themes, including modifying Liquid code, HTML, CSS, sections, and blocks.
Deep understanding of DTC data flows, tracking pixels, UTM governance, and database hygiene.
Demonstrated experience executing platform migrations or tech stack consolidation initiatives.
Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize workflows and manual tasks.
Fluent English is mandatory (both written and verbal), as the role involves regular collaboration with an international team.
Must be based in Latin America and able to work aligned with US Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

SQL proficiency and experience creating dashboards in BigQuery or Looker Studio.
Experience with specialized DTC platforms such as Recharge, Rebuy, Stamped.io, Smile.io, or Triple Whale.
Background in CPG, consumer health, dietary supplements, or regulated consumer categories.
Experience with marketplace brand protection enforcement (Amazon Brand Registry, IP takedowns) or affiliate platforms (UpPromote).

Career growth with international clients and dynamic projects

Build and maintain multi-step automated workflows in Make.com (or similar integration tools) connecting platforms, webhooks, and APIs.

Maintain data integrity and reporting connections across Shopify, Klaviyo, Triple Whale, and BigQuery.

Ensure strict email and SMS legal compliance across platforms (CAN-SPAM, TCPA) and document all system architectures in Asana.
Requirements
15+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, or DTC ecommerce operations.
Strong expertise with Shopify and Klaviyo ecosystems, including app integrations and automated flow architecture.
Hands-on experience building multi-step automated scenarios using Make.com, Zapier, or similar platforms via APIs and webhooks.
Proven proficiency editing Shopify themes, including modifying Liquid code, HTML, CSS, sections, and blocks.
Deep understanding of DTC data flows, tracking pixels, UTM governance, and database hygiene.
Demonstrated experience executing platform migrations or tech stack consolidation initiatives.
Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize workflows and manual tasks.
Fluent English is mandatory (both written and verbal), as the role involves regular collaboration with an international team.
Must be based in Latin America and able to work aligned with US Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

SQL proficiency and experience creating dashboards in BigQuery or Looker Studio.
Experience with specialized DTC platforms such as Recharge, Rebuy, Stamped.io, Smile.io, or Triple Whale.
Background in CPG, consumer health, dietary supplements, or regulated consumer categories.
Experience with marketplace brand protection enforcement (Amazon Brand Registry, IP takedowns) or affiliate platforms (UpPromote).
Benefits
Compensation in USD
Fully remote work within Latin America with flexible time schedules
Career growth with international clients and dynamic projects

Role overview
As a Digital Media Planner, you will work in a hands-on paid media role with a strong performance and optimization focus. You will own day-to-day campaign execution primarily across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, while also contributing to campaign planning, budget allocation, testing strategy, performance analysis, and recommendations. Reporting directly to the Performance Media Marketing Manager, you will use channel and ecommerce data to determine what to optimize, where opportunities exist, and what actions should be taken next.
We are looking for a media specialist with strong agency or fast-paced paid media experience who can translate raw channel data into clear business insights, and troubleshoot platform issues independently. Candidates must be able to work US Eastern Time hours.
Selection process

Build, launch, QA, and optimize paid media campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, managing campaign structures, targeting, bids, budgets, and creative assets.
Monitor pacing and performance daily to identify material shifts early and execute optimizations proactively.
Analyze campaign results using platform analytics, search trends, auction signals, creative performance, and ecommerce data.
Prepare clear recurring performance updates summarizing performance changes, optimizations made, and next steps for stakeholders.
Execute structured A/B tests across audiences, keywords, bidding strategies, formats, and placements, documenting repeatable learnings.
Partner with brand and creative teams to communicate creative fatigue, request asset needs, and translate channel performance into actionable feedback.
Troubleshoot ad disapprovals, account flags, and platform support cases to ensure uninterrupted account delivery.
Utilize tools like Triple Whale, platform automation, and AI workflows to streamline reporting and campaign optimizations while validating source data.
Requirements
2+ years of hands-on paid media experience, ideally within an agency or fast-paced DTC/ecommerce environment.
Proven direct experience building, pacing, and optimizing campaigns within both Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign metrics, budget pacing, testing data, and market trends.
Solid working knowledge of core digital media levers, including account architecture, bid strategies, audience targeting, and troubleshooting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex advertising platform data into clear insights.
Strong organizational skills and high bias for action, with comfort utilizing AI-assisted workflows responsibly.
Fluent English is mandatory, as the role involves regular written and verbal communication with a U.S.-based team.
Must be based in Latin America and available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time hours.
Bonus
:
Exposure to programmatic media and experience supporting or managing programmatic campaigns.
Experience with Amazon Advertising, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, or DSP.
Familiarity with Triple Whale, Shopify, or other DTC ecommerce analytics platforms.
Exposure to CTV/OTT, audio/podcasts, or paid influencer amplification.
Previous experience in CPG, consumer health, dietary supplements, or regulated consumer categories.
Benefits
Compensation in USD
Fully remote work within Latin America with flexible time schedules
Career growth with international clients and dynamic projects
This is a long-term independent contractor agreement with no additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, etc.

About Hi-Altitude Brands
Hi-Altitude Brands, through our flagship brand, Stonehenge Health, is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer supplement company on a mission to help people live healthier, more vibrant lives. We develop premium, science-backed formulations featuring clinically studied branded ingredients that set us apart from competitors. Our products are sold through our website, Amazon, and Walmart, reaching hundreds of thousands of customers nationwide.
We are a fully remote team that values autonomy, ownership, and results. We move fast, test constantly, and hold ourselves to high standards. If you thrive in environments where your work has a direct, measurable impact, you will fit right in.
Position Overview
We're hiring a
Direct-to-Consumer Senior Data Analyst
to be the analytical backbone of our marketing organization. You’ll own analytics across the full marketing funnel — acquisition, brand, and retention — and turn complex data into clear recommendations on where to invest, what to test, and what to do next.
You’ll lead MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, executive reporting, and predictive modeling, while helping us evolve our analytics infrastructure. You’ll inherit a strong foundation across BigQuery, Power BI, SQL, and Python and play a key role in evaluating and transitioning to a more modern, AI-augmented analytics platform.
You’ll report to the Chief Retention Officer, who will provide strategic direction while relying on you as the subject-matter expert for analytics, methodology, and data-driven decision-making.
Responsibilities
Marketing & Media Analytics (Core Focus)
Own MMM, MTA, and incrementality testing across the marketing funnel.
Analyze DTC channel performance and cross-channel halo effects using Northbeam or similar platforms.
Evaluate channel efficiency and recommend marketing investment priorities.
Apply subscription and DTC economics (CAC, ROAS, LTV, churn, AOV, and CPA) to marketing decisions.
Support A/B test design and analysis across CRM and marketing channels.
Insights & Reporting
Build and maintain executive dashboards across marketing and customer performance.
Translate complex, multi-source data into clear, actionable insights.
Partner with the CRO and marketing leadership on data-driven decision-making.
Predictive & Decision Modeling
Build churn, LTV, profitability, and sensitivity models.
Develop models to evaluate the long-term financial impact of tests and business decisions.
Use analysis and modeling to inform go/no-go recommendations.
Data & Analytics Infrastructure
Evaluate and help select our next BI/analytics platform, including AI-augmented capabilities.
Lead the transition from Power BI to the selected platform, including report migration and stakeholder adoption.
Map and document data sources, definitions, dependencies, and gaps.
Establish data quality, governance, and metric standards.
Manage data connections and ETL processes as needed.
Requirements
7+ years in analytics, marketing analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience working with subscription-based or recurring-revenue business models, ideally within DTC/e-commerce.
Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related field.
Deep expertise in subscription and DTC unit economics, including CAC, ROAS, CPA, churn, LTV, and AOV.
Hands-on experience with MMM, MTA, and incrementality testing, including reconciling conflicting model outputs.
Experience with Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox, or similar attribution/analytics platforms.
Strong statistical modeling skills, including churn, LTV, and profitability modeling.
Expert SQL and strong Python skills for transformation, automation, and modeling.
Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests and causal inference.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or similar BI platforms and migrating to new technologies.
Proven ability to turn analysis into clear business recommendations and challenge assumptions when warranted.
Strong communication skills with experience presenting to CEO/COO-level audiences.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and manage long-term projects.
Nice to Have
Experience in a DTC + Amazon hybrid business, particularly measuring cross-channel halo effects.
Experience with health & wellness or supplements.
Experience evaluating or migrating BI platforms such as Domo, Sigma, Looker, or Tableau.
Familiarity with AI-driven analytics and decisioning tools, including natural-language reporting, Hightouch, Braze, or similar.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, or similar data pipeline tools.
Prior experience managing or mentoring junior analysts.
Compensation
Competitive Salary: $135,000 - $165,000 (based on experience), bonus eligibility
Benefits
Flexible time off + 9 annual company holidays
Your Birthday is a paid vacation day - take the day to celebrate your awesomeness!
100% company-paid base plan Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance for employees
100% company-paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability Coverage
3% Employer contributions to 401(k) regardless of employee participation! (Free money)
Matching Charitable Contributions up to $2,500/year
$1,200/annual Work from Home (WFH) stipend
Employee Recognition and Rewards Program
Pet insurance
Employee Product Samples and Discounts

Azumo is looking for a highly motivated AI-Powered Marketing Analyst to join our marketing team and help grow the Azumo brand and business.
The role is fully remote across Latin America
, aligned to your working day.
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.
This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.
Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.
You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.
What We’re Looking For
We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.
We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.
AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.
At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.
Why Join Azumo?
Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.
You will have the opportunity to:
Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools.
Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels.
Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives.
Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo.
Work closely with experienced team members and company leadership.
Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work.
Receive training and mentored career development.
Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies.
Responsibilities
As part of the Azumo marketing team, you will:
Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations.
Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content.
Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools.
Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets.
Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo’s visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.
Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements.
Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows.
Help maintain and update Azumo’s website when needed.
Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams.
Requirements
Mandatory Qualifications
Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational.
3+ years of hands-on marketing experience, including practical use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in your day-to-day work.
Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy.
Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms.
Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis.
Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication.
Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact.
Other Qualifications
Ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together.
Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations.
Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment.
Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility.
Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms.
Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system.
Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms.
Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations.
Benefits
The AI-Powered Marketing Analyst will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential.
Company benefits include:
Paid time off
100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America)
U.S. Holidays
Training
Mentored career development
USD remuneration
Profit Share Program
Access to premium AI and marketing tools
Maternity coverage
About Azumo
Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile.
We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere.
If you are excited about marketing, already use AI as part of how you work, and want the opportunity to learn quickly and have a measurable impact on a growing technology company, we’d like to hear from you.|
At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.

About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.
For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.
About the Role
As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.
Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.
Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.
Requirements
Must-Have:
3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.
Nice to Have:
Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

Summary
We're a growing B2B SaaS company. We want an operator to build a team of high performers, especially in sales and marketing. This is not a traditional HR role.
PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF:
You haven't hired sales or marketing people at a B2B SaaS company.
Your main work has been policies, benefits, compliance or HR administration.
You wait for problems to come to you.
You've never personally run the exit of an underperformer.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Performance. Set clear, measurable standards for every role. Spot underperformers early, coach them fast, and exit them within 60–90 days if they don't improve. You will run and deliver terminations yourself, with the CEO signing off.
Hiring. Build a hiring engine for account executives, SDRs, marketers and their leaders. You'll track time-to-hire, ramp time and quota attainment.
Culture. Build a culture where top performers are rewarded publicly and everyone knows the bar.
Managers. Hold managers accountable for their teams, and back them when they make tough calls.
Initiative. Bring problems and fixes to the CEO before you're asked.
Requirements
YOU ARE
An operator first, with a background in sales, RevOps, recruiting or ops leadership at B2B SaaS companies.
Someone who talks in revenue per employee, quota attainment and regretted attrition, not "engagement."
High energy, fast-moving, and willing to push back on the CEO.
Available 15–25 hours a week, US-based, and open to going full-time.
HOW IT WORKS
Paid 30-day trial. We'll judge you by what you ship: scorecards, a sales hiring scorecard and a performance review cadence.
We'll convert to a longer engagement based on results.

Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor
Workplace: Remote
Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm EST
Compensation: $1,800 - $2,000
About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.
For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.
About the Role
As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.
Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.
Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.
Requirements
Must-Have:
3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.
Nice to Have:
Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

Use customer feedback, market insight, and commercial performance data to improve the product, proposition, launch strategy, and customer experience.
Drive Growth:
Identify what to scale, iterate, or stop, and help turn successful offerings into meaningful and repeatable revenue streams.

5+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, operations, advertising, digital media, or a related discipline.
Proven experience identifying, developing, launching, or scaling a new product, market, customer segment, or commercial offering.

Experience owning or significantly contributing to external product launches and integrated go-to-market campaigns.
Strong customer discovery, research, analytical, and market-sizing skills.
Strong commercial instincts around pricing, packaging, monetization, and revenue growth.
Experience working closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and customers.
Excellent strategic, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Highly curious and innovation-minded, with an interest in emerging technology and AI.
Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial; comfortable creating the path forward rather than waiting for one.
A bias toward action, experimentation, and learning.
Comfortable operating without a playbook and building structure from scratch.
Experience in advertising, ad tech, media buying, publisher monetization, marketing technology, or digital media is a plus, as is experience with high-volume, self-service, automation, or AI-enabled products.

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401k plus a company match
Uncapped leave

Refer a friend and get rewarded when they join Future
Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programs

With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.
We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.
Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.
Overview
We are seeking a creative and trend-savvy
Social Media Content Specialist
to grow brand awareness, engagement, and community presence across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts. This role will be responsible for executing day-to-day social media activities, managing content calendars, creating engaging short-form content, and identifying emerging trends that strengthen TP-Link's connection with consumers.
The ideal candidate combines strong content creation skills with a data-driven approach to social media marketing. They will develop and publish compelling social content, collaborate with creative teams and influencers, and capitalize on real-time trends to maximize reach and engagement. Success in this role requires hands-on experience producing short-form video content, deep knowledge of social platform best practices, and the ability to balance creative storytelling with measurable business results.
Responsibilities
1. Channel & Calendar Management
Execute Daily Publishing: Plan, schedule, and publish daily content across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, ensuring every channel remains active, on-brand, and consistently scheduled.
Content Calendar Strategy: Build and maintain an integrated social content calendar aligned with product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal moments, and trending topics.
2. Content Creation & Production
Agile Content Creation: Shoot and edit native short-form video (Reels, Shorts) and photo content independently when quick turnaround or real-time trend capitalization is needed.
Creative Briefing & Asset Coordination: Draft clear creative briefs and collaborate with internal graphic designers, video editors, and copywriters to produce high-quality brand assets.
Budget & Production Management: Manage micro-budgets for creative production, freelance resources, or sponsored post boosts as required.
3. Trend Discovery & Creator Activation
Trend Spotting: Continuously monitor viral audio, formats, memes, and emerging social trends, pitching actionable ideas with a clear hypothesis on why they will perform.
Influencer & Creator Engagement: Identify relevant tech creators, reviewers, and lifestyle influencers worth activating for content collaborations, product seeding, or co-branded campaigns.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree required.
3+ Year of hands-on experience managing brand social media channels (consumer electronics, hardware, or DTC e-commerce background strongly preferred).
Production Skills: Proven ability to shoot, edit, and produce short-form video content using mobile editing tools (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or native platform editors).
Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook formats, algorithms, and performance analytics.
Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to balance aesthetic storytelling with data-driven decision-making to optimize reach, impressions, and engagement rate"
Benefits
Salary range: $73,500 - $100,00 annually
Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial premium coverage for dependents)
Contributions to 401k funds
Bi-annual reviews, and annual pay increases
Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
Quarterly team-building events
At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to translate complex technical search requirements into clear business priorities for engineering, merchandising, and marketing teams.

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.
For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.
About the Role
As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.
Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.
Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.
Requirements
Must-Have:
3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.
Nice to Have:
Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

We create trusted, expert content that helps millions of people discover more about the things they love, need and care about. From technology, gaming and entertainment to fashion, lifestyle, sport, finance and beyond, our specialist brands connect people with their passions every day.

We combine our deep specialist knowledge with innovative technology and data to create engaging experiences, build valuable communities and help people make better-informed decisions.
Behind it all are our people - passionate experts, creators, innovators and problem-solvers who are shaping the future of media.

Our Retention team in Bath manages direct-to-consumer engagement across 60+ specialist brands, including iconic titles in Gaming, Homes, Sport, and Lifestyle. We focus on keeping readers engaged, expanding subscriber lifetime value, and delivering customer-first marketing journeys. You'll join a supportive, collaborative group that connects directly with millions of passionate magazine, paywall, and app readers. This position offers a fantastic opportunity to build authentic marketing campaigns that foster long-term loyalty across world-class media titles.
What you'll do
Reporting to the Retention Manager in Bath, you'll deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns that retain and win back subscribers across our print and digital portfolio. You'll work closely with editorial, brand, printer, and CRM teams to build authentic customer communications that reflect the unique voice of each title.
On a daily basis, you'll write creative design briefs, draft engaging campaign copy, and manage automated email onboarding journeys using CRM platforms, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Excel. You'll review subscriber analytics, monitor campaign performance, coordinate artwork through sprint workflows, and liaise with suppliers to ensure smooth operational delivery.
Deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns to retain and win back print and digital subscribers across 60+ specialist titles.
Manage subscriber onboarding journeys and ongoing automated campaigns to enhance customer engagement and lifetime value.
Draft copy and design briefs for campaign artwork, coordinating with internal teams and external printers.
Work alongside CRM specialists to build and test best-practice email campaigns and automated communications.
Analyse subscriber survey feedback and campaign metrics using Google Sheets and Excel to optimize retention activity.
Handle key administrative tasks, including purchase order processing and supplier invoice coordination, with high attention to detail.
What you’ll bring
Experience or strong interest in subscription marketing, CRM, or audience engagement strategies.
Demonstrable experience creating or supporting multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital or print media.
Proficiency with office collaboration software, including Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint.
Strong written communication skills with high attention to detail for proofreading and campaign copy.
Collaborative working style with the ability to build positive relationships across cross-functional brand teams.
Analytical curiosity with confidence using spreadsheets to evaluate performance data.
Minimum Requirements
Interest in starting or continuing a career in retention, CRM, or digital marketing.
Demonstrable experience or qualification in marketing, business, or a related field.
Practical experience delivering marketing communications or using digital collaboration tools like Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
Capability to work collaboratively from our Bath office.
What we offer
Uncapped leave
Enhanced parental leave
Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care
When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
Refer a friend scheme - with payment following the successful hire.
Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes
Opportunity to purchase shares in Future, with our Share Incentive Plan
Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match
Free drinks and snacks in our offices
The expected salary for this role is £26,500
This is a hybrid role, working 2 days per week from our Bath Office
Internal job family level P7

The Opportunity
As
Senior Manager of Product Marketing
at Coursedog, you'll lead the strategic vision and execution of our product marketing function, positioning our Intelligent Academic Operations Platform as the essential solution for higher ed institutions. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership to drive go-to-market strategy, competitive positioning, and customer advocacy. You'll own translating market insights into compelling positioning and messaging that resonates across multiple buyer personas and use cases. You’ll drive alignment across teams and accelerate our market leadership in the higher ed space by balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, deep market research with rapid iteration, and customer empathy with business acumen.
If you're excited by the challenge of establishing Coursedog as the market leader in education operations and want to help institutions break down barriers to student success at scale, this is a chance to do meaningful work with real impact.
This position offers a
competitive base salary between $125,000 - $130,000
, based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing
total on-target earnings (OTE) to $135,000 - $150,000
when performance objectives are achieved.
What You'll Do
Own and evolve the overall product marketing strategy, including positioning, messaging architecture, and go-to-market plans across all platform modules and buyer segments
Oversee market and competitive research initiatives to inform segmentation, persona development, pricing strategy, and long-term product roadmap alignment
Drive alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership on strategy, messaging, and priorities—escalating and resolving conflicts to accelerate execution
Establish and oversee key performance indicators across product marketing activities, including pipeline influence, win rates, competitive win/loss analysis, and customer satisfaction metrics
Develop comprehensive customer advocacy programs, including advisory boards, case studies, testimonials, and customer reference networks that amplify our market presence
Lead the creation and evolution of high-impact customer and prospect-facing assets—positioning documents, competitive battlecards, sales enablement materials, website content, videos, and thought leadership
Own sales enablement strategy and execution, ensuring sales teams have the insights, messaging, and tools to effectively communicate value to different buyer personas and use cases
Represent Coursedog as a thought leader and spokesperson at industry events, conferences, analyst briefings, and speaking engagements, often including presentations
Establish and nurture relationships with industry analysts, press, and key opinion leaders to shape market perception and third-party credibility
Onsite travel for conferences and events expected 20% throughout the year
Leverage AI and emerging technologies to enhance product marketing efficiency and effectiveness—from market research and content creation to competitive analysis and customer insights
Requirements
What You'll Bring
3-5 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or strategic role. Higher Ed experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Deep expertise in market research, competitive analysis, buyer persona development, and segmentation methodologies
Demonstrated ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging that resonates across multiple audiences and personas
Strong strategic thinking combined with execution excellence—able to set vision while rolling up sleeves to deliver high-quality assets
Experience driving sales enablement, working directly with sales teams, and measuring impact on pipeline and revenue outcomes
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior leadership across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success
Excellent communication and storytelling skills—comfortable presenting to executives, customers, and external audiences internally and externally at conferences
Experience with SaaS pricing strategy, packaging, or go-to-market launches
Knowledge of or passion for the higher education market or complex B2B enterprise software environments
An empathetic, curious mindset paired with strong business acumen and ownership mentality
Experience using AI tools and technologies effectively to drive productivity and creativity in marketing strategy, content development, and cross-functional collaboration
Not sure if you should apply?
Research shows that women and people from underrepresented backgrounds are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification listed. At Coursedog, we're focused on finding the best person for the role, and that person may come from a non-traditional background. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement — our evaluation focuses on your ability to thrive in this role and make an impact.
Benefits
About Coursedog
At Coursedog, our mission is simple but ambitious: to break down barriers to student success. Founded by former college students who were frustrated by outdated academic systems, Coursedog was built to empower higher ed administrators to deliver exceptional educational experiences and make it easier for students to achieve their goals. Since then, we’ve grown into a platform trusted by institutions across the country.
Coursedog is the Intelligent Academic Operations Platform, empowering 500+ colleges and universities to better serve over 4 million students. Our platform brings together academic scheduling, curriculum and catalog management, assessment, and workflow automation — all designed to adapt to each institution’s unique needs and remove administrative roadblocks so educators can focus on helping students succeed.
We’re a remote-first, fast-growing company and a Forbes Top 500 U.S. Startup Employer, with a culture that prioritizes engagement, ownership, and impact. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems, working with thoughtful teammates, and improving education at scale, you’ll feel right at home at Coursedog.
Working at Coursedog
Healthcare, Dental & Vision
We follow a fixed contribution model to promote equity and transparency. Every employee receives the same annual dollar amount to apply toward medical, dental, and vision coverage. This approach gives you the flexibility to choose the plan that best fits your needs, whether that is a base-level option or more comprehensive coverage.
Depending on the selected coverage level, the company covers:
Employee-only coverage: 65% to 99% of monthly premiums
Employee plus dependents: 45% to 75% of monthly premiums
We partner with Aetna and Guardian, and offer access to best-in-class wellness and support programs, including:
Spring Health (mental health support)
XP Health (vision benefits)
Carrot Fertility (family planning support)
One Medical (primary care)
We also support pre-tax savings through Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).
Retirement Planning
To support long-term financial health, we offer a Safe Harbor 401(k) plan from day one of employment. Coursedog provides a 4% employer match on your total compensation (subject to federal limits) each pay period for employees contributing to a tax-advantaged retirement account.
Paid Time Off
We trust our employees to manage their time responsibly. That’s why we offer an unlimited Paid Time Off policy — because flexibility and balance are critical for sustained excellence and personal well-being.
Remote-First Since Inception
We were built for distributed work. Our culture emphasizes flexibility over rigidity, outcomes over hours, and transparency over gatekeeping. We are committed to being a remote-first organization indefinitely, empowering you to work where and how you thrive best.
Equity
As a valued contributor to our collective success, you’ll participate in the upside. All employees are granted equity in the company aligned to your role and tenure. Equity grants are reviewed and adjusted with promotions to reflect your evolving impact.
Paid Parental Leave
We proudly support working parents with industry-leading benefits. Employees are eligible for up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave. This benefit is available to all eligible employees, regardless of gender or family structure.

Position Summary
As Growth Marketing Manager at Sadie, you will be responsible for figuring out how Sadie earns attention and turns that attention into growth. We are looking for someone with exceptional creative instincts, a strong personal point of view, and the ability to turn ideas into campaigns, content, and experiences that people want to engage with.
You should care deeply about the quality of what you put into the world. We don't want generic B2B marketing, content from a corporate template, or AI slop. We expect you to embrace AI and new creative tools to explore more ideas, move faster, and push what a small marketing team can produce. AI should increase your creative ambition, not replace your taste.

Values
Exceptional creative taste and attention to detail
High ownership and bias toward action
Commercially minded and outcome-focused
Curious and experimental
Willing to challenge mediocre work
Obsessed with understanding what resonates with people
What You'll Be Doing
Make Sadie Impossible to Ignore
Develop campaigns, content, creative concepts, and experiences that make Sadie stand out in a crowded technology market.
Find interesting ways to tell Sadie's story without generic B2B SaaS marketing.
Build a distinctive voice and creative identity across everything we put into the market.
Turn product launches, customer stories, hospitality insights, company moments, and product improvements into things worth talking about.
Develop ideas that travel across social, paid, email, events, sales, partnerships, and other channels.
Create, Not Coordinate
This is a hands-on role. Take ideas through to execution without relying on an agency or a large team. Write campaigns, create concepts, produce videos, build landing pages, develop ad creative, interview customers, turn customer results into stories, and launch experiments. We care much more about what you can create than how many people you can coordinate.
Use AI Without Looking Like You Used AI
Use AI to research, brainstorm, prototype, write, design, edit, analyze, automate, and increase experimentation. Finished work must feel intentional, original, human, and unmistakably ours. Bring the judgement to distinguish interesting work from polished garbage, and use these tools to extend your creativity rather than substitute for ideas.
Find What Resonates
Understand hospitality operators: what they care about, what frustrates them, and what gets their attention.
Spend time with customers, sales, and product so marketing reflects how people actually talk.
Experiment with messaging, formats, channels, audiences, and creative concepts.
Bring influences from culture, technology, hospitality, media, and the internet into Sadie's communication.
Develop a strong instinct for which ideas deserve to exist.
Turn Attention Into Growth
Build campaigns that generate qualified opportunities and pipeline.
Experiment with paid, organic, outbound, partnerships, events, content, and unconventional acquisition channels.
Work closely with sales on target accounts, campaigns, messaging, and follow-up.
Improve the journey from attention to conversation to customer.
Track which ideas, campaigns, and channels influence pipeline and revenue.
Build the Playbook
Treat growth as a continuous series of experiments: form hypotheses, get ideas into market quickly, measure, and learn.
Stop what isn't working and turn successful approaches into repeatable systems.
Constantly look for new ways Sadie can earn attention and reach hospitality operators.
Why This Role Matters
Sadie is building something fundamentally new for hospitality. This role turns customer outcomes, product capabilities, hospitality culture, company personality, and great ideas into something the market notices — turning creativity into attention, attention into demand, and demand into growth.
You will have significant freedom to experiment across content, creative, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, social, outbound, and new formats while working directly with management, sales, product, and customers.
What You Bring
4+ years of experience in growth marketing, creative marketing, content, brand, demand generation, or a related role.
A portfolio that demonstrates strong creative judgement.
Excellent writing and storytelling ability.
Strong visual and creative instincts, even without formal design training.
A distinct point of view about what makes marketing good or bad.
Experience personally creating and launching campaigns, rather than simply briefing others.
Comfort experimenting across different mediums, formats, and channels.
Strong understanding of how creative work connects to acquisition, conversion, pipeline, and revenue.
Experience using modern AI and creative tools to increase the speed and ambition of your work.
Strong analytical instincts and the ability to learn from performance without allowing dashboards to replace judgement.
Ability to operate independently and turn loosely defined objectives into real work.
Willingness to try ideas that might not work and recognize when work isn't good enough.
Pluses
Experience building a brand or growth function from an early stage.
Content that has earned meaningful organic distribution.
Experience with video, design, social, events, or other creative mediums.
Experience marketing B2B technology.
Experience in hospitality, restaurants, hotels, or other culturally driven industries.
Campaigns for enterprise or multi-location customers.
Developing a founder or executive voice alongside a company brand.
Deep familiarity with emerging creative and AI tools.
A strong interest in understanding what works on the internet.
Personal Fit
Strong opinions about advertising, brands, content, design, writing, and the internet; an eye for genuinely great work; and excitement about AI's creative possibilities alongside high standards for originality and quality.
About the Team
Sadie is building something fundamentally new for hospitality. AI and modern creative tools support ambitious experimentation across content, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, social, outbound, and new formats.
