Sommaire du poste
À titre de gestionnaire, marketing de croissance chez Sadie, vous aurez la responsabilité de déterminer comment Sadie capte l'attention et transforme cette attention en croissance. Nous cherchons une personne dotée d'un flair créatif exceptionnel, d'un point de vue personnel affirmé et de la capacité de transformer des idées en campagnes, en contenus et en expériences auxquels les gens ont envie de participer.
La qualité de ce que vous mettez au monde doit vous tenir profondément à cœur. Nous ne voulons pas de marketing B2B générique, de contenu calqué sur un gabarit corporatif ni de contenu bâclé généré par l'IA. Nous nous attendons à ce que vous adoptiez l'IA et les nouveaux outils créatifs pour explorer plus d'idées, avancer plus rapidement et repousser les limites de ce qu'une petite équipe marketing peut produire. L'IA doit accroître votre ambition créative, et non remplacer votre jugement.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle afin de comprendre ce qui distingue Sadie et de trouver des façons créatives d'intéresser le marché. Vous allierez goût, créativité, expérimentation et sens des affaires pour bâtir un moteur de croissance résolument à l'image de Sadie.
Valeurs
Goût créatif exceptionnel et souci du détail
Grand sens des responsabilités et propension à l'action
Sens des affaires et orientation vers les résultats
Curiosité et goût de l'expérimentation
Volonté de remettre en question le travail médiocre
Passion pour comprendre ce qui résonne auprès des gens
Ce que vous ferez
Rendre Sadie impossible à ignorer
Concevoir des campagnes, des contenus, des concepts créatifs et des expériences qui font ressortir Sadie dans un marché technologique saturé.
Trouver des façons intéressantes de raconter l'histoire de Sadie, sans recourir au marketing SaaS B2B générique.
Bâtir une voix et une identité créative distinctives dans tout ce que nous mettons en marché.
Transformer les lancements de produits, les témoignages de la clientèle, les tendances du secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration, les moments marquants de l'entreprise et les améliorations du produit en sujets dont on a envie de parler.
Développer des idées qui voyagent d'un canal à l'autre : médias sociaux, publicité payante, courriel, événements, ventes, partenariats et autres.
Créer, et non coordonner
Il s'agit d'un rôle très concret. Vous mènerez les idées jusqu'à leur exécution, sans dépendre d'une agence ni d'une grande équipe : rédiger des campagnes, créer des concepts, produire des vidéos, monter des pages de destination, concevoir des créatifs publicitaires, interviewer des clients, transformer leurs résultats en histoires et lancer des expérimentations. Ce que vous êtes capable de créer nous importe bien davantage que le nombre de personnes que vous pouvez coordonner.
Utiliser l'IA sans que cela paraisse
Servez-vous de l'IA pour faire de la recherche, générer des idées, prototyper, rédiger, concevoir, réviser, analyser, automatiser et multiplier les expérimentations. Le travail final doit paraître intentionnel, original, humain et incontestablement le nôtre. Ayez le jugement nécessaire pour distinguer le travail réellement intéressant de la camelote bien polie, et servez-vous de ces outils pour prolonger votre créativité plutôt que pour remplacer vos idées.
Trouver ce qui résonne
Comprendre les exploitants du secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration : ce qui compte pour eux, ce qui les frustre et ce qui attire leur attention.
Passer du temps avec la clientèle, les ventes et le produit pour que le marketing reflète la façon dont les gens s'expriment réellement.
Expérimenter avec les messages, les formats, les canaux, les auditoires et les concepts créatifs.
Puiser des influences dans la culture, la technologie, l'hôtellerie et la restauration, les médias et Internet pour nourrir la communication de Sadie.
Développer un instinct sûr pour reconnaître les idées qui méritent d'exister.
Transformer l'attention en croissance
Bâtir des campagnes qui génèrent des occasions d'affaires qualifiées et alimentent le pipeline de ventes.
Expérimenter avec la publicité payante, le référencement organique, la prospection sortante, les partenariats, les événements, le contenu et des canaux d'acquisition non conventionnels.
Travailler étroitement avec les ventes sur les comptes ciblés, les campagnes, les messages et les relances.
Améliorer le parcours qui mène de l'attention à la conversation, puis à la clientèle.
Assurer le suivi des idées, des campagnes et des canaux qui influencent le pipeline et les revenus.
Bâtir nos façons de faire
Aborder la croissance comme une série continue d'expérimentations : formuler des hypothèses, mettre rapidement les idées en marché, mesurer et apprendre.
Cesser ce qui ne fonctionne pas et transformer les approches gagnantes en systèmes reproductibles.
Chercher constamment de nouvelles façons pour Sadie de capter l'attention et de rejoindre les exploitants du secteur.
Pourquoi ce rôle est important
Sadie crée quelque chose de fondamentalement nouveau pour le secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration. Ce rôle transforme les résultats obtenus par la clientèle, les capacités du produit, la culture du secteur, la personnalité de l'entreprise et les bonnes idées en quelque chose que le marché remarque — en convertissant la créativité en attention, l'attention en demande et la demande en croissance.
Vous disposerez d'une grande liberté pour expérimenter en matière de contenu, de création, d'acquisition payante, d'événements, de partenariats, de médias sociaux, de prospection sortante et de nouveaux formats, tout en travaillant directement avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle.
Ce que vous apportez
Au moins 4 ans d'expérience en marketing de croissance, en marketing créatif, en contenu, en marque, en génération de la demande ou dans un rôle connexe.
Un portfolio qui démontre un solide jugement créatif.
D'excellentes aptitudes en rédaction et en narration.
De forts instincts visuels et créatifs, même sans formation officielle en design.
Un point de vue affirmé sur ce qui distingue un bon marketing d'un mauvais.
De l'expérience dans la création et le lancement de campagnes par vous-même, plutôt que dans la simple rédaction de briefs confiés à d'autres.
De l'aisance à expérimenter avec différents médiums, formats et canaux.
Une bonne compréhension du lien entre le travail créatif et l'acquisition, la conversion, le pipeline et les revenus.
De l'expérience avec les outils d'IA et de création modernes pour accroître la vitesse et l'ambition de votre travail.
De solides réflexes analytiques et la capacité d'apprendre de la performance sans laisser les tableaux de bord remplacer le jugement.
La capacité de travailler de façon autonome et de transformer des objectifs vaguement définis en travail concret.
La volonté d'essayer des idées qui pourraient ne pas fonctionner et de reconnaître quand le travail n'est pas à la hauteur.
Atouts
Expérience de la mise sur pied d'une marque ou d'une fonction de croissance à un stade précoce.
Du contenu ayant obtenu une distribution organique significative.
Expérience en vidéo, en design, en médias sociaux, en événements ou dans d'autres médiums créatifs.
Expérience du marketing de technologies B2B.
Expérience dans l'hôtellerie, la restauration, l'hébergement ou d'autres secteurs à forte dimension culturelle.
Campagnes destinées à des clients grande entreprise ou à des comptes multisites.
Développement de la voix d'un fondateur ou d'un dirigeant en parallèle de la marque d'entreprise.
Grande familiarité avec les outils créatifs et d'IA émergents.
Un vif intérêt à comprendre ce qui fonctionne sur Internet.
Affinité avec le rôle
Des opinions bien arrêtées sur la publicité, les marques, le contenu, le design, la rédaction et Internet; un œil pour le travail véritablement remarquable; et de l'enthousiasme pour les possibilités créatives de l'IA, assorti d'exigences élevées en matière d'originalité et de qualité.
À propos de l'équipe
Sadie crée quelque chose de fondamentalement nouveau pour l'hôtellerie et la restauration. Ce rôle collabore directement avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle afin de comprendre les exploitants du secteur et de traduire les résultats obtenus par la clientèle, les capacités du produit et la personnalité de l'entreprise en un marketing qui capte l'attention et stimule la croissance.
Le poste s'inscrit dans une petite équipe marketing au fonctionnement très concret, marquée par un fort sens des responsabilités, des standards créatifs élevés et une grande liberté d'expérimentation. L'équipe valorise un goût créatif exceptionnel, le souci du détail, la curiosité, le sens des affaires et la volonté de remettre en question le travail médiocre. L'IA et les outils créatifs modernes soutiennent une expérimentation ambitieuse en matière de contenu, d'acquisition payante, d'événements, de partenariats, de médias sociaux, de prospection sortante et de nouveaux formats.

AutoLeap is the market-leading shop management SaaS provider in the underserved auto repair industry. The Shop Management System (SMS) provides an all-in-one, cloud-based auto repair management software that helps after-market auto shop owners focused on general repair to better understand, manage and grow their business—from scheduling appointments to managing technicians and generating invoices to help save time and money.
In 2023, we announced our $30M Series B, led by Advanced Venture Partners (AVP), with continued participation from Bain Capital Ventures and Threshold Ventures. And we aren’t slowing down! Our mission is to change the auto repair industry one shop at a time, helping shop owners get home to their families earlier and helping them build long-lasting healthy businesses to pass on to future generations. We will be the de facto choice for all shop owners looking to grow and improve their businesses with your help!
We take pride in creating an exceptional workplace and experience—here’s how that’s been recognized:
🏆Certified Great Place to Work since 2021
🏆Fortune’s 2024 Best Workplaces in Technology (Small & Medium Businesses)
🏆Numerous G2 Awards (some include: Momentum Leader, Best Relationship, Leader)
🏆One of the Best SMB Companies in North America by SMB Tech 50
As an SEO Lead, you will:
Coordinate SEO efforts and website optimization for repair shops in North America
Perform keyword research to guide on-page and off-page optimization.
Implement and manage organic strategies for businesses including technical SEO, content creation and link-building campaigns.
Review issues on websites and recommend fixes,
Use analytical tools to monitor, analyze and improve search performance.
Develop optimization strategies that increase search engine results rankings for various websites.
Keep abreast of SEO and integrated marketing trends
And so much more!
To be successful in this role, you will need:
4-5 years of professional experience in SEO
Strong SEO expertise across SaaS/B2B websites, including keyword research, search intent, content strategy, site architecture, and internal linking.
Deep knowledge of technical SEO, website optimization, crawling, indexing, and ranking.
Proven track record of ranking competitive keywords in the Top 3.
Experience with AI SEO, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming frog.
Strong analytical, communication, and ownership skills with a focus on business impact.

Manage the product seeding and review program — coordinating sample allocation, tracking loaner units, setting review timelines, and following up with media/reviewers to secure timely, high-quality coverage.
Collaborate with the marketing team to monitor user sentiment, quickly respond, transform insights into PR actions, and optimize user experience and brand image.
Align and integrate PR efforts with companywide goals and cohesive storytelling, integrating cross-functional resources (marketing, sales, etc.).
Measure performance using data-driven metrics — share of voice, sentiment, impressions, message pull-through, and increasingly, AI citation/visibility tracking — to optimize results and demonstrate impact.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Communications, or related field, required.
3+ years of PR experience, ideally in consumer electronics or technology, leading successful media relations and product launch programs.
Exceptional storytelling and messaging skills, with the ability to engineer compelling narratives that clearly differentiate TP-Link’s technology in the market.
Strong existing network and media intelligence to proactively secure high-quality coverage with Tier-1 to Tier-3 outlets across consumer tech and business press.
Proven success driving product launches and thought-leadership initiatives that elevate brand awareness and credibility.
Skilled in PR analytics and performance measurement, including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment, message pull-through, and business outcomes, with the ability to optimize campaigns based on data.
Creative, proactive mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the agility to respond quickly in fast-moving situations.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

About Us
Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.
We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.
Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.
Overview
The Public Relations Manager will be a strategic storyteller responsible for raising TP-Link’s brand awareness and credibility through creative, high-impact communications. This role will craft compelling narratives that differentiate our technology and products, while securing meaningful visibility across Tier-1 to Tier-3 media. Partnering with internal teams and agencies, this leader will drive standout campaigns for consumer electronics launches and thought-leadership initiatives that advance TP-Link’s voice in the market. Success will be measured through clear PR outcomes including share of voice, sentiment, impressions, and message pull-through.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end PR strategy and execution for new product launches, including briefing timelines, embargo management, and coordinated messaging.
Craft compelling, media-worthy storytelling and differentiated messaging to drive consistent, high-volume coverage that captures top-tier interest and reinforces TP-Link's unique market position.
Build and maintain strong relationships with Tier-1 to Tier-3 media, expanding the active media pool — with particular focus on outlets and reviewers frequently cited or referenced by AI search/answer engines (e.g., Google AI Overview, ChatGPT, Perplexity) — to strengthen TP-Link's visibility in AI-driven discovery and search results.
Develop and maintain comprehensive media guides and briefing materials (product fact sheets, key messaging, spokesperson Q&A, competitive positioning) to ensure accurate, consistent coverage across all media tiers.
Manage the product seeding and review program — coordinating sample allocation, tracking loaner units, setting review timelines, and following up with media/reviewers to secure timely, high-quality coverage.
Collaborate with the marketing team to monitor user sentiment, quickly respond, transform insights into PR actions, and optimize user experience and brand image.
Align and integrate PR efforts with companywide goals and cohesive storytelling, integrating cross-functional resources (marketing, sales, etc.).
Measure performance using data-driven metrics — share of voice, sentiment, impressions, message pull-through, and increasingly, AI citation/visibility tracking — to optimize results and demonstrate impact.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Communications, or related field, required.
3+ years of PR experience, ideally in consumer electronics or technology, leading successful media relations and product launch programs.
Exceptional storytelling and messaging skills, with the ability to engineer compelling narratives that clearly differentiate TP-Link’s technology in the market.
Strong existing network and media intelligence to proactively secure high-quality coverage with Tier-1 to Tier-3 outlets across consumer tech and business press.
Proven success driving product launches and thought-leadership initiatives that elevate brand awareness and credibility.
Skilled in PR analytics and performance measurement, including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment, message pull-through, and business outcomes, with the ability to optimize campaigns based on data.
Creative, proactive mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the agility to respond quickly in fast-moving situations.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Benefits
Salary Range: $100,000 - $130,000
Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
Contributions to 401k funds
15 days accrued vacation
11 paid holidays
Bi-annual pay increases
Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
Quarterly team-building events
At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.
Please, no third-party agency inquiries. We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorships.

About ICBD
ICBD is a robust single-family office focused on private investment and business development, supporting exceptional companies in healthcare, technology, and beyond.
We own and operate a growing portfolio of high-performance businesses united by a shared commitment to people, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. But we’re not just building businesses – we’re building a legacy of leadership, innovation, and purpose.
Joining ICBD means you’ll be part of the team behind some of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare, technology, and business services. We are proudly self-funded, committed to sustainable growth, and led by visionary thought leaders—including our CEO and Founder, the 2024 Ernst & Young U.S. Entrepreneur of The Year® National Overall Award winner.
Our most visible success is ABA Centers, a revolutionary leader in autism care and diagnostics, ranked #5 on the 2024 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.
The ICBD portfolio includes these dynamic organizations united by strategic vision, operational expertise, and unwavering commitment to excellence:
ABA Centers
– The leading provider of autism care in the U.S., with 13 regional brands and 70+ operating areas.
GateHouse Treatment
– A comprehensive network of substance use disorder programs that address the full spectrum of recovery needs from medical treatment to supportive housing and respite services.
Marquis MD
– A concierge medicine concept redefining healthcare by prioritizing convenience, connection, and care powered by advanced technology.
Exact Billing Solutions
– Innovative revenue cycle management and advanced billing support systems for healthcare providers.
The Christopher M. Barnett Family Foundation
– The philanthropic heart of ICBD, advancing programs that address autism care, food insecurity, homelessness, women’s empowerment, and underserved children.
Recognition & Awards
At ICBD, our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned us recognition across industries. Our portfolio companies and leadership team have been honored with multiple awards, including:
Inc. 5000 – 5th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America (2024).
Financial Times – #1 on “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies.”
EY Entrepreneur of The Year® U.S. Overall.
South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies.
Florida Trend Magazine’s 500 Most Influential Business Leaders.
Inc. Best in Business, Health Services
The Role
Overview
As VP, Head of Digital Marketing, you will lead all efforts in the digital space. In this highly visible leadership role, you will define and execute the enterprise digital growth strategy across all channels, driving measurable demand generation, brand visibility, and patient acquisition outcomes across a high growth portfolio of operating companies.
You will lead a high-performing, multi-discipline digital team and act as the strategic owner of performance marketing, digital experience, marketing technology, and AI-enabled growth disciplines including emerging search and discovery ecosystems.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Strategy & Growth Leadership
Define and lead the enterprise-wide digital marketing strategy aligned to customer acquisition, brand growth, and revenue objectives.
Own the end-to-end digital funnel strategy, optimizing across awareness, acquisition, conversion, and retention using a “test and learn” approach with a focus on continuous improvement.
Translate business priorities into scalable, data-driven digital campaigns that deliver measurable performance outcomes.
Be accountable for ROI of all digital marketing efforts, tracking metrics on all campaigns.
AI, GEO & Next-Generation Search Leadership
Lead strategy for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to ensure strong brand visibility across AI-driven answer engines, generative search platforms, and large language model ecosystems.
Drive AI Search (AEO) initiatives to strengthen discoverability across evolving search behaviors and conversational interfaces.
Establish frameworks to optimize content, structured data, and digital assets for both traditional search engines and generative AI discovery systems.
Evaluate and implement AI-powered marketing technologies that enhance targeting, personalization, content generation, and performance.
Stay ahead of emerging trends in generative AI, multimodal search, and AI-mediated consumer journeys.
Performance Marketing & Channel Ownership
Oversee all digital performance channels including SEO, SEM, PPC, paid social, email automation, and CRM-driven lifecycle marketing.
Drive continuous optimization to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.
Ensure consistent execution across enterprise, multi-location, and clinic-level marketing initiatives.
Analytics, Measurement & Optimization
Own digital marketing measurement frameworks, attribution modeling, and ROI reporting across all channels.
Build and institutionalize a culture of experimentation, A/B testing, and rapid optimization.
Deliver actionable insights into the full digital patient journey, from first touch through conversion and retention.
Budget & Resource Management
Develop, manage, and optimize digital marketing budgets across enterprise, regional, and clinic-level allocations.
Allocate investment based on performance data, scalability, and strategic growth priorities.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing digital marketing organization across multiple disciplines, including the areas of SEO, SEM, email automation, PPC, and social media.
Partner closely with clinical operations, sales, analytics, and executive leadership to align marketing strategy with organizational goals.
Influence senior stakeholders through clear, data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.
Requirements
Qualifications, Personal Attributes & Education
Education:
This role requires a minimum of a BS/BA in Marketing, Business Administration or relevant field.
Experience:
10 + years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing.
Proven success driving measurable growth in complex, multi-location or multi-brand environments through highly sophisticated digital marketing strategies.
Technical & Functional Expertise:
Deep expertise in performance marketing including SEO, SEM, PPC, paid social, and lifecycle or email marketing.
Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar.
Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools, automation platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
Deep understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), including how content is surfaced, ranked, and synthesized by AI-driven search and answer engines.
Strong knowledge of AI Search (AEO), modern SEO, and evolving discovery ecosystems.
Advanced data analytical skills with expertise in attribution modeling, performance tracking, and ROI optimization
Personal Attributes:
Highly responsive, execution-oriented leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and rapid change.
Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing marketing teams.
Must be confident and decisive but be a good listener and be highly flexible/adaptable.
Willingness to travel nationwide (10-15%) to support marketing initiatives, events, and strategic partnerships.
Location, Travel and Role Expectations
This is a full-time position based in ICBD’s corporate offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL with ability to travel as needed; possibly for extended periods of time.
Compliance with all applicable laws, professional responsibility obligations, and Company policies.
Benefits
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
21 paid days off (15 days of PTO, which increases with tenure, plus 6 holidays).
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance.
Generous 401(k) with up to 6% employer match.
Closing Statement
ICBD is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to building an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
ICBD participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

AutoLeap's Marketing Services (DMS) team runs PPC (Google Ads, Bing Ads, LSA etc.), SEO, Content, Social, Website programs for hundreds of auto repair shop clients. We're hiring a Marketing Manager to own technical delivery across the PPC and SEO teams, leading both disciplines day-to-day and building a team environment based on accountability. This is a hands-on leadership role covering both people management and delivery outcomes across a large, growing portfolio of accounts.
About AutoLeap
AutoLeap is the market-leading shop management SaaS provider in the underserved auto repair industry. The Shop Management System (SMS) provides an all-in-one, cloud-based auto repair management software that helps after-market auto shop owners focused on general repair to better understand, manage, and grow their business—from scheduling appointments to managing technicians and generating invoices to help save time and money.
In 2023, we announced our $30m Series B led by Advanced Venture Partners (AVP) and aren’t slowing down. Our mission is to change the auto repair industry one shop at a time, helping shop owners get home to their families earlier and helping them build long-lasting healthy businesses to pass on to future generations. We will be the de facto choice for all shop owners looking to grow and improve their businesses with your help!
As a Technical Marketing Manager you will own the:
Team:
manage the PPC Team and SEO Team day-to-day workload, performance, goals and be accountable for outcomes across a large portfolio of client accounts.
Cadence:
run regular 1:1s, weekly team check-ins, and client facing touchpoints so every account gets consistent attention.
Process/Automation:
continuously look for ways to reduce manual work through better workflows, reporting, and automation, including the use of AI tools
Cross-functional Coordination
: work alongside the Onboarding, Web and Social Team on shared accounts and client needs.
Reporting:
keep team performance and account health tracked and reported on a regular cadence.
To be successful in this role, you will need:
5+ years of hands-on, working experience in both PPC and SEO, someone who can go deep on either side.
2+ years leading or managing a team, ideally in an agency, in-house local marketing services, or multi-account environment.
To be Comfortable working with call tracking tools, local SEO management platforms (e.g. BrightLocal), and PPC management tools.
To be Comfortable using AI tools as part of the regular workflow for reporting, content, or process efficiency.
To be Someone who instinctively looks to systemize and automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.
To be someone with local services ads, small businesses, or SaaS marketing experience.
To Have a Positive, can-do attitude and brings energy to the table.
To have Collaborative mindset: works well across PPC, SEO, onboarding, and web, not just within your own lane.
To be Hands-on with strong attention to detail, comfortable in the weeds when it matters.
Growth-at-all-cost focus: always looking for the next lever to pull for clients and for the team, never settling for “good enough.”
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience building and managing a team from the ground up.
Location/Time Zone: Candidates must be able to consistently work within Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.
What Success in this role looks like:
Growth in the number of accounts managed, high client satisfaction, and improved retention.
Reporting and account management increasingly automated, less time on manual work, more time on strategy and clients.
A regular meeting and check-in cadence running across the team, with strong client relationships as a result.

Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that handles e-commerce operations for brands across major retail channels. They specialize in catalog management, content, retail operations, and advertising on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and Target Plus. Their AI Agentic Commerce practice builds proprietary tooling for optimized performance.
About the Company
The company manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work.
Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance.
The Role
Advertising Analysts run the accounts. This is the seat where the work actually happens.
Analysts own the day-to-day management of advertising for a set of client brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and Target Plus — building campaigns, managing bids and budgets, adjusting targeting, watching pacing, and finding the changes that move performance. Their manager sets the strategy and the media plan; they make it real in the platform, and they are the first person to know when something isn't working.
This is an individual contributor role, but it isn't a heads-down one. Analysts work directly with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness — inventory, catalog, promotions, detail page quality — and with the Design Team on creative for Sponsored Brands, video, and display. Advertising in these channels doesn't perform in isolation, and analysts who understand that make better recommendations than analysts who only look at ad reports.
Analysts also do a meaningful amount of thinking, not just executing. They run account audits, dig into search term and placement data to find waste and opportunity, build the analysis behind quarterly and annual business reviews, and prepare the decks their manager presents to client leadership. Where they see a better answer than the plan calls for, the company wants to hear it.
The company expects analysts to use AI in their work. The team uses AI for report analysis, bulk file preparation, keyword and search term work, audit drafting, and internal tooling. They don't need to be an engineer, but they should be comfortable working with AI tools and interested in using them to get through the mechanical parts of the job faster so they can spend more time on the parts that require judgment.
This role is a path to account and strategy ownership. The analysts who do it well are the people the company promotes.
What You'll Own
Campaign management and optimization:
Build, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP campaigns, plus their Walmart Connect and Target Roundel equivalents. Manage bids, budgets, negatives, placement modifiers, and dayparting against agreed targets. Keep pacing on plan and flag risk before it becomes a shortfall.
Keyword, targeting, and audience work:
Research and build keyword and product targeting sets, mine search term reports for new opportunity and wasted spend, and maintain clean negative structures. Support audience building and testing in DSP.
Analysis:
Pull and interrogate the data yourself — search term, placement, product-level, and business reports — and turn it into a recommendation rather than a summary. Understand why a number moved, not just that it did.
Account audits:
Perform structured audits on new and existing accounts: campaign architecture, targeting overlap, budget allocation, wasted spend, missed placements, and gaps between what the account is doing and what the strategy calls for. Write up findings clearly enough that someone else can act on them.
Client reporting and business reviews:
Build the reporting that keeps clients informed, and prepare the analysis and decks for quarterly and annual business reviews. Your work goes in front of client leadership, so it needs to be accurate, clear, and defensible.
AI-assisted workflows:
Use AI tools to speed up analysis, bulk file work, keyword processing, and documentation. Contribute to improving how the team works rather than just following the process you were handed.
Collaboration:
Partner with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and the Design Team on creative. Raise the constraints — inventory, catalog, pricing, page quality — that advertising can't fix on its own.
What You Bring
Required
2+ years hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns
Amazon Ads certification in Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP (both required; verified)
Experience with Amazon DSP campaign management, not just Sponsored Ads
Genuinely analytical: comfortable in large data sets, can build your own analysis in Excel or Sheets, and check your own math
Intellectual curiosity: want to know why something happened, and keep pulling the thread after the immediate question is answered
Strong written and verbal communication: can explain a performance change in plain language and write findings a client can read
Proficiency working with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows
Detail discipline: bulk uploads, naming conventions, and negatives done right the first time
Preferred
Walmart Sponsored Ads and Walmart DSP certification
Meta and TikTok ads experience, with certifications
Target Roundel experience
SQL, Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, or Amazon Marketing Cloud exposure
Agency or multi-brand experience across categories
Advanced Excel; Python or scripting a plus
Familiarity with retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions
Who Does Well Here
The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The analysts who do well here treat a bad week as something to diagnose rather than defend, and would rather find the problem themselves than be told about it.
The company also looks for ownership (escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (would rather be corrected than confidently wrong), care about accuracy, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it.
What Success Looks Like
30 days:
Managing daily optimizations on your accounts with light supervision, and you know each brand's structure, targets, and constraints.
90 days:
Running your accounts independently, delivering audits and reporting your manager doesn't have to rewrite, and surfacing recommendations rather than waiting for direction.
12 months:
Your accounts show measurable improvement you can explain, you're trusted in front of clients, and you've improved at least one thing about how the team works.
How to Stand Out
Come ready to walk through one account you improved — what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

Create sales enablement collateral, including playbooks, demo scripts, one-pagers, pitch decks, and objection-handling assets.

Proven B2B product marketing experience within software, ideally EHSQ, compliance, risk, or operational SaaS.
Demonstrated ownership of full go-to-market strategy, from planning through execution.
Strong command of product positioning, messaging frameworks, and category development.
Experience collaborating with Product, R&D, UX, and technical teams.
Hands-on experience developing sales enablement, technical collateral, and product demos.
Experience launching new products, modules, or brands.
Strong analytical, communication, and storytelling skills for both technical and commercial audiences.
Ability to operate across multiple products and business units simultaneously.

Experience with EHSQ, compliance, risk, operations, or regulatory software.
Background working with environmental, safety, or quality management workflows.
Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and working knowledge of Figma.
Hands-on use of AI tools for content creation, research, and workflow automation.
Experience producing demo videos, product walkthroughs, and technical explainers.
Solid understanding of marketing analytics and product performance metrics.
Strong aptitude for quickly learning new enterprise applications and technical environments.

Competitive salary aligned to experience and market.
Employee profit sharing plan.
Fully remote.
Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance.
High ownership and autonomy across product marketing initiatives.
Opportunity to work directly with leadership in a fast-paced environment.
Fast-growing environment with strong long-term career development potential.

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to gifted people, regardless of location.
About the Client
Our client is a modern packaged food and functional wellness brand built around the belief that great food should support both wellness and enjoyment. The company is committed to creating products with thoughtful ingredients and a strong attention to detail, while bringing a sense of wonder and adventure to the everyday food experience.
Its mission is to help customers thrive in the present by providing wellness, great taste, and inspiration. Our client flagship products are soft, dessert-inspired protein bars made with grass-fed bovine collagen peptides, combining functional nutrition with indulgent flavors.
About the Role
We’re looking for a technically strong, hands-on E-commerce Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of a growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) business.
In this role, you’ll coordinate internal team members and external agencies across paid acquisition, retention marketing, and website operations, ensuring that projects are executed correctly, systems are working as expected, and nothing falls through the cracks.
This is not a traditional project management or high-level strategy role. We need someone who understands how e-commerce platforms and marketing channels work in practice, can confidently navigate tools like Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, and Klaviyo, and knows how to identify and troubleshoot issues when something goes wrong.
You won't necessarily be responsible for executing every marketing initiative yourself, but you'll need enough hands-on experience to evaluate the quality of execution, understand performance data, hold partners accountable, and occasionally step in to resolve operational issues.
You'll work directly with the business owner in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and keeping a growing e-commerce operation running smoothly.
Responsibilities
Coordinate internal team members and external agencies across paid acquisition, retention marketing, and website management, ensuring priorities are clear and deliverables are completed on time.
Monitor Meta and Google Ads execution, review campaign activity and performance data, and ensure agencies are implementing campaigns correctly.
Oversee email and SMS marketing operations through platforms such as Klaviyo, checking campaign schedules, flows, launches, and performance.
Regularly review the Shopify storefront to identify issues, verify updates, and ensure website changes and initiatives are implemented correctly.
Investigate problems such as missed email sends, campaign setup errors, platform access issues, or website operational issues, resolving them directly when appropriate or coordinating with the responsible team.
Gather and interpret data across acquisition, retention, and website operations to provide visibility into performance, identify issues, and support informed business decisions.
Follow up on deliverables, identify execution gaps, communicate expectations, and ensure outstanding tasks are resolved rather than simply reported.
Keep initiatives moving across multiple channels, coordinate dependencies, and ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into progress and priorities.
Identify operational inefficiencies, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve processes, execution quality, and overall e-commerce performance.
Requirements
3+ years of relevant experience in e-commerce operations, DTC marketing, e-commerce project management, or a similar hands-on role.
Experience working with a direct-to-consumer (DTC) or e-commerce brand, or at an agency supporting e-commerce businesses.
Practical familiarity with Shopify, including navigating the platform, reviewing storefront changes, and troubleshooting basic operational issues.
Experience with Meta Ads Manager and a working understanding of paid acquisition campaign setup, execution, and performance monitoring.
Familiarity with Klaviyo or similar email and SMS marketing platforms, including campaign scheduling, launches, and basic troubleshooting.
Exposure to Google Ads and an understanding of how paid acquisition fits into the broader e-commerce operation.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to navigate dashboards, interpret performance data, identify inconsistencies, and communicate findings clearly.
Proven project and stakeholder management skills, including coordinating agencies, following up on deliverables, and ensuring accountability across teams.
A hands-on, solutions-oriented mindset. You're comfortable getting into the details, investigating problems, and taking action rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate directly with U.S.-based leadership and external partners.
Comfortable with occasional urgent requests outside standard working hours when business-critical issues arise. These situations are not constant, but flexibility and responsiveness are important.

Who We Are
Akkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies. Our platform currently reduces manual work by up to 90% and costs by as much as 50%, while improving accuracy and governance across leading Unified Communications platforms.
This ability to innovate at scale defines who we are: big enough to compete at the highest level, yet agile enough to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving market. Our culture is people-first, fully remote, and rooted in grit, clarity, trust and respect, because when our people thrive, so do our customers.
Who You Are
You thrive in complex B2B environments, driving demand through Account-Based Marketing - direct enterprise channels and, through partner ecosystems including authorized resellers, service providers, and integration partners.  You understand how to build scalable partner-led programs, co-marketing motions, and joint pipeline engines that create predictable demand.
You bring rigor to how pipeline gets built, working backward from the ARR target to determine how much qualified pipeline needs to be in motion at any given time, and you hold yourself accountable to that math. You dig into account and funnel data regularly, not just to report on it, but to catch where deals are stalling and bring sales clear, specific recommendations on what to do next. You care as much about clean, standardized data (HubSpot lifecycle stages, attribution, partner association) as you do about the campaigns themselves, because you know unreliable data undermines every decision built on top of it. Equal parts analyst and operator, you turn every dollar of spend into measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer impact.
Core Responsibilities
Marketing & Campaign Management
Build, manage, and continuously refine orchestrated, account-based and partner-based campaign sequencing, integrated end-to-end (email, LinkedIn, partner, events, sales follow-up), that proves out the account-based, partner-led model and establishes a repeatable template for future campaigns.
Lead multi-channel demand generation marketing (SEM, paid social, programmatic, retargeting, affiliates) to drive leads, pipeline, and revenue.
Ensure we are focused on the right accounts, and the right people in them.
Maintain and update ICP inclusion/exclusion criteria; continuously rescore and prioritize Tier 1–3 accounts to concentrate high-touch effort on a manageable, well-defined set.
Maintain and continually update buying committee maps across target accounts (economic, technical, operational, security, procurement, and champion roles), ensuring key contacts across those roles are identified and actively engaged for all Tier 1–2 accounts.
Own the account-level funnel (ICP → Target → Engaged → MQA → SAA → Qualified Opportunity → Pipeline → Closed-Won) as the core measurement framework for demand generation performance.
Continuously analyze account and funnel data to identify where accounts are stalling or losing momentum, and proactively bring findings and recommended next actions to sales to keep opportunities moving.
Activate partners as a primary route to market, not a channel.
Establish partner prioritization criteria based on ICP alignment, account access, and willingness to execute; maintain a ranked view of highest-value partners.
Maintain and continually update the mapping of priority partners to target accounts, determining, account by account, whether activity is Akkadian-led, partner-led, or joint.
Track and report partner-sourced versus partner-influenced pipeline as a standing metric, distinct from general partner activity.
Develop and execute partner-led demand generation programs with authorized resellers and integration partners, including co-marketing campaigns, MDF utilization, webinars, and joint events.
Build scalable partner enablement and activation workflows, including partner-specific messaging, playbooks, landing pages, nurture streams, and analytics dashboards to measure partner pipeline contribution.
Backsolve pipeline from the ARR target and make it measurable.
Standardize HubSpot data structure and attribution, including lifecycle stage, source, persona, tier, and partner association, distinguishing sourced from influenced contribution; collaborate with Sales on UTM hygiene and offline conversion tracking.

This is a builder’s role for someone who wants to stay close to the craft while shaping the systems behind it, and it is scoped to grow with its results.

A clear map of our lifecycle: the product messaging, stages, seasonal moments, partnerships, and top events, performers, and categories that should drive what we send.
An audited, streamlined journey architecture, with underperforming or overlapping messaging optimized or retired.
A CRM segmentation model built with the data team, with standardized company-wide definitions (new, repeat, lapsed, dormant, super-dormant, reactivated) and live reporting on cohort size, value, and migration.
A standing test-and-learn agenda producing measurable lifts in revenue and retention.
Responsibilities
Strategy and journeys
Own lifecycle strategy and execution across email, SMS, and push, from planning through optimization.
Build always-on journeys spanning onboarding, conversion, cross-sell, retention, reactivation, and win-back.
Design, present, and ship new campaigns and ad hoc sends that grow sales while protecting customer trust.
Optimize cadence, offers, and incentive strategy to lift engagement without driving fatigue or unsubscribes.
Segmentation and personalization
Partner with the data team to define and maintain segments and lifecycle stages, with live reporting on cohort size, value, and movement between stages.
Drive behavior-based, triggered, and dynamic messaging from first-party data, starting with the highest-volume audiences and working toward the niche.
Platform, deliverability, and data
Serve as the in-house owner of the ESP and CRM stack, from configuration and integrations through the data flows that feed it.
Protect deliverability and sender reputation, and partner with Product on consent and compliance across email and SMS.
AI and automation
Build or co-build tooling that automates journey auditing, segment refresh, content variation, and reporting.
Help shape, test, and iterate the automation roadmap as new capabilities become available.
Measurement and reporting
Own lifecycle reporting and forecasting, tying the program to revenue and lifetime value and contributing to planning.
Contribute to channel measurement strategy with a focus on incrementality.
Present performance quarterly and speak to progress and data weekly.
Requirements
5 to 8 years in CRM, lifecycle, retention, or database marketing, with your tactical depth intact, whether you rose quickly and stayed close to the craft or are a more senior operator returning to hands-on work.
Tactical mastery of email, SMS, and push execution, segmentation, and journey building. You get the most out of the tooling yourself.
Demonstrated use of AI at a software level. You have built or co-built tools, with a technical partner, a software kit, or on your own, that turn best practices into automated auditing, optimization, and reporting. This is beyond prompting in a chat interface.
Strong analytical skills, comfortable with cohort and LTV analysis and turning data into action.
A self-directed operator who can carry a function forward with data and engineering support.
Preferred qualifications
Hands-on experience with an ESP or CRM platform (Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo, or similar) and with deliverability and consent compliance.
Experience with predictive modeling and segmentation in partnership with a data team.
A track record of scaling program output faster than team size.
Sports, entertainment, and/or two-sided marketplace experience.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or the sciences.
Benefits

FMX is looking for a strategic, execution-minded
Director of Product Marketing
to lead our product marketing function and serve as the connective tissue across product, engineering, sales, and demand generation. In this role, you'll set the vision for how FMX communicates complex platform value to the market while managing and developing a team of product marketing managers. You'll partner with leaders across the go-to-market and product organizations to make sure positioning, technical feature launches, and enablement translate directly into pipeline and revenue.
Responsibilities:
As the Director of Product Marketing, you will:
Own the strategic direction for product marketing, establishing product positioning, technical messaging, and launch frameworks that align product, sales, and marketing around one go-to-market motion.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product marketing managers, building a technical PMM function that scales alongside FMX's platform roadmap and growth goals.
Serve as the primary connector between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation, ensuring GTM plans have clear ownership, timelines, and shared accountability across teams.
Lead market research into FMX’s target segments to define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), build technical buyer personas (including facilities, operations, and IT leaders), perform Total Addressable Market (TAM) analysis, and provide targeting guidance for our GTM teams.
Set the standard for how FMX plans and executes go-to-market launches for core platform capabilities and integrations, from early positioning through post-launch product adoption and retention.
Direct ongoing competitive analysis, feature benchmarking, and market research to sharpen FMX's technical differentiation and inform product and sales strategy at the leadership level.
Ensure the sales organization has the technical messaging, collateral (like feature deep-dives, architecture overviews, and battlecards), and training needed to sell confidently, and measure enablement's impact on win rates and deal velocity.
Represent product marketing in leadership conversations, translating technical product insights, user feedback, and market dynamics into clear, confident recommendations for the executive team.
Define and report on KPIs that connect product marketing activity to feature usage, pipeline, revenue, and retention outcomes.
Requirements
Preferred Experience & Qualities:
10+ years in product marketing, including 5+ years leading or managing a product marketing team, preferably in B2B SaaS handling complex software or technical platforms.
Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities, architecture, and integrations into clear value propositions for both business decision-makers and technical buyers (e.g., IT, operations).
Familiarity with facilities management, education, or government is a plus.
A confident, assertive communicator who can influence senior stakeholders and represent product marketing at the leadership table and with strategic prospects and customers.
A track record of moving quickly from strategy to execution and driving urgency across cross-functional teams.

Company Description
Our client is a global organization operating within the financial services and trading industry, providing individuals with access to a wide range of financial markets, including equities, commodities, and foreign exchange.
With over two decades of experience, the company has built a strong international presence, serving a diverse customer base across multiple regions. It operates through a portfolio of established brands and continues to expand its global footprint.
The organization focuses on delivering user-friendly platforms, efficient services, and reliable support to help clients navigate financial markets. With offices across key international hubs, it offers a dynamic and multicultural working environment with opportunities for professional growth.
About the Role
Our client is seeking a data-driven and strategic
Senior Manager, Customer Value
to relentlessly focus on maximizing trading activity, portfolio diversification, and loyalty tier progression. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Product, CRM, and Trading functions to commercialize loyalty programs and drive sustainable revenue diversification. You will lead global campaigns that consistently deliver high-profit margins while leveraging behavioral data to unlock exponential growth.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Value Strategy & Ownership
Own the customer value Key Results (KRs), specifically focusing on increasing trading activity, portfolio diversification, and upward loyalty tier migration.
Define and deliver comprehensive customer value strategies to move users from the bottom of the funnel through to high-value tiers.
Develop and implement an overarching revenue diversification strategy and workflow in alignment with regional owners and key stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Lead cross-functional alignment on goals, plans, and workflows, ensuring seamless collaboration between regional managers, Trading, Proposition, Product, CRM, and Client-Facing teams.
Drive adoption of crypto funding mechanisms across the global client base.
Revenue Diversification
Drive global revenue diversification strategies for key trading products (FX majors, indices, cryptocurrencies, etc.), partnering with Brand, Acquisition, Product, and Client-Facing teams to accelerate adoption.
Increase trading revenue while reducing concentration risk through active cross-selling.
Collaborate with the Data and CRM teams to build automated cross-selling journeys that improve efficiency and scalability.
Planning & Commercialization
Create monthly and quarterly customer value plans and roadmaps aligned with regional business objectives.
Develop and implement marketing plans to maximize loyalty program commercialization through close cross-functional collaboration.
Build and test value toolkits tailored to different customer segments.
Campaign & Growth Leadership
Lead end-to-end global campaign strategy, roadmap, and execution, coordinating across Trading, Product, Brand, Acquisition, and Client-Facing teams.
Scale high-impact initiatives such as digital trading contests and instrument-specific promotional campaigns to drive both short- and long-term revenue growth.
Monitor and manage promotional costs to consistently deliver profit margins of 50% or higher.
Performance Reporting
Leverage reporting tools such as Power BI, Bloomberg, and Amplitude to identify trading trends and uncover growth opportunities.
Qualifications
7+ years of experience in Customer Value Management, preferably within brokerage or financial services.
Strong expertise in behavioral analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude), business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI), and financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg).
Proven ability to identify opportunities and solve business challenges using data.
Deep experience managing customer value initiatives, including loyalty program strategy and operations.
Demonstrated success leading global campaigns with high cost efficiency and measurable business impact.
Solid understanding of financial trading instruments, including FX, metals, indices, cryptocurrencies, commodities, and current market trends.
Ability to own Key Results (KRs) end-to-end, from strategic planning through execution and operational delivery.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning Product, Trading, CRM, Client-Facing, and business teams toward shared objectives.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Growth in trading revenue, trading volume, and customer deposits.
Reduction in concentration risk through increased cross-selling adoption.
Customer tier progression and loyalty program uplift.
Adoption rate of crypto funding solutions.

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.
About the role
Come and join the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world, and run real spend on ecommerce accounts where search and shopping mastery decides who wins.
Our client is the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world. Led by their founder and CEO, Jem, they manage nine figures in annual ad spend across 180+ ecommerce DTC brands, powered by direct relationships with Google's product teams and access to alpha and beta features most agencies never touch. Their strategies are not public, their standards
are high, and their results do the talking.
They grow fast because the work is that good, and they keep the team senior and selective on purpose. Their average client stays with them well beyond a year, close to unheard of in this industry. Join them and you plug into a team operating at the top of the game, and a founder whose personal brand is becoming the loudest signal in performance marketing.
- This is a senior seat for a full stack Google buyer whose core is search and shopping, done at real scale, and who can prove it. You own accounts end to end and run them against real spend, where the numbers are the only thing that matters. Search and shopping are the heart of the role. Get those right and the rest follows.
- On the search side, you build a clean, profitable structure, you split brand from non-brand without being told, and you research top of funnel keywords that open a category before a buyer knows the brand, at the category level, the problem level, and the ingredient or mechanism level. You know which demand is worth paying for and which is not.
- On shopping, the feed is the account. That is the part most buyers get wrong, and it is where you are strongest. You live in DataFeedWatch, Channable, or Google Sheets, and you turn a raw product feed into a shopping and PMax engine: clean attributes, smart custom labels, supplemental feeds, and constant title and image testing at the feed level. You know a title test can move an account more than a bid change, and you run those tests as a discipline, not a one off.
- You are full stack, so YouTube and Demand Gen are part of the picture too, but we are happy to teach those if your search and shopping foundation is elite. And you are deep in the data throughout: Triple Whale and Northbeam are where you check your work, and you optimize to profit, not to whatever the Google interface wants to celebrate.
Responsibilities:
● Own Google Ads accounts end to end, with search and shopping as the priority
● Build and manage profitable search structure and the brand versus non brand split
● Research and structure top of funnel keywords that open new demand at the category, problem, and mechanism level
● Own the feed as part of the account: build and optimize attributes, custom labels, and supplemental feeds in DataFeedWatch, Channable, or Sheets
● Run continuous title and image testing at the feed level and turn the winners into scale
● Grow into YouTube and Demand Gen, scaling them deliberately as you go
● Scale winners and cut waste quickly against real spend
● Live in Triple Whale and Northbeam and let profit lead every decision
● Partner with the creative team so the right angles and formats get tested against the right traffic
● Keep clients informed with clear, honest reporting on what is working and why
Requirements
● Proven experience buying Google Ads for ecommerce at real scale, with a core in search and shopping and results you can point to in hard numbers
● Elite on search: account architecture, the brand versus non brand split, and top of funnel keyword research at the category, problem, and mechanism level
● Elite on shopping and feeds: hands on in DataFeedWatch, Channable, or Google Sheets, with real command of attributes, custom labels, and supplemental feeds
● Runs structured title and image testing at the feed level as a habit, and reads the results honestly
● Full stack across Google, comfortable owning whole accounts. YouTube and Demand Gen experience is a plus, but we will teach it if your search and shopping are strong.
● Deep in the data: Triple Whale, Northbeam, and the Google Ads interface, always optimizing to profit
● A genuine understanding of the whole Google Ads ecosystem, not just the buttons in one campaign type
● Ecommerce or DTC experience
Benefits
Fully remote. Work from anywhere, with flexible hours.
A seat inside a premium agency managing nine figures in ad spend, running accounts that move real budgets from day one.
A small, senior, global team with no bureaucracy and no busywork.
Direct access to the founder and to work that actually stretches you.
Weekly personal mentoring directly from the founder himself.
Paid time off.
A wellness bonus.
Team retreats and workations

Company and Vision
PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make-on-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end-to-end customer experience that result in high-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of life events.
The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading SimplytoImpress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit
www.planetart.com
to learn more about our brands.
We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe.
Job Overview
We're looking for a talented Sr. Acquisition Marketing Manager to join PlanetArt's marketing team, focused on driving customer acquisition across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google, and other paid social and offline channels. In this role, you'll be responsible for executing user acquisition strategies across both paid and organic efforts—scaling what works, optimizing relentlessly, and finding what's next.
This individual must be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, bringing strong project management skills and a sharp eye for detail. You'll thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and fluid environment where multitasking is the norm and adaptability is key. A "can-do" attitude and superb interpersonal skills—both verbal and written—are an absolute must.
PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be local to or willing to relocate to the Pleasanton area as we operate on a hybrid work model (3 days onsite, 2 remote)
Who You Are
Obsessed with testing and growth.
You continuously identify new products, offers, promotions, and growth opportunities to bring to market — moving quickly from idea to execution while maintaining a bias for action. You're never satisfied with the status quo.
Data-driven and commercially minded.
You evaluate opportunities through rigorous margin analysis, forecasting, and performance measurement to ensure profitable growth and scalable customer acquisition. Gut instinct is informed by numbers.
Expert in experimentation and AI.
You design, launch, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across offers, creative, pricing, and customer journeys—using insights and emerging AI tools to drive continuous improvement.
An entrepreneurial operator.
You combine creativity, analytical thinking, and executional excellence to build winning campaigns, uncover new revenue opportunities, and create value from scratch. You thrive in ambiguity, embrace creative problem-solving, take calculated risks, and build from the ground up.
What You'll Do
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning:
Own customer acquisition and retargeting strategies, explore new partner and channel opportunities, and manage budget allocation and forecasting.
Campaign Management:
Set up, manage, optimize, and report on campaign performance across paid social, search, and offline channels.
Performance Analysis:
Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, interpreting data to derive actionable insights that drive optimization and inform strategic decisions.
Measurement & Tracking:
Leverage Google Analytics, Tableau, and internal tools to ensure data accuracy and reliable flow-through between platforms and internal databases.
Cross-Device Journey Mapping:
Map user touchpoints across mobile, desktop, and other devices to inform holistic acquisition strategy.
Creative & Testing:
Partner with the Creative team to develop and iterate on ad creative, driving a rapid test-and-learn cycle at scale.
Requirements
What You Should Have
Skills, Qualifications & Requirements
6+ years of marketing experience with a proven track record of driving profitable customer acquisition at scale.
Deep hands-on experience executing and optimizing campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google, YouTube, CTV, and other paid channels.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable insights and strategic decisions.
Proficient in Excel, Google Analytics, Tableau, and familiar with AI-powered marketing tools (creative generation, bidding optimization, etc.).
Experience with SEO, ASO, and mobile measurement platforms a plus.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tight deadlines, especially during peak seasonal periods.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Bachelor's degree required; Business or Marketing preferred.
What You Can Expect
Working Conditions
Work is performed in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels.
Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.
Position requires regular, continuous use of a computer.
Position requires regular sitting and standing.
Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: in-person, phone, Zoom, Slack, or email.
May require occasional travel.
This is a hybrid position; employees are expected to be in the office three days per week (Monday, Tuesday
Benefits
The compensation range for this position is $110,000 - $128,000 annual salary.

Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Life Insurance
401(k) with matching
Pet Insurance
Mental Health Benefits
Comprehensive Time Off Program, including Vacation, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, and Floating Holidays

Deine Mission
Als Head of Marketing übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Marketingmaßnahmen, die unsere Marken stärken und ihre Sichtbarkeit nachhaltig steigern. Du verbindest kreatives Storytelling mit datengetriebenem Marketing und entwickelst wirkungsvolle Kampagnen über verschiedene digitale Kanäle hinweg.
Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf Brand Building, Social Media Marketing sowie der Entwicklung kreativer Inhalte für Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok und Facebook. Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Partnern sorgst du für eine konsistente Markenpräsenz und eine zielgerichtete Kundenansprache.
Deine Aufgaben
Marketingstrategie & Markenführung
·       Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien und Kampagnen zur Steigerung der Markenbekanntheit und Markenwahrnehmung.
·       Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung der Markenpositionierung sowie Sicherstellung eines konsistenten Markenauftritts über alle Kanäle hinweg.
·       Planung und Umsetzung integrierter Marketingkampagnen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Partnern.
·       Analyse von Markttrends, Zielgruppen und Wettbewerbern zur Identifikation neuer Potenziale und Marketingansätze.
Social Media & Content Marketing
·       Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kanalübergreifenden Social-Media-Strategie mit Schwerpunkt auf Instagram, TikTok und Facebook.
·       Planung, Erstellung und Optimierung von Content-Formaten zur Steigerung von Reichweite, Engagement und Markenbindung.
·       Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung einer aktiven Community über relevante Social-Media-Kanäle.
·       Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, Influencern, Content Creators und weiteren externen Partnern.
·       Beobachtung aktueller Trends und Entwicklung kreativer Ideen für innovative Marketingmaßnahmen.
Customer Insights & Performance
·       Durchführung von Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen zur Gewinnung relevanter Kundeninsights.
·       Analyse von Marketingdaten und Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen zur Optimierung von Kampagnen.
·       Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung personalisierter Marketingmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Customer Experience.
·       Definition und Überwachung relevanter KPIs zur Erfolgsmessung von Marketingaktivitäten.
·       Erstellung regelmäßiger Reports zur Bewertung der Marketingperformance.
Budget- & Stakeholder Management
·       Unterstützung bei der Planung und Verwaltung des Marketingbudgets.
·       Monitoring von Kampagnenergebnissen und Ableitung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen für zukünftige Aktivitäten.
·       Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern sowie externen Agenturen und Dienstleistern.
·       Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kommunikation und Abstimmung zwischen allen relevanten Ansprechpartnern.
Team & Zusammenarbeit
·       Fachliche Unterstützung und Koordination von Marketingprojekten.
·       Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Marketinginitiativen.
·       Förderung einer kreativen, lösungsorientierten und kollaborativen Arbeitsweise innerhalb des Teams.
Requirements
Dein Profil
·       Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
·       3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing, Brand Management, Social Media Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Position.
·       Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen.
·       Sehr gutes Verständnis für Markenaufbau, digitale Kommunikation und Content Marketing.
·       Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok und Facebook sowie deren aktuellen Trends und Best Practices.
·       Analytische Denkweise sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit KPIs und Marketingdaten.
·       Erste Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, Influencern oder externen Partnern von Vorteil.
·       Selbstständige, strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise.
·       Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.
·       Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
Das bringst du mit
·       Leidenschaft für Marken, Storytelling und digitale Kommunikation.
·       Kreativität gepaart mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität.
·       Gespür für Trends, Zielgruppen und kulturelle Entwicklungen im digitalen Umfeld.
·       Hohe Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungsstärke.
·       Freude daran, Ideen in erfolgreiche Marketingmaßnahmen zu verwandeln.
Benefits
Das erwartet dich
·       Ein dynamisches und kreatives Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
·       Die Möglichkeit, bekannte Marken und innovative Marketingprojekte aktiv mitzugestalten.
·       Zusammenarbeit mit motivierten Kolleg:innen und externen Partnern.
·       Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
·       Attraktive Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
·       Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Wien.
