About the Role:
Most marketing teams still measure output in campaigns shipped. We measure it in decisions our agents make autonomously, and we want to widen that gap. As VP, Marketing Operations & Agentic AI Systems, you will own the management of our martech stack and the strategy, architecture, and execution of the agentic layer that runs Sidetrade marketing: lead scoring, enrichment, prospection, campaign orchestration, and attribution. You will define what "production-ready" means for AI agents at Sidetrade, build and lead the team that ships them, and hold accountability for measurable business outcomes reported at board level.
This is a builder-leader role. You will set the vision and roll up your sleeves. You will not manage a function that runs on slide decks.
About Sidetrade:
Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a
Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader
since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.
Curious about Sidetrade?
Catch Aimie in motion
:
Aimie Video
Requirements
What You will do:
Define and own the multi-year roadmap for AI-powered marketing operations, aligned to revenue targets and approved at exec level.
Set the standard for what constitutes a production-grade agent at Sidetrade: Eevaluation suites, guardrails, observability, and retirement criteria.
Advise the CMO and CEO on emerging AI capabilities and their commercial implications for pipeline and revenue.
Lead delivery of Deliver production agents for lead scoring, enrichment, MQL handoff, prospection, and revenue attribution, co-owned with Sales, BDRs, and Demand Gen.
Replace at least five manual marketing workflows with production agents in the first 18 months, with documented time savings and quality parity or better.
Own prompt libraries, tool definitions, and evaluation suites that govern agent quality across the team.
Stand up and own the observability layer: cost per task, accuracy, drift, human escalation rate.
Report the performance of the agentic layer monthly to the exec team and quarterly to the board.
Quantify pipeline and revenue influenced by AI-driven workflows; defend the numbers.
Own and manage the Martech stack: Marketo, Salesforce, Salesloft, 6Sense, ZoomInfo, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, LetSignIt, Asana, Kinsta, GoToWebinar, Wistia, Google GTM, Search Console, Analytics, Ads, Zapier, Proofjump.
Cut the stack by at least 25% on cost or tool count in the first 18 months against measurable value.
Evaluate, onboard, and retire vendors. You hold final sign-off on Martech investment.
Provide enablement to marketing and sales users in collaboration with the department leaders
Hire, develop, and retain a team of marketing engineers and operations specialists.
Define roles, set standards, and create a culture of measurement and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to align shared infrastructure and tooling.
What You Will Bring:
12+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role owning technology and operations.
Proven track record shipping production AI-driven workflows or agents that real users and revenue processes depended on. Sandbox demos do not count.
Deep fluency with Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot, plus Salesforce. You have owned these platforms at scale.
Hands-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier: multi-step flows, error handling, API integrations without writing production code from scratch.
Expert-level command of LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent): prompt design, AI-in-workflow architecture, and clear judgment on reliability limits.
Able to scope work for engineering teams, spec clearly, and validate output. You read JSON and API docs fluently.
Track record of board-level reporting on marketing technology performance and ROI.
Strong communicator: you translate agentic complexity into commercial outcomes for exec and investor audiences.
Benefits
Competitive executive compensation package including base salary and performance incentives.
Hybrid work model: a flexible mix of in-office and remote days.
Health & wellness: medical coverage, life insurance, and wellness programs.
Generous paid leave plus public holidays.
Learning, mentorship, and career advancement support at exec level.
Active Social Club with regular team events across our international offices.

QRY 101
Hey there! We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands. We connect brand awareness and performance media to unlock growth, use sophisticated data analytics, and employ a full-funnel marketing strategy to help brands reach their most valuable consumers. We’re a high‑performance, high‑ownership team that values candor, curiosity, and results. We love what we do and the people we do it with.
We’re hiring a Paid Search Strategist to own search performance across a portfolio of clients. You’ll plan, launch, and optimize search and shopping programs (Google, Bing, YouTube, and other retail channels where relevant), keeping budgets/pacing tight and turning data into crisp decisions. You love the details, move with urgency, and explain complex ideas simply to teammates and clients.
If you have experience leading and managing search / SEM budgets for retail and ecommerce brands, this could be a perfect position.
Your day-to-day
Search Strategy:
You plan, book, and optimize paid search campaigns (i.e. Google AdWords, YouTube, Bing Ads, Amazon, etc) for 5-8 clients, utilizing available search planning tools to develop search plans.
You strategize and implement A/B experiments to test keywords, bid strategies, ad copy, landing pages, offers, etc
You advise on paid search strategies, rationales, and plans to meet client goals.
You keep current on the latest trends in search, social media, mobile marketing, tracking and tagging, behavioral marketing, retargeting & addressability.
With support from Associate Directors, you manage the channel's monthly reporting and strategy sessions with the client, owning overall communication for all channel initiatives.
Performance
:
You scope, develop, and manage channel initiatives to consistently hit the goals for channels across all clients.
You act as a strategic advisor and recommend strategic pivots to increase the channel's performance.
Reporting + Forecasting:
You enthusiastically present reports to clients, highlighting the performance of your channels, how they assisted other channels in the funnel, and how they affect the client's business, while recommending next steps.
You complete a monthly forecast for respective channels based on budget and/or revenue goals.
Cross Channel Strategy + Collaboration:
You collaborate with the other media and creative agency team members to ensure the creative specifications of negotiated plans are met.
You consistently identify cross-channel strategies / collaborations with clients to improve performance.
You effectively communicate with clients on teams' capabilities and opportunities, and proactively offer solutions for ad hoc issues.
How you win
Channel performance: You hit agreed KPI targets for your channels (e.g., MER/ROAS, CAC/LTV, revenue, efficiency) within budget and platform guardrails.
Learning velocity: You run a disciplined test program with documented hypotheses, win rate, rollout decisions, and measurable lift.
Forecast accuracy: You run accurate forecasts on a monthly basis and tie expectations to realistic assumptions.
Execution: You deliver decks, reports, and campaign launches with low error rates related to QA or data, and you ensure QRY quality is represented in every outcome.
What’s it like here
We’re a high‑performance culture with high support. We’re serious about setting clear goals, providing direct feedback, documenting our progress, and celebrating our wins. You’ll get real ownership, supportive teammates, and the tools to do excellent work.
Your first month: You’ll build trust with client and internal partners, learn each brand’s goals and constraints, and align on how success will be measured. You’ll review current channel setups and performance at a high level and agree on priorities and near‑term wins. By the end of the month, you’ll have a good understanding of our clients, their channel setups, and how our pods work.
After month one: You’ll own steady, predictable performance against plans and keep budgets and timelines on track. You’ll communicate often, surface risks early with options, and highlight opportunities for smart growth. The result is consistent delivery, fewer surprises, and clear momentum.
Requirements
✍️​ Experience: You have 2-5 years of successful hands-on paid search or SEM experience, ideally in an agency environment. You know the ins and outs of making things run smoothly and have applied successful tactics in a previous role.
📚 Education: Ideally, you have a bachelor's degree in marketing, science, or in a related field.
🔢 Analytical Mindset: You're an analytical thinker. You have experience turning complex data into digestible reports, seeing the big picture, and breaking it down into an actionable plan that gets results.
💬​ Communication: Your communication skills are top-notch and you can communicate with senior stakeholders effectively and efficiently.
⌚ Time Management: You're a master of time management. You know how to juggle multiple tasks effectively.
🚀​ Industry Passion: The e-commerce, advertising, and agency space excite you. You're genuinely interested in these fields and eager to make an impact within them.
🧠​ Creative Problem Solver: When challenges arise, you're ready to jump in and troubleshoot with creative solutions. You enjoy tackling problems head-on and finding innovative ways to overcome them.
💡​ Continuous Learner: You have a genuine passion for learning. You stay updated with the latest trends in digital advertising and marketing, always expanding your knowledge base.
🖥️​ Remote Work Environment: You understand the importance of a clean and quiet work environment suitable for video conferencing. You respect digital etiquette and ensure smooth virtual collaboration.
Benefits
🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 per year, based on experience.
💰 Quarterly bonuses. Enjoy quarterly bonuses tied to company revenue.
🏠 USA remote flexibility. Choose your ideal workspace, whether it’s your home office or a coffee shop.
🌴 Time off made easy. Take advantage of our unlimited PTO policy.
🏥 Comprehensive healthcare. We offer exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance, fully covered for employees by QRY. We also offer a $100 monthly budget for your wellbeing, i.e. gym memberships, coworking day pass, etc.
📈 Secure your future. Participate in our 401k program with a company match.
🌱 Growth and development. Nurture your learning and development with our investment to L&D, growth opportunities, and tools such as our Learning & Development Philosophy + Policy, role matrices, and skill assessments.
💻 Latest tech. Team members are provided with the latest Macbook Pro and a one-time $500 stipend to set up their at-home workspace.
🥳 Celebrate and connect. Join us for annual team retreats (we’ve been to Austin, Tennessee, and Utah to name a few), weekly Coffee Chats, and monthly Happy Hours to foster our vibrant culture.

Site CRO & Shopify

Coordinate with creative team to brief and deploy updated imagery, copy, and UGC across PDPs
TikTok Shop
Own PDP optimization on TikTok Shop titles, bullets, imagery, A+ content, category/attribute setup
Monitor TikTok Shop storefront performance and flag issues to the broader team
Coordinate with the content and affiliate team to ensure product pages are dialed in to support creator traffic
Stay current on TikTok Shop feature releases and surface relevant updates
Amazon
Assist with Amazon listing optimization titles, bullets, A+ content, backend keywords, imagery
Work alongside internal stakeholders and agency contacts to implement updates and maintain listing health
Flag suppressed listings, content issues, or policy flags and coordinate resolution
Email Marketing
Execute campaign sends end-to-end: build, QA, schedule, and deploy in Klaviyo
Partner with Director of Growth and retention agency on flow strategy — your role is hands-on implementation
Manage segmentation logic, list hygiene, and send cadence
Pull post-send reporting and surface performance insights
Tooling & Operations
Own the review platform — ensure review collection, moderation, and syndication are running
Leverage AI tools for copywriting, content optimization, and productivity
Maintain clean documentation across SOPs, app settings, and platform configurations
Support new channel or integration launches as the business scales

2 to 4 years in a DTC ecommerce role, you've lived inside Shopify and know it cold

Basic Amazon Seller Central familiarity listing updates, A+ content, suppression troubleshooting
Comfortable with the Shopify app ecosystem: you know what tools exist, how they talk to each other, and how to triage when something breaks
CRO mindset: you think about the customer journey, not just the task in front of you
Detail-oriented and execution-focused you ship, you follow up, you close the loop
Comfortable using AI tools to move faster (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, etc.)
Strong communicator who can work cross-functionally with creative, growth, and external partners

Experience at a beauty, wellness, or CPG DTC brand
Familiarity with affiliate or influencer-adjacent ecommerce (TikTok Shop affiliates, LTK, etc.)
Basic HTML/CSS for email template edits
Experience with tools like Elevar, Triple Whale, or similar attribution/analytics platforms
Comfort pulling and interpreting data in Google Sheets or Looker

$200K+ perk marketplace
with discounts on 150+ services.

Description
About Us:
Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.
We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.
Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.
About the role:
The Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Robot Vacuums, will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, and content execution for TP-Link’s robot vacuum portfolio within the Smart Home division. Reporting directly to the Director of Product Marketing – Smart Home, this role is a high-impact, category-focused position that requires an operator who can think like a brand builder and act like an owner.
The right candidate will bring deep knowledge of the robot vacuum category, a sharp instinct for what motivates consumers, and the creative ability to transform technical specifications into compelling, moments-based stories that drive purchase. TP-Link’s robot vacuums compete in one of the fastest-growing segments of the smart home market – this person will be the driving force behind how we position, message, and market our products, and a key contributor to taking market share from SharkNinja, Ecovac, Eufy, Roborock, Wyze, and Dreame.
A note on experience:
Prior hands-on product marketing experience in the robot vacuum or floor care category is highly desirable and candidates who have marketed robot vacuums – including knowledge of navigation technology, self-empty systems, mop/vac combos, and Matter compatibility – will be prioritized. Equally essential is the demonstrated ability to write world-class consumer copy: translating technical specs such as LiDAR navigation, suction Pa ratings, and auto-empty docks into emotionally resonant, moments-based language that speaks to real consumer life. We also place high value on idea generation – we want someone who brings differentiated campaign concepts, sharp naming instincts, and a creative point of view that helps TP-Link stand out in a crowded category.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Positioning, Naming, and Messaging
· Own the positioning and messaging architecture for TP-Link’s full robot vacuum portfolio – from entry-level models to premium self-empty and mop-combo systems.
· Develop moments-based copy that connects product capabilities to real consumer life situations: clean floors before guests arrive, mornings without chores, homes that clean themselves.
· Translate technical specifications – suction power, navigation precision, obstacle avoidance, dock auto-empty – into clear, differentiated consumer benefits that drive purchase intent.
· Build and maintain naming frameworks and messaging hierarchies consistent across retail, digital, social, and in-box materials.
· Partner with the Director of Product Marketing to align robot vacuum messaging with the broader Smart Home brand narrative and Tapo brand architecture.
Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution
· Lead GTM planning for all robot vacuum product launches – from feature brief to retail execution – in coordination with product management, sales, and creative teams.
· Build coordinated launch frameworks covering product messaging, creative direction, media strategy, retail assets, and Amazon listing optimization.
· Develop creative retail, web and packaging assets that will help differentiate our category in the robot vacuum market.
· Ensure all launch activities are data-driven, consumer-informed, and aligned with sales and channel objectives.
· Coordinate with retail partners including Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Costco, and Target on content, promotional windows, and sell-in materials.
Product Feature Prioritization and Content Creation
· Lead the creation of all robotic vacuum product content: web copy, product detail pages, Amazon A+ content, retail assets, setup videos, explainer videos, and social-ready creative.
· Brief and manage creative partners, agencies, and in-house teams to produce high-quality video and visual assets that bring the product to life.
· Ensure all content reflects the voice of the customer and clearly communicates differentiated value at every touchpoint – Amazon search, Google organic, retail shelf, and social.
· Generate original concepts for campaigns, hero moments, and product storytelling that differentiate TP-Link from SharkNinja, Ecovac, Eufy, Roborock, Wyze, and Dreame in the consumer’s mind.
· Collaborate with Product Management to influence feature prioritization based on consumer insights, market trends, and competitive research – particularly around AI navigation, smart home integration, and Matter compatibility.
Brand Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion
· Develop marketing strategies that elevate TP-Link’s presence in the robot vacuum market and strengthen consumer engagement across the full funnel.
· Execute awareness and conversion campaigns across digital, paid, retail, and social channels.
· Leverage analytics and consumer data to optimize the customer journey and maximize conversion rates.
· Create and manage programs that deepen customer engagement throughout the product lifecycle, including Tapo Care subscription acquisition and retention.
Competitive Intelligence and Consumer Insights
· Maintain a deep, current understanding of the robot vacuum competitive landscape: pricing tiers, product roadmaps, messaging strategies, and market share trends.
· Track consumer sentiment, product reviews, and community feedback to identify messaging gaps, product pain points, and differentiation opportunities.

Français
Responsable marketing produit
Première embauche marketing de Fulltime
À propos de Fulltime AI
Fulltime transforme la façon dont les entrepreneurs des métiers et des services à domicile répondent à leurs clients grâce à la technologie vocale alimentée par l’IA. Nos agents vocaux aident les entreprises de chauffage, de plomberie et d’électricité à répondre aux appels 24/7, à réserver plus d’interventions et à offrir un service plus rapide. Les propriétaires récupèrent du temps pour se consacrer à leur entreprise. Fulltime connaît une forte croissance en Amérique du Nord et le marché répond très bien à son produit.
À propos du poste
Nous recherchons un(e) responsable marketing produit qui sera notre première embauche en marketing et dirigera l’ensemble de nos efforts marketing, avec le marketing produit au cœur du rôle.
Vos premières priorités seront de préciser notre positionnement à partir des échanges avec les clients, de transformer les preuves clients en outils pour les ventes, d’améliorer le site Web et de tester quelques pistes ciblées de génération de la demande. Vous travaillerez étroitement avec les fondateurs et les équipes produit et ventes. C’est un rôle concret où vous devrez définir les priorités et faire avancer le travail vous-même.
Ce que vous ferez
Comprendre nos clients cibles et transformer les échanges avec les clients et les équipes de vente en positionnement, propositions de valeur et messages clairs
Créer des outils qui aident l’équipe de vente à expliquer la valeur du produit, dont des témoignages clients, des études de cas et des présentations fondés sur des résultats vérifiés
Prendre en charge le site Web, notamment sa stratégie, son contenu, ses parcours de conversion et son amélioration continue
Planifier et lancer les nouveaux produits et fonctionnalités avec les équipes produit, ventes et succès client
Choisir avec les fondateurs et l’équipe de vente un ou deux canaux de génération de la demande à tester, mener les expériences et mesurer leurs résultats
Transmettre les commentaires des clients et les informations concurrentielles aux équipes produit et de direction
Suivre les résultats, notamment la qualité des occasions générées et leur conversion, puis développer progressivement les approches qui fonctionnent
Ce que vous apportez
Au moins 4 ans d’expérience en marketing produit ou dans un rôle marketing polyvalent en startup
De l’expérience dans la création de positionnements, de contenus et d’outils de vente à partir de zéro
De solides compétences en rédaction et en communication, et la capacité de présenter clairement la valeur d’un produit d’IA aux propriétaires d’entreprise
Une approche pratique et autonome, et la capacité de travailler dans un environnement qui évolue rapidement
Une aisance avec les données pour établir les priorités, tester des idées et améliorer les résultats
Un intérêt pour l’IA et pour l’amélioration des activités des entreprises de services
Une expérience dans les métiers spécialisés, les services à domicile ou le SaaS vertical constitue un atout important
Une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
Pourquoi joindre Fulltime AI?
Contribuer à la croissance d’une entreprise d’IA qui sert les entrepreneurs des métiers
Diriger le marketing produit et contribuer directement à la croissance de l’entreprise
Travailler étroitement avec les fondateurs et l’équipe produit
Aider les petites entreprises à gagner du temps, à réserver plus d’interventions et à mieux servir leurs clients
Prêt(e) à bâtir avec nous?
Envoyez votre CV et une courte note expliquant ce qui vous intéresse dans ce rôle et ce que vous pourriez apporter à Fulltime.
English
Founding Product Marketing Lead
Fulltime’s first marketing hire
About Fulltime AI
Fulltime is changing how trade and service contractors handle customer calls through AI voice technology. Our voice agents help HVAC, plumbing, and electrical businesses answer calls 24/7, capture more booked jobs, and respond faster, giving owners more time to run their businesses. We are growing quickly across North America, with strong customer response to the product.
About the Role
We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to join as our first marketing hire and lead Fulltime’s marketing, with product marketing at the center of the role.
Your first priorities will be to sharpen our positioning through customer conversations, turn customer proof into useful sales tools, improve our website, and test a small number of focused demand generation opportunities. You will work closely with the founders and our product and sales teams. This is a hands on role where you will set priorities and move the work forward yourself.
What You’ll Do
Understand our target customers and turn conversations with customers and the sales team into clear positioning, value propositions, and messaging
Create tools that help the sales team explain the product’s value, including customer stories, case studies, and product explainers grounded in verified results
Own our website, including its strategy, content, conversion paths, and ongoing improvements
Plan and launch new products and features with the product, sales, and customer success teams
Choose one or two demand generation channels to test with the founders and sales team, run the experiments, and measure the results
Bring customer feedback and competitive insights to the product and leadership teams
Track performance, including the quality of opportunities generated and their conversion, then expand the approaches that work
What You Bring
4+ years of experience in product marketing or a broad marketing role at a startup
Experience building positioning, content, and sales tools from the ground up
Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to make an AI product clear and relevant to business owners
A practical, hands on approach and the ability to work independently in a changing environment
Comfort using data to set priorities, test ideas, and improve performance
Interest in AI and in helping traditional service businesses work better
Experience in the trades, home services, or vertical SaaS is a strong asset
Fluency in written and spoken English and French
Why Join Fulltime AI?
Help grow an AI company serving trade contractors
Lead product marketing with a direct connection to company growth
Work closely with the founders and product team
Help small business owners save time, capture more jobs, and serve customers faster
Ready to Build With Us?
Send us your CV and a short note about why this role interests you and what you would bring to Fulltime.
FulltimeAI

Job Description
Our client is seeking a strategic and commercially minded Senior Manager, Regional Marketing to lead their marketing efforts across Vietnam. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing impactful marketing strategies that support client acquisition, improve onboarding, and drive regional growth.
This role requires a deep understanding of digital marketing, strong regional market knowledge, and the ability to work cross-functionally with a wide range of internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine commercial acumen with creativity and data-driven decision making to optimize the end-to-end client journey.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Strategy & Execution:
Design and implement targeted marketing plans for the Vietnam region, tailored to local customer needs and preferences, while aligning with global brand and product objectives, identifying new opportunities to drive revenue growth and increase market share across Russian-speaking countries.
Commercial Focus:
Ensure marketing initiatives contribute directly to commercial goals, including lead generation, conversion, and revenue growth. Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Partnerships teams to align on business priorities.
Onboarding Funnel Optimization:
Partner with product, design, and marketing ops to improve the client onboarding journey. Use data and user insights to identify friction points and optimize conversion paths.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Act as the marketing lead for the region, working closely with internal teams across Product, Payments, Compliance, Sales, and Partnerships to ensure alignment and efficiency in go-to-market execution.
Regional Advocacy:
Act as the internal champion for the Vietnam region, providing recommendations, and updates to leadership and internal teams. You’ll share market insights, campaign performance, and recommendations to improve relevance and growth in the region.
Requirements
Essential
Proven experience in a regional or digital marketing role focused on Vietnam.
Deep understanding of digital marketing strategies and tools across acquisition, CRM, and funnel optimization.
Commercial mindset, with a strong track record of delivering measurable business impact through marketing.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to align diverse teams behind shared regional goals.
Analytical approach with experience using data and insights to guide strategy and improve performance.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in Vietnamese and English (written and spoken) is essential.
Desirable / Nice to Have
Qualification (BA degree or equivalent professional experience).
Working experience within a Brokerage environment.
Benefits
Our client believes in fairly compensating everyone by providing them with a world-class health insurance plan and a range of both core benefits and flex benefits for individual preferences. You will receive:
Hybrid Working Policy
Discretionary performance related bonus
Personalized Flex-Benefits
A focus on your wellbeing, including talks and access to self-development tools.
Medical insurance for employees.
Comprehensive leave package of 40 days inclusive of Public Holidays
Our client is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partner status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability or age.

About Sadie
Sadie is a 24/7 voice AI agent built for the hospitality industry. Acting as an always-on extension of the hotel or restaurant team, Sadie instantly answers guest calls, shares property information, provides real-time availability and rates, and seamlessly books and manages reservations. Headquartered in Montreal and owned by Valsoft, Sadie is on a mission to transform how hospitality connects with guests—making every interaction effortless, personal, and revenue-generating.
For more information, visit heysadie.ai.
Sadie hotel division is transforming how hotels communicate with guests using AI powered voice technology. Our platform answers inbound calls 24-7, manages bookings, captures upsell opportunities and integrates with major hotel systems across the globe.
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on
Marketing Lead
to own and execute Sadie's marketing strategy across all channels. This is an exciting opportunity for a well-rounded marketing generalist who enjoys both strategy and execution.
Reporting directly to the VP of Sales & Partnerships, you'll lead all aspects of marketing—from positioning and content creation to demand generation, product marketing, digital campaigns, events, and customer communications. You'll collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Design, and external partners to build the Sadie brand, generate pipeline, and support our continued growth.
If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and loves turning ideas into measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.
What You Will Do
Marketing Strategy & Brand
Develop and execute Sadie's overall marketing strategy aligned with company growth objectives.
Own brand positioning, messaging, and go-to-market initiatives across target verticals.
Ensure consistency across all customer-facing marketing materials and channels.
Demand Generation & Digital Marketing
Plan and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns to drive awareness, lead generation, and pipeline growth.
Own email marketing, lifecycle campaigns, lead nurturing, and marketing automation within HubSpot.
Manage website content, landing pages, conversion optimization, and campaign performance.
Collaborate with external PPC and SEO partners to maximize digital performance and ROI.
Monitor key marketing metrics and continuously optimize campaigns based on data.
Content & Product Marketing
Create compelling content including blogs, customer stories, case studies, landing pages, sales collateral, email campaigns, social media content, and product announcements.
Develop messaging that clearly communicates Sadie's value proposition across hospitality verticals.
Partner with Product and Sales to launch new features and create customer-facing materials that support revenue growth.
Events & Community
Plan and manage webinars, conferences, trade shows, and customer events from planning through execution.
Coordinate event logistics, promotional campaigns, booth materials, and post-event follow-up.
Support thought leadership opportunities and industry partnerships that strengthen brand awareness.
Customer Marketing
Develop customer success stories, testimonials, and advocacy programs.
Create onboarding and customer engagement content that supports adoption and retention.
Partner with Customer Success to identify upsell and expansion marketing opportunities.
Marketing Operations & Analytics
Own HubSpot marketing operations, including workflows, segmentation, lead scoring, reporting, and campaign automation.
Track campaign performance, marketing attribution, and pipeline contribution.
Conduct competitor, market, and customer research to continuously improve messaging and strategy.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, preferably in a startup or high-growth environment.
Experience owning multiple areas of marketing, including demand generation, content, product marketing, digital marketing, and events.
Strong understanding of marketing strategy while remaining excited to execute day-to-day initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform.
Experience managing agencies or external marketing partners.
Analytical mindset with the ability to measure results and make data-driven decisions.
Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Experience in hospitality technology, AI, SaaS, or enterprise software is considered a strong asset.
Why You Will Love Working at Sadie
You will join a fast-growing AI company changing how hospitality operates.
Your work will directly shape our go-to-market strategy for hotels.
High ownership and visibility across both the hotel and restaurant verticals.
Clear growth pathways including Senior Content Manager, Demand Generation Manager, or Marketing Operations.
Flexible hybrid environment and opportunities to attend major industry events.

À propos de Sadie
Sadie est un agent vocal IA disponible 24 h/24, 7 j/7, conçu pour l'industrie de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration. Véritable prolongement de l'équipe de l'hôtel ou du restaurant, Sadie répond instantanément aux appels des clients, transmet les informations sur l'établissement, fournit les disponibilités et les tarifs en temps réel, et effectue et gère les réservations en toute fluidité. Établie à Montréal et détenue par Valsoft, Sadie a pour mission de transformer la façon dont l'industrie hôtelière communique avec sa clientèle — afin que chaque interaction soit simple, personnalisée et génératrice de revenus.
Pour en savoir plus, visitez heysadie.ai.

À propos du poste
Nous recherchons un chef marketing ou une cheffe marketing au profil opérationnel, prêt à s'approprier et à déployer la stratégie marketing de Sadie sur l'ensemble des canaux. Une belle occasion pour un ou une généraliste du marketing qui aime autant la stratégie que l'exécution.
Relevant directement du vice-président, Ventes et Partenariats, vous dirigerez tous les volets du marketing : positionnement, création de contenu, génération de la demande, marketing produit, campagnes numériques, événements et communications clients. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes Ventes, Produit, Succès client et Design, ainsi qu'avec des partenaires externes, pour bâtir la marque Sadie, générer du pipeline et soutenir notre croissance.

Stratégie marketing et marque
Élaborer et déployer la stratégie marketing globale de Sadie, en cohérence avec les objectifs de croissance de l'entreprise.
Être responsable du positionnement de la marque, du messaging et des initiatives de mise en marché dans les verticales ciblées.
Assurer la cohérence de tous les canaux et de tout le matériel marketing destiné à la clientèle.
Génération de la demande et marketing numérique
Planifier et exécuter des campagnes multicanaux pour accroître la notoriété, générer des prospects et alimenter le pipeline.
Être responsable du marketing par courriel, des campagnes de cycle de vie, de la maturation des prospects et de l'automatisation du marketing dans HubSpot.
Gérer le contenu du site Web, les pages d'atterrissage, l'optimisation du taux de conversion et la performance des campagnes.
Collaborer avec les partenaires externes en SEM et en SEO afin de maximiser la performance numérique et le rendement des investissements.
Suivre les indicateurs marketing clés et optimiser les campagnes en continu à partir des données.
Contenu et marketing produit
Créer du contenu percutant : billets de blogue, témoignages clients, études de cas, pages d'atterrissage, outils d'aide à la vente, campagnes courriel, contenu pour les réseaux sociaux et annonces de produits.
Développer un messaging qui communique clairement la proposition de valeur de Sadie dans chacune des verticales de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration.
Travailler avec les équipes Produit et Ventes pour lancer de nouvelles fonctionnalités et créer du matériel client favorisant la croissance des revenus.
Événements et communauté
Planifier et gérer les webinaires, conférences, salons professionnels et événements clients, de la planification à l'exécution.
Coordonner la logistique événementielle, les campagnes promotionnelles, le matériel de kiosque et les suivis post-événement.
Soutenir les occasions de leadership éclairé et les partenariats sectoriels qui renforcent la notoriété de la marque.
Marketing client
Développer des témoignages, des histoires de réussite client et des programmes d'ambassadeurs.
Créer du contenu d'accueil et d'engagement client qui favorise l'adoption et la fidélisation.
Collaborer avec l'équipe Succès client pour repérer les occasions de vente incitative et d'expansion.
Opérations marketing et analytique
Être responsable des opérations marketing dans HubSpot : flux de travail, segmentation, pointage des prospects, production de rapports et automatisation des campagnes.
Suivre la performance des campagnes, l'attribution marketing et la contribution au pipeline.
Mener des recherches sur la concurrence, le marché et la clientèle afin d'améliorer continuellement le messaging et la stratégie.
Votre profil
5 ans ou plus d'expérience en marketing SaaS B2B, idéalement en démarrage ou en environnement de forte croissance.
Expérience dans plusieurs volets du marketing : génération de la demande, contenu, marketing produit, marketing numérique et événements.
Solide compréhension de la stratégie marketing, jumelée à l'envie de mettre la main à la pâte au quotidien.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et verbale.
Expérience pratique de HubSpot ou d'une plateforme d'automatisation du marketing équivalente.
Expérience de gestion d'agences ou de partenaires marketing externes.
Esprit analytique et capacité à mesurer les résultats pour prendre des décisions fondées sur les données.
Grand sens de l'organisation, proactivité et aisance à gérer plusieurs priorités à la fois.
Une expérience en technologies hôtelières, en IA, en SaaS ou en logiciels d'entreprise constitue un atout important.
Pourquoi vous aimerez travailler chez Sadie
Vous vous joindrez à une entreprise d'IA en pleine croissance qui transforme le fonctionnement de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration.
Votre travail façonnera directement notre stratégie de mise en marché auprès des hôtels.
Beaucoup d'autonomie et de visibilité, tant dans la verticale hôtelière que dans la restauration.
Des parcours de progression clairs : gestionnaire principal de contenu, gestionnaire de la génération de la demande ou opérations marketing.
Un environnement hybride flexible et la possibilité d'assister aux grands événements de l'industrie.

FMX is a fast-growing SaaS company that helps schools and local governments run their operations more efficiently. We’re not looking for someone to simply support launches or check boxes on a roadmap. We’re looking for a
Product Marketing Manager
who can shape how our products are understood in the market—defining clear positioning, building messaging that resonates, and leading go-to-market efforts that drive real impact. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, and Content to ensure every launch is thoughtful, every asset has a purpose, and every story connects back to what our customers truly care about.
Responsibilities:
As a Product Marketing Manager, you will:
Develop clear, compelling value propositions and messaging frameworks that differentiate our products and solidify our positioning in a crowded market.
Lead end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) execution and product launches, coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure consistent delivery across all channels.
Drive sales enablement by arming our team with the tools they need to win, including pitch decks, case studies, one-pagers, and competitive battle cards.
Gather deep market intelligence to become the resident expert on our competition and our buyers’ specific purchasing criteria.
Partner on content strategy by collaborating with the creative team to produce high-impact assets, such as blogs, whitepapers, and videos, that address every stage of the funnel.
Foster customer advocacy by engaging with users to gather insights, testimonials, and success stories that validate our product’s value.
Requirements
Preferred Experience & Qualities:
What are we looking for in this role?
2–5 years of dedicated Product Marketing experience, ideally with a strong background in the B2B SaaS space.
The ability to communicate through exceptional writing and storytelling, translating complex technical jargon into clear and relatable "human" benefits.
Proven project management skills demonstrated by successfully overseeing multiple initiatives simultaneously, from minor feature updates to high-stakes product launches.
An analytical mindset that thrives on using data (usage metrics, market trends, and Win/Loss analysis) to drive strategic decision-making.
A collaborative spirit reflected in a history of working closely with Product and Sales leadership to align on roadmaps and organizational goals.
You embody our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.
The hiring process for this role:
Apply!
Submit your resume and answers to the application questions below via the Workable portal.
Phone screen with People Ops:
A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
Hiring manager conversation:
A 60-minute conversation with the VP, Marketing. Be prepared to discuss your background as well as what you’re looking for in your next role and what direction you see your career path taking. Also, this is a great time for you to ask questions about the expectations for this role, team culture, etc.
Take Home Assessment
: Selected candidates will complete a brief at-home assessment as part of the hiring process.
Final Interview:
A 60-minute peer interview with members from the Product Marketing team.
Questions for you from the team on your background, as well as time to discuss the day-to-day responsibilities and team culture.
Offer & Onboarding:
Candidates who receive an offer will be required to complete a background check prior to onboarding. New hires are also expected to work onsite at our Columbus, OH office during their first week to complete onboarding and connect with the team in person.
Benefits
FMX Benefits
and Life at FMX:
You'll make a big impact:
You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our product and the future of our company.
Competitive benefits:
100% company-paid health, dental, vision, long and short term disability, and life insurance.
Work from home:
At FMX, we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have one all-company event a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.
Home office stipend:
We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company-sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture, and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection.
Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies:
If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time?
Flexible Schedule:
We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines.
You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team:
We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.
Compensation:
This position offers a base salary and is eligible for the Company's Performance Bonus program. Total on-target earnings (OTE) are expected to be $90,000–$100,000 annually.
401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance.
Other considerations:
The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US.
Company:
FMX is founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio and develops a cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space. Check us out at:
https://www.gofmx.com/
Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Teammate Handbook. FMX is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

2549.Gecko Job Description: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Marketing Technologies Director The Marketing Technologies Director, leads PlayStation's global marketing technology organization across engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, audience activation, and marketing data. This leader owns the technology vision, architecture, product strategy, and roadmap for platforms used by marketers worldwide to reach hundreds of millions of players. The role is accountable for building secure, scalable, AI-enabled capabilities that improve marketing effectiveness, speed, and customer experience. We are seeking a technology leader with direct software or data engineering experience building marketing technology products and platforms. The successful candidate can lead engineers and technical product teams, make architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, and translate marketing needs into durable systems. Experience limited to administering vendors or managing a marketing technology stack without direct engineering experience does not meet the requirements of this role. Key Responsibilities Technology Engineering and Product Leadership Lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for marketing technology engineering, product management, and UX, with clear goals, operating rhythms, and accountability for delivery. Own end-to-end delivery and operation of global marketing platforms, from discovery and architecture through launch, adoption, reliability, and continuous improvement. Set the architecture for marketing platforms, APIs, data pipelines, audience services, orchestration, and activation integrations. Define the marketing technology product vision and prioritize a multi-year roadmap based on customer value, technical feasibility, business impact, risk, and platform health. Establish engineering standards for security, privacy, reliability, observability, scalability, and the management of technical debt. Lead product discovery and UX research with marketing teams globally, converting user needs into intuitive workflows and measurable product outcomes. Evaluate build, buy, and partner options with technical rigor, and ensure third-party platforms integrate into a coherent, maintainable architecture. Measurement Experimentation and Audience Activation Lead the measurement and experimentation function, including test design, measurement frameworks, platform capabilities, and the use of results in marketing decisions. Lead audience activation and marketing data teams responsible for identity, segmentation, consent-aware audience management, data quality, governance, and activation readiness. Connect audience, measurement, and activation capabilities across marketing channels so teams can plan, execute, learn, and optimize through shared data and platforms. Partner with Data Science and Analytics leaders to embed experimentation, causal measurement, predictive models, and decision support into marketing workflows. Assess and scale AI and automation use cases that improve marketer productivity, decision quality, and customer relevance. Strategy and Transformation Serve as the technical and strategic partner to Media, Creative, Brand Marketing, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Data Science, and Business Analytics leaders. Align SIE teams that own or influence the marketing technology stack around a single architecture, product vision, roadmap, and set of investment priorities. Lead high-priority transformation initiatives, managing execution, organizational dependencies, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. Partner with marketing leaders to redesign workflows, processes, decision rights, and operating models around new platform capabilities. Balance global platform standards with appropriate local and product-level flexibility while maintaining security, privacy, and architectural integrity. Define success measures and post-launch KPI tracking for platform performance, adoption, marketing effectiveness, and business impact. Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, data engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An advanced degree is preferred. 12+ years of experience across software or data engineering, technical product management, and marketing technology, including leadership of global teams. Direct software or data engineering experience and a record of leading engineering teams that built and operated production marketing technology systems. Demonstrated success building, launching, and operating enterprise SaaS products or internal platforms, beyond implementing or administering third-party tools. Technical depth in cloud architecture, APIs, systems integration, data pipelines, identity and audience systems, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability. Experience leading multidisciplinary organizations spanning engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, analytics or data science, and audience activation. Strong command of experimentation methods, marketing measurement, analytics, and the use of data to improve product and marketing decisions. Experience with AI-powered products, machine learning platforms, or automation in production environments. Experience owning multi-year technology and product roadmaps and making investment, architecture, and build-versus-buy decisions. Ability to influence senior leaders, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and lead transformation across teams and regions. At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.  Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.  In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more. This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below. $207,400 — $311,200 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our  Candidate Privacy Notice  for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. Equal Opportunity Statement: Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category. We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.  Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration. Benefits The AI Marketing Semi Senior Assistant will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential. Company benefits include: Paid time off 100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America) U.S. Holidays Training Mentored career development USD remuneration Profit Share Program Access to premium AI and marketing tools Maternity coverage About Azumo Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile. We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere. If you are excited about marketing, already use AI as part of how you work, and want the opportunity to learn quickly and have a measurable impact on a growing technology company, we’d like to hear from you.| At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.

In this position, you'll take ownership of key search and shopping accounts, while driving performance improvements and expanding our digital presence. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, product feed management, and revenue growth across paid search and DemandGen, while continuously testing, learning, and optimizing. Your insights will be critical in shaping strategic decisions that contribute to our long-term revenue goals. Who You Are: You bring a strong interest in driving results and a proactive approach to learning and problem-solving. You have a deep understanding of paid search platforms and are always up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices. You're data-driven, with an analytical mindset that allows you to dissect campaign performance and make informed decisions quickly. Responsibilities Own & Scale Paid Media Own end-to-end strategy, execution and optimization of paid search channels (Google, YouTube, etc), ensuring seamless execution from start to finish, with a focus on driving performance and achieving growth targets Manage media buying, bidding strategies, budget allocation and pacing to hit ROAS, CPA and revenue goals Oversee all aspects of campaign and ad trafficking, including quality control, launch, reporting, and comprehensive analysis Operate as the in-house resource for paid search execution; translate complex data into actionable insights for future campaigns Collaborate Across Teams Collaborate with internal teams such as Creative, Brand, and Retention to optimize campaign performance through targeting, creative direction, and optimization strategies (specifically when it comes to DemandGen) Work closely with the Senior Manager of Performance Creative to oversee and launch high-impact paid social creatives on DemandGen Requirements 5-7 years of experience in paid search and/or paid social or ecommerce or DTC brands Proven track record of scaling paid media profitability Hands-on experience managing Google Ads, Google Shopping/Merchant Center, and YouTube Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize data into actionable insights Experience working with larger budgets and complex account structures Comfortable operating in a test-and-learn approach in a fast-paced environment Familiarity with data tools like Omni, Looker, GA4, Northbeam or similar Strong understanding of product feed management and shopping campaign optimization Experience with Amazon is a plus The anticipated base salary range for this role is $120,000 - 135,000. Team : You will be joining a passionate and collaborative fully-remote team that prides itself on high-quality work, supporting one another, sharing our successes, and building a brand we truly love, together. We strive to continually optimize our processes, ensuring that we’re thoughtful in everything we do, both internally and externally. We listen to our employees, celebrate our wins, and constantly look for ways to be better for our team, and the world. Our leadership team sits on both the East and West Coast and we have folks in a variety of states. We offer a monthly stipend towards co-working space should folks need to switch up their working environment every now and then. Benefits : We value you and your family. With this in mind, full-time eligible employees are provided: Equity : We believe in our product and that the sky's the limit for where our business is going. Leveling Up with Caraway : In addition to exciting opportunities and exposure in your day-to-day work, we offer annual reimbursements to full-time employees to support their professional development aspirations! #AwayFromCaraway : We believe healthy, happy humans do better work. This role connects marketing & financial data and uses its analytical capabilities to help teams understand what’s driving results, spot risks and opportunities, set expectations, and propose actions that can directly impact business performance. Use AI tools to build and improve reporting, tracking, dashboards, and models - for example, dashboards or forecasting models in Claude or Google Sheets - that help teams understand performance and take action. Improve marketing reporting models and work with Analytics to define requirements for dashboards and other reporting tools. Support testing and experimentation by helping teams plan learning agendas, evaluate results, and incorporate findings into forecasts and performance tracking. Develop clear performance read-outs and presentations that help leaders make informed decisions about marketing investment and business goals. Minimum Qualifications: We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Strong scenario planning, forecasting, and financial modeling skills, combined with high competence in business intelligence platforms. Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools (LLMs, AI agents, Python scripts) to automate manual reporting workflows and scale insight generation. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Senior Technical SEO Analyst to improve the technical foundations that help 1Password.com attract qualified audiences, support conversion, and build category authority across consumer, product-led growth (PLG), and enterprise experiences. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who moves beyond audits to diagnose root causes, recommend practical solutions, implement changes, and partner with Web Engineering when improvements require code or platform development. Reporting to the Senior Manager, SEO and GEO. On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights fasterso we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password. This is a remote opportunity the US. What we're looking for: • 4+ years of hands-on technical SEO experience on a complex software as a service (SaaS), enterprise, international, or multi-audience website. • Strong knowledge of crawling, indexing, rendering, canonicals, redirects, sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, JavaScript SEO, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, and international SEO. • Experience moving from technical diagnosis to implementation through content management system (CMS) changes, engineering requirements, release quality assurance (QA), and measurement. • Experience with an enterprise or headless CMS, including content models, publishing workflows, governance, and data quality. • Experience supporting a domain, CMS, platform, or acquired-site migration. • Strong analytical judgment and working knowledge of Hypertext Markup Language (HTML), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), JavaScript, crawl tools, Google Search Console, web analytics, and monitoring systems. • Clear communication and cross-functional project leadership, including the judgment to make day-to-day decisions independently and bring forward recommendations on broader decisions. Experience with Contentful, Vercel, Next.js, GitHub, GitLab, server-log analysis, observability, automated testing, workflow automation, cybersecurity, developer products, or a global website serving both business and consumer audiences is a plus. What you can expect: • Monitor and improve crawlability, indexation, rendering, site performance, structured data, internal linking, and international SEO. • Diagnose complex technical issues and recommend priorities based on impact, effort, risk, dependencies, and business goals. • Implement changes in the CMS and partner with Web Engineering on technical SEO requirements, acceptance criteria, and release QA. • Lead defined technical SEO workstreams for migrations and major site changes, including redirect planning, launch monitoring, and post-launch remediation. • Maintain agreed taxonomy, structured-content, internal-linking, and data-quality systems that support scalable content discovery. • Build monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and repeatable processes using crawl, search, analytics, log, and CMS data. • Use artificial intelligence (AI), scripts, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation to scale technical analysis, quality assurance, and repeatable fixes with appropriate human oversight. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $88,000 USD and $123,000 USD , plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy Growth and future 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account Community 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. Head of Digital Marketing & AI-Driven Growth Job Overview The Head of Digital Marketing drives the vision, strategy, and execution of Socure's digital marketing initiatives — with AI and marketing agents at the core of how the team operates. This role leads the digital marketing team, partners with cross-functional stakeholders, and builds an agentic marketing engine that senses market signals in real time and turns them into high-impact campaigns, content, and conversions. The Head of Digital Marketing is accountable for elevating digital marketing quality, pioneering AI-driven approaches to speed and scale, and mentoring team members to work effectively alongside AI agents in pursuit of business objectives. What you'll own Answer engine and organic discovery (AEO + SEO). Make Socure the answer when buyers ask AI assistants about identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC, and onboarding risk. Build the program that measures and grows our share of voice and citation rate across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews, alongside traditional rankings. Structure our content, data, and third-party footprint so models understand and trust us. Paid media wherever buyers ask questions. Run a full-funnel paid program across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, LLM Ads and programmatic, and lead Socure's early moves into emerging AI ad surfaces, including sponsored placements inside conversational assistants. Use AI for targeting, creative variation, bid strategy, and budget reallocation, and know when to override it. Agentic lifecycle marketing. Replace static nurture streams with agent-driven lifecycle programs that read buying signals (product usage, intent data, engagement, firmographic change) and respond with the right message, channel, and timing. Partner with Sales Development and ABM so agents hand off to humans at the right moment, with full context. The adaptive website. Turn socure.com into an experience that adapts by account, industry, persona, and stage, with personalized content, dynamic proof points, and conversational paths to a demo. Make the site readable and useful to AI agents and crawlers as well as people, since more buyer research will be done by agents on their behalf. The agentic marketing engine. Design and run the system that senses the market in real time (news, competitor moves, regulatory shifts, fraud trends) and turns it into drafted content, campaign briefs, social copy, and landing pages within hours. Build the human-in-the-loop review that keeps everything accurate, on-brand, and compliant for a regulated buyer base. Measurement that reflects how buying works now. Build attribution and reporting that connect AI visibility, paid, lifecycle, and web engagement to pipeline and bookings. Retire metrics that no longer mean anything and define the ones that do. The team. Lead and grow a team spanning paid, organic/AEO, lifecycle, and digital operations. Coach each person to run their lane as an operator of agents, with the judgment to know what to automate, what to supervise, and what to keep human. The opportunity What success looks like in your first year Socure is consistently cited in AI-assistant answers for our priority categories, with a measurable, rising share of voice against named competitors. Digital channels source and influence a clearly larger share of qualified pipeline, with attribution leadership trusts. At least one agentic lifecycle program and one signal-to-content workflow are live, producing work weekly, with documented review and quality controls. The website personalizes for priority accounts and segments, and demo conversion improves as a result. Your team ships more, faster, at higher quality, and each member can show what they've built with AI. Who you are You've lived at the front edge of digital marketing for the last few years and have the scars to prove it. You've run real budgets and real teams, and you've also personally built agents, prompts, automations, and workflows that run in production. You think in systems, read data fluently, and write well enough to tell good AI output from plausible AI output in seconds. You're comfortable with ambiguity because most of the playbook you need hasn't been written yet, and you'd rather write it than wait for it. What you bring 10+ years in digital marketing, including leading teams and owning multi-channel budgets, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another complex, high-consideration sale. A track record of building AEO/GEO programs, with examples of how you measured and moved AI-assistant visibility. Deep paid media expertise across Google, LinkedIn, and programmatic, plus hands-on experimentation with AI-native ad formats. Experience building agentic or AI-driven lifecycle and personalization programs on a modern stack (marketing automation, CDP or intent data, enrichment, orchestration). Experience shipping a personalized or adaptive web experience and running a disciplined testing program on it. Hands-on fluency with AI tooling: LLMs, agent frameworks, workflow automation, and AEO and enrichment platforms. You can build a working prototype yourself. Strong analytical and attribution chops, with the credibility to present pipeline impact to a CMO and executive team. Sound judgment on brand, accuracy, compliance, and data privacy for AI-generated content and automated decisions, especially with regulated buyers. A leader who develops people and can bring a team through a real change in how work gets done. Bonus points Experience marketing to banks, fintechs, or other regulated industries. Experience with tools in our orbit, such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Clay, Apollo, AirOps, Ahrefs, or Mixpanel. A public body of work: writing, talks, or open-sourced workflows on AEO or agentic marketing. Why Socure Socure is the AI-native leader in identity verification and fraud prevention, trusted by thousands of organizations, including the largest banks and fintechs. We're scaling fast, the market is moving our way, and marketing has a real seat in how we grow. You'll have executive air cover, a team ready to move, and room to build something other companies will copy.
