2633.FireCrawl Job Description: $127B industry. Should be $300B. We're building the platform to get it there. The catch: the market thinks we're an upgrade. We're a new category. Your job as Head of Marketing is to close that gap, make the transformation obvious, and turn that clarity into growth. Small team, weekly ships, AI-first. If you want to help craft the story that will change an industry, let's talk. ABOUT TERN Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it. Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations, giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel. But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of. At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both. HEAD OF MARKETING As a Head of Marketing, you'll work with our existing brand and demand gen team, partnering directly with Sales as a GTM counterpart. Tern is building a new category in travel, and the market hasn't caught up yet. Advisors on Tern make more money. They spend less time on admin. We're building the first modern back-office the industry has seen in 40 years. We're changing how suppliers sell to the advisors who move $127B+ of travel a year, how those suppliers deliver personalized service, and how advisors get paid, faster and more reliably than ever. This is a $127B industry that should be a $300B one. We're making that happen, and it's going to run on Tern. Here's the problem. People think we're a better version of something they already use. We're not. We're an entirely new category, out to reimagine this industry for the better, and Tern is already transforming how advisors work today. We lose deals we should win, not because a competitor is better, but because the buyer doesn't grasp how different their business becomes on Tern. That gap shows up everywhere. It costs advisor and agency growth, and it shapes how suppliers and investors read the story. That's your job. Own Tern's brand and demand generation globally. Set Tern's 18 to 24 month marketing direction, bring structure to a fast-moving team, and make sure we ship every week. Make the transformation obvious, then turn that clarity into growth across advisors, agencies, and suppliers. You'll do it on a small team, in one-week cycles, with AI as your default leverage. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. If you need agencies or large teams be successful, this isn’t the role for you. It also isn't the seat if you need a fully defined plan before you can move, or if you default to tactics before setting direction. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own how Tern explains itself. Build the messaging that makes an advisor, a supplier, and an investor each get Tern in one sentence, backed by real proof like higher advisor earnings and less admin time. Find and tell the advisor stories that prove it. Tern's best marketing is a real advisor whose business changed. Go find those people and make sure everyone hears them. Build the advisor and agency demand engine across content, PR, digital, and events. A weekly motion, not quarterly campaigns. Run marketing and sales as one motion. Work hand in hand with Sales on ICP, pipeline definitions, and conversion. Turn product innovation into market growth. Partner with Product and Sales to shape how new product capabilities reach the market, strengthen Tern's differentiation, and drive adoption across advisors, agencies, and suppliers. Stand up Tern's brand in the hotel and supplier world as that side scales. Get Tern into the rooms, stages, and channels suppliers actually watch. Ship in one-week cycles. Small bets, measure fast, kill what doesn't work. Run marketing with AI as the default. The first question is always "can AI do this," not "who do we hire." Build and lead a small team supercharged with AI. We believe small, high-performing teams with AI as leverage are the future of marketing. Building that team is the job. If you're not the leader to build it, you're not the right fit. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS Get your arms around everything marketing has in motion, decide what matters, put owners and metrics on it, and present a plan for where marketing takes Tern over the next two years. WHAT YOU HAVE Experience: 8+ years in marketing, including 3+ years leading a marketing function. Full-stack marketing leadership: You've led across paid media, product marketing, content, PR, and events, ideally in a producer-led industry. You've owned both brand and demand, not one lane. Builder instincts: You can zoom out to set direction and zoom in to sweat the details of what ships this week. Executive presence: You've operated on a leadership team and can lead with authority across sales, product, and the exec team, not just within marketing. Structure in ambiguity: You've walked into a fast, under-structured environment and turned it into a clear operating rhythm without slowing it down. AI-native execution: You run marketing with AI as core leverage. You can point to systems and campaigns you shipped that a much larger team would otherwise have needed. Narrative and category chops: You've taken a product that's hard to explain and made the market understand it. Better if you did it in a new or contested category. Team leadership with a small-team bias: You've led teams, and you're motivated by impact per head, not by headcount. BONUS POINTS Travel, hospitality, or supplier-side marketing experience You've marketed to a two-sided or producer-led ecosystem (advisors, agents, franchisees, sellers) A track record of building brand equity through events, awards, and speaking WHAT WE VALUE @ TERN 🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity. 🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve. 💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust. OPERATING PRINCIPLES: 👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in. ➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now". 📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego. 🏃 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality. 🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last. WHY JOIN TERN? Be part of a mission-driven team transforming the travel planning space Work with a supportive, curious, and creative team Shape how the entire travel industry sees Tern Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package Tern is committed to building a team that represents people from many different backgrounds and life experiences, reflecting our worldview coinciding with the users and customers we serve across the world. We prefer that you apply, so think of our postings as the start of the conversation. Take the chance- you may be a wonderful add to our Tern team, even if you don't fully match every requirement on the job description.

2638.Gecko Job Description: About Cogent Security Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur. To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality. Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world. We're backed by Greylock and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from: Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler Preeminent ML research labs like Deepmind and SAIL About the Role Cogent is building a world-class marketing team, and we're looking for smart, fast, exceptional people who are committed to our mission and bring a spark of creativity that sets us apart from traditional B2B marketing. As Senior Manager of Content Marketing, you'll write the content that introduces security teams to Cogent and carries them through a buying decision: blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, research reports, social series, and scripts for short video. This is a writing-heavy role. Most of your week goes to interviewing experts, drafting, and shipping. The rest goes to making sure the work gets found in search, AI answers, and social. You'll take raw material (product insight, original research, customer outcomes, breaking security news) and turn it into content that security practitioners read and share. What You'll Do Content Production Write the blog posts, whitepapers, and ebooks that build awareness with security practitioners and engage buyers at each stage of the buying process. Interview Cogent's researchers, engineers, and field team for raw material, and get every technical detail right. React fast when security news breaks: write and ship the POV piece while the story still matters. Social & Video Execute Cogent's social strategy: regular series (weekly VM insights, AI security myths, remediation playbooks) that keep a steady drumbeat of Cogent's point of view in front of practitioners. Write scripts for short videos and explainers, and work with contractors who shoot and edit them. Search & AEO Run the SEO and AEO program: research what buyers search for and ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, then structure each piece so it ranks and gets cited. Track how your content performs in search and AI answers, and refresh the pieces that slip. Research & Story Packaging Work with the research team on Cogent's flagship research report: dig into the data, shape the findings into a story, and write the report. Project manage the report through launch, then turn it into derivative content: blog series, social posts, short video, and sales assets. Repurpose the strongest research, product insight, and customer stories in Cogent's library into formats that reach new audiences. AI-Native Production Use AI across your workflow (research synthesis, drafting, editing, repurposing) to ship at the pace of a small team without losing accuracy or voice. Build systems that make the work faster, like prompt libraries, voice guides, and a living archive of positioning, proof, and research. What We're Looking For Must-Have 5-7 years in B2B content roles, with at least three of them writing for security practitioners and buyers. Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain complex security topics simply and credibly. A track record of content that earned attention: organic traffic and rankings, citations in AI answers, social engagement, and downloads of long-form assets. Hands-on SEO and AEO experience, with tools like Semrush, GA4, Profound, and AirOps. You've shipped at a fast-moving company without a big team behind you. Fluent with AI in the actual work. You can walk through a content workflow you built, where it broke, and what you changed. Nice-to-Have Experience writing about vulnerability management, exposure management (CTEM), AppSec, cloud security, or AI in security operations. Experience writing or project managing a research report (threat report, benchmark, or survey) and turning it into a campaign's worth of derivative content. Production ability beyond writing: short video, explainers, visual assets, or the judgment to direct contractors who make them. Experience growing a practitioner audience on LinkedIn. Why Cogent Cogent is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You'll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world's most sophisticated organizations.

2642.Gecko Job Description: If you want full ownership of your accounts, a seat on a fast-scaling team, and a front-row spot while a company goes from $15M to $50M, keep reading. Stryker Digital is one of the fastest-growing home service marketing agencies in the United States. We went from $0 to a $15M/year run rate in under five years. SEO is the backbone of what we do — and you'd be managing the accounts that built this company. You own your book of accounts end to end: strategy, communication, and the client relationship. You're on the calls. You're presenting the numbers. You're the reason they renew. We don't care where you learned this or how long you've been doing it. We care that you can show us local SEO campaigns you ran that moved the needle — rankings you climbed, Google Business Profiles you took over and made produce, clients who stayed because of you. If you can point at real results for real businesses with trucks on the road, we want to talk. About the Role As an SEO Client Success Manager at Stryker Digital, you'll be the strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of home service clients. You'll work directly with business owners to make sure their SEO campaigns deliver measurable results — and that they understand exactly what they're getting for their money. This is not a behind-the-scenes SEO role. You'll be at the frontline of client relationships, from onboarding to monthly performance reviews. You'll oversee fulfillment, translate technical work into business outcomes, spot upsell opportunities, and be the trusted advisor our clients call first. You'll collaborate closely with internal fulfillment teams to ensure every campaign is executed on time, to standard, and profitably. Responsibilities Client Management: Serve as the day-to-day contact for assigned SEO accounts, communicating via Slack, video, and email. Campaign Oversight: Work with our fulfillment teams to ensure on-page content, backlinks, citations, and Google Business Profile optimization are delivered on time and meet our quality standards. Performance Reviews: Lead monthly video calls to walk clients through results, educate them on strategy, and discuss next steps. Upsells: Identify and recommend additional services — Google Ads, Facebook Ads, websites — that align with each client's goals. Reporting & Analysis: Present SEO data in a way that highlights business outcomes and ROI, not just vanity metrics. Client Retention: Build long-term relationships through exceptional service, proactive communication, and consistent follow-through. What We're Looking For 2+ Years of Experience: Client-facing SEO or account management experience required, preferably at a digital agency or with local service businesses. Local SEO Knowledge: A strong command of Google Business Profiles, on-page SEO, backlinks, and citations. Client-Facing Skills: You've led strategy calls, handled tough questions, and built real relationships. Detail-Oriented: You can juggle multiple accounts without dropping a ball — and your Slack messages and reports are polished. Growth-Minded: You're looking to take ownership, grow with a high-performing team, and make your mark in a fast-scaling department. Bonus Skills: Familiarity with GoHighLevel, GA4, Monday.com , and Slack is a major plus. What You'll Get Compensation: $60,000 – $80,000 USD/year base, with $100,000+ on-target earnings Work Hours: Monday – Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM ESTLocation: Remote Benefits: Monthly tax-free healthcare stipend for marketplace coverage Unlimited PTO Our Core Values Competitive Greatness We show up strongest when it matters most. We don't avoid hard things, we go straight at them. We do the hard stuff first: hard conversations, hard decisions, and uncomfortable work we've been putting off. We build confidence through action, not talk. Sincere Candor We believe feedback is a requirement to get better, not a personal attack. Candor is expected from day one, at every level, in every direction. We tell the truth, especially when it's uncomfortable. Unimpeachable Character We do the right thing when no one's watching. No shortcuts, no lies, no excuses. We take ownership, step in, and solve problems without finger-pointing.

2645.FireCrawl Job Description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Content Marketing Lead produces TRM's flagship brand content: high-impact, globally relevant work that makes TRM the reference point on the issues that define modern crime and how it's fought. You'll spend most of your time creating that content with TRM's experts and making sure it reaches the audiences who matter. You'll also set the quality bar for content across TRM and build the frameworks and AI workflows that let marketers across regions and campaigns produce strong work on their own. The impact you will have: Create flagship content with TRM's Insights, Policy, leadership and other SME teams that makes TRM the authority on the issues that matter most to our customers Own distribution for everything you produce. Run TRM's owned channels directly, and partner with Demand Gen, Comms and other teams to get your work into the channels you don't own, from paid promotion and earned media to executive voice. For now, you'll also oversee TRM's corporate social channels Own TRM's voice and tone. Build the style guide, templates and AI workflows that help regional and demand marketers produce on-brand content, and give the final edit on high-visibility work Own TRM's blog/Resources hub and, with technical and agency partners, the SEO/GEO content strategy. Produce the content that moves search and AI-citation metrics on the topics that matter most to TRM What we’re looking for: 5+ years of B2B content marketing, with a portfolio of flagship, point-of-view work. A background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, fintech or public-sector-facing work is a strong plus Strong editorial judgment, and experience setting standards other teams adopt An AI-native approach: you use AI across research, drafting, repurposing and optimization, and you're curious about new tooling A distribution mindset: you plan how a piece will reach people before you publish it Experience working with SEO/GEO specialists and owning the performance of the content you produce An excellent writer who can distill nuanced, technical topics for different audiences Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Ship first-to-market: when Design is backed up before a launch and a competitor is about to announce a comparable solution, break a white paper into blog posts and publish yourself to win the moment Build scalable systems (templates, standards) so quality content ships faster without adding headcount Use AI to compress drafting and production cycles Move content from idea to press-ready without unnecessary hand-offs The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only. The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000. Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Privacy Policy and Additional Information By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy . We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com . To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form . Recruitment agencies TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

2647.Gecko Job Description: Role We're seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager for our Portfolio company to turn paid media investment into profitable growth. You will own campaign performance from strategy and setup through optimization, measurement, and reporting. The role begins with Meta across Facebook and Instagram, then expands into channels such as Google, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Spotify, and Amazon when performance data and business needs support the investment. Success is measured through qualified demand, sales, acquisition efficiency, and profitability. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will work directly in the accounts, interpret performance daily, manage budgets, strengthen tracking, and build a disciplined testing practice. You will partner closely with the Meta, Funnels & AI Performance Coach, Brand & Creative Director, Messaging & Copy Strategist, and teams across marketing and sales. Responsibilities Own paid media campaigns from planning and launch through daily optimization, beginning with Meta and expanding to additional channels based on performance and business needs. Analyze channel and blended performance to improve CAC, ROAS, lead quality, revenue, and profitability while keeping spend on pace. Maintain reliable measurement across pixels, tags, UTMs, conversion events, conversion APIs, server-side tracking, dashboards, and attribution analysis. Run a documented testing roadmap across creative, audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, and funnels in partnership with creative, copy, and performance stakeholders. Deliver clear performance reporting, surface risks and opportunities early, monitor platform changes, and use AI tools where they measurably improve speed or quality. Requirements 5+ hands-on paid media experience owning Meta campaigns and at least one additional major platform, with accountability for meaningful budgets and business results. Advanced analytical ability across advertising platforms, GA4, dashboards, and business data, with a record of turning performance signals into timely decisions. Hands-on experience implementing and auditing pixels, conversion APIs, UTM structures, conversion events, and server-side tracking, plus a practical understanding of attribution limits. Demonstrated discipline in designing, running, and documenting experiments, with the judgment to turn findings into stronger creative, messaging, offers, and funnels. Clear, leadership-ready communication skills, current knowledge of paid platform changes, and practical experience using AI to improve repeatable workflows. Results Meta campaigns are fully owned and consistently optimized against agreed CAC, ROAS, lead-quality, revenue, and profitability targets. Monthly spend remains within 5% of plan, with material pacing risks identified and addressed early. Tracking and conversion measurement are audited regularly, with major gaps identified, communicated, and resolved promptly. At least two structured tests per active platform are completed each month, with hypotheses, outcomes, and next actions documented. Weekly reports arrive on time, monthly reviews are delivered by the fifth business day, and quarterly channel-expansion recommendations include audience, budget, and test design. Schedule Full-time, with working hours aligned to U.S.-based team collaboration and campaign needs. No travel is required. Location Remote, USA Compensation $80,000 - $100,000 base salary The salary range may include multiple levels applicable to the position. Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, skills, expertise, and the level at which the candidate is hired. This range includes base salary only and does not include benefits. Benefits Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off after six months, plus company-wide holidays. Retirement Plan: 401(k) with a 3% company match after six months of continuous employment. Profit-Sharing 401(k): Employer-funded contributions based on tenure and other plan factors, with a three-year vesting schedule. Home Office Stipend: One-time stipend to establish a comfortable and productive remote workspace. Annual Incentive Trip: Fully paid team trip to a bucket-list destination. Private Wellness Center: Monthly access to a gym, sauna, and cold plunge for Georgia-based employees. Parental Leave: Twelve weeks fully paid for the primary provider and four weeks fully paid for the secondary provider, subject to length-of-service eligibility. Disclaimer: Please note that our portfolio company benefits and values differ, and please ignore the sections below. Benefits: We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings: Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company-wide Holidays Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, & Vision plans $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution FSA options including dependent care Employee assistance program and mental health resources Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more! For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas * Benefits eligibility applies only to full-time exempt roles. ACQ Core Values: Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business. Competitive Greatness Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns. Sincere Candor Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally. Unimpeachable Character Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.

2649.FireCrawl Job Description: About Us: Here at Ambience, we never set out to be just another scribe. We’re building the AI intelligence platform that restores humanity to healthcare and drives meaningful ROI for health systems across the country. Our technology helps providers focus on delivering great care by removing the administrative burden that pulls them away from patients and away from their most impactful work. Ambience delivers real-time coding-aware documentation and clinical workflow support across ambulatory, emergency and inpatient settings at the top health systems in North America. Our teams operate relentlessly with extreme ownership to build the best solutions for our health system partners. We value candor, positivity and deep thought — and we expect a lot from each other because we know the problems we’re solving truly matter. Ambience was ranked #1 for Improving the Clinician Experience in the KLAS Research Emerging Solutions Top 20 Report, recognized by Fast Company as one of the Next Big Things in Tech, named one of the best AI companies in healthcare by Inc., and selected as a LinkedIn Top Startup in 2024 and 2025. We’re backed by Oak HC/FT, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), OpenAI Startup Fund, and Kleiner Perkins — and we’re just getting started. The Role: Ambience Healthcare is looking for a Senior Manager, Growth Marketing to own the execution and measurement of our account-based marketing (ABM) motion. You'll sit within Commercial Marketing, reporting to the Head of Commercial Marketing, and partner closely with Sales to turn a prioritized list of target hospital and health-system accounts into concrete, measured marketing plays. This is a fully remote role — any time zone. What You'll Do: Design and launch account-based marketing plays. Turn Sales' prioritized target-account list into specific, sequenced campaigns tailored to each account's context and blockers. Own measurement and reporting. Apply Ambience's account-based measurement framework to real data pulled from our CRM and other systems, grade what worked, and report results that shape the next round of plays. Partner directly with Sales on shared accounts. Work the same target accounts as the sales team, surfacing and resolving discrepancies between marketing's and sales' view of an account before they become blockers. Coordinate cross-functionally to activate plays. Work with Events, Customer Marketing, and Product Marketing to get the right messaging and content to the right accounts through the right channels. Build a repeatable ABM operating rhythm. Establish a durable cadence for proposing, running, measuring, and iterating on account-based plays so the function scales beyond any single campaign. Who You Are: An experienced B2B marketer. 6–8+ years of marketing experience with direct exposure to a sales-aligned or account-based motion. Healthcare-tested. You've worked directly with hospitals and health systems — payer-only or life-sciences-only backgrounds don't meet this bar. Hands-on with CRM/martech. You're comfortable working inside a CRM or marketing platform (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar) to pull and act on your own data. Measurement-minded. You're skeptical of activity metrics and know how to separate real signal — account or pipeline movement — from noise. Comfortable with ambiguity. You propose next steps rather than waiting for direction. Life at Ambience Working at Ambience means opting into a high-ownership, high-trust environment built for people who want to grow fast, operate decisively and focus on work that matters. This could be the right place for you if you want to Work on mission-critical AI technology that directly improves clinicians’ day-to-day lives and health system financial health across some of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in the world. Join a “dream team” culture where we hire exceptional people, expect exceptional outcomes and invest deeply in feedback and continuous growth. We operate as a championship team, and that means being ok with hard, uncomfortable, ambiguous problems that lead to real greatness. Operate with real ownership and accountability in an environment where there are no bystanders: If something is broken, we fix it! You will have meaningful autonomy and be expected to drive work to completion. To help you do your best work, we pair these expectations with benefits intentionally designed to help you feel supported and safe at Ambience and beyond. Some of our key benefits include Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents 401(k) with a company match of up to 3% of base salary A remote-friendly culture (with a San Francisco HQ) and full equipment provisioning to ensure you can work effectively from wherever you’re based. Parental leave to support your family needs Annual company-wide off-sites, team off-sites and regular team lunches and all-hands gatherings, with travel, lodging and meals covered Flexible time off with no annual cap, company-wide holidays and an annual holiday shutdown from December 24–January 1 designed to support real rest and long-term sustainability. Ambience Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Ambience is committed to supporting every candidate’s ability to fully participate in our hiring process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interviews, please reach out to our Recruiting team at accommodations@ambiencehealthcare.com . We’ll handle your request confidentially and work with you to ensure an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates. Ambience Healthcare has become aware of scams targeting jobseekers with fake jobs and even interviewing people. Our emails will always come from @ambiencehealthcare.com. We would never our ask candidates to download apps or make any form of payment(s). If you are contacted through WhatsApp, Telegram, similar but fake email domains, or asked to make a payment, these contacts are not legitimate. Report the issue immediately to LinkedIn and the FBI .

2663.FireCrawl Job Description: Product Marketing Manager, New Verticals The Opportunity Help expand Hinge Health access by turning complex products into clear stories, successful launches, and meaningful client adoption. As Product Marketing Manager, New Verticals, you will lead product marketing for new expansions. You will partner closely with Health Services to support health-plan approvals and with Client Success to help clients understand and adopt new offerings. Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, Digital Care, you will own GTM strategy and execution, from positioning and launch planning to building slides, writing messaging, and leading live enablement. Your work will help establish Hinge Health as a market leader in new verticals. What You’ll Accomplish In your first three months: Build expertise in current new verticals solutions, including its strengths, differentiators, and messaging within your first 30 days. Create and improve slides, messaging, FAQs, and objection-handling resources that support health-plan approvals and client conversations. Lead enablement sessions within your first 60 days and develop a reliable approach to answering questions and maintaining useful resources. In your first six months: Independently own the product marketing work supporting New verticals expansion, prioritizing approval needs with Health Services and delivering the assets partners need to move decisions forward. Drive client readiness and adoption for new offerings through coordinated launch communications, practical resources, and live enablement. Establish adoption measures with Client Success and use client feedback, recurring objections, and performance data to improve messaging and launch execution. In your first year: Help expand new verticals availability across the book of business by supporting outstanding health-plan approvals. Drive measurable client adoption of new offerings against agreed goals, tracking adoption separately from health-plan approval coverage. Lead go-to-market planning and execution for the product expansions, aligning positioning, audiences, launch milestones, partner readiness, and measurement with the product roadmap. Keep cross-functional partners and leadership informed with concise updates on progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed. Who You Are A clear communicator: You translate complex clinical and product information into concise messaging, well-structured slides, and effective live presentations. You can recommend a course of action and answer senior stakeholders’ questions directly. A hands-on owner: You connect business priorities to daily execution, create the assets yourself, and take accountability for commitments and results. A Learn-it-All: You seek feedback, apply it without defensiveness, and quickly build fluency in unfamiliar products and markets. A trusted partner: You work efficiently with Health Services, Client Success, Product, and Clinical partners, make tradeoffs explicit, and follow through. A resourceful problem-solver: You bring urgency and sound judgment, adapt when priorities change, and keep work moving through constraints. Basic Qualifications Experience independently owning product positioning, go-to-market launches, or product-adoption initiatives with measurable outcomes. Demonstrated ability to create clear messaging and presentation materials and deliver live enablement for business or client-facing teams. Experience leading cross-functional work from planning through execution, influencing partners without direct authority, and improving work through feedback. Preferred Qualifications Product marketing experience in healthcare, digital health, or another complex, evidence-based category. Experience working with benefit managers, health plans, or healthcare services teams. Experience enabling sales, client success, or partnership teams to drive adoption. Experience translating clinical or technical information into differentiated, business-relevant positioning. Experience measuring adoption and using customer feedback to improve go-to-market execution. Hinge Health Hybrid Model This role is based in San Francisco. We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program. About Hinge Health At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care, from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation, through personalized, evidence-based care. As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Source: Standard Company Information in the job-posting template . Learn more at Hinge Health . What You’ll Love About Us Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live. Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match. Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development. Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. Culture & Engagement Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. Beware of Phishing Attempts: We’ve noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We’ll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use “@ hingehealth.com ” emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. 2664.Gecko Job Description: Meet Benevity Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more! As a seasoned product marketer and leader, you possess a knack for being able to identify business and market needs, conduct research and build strategic plans, craft compelling messaging and positioning, work directly with clients, and collaborate with teams across the business to bring game-changing products to the market. You see the big picture while managing seamless execution for your portfolio. What you’ll do: Team Leadership & Coaching Mentor and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketers, providing regular coaching on core competencies such as messaging, GTM execution, and cross-functional influence. Establish a culture of professional growth by creating tailored development plans that align individual career goals with company objectives. Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, offering actionable feedback to help team members navigate complex projects and evolve their strategic thinking. Define and prioritize the team’s roadmap, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across product launches, sales enablement, and demand generation efforts. Standardize PMM workflows by implementing scalable processes for launch tiering, messaging frameworks, and competitive intelligence to ensure consistent quality across the team. Act as a strategic influencer, navigating internal stakeholder dynamics and clearing hurdles to ensure the team can execute on-time and with high impact. Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team. Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market. Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role) Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas. Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio. Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level. Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops. Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams. What you’ll bring 8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS. A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution. Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy. Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members. An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing. Outstanding presentation and business writing skills. Bonus Points Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits. Discover your purpose at work We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more … Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose. If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become … It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you. Where We Work At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most. Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams. We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine. That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity. Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

2665.FireCrawl Job Description: The role / impact As the SEM Senior Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Xero’s global Paid Search program. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on using automation, AI and data to unlock scalable growth and improve how our SEM operation works. You will help evolve the technical foundations of the channel, from AI-powered optimisation workflows and automation through to feeds, scripting and new ways of using emerging technology across search. You’ll work closely with SEM specialists, Data Science, Marketing Technology and Product teams to turn complex performance challenges into scalable solutions. Your impact will go beyond campaign optimisation. You’ll help define how Xero applies AI and automation to Paid Search, build systems that improve decision quality and speed, and act as a senior technical voice across the organisation, translating complex ideas into clear opportunities for senior stakeholders. The team / how they connect You will join Xero’s global SEM team, a specialist group spanning technical SEM, bidding and optimisation, creative and AI. The team manages Paid Search across Xero’s global markets and is focused on using data, experimentation and technology to continually improve performance and unlock new growth opportunities. You’ll work closely with the Head of SEM and our existing SEM team, while partnering across Data Science, Marketing Technology, Product, CRO and the wider Performance Marketing organisation. As a senior leader within the team, you’ll bring new ideas, share your expertise and help elevate the technical capability of those around you. Initially, you will focus on: Evolving the technical foundations of our global SEM program, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, automation and performance Building and operationalising AI-powered workflows that automate optimisation, analysis, reporting and operational processes Advancing our AI-driven SEM capabilities, including automated bidding and decision-making systems, with robust validation, guardrails and measurement Identifying and delivering new automation opportunities, turning manual or complex SEM processes into scalable, reusable solutions Partnering with Data Science, Marketing Technology and Product to connect data, AI and emerging technology into our SEM ecosystem Exploring emerging search and AI capabilities, testing where new technologies can create genuine commercial advantage Where and how you can work Xero offers a hybrid working model that balances flexibility with the value of working together in person. You’ll spend time in our office collaborating with the team, while also having the flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. As part of a global SEM and Performance Marketing team, you’ll also collaborate regularly with colleagues and partners across different markets and time zones. As the Senior Manager, Partner Marketing Programs at Vanta, you will build, scale and execute the foundational engine behind our global partner marketing strategy. This is a highly visible, highly cross functional role working closely with partner product marketing, partner enablement, partner marketing, partner sales, systems and finance. You will champion three critical focus areas to propel our partnership strategy forward: Orchestrate high-impact partner communications and community engagement —including product launches, enablement webinars, and an active partner community—designed to keep partners fully enabled, deeply engaged, and continuously choosing Vanta. Maximize Market Development Fund (MDF) Impact and ROI —strategically allocating, tracking, and optimizing investments to turn MDF into a high-yield engine for measurable pipeline expansion across our entire partner ecosystem. Scale partner pipegen programs by transforming Vanta's campaign calendar and product roadmap into robust, partner-ready packages, campaign kits, and sales plays that drive joint pipeline. Reporting to the Head of Global Strategic Partner Marketing, you will empower our partner network to grow and scale with clarity and confidence—turning strategic investments into real growth. You will ensure partner programs are properly resourced, tracked, and optimized across all six of our partner ecosystems — Solution Providers and VARs, Cloud Service Providers, Service Providers and MSPs, Audit Partners, GSIs, and Technology Partners — while equipping the team and leadership with the reporting and insight needed to make smart, fast decisions. What you’ll do as a Partner Marketing Programs Manager at Vanta: Lead partner communications, product launches, and enablement webinars while building an active partner community to ensure our ecosystem stays continuously engaged, fully enabled, and inspired to choose Vanta. Run the Vanta partner community as a core pillar of the partner program — owning the rhythm of content, enablement moments, recognition, and connection that makes partners feel like insiders Oversee partner funding and MDF programs, including AWS MDF processes, SCAs, compliance requirements, budget management and payment process execution Drive the end-to-end partner marketing lifecycle—from strategic planning and global investment allocation to rigorous lead flow management, attribution tracking, and ROI analysis—ensuring every initiative fuels continuous growth and measurable pipeline impact. Translate Vanta's campaign calendar and product roadmap into partner-ready plays, then put them directly into the hands of our regional and ecosystem partners to activate and our strategic partner marketers to make bespoke and activate with their partners How to be successful in this role: 5-7+ years of experience in partner programs, partner marketing, partner marketing operations, partner marketing communications Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with a bias for action Prior experience building and scaling partner or channel marketing programs — packaged campaigns, co-marketing kits, partner plays, or partner communities Experience supporting partner marketing teams budgets and managing MDF programs (AWS MDF and SCAs strongly preferred) Demonstrated ability to manage a full program lifecycle from planning through launch, tracking, and reporting Highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable in a startup environment where speed and ownership matter Open to using AI to amplify skills and strengthen work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. Strong proficiency in Salesforce reporting and dashboard creation. Experience with Tableau (or similar BI tools) Advanced Excel expertise (complex formulas, pivot tables, modeling, data connectors, automation) Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. 2676.FireCrawl Job Description: About DeepJudge: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: DeepJudge is growing rapidly across North America, working with some of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams. As our presence in the market continues to expand, we’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, North America to own and develop our field marketing strategy and tactics across the region. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how DeepJudge shows up in the market, from our presence at the industry’s most important conferences to executive experiences, customer programs, partner activations, and highly targeted initiatives to strengthen our positioning in the market. You’ll own programs from strategy through execution, thinking holistically about the audiences we want to reach, the experiences we create, how we activate across channels, and how each initiative contributes to our broader growth strategy. You’ll work closely with our commercial team to understand where the biggest opportunities are and translate those into creative, high-impact field programs. You’ll also collaborate with the broader Marketing team to connect field initiatives with our content, product launches, customer stories, partnerships, and integrated campaigns. We’re looking for someone who combines commercial thinking with creativity and exceptional execution – someone excited by the opportunity to build, experiment, and continuously grow the field marketing function as we scale. Your responsibilities will include: Develop a deep understanding of target personas, market trends and the competitive landscape to inform campaign planning, messaging and event positioning in the region. Evolve DeepJudge’s North American field strategy and program calendar, aligned with our GTM priorities and growth ambitions. Partner closely with Sales to understand regional priorities, target accounts, active opportunities, and customer relationships, and translate these into impactful field programs. Project Management ensures that the Directive team and the client team knows who is responsible for specific tasks to ensure we make progress towards our goals. Use of the project management tool Asana is required. This includes delegating tasks to other team members, such as Specialists, as well as our clients and then ensuring that these tasks are completed in a timely manner. In pods where Project Managers are present, Strategists will ensure they partner with Project Managers to ensure all tasks are created, assigned and due dates are met and communicated to the client Strategists will work closely with content writers and designers to complete content campaigns for clients on time while also being responsible for ensuring that the quality is up to client standards. Internal and External Communication: Strategists are the main interface between our clients and our team. Strategists are expected to build relationships with our clients that goes beyond just deliverables and get to know them on a human level with the primary goal of being the best consultant for our clients and their business. Additionally Strategists are expected to proactively communicate to clients and internal leadership on a regular basis to ensure we are driving the best results for clients. When proactively communicating with clients we want to ensure we communicate timeline expectations for deliverables, goal attainment progress, and actively use our shared communication channels, such as Slack, to communicate between bi-weekly meetings. This includes sending deliverables on a regular cadence instead of only during bi-weekly meetings When proactively communicating with internal leadership this should include communicating any roadblocks, opportunities for account growth, and any moments of change on clients accounts. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country. This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. 2680.Gecko Job Description: Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Set the objective, and the system runs until you hit it. We’re 1,000+ customers across 20+ countries, backed by a16z and Y Combinator. About this role Nash is hiring its first global field and event marketing lead. You will own how Nash shows up in person: the event strategy for the company, and the field execution behind it in every region. You will build the event calendar with our regional GTM leads, and lead a team of regional field managers across APAC, EMEA and North America. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with Sales leaders in each region. What you own The event calendar. You decide which shows and sponsorships earn a place, and how big Nash goes at each one. The account list for each event, shared with Sales, so events and outreach point the same way. What each event returned, and what that says about where Nash shows up next. The field budget across regions, invested against pipeline and deal acceleration. Every in-person moment Nash creates: booths, dinners, hosted events, gifting, merch and swag. ABM events for our top accounts, built with the account teams. Executive dinners, onsites, and gifts made for one account at a time. The relationships with show organizers, partners and vendors that earn speaking slots, better booth placement, and co-hosted events. Vendors and production partners in every region. You choose them, set the terms, and hold them to the standard, across booth build, print, swag, freight and storage. The content each event produces. You shoot your own, direct photographers and videographers, and get attendees and the team posting. Internal events, including all-hands and company offsites, held to the same standard as the ones customers see. The regional team. You hire the field managers, set the standard, and keep running the events that matter most yourself. What you bring 7+ years in B2B field or event marketing, across more than one region. Shows you owned outright. You picked them, ran them, and answered for what came back. You have run an event people wanted to come to and talked about afterward. One you were proud of, and that became a flagship part of the company. A team you built and led across time zones, employees or contractors, including the hiring. Super self-starter. You find the person who can unblock you, and you can put something good together on budget and with days' notice, then build the system that makes the next one easier to run. Taste and polish. You know the difference between a booth people stop at and one they walk past, and the details guests notice are right, from the invite through the run of show. Pipeline and the big picture. You can walk through the pipeline your events produced and how it moved, and you plan a year of events as one program rather than a series of one-offs. AI already in your workflow, and something you built or improved that you can show us. Command of budget and logistics at scale, and steadiness in the week of a show. Willingness to travel 30 to 40% of the year. How to Apply Send us your resume, links or photos of events you have run, and a short note on the one you are proudest of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through that event, the invite that filled the room, or the run of show behind it, that is very much encouraged. Want to grab our attention and bypass the Recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH. Your application pings us in Slack the moment it lands. If you are show ready at 8am on the first morning of a conference, this is nothing. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. 2680.FireCrawl Job Description: Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Set the objective, and the system runs until you hit it. We’re 1,000+ customers across 20+ countries, backed by a16z and Y Combinator. About this role Nash is hiring its first global field and event marketing lead. You will own how Nash shows up in person: the event strategy for the company, and the field execution behind it in every region. You will build the event calendar with our regional GTM leads, and lead a team of regional field managers across APAC, EMEA and North America. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with Sales leaders in each region. What you own The event calendar. You decide which shows and sponsorships earn a place, and how big Nash goes at each one. The account list for each event, shared with Sales, so events and outreach point the same way. What each event returned, and what that says about where Nash shows up next. The field budget across regions, invested against pipeline and deal acceleration. Every in-person moment Nash creates: booths, dinners, hosted events, gifting, merch and swag. ABM events for our top accounts, built with the account teams. Executive dinners, onsites, and gifts made for one account at a time. The relationships with show organizers, partners and vendors that earn speaking slots, better booth placement, and co-hosted events. Vendors and production partners in every region. You choose them, set the terms, and hold them to the standard, across booth build, print, swag, freight and storage. The content each event produces. You shoot your own, direct photographers and videographers, and get attendees and the team posting. Internal events, including all-hands and company offsites, held to the same standard as the ones customers see. The regional team. You hire the field managers, set the standard, and keep running the events that matter most yourself. What you bring 7+ years in B2B field or event marketing, across more than one region. Shows you owned outright. You picked them, ran them, and answered for what came back. You have run an event people wanted to come to and talked about afterward. One you were proud of, and that became a flagship part of the company. A team you built and led across time zones, employees or contractors, including the hiring. Super self-starter. You find the person who can unblock you, and you can put something good together on budget and with days' notice, then build the system that makes the next one easier to run. Taste and polish. You know the difference between a booth people stop at and one they walk past, and the details guests notice are right, from the invite through the run of show. Pipeline and the big picture. You can walk through the pipeline your events produced and how it moved, and you plan a year of events as one program rather than a series of one-offs. AI already in your workflow, and something you built or improved that you can show us. Command of budget and logistics at scale, and steadiness in the week of a show. Willingness to travel 30 to 40% of the year. How to Apply Send us your resume, links or photos of events you have run, and a short note on the one you are proudest of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through that event, the invite that filled the room, or the run of show behind it, that is very much encouraged. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.
