We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world. Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world. Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor. Own email creation in HubSpot , building marketing emails from start to finish using templates, modules, and personalization tokens. Build and segment lists , creating targeted lists in HubSpot so each email reaches the right audience. Run A/B tests , testing subject lines, content, send times, and calls to action, and applying what you learn to future emails. Analyze email metrics to guide decisions , tracking open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes, and using the results to recommend changes to content, timing, and audiences. Maintain the email calendar , planning and scheduling sends across teams so campaigns are coordinated and audiences aren't over-emailed. Manage the approval process for email sending , getting emails to reviewers on time, tracking feedback and sign-off, and making sure nothing is sent before it's approved. Maintain oversight of marketing team inbox , organizing, deleting and responding to email responses as necessary. Test every email before it goes out , checking links, merge fields, recipient lists, and how each email looks on desktop and mobile. Turn campaign briefs into finished emails , working with marketing team members to get copy, images, and calls to action ready for review. Create basic graphics in Canva , including email banners, buttons, and simple images, using Cin7 brand guidelines and approved templates. Hand larger design projects to our graphic designer. Keep email assets organized , including templates, saved content, and image files, so the team can find and reuse them. Follow email best practices and privacy rules , including unsubscribe handling and consent requirements for the regions we send to. What you'll bring: 2-3 years of experience in email marketing, marketing operations, or a similar role. Hands-on experience building and sending emails in HubSpot's marketing email tool. Experience building and segmenting lists in HubSpot. Experience running A/B tests and using the results to improve future emails. The ability to read email metrics and turn them into clear recommendations. A basic understanding of HubSpot workflows, such as enrolling contacts and sending automated emails. Basic graphic design skills and working experience with Canva. Experience using Asana or similar project management tool (ClickUp, Trello, Etc.) Strong writing and proofreading skills, with close attention to detail. The ability to manage several projects at once, keep a calendar on track, and meet deadlines. Clear, friendly communication with teammates across time zones. A willingness to learn new tools, including AI-powered tools, that help you work faster and improve results. Nice to have: HubSpot certifications, basic HTML and CSS for email troubleshooting, and familiarity with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL. Own a key part of how Cin7 communicates with prospects, customers, and partners. Grow your HubSpot and email marketing skills with support from an experienced marketing operations team. Work closely with a collaborative marketing team. See the results of your work in every campaign you send. Competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, and a 401k company match program. A flexible PTO policy, allowing you the time you need to recharge. A diverse team, where everyone helps each other and inclusion is a core value. Remote work flexibility allows you to maintain a work-life balance in a way that suits your needs. Frequent company-sponsored events so you can get to know your coworkers. Why CIN7? CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company. At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock. We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

2763.FireCrawl Job Description: At Gurobi Optimization, we're on a mission! A mission that focuses on mathematical optimization. We empower our customers to expand their use of mathematical optimization technology in order to make smarter decisions and solve some of the world's toughest and most impactful business problems. We're looking for passionate, dedicated, innovative game-changers to join our team and drive the future of Gurobi. As the Director of Marketing - EMEA at Gurobi Optimization, you will lead the execution of marketing strategies for EMEA, ensuring alignment with business objectives. You will oversee campaign development, brand positioning, demand generation, and cross-functional collaboration to drive pipeline growth, customer engagement, and brand awareness. You will mentor and manage a high-performing marketing team, providing leadership in digital marketing, content strategy, and data-driven decision-making. Your ability to foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and accountability will be essential in achieving marketing excellence. Develop and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns to enhance brand awareness, lead generation, and customer retention. Align marketing initiatives with company-wide objectives and sales priorities to maximize impact. Optimize digital marketing campaigns, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media. Drive lead-generation initiatives to support sales pipeline growth and business expansion. Utilize data-driven insights to refine targeting, improve conversion rates, and maximize ROI. Collaborate with sales leadership to optimize account-based marketing (ABM) strategies. Oversee the development and execution of high-quality content (whitepapers, case studies, webinars, blog posts, and videos). Ensure brand consistency across all messaging, campaigns, and marketing materials. Conduct market research to stay ahead of industry trends, competitive positioning, and customer expectations. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of marketing professionals to drive operational excellence. Foster a culture of creativity, ownership, and accountability within the marketing organization. Collaborate with sales, product, and customer success teams to align marketing efforts with business needs. Establish key marketing performance indicators (KPIs) to measure effectiveness and inform decision-making. Manage and optimize the marketing budget to ensure efficiency and impact. Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on campaign performance and market opportunities. 10 years of experience in B2B marketing, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role. Proven experience in demand generation, campaign management, and digital marketing. Strong background in marketing analytics, automation tools (Marketo, HubSpot), and CRM platforms (Salesforce). Experience leading marketing programs for SaaS or technology-focused businesses. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred). Strategic Leadership – Ability to set vision, drive execution, and align marketing with company growth objectives. Data-Driven Decision-Making – Proficiency in analytics tools to track campaign effectiveness and optimize strategy. Cross-Functional Collaboration – Strong ability to work across teams (sales, product, customer success) to drive alignment. Content & Brand Storytelling – Ability to craft compelling messaging that resonates with target audiences. Strong Communication Skills – Verbal and written skills to influence stakeholders and inspire teams. Project & Budget Management – Ability to lead multiple marketing initiatives within financial constraints. Proficient in using macOS and Microsoft 365. Fluent in managing and utilizing Marketo, a marketing automation platform. Comfortable with learning and utilizing Salesforce, a customer relationship management (CRM) platform. Customer Focus: Verbal & written communication skills that bring clarity and build trust. Power of the Team: Motivated with a team-oriented mindset that aims to both inspire and be inspired by others. Innovation: The courage to bring ideas forward and see yourself as an integral part of our global team. Dedication: Organized and agile, focusing on meeting professional objectives while promoting a healthy work/life balance. Integrity: Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility. Gurobi Optimization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Gurobi Optimization is an E-Verify employer. As part of our hiring process, we utilize the federal E-Verify program to verify the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For additional information regarding E-Verify, please visit www.e-verify.gov.

2764.FireCrawl Job Description: About Handshake Handshake is the career network for the AI economy. 20 million knowledge workers, 1,600 educational institutions, 1 million employers (including 100% of the Fortune 50), and every foundational AI lab trust Handshake to power career discovery, hiring, and upskilling, from freelance AI training gigs to first internships to full-time careers and beyond. This unique value is leading to unparalleled growth; in 2025, we tripled our ARR at scale. Why join Handshake now: Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel Work hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions Join a team with leadership from Scale AI, Meta, xAI, Notion, Coinbase, and Palantir, among others Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue The Role As Director, Product Marketing, you will own how the market sees Handshake on the employer side: not as a college job board, but as the career network employers rely on to find and hire talent in the AI economy. You will set the narrative and category strategy that puts Handshake in front of CHROs and talent leaders, and lead a team of product marketers who bring it to life across every launch and channel. You will report to the VP, Marketing and inherit a team of 3-4 product marketers, partnering closely with the EDU-side product marketing lead, Product, Sales, and the executive team. Define and own the employer narrative and positioning that shows how the market sees Handshake, so that employers and CHROs see us as a strategic hiring partner rather than a college job board Create and evolve the category story for the employer buyer, elevating our message beyond product features to win mindshare in a crowded HR tech landscape Build thought leadership and content channels that put Handshake leaders in front of CHROs and senior talent decision-makers, growing executive awareness and pipeline influence Lead, coach, and grow a team of 3-4 product marketers, setting a high bar for craft and strategic thinking across employer-side launches Partner with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to translate roadmap and customer insight into launches and messaging that drive adoption and revenue Align with product marketing on the EDU side and adjacent teams, including Handshake AI and our learning offerings, to keep one unified Handshake story across audiences You Have 8+ years in B2B product marketing, including leading a team of product marketers A track record of creating or evolving a category, with the vision to reposition a company or product in the market Experience elevating a narrative beyond the product, rather than selling primarily on features and specs Experience marketing a marketplace or employment-related product, where the value comes from connecting both sides Experience building executive-level content and thought leadership that reaches senior buyers such as CHROs Strong cross-functional partnership with Product, Sales, and executive leadership on launches and go-to-market Exceptional strategic storytelling and writing, with a high bar for craft in your own work and your team's Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to work from our SF office Bonus points: HR tech or recruiting technology background, or existing relationships with talent and HR leaders Experience marketing to both a supply side and a demand side of a two-sided network We Offer Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported — and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full-time US employees. 🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company 💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching 🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching 💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend 📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development 💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office 🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days 🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers .

2765.FireCrawl Job Description: Our Purpose At Xero, we’re here to make running a business beautiful. By making small business more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology and empowering a community behind them, their potential is limitless. When that happens, we’re not only helping small business, we’ll be building a stronger economy that can change the world. The role and its impact Product Marketing at Xero works closely with both Product and Go-to-market teams across the business to bring a holistic view of customer needs to Product, and translate product initiatives into customer value. We do this so that we deliver maximum product value to customers as efficiently and effectively as possible. In this fixed-term role, you’ll help shape and grow Xero’s global Payments products, including bill payments and invoice payments. You’ll bring customer, market and commercial insight into product decisions; define clear customer value, positioning and evidence-backed claims; and partner with Product and global and regional go-to-market teams to launch products and improve adoption, usage and revenue. You’ll identify and test opportunities to deliver differentiated value for small businesses and their advisors. You’ll build trusted cross-functional relationships, understand the portfolio and its commercial priorities, and shape a focused set of launch and growth opportunities. You will be a key contributor in assessing market opportunity Partner with Strategy, Product Management, Design and research and analytics teams to understand small businesses, advisors, competitors and market dynamics across Payments, and identify the customer problems and opportunities that matter most. Synthesise customer research, product performance and regional feedback into clear insights and recommendations that inform product strategy, positioning and go-to-market plans. Help size and prioritise market opportunities, define the customer and advisor segments to focus on, and identify where Xero can win; use market-sizing measures such as serviceable available market where relevant. You will lead Customer Value Propositions, including development, maintenance, and custodianship throughout Xero Lead a collaborative process with Product and Customer teams to define the value proposition for priority segments, including the customer problem, differentiated value, reasons to believe and supporting evidence. Translate value propositions into clear positioning, messaging frameworks and product playbooks that internal teams can use consistently across customer touchpoints. Maintain and update positioning, claims and evidence as customer needs, product capabilities, competitor activity and regional requirements change. You will partner with Product and Go-to-market leads on priority launches and significant product changes, bringing the customer and commercial perspective into launch strategy, sequencing and readiness. Translate product plans and changes into clear customer value, and keep relevant Customer and regional stakeholders informed of priorities and readiness. Work with Product and regional Customer teams to shape launch timing and approach, set clear value and claims guardrails, and surface dependencies or customer risks early. Develop clear briefing and enablement resources for Sales, advisors, Customer Experience and other internal teams so they can explain product value and support customers. You will partner with Product and Go-to-market teams, including Lifecycle, to identify and grow Payments opportunities Use customer insight, product analytics and regional feedback to identify opportunities to improve adoption, attach, usage, retention and revenue, and recommend where to focus against commercial priorities. Develop and prioritise growth hypotheses and experiments with Product, Lifecycle, Data and regional teams; support test design, customer messaging and measurement, then apply the learnings. Shape in-product and lifecycle strategy for priority growth opportunities, partnering with channel owners on targeting, journey design and execution. Where And How You Can Work This is a hybrid role based in Melbourne. You will spend part of your week in our Melbourne office to collaborate with your team and partners, with boost days as an opportunity to come together in person and build relationships across the business. As you will work across time zones and regions, you will also get comfortable with flexible hours and asynchronous updates. Here are some of the things we’re looking for, for this role Strong product marketing experience, or experience in lifecycle, growth or customer marketing (preferably within a SaaS organisation) Experience in payments, financial services or another complex, transaction-based product is an advantage; the ability to learn complex products and customer needs is essential. Experience working across geographies and time zones, partnering with Product Managers and development teams in an agile environment, will help you succeed in this role. Proven experience developing customer lifecycle and growth strategies, including messaging, channel planning, measurement and optimisation. Ability to think strategically, work independently and effectively in a fast paced environment Self-motivated and collaborative, with strong planning, prioritisation and coordination skills and attention to detail. Creative problem solver who can incorporate new learnings into existing plans and act decisively and independently Strong communication, analytical, critical thinking and business strategy skills A gift for storytelling: turning complex Payments products and propositions into clear, compelling language customers can understand and act on. Ability to handle the pace and ambiguity that comes with working in a fast-paced tech environment

2766.FireCrawl Job Description: The Opportunity As Senior Manager of Product Marketing at Coursedog, you'll lead the strategic vision and execution of our product marketing function, positioning our Intelligent Academic Operations Platform as the essential solution for higher ed institutions. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership to drive go-to-market strategy, competitive positioning, and customer advocacy. You'll own translating market insights into compelling positioning and messaging that resonates across multiple buyer personas and use cases. You’ll drive alignment across teams and accelerate our market leadership in the higher ed space by balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, deep market research with rapid iteration, and customer empathy with business acumen. If you're excited by the challenge of establishing Coursedog as the market leader in education operations and want to help institutions break down barriers to student success at scale, this is a chance to do meaningful work with real impact. This position offers a competitive base salary between $125,000 - $130,000 , based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to $135,000 - $150,000 when performance objectives are achieved. What You'll Do Own and evolve the overall product marketing strategy, including positioning, messaging architecture, and go-to-market plans across all platform modules and buyer segments Oversee market and competitive research initiatives to inform segmentation, persona development, pricing strategy, and long-term product roadmap alignment Drive alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership on strategy, messaging, and priorities—escalating and resolving conflicts to accelerate execution Establish and oversee key performance indicators across product marketing activities, including pipeline influence, win rates, competitive win/loss analysis, and customer satisfaction metrics Develop comprehensive customer advocacy programs, including advisory boards, case studies, testimonials, and customer reference networks that amplify our market presence Lead the creation and evolution of high-impact customer and prospect-facing assets—positioning documents, competitive battlecards, sales enablement materials, website content, videos, and thought leadership Own sales enablement strategy and execution, ensuring sales teams have the insights, messaging, and tools to effectively communicate value to different buyer personas and use cases Represent Coursedog as a thought leader and spokesperson at industry events, conferences, analyst briefings, and speaking engagements, often including presentations Establish and nurture relationships with industry analysts, press, and key opinion leaders to shape market perception and third-party credibility Onsite travel for conferences and events expected 20% throughout the year Leverage AI and emerging technologies to enhance product marketing efficiency and effectiveness—from market research and content creation to competitive analysis and customer insights Requirements What You'll Bring 3-5 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or strategic role. Higher Ed experience is preferred but not mandatory. Deep expertise in market research, competitive analysis, buyer persona development, and segmentation methodologies Demonstrated ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging that resonates across multiple audiences and personas Strong strategic thinking combined with execution excellence—able to set vision while rolling up sleeves to deliver high-quality assets Experience driving sales enablement, working directly with sales teams, and measuring impact on pipeline and revenue outcomes Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior leadership across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success Excellent communication and storytelling skills—comfortable presenting to executives, customers, and external audiences internally and externally at conferences Experience with SaaS pricing strategy, packaging, or go-to-market launches Knowledge of or passion for the higher education market or complex B2B enterprise software environments An empathetic, curious mindset paired with strong business acumen and ownership mentality Experience using AI tools and technologies effectively to drive productivity and creativity in marketing strategy, content development, and cross-functional collaboration Not sure if you should apply? Research shows that women and people from underrepresented backgrounds are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification listed. At Coursedog, we're focused on finding the best person for the role, and that person may come from a non-traditional background. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement — our evaluation focuses on your ability to thrive in this role and make an impact. Benefits About Coursedog At Coursedog, our mission is simple but ambitious: to break down barriers to student success. Founded by former college students who were frustrated by outdated academic systems, Coursedog was built to empower higher ed administrators to deliver exceptional educational experiences and make it easier for students to achieve their goals. Since then, we’ve grown into a platform trusted by institutions across the country. Coursedog is the Intelligent Academic Operations Platform, empowering 500+ colleges and universities to better serve over 4 million students. Our platform brings together academic scheduling, curriculum and catalog management, assessment, and workflow automation — all designed to adapt to each institution’s unique needs and remove administrative roadblocks so educators can focus on helping students succeed. We’re a remote-first, fast-growing company and a Forbes Top 500 U.S. Startup Employer, with a culture that prioritizes engagement, ownership, and impact. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems, working with thoughtful teammates, and improving education at scale, you’ll feel right at home at Coursedog. Working at Coursedog Healthcare, Dental & Vision We follow a fixed contribution model to promote equity and transparency. Every employee receives the same annual dollar amount to apply toward medical, dental, and vision coverage. This approach gives you the flexibility to choose the plan that best fits your needs, whether that is a base-level option or more comprehensive coverage. Depending on the selected coverage level, the company covers: Employee-only coverage: 65% to 99% of monthly premiums Employee plus dependents: 45% to 75% of monthly premiums We partner with Aetna and Guardian, and offer access to best-in-class wellness and support programs, including: Spring Health (mental health support) XP Health (vision benefits) Carrot Fertility (family planning support) One Medical (primary care) We also support pre-tax savings through Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA). Retirement Planning To support long-term financial health, we offer a Safe Harbor 401(k) plan from day one of employment. Coursedog provides a 4% employer match on your total compensation (subject to federal limits) each pay period for employees contributing to a tax-advantaged retirement account. Paid Time Off We trust our employees to manage their time responsibly. That’s why we offer an unlimited Paid Time Off policy — because flexibility and balance are critical for sustained excellence and personal well-being. Remote-First Since Inception We were built for distributed work. Our culture emphasizes flexibility over rigidity, outcomes over hours, and transparency over gatekeeping. We are committed to being a remote-first organization indefinitely, empowering you to work where and how you thrive best. Equity As a valued contributor to our collective success, you’ll participate in the upside. All employees are granted equity in the company aligned to your role and tenure. Equity grants are reviewed and adjusted with promotions to reflect your evolving impact. Paid Parental Leave We proudly support working parents with industry-leading benefits. Employees are eligible for up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave. This benefit is available to all eligible employees, regardless of gender or family structure.

2767.Job Title: Marketing Data & Automation Analyst for a DTC E-Commerce Company (Remote)
2767.FireCrawl Job Description: Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located. Our client is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) health & wellness gummy supplement brand, offering products designed to support everyday health and wellness, including Hair, Skin & Nails, Apple Cider Vinegar, and Immune Support gummies. Role Overview: We are looking for a Marketing Data & Automation Analyst to help turn paid media data into actionable insights and build smarter, more efficient marketing workflows. Key Responsibilities: Analyze paid media and advertising performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Interpret campaign data and translate complex outputs into clear, actionable insights. Build, maintain, and improve automated marketing and data workflows. Use tools such as Make.com, Claude, and AI-powered marketing/ad platforms to automate analysis and operational processes. Connect and organize data from different marketing sources to improve reporting and decision-making. Identify patterns, anomalies, and performance changes across paid media campaigns. Support the media buying team with data-driven analysis and recommendations. Develop AI-assisted processes for recurring analysis, reporting, and marketing operations. Continuously evaluate new AI, automation, and data tools that can improve the team's workflows. Work in an evolving environment where processes and technologies are continuously changing. Requirements Background in engineering, software development, coding, automation, data analytics, or a closely related technical field. Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or other AI-assisted tools for analytical or operational workflows. Experience in DTC, e-commerce, performance marketing, or consumer brands. Experience working with or interpreting marketing, advertising, or paid media data. Ability to understand large or complex datasets and identify meaningful trends. Comfortable using AI tools and automation platforms. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Ability to work independently and adapt to changing tools, systems, and workflows. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or other paid media platforms. Experience with Make.com or similar automation platforms. Familiarity with Shopify and subscription-based e-commerce businesses. Experience building automated reporting or marketing dashboards. Benefits Competitive salary in USD Fully remote work environment with flexible scheduling

2768.Gecko Job Description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://clickhouse.com/es NOTE: this position can be remote anywhere within the United States. As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders. What you will do: Define and drive the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, with a focus on cloud-native database capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, and schema evolution. Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements to the core database engine, storage layer, and query optimizer, ensuring the Cloud offering keeps pace with open-source and enterprise use cases. Engage directly with customers, gathering insights through interactions, feedback, and market research to guide product decisions. Work alongside design, marketing, operations, and sales teams to support feature launches, contribute to blog posts, and help shape product positioning and messaging. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success. Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related communications, effectively managing expectations and keeping stakeholders informed. About You: Minimum 8+ years of product management experience with a strong background in cloud-based SaaS products. Deep familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, or real-time analytics platforms is strongly preferred. Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning. Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other columnar databases. Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks. Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design. Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences. Bonus Points: Experience working and scaling open source technologies Prior experience at a startup Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Please see here for our Privacy Statement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickhouse-principal-product-marketing-manager

2769.Gecko Job Description: Headquarters: EMEA Remote About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Rosie, Events Team Manager here at Customer.io , and I am looking for an Events Marketing Manager to own our in-person events across EMEA. You'll lead live field events, hosted customer and prospect experiences, and sponsored conferences across the region, and run our monthly EMEA webinar. You'll partner closely with Demand Gen, Content, Design, Partnerships, and EMEA Sales to create events that feel polished, thoughtful, and unmistakably "us" - tailored to EMEA markets rather than a copy-paste of NA programming. You'll ramp alongside our Events Manager, who currently supports the region, and take full ownership of EMEA within your first 90 days. This role includes 15%+ travel for EMEA field events, conferences, and onsite support. What we value Human-centered experiences. You create events that feel thoughtful, relevant, and genuinely useful - built for EMEA audiences. Collaborative energy. You work smoothly across teams and time zones, and make alignment feel easy. Insight-driven decisions. You let data guide you while keeping the attendee experience at the center. Action with intention. You move quickly, adapt gracefully, and learn from every event. Operational clarity. You bring structure, calm, and consistency to fast-moving, cross-market work. What you’ll do Event planning & coordination Own and manage the EMEA in-person events calendar - field events, hosted experiences, sponsored conferences, and activations across the region Partner with the Events Team and Demand Gen to define goals, audiences, formats, and success metrics specific to EMEA markets Evaluate EMEA sponsorships, speaking slots, and event formats against goals Work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure every event feels cohesive with global campaigns while staying relevant to EMEA audiences Execution & project management Manage day-to-day logistics: vendor coordination, timelines, run-of-show, speaker prep, and on-the-ground support for EMEA events Partner with Content, Brand, Product Marketing, and Sales to develop compelling event assets and presentations Oversee registration flows, pre-event communication, and the attendee experience from first touch to follow-up Step in wherever needed to keep events running smoothly, calmly, and on-brand EMEA webinars (about one per month) Run our monthly EMEA webinar end to end - topic and speaker selection, registration, promotion, and follow-up - timed and localized for a European audience Partner with Content and Product Marketing to adapt or build webinar content that lands with EMEA audiences Build and optimize registration pages, forms, and workflows for EMEA campaigns Audience growth & promotion Execute multi-channel promotional plans across email, social, and partner channels for EMEA audiences Collaborate with Demand Gen, Marketing Ops & Sales to ensure EMEA lead capture, routing, and follow-up happen correctly and quickly Manage attendee communication throughout the event lifecycle Performance & optimization Track EMEA event performance - pipeline, revenue, deal acceleration, and event engagement Share insights and recommendations to continually improve ROI and attendee experience across the region Maintain documentation, templates, and repeatable workflows that make running EMEA events smoother and more scalable Partner with ops to ensure clean attribution and accurate reporting across systems What success looks like Regional ownership: EMEA events and webinars run smoothly, predictably, and feel built for the region Engagement growth: Attendance and engagement steadily increase across EMEA field events and webinars Sales alignment: EMEA Sales and Marketing feel tightly connected and supported by event-driven pipeline Sharper insights: You surface insights that help the program get sharper, smarter, and more efficient over time Better playbooks: EMEA-specific playbooks, templates, and processes get better and help the team move faster What we're looking for You're a hands-on, highly organized marketer who loves building great experiences and understands how events translate into revenue. You're comfortable owning a region end to end - you stay grounded under pressure, thrive in a distributed environment, and enjoy the cross-market collaboration required to make EMEA events exceptional. Based in the UK or Ireland (London or Dublin ideal) 4+ years in event marketing within B2B SaaS Experience running in-person events across formats (field events, hosted experiences, conferences), ideally across multiple EMEA markets Experience running webinars, and real excitement about doing both: a busy in-person calendar plus about one webinar a month Strong project management skills - you juggle timelines, tasks, and teams (and time zones) with ease Experience collaborating with Sales and supporting event-driven follow-up Comfortable with marketing automation tools ( Customer.io , Marketo, etc.) and Salesforce Familiarity with webinar platforms (Livestorm, Zoom, Sequel) and event management tools Understanding of lead capture, UTMs, and event pipeline attribution Ability to partner with Rev/Marketing Ops to troubleshoot data flows and ensure clean reporting Comfortable with 15%+ travel Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $93,000 - $110,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. 2770.FireCrawl Job Description: Role: Influencer Marketing Manager Team: Brand, Marketing Location: Remote or hybrid on-site at the Studio McGee | McGee & Co. HQ in Draper, UT Employment Type: Full-Time Overview: Studio McGee is looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day strategy and execution of our influencer and creator marketing program. This role will help evolve our influencer program beyond gifting and traditional affiliate relationships into a more intentional mix of organic relationships, paid creator partnerships, affiliate commerce, and high-performing creator content that can be amplified across the broader marketing ecosystem. The Influencer Marketing Manager will identify and cultivate creators who authentically represent the Studio McGee brand, develop partnerships that introduce new customers to Studio McGee and drive product discovery, and build a pipeline of compelling creator content that can be leveraged across paid media, email, social, PDPs, and other owned channels. The ideal candidate has strong instincts for brand and design, understands the creator landscape, is highly relationship-oriented, and is equally comfortable evaluating creative quality and analyzing performance. Who We are: Founded in 2014, Studio McGee, Inc. is one of the fastest growing home design brands in America. Our journey began with a thriving interiors business that focused on approachable, yet aspirational design. By leveraging the power of digital communities, we were able to expand our footprint in the interior design industry through an unconventional approach that connected us with our consumers. We continued to carry that forward-thinking attitude into the launch of our retail business, McGee & Co., which anchors the operational and revenue growth of our company. Our licensing partnerships allow us to further expand our design voice beyond our own collection. From a multi-year partnership with Target to an Emmy-nominated Netflix Series and a NY Times Best-Selling book, Studio McGee's passion is to empower people to design with an approachability that enhances their daily life and elevates their every day. Whether following us on social media or becoming part of our company, we invite you to join us on our mission to “Make Life Beautiful.” What You'll Do: Influencer Strategy & Partnerships Execute Studio McGee's influencer and creator strategy across organic, gifting, affiliate, and paid partnerships. Identify and develop relationships with creators who authentically represent Studio McGee's aesthetic, values, and customer. Build and manage a strong pipeline of creators across different audience sizes, categories, and markets. Develop paid creator partnerships with clear objectives, deliverables, timelines, compensation structures, and performance expectations. Manage creator relationships from initial outreach and negotiation through content delivery, reporting, and ongoing relationship management. Partner with the Director of Brand and CMO to continually refine where and how Studio McGee invests in influencer marketing. Creator Commerce & Affiliate Manage creator relationships and programs across platforms including ShopMy, LTK, and AWIN. Use affiliate and commerce data to identify creators with strong brand alignment and demonstrated ability to influence purchasing behavior. Partner with internal teams to identify priority products and categories for creator campaigns, with an emphasis on key growth categories such as furniture, lighting, rugs, bedding, and seasonal collections. Develop strategies that balance product discovery, new customer acquisition, content creation, and attributable revenue. Continually evaluate creator and campaign performance to determine where to increase, decrease, or redirect investment. Creator Content & Amplification Build a scalable pipeline of high-quality creator content that extends beyond creators' organic audiences. Secure appropriate content usage rights and whitelisting permissions as part of paid partnerships. Partner with Paid Media, Creative, Social, E-commerce, and Email teams to identify creator content that can be amplified across marketing channels. Help develop and test different applications of creator content, including creator-led advertising, brand voiceovers, product-focused edits, PDP content, and promotional campaigns. Identify high-performing creator content and partnerships that can be scaled or repeated. Gifting & Relationship Management Oversee Studio McGee's influencer gifting and product-seeding program. Develop thoughtful gifting strategies tied to launches, seasonal priorities, and key product categories rather than relying solely on broad product seeding. Maintain strong, authentic relationships with existing creators while continuously identifying new voices and audiences. Manage creator communications and ensure partners have a consistently high-quality Studio McGee experience. Retail & Local Influencer Support Build relationships with relevant creators in markets surrounding Studio McGee retail locations and future store openings. Partner with Brand and Retail teams to identify the right creators to support store openings, shopping experiences, product launches, and local activations. Own the influencer component of events and activations, including creator identification, outreach, attendance, deliverables, and follow-up. Partner with the Director of Brand on broader events and community initiatives while remaining focused on influencer and creator participation. Measurement & Optimization Establish clear objectives and KPIs for influencer campaigns before launch. Track performance across paid partnerships, gifting, affiliate activity, content, and product/category initiatives. Measure both brand and commercial impact, including reach, engagement, content performance, traffic, new customer acquisition, affiliate revenue, ROAS, and product sales where measurable. Partner with Performance Marketing and Analytics teams to understand how creator content performs when amplified through paid media. Develop regular reporting that identifies what's working, what isn't, and where Studio McGee should invest next. Maintain budget discipline and evaluate partnerships based on both performance and strategic brand value. What You'll Bring: 4–6+ years of experience in influencer, creator, affiliate, social, or related digital marketing roles, preferably within a consumer, lifestyle, home, fashion, beauty, or retail brand. Hands-on experience managing influencer relationships and paid creator partnerships. Experience with creator commerce and affiliate platforms such as ShopMy, LTK, AWIN, or similar platforms. Understanding of influencer contracting, content usage rights, whitelisting, paid amplification, and creator compensation models. Strong understanding of social platforms and the evolving creator landscape. Ability to evaluate both the creative quality of content and its business performance. Strong analytical skills and comfort using performance data to make investment decisions. Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and project-management skills. Strong aesthetic judgment and an understanding of what makes content feel authentic to a premium design and lifestyle brand. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple creator relationships, campaigns, product launches, and deadlines simultaneously. Collaborative working style and ability to partner effectively across Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Retail, PR, and Social. What Success Looks Like: Success in this role means Studio McGee has a focused, measurable, and scalable creator program that: Introduces Studio McGee to new and relevant audiences. Builds lasting relationships with creators who authentically represent the brand. Drives meaningful product discovery and customer acquisition. Produces high-quality creator content that performs beyond the creator's own channels. Creates a repeatable pipeline of content for paid media, email, PDPs, social, and other owned channels. Uses performance data to continually improve where and how we invest. Supports Studio McGee's growth as both a premier design and taste leader and a leading home furnishings brand. Benefits: Remote or hybrid flexibility Competitive compensation + bonuses Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet) Open PTO and company paid holidays 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales McGee is proud to be an equal opportunity employer - we see the beauty of celebrating our teams' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Together we Make Life Beautiful.

2771.Gecko Job Description: Web Marketing Manager Mountain View, CA- Hybrid; Draper, UT- Hybrid; Remote (Pacific, Mountain) EGNYTE YOUR CAREER. SPARK YOUR PASSION. Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people. We believe that every role has a great impact, and every Egnyter should be respected. When joining Egnyte, you’re not just landing a new career, you become part of a team of Egnyters that are doers, thinkers, and collaborators who embrace and live by our values: Invested Relationships Fiscal Prudence Candid Conversations ABOUT EGNYTE Egnyte is the secure multi-cloud platform for content security and governance that enables organizations to better protect and collaborate on their most valuable content. Established in 2008, Egnyte has democratized cloud content security for more than 22,000 organizations, helping customers improve data security, maintain compliance, prevent and detect ransomware threats, and boost employee productivity on any app, any cloud, anywhere. For more information, visit www.egnyte.com. The Web Marketing Manager is accountable for what goes on egnyte.com, how it is organized, and how well it performs. This is a hands-on role to manage the day-to-day work of the site and lead the projects that improve it. Success takes a data-driven approach to prioritizing the work that will have the greatest impact, strong collaboration with creative, web development, product marketing, and conversion optimization, and the ability to turn their goals into pages that perform. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Responsible for egnyte.com — what is on the pages, how they are organized, and how well they perform. Be hands-on. You will be personally responsible for the work and close to the details of every project that touches the site. Manage web projects from start to finish — scope, schedule, reviews, and launch — and keep everyone informed along the way. Work with product marketing, demand generation, sales, field marketing, and communications to turn what they need into pages that work. Take part in design reviews. You do not need to be a designer, but you should be able to judge creativity against business goals and best practices to give clear, useful feedback. Work with web development to ensure what gets built matches what was designed, loads quickly, and is accessible. Partner with our conversion optimization lead on testing — what to test, what the results mean, and what to change as a result. Use analytics to find what is not working on the site, recommend fixes, and see them through. Keep the site accurate and current, and apply SEO and AEO fundamentals to page structure, copy, and metadata. Direct internal designers, agencies and contractors on wireframes and mockups to match business requirements. Report to the Senior Director of Brand Marketing. Work day to day with creative, web development, conversion optimization and analytics, product marketing, demand generation, corporate communications, sales, and field marketing. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS: Seven or more years of web marketing experience, preferably at a B2B technology or software company. A proven track record of making a website perform better — redesign, restructuring, optimzation — and the ability to describe what changed and what it produced. Sound business judgment. You can tell the difference between a request that will move the business and one that will not. Experience running several projects at once and finishing them on time with little supervision. Clear communication with people who do not work on the web, including executives. Working knowledge of a content management system (Drupal is a plus) and an analytics platform such as GA4 or Adobe Analytics. General understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to have a productive conversation with developers. SEO and AEO fundamentals, both technical and editorial. Familiarity with A/B testing and personalization tools. COMPENSATION: Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across multiple U.S. geographic locations, and pay varies based on defined markets. The standard base pay range for this position across the U.S. is $120k - $140k annually. Pay varies by work location and may also be dependent on job-related skills, knowledge, and/or experience. During the interview and/or hiring process, your recruiter can share more information about the compensation package specific to the role and job location. BENEFITS: Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits Flexible hours and generous time off (RTO, Responsible Time Off) to help support your work-life balance Paid holidays and sick time 401(k) with company match Health Savings Account (HSA) with a generous employer contribution and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options Up to 12wks of paid Parental and 10wks Adoption Leave to help you grow your family Modern and collaborative offices located in Draper, UT; Raleigh, NC; Mountain View, CA; Reading, England, and Poznan, Poland Gym, cell phone, and internet reimbursement Free well-being apps such as Spring Health for Guardian are offered, as well access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Perks include discounted pet insurance, electronics, theme park tickets, travel, plus more Your own Egnyte account with lifetime access HealthJoy – a benefits navigation app that lets you access your benefits and get answers to your questions all in one place One Medical virtual care, providing you with healthcare access across the country Equal Employment Opportunity Egnyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Egnyte, Inc.'s management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment. At Egnyte, we embrace our unique differences and thrive on the individuality of our employees, our products, our customers, our investors, and our communities. Our global Egnyte Employee Communities (EECs) support representation and foster connectedness across our varied workplace. Egnyters are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work and to appreciate the many differences that collectively make Egnyte a higher-performing company and a great place to be. Any employees with questions or concerns about equal employment opportunities in the workplace are encouraged to bring these issues to the attention of hr@egnyte.com. Egnyte, Inc. will not allow any form of retaliation against employees who raise issues of equal employment opportunity. If employees feel they have been subjected to any such retaliation, they should contact hr@egnyte.com. To ensure the workplace is free of artificial barriers, violation of this policy including any improper retaliatory conduct will lead to discipline, up to and including discharge. All employees must cooperate with all investigations conducted pursuant to this policy. #LI-AG1 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

2775.Gecko Job Description: About Vitality Medical Vitality Medical is a well-established and growing ecommerce company that has served customers for more than 20 years. We have been recognized multiple times as an Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Company and offer thousands of medical equipment and supply products—from everyday essentials to life-saving equipment. We are seeking an experienced Ecommerce SEO Manager to own and execute the organic search strategy for VitalityMedical.com. You will develop this strategy in close collaboration with our catalog and technical teams, incorporating their product knowledge, technical expertise, operational experience, and business priorities. This is an execution-first position—not a consultant-only role. We need someone who will identify opportunities, develop solutions, and personally complete the work whenever possible. When an initiative requires support from another department, you will work alongside that team and remain actively involved through implementation, testing, and measurement. The right candidate will be comfortable moving between long-term strategy and detailed execution. You may spend one day developing the SEO roadmap and the next correcting metadata, improving internal links, analyzing an indexing issue, optimizing a category page, conducting backlink outreach, or working with developers on a technical problem. You must also be flexible as priorities change. The ability to shift focus, respond to urgent issues, and take advantage of new opportunities—without losing sight of long-term objectives—is essential. Direct ecommerce SEO experience is required. Working knowledge of Magento is a strong plus. What You’ll Be Doing Own and Execute the SEO Strategy Own and drive the overall SEO and AI search strategy for VitalityMedical.com. Develop the strategy collaboratively with our catalog, technical, content, merchandising, marketing, and leadership teams. Build and maintain a prioritized SEO roadmap based on customer value, revenue potential, business impact, technical risk, and required effort. Turn strategy into completed work—not just audits, presentations, and recommendations. Own initiatives from initial research and diagnosis through implementation, testing, measurement, and continued maintenance. Personally execute SEO improvements whenever access, skills, and systems allow. Establish organic search goals, performance benchmarks, and key performance indicators. Regularly communicate priorities, progress, risks, results, and next steps to leadership. Adjust the strategy based on performance, company objectives, algorithm changes, competitor activity, and evolving customer behavior. Remain flexible as priorities shift and reorganize the roadmap when business needs, technical issues, or new opportunities require attention. Balance long-term strategic initiatives with urgent maintenance, catalog, technical, and revenue-impacting needs. Work Closely With the Catalog Team Partner with the catalog team to improve product data, category structures, manufacturer pages, product relationships, attributes, navigation, and product discoverability. Develop SEO standards for adding, updating, organizing, and discontinuing products. Identify opportunities to improve product and category names, descriptions, metadata, images, attributes, and internal links. Determine how new products and categories should fit within the existing website structure. Develop processes for new, out-of-stock, seasonal, replacement, and discontinued products. Help determine when pages should be created, optimized, consolidated, redirected, canonicalized, or removed. Work directly with catalog team members to implement improvements rather than simply handing off recommendations. Review catalog changes for SEO quality and help team members understand how their work affects organic visibility and revenue. Create templates, documentation, and repeatable processes that allow SEO best practices to scale across a large product catalog. Work Closely With the Technical Team Partner with the technical team to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical SEO issues. Improve crawling, indexing, site architecture, page speed, Core Web Vitals, canonicalization, redirects, structured data, XML sitemaps, and robots directives. Address ecommerce challenges involving filters, faceted navigation, pagination, product variants, duplicate content, and complex URL structures. Include technical team members early when evaluating opportunities that may require development or platform changes. Create clear technical requirements when development work is necessary. Stay involved during implementation to answer questions, review decisions, and resolve unexpected issues. Test deployed changes and confirm they achieve the intended SEO result. Monitor releases for unintended effects on crawling, indexing, rankings, customer experience, and conversions. Remain accountable for the SEO outcome rather than considering the project complete when a development ticket is submitted. Perform Hands-On SEO Maintenance Regularly audit the website and personally correct SEO issues when possible. Identify and fix broken links, 404 errors, redirect chains, duplicate content, incorrect canonical tags, and indexing problems. Maintain page titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, schema markup, and other on-page elements. Monitor and improve the health of internal links. Find orphaned, underlinked, outdated, competing, and underperforming pages. Diagnose changes in organic traffic, rankings, indexing, conversions, and revenue. Conduct keyword, competitor, content-gap, search-intent, and customer-question research. Optimize product, category, manufacturer, brand, and informational pages directly. Write or edit metadata, page copy, content briefs, internal links, and SEO recommendations. Verify that completed changes were implemented correctly and continue monitoring their results. Maintain the overall SEO health of the website instead of treating SEO as a collection of one-time projects. Lead Ecommerce SEO Improve organic performance across thousands of products, categories, manufacturers, and informational pages. Develop scalable optimization methods for a large ecommerce catalog. Improve navigation, site architecture, internal linking, and product discoverability. Align product and category pages with customer search intent. Identify opportunities for new category, manufacturer, comparison, buying-guide, and educational pages. Prevent keyword cannibalization and unnecessary duplication across similar products and categories. Connect SEO priorities to qualified traffic, conversions, revenue, and customer value—not rankings alone. Consider the entire customer journey, from initial research through product selection and purchase. Own Content Optimization Develop and execute a content strategy that supports customers throughout the research and purchasing journey. Identify opportunities involving products, categories, medical conditions, comparisons, buying guides, FAQs, and customer questions. Personally create, edit, or optimize content when appropriate. Produce actionable content briefs covering search intent, target topics, page structure, internal links, supporting sources, and conversion goals. Work alongside writers and subject-matter experts to produce accurate, useful, original, and search-focused content. Review content for accuracy, sourcing, search intent, readability, and business value. Update, consolidate, redirect, or remove outdated and underperforming content. Establish appropriate sourcing, citation, and review standards for medical and health-related information. Manage External Links and Authority Own and execute Vitality Medical’s backlink, external-linking, and off-site authority strategy. Identify and pursue opportunities involving manufacturers, suppliers, associations, industry partners, publishers, resource pages, and digital PR. Conduct outreach directly and manage opportunities through completion. Build relationships that can produce relevant links, mentions, referral traffic, and brand authority. Monitor the backlink profile for new, lost, broken, low-quality, or potentially harmful links. Reclaim broken backlinks and convert appropriate unlinked brand mentions into links. Review outbound links to ensure they direct customers to accurate, trustworthy, and current resources. Establish external-linking and citation standards for medical and health-related content. Ensure link-building activities follow search engine guidelines and avoid manipulative or high-risk tactics. Measure the effect of external-link initiatives on authority, rankings, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue. Own AI Search and AI-Assisted SEO Develop and implement strategies to improve Vitality Medical’s visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI assistants, answer engines, and other emerging discovery platforms. Improve content structure, entity signals, structured data, citations, and brand authority so AI systems can better understand and reference Vitality Medical. Monitor AI search visibility, citations, brand mentions, referral traffic, and changes in customer search behavior. Use AI tools to improve keyword research, content analysis, content briefs, internal linking, reporting, and other SEO workflows. Build repeatable AI-assisted processes and automations where they provide measurable value. Establish quality standards for AI-generated and AI-assisted content. Ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, original, useful, brand-appropriate, and properly reviewed—especially when it involves medical or health-related information. Test new AI tools and determine where they can improve execution without sacrificing quality or customer trust. Mentor and Develop Others Mentor catalog, content, technical, merchandising, and marketing team members on SEO best practices. Teach by working alongside team members on actual projects and problems. Explain what needs to change, why it matters, and how it should be implemented. Review completed work and provide specific, constructive feedback. Help team members develop the ability to identify and prevent SEO issues. Create checklists, templates, training materials, and quality-control processes. Lead through expertise, communication, collaboration, and hands-on participation. Help departments become more SEO-capable without becoming disconnected from day-to-day execution. Measure and Report Performance Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, backlink growth, AI visibility, and other key performance indicators. Build and maintain reporting that connects SEO activity to business results. Use data to identify opportunities, investigate performance changes, and prioritize work. Measure completed initiatives to determine whether they produced the expected results. Continue improving projects after launch instead of treating implementation as the end of the work. Monitor algorithm updates, competitor activity, technical changes, and emerging search behavior. Clearly explain performance, opportunities, and next steps to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Required Experience and Qualifications Direct, hands-on ecommerce SEO experience is required. At least four years of professional SEO experience, including meaningful responsibility for an ecommerce website. Demonstrated success increasing qualified organic traffic, conversions, or ecommerce revenue. Experience owning both SEO strategy and day-to-day execution. Experience taking SEO projects from research through implementation, verification, and measurement. Experience working with large product catalogs and complex ecommerce site structures. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, internal linking, site architecture, and structured data. Experience developing and executing backlink, external-linking, digital PR, or off-site authority strategies. Ability to independently identify and complete high-impact work without waiting for someone else to manage each task. Willingness to perform ongoing maintenance and detailed implementation work in addition to strategic planning. Ability to collaborate across departments without defaulting to handing projects off. Experience teaching, mentoring, or guiding others through hands-on work. Ability to adapt quickly, manage changing priorities, and maintain progress in a fast-moving ecommerce environment. Sound judgment when deciding what requires immediate attention, what can be postponed, and how changes affect the broader SEO strategy. Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. High levels of ownership, accountability, initiative, integrity, and self-motivation. Familiarity with AI-powered search and the practical use of generative AI in SEO workflows. Preferred Skills and Experience Working knowledge of Magento or Magento 2 is a strong plus. Experience making SEO, product, category, and content updates within an ecommerce platform. Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar tools. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity. Experience creating repeatable AI prompts, workflows, custom tools, or automations. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and common web technologies. Familiarity with SQL, APIs, Python, automation platforms, or data-analysis tools. Experience with product feeds, Google Merchant Center, ecommerce analytics, and conversion tracking. Experience with website redesigns, migrations, platform changes, or large-scale content updates. Experience in healthcare, medical supplies, durable medical equipment, or another regulated industry. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, computer science, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required. What Success Looks Like Vitality Medical has a clear SEO strategy developed collaboratively across the company. The SEO roadmap consistently turns into completed, measurable improvements. The Ecommerce SEO Manager personally completes work and remains actively involved when other teams are needed. SEO projects move from discovery through implementation without stalling after an audit or recommendation. Priorities are adjusted effectively as business needs, technical issues, and new opportunities arise. The catalog and technical teams have a clear understanding of current SEO priorities. Technical, content, internal-linking, and external-authority improvements are maintained consistently. Other departments make better SEO decisions because they receive practical guidance, mentoring, and hands-on support. Product, category, manufacturer, and informational pages gain greater organic visibility. Vitality Medical earns greater authority across traditional and AI-powered search platforms. Organic search produces measurable growth in qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue. Leadership receives clear reporting on completed work, results, opportunities, risks, and next steps. What We Offer Medical, dental, and vision insurance Accident, cancer, hospital indemnity, group life, legal, identity protection, and pet insurance Paid holidays and paid time off Retirement plan Career growth and advancement opportunities Casual and enjoyable work environment Vitality Medical is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Job Type: Full-time Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year Benefits: 401(k) 401(k) matching Dental insurance Flexible schedule Health insurance Paid time off Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Salt Lake City, UT 84121

Manage paid media budget and pacing across channels, making weekly allocation calls based on CAC and pipeline contribution. Strong analytical rigor—fluent in CAC, ROAS, and pipeline attribution, and comfortable defending budget decisions with data. Experience running full-funnel paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through landing page and conversion optimization. Experience managing paid marketing agencies Experience with paid brand investments such as niche publications, podcast sponsorships, or out-of-home is a plus. Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience of our clinics across North America, have allowed us to lead the charge against “we caught it too late again.” Prenuvo is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to support execution across our core acquisition channels. As the Performance Marketing Manager, you’ll be an embedded member of the Growth Marketing team—collaborating closely with internal leads to manage and optimize day-to-day campaigns for paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads). Your primary focus will be tactical campaign management: implementing bid and budget optimizations, testing and refreshing ad copy and creative, cleaning up search terms, and executing cross-platform experiments that keep campaigns responsive to both performance data and evolving creative direction. This role is a critical addition during a high-growth phase to sustain campaign momentum, drive efficiency, and scale Prenuvo’s customer acquisition through the busy season and beyond. This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future). Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives! What You'll Do Execute day-to-day campaign management + analysis across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit), paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) including bid, budget, audience, and creative optimizations. Refresh ad copy, creative assets, and extensions in collaboration with the internal team. Implement structured testing frameworks (copy, creative, audience, landing page) to identify performance drivers and scale winners. Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations that align with overall acquisition goals (CPA, ROAS, Cost/Purchase). Support the rollout of new channels and campaign types (YouTube, Demand Gen, etc.) as Prenuvo expands its media mix. Partner with internal teams on tracking and measurement to ensure high-quality signal input for campaign optimization. Collaborate with internal leads to deliver reports, insights, and recommendations for weekly reviews. Utilize paid media technology to manage campaigns, bids, and budgets at scale. What You'll Bring 5-8 years of hands-on experience managing paid social and paid search campaigns. Proven success managing seven-figure monthly budgets and optimizing to CPA and ROAS targets. Deep proficiency in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), with a strong grasp of campaign structure, automation levers, and creative optimization. Strong analytical mindset; ability to interpret data and pivot quickly based on performance insights. Familiarity with other platforms such as Pinterest, Reddit and tools like Google Analytics a plus. Excellent communication and collaboration skills; comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment. Experience in high-AOV consumer, healthcare, or wellness categories a plus.
