You will establish best practices for SEM tailored to compliance within the pharmaceutical industry. It will also involve authoring points of view and white papers that position Inizio Evoke as an voice on paid search. Additionally, you will use new technologies to optimize our search campaigns. The Paid Search Supervisor will collaborate with a talented team of media subject matter experts. This team includes specialists in programmatic advertising, ad operations, social media, and SEO. You Will: Best Practices Development Establish and implement SEM best practices across the organization Review and refine SEM strategies to align with our goals, maximizing ROI on search campaigns Create QA process to ensure all campaigns meet organizational standards and align with new best practices Author points of view, white papers, and internal briefings that establish the agency's perspective on the future of paid search and how AI is reshaping search behavior in pharmaceutical marketing Trend Analysis and Adaptation Monitor industry trends, new technologies, and competitive landscape related to SEM I dentify opportunities for the use of tools and techniques that enhance search performance Lead the agency's perspective on how AI, generative search engines, and AI-driven answer experiences (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT) are reshaping paid search strategy in a regulated industry Evaluate emerging AI-powered bidding, creative, and audience tools and recommend where to pilot, scale, or hold based on performance and compliance fit Campaign Management Support the planning, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Bing Ads) to achieve targeted KPIs Conduct regular campaign analysis and use data-driven insights to inform decisions regarding bidding strategies, keyword selection (including relevant therapeutic areas), ad copy, and audience targeting Troubleshoot live campaign performance issues and investigate reporting discrepancies across platforms, ad servers, and analytics tools, identifying root causes and implementing fixes to keep campaigns delivering accurately Team Collaboration Collaborate with the Center of Excellence team to implement integrated marketing strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and conversions Provide guidance internally to brand team members, assisting in their daily campaign management. Externally, act as a technical voice to clients for SEM, providing recommendations and campaign updates. Manage training documentation for setup and campaigns management, and standardized pacing and performance documentation Reporting and Analytics Develop SEM performance reports, providing recommendations to senior leadership Analyze and present data to evaluate the effectiveness of search campaigns, using key performance indicators to demonstrate success and inform future strategies Develop Search Testing Process that allows us to systematically test new strategies and prove out new tactics and develop case study materials Provide forecasts and budgetary recommendations based on campaign analysis and market trends specific to the pharmaceutical landscape You Have: 4+ years of experience in SEM/Digital Marketing with experience successful campaign management Proficiency in Google Ads, Bing Ads, SA360, Google Analytics and SEM tools (e.g., SEMrush, AdThena) with an understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulations Experience with web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics). Mastery of Excel and Microsoft Office necessary. Understanding of AI as a tool for efficiency Knowledge of SEM best practices and how they apply to the pharmaceutical industry to integrate search strategies. Demonstrated experience writing thought leadership content (POVs, white papers, conference talks, or published articles) on paid search, digital media, or marketing technology Working knowledge of how AI and generative search (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, LLM-driven answer engines) are changing paid search, and a clear perspective on where the discipline is heading Our Benefits: Inizio Evoke offers a fully remote work environment and outstanding company-paid benefits, including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work. Compensation $100,000—$120,000 USD Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

2846.FireCrawl Job Description: Who We Are Roots is a wealth-building platform built on a simple belief: everyone deserves a real path to financial growth, and that path should feel achievable. We create simple, accessible ways for people to participate in ownership and invest in real assets, making wealth-building more engaging and within reach. Today, Roots is a growing ecosystem that combines an investment platform, financial tools, and education to support long-term financial progress. We’re already helping a rapidly growing community take meaningful steps toward building wealth, and we’ve seen that when the experience feels intuitive and rewarding, people actually stick with it. That’s what we’re continuing to build. Why We Need You We’re hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own the day-to-day execution and optimization of our paid acquisition engine as Roots scales toward 1 million members. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting into the details. You’ll manage campaigns across Google, Meta, Bing, and mobile app acquisition channels, build a high-velocity creative testing engine, and make sure our measurement and attribution are set up to optimize toward the outcomes that actually matter. You’ll work closely with Creative, Product, Lifecycle, and Engineering and use AI and automation to move faster, test smarter, and continuously improve performance. Role Responsibilities Own day-to-day media buying and optimization across Google, Meta, Bing, Apple Search Ads, and other mobile app acquisition campaigns, including budgets, bids, audiences, structure, and pacing. Grow top-of-funnel acquisition while managing cost per conversion, ROAS, and other key efficiency targets. Partner with Creative to build a consistent testing pipeline, launching new concepts weekly and turning winning ideas into iterations. Own paid media measurement, including conversion actions, attribution settings, bidding signals, pixels, and server-side tracking. Partner with Engineering to instrument and QA events across platforms, including CAPI, Enhanced Conversions, app SDK events, SKAdNetwork/AEM, and offline/server-side conversions. Design and evaluate experiments across creative, landing pages, onboarding, and acquisition strategy with clear hypotheses and reliable measurement. Reconcile platform reporting against internal data and turn performance insights into clear recommendations. Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, creative ideation, account QA, reporting, and other performance marketing workflows. Partner across Lifecycle, Product, and Brand to ensure paid traffic converts and retains beyond the initial acquisition. Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including meaningful experience directly managing paid media budgets in-platform. Strong command of Google Ads and Meta Ads, plus experience with Bing/Microsoft Ads and mobile app user acquisition. Proven experience acquiring users for a consumer mobile app, including app install and post-install optimization. Deep understanding of conversion tracking, attribution models and windows, pixels, server-side tracking, and mobile measurement platforms such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch. Highly analytical and comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets, BI tools, and large performance datasets. Comfortable partnering with engineers on event instrumentation, implementation QA, and troubleshooting measurement discrepancies. Strong understanding of experimentation and incrementality, including when and how to use holdouts and platform lift tools. Strong creative instincts and experience partnering with designers, editors, and creators to develop performance-driven advertising. Fluency using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, media buying, and creative workflows. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. Bonus Points Experience in fintech, investing, real estate, or another regulated consumer category. Experience scaling a consumer mobile app from early traction to meaningful volume. Experience with TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, connected TV, podcasts, influencer-driven paid media, or other emerging channels. Experience using scripts, APIs, Python, or other automation tools to reduce manual account work. How We Work We move quickly, take ownership, and expect people to be close to the work. You’ll have the autonomy to test aggressively, dig into the data, challenge assumptions, and make changes when something isn’t working. Roots is small enough that your work will have immediate visibility and impact, but we’re operating at a scale where great decisions compound quickly. If you love the combination of analytical rigor, creative experimentation, and hands-on execution, you’ll have a lot of room to make this role your own. At Roots, we're committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We firmly believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation, enhancing the quality of our work and the strength of our team. Join us and be part of an inclusive environment where every perspective is valued. frtgn8Fc42

2848.FireCrawl Job Description:
Mira Home, founded in 2024, is a home services brand operating in 14 U.S. markets with nationwide expansion planned for 2027. This hands-on individual contributor role reports to the Director of Marketing and owns Google's advertising channel end to end. Success is measured in customers, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and revenue.

Responsibilities: Own Google Search and Local Services Ads across every market; expand into Performance Max, Microsoft Ads, YouTube, and Demand Gen where justified. Build a multi-location account structure supporting growth from 14 to 20+ markets. Personally manage keyword strategy, search term mining, match types, negatives, geographic targeting, ad copy, bidding, budgets, and scheduling. Manage Local Services Ads verification, service categories, budgets, and daily lead disputes. Separate high-value recurring protection plan demand from low-value demand and protect brand terms. Own GTM, GA4, conversion actions, enhanced conversions, and call tracking; collaborate with development and data teams to send sold customers and their value back to Google. Forecast spend, leads, customers, and CAC by market and allocate budgets. Build a new-market launch playbook, test landing page improvements, maintain a documented testing roadmap and change log, and report weekly.

Required qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience with direct ownership of strategy, budgets, and results. Experience in pest control, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, other home services, or multi-location lead generation. Personally managed at least $100,000 per month in Google Ads and increased spend without losing efficiency. Hands-on Local Services Ads experience. Ability to handle GTM, GA4, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and call tracking using CallTrackingMetrics, CallRail, or similar tools. Clear writing, plain explanations for leadership, and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Preferred qualifications: Pest control experience; six-figure monthly Google Ads budgets; building or rebuilding a Google channel from a low base or launching new local markets; value-based bidding using CRM data; experience with FieldRoutes, ServiceTitan, PestPac, Salesforce, or HubSpot; scaled call-driven lead generation; incrementality testing; Google Ads certification.

The role requires commercial judgment, diagnostic skills across advertising and lead handling, and ownership of account changes and results.

Benefits: Performance-based bonus; health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) matching; paid time off. Final compensation depends on experience, qualifications, and position scope.

Application requirements stated in the posting: Resume plus one or two short write-ups of personally managed Google Ads accounts covering monthly spend, number of markets, industry, campaign types, challenge, personal contributions, and measurable results over a stated period. Distinguish personal work from team or agency work. Applications without write-ups will not be reviewed.

2850.Gecko Job Description: Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more. We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA. Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era. About the role We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities. You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management. What you'll do Own our conference program Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth Own the events budget and decide where the money goes Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more Plan side events around conferences, such as happy hours, dinners, and meetups Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities Run field events with sales Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, and regional events with our account executives Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once Grow our digital events and partnerships Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team Work across the team Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up What we're looking for 3-4+ years in field marketing, events, or marketing programs at a B2B SaaS company Events you've run that created pipeline, and numbers you can share from them Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events Nice to have Experience marketing to developers, DevOps, platform engineering, or security teams Existing relationships with organizers of developer and security conferences Experience planning custom booths at large conferences Familiarity with open-source communities or developer meetups Hands-on experience with webinar platforms Team, values & benefits Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings. At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

2851.FireCrawl Job Description: At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success. Head of Enterprise Marketing at BairesDev In this role, you'll build and lead a new Customer Marketing area from the ground up, reporting directly to the CMO. This is a hands-on leadership position where you'll turn our existing client base and our sales collateral into a genuine growth lever for the company. This is your opportunity to inherit an experienced team of about eight people across three functions, define the strategy yourself, and work with executives across Sales, Client Engagement, Delivery, and Marketing from day one. What You'll Do: Own product marketing hands-on, defining positioning and messaging for go-to-market plans for our service lines and new offerings, and maintaining competitive intelligence on competitors. Lead the Sales Collateral and Copywriting teams, setting the positioning and messaging frameworks briefing and quality standards, and delivering pitch decks, case studies, one-pagers, and proposals that Sales measurably uses. Lead Customer Marketing and Events, building upsell and cross-sell campaigns, executive events, client references, and advocacy programs with revenue targets agreed with Sales and Client Engagement. Build the new area by hiring, defining KPIs such as collateral adoption by Sales, influenced pipeline, and revenue from existing accounts, and reporting results to the CMO and executive team. Partner with Sales leadership to identify win-rate gaps by segment and close them through messaging, collateral, and enablement. What we are looking for: 8+ years of overall B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in a leadership role. 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Marketing Manager or Director, owning positioning, messaging, and launches at a B2B company. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, or Engineering. Experience in customer marketing, including upsell/cross-sell campaigns, client case studies and references, client events and webinars, and ABM to existing accounts. Proficiency in copy management, including briefing, editing, and quality control of B2B copy, and managing writers. Nice to have: Background in IT services, nearshore software outsourcing, or IT staffing (e.g., Globant, EPAM, Endava, Toptal, Thoughtworks, Accenture). Experience building a marketing function or team from zero inside a company of 1,000+ employees. Prior experience reporting directly to a CMO or sitting on an executive leadership team. How we make your work (and your life) easier: 100% remote work. Work-from-home hardware setup. Flexible hours, make your schedule. PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves. An excellent compensation package, well above market average. Healthcare coverage (Vision and Dental). Life Insurance. 401K Plan. Diverse and multicultural work environment. Collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent in each area. Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact! Apply now!

2852.FireCrawl Job Description: Job Summary: We are seeking a Marketing Performance Analyst to join our digital marketing team at Alsco Uniforms. This role analyzes performance across all digital marketing channels including email, social media, paid advertising, SEO, and web analytics, and connects that performance to sales pipeline and revenue outcomes. You will build dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, deliver reporting and presentations to marketing and sales leadership, and recommend where to focus budget and effort to improve results. You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure data accuracy, identify trends and opportunities, and turn numbers into a clear story people can act on. The ideal candidate is a marketer who is strong with data, not a data specialist looking for a marketing application, and communicates insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Annual base pay: $90,000 Essential Functions: Analyze performance data from digital marketing channels including email campaigns, social media, paid advertising (PPC, display, social), SEO, and website traffic to measure campaign effectiveness. Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualizations in Tableau, along with Excel and other analytics tools, to track key performance indicators across marketing and sales. Utilize HubSpot and Salesforce to analyze campaign performance, customer journeys, and pipeline attribution across the marketing funnel. Build recurring and ad hoc presentations for marketing and sales leadership that tell the story behind the numbers, including performance, results, and recommendations. Analyze customer behavior, engagement patterns, and conversion trends, and recommend optimizations to improve campaign performance and audience targeting. Partner with marketing operations, web, and third-party vendors to audit tracking and data collection, troubleshoot issues, and maintain data accuracy across marketing platforms. Collaborate with IT, systems teams, and other departments to ensure cohesive measurement and attribution across the marketing ecosystem, and communicate what marketing and sales need from the data available to them. Additional Functions: Other job duties as assigned. Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in marketing and sales performance reporting, marketing analytics, or a similar analyst role. Advanced proficiency in Tableau or Power BI, including building dashboards and visualizations that make complex data easy to understand for executive and day-to-day audiences. Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis, connecting channel performance to leads, pipeline, and revenue. Advanced proficiency in Excel including pivot tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, Power Query, and complex formulas. Strong knowledge of HubSpot and Salesforce for marketing analytics, sales reporting, and CRM data analysis. Deep understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC (Google Ads), social media advertising, email marketing, and call tracking. Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4) and other web analytics tools. Experience using performance data to recommend marketing improvements, including advising on testing and experimentation approaches where appropriate. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to turn marketing and sales data into clear, actionable recommendations. Strong storytelling, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build executive-ready presentations and explain what the numbers mean and what to do about them. Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, IT, and external agencies or vendors. Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy and documentation. Understanding of how marketing and sales data moves between platforms, including experience participating in a tool implementation, integration, or reporting rebuild. Comfortable working in an environment where reporting infrastructure is still being built rather than fully configured. Education Requirements: A combination of education and experience will be considered. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Business Analytics, or related field, OR equivalent combination of education / 4+ years of professional experience in marketing and sales performance reporting or analytics. Tableau, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or Salesforce certification is preferred but not required. Physical Requirements: Physical Demands/Requirements consist of standing, sitting, walking, stooping, reaching overhead, grasping, seeing, reading, speaking, hearing, and occasional lifting up to 30 lbs. Environmental Conditions: Indoor office environment. Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required, typically around 5–10%. Our Benefits: 401 K Plan with Company Match Medical, Dental, Vision, and FSA/HSA Life Insurance, Disability Insurance Vacation, Sick Time, Holidays Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Benefits may vary for positions covered by a collective bargaining agreement. For a general description of benefits that are being offered for this position, please visit alsco.com/benefits. About Us: We are Alsco Uniforms. We've been committed to our customers since 1889, proudly pioneering the uniform and linen rental industry and growing into a global leader serving over 350,000 customers across 13 countries. We provide exceptional service and create solutions that strengthen our customers’ operations. At Alsco, our diverse workforce drives performance, innovation, and exceptional service. We're looking for individuals who want to build a rewarding career while making a meaningful impact. Explore how Alsco helps you build a successful career with competitive compensation, benefits, and ongoing opportunities for growth. Join our team and build your career with Alsco Uniforms! Equal Opportunity Employer: Alsco Uniforms provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military status, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. The Company also provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. Thank you for your interest in joining Alsco Uniforms. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background and drug screening. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor. Pay: $90,000.00 per year Additional information from the current job posting: Analyze performance across digital marketing channels including email, social media, paid advertising, SEO, and web analytics, connecting results to sales pipeline and revenue. Build Tableau dashboards, deliver reports and presentations to marketing and sales leadership, recommend budget and campaign improvements, and collaborate across teams to ensure data accuracy and cohesive measurement and attribution. Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in marketing and sales performance reporting, marketing analytics, or a similar analyst role. Advanced Tableau or Power BI and Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, Power Query, and complex formulas. Strong knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing attribution, funnel analysis, digital marketing channels, and Google Analytics (GA4). Strong analytical, storytelling, communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Experience with platform data flows and participation in a tool implementation, integration, or reporting rebuild. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Business Analytics, or a related field, OR an equivalent combination of education / 4+ years of professional experience in marketing and sales performance reporting or analytics. Tableau, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or Salesforce certification preferred but not required. Physical requirements include standing, sitting, walking, stooping, reaching overhead, grasping, seeing, reading, speaking, hearing, and occasional lifting up to 30 lbs. Indoor office environment. Occasional travel, typically 5–10%. Benefits include a 401(k) with company match; medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA; life and disability insurance; vacation, sick time, holidays; and an Employee Assistance Program. Benefits may vary for positions covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Alsco Uniforms is a uniform and linen rental company serving over 350,000 customers across 13 countries. Equal opportunity employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background and drug screening.

2853.FireCrawl Job Description:
We’re a specialty pet products company selling D2C, Amazon, and through wholesale worldwide. We need an ecommerce guru with strong marketing skills to accelerate and manage growth. This is a small tight knit group, we run like a 10 year old start-up.

The Role

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll own large portions of digital commerce operation — Shopify D2C, domestic and international marketplaces — setting strategy and executing it. You’ll work cross-functionally with product, logistics, marketing agency and leadership.

What You’ll Own

International channel selling directly or through a partner such as Channel Engine, Rithum, Base.com, or similar — market entry strategy, localized listings, cross-border logistics, and international partner relationships. Amazon Japan and EU, Mercado Libre, Coupang, Rakuten and others.
Oversee our Amazon 1PL partner for US and Candada.
Shopify D2C: store optimization, integrations (QuickBooks, shipping, returns), CRO, landing pages, and overall web strategy.
Brand protection: unauthorized reseller enforcement and MAP policy compliance across all channels
Cross-channel product data and PDP management across all marketplaces and D2C
Product feed management: Google Shopping, Facebook Commerce, Whatnot, TikTok.
Full channel P&L ownership — margin management, promotional ROI, channel profitability and partnership with our marketing agency and product management.
Returns and reverse logistics — reducing return rates and managing policies across channels
Traffic analysis: sessions, conversions, traffic quality assessment, and bot mitigation
Analytics and reporting: performance dashboards, data-driven pricing, inventory, and promotional decisions — tools like Triple Whale, Shopify Growth, GA4

What We’re Looking For Required

3+ years of ecommerce ninja skills with proven revenue growth
Hard goods experience, physical shipped products with logistics. (not SaaS)
Marketplace experience, direct or through multi-channel tools.
Shopify proficiency — store management, plugins, integrations
Strong data analysis — you make decisions with numbers
AI tools for ecommerce — content, analytics, automation, reporting

Highly Valued

Emerging U.S. marketplace experience (TikTok Shop, Etsy, Target, Walmart Marketplace, Whatnot)
CRO, AEO, GEO, and ecommerce marketing (SEO, SEM, email, social, influencer)
Multi-channel order management systems (Rythum, Channel Engine, Base.com)
Tech stack evaluation and vendor selection — assessing platforms, negotiating contracts

Bonus Skills

Wholesale B2B — sales to distributors and wholesale partners via Shopify or similar
MAP enforcement and unauthorized reseller policing internationally

Why K9 Sport?

Own the flow and see your efforts results — no bureaucracy, direct access to leadership, bonuses on success that YOU create.
Lead international expansion from the ground up in a $155B+ pet products market
Small, relaxed group doing big things. We have 85% market share, blue sky everywhere and huge growth potential.

Details

Type: Full-Time

Location: On-Location first 90 days in Lehi. Long-term WFH 1-2 days potential.

Compensation: Competitive + performance incentives

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lehi, UT 84043

2855.Gecko Job Description: WHO WE ARE EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform. Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity , Ecstatic Clients , and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun —celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance. POSITION SUMMARY The Manager, Demand Generation owns EnableComp’s demand generation engine — planning and executing the multi-channel campaigns that build pipeline, and, as our first dedicated content hire, creating the blog posts, ebooks, landing pages, and nurture content those campaigns run on. This role builds on the technical infrastructure the GTM Engineer maintains and the positioning the Director, Product Marketing sets, translating both into campaigns that generate and nurture qualified leads. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the Manager will partner closely with Product Marketing, the Commercial Enablement Director, the Manager of Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships, and the SDR function to ensure a consistent, well-coordinated path from first touch to qualified pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at this time. Plan, build, and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, paid social, SEM, retargeting, and organic channels. Own marketing-sourced pipeline targets and report on campaign performance against revenue goals. Manage the demand generation budget, tracking spend against ROI and reallocating based on channel performance. Own funnel content end-to-end: blog posts, ebooks/guides, landing pages, and nurture email copy that fuel campaigns — this is our first dedicated content hire, so the expectation is building the engine, not just staffing it. Ensure all campaign content reflects current positioning and messaging maintained by the Director, Product Marketing. Establish a scalable, repeatable content calendar and production workflow. Build and manage lead nurture email programs and campaign workflows inside HubSpot, working within the lead scoring and account routing logic the GTM Engineer designs and maintains. Partner with the GTM Engineer on campaign-specific automation needs and data requirements, without owning the underlying tech stack, integrations, or scoring/routing architecture. Monitor and troubleshoot campaign-level workflow issues, escalating systemic or infrastructure issues to the GTM Engineer. Partner with the Manager, Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships on webinar and event promotion strategy, registration goals, and post-event lead nurture (Events owns strategy, logistics, and execution; Growth Marketing owns the pipeline goals and follow-up). Partner with the Director, Product Marketing to ensure campaigns and content reflect current narrative, positioning, and competitive messaging. Partner with the SDR function on lead handoff, MQL quality feedback, and conversion tracking. Analyze campaign and content performance data to identify what’s working, kill what isn’t, and continuously optimize for MQL volume, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition. Stay current on emerging channels and AI-powered marketing/content tools, piloting new tactics to keep programs ahead of the curve. Other duties as assigned. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. 3–5 years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, or a related B2B marketing role. Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), or another complex B2B industry is a plus. Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce). Strong writing skills — comfortable independently drafting blog posts, email copy, and landing page copy, since this role owns content without a dedicated content team behind it. Strong analytical skills, with experience pulling and interpreting campaign data to make decisions. Comfort partnering with a technical GTM/RevOps function (e.g., a GTM Engineer) on automation and data needs without owning the underlying systems. Regular and predictable attendance. Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use office applications, including MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook), Zoom, and other learning technology. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. Individual contributor role; no direct reports at this time. A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders. Strong project management and prioritization skills; comfortable running multiple campaigns simultaneously. A bias toward experimentation and iteration, including piloting AI-enabled content and marketing tools. Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites. Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment. EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment. EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success , and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you. Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying: “I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.” – Revenue Specialist “I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented and flexible, along with understanding the balance of work, life, and fun.” – Supervisor, Operations

2860.Gecko Job Description: Join the Sleep Fitness Movement At Eight Sleep , we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2026, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up. High Standards. No Apologies We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. We’re a team that puts in the extra effort, not because it’s required, but because we care about the impact of our work. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier – this isn’t it. The role We are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager with experience in managing campaigns on Google Search, YouTube, TikTok, and/or Meta as well as a quantitative background leveraging Statistics and AI. The role sits within our Global Growth Marketing team and reports directly to the Growth Marketing Lead. It will focus on optimizing and scaling our digital advertising presence in all regions, managing multiple accounts. This is a high-impact role for a strategic, analytical, and creative individual passionate about transforming complex technology into simple, human, and aspirational advertising that delivers business results. The role can be based out of NYC, SF, or Remote. How you’ll contribute Lead performance marketing channels, including but not limited to Search, Shopping, YouTube, and TikTok while collaborating cross-functionally on Meta, Affiliate, lifecycle, and influencers. Build new growth and automation systems using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n, and similar) to eliminate manual work and increase marketing efficiency Analyze campaign performance, evaluate and interpret key performance indicators (KPIs), and work closely with the performance and data team to consolidate learnings and continuously optimize campaigns for greater efficiency. Prepare accurate reports with clearly synthesized insights and actionable next steps Analyze and recommend new copy & creative, bidding strategies, and testing structures using both qualitative and quantitative metrics at a rapid pace Stay up to date on relevant industry trends, new ad products, and best practices What you need to succeed 3+ years of experience with at least two of Google, YouTube, Meta, and TikTok Ads with proven success working on campaigns for direct-to-consumer brands, with budgets above $1M per year Analytical mindset with creative intuition. Equally fluent in metrics and emotion Experience building automation and tools with AI such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, n8n, Cursor, etc. for Marketing and analytics applications Experience with analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, Looker, Mode, Hex, Tableau, SQL, Amplitude, Google Search Console, keyword planner) Capable of working independently, proactively creating plans from the ground up Develop and continually expand or refine targeting/copy/assets based on performance Strong familiarity with marketing funnels + modern attribution platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox or equivalent) Experience designing or reading geo-lift, conversion lift, or brand lift studies International awareness, with knowledge of diverse cultures A strong, proactive communicator with a can-do, positive attitude and a strong desire to get things done Why join Eight Sleep? Innovation in a culture of excellence Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness. Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments, aiming for high standards. Collaboration with exceptional talent Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep, exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment. Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience with Eight Sleep and translate it into concrete impact. Your own Pod - and other great benefits Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod, along with other benefits. Learn more at eightsleep.com/careers At Eight Sleep, we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

2862.Gecko Job Description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Opportunity You own two things that are easy to under-invest in and expensive to ignore: the customers we already have, and the rooms where buyers gather. You run customer and expansion marketing in partnership with Customer Success, and you execute the field and event motion that the segment owners scope. You also own the proof. References, case studies, and advocates are how we win deals and how an acquirer values us. That program is yours to build. What You’ll Own Sales enablement Build custom sales decks and assets for client engagements, with a focus on enterprise deals. Run broader enablement: operationalize the master pitch and battlecards PMM owns, onboard reps to the materials, and keep deal assets current. Be the bridge between marketing’s narrative and what reps actually present in the room. Field and event execution Execute the events the segment owners scope and recommend: booth, on-site meetings, and follow-through. Own on-site ROI and the pre- and post-event motion with sales and CS. References, case studies, and advocacy Own the reference and advocacy program; recruit advocates and turn outcomes into proof. Partner with Content to produce and PMM for the outcome data. Field enablement Own field and event enablement materials in partnership with PMM’s core positioning. What You Don’t Own New-logo demand creation — the segment owners. Which events we attend (the thesis) — segment owners decide; you execute. Core positioning and battlecards — PMM. Key Performance Indicators Expansion pipeline influenced. Customer and expansion pipeline, with Customer Success. Net revenue retention contribution. Marketing’s influence on retention and expansion. Event execution ROI. Pipeline and qualified meetings per event, on budget. Proof produced. References and case studies created — exit-critical. Field contribution to acute pipeline. Field-influenced pipeline supporting the ABM motion. What We’re Looking For 4+ years in customer marketing, field marketing, or events in B2B SaaS; healthcare IT preferred. A program builder who can run events and customer motions at the same time without dropping either. Comfort partnering closely with Customer Success and Sales. A reference and advocacy track record. An AI-first approach to scaling field and customer content. Ability to travel up to 25% travel Nice to Have Experience building a customer advocacy or reference program from scratch. Experience supporting diligence with customer proof points. Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $75,000-$85,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

2863.FireCrawl Job Description: Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun! Minimum Requirements 3+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Business Partnering within a high-growth B2B organization. UK Based: Must be based in and legally authorised to work in the United Kingdom . Expertise in Marketo: Hands-on operational experience with Marketo admin capabilities. Proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC): Solid working knowledge of Salesforce, with the ability to build custom reports and dashboards, manage campaigns, and track lead routing and status updates. Strong consultative communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical constraints into simple, supportive commercial language for cross-functional partners. Collaborative Mindset: A proactive problem-solver with a high EQ who builds strong operational alignment across global, cross-functional GTM teams and time zones, meeting stakeholders where they are to co-design solutions. Demonstrated ability to diagnose systemic process bottlenecks and design scalable, automated backend solutions. Preferred Qualifications Strong Project Management Skills: Exceptional organizational ability with deep attention to detail and a passion for turning campaign delivery friction into smooth, predictable, and scalable workflows. Innovative AI & Automation Application: A tech-forward operational mindset with a passion for staying on top of the rapid changes in AI and modern automation tools, and the creativity to apply these technologies to solve complex GTM business problems. Analytics & Attribution Knowledge: Strong conceptual understanding of Looker (or comparable modern BI platforms) to navigate dashboards and interpret data, alongside a solid grasp of multi-touch attribution models to evaluate campaign performance. Proven success navigating large, complex B2B enterprise environments and managing alignment across a wide matrix of global stakeholders. Post-Acquisition System & Process Awareness: Experience or familiarity with post-acquisition environments, bringing a strong understanding of how merging with a large enterprise business impacts systems, lead processes, and shared pipeline targets. Experience architecting structured collaborative workflows and intake models in project management platforms like Asana. Familiarity with global deliverability best practices , IP sender reputation management, and international privacy regulations (such as GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM). About the Job As a Business Partner, Marketing Operations , your goal is to act as a strategic advisor to regional marketing stakeholders - identifying friction trends, solving system level bottlenecks, and driving pipeline scale. Rather than focusing on manual campaign builds, you will drive proactive system-level diagnosis and solutions to ensure commercial decision making and GTM execution feel effortless and fast. Your primary daily focus is simple: unblock marketers so they can focus on building pipeline. If a marketer's job is to know what Sales needs to win, your job is to know exactly what is holding Marketing back from supplying it and propose solutions. By partnering closely with regional teams, you will translate recurring operational hurdles into backend workflow enhancements, lead lifecycle clarity, and scalable automation. You will design solutions that satisfy unique local requirements while preserving global consistency and regional alignment. Ultimately, you will ensure campaign launches are smooth and predictable, cementing Marketing Operations as the vital engine room that executive leadership consults to protect and multiply pipeline velocity. Responsibilities Trusted Business Consultant: Act as a strategic advisor to regional marketing leads - understanding campaign goals, resource tensions, and day to day execution roadblocks to advise on priorities and drive efficiencies. Targeted Campaign Operations Support: Act as the primary regional POC for self-service support, lead QA process for self-service programs in your region, and provide hands-on custom campaign builds for complex, non-standard "big rock" marketing events. Quarterly Plan Alignment: Support quarterly planning rhythms to align team capacity, operational tools, and sales needs directly to marketing execution. Business Metrics Advisory: Advise marketers on key business metrics, KPIs, and campaign performance standards, guiding the interpretation of metrics to inform strategic commercial choices and pipeline pivots. 2865.FireCrawl Job Description: About the Role: As the Regional Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager for EMEA, you will play a key role in bringing Mendix's global ABM strategy to life across the Europe, Middle East, and Africa region. You'll partner closely with regional Sales, BDR, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to implement high-impact 1:1 and 1:few ABM programs that reflect the outstanding dynamics of EMEA markets and accelerate account progression. While aligned to a global ABM strategy, you will be responsible for regional execution, adapting messaging, campaigns, events, and experiences to meet local market needs while maintaining global consistency. This is a phenomenal opportunity for a creative, strategic marketer who understands the diverse EMEA landscape and enjoys developing innovative account-based programs that move enterprise opportunities forward. Responsibilities: Drive Regional ABM Execution Execute global 1:1 and 1:few ABM strategies the EMEA region, adapting programs to regional priorities, customer needs, and market dynamics. Serve as the voice of the region within the global organization, providing market insights, identifying regional opportunities, and helping evolve global programs based on local customer and sales feedback. Build Creative Account Engagement Programs Develop innovative account-based campaigns and experiences that help progress strategic opportunities through the sales cycle, including executive engagement, workshops, direct mail, field experiences, customer events, and digital programs. Partner with Sales Teams Work closely with Sales and BDR teams to identify priority accounts, develop account engagement strategies, and align marketing programs with outbound sales motions that drive meetings, pipeline, and opportunity progression. Localize Global Programs Partner with global ABM, Product Marketing, Digital, and Content teams to localize campaigns, messaging, and content for EMEA markets while ensuring consistency with global strategy. Account for varying languages, cultures, regulations, and buying behaviors across EMEA countries. Deliver Coordinated Campaigns Coordinate multi-channel ABM programs across digital, outbound, events, paid media, web personalization, and executive engagement to reach technical, business, and executive customers across the buying group. Leverage ABM Technology Work with platforms such as Demandbase, Qualified, CRM, and marketing automation tools to implement personalized campaigns and measure account engagement. Provide input on EMEA-specific technology, data, and process requirements to ensure regional success in ABM execution. Measure & Optimize Performance Monitor account engagement, meetings, pipeline progression, and campaign performance. Use data, sales feedback, and regional insights to continuously improve programs. Demonstrated ability in B2B marketing, with experience in Account-Based Marketing, Field Marketing, Enterprise Marketing, or Demand Generation. Experience developing and driving marketing programs, with a strong understanding of regional business practices, cultural nuances, and buying behaviors. Consistent record developing creative account engagement programs that help advance enterprise opportunities through the sales cycle. Experience partnering closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to execute coordinated account strategies. Strong understanding of enterprise buying groups. Experience accomplishing integrated marketing campaigns across digital, events, outbound, and executive engagement programs. Proven experience with marketing technologies such as Demandbase, Qualified, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and web personalization tools. 2869.Gecko Job Description: About Future Finance Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience. Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information. We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space. The Role We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands. This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time. Key Responsibilities Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter). Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv. Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters. Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links. Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times. Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings. Maintain campaign calendars and trackers. Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live. Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed. Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns Requirements Who You Are Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision. Key qualities: Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc. Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed. Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time. Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip. Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows. Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute. Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training. Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly. Experience Requirements Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person. Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner. What You Won't Be Responsible For Writing email copy or subject lines Developing email marketing strategies Creating offers or promotional campaigns All copy, creative assets, and campaign instructions will be provided by the marketing team. Your role is to ensure everything is executed correctly. Availability: Must be available and responsive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on working days to coordinate campaign scheduling, handle time-sensitive requests, and make any necessary adjustments. Benefits What do we offer Competitive salary Company offsites Remote work High ownership, high-impact role

2873.FireCrawl Job Description: Buscamos uma Assistente Virtual Executiva para apoiar uma consultora de negócios e mentora na organização e gestão de uma consultoria em fase inicial. A profissional selecionada dará suporte direto à gestão da agenda, à comunicação com clientes e ao acompanhamento das atividades administrativas. Além disso, utilizará ferramentas de inteligência artificial e automação para simplificar tarefas e melhorar a eficiência dos processos. Principais responsabilidades Gerenciar a agenda profissional, coordenando reuniões, consultorias, mentorias, palestras e outros compromissos, evitando conflitos de horários. Elaborar, formatar e organizar propostas comerciais, apresentações e documentos. Apoiar a organização de palestras e eventos, incluindo o contato com clientes, o cadastro de fornecedores e o agendamento de reuniões de briefing. Realizar o acompanhamento de clientes, contatos, parceiros e demandas administrativas. Organizar e filtrar e-mails, mensagens e solicitações, identificando prioridades e acompanhando as pendências. Apoiar a gestão de programas de mentoria, centralizando a comunicação com participantes e voluntários. Criar checklists, acompanhar prazos e garantir o andamento das atividades. Coordenar reservas de passagens e outros aspectos das viagens profissionais. Gerenciar a emissão de notas fiscais e outros documentos administrativos, em conjunto com os responsáveis. Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial e implementar automações para otimizar tarefas recorrentes. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência prévia como assistente virtual, assistente executiva ou em funções administrativas similares. 2878.FireCrawl Job Description: About AirGarage AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking. We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more. By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities. AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time. We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before. Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online. We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking. We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more. Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling? Check out these podcasts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4 https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7 The Role 💼 You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders. You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works. This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on. You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out. What You Will Do 📊 Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion. Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient. Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing. Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show. Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story. Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month. Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity. Who You Are 🦚 You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed. LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks. You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached. You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page. You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own campaigns.You 'd rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one. You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation. You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it. You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions. ⭐️ Nice To Have: Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe. Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships. Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts. Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels 🚨 Why This Role May Not Be for You 🚨 Please review this section before applying. We are sharing this information up front because we don't expect this job to be appealing to everybody and we do not want to waste your time if you are not on board with all of the following. Below are some of the reasons you might not want this job: You want a strict 9-5. We work long hours at AirGarage, including nights and occasional weekends, because we love what we do. You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation. You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them. You want to set it and forget it. The channels that work here are the ones that get tested and refined every week. Managing spend without changing anything is not the job. You're uncomfortable with imperfect data. Our attribution is still maturing, and part of your job is improving it while making decisions with what we have. You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional. You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media. You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team. You'll build your own ad creative using Claude Design, templates you work with our in-house designer on, and AI tools for testing video and gif variations. Our team is currently 40% female and 30%+ from underrepresented communities. Note : Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws.
