Job Title: Product Marketing Manager, Staff**

**Location: Remote (San Jose, CA)** **JOB DESCRIPTION:** This role will focus on the supplier and network, developing strategies and programs to drive acquisition and retention, partnering across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You will be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, create differentiated positioning and messaging, and orchestrate effective GTM launches. You'll lead the GTM strategy for acquisition, retention and enablement. You'll also lead core functions such as competitive analysis, market research, and customer advocacy. Success in this role will be measured by shared supplier goals, which you'll co-own with Sales and Product, and by the adoption and quality of the GTM systems you build. **Key Responsibilities:**

- Architect the (GTM) strategy for supplier and network, translating insights that drive acquisition, adoption, and retention, aligning cross-functional stakeholders and resources.Set KPIs with Sales and Product and track progress against shared targets.
- Influence roadmap and investment decisions for the segment, partnering with Product to turn firm and sales insights into prioritization. Define the research learning agenda.
- Serve as the champion for suppliers and the network, turning insights about needs, journeys, and segments into messaging and programs that resonate.
- Lead audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging, creating compelling product narratives that guide all GTM efforts.
- Lead complex, multi-team launches and programs end to end, and iterate the GTM playbook so the team can repeat what works.
- Partner with Sales to deliver enablement content, tools, and processes that drive adoption, address competition, and support new capabilities.
- Run win/loss, competitive, and funnel analysis to sharpen positioning, and develop pricing POVs for the Pricing team.

**We'd love to chat if you have:**

- 12+ years of professional experience in Product Marketing (or closely related role), with direct experience at the Senior Product Marketing Manager level.
- Proven experience in B2B SaaS and/or fintech with preference for companies that sell to finance professionals.
- A track record of successful product and feature launches, including developing positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy.
- Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer segmentation ,and translating findings into strategy and roadmap decisions, with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to work closely with research and analytics teams.
- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and outcomes through others across Product, Sales, and Marketing, without direct authority.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to VP and executive leadership.
- Ability to reconcile competing priorities across audiences, products, or sales motions in a highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Proven track record in product or segment marketing targeting B2B enterprise channels(payments or fintech experience heavily preferred).
- Hands-on experience with training, battle cards, objection handling, and payments or product-specific playbooks for a sales and customer success teams.
- Ability to set direction and build processes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, with minimal supervision.
- Skilled storyteller who can connect multiple products or segments into one narrative for internal and external audiences.
- Exposure to pricing and packaging strategy.

2886.Gecko Job Description: Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. Position Summary As the Senior Field Marketing Manager, Events, you will own the strategy and execution of Harness' North America regional field marketing and events portfolio, designing integrated marketing programs that accelerate pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and elevate the Harness brand across enterprise technology audiences. This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who thinks beyond event logistics. You'll develop investment strategies, identify growth opportunities, and partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Executive Leadership to create experiences that deliver measurable business impact About the role Own the strategy, planning, and execution of Harness' North America regional field marketing event portfolio, aligning investments with revenue goals, product launches, and regional go-to-market priorities. Build scalable event playbooks and operational frameworks that support multiple regions, product lines, and future organizational growth. Evaluate sponsorship opportunities and recommend event investments based on audience fit, pipeline potential, executive engagement, and business impact. Develop engagement strategies before, during, and after events to maximize interactions with high-value prospects and customers. Manage end-to-end event execution, including budget management, vendors, staffing, creative, production, logistics, and onsite operations, while ensuring a consistent and differentiated Harness brand experience. Track KPIs across engagement, pipeline, revenue influence, and ROI, using performance data and attendee insights to optimize event investments. Develop post-event recommendations that influence future investments, optimize performance, and improve overall event strategy About you Experience: 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS field marketing, strategic events, or integrated marketing, with a strong focus supporting enterprise sales organizations. Strategy: Proven success developing and executing integrated field marketing and event strategies that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, executive engagement, and brand awareness. Cross Functional Engagement: Experience developing strong relationships with Sales counterparts and partnering cross-functionally with Demand Generation and Product Marketing to execute go-to-market initiatives. Project Management: Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex, high-impact programs simultaneously. Analytics: Strong experience using performance metrics and insights to optimize marketing investments, measure ROI, and inform strategic decisions. Event Management: Experience managing marketing budgets, agency relationships, vendors, and event production from planning through execution. Communication: Outstanding presentation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with executives, customers, and external partners. Travel + Pace: Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and a bias toward action. Ability and willingness to travel 25-30% of the time for on-site event management. Work Location Remote or Hybrid within the West Coast of the U.S What you will have at Harness Competitive salary Comprehensive healthcare benefits Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Flexible work schedule Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events Monthly internet reimbursement Pay transparency $125,000—$140,000 USD Harness in the news: Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin. At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/ Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations. If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io . You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website ( https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams) , or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

2887.Gecko Job Description: We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu Instacart's commercial event calendar, spanning premier industry tradeshows like Cannes Lions, Expo West, and Shoptalk Europe alongside owned executive programs and bespoke cultural hospitality experiences, needs dedicated, hands-on ownership for the next six months. Without this role, event logistics, vendor relationships, and cross-functional coordination across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative go unmanaged at a critical point in our B2B growth. This contract role exists to ensure every Instacart presence at a major industry event is executed with precision, on budget, and with measurable impact. By the end of the engagement, Instacart's reputation as a sophisticated event marketer in the eCommerce, AdTech, and CPG space will be meaningfully advanced. What you'll cook up in your first year Instacart's B2B event calendar is executed flawlessly across premier tradeshows (Cannes Lions, Expo West, Shoptalk Europe), executive programs, and bespoke hospitality experiences, with every event delivered on time and within budget. Event creative assets are produced in close partnership with marketing, creative, and sales teams, ensuring consistent brand representation across all touchpoints. Project plans, timelines, and budgets are built and maintained per event, giving stakeholders across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative clear visibility and alignment throughout. A reporting and measurement framework is in place that captures event performance and informs future investment decisions. Vendor and contract relationships are managed efficiently, with invoicing and negotiations handled smoothly to keep event operations running without friction. The secret ingredients we're looking for Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 5 to 10 years of B2B event marketing experience Hands-on Cannes Lions experience required Proven track record managing high-profile tradeshows and industry events Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Strong written and verbal communication skills Experience with contract negotiation and vendor invoicing Comfortable with administrative duties and operational support Ability to travel 2 to 4 times during the contract period Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) Experience with Cvent, Salesforce, Google Sheets, or Excel Experience with events in the eCommerce, AdTech, and/or CPG marketing industries Experience managing large-scale events (100 to 600+ attendees) #LI-Remote Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here . For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $142,000—$150,000 USD WA $136,000—$143,500 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $131,000—$138,000 USD All other states $119,000—$125,500 USD

2891.Gecko Job Description: WHY DEPT®? We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA. We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter. At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build. THE ROLE: As an Account Coordinator, Paid Media your primary function will be to provide vital production support for your account team. Day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to running and formatting performance reports, implementing account tasks and optimizations, building and uploading campaigns, and participating in and taking notes during internal syncs, client meetings, and presentations.  Account Coordinators will become responsible for 2-3 accounts and will learn DEPT®’s best practices for Paid Search Engine Marketing while gaining the foundational skills necessary to progress into more advanced roles that will expand on the breadth and depth of knowledge.   PROFICIENCY EXPECTATIONS We expect Account Coordinators to develop a solid foundation of Paid Media analytical and technical expertise and be proficient in the following: Proficiency in Excel/Sheets: Demonstrate proficiency in using essential spreadsheet functions and formulas including, but not limited to: sorting filters vlookup concatenate pivot tables text to columns conditional formatting Demonstrate an understanding of how to take advantage of these functions and formulas when performing tasks (ex: ad customization uses concatenation and length formulas) with limited oversight needed. Accuracy is critical, and Associates will need to QA their work to ensure accurate data is being relayed to the rest of the team and clients. Proficiency in Paid Media: Ability to navigate through the UIs to: Pull reports at various levels (campaign, keyword, audience, placement, device, etc.) along with the desired columns/metrics and understand the data/results. Implement tasks via the Google UI, Editor, and other necessary channel-specific platforms Upload & edit campaigns, targeting methods, ads, keywords, placements, negatives and other standard account management tasks within the UI Create and edit campaigns, ads, and audiences in Facebook Understanding of DMUS’s SEM methodology Various metrics and how to calculate them, as well as their relationship to each other (ex: CPC, CTR, CVR, etc) High-level understanding of the different levers to pull to hit target goals Attend search-specific training led internally or by channel partners to continue education  Experience across Google - search, display and/or app campaigns Experience with a combination of these campaign types: UAC (universal app campaigns), ACi (app campaign install), Google app campaigns, GDN campaigns (Google Display Network), performance max, discovery campaigns Experience with A/B testing   GROWTH EXPECTATIONS Over time in the role, we expect Associates to be responsible for learning and mastering higher-level concepts as outlined below: Report write-ups –Able to identify performance trends, understand the metrics, explain why certain things happened in the past week, and develop write-ups with clear explanations. Bid adjustments – Able to understand different bidding methodologies (smart bidding vs manual) and the strategy behind the bid adjustments. Daily performance monitoring – Understand what to look at within the platforms daily to know when an action is needed based on performance fluctuations and trends. Understands how to leverage Qontrol to identify where accounts need attention and conduct a deeper investigation to solve execution problems. Budget pacing - Able to update, monitor, and communicate budget pacing performance to the broader team and flag any pacing areas above/below 15% variation. Campaign builds – Able to develop suggestions on the best method to build out a campaign, overall theme, keywords (search),  parameters, settings, ads, etc. Pixels – Able to create/pull/QA pixels, tracking, remarketing, and list creation. Able to delegate production tasks to nearshore or other internal team members where appropriate.   WHAT DO WE OFFER? Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage 401K plan, plus matching PTO Paid Company Holidays Parental Leave WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:  DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle, or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.  DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.  We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work .  Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.  DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI. Learn more about DEPT®   DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.  We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us. Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here . #LI-remote  The anticipated salary range for this position is listed below. Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, expertise, physical location , and organizational impact. This is based on a 40-hour workweek and leveling. Keep in mind, we’re flexible. US Remote Range $47,900 — $60,000 USD

2892.Gecko Job Description: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page:  https://www.fleetio.com/careers We're looking for a strategic, creative, and highly skilled content marketer who knows how to turn complex ideas, industry trends, and original research into compelling stories that educate audiences, influence buying decisions, and drive business growth. You're an exceptional writer and storyteller who can transform data and insights into thought-provoking content that positions a brand as an industry authority. You thrive at the intersection of content strategy, thought leadership, and demand generation. You understand that great content doesn't just attract attention—it builds credibility, shapes conversations, and creates demand. You know how to develop a compelling narrative and bring it to life across multiple formats, channels, and stages of the buyer journey. You're equally comfortable developing a long-form industry report, crafting executive thought leadership, or responding quickly to emerging industry trends. You're naturally curious, highly organized, and self-driven, with a passion for finding interesting stories and bringing them to market. As Fleetio's Senior Content Marketing Manager, you'll lead the development of thought leadership content that establishes Fleetio as a trusted voice in fleet maintenance and fleet management. You'll collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Creative, and Revenue Marketing to create high-impact content that strengthens our brand, fuels integrated campaigns, and contributes to pipeline and revenue growth. Your Impact Lead Fleetio's thought leadership content strategy Develop and execute a thought leadership content strategy that positions Fleetio as an authority in fleet maintenance, fleet management, and the broader transportation industry. Create compelling, high-quality content across industry reports, original research, white papers, articles, webinars, executive thought leadership, and conference presentations. Translate industry trends, customer insights, proprietary data, and subject matter expertise into differentiated perspectives and compelling narratives. Identify emerging industry conversations and proactively develop timely, relevant content that keeps Fleetio at the forefront of the market. Build an integrated content engine Own and manage a strategic editorial calendar aligned with business priorities, audience interests, product initiatives, and integrated marketing campaigns. Develop cornerstone content assets and create strategies to extend their impact across blogs, social media, webinars, email, paid advertising, and other channels. Partner with Growth Marketing to ensure content supports SEO, AI-driven search discovery (AEO), and organic audience growth. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Creative teams to ensure content is accurate, differentiated, engaging, and aligned with Fleetio's broader messaging. Balance long-term editorial initiatives with the agility to capitalize on timely industry trends and business opportunities. Drive demand generation and business impact Partner with Revenue Marketing to develop content that attracts, engages, and converts prospective customers across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments. Create content that supports integrated campaigns, lead generation, account-based marketing, and sales enablement initiatives. Develop distribution and amplification strategies that maximize the reach, engagement, and business impact of content investments. Measure and optimize content performance across engagement, organic visibility, lead generation, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution. Scale content production and innovation Own the content development process from ideation and research through writing, editing, stakeholder reviews, and publication. Establish efficient editorial workflows that maintain exceptional quality while enabling consistent, timely content production. Leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate research, ideation, repurposing, and production without compromising originality, accuracy, or editorial quality. Build strong relationships with internal subject matter experts and business leaders to uncover insights and translate their expertise into compelling content. Your Experience 7+ years of experience developing and producing high-quality content in B2B SaaS, with a strong emphasis on thought leadership and content marketing. Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to create compelling long-form and short-form content. Proven experience developing original research, industry reports, executive thought leadership, and other high-impact content assets. Strong understanding of how content supports demand generation, SEO, brand awareness, and pipeline growth. Experience building editorial strategies and content calendars that align with business priorities and integrated marketing campaigns. Demonstrated ability to transform complex topics, data, and research into clear, engaging narratives for business audiences. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives and deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate across Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders. Highly self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable taking ownership of content initiatives from concept through execution. Experience using AI tools and modern content workflows to improve productivity while maintaining high editorial standards. Benefits  Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) Vision insurance Incentive stock options 401(k) match of 4% PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!) 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid) FSA & HSA options Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) Community service funds Professional development funds Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only) Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

2894.Gecko Job Description: Role Description As the Senior Manager of Lifecycle Marketing, you will own Dropbox’s lifecycle marketing strategy across onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, expansion, cross-sell, and re-engagement. You will lead a team of lifecycle marketers and build a portfolio of programs that help customers discover value, expand their use of Dropbox, and deepen their relationship with our products over time. This is a senior people leadership role with direct accountability for business outcomes. You will set the lifecycle strategy and roadmap, determine where the team should invest, establish how programs are prioritized and measured, and stay close enough to the work to raise the quality of execution and unblock the highest-priority initiatives. You will work closely with Product Growth, Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other marketing teams. Lifecycle Marketing will own customer communication strategy, channel planning, lifecycle program design, and marketing execution. The opportunity is broader than running an email program. Dropbox has a large global customer base, multiple products, and both product-led and sales-assisted customer motions. The Head of Lifecycle Marketing will define how those pieces connect across the customer lifecycle and build the operating model needed to move from individual campaigns toward scalable growth programs. Responsibilities Own Dropbox’s lifecycle marketing strategy and roadmap across onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, expansion, and multi-product adoption. Lead, coach, and develop a team of lifecycle marketers, with clear goals, operating rhythms, and accountability for business outcomes. Build and manage a portfolio of lifecycle programs using customer behavior, product usage, segmentation, triggers, and personalization to improve adoption, retention, and revenue. Partner with Product Growth, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other cross-functional teams to connect lifecycle communications with activation, in-product discovery, monetization, and expansion while maintaining clear ownership across teams. Establish a strong experimentation and measurement approach, using controlled tests, holdouts, cohort analysis, customer behavior, and revenue to determine what creates incremental impact. Build the operating model for lifecycle marketing, including prioritization, planning, governance, and the technical and data capabilities required to execute reliably at scale. Requirements 10+ years of experience across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, growth marketing, customer engagement, or closely related disciplines, ideally in a SaaS, subscription, or product-led business. Significant people-management experience, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and leading high-performing teams. Demonstrated experience setting lifecycle strategy and translating it into programs that improve customer adoption, retention, monetization, expansion, or revenue. Deep experience with customer segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, experimentation, and marketing automation. Strong technical fluency across CRM and lifecycle systems, customer data, campaign orchestration, measurement, deliverability, and related operational requirements. Strong business judgment and experience working across Product, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, Engineering, and Product Marketing to turn complex inputs into clear priorities and decisions. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading lifecycle marketing in a product-led growth business with both self-serve and sales-assisted motions. Experience building expansion, cross-sell, or multi-product programs across a broad existing customer base. Experience with Iterable or comparable enterprise lifecycle and marketing automation platforms. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this  blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. Compensation US Zone 1 This role is not available in Zone 1 US Zone 2 $181,500 — $245,500 USD US Zone 3 $161,300 — $218,300 USD

2895.Gecko Job Description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . Pinterest's Consumer Brand Marketing team builds the campaigns and cultural moments that bring Pinterest's brand to life, from global tentpole brand campaigns to experiential activations at Coachella, all in service of our mission: helping people create a life they love. We're looking for a Brand Marketing Manager who has helped shape culture-defining creative campaigns. Someone able to translate cultural and consumer insight and business needs into brand strategy while harmoniously driving campaigns from initial briefing through launch and final reporting. What you'll do: Own specific work streams within Pinterest's tentpole brand marketing activations. Drive the day-to-day process of Pinterest's brand marketing campaigns from kickoff through final execution and reporting, keeping work streams, timelines, and deliverables on track across tentpole activations. Manage channel and creative partners, review and give feedback on creative work, and give informed, critical input into media strategy and plans. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. About the Role Motive is hiring a Senior Customer Marketing Specialist to own and execute customer engagement and advocacy programs that drive retention, expansion, and brand credibility. In this role, you will build, scale, and nurture a thriving online customer community while managing incoming advocacy initiatives. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building programs from the ground up and running them end-to-end. You’ll join a lean, high-impact team responsible for customer storytelling (case studies, video testimonials, speaking engagements), online reviews, community engagement, reference management and advocacy programs that amplify the voice of the customer and support business growth. Experience working in industries with physical operations—such as transportation and logistics, field service, construction, or similar environments—is a strong plus. In this role, you’ll use AI, automation, and modern customer marketing tools to make advocacy more scalable and efficient, while ensuring customers have a positive experience and programs deliver measurable business impact. Key Responsibilities Customer Marketing Execution & Lifecycle Engagement Execute customer marketing campaigns that support adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion Manage customer communications across key moments in the lifecycle, partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Marketing Coordinate closely with internal teams to ensure customer advocacy assets are discoverable, up to date, and actively used Maintain campaign calendars, trackers, and workflows to ensure consistent execution Customer Advocacy & Storytelling Design how customers are activated across the business—spanning references, storytelling, events, campaigns, media interviews, and other go-to-market initiatives Identify and recruit customers for advocacy opportunities and strengthen long-term relationships with champions Evangelizing the value of customer advocacy internally; this includes articulating advocacy contributions to executive-level audiences Produce and manage customer testimonials, case studies, customer spotlights, and reference stories Build and maintain a centralized, well-organized repository of customer proof points for Sales and Marketing use   Online Community Management Develop and execute engagement strategies to drive active participation, peer-to-peer connection, and growth within our customer community. Execute community initiatives including discussions, recognition programs, and events created for just the community Synthesize community feedback and sentiment to share actionable product and messaging insights with cross-functional teams Review Platform & Reputation Operations Own day-to-day execution of Motive’s presence on review platforms such as G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights Run review generation campaigns, including customer targeting, outreach, and follow-up Track review performance and trends, escalating insights, risks, or opportunities as needed Coordinate internally on responses and actions related to customer feedback Customer Programs & Events Support execution of customer-facing events such as webinars, media interviews, and speaking opportunities Activate customer advocates for product launches, campaigns, and field marketing initiatives Fulfill and track customer reference requests across the sales organization, building an active advocate network to support high-value deal conversions. Build and maintain an advocate pipeline by consolidating signals from CS, Sales, NPS, product usage, events, and community activity Measurement & Optimization Track and report on core metrics, including advocacy participation, community engagement, review momentum, and asset utilization Use data and customer insights to improve processes, messaging, and program effectiveness over time   Program Execution & Operations Manage day-to-day execution of customer marketing programs, including timelines, logistics, follow-ups, and asset delivery Coordinate customer outreach, scheduling, approvals, and consent for testimonials, case studies, and advocacy activities Maintain clean documentation, trackers, and systems to ensure advocacy efforts are organized, up-to-date, and easy to activate across teams Ensure customer-facing experiences—from outreach to delivery—are polished, timely, and positive Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience) 3–5 years of experience in customer marketing, customer references, online reviews, advocacy, community, or lifecycle marketing within a B2B technology company Proven experience launching and managing customer marketing and retention/expansion-focused programs Ability to balance customer empathy with business priorities when managing advocacy requests Strong storytelling, writing, and customer communication skills Strong organizational skills with attention to detail across systems, timelines, and customer touchpoints Experience in establishing, building, and managing strong customer relationships Familiarity with review platforms such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights, customer engagement tools such as Peerbound , and project management solutions like Asana Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives end-to-end Experience interviewing customers and contributing to written customer stories or case studies Experience managing a customer reference program is a plus. Proven track record of growing and managing an online customer community Familiarity with WordPress and video hosting platforms like Wistia Success in This Role Looks Like A growing pipeline of engaged advocates and customer champions A thriving online customer community that drives connection and loyalty Strong brand credibility across review platforms A robust testimonial library that supports Sales and Marketing needs Measurable improvements in customer engagement, retention, and advocacy participation Increase in the customer voice being used in Sales outreach Pay Transparency Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. 2898.Gecko Job Description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.  BASE SALARY: $100,000 - $120,000 per year MUST HAVE: Strong follow-through and task ownership; thrives on getting things done Understands direct response mechanics and high-volume testing environments, preferably within verticals such as financial services (investing, banking, credit cards, lending, etc), home services, insurance, or similar lead‑form categories Experience running A/B tests, QA'ing launches, and reporting on test outcomes Comfortable updating copy, layout, and page flows within testing tools or CMS Solid understanding of what impacts conversion, even if you're not the strategist Working knowledge of analytics platforms like Google Analytics, Looker, or similar Ability to balance internal and external pressure to drive competing KPIs Experience  optimizing lead form pages end-to-end through UI/UX savvy Clear communicator who can work across Copy, Design, and Media teams Creative mindset — can spot UX friction and suggest improvements based on behavior EXPERIENCE : 5+ years in a performance marketing or CRO execution role. You’ve launched tests, owned strategy, QA and implementation, and collaborated with strategic leads to bring ideas to life. YOUR ROLE Execute high-impact landing page and funnel tests that optimize performance across high-traffic campaigns. You’ll bring revenue-driving optimizations to life through hands-on building, multi-variate analysis, launching, and reporting to ensure flawless execution and continuous iteration, and you’ll balance expectations of internal and external KPIs. Outcomes (Performance Expectations) Test Execution: Perform continuous high-impact optimizations across device types and user journeys (e.g., copy, UI/UX, advertiser order) QA & Launch Reliability: Ensure tests and optimizations are implemented error-free, follow spec, and are tracked accurately. Insight Documentation: Summarize and document test results clearly to inform future optimizations. Task Velocity Support: Partner with optimization leads to move quickly on ideas and reduce bottlenecks; and become the subject matter expert on assigned offer verticals. Collaboration & Handoff: Work cross-functionally to get inputs, finalize creative, and prep launches efficiently. Multi-Variable Analyses: Create and monitor clear & comprehensive reports that track multiple KPIs, both internal and external Success Looks Like You consistently ship high-quality tests and optimizations that match the strategy brief You stay on top of timelines and follow through on implementation steps You catch bugs or tracking issues before they go live You share learnings that help the broader team execute better You’re a reliable executor who enables strategists and creatives to move faster Competencies Industry-Savvy: Experience within verticals such as financial services (investing, banking, credit cards, lending, etc), home services, insurance, or similar lead‑form categories Execution Machine: Detail-oriented and efficient; gets things done with speed and care. Process-Focused: Follows structured workflows and tracks everything from briefs to results. Analytical: Has the eye for creating easy-to-read and effective reports to keep track of performance. QA Mindset: Spots gaps before they cause issues — from typos to misfiring events. Collaborative Doer: Brings a positive, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude to getting things over the finish line. Adaptable: Comfortable shifting priorities and managing multiple launches at once. Hungry to Learn: Curious about what’s working, why, and how to improve results over time. TOTAL COMPENSATION Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments. 2903.Gecko Job Description: About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape. What you'll do: Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations. Know the industry and these associations inside and out: ensure Pinterest is getting the most value out of each membership, and recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit a relationship when it's no longer earning its keep. Partner with Sales leadership to make sure membership benefits (introductions, visibility, data, access) are actually being used and translating into value for the business. Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key U.S. and Canada industry moments — including CES and POSSIBLE — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities. Develop programming — talking points, fireside chats, client panels and more — for Pinterest's owned events and industry events across the U.S. and Canada. Support programming for occasional agency events (e.g., WPP Stream) and large client moments, such as an executive panel at a major client's company-wide gathering or a top-five agency holding company event. Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment. Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Comms to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities and reconcile competing perspectives. Track, measure and report on the value and impact of memberships, event investments and speaking engagements, and use those insights to recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit commitments. Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality. What we're looking for: Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, industry relations, communications or event marketing, with expertise in sourcing and shaping speaking opportunities at major industry events. Experience managing industry association memberships or similar external relationships, including evaluating their value and making recommendations on where to invest or pull back. Experience preparing spokespeople and executives for stage moments, including developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with communications teams. Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of events and activations, including sponsorships, panels, logistics, budgets and timelines across multiple moments at once. Experience building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, including Sales leadership, and reconciling perspectives to prioritize the highest-impact work with limited guidance. Expertise in written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent a company credibly to external organizations, clients and agency partners. Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing and reporting, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality. Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work, with high integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables. Willingness to travel for key industry events, client events and speaking engagements as needed. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing or communications, or equivalent experience. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.    #LI-REMOTE #LI-JH4 At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $120,321 — $247,718 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete  this form for support.   By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Success in this role requires a focus on executing marketing programs, driving customer acquisition and retention, and continuously optimizing our processes and toolset. You are customer-focused, driven to make Oura “our retail partner’s best partner,” and thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.Frequent travel to meet key accounts is required. Drive cross-functional execution of retail marketing programs to meet Oura business goals that are within agreed-upon budgets and KPIs. Coordinating and managing marketing brand assets and deliver on time to creative teams, while following-up and delivering to retail partners Track and optimize marketing programs, utilizing results to improve efficiency Serve as primary marketing point- of contact for Regional partners Analyze campaign and project performance, applying data and critical thinking to inform decisions and implement solutions Provide strategic input during the Retail Marketing goal creation process Influencing Regional Retail Marketing team and accounts they support Cultivate and maintain productive relationships, networking internally and eternally with marketing counterparts at Regional accounts Participating actively in interviewing and onboarding of new employees This is a US remote role.  What you'll bring 6+ years of experience in a Retail Channel Marketing/ Partner Marketing role Experience executing Retail/ Channel marketing activities and OPEX investments. Understanding how retailers measure and manage their businesses (CPC, CPA, LTV, ROAS) Understanding retail marketing levers that drive traffic in-store and online Excellent communicator, superb verbal and written communication Extremely high level of accuracy and attention to detail Experience working with retail partners building in-store experiences through permanent fixtures, temporary displays, staff training and education Experience maintaining comarketing and OPEX budgets with fiscal responsibility Highly effective at managing conflict. Is able to address issues between stakeholders swiftly in order to maintain a positive team spirit that is consistent with Ōura values Strong interpersonal skills, approachable and flexible Experience with navigating various organizational environments where culture and structure varies Bilingual - English & Spanish Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or Economics Benefits At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: Competitive salary and equity packages Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $143,650 - $169,000 Region 2 $130,050 - $153,000 Region 3 $117,300 - $138,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

2905.Gecko Job Description: Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work. We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference. Silverback’s next SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll also flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses. Here’s what we expect from our SEO Manager: Strategic Chops: Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies. AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Analytical Skills: Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Client-Facing: Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner. Client Management: Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships. Tactical Execution: Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale. Innovation: Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices. Data Analysis: Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life. Agency Background: You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results Years of Experience: We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 2 years of agency experience; 3 years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required, 5+ years preferred. Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients. AI Search Testing & Optimization: You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out. Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar. Content Experience: You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production. Tools/Platforms: You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog. “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day. Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you. Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable. Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact. Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously. Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works. Unlimited PTO Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans Monthly Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture Company-paid ClassPass membership 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave Summer Fridays 401(k) with Employer Match We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication. We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality. Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you! Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, color, disability, family, genetic information, origin, race, religion, sex. For more information, we invite you to visit eeoc.gov.

Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems. For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Content Marketing Manager – Industrial B2B Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors and thrives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. This individual will create content that earns the trust of executive audiences and translates complex technical concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption. SEO & Distribution • Support organic content strategy through keyword research, topic clustering, content planning, and on-page SEO optimization. • Focus on high-intent, bottom-of-funnel content opportunities that drive qualified traffic and business outcomes. • Partner with Demand Generation teams to integrate content into nurture programs, paid campaigns, and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives. • Manage content distribution across owned channels, including blogs, newsletters, and developer communities, as well as earned channels such as syndication, guest publications, and industry forums. • Ensure content is optimized for discoverability across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search and answer platforms. 2910.Job Title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure
2910.Gecko Job Description: At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto. Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings. The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn. With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot. We are looking to add a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure to our team. You will own how Anchorage Digital positions and takes to market its stablecoin infrastructure: the platform institutions use to mint, redeem, bridge, custody, settle, and manage USD stablecoins through a federally chartered bank, plus the API and developer surface behind it and the payments service that lets banks move dollars onchain without a correspondent bank. Your buyers are the people who run money movement and treasury: payments and treasury leads at banks and fintechs, trading desks and exchanges that settle in stablecoins, and the engineers and product managers who integrate against our API. They care about speed, cost, counterparty risk, and regulatory standing, and they are comparing us to crypto-native infrastructure providers, bank consortia, and doing nothing. This is a generalist product marketing role on a small team. Product marketing is the core of the job, and you will also carry brand, events, and communications work for your product lines: the launch announcement, the developer content, the conference presence, the client reference program. You should be as comfortable writing a technical one-pager as briefing a designer or prepping an executive for a panel. We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure role: Write the positioning, messaging, and ICP definition for stablecoin infrastructure, covering minting and redemption, settlement, treasury, bank payments, and the API, and keep them current as the products and the market move. Build and maintain the sales toolkit: pitch decks, one-pagers, solution pages, competitive battlecards, FAQs, integration overviews, and client case studies, and train Sales on how to use them. Run product launches end to end: new chains and stablecoins supported, new API capabilities, pricing changes, and new bank services, with the announcement, developer content, website and in-app updates, and enablement ready on day one. Produce content for an institutional and technical audience, from web copy and blog posts to developer guides, white papers, webinars, and conference talks, in the Anchorage Digital voice. Turn infrastructure concepts (settlement finality, reserve handling, bridging, treasury operations) into a clear business case for a treasurer, a payments lead, and an engineer, and decide which proof points each one needs. Build competitive positioning against crypto-native infrastructure providers and bank consortia, and make the case for running money movement through a federally chartered bank in plain terms a buyer can repeat internally. Own the brand, events, and communications calendar for your product lines, including developer and payments conference presence, speaking submissions, and executive prep. Develop fluency in how our platform and API work, which stablecoins and chains we support, and the regulatory standing that shapes what we can say. Partner with Product and Engineering on roadmap priorities using client interviews, integration feedback, win and loss analysis, and market research. Work with Legal and Compliance so every external claim survives review the first time. Gather client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and share it across Marketing, Product, Sales, and the Stablecoin Solutions team. Act as the marketing point of contact for the stablecoin infrastructure business, and bring the broader Marketing team (design, demand generation, social, communications) into your launches. Have 5 or more years in B2B product marketing, with at least part of that marketing an API, platform, or infrastructure product in fintech, payments, financial services, or digital assets. Have owned positioning and go-to-market for a technical product end to end, from ICP and messaging through launch and sales enablement, and can show the results. Write clearly for both a treasurer and an engineer, in short form and long form, and can explain settlement, minting and redemption, or a bridge between chains without a glossary. Have worked on brand, events, or communications programs, not only product marketing, and are happy to carry those for your product lines on a small team. Have sold alongside a sales team: built the deck, trained the reps, sat in on the calls, and changed the pitch based on what you heard. Are comfortable with regulatory and compliance review, and treat it as part of getting the story right rather than an obstacle. Search constantly for client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and use it to change what we build and say. Have marketed payments infrastructure, a developer platform, or a settlement or treasury product. Have worked with developer relations or produced developer-facing content such as integration guides and API overviews. Have marketed to banks, and understand how a bank evaluates a new vendor for money movement. Follow stablecoin settlement, bank adoption of onchain payments, and the GENIUS Act closely and have opinions about where the market goes next. Were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. About Anchorage Digital: Who we are The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy. Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives. Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation. Protecting your privacy rights is important to Anchorage Digital, and we work to maintain the trust and confidence of our clients when handling personal or financial information. Please see our privacy policy notices here.
