## Media Buying Team Lead

Remote

Full Time

Experienced

[Share](https://bmdigital.applytojob.com/app/share/NnhjjtMSy4)

About Advantage HQ

Advantage HQ is building the next generation of creator-led growth infrastructure for consumer brands.

We combine creative strategy, creator partnerships, performance content, whitelisting, affiliate distribution, paid media, and proprietary technology into one integrated growth system.

Our team manages more than $850 million in annual media spend and works with a network of more than 400,000 creators across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Through Meteoric AI, our proprietary intelligence platform, we use data and AI to improve decision-making across creative production, creator selection, customer acquisition, campaign performance, and brand growth.

We work with ambitious consumer brands across health, wellness, beauty, nutrition, personal care, and lifestyle.

The Opportunity

As our client portfolio and media organization grow, we need strong leaders who can help our Media Buying teams operate at a consistently high level.

The Media Buying Team Lead is the first layer of leadership within our media organization. You will lead a team of Media Buyers and Media Analysts, help them solve complex performance challenges, maintain high execution standards, and create the structure they need to do their best work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You should have strong paid media expertise and still be close enough to campaign performance to coach your team effectively.

## What You'll Own

### Lead and develop the team

You will manage a team of Media Buyers and Media Analysts, providing regular coaching, feedback, and performance support.

You will understand the strengths and development areas of each team member and help them become more capable and independent operators.

### Maintain execution quality

You will review campaign performance, account health, testing activity, and execution quality across your team's portfolio.

You will identify problems early, challenge weak decisions, and ensure the team follows the standards required to deliver strong client outcomes.

### Solve complex media problems

You will act as an escalation point when Media Buyers encounter difficult performance or account challenges.

You will help the team diagnose problems, determine the right course of action, and learn from the situation rather than simply providing the answer.

### Improve team workflows

You will identify recurring execution issues and work with leadership to improve processes, documentation, and team routines.

You will help create a more consistent way of working across accounts without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

### Build the next generation of media talent

You will support onboarding and training for new Media Buyers and Analysts and help identify high-potential team members who can take on greater responsibility.

## Who You Are

You are an experienced paid media professional who has started taking responsibility for other people's performance.

You understand e-commerce media deeply enough to challenge campaign strategy, interpret performance data, and coach others through difficult decisions.

You are organized, direct, and comfortable holding people accountable. You do not need to personally solve every problem. You know how to help other people become better problem solvers.

Most importantly, you care about both performance and people.

## Experience We Value

- 5+ years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, or a related field
- Strong e-commerce media buying experience
- Experience with Meta, Google, TikTok, or other major paid media platforms
- Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets
- Experience mentoring, coaching, or leading media professionals
- Strong understanding of performance metrics, testing, optimization, and funnel performance
- Strong communication and analytical skills
- Experience working with multiple clients or brands

## Why Join Advantage HQ

You will have the opportunity to move from being a strong individual contributor into a leadership role while staying close to the media work you know best.

You will work alongside experienced media, creative, growth, and client teams and have the opportunity to help shape how our media organization operates as we scale.

## Compensation & Location

- $40,000 - $90,000 USD total annual compensation, including base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
- Fully remote. We have built the infrastructure for high-performance distributed teams and trust our people to do their best work from wherever they work best.
- We are open to candidates globally.
- We care far more about ownership, judgment, and execution than geography.

If you're excited by leading talented media professionals, solving performance challenges, improving how teams work, and helping build a stronger media organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Remote

Full Time

Digital Marketing

Senior Manager/Supervisor

**Ready to Make your Mark?**

The Senior Digital Marketing Manager at BlastX Consulting owns the digital engine that builds our brand and drives inbound demand. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with full-funnel accountability, from first impression to qualified pipeline, across organic, partner, and paid channels.

You’ll run our inbound program in HubSpot, build and maintain our ideal customer profile (ICP) database, and curate the website content and landing pages that turn visitors into conversations. You’ll direct outside contractors for paid media and specialized digital work, and partner with our designer to bring campaigns to life. You’ll also grow our Adobe partner marketing and run the webinars and online events that put our experts in front of buyers. Most important, you’ll measure what works, fix what doesn’t, and keep the funnel moving.

This role is ideal for a builder who loves data, writes well, and gets things done. This is not a role for the faint of heart, but we promise you’ll have the opportunity to [Make Your Mark](https://www.blastx.com/make-your-mark) every day by building the brand and demand engine that powers BlastX Consulting.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Inbound Demand Generation & Full-Funnel Marketing**

- Plan and run integrated campaigns across awareness, consideration, and conversion stages


- Build nurture programs that move prospects from first visit to sales conversation


- Partner with the Growth team to define lead stages, scoring, and handoff to sales


- Own campaign calendars, budgets, and launch timelines


**HubSpot Marketing Operations & Content**

- Build and manage emails, workflows, lists, forms, and landing pages in HubSpot


- Write and produce campaign content for email, nurture, webinars, and events


- Maintain database health, segmentation, deliverability, and contact property standards


- Keep marketing and CRM data aligned so reporting stays accurate and trusted


**ICP Database Development**

- Define and refine our ideal customer profile and buyer personas with marketing and growth leadership
- Build, enrich, and validate target account and contact lists using prospecting and enrichment tools


- Segment the database for targeted campaigns and account-based outreach


- Track database growth, coverage, and quality over time


**Website Content & Landing Pages**

- Write and publish web pages, landing pages, and conversion paths on blastx.com


- Partner with our designer on layout and creative while owning copy, structure, and conversion goals


- Apply SEO and AI search best practices to site content and Insights articles


- Test pages, forms, and calls to action to improve conversion rates


**Organic & Paid Media**

- Grow organic reach through SEO, LinkedIn, email, and content distribution


- Direct paid media contractors across Google Ads and LinkedIn, setting strategy, budgets, and targets


- Review paid performance regularly and reallocate spend toward what converts


- Manage retargeting and audience strategy across channels


**Adobe Partner Marketing & Events**

- Build and run co-marketing programs with Adobe to grow brand awareness and consideration


- Use Adobe partner resources, listings, and joint campaigns to reach new audiences


- Plan, promote, and run webinars, virtual events, and online roundtables from concept to follow-up


- Coordinate speakers, including our Adobe Champions and consulting experts, and support event content


- Turn event attendance into pipeline through registration, nurture, and post-event follow-up in HubSpot


- Support presence at industry conferences and Adobe events


**Analytics, Reporting & Optimization**

- Own marketing performance reporting from traffic to qualified pipeline


- Analyze campaign results and turn findings into specific optimizations and impact


- Maintain tracking, UTM standards, and attribution across GA4, Adobe Analytics/CJA and HubSpot as well as our CRM


- Share results and recommendations with marketing and executive leadership


**Contractor & Vendor Management**

- Scope, hire, and manage contractors for paid media and specialized digital needs


- Set clear deliverables, review work quality, and hold partners accountable to results


- Evaluate and recommend MarTech tools that improve marketing performance


**Desired Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications**

- 6-8+ years in B2B digital marketing, including 3+ years in a senior role, ideally in professional services, consulting, or MarTech


- Proven record of building inbound programs that generate qualified pipeline


- Advanced hands-on experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub (workflows, lists, forms, landing pages, and reporting) is required


- Experience building and managing ICP and target account databases with tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar


- Working knowledge of paid search and paid social, including Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager


- Strong SEO skills and comfort with GA4, Google Search Console, and SEMrush or similar tools


- Excellent conversion-focused copywriting for web, landing pages, and email


- Experience with technology partner co-marketing (Adobe preferred) and running webinars and virtual events


- Experience with WordPress and basic HTML


- Comfort with dashboards, attribution, A/B testing, and funnel metrics

- Experience managing contractors or agencies to defined goals and budgets
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

This is a full-time remote opportunity that requires minimal travel for conferences and networking events.

**To Be Successful**

To succeed in this role, the Digital Marketing leader should demonstrate:

- Hands-On Execution: Gets things done; builds, launches, and fixes without waiting for perfect conditions


- Full-Funnel Thinking: Connects brand awareness to pipeline and knows how each stage feeds the next


- Data-Driven Optimization: Uses data to decide, test, and improve campaign performance


- Ownership & Accountability: Owns results end-to-end and follows through on commitments


- Contractor Leadership: Gives outside partners clear direction and holds them to high standards


- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively with designers, consultants, and the Growth team


- Clear Communication: Turns results into plain-language insights leadership can act on


- Agility & Prioritization: Thrives on a small team in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

- Passion for Continuous Learning: Stays ahead of digital marketing, AI search, and MarTech trends

2972.FireCrawl Job Description:
About You

You’re a hands-on performance marketer who knows how to reach the right buyers on LinkedIn and beyond. You’re equally comfortable planning a full-funnel, account-based program and strategizing the creative that brings it to life. You bring rigor to QA, curiosity to testing, and a sharp eye for when creative needs a refresh.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to lead our LinkedIn programs and run paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, content syndication, CTV, and podcasts/audio.

Our buyers are ecommerce and retail leaders, and paid media is how many of them first hear from us. In this role, you’ll turn Sales, Demand Gen, and ABM goals into campaigns that reach the right people at the right stage and build pipeline. You’ll own the channel end-to-end: planning, creative briefing, building, QAing, targeting, pacing, testing, reporting, and optimizing.

This is a hands-on, in-platform role. You’ll work alongside our Paid Search Specialist and partner closely with our Sales, Customer Marketing, Demand Gen, Creative, Product Marketing, and EMEA teams.

What makes this role different:

- 

You’ll own LinkedIn as a channel, not a slice of it. Planning, building, testing, and reporting all sit with you.

- 

You’ll plan across the full funnel and across 1:many, 1:few, and 1:1 programs, covering both broad reach and named accounts.

- 

You’ll own the creative pipeline for your channels, from requests and approvals through trafficking and rotation.

- 

You’ll lead weekly cross-channel optimization syncs, which gives you a voice in how the whole paid program performs.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Planning

- 

Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, content syndication, CTV, and podcasts/audio.

- 

Build tactical strategies across TOFU, MOFU, and BOFU, and across 1:many, 1:few, and 1:1 programs.

- 

Translate Sales and Demand Gen goals into plans by stage, persona, and segment.

- 

Shape copy and creative strategy with Creative, Customer Marketing, and Product Marketing, so each audience gets the right message.

Execution and Quality Assurance

- 

Build paid social campaigns end-to-end, including creative strategy, bidding, ad copy, and audiences.

- 

Run rigorous QA across copy, assets, campaign structure, audiences, and UTMs before anything goes live.

- 

Partner with our EMEA team to localize global campaigns for their markets.

- 

Track tasks, requests, and SLAs in Asana so work stays visible and on schedule.

Audience Targeting and Management

- 

Own audience list hygiene and targeting across platforms.

- 

Build audiences from first- and third-party data.

- 

Manage pixels and primary vs. secondary conversion architecture, so campaigns optimize toward the actions that matter most.

Budget Pacing and Management

- 

Manage budgets against lead volume, lead quality, conversion, pipeline, and ROI.

- 

Own pacing and anomaly detection, and keep documented budget pacing up to date.

Testing & Optimization

- 

Run structured tests on audiences, creative, landing pages, copy, and bidding.

- 

Run ongoing search query analysis and keyword optimization.

- 

Lead weekly cross‑channel optimization syncs.

Reporting

- 

Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting that pairs results with clear recommendations.

- 

Lead campaign hindsights that capture what drove results, what we learned, and what to do next.

- 

Stay current on platform changes, privacy, and B2B trends.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

- 

2-3 years of hands-on paid media experience, ideally within a media agency or performance‑focused environment

-

2973.FireCrawl Job Description:
We're looking for an experienced and driven Integrated Marketing Manager to lead the go-to-market plan and programs for NMI's payment gateway, with a focus on generating pipeline, acquiring new ISO partners and increasing adoption across priority vertical markets.

In this role, you'll develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring together demand generation, content, digital, channel, sales and product marketing. A key part of the role will also be developing a verticalized marketing approach for markets such as parking, transit, EV charging and healthcare, making NMI's gateway proposition more relevant to the specific needs, use cases and audiences within each market.

ISOs will be the primary audience, alongside vertical specific ISVs and software providers.

This is both a strategic and hands on role. You'll identify where the biggest opportunities lie, build the marketing strategy and work across teams to turn it into campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

### About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

 

### How We Work - Our Core Values

- Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus

- Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.

- Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

 

### About the Team

The NMI marketing team is a group of smart, collaborative people in a fast moving environment. Self-starters who love solving problems, learning continuously and building creative, data driven campaigns will thrive here.

 

### Key Responsibilities:

- Own the integrated marketing strategy and plan for NMI's core payment gateway, aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

- Develop and execute multi-channel campaigns to acquire new ISO partners, drive gateway adoption and support cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

- Develop verticalized marketing strategies for priority markets, using market, customer and competitive insight to tailor positioning, messaging and campaigns to specific industry needs.

- Build a strong understanding of ISO and ISV audiences, their buying journeys, challenges and decision drivers.

- Partner with product marketing and content teams to develop compelling messaging, thought leadership, customer stories, campaign content and sales enablement.

- Work closely with demand generation to define target audiences, campaign journeys, lead follow-up and conversion strategies.

- Collaborate with sales, channel and other marketing teams to ensure programs are aligned to commercial priorities and effectively executed.

- Manage campaigns from planning through execution, reporting and optimization, ensuring activity stays on track, on budget and on brand.

- Track performance against agreed KPIs and use insights to continuously improve targeting, messaging, channel mix and campaign effectiveness.

### Essential Skills and Experience:

- 5-7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in payments, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

- A marketing or related business degree or equivalent.

- Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.

- Experience with verticalized marketing, including developing market-specific positioning, messaging and go-to-market programs.

- Strong understanding of B2B partner or channel-led business models. Experience marketing to ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs or other payments audiences is highly desirable.

- Experience working closely with sales and demand generation teams on lead management, account targeting, sales enablement and pipeline acceleration.

- Experience collaborating with and managing agency partners.

- Strong digital marketing, campaign management and performance measurement skills, including marketing automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Pardot, ZoomInfo), SEM, SEO, PPC, display, programmatic, etc, as well as analytics (GA4).

- Exceptional project management, communication and stakeholder alignment skills.

- Creativity, curiosity, initiative and a strong commercial mindset.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

### As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

- A remote first culture!

- Competitive compensation and benefits

- Personal growth and advancement opportunities

- Flex PTO & dedicated sick time

- Health, Dental and Vision Insurance

- Life, ADD, Short-term and Long-term Disability insurance

- 401k matching up to 4% after two months of service

- Flexible Spending Account

- Paid Parental Leave

- Company volunteer days

- Employee referral program

- Bonusly colleague recognition

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We're focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.

Equal Opportunity

NMI is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation or sexual identity, genetic information, citizen status (except those that do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States), disability, military service, service member, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Please be aware that all offers of employment are made subject to receipt of satisfactory background and financial checks.

Attention job applicants: Please note that in compliance with the data protection regulations within your jurisdiction, any personal information submitted with your job application may be collected and used by NMI for the purpose of recruitment and employment-related activities. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and provide explicit consent to the processing of your personal information as described in our privacy policy found on our website. For more information on how we process your information, please read our privacy policy here: https://www.nmi.com/legal/privacy-policy/

About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.  

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

The Senior Channel Specialist, Paid Search is an execution-focused role on ISC's Retail Marketing Team (RMT), sitting within the Channel Acquisition Team reporting to the Channel Manager. This person is the operational engine behind ISC's paid search programs across 5 retail business units. The Senior Channel Specialist owns the hands-on, daily execution of building and managing campaigns, monitoring partner placements, reconciling billing, and maintaining the data hygiene for optimal performance/ reporting. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented performance marketer who thrives in a high-volume, multi-business unit environment with direct revenue impact.

Position Responsibilities

- Execute day-to-day paid search campaign management across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for all active ISC retail brands, including campaign builds, ad copy trafficking, bid adjustments, keyword maintenance, negative keyword management, and quality score monitoring.

- Monitor paid search campaign performance daily; flag anomalies in conversion rates, impression/ click share trends, CPL, and partner attribution to the Channel Manager and escalate data integrity issues to the Snr. Manager Marketing Analytics / Operations.

- Coordinate ad copy and landing page testing, reporting on findings and insights to enable performance improvements.

- Own monthly affiliate vendor billing reconciliation across all active partners; maintain accurate budget tracking records and surface material pacing variances to the Channel Manager and Finance.

- Ensure UTM parameter governance, pixel tagging accuracy, and affiliate tracking integrity across all active placements in coordination with the Snr. Manager Marketing Analytics / Operations; actively flag and help resolve attribution discrepancies.

- Support the Channel Manager in preparing weekly performance summaries, monthly channel reports, and competitive intelligence research across paid search and affiliate for the ISC retail brand portfolio.

Minimum Qualifications

- 2–4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with direct execution experience in paid search (Google Ads + Bing required).

- Practical experience managing paid search campaigns including keyword builds, ad copy trafficking, match type management, and bid adjustments; familiarity with value-based bidding strategies (target ROAS, target CPA) preferred.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; able to manage high task volume across multiple brands without sacrificing execution accuracy or SLA adherence.

- Proficient in Google Ads UI, SA360 Microsoft Ads UI, and Google Analytics 4 or comparable analytics tools; experience working with Looker or similar BI dashboards preferred.

- Solid understanding of UTM parameters, conversion tracking concepts, and pixel-based attribution; comfortable identifying and escalating tracking discrepancies.

- Collaborative team player who communicates proactively, takes direction well, and brings initiative in surfacing performance issues before they compound.

 

This role also offers bonus pay. Your ISC Talent Acquisition representative will share more details about the bonus component should you advance in the interview process.
